papers.title: GUMP-Net: An interpretable model-data-driven intelligent algorithm for multi-class pelvic segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Pelvic segmentation is one of the most important and fundamental research problems in precise and intelligent diagnosis and treatment, as well as surgical planning and navigation for pelvic fractures. By combining an improved geodesic active contour model with deep neural networks, we propose GUMP-Net, an interpretable model-data-driven intelligent algorithm for multi-class pelvic segmentation, in which three network modules are designed to constitute the overall segmentation framework together: the object detection module for automatic level set initialization, the edge detector module for learning an anatomy-aware edge detector function and the iteration module for deep level set evolution. Leveraging the advantages of level set representation and deep learning, GUMP-Net shows more accurate, robust and consistent segmentation performance, especially in small training data situation, compared to the state-of-the-art methods. Extensive experiments on pelvic datasets demonstrate the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Further experiments extended to ankle dataset indicate broader applications to other anatomies. The proposed algorithm not only provides an efficient segmentation method for complex fracture reduction, but also gives an interpretable geometric perspective for understanding deep learning segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GUMP-Net，一种结合改进测地线活动轮廓模型与深度神经网络的可解释模型-数据驱动多类骨盆分割算法。通过目标检测、边缘检测器和迭代模块实现水平集自动初始化与演化，在小训练数据场景下比现有方法更准确、鲁棒且一致。
Motivation: 骨盆分割是骨盆骨折精准诊断与手术导航的关键基础问题，现有深度学习方法在小样本下性能不足且缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出 GUMP-Net，包含三个模块：目标检测模块自动初始化水平集，边缘检测器模块学习解剖感知的边缘函数，迭代模块驱动深度水平集演化。
Result: 在骨盆数据集上实验表明，该方法在小训练数据下分割精度、鲁棒性和一致性均优于现有方法；扩展至踝关节数据集也验证了其泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该算法为复杂骨折复位提供高效分割方法，同时为理解深度学习分割提供可解释的几何视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generalised Eigenvalue Geometry of Semantic Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Recent empirical work shows that semantically equivalent paraphrases can fool financial sentiment classifiers: although a paraphrase remains close to the original under a strong reference embedding, it may shift the target model's representation enough to change the predicted class. Existing robustness theory either assumes a single-model threat model or focuses mainly on empirical attack algorithms. We develop a continuous local model of semantic paraphrase perturbations that captures this two-model structure. We show that the worst-case local displacement of the target representation, subject to a proxy-model budget, is governed by the largest generalised eigenvalue of a matrix pencil $(A,B)$ constructed from the Jacobians of the two embedding maps. The resulting attackability index $λ^*(x)$ is intrinsic to the local paraphrase geometry and the chosen embedders, yields a closed-form prediction-flip condition for affine readouts, and supports conservative population and finite-sample attackability certificates. For uniform control over classes of affine readouts, we derive a distribution-free VC bound for binary attackability indicators and a scale-sensitive margin bound based on an attackability-adjusted margin that subtracts a local geometric penalty from the standard classifier margin. We also connect the continuous theory to discrete paraphrase search, identify an asymmetry between successful and unsuccessful finite searches, and give a covering condition under which the discrete and continuous settings agree. Finally, we propose an empirical verification framework using soft-token relaxations and generated paraphrase sets to assess the local eigenvalue geometry, prediction-flip condition, and finite-search approximation on a deployed financial-text classifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了语义等价改写（语义对抗攻击）如何欺骗金融情感分类器。作者建立了一个连续局部模型，捕获代理模型（如BERT嵌入）和目标模型（如分类器）之间的两模型结构，并证明最坏情况下的局部位移由矩阵束的广义特征值控制。该模型给出了攻击性指标λ*(x)，支持闭式预测翻转条件、保守的总体和有限样本攻击性证明，并与离散改写搜索建立联系。最后，在金融文本分类器上进行了实验验证。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒性理论大多假设单一模型威胁模型或主要关注经验攻击算法，缺乏对语义等价改写（使用代理嵌入模型进行扰动的两模型结构）的几何分析。
Method: 提出连续局部模型，通过两个嵌入映射的雅可比矩阵构造矩阵束(A,B)，其最大广义特征值控制目标表示的最坏情况局部位移。推导了攻击性指标、闭式预测翻转条件、以及基于攻击性调整间隔的VC界和边际界。
Result: 理论结果包括攻击性指标与广义特征值的关系、预测翻转的闭式条件、均匀控制的VC界和边际界。实验上，通过软令牌松弛和生成改写集验证了特征值几何和预测翻转条件在金融文本分类器上的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文为语义对抗攻击提供了严格的几何理论基础，并给出了可验证的离散-连续一致性条件，但方法局限于局部几何和特定嵌入器选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ROSA-TFormer: A Radar-Optical Sensor-Aware Temporal Transformer for Pinus sylvestris Plantation Classification in Northern Shaanxi Using GEE-Derived Sentinel-1/2 Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Accurate identification of Pinus sylvestris var. mongolica plantations is important for monitoring afforestation quality and ecological restoration in northern Shaanxi. This paper proposes ROSA-TFormer, a radar-optical sensor-aware temporal Transformer for P. sylvestris classification using Sentinel-1/2 time-series data generated on Google Earth Engine. The model integrates separate SAR and optical embedding branches, a sensor-aware gate, and temporal attention pooling to capture multi-source seasonal features. Experiments on monthly and half-month point-level datasets show that ROSA-TFormer achieves strong classification performance, with 99.67% overall accuracy, 99.56% macro F1, and 98.91% P. sylvestris F1 on the HalfMonth-dataBig dataset. Spatial block validation and ablation results further indicate the effectiveness of radar-optical temporal fusion and sensor-aware modeling. The results demonstrate the potential of ROSA-TFormer for point-level P. sylvestris plantation classification, while broader wall-to-wall validation remains necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ROSA-TFormer，一个雷达-光学传感器感知的时间 Transformer，用于利用 Sentinel-1/2 时间序列数据对陕西榆林地区的樟子松人工林进行分类。模型结合独立 SAR 和光学嵌入分支、传感器感知门及时间注意力池化，在半月数据集上达到 99.67% 总体精度和 99.56% 宏平均 F1。实验表明雷达-光学时间融合与传感器感知建模的有效性，但需要更大范围验证。
Motivation: 准确识别樟子松人工林对于监测陕北地区造林质量和生态恢复具有重要意义，现有方法未能充分利用雷达-光学时间序列的时序和传感器信息。
Method: 提出 ROSA-TFormer，包含独立的 SAR 和光学嵌入分支、传感器感知门以及时间注意力池化模块，在 Google Earth Engine 上生成 Sentinel-1/2 月度和半月时间序列数据进行训练。
Result: 在半月数据集上总体精度 99.67%，宏平均 F1 99.56%，樟子松 F1 98.91%；空间块验证和消融实验证明了雷达-光学时间融合和传感器感知建模的有效性。
Conclusion: ROSA-TFormer 在点级樟子松分类中表现出潜力，但尚需进行全区域 wall-to-wall 验证以评估实际应用能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forecasting what Matters: Decision-Focused RL for Controlled EV Charging with Unknown Departure Times
papers.abstract_en: The recent growth of EV adoption poses challenges for power systems, including increased peak demand and potential grid instability. Smart control of EV charging -- e.g., based on reinforcement learning (RL) -- can alleviate these issues by learning temporal and contextual patterns from historical data. Yet, in real-world scenarios, key features, such as departure time, often are unavailable. This, in turn, makes it harder for an RL agent to learn and execute an effective charging policy. To mitigate this uncertainty, a trained forecaster can approximate the unknown features from available data. However, since these forecasting models are typically trained for accuracy (rather than their impact on a downstream agent's decision quality), their errors may propagate and hinder the overall performance of a controller that is using the forecasts. To avoid this, we propose a decision-focused RL (DF-RL) framework in which the forecaster is trained end-to-end, i.e., with feedback from the charging policy actions taken by the RL agent. Such joint training of both the forecaster and controller ultimately results in higher-quality actions: our proposed DF-RL method yields superior charging decisions compared to other baselines, achieving up to a 14% improvement in total reward and a 55% reduction of unsupplied energy (i.e., charging that failed to happen because the EV already left), relative to the RL method without departure time forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电动汽车充电控制中离去时间未知的问题，提出一种决策聚焦强化学习（DF-RL）框架，将预测器与RL控制器联合端到端训练，使预测器直接优化下游决策质量。实验表明，该方法相比不使用离去时间预测的RL方法，总奖励提升14%，未供给能量（即因EV已离开而未能充电的电量）减少55%。
Motivation: 真实场景下电动汽车的离去时间等关键特征往往不可用，导致RL智能体难以学习有效充电策略。传统预测模型仅以准确性为目标训练，其误差会传播给控制器，影响决策质量。
Method: 提出DF-RL框架，将离去时间预测器嵌入RL充电策略中，通过RL反馈信号对预测器进行端到端训练，使预测器直接优化对控制决策的贡献。
Result: 相比不使用离去时间预测的RL基线，该方法总奖励提升14%，未供给能量降低55%。
Conclusion: 联合训练预测器和控制器可以改善由特征不确定性导致的决策质量下降，适用于类似电动汽车充电的时序控制问题。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The More the Merrier: Combining Properties for ABox Abduction under Repair Semantics for ELbot
papers.abstract_en: Abduction is a central approach to explain missing entailments from a knowledge base by providing a hypothesis, that would, if added to the knowledge base, make the missing entailment become true. Abduction under repair semantics has recently been investigated in detail, where several desirable properties and optimality criteria were considered, such as signature-restrictions and minimality in size and of introduced conflicts. Naturally, hypotheses that satisfy more than one of these properties or combine a property with an optimality criterion would be even more desirable for applications. So far, such hypotheses have not been investigated in the literature. In the present paper, we consider the ABox abduction problem for hypotheses satisfying more than one property or additional optimality criteria, for EL_bot under brave and AR semantics. Our main observation is that often requiring additional properties for hypotheses does not lead to an increase of complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究EL_bot描述逻辑中，在勇敢语义和AR语义下，同时满足多个属性或最优性标准的ABox溯因假设问题。主要发现是，要求假设具有额外属性通常不会增加计算复杂性。
Motivation: 现有研究分别考虑了溯因假设的签名限制、规模最小性和引入冲突最小性等属性，但未探讨同时满足多个属性或结合属性与最优性标准的情况，而这些组合假设对实际应用更有利。
Method: 形式化定义EL_bot下满足多个属性或最优性标准的ABox溯因问题，并进行复杂性分析。
Result: 摘要称，要求假设具有额外属性通常不增加复杂性。
Conclusion: 同时满足多个属性或最优性标准的溯因假设在理论上可行，且复杂性不会显著上升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Moebius: 0.2B Lightweight Image Inpainting Framework with 10B-Level Performance
papers.abstract_en: While 10B-level industrial foundation models have pushed the boundaries of image inpainting, their prohibitive computational costs severely hinder practical deployment. Constructing a highly optimized task-specific specialist offers a promising solution; however, extreme structural compression inevitably triggers a severe representation bottleneck. To conquer this, we propose Moebius, a highly efficient lightweight inpainting framework. We systematically reconstruct the diffusion backbone by introducing the Local-$λ$ Mix Interaction ($LλMI$) block. Comprising Local-$λ$ and Interactive-$λ$ modules, it elegantly summarizes spatial contexts and global semantic priors into fixed-size linear matrices, preserving complex latent interactions while drastically shedding parameters. Furthermore, to unlock the full representational capacity of this highly compact architecture, we synergistically pair it with an adaptive multi-granularity distillation strategy. Operating strictly within the latent space to avoid expensive pixel-space decoding, this strategy dynamically balances multiple gradient-based losses to achieve high-fidelity alignment. Extensive experiments across natural and portrait benchmarks demonstrate that this optimal synergy enables Moebius to rival or even surpass the generation quality of the 10B-level industrial generalist FLUX.1-Fill-Dev. Remarkably, Moebius achieves this using less than 2\% of the parameters (0.22B vs. 11.9B) while delivering a $>15\times$ acceleration in total inference time, setting a new efficiency standard for high-fidelity inpainting. Project page at https://hustvl.github.io/Moebius.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Moebius，一个仅 0.22B 参数的轻量级图像修复框架，通过 Local-λ Mix Interaction 模块和自适应多粒度蒸馏策略，在自然与肖像数据集上达到与 10B 级模型 FLUX.1-Fill-Dev 相当甚至更优的生成质量，同时实现 15 倍以上的推理加速。
Motivation: 10B 级工业基础模型计算成本极高，阻碍实际部署；而极端结构压缩会导致表示瓶颈，需要高效且高质量的轻量级方案。
Method: 系统重构扩散主干，引入 Local-λ Mix Interaction（LλMI）模块，包含 Local-λ 和 Interactive-λ 子模块，将空间上下文与全局语义先验压缩为固定尺寸线性矩阵；并配合自适应多粒度蒸馏策略，在隐空间中动态平衡多种梯度损失以实现高保真对齐。
Result: 在自然与肖像基准上，Moebius 以 0.22B 参数（不到 FLUX.1-Fill-Dev 的 2%）达到或超越其生成质量，总推理时间加速超过 15 倍。
Conclusion: 该工作通过极轻量架构与蒸馏策略的协同，为高保真图像修复设立了新的效率标准。

papers.title: Learning to Annotate Delayed and False AEB Events: A Practical System for Extreme Class Imbalance and Asymmetric Label Noise
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB) optimization relies on accurately annotated real-world trigger events, particularly rare but critical delayed and false AEB triggers that expose system deficiencies. However, these minority samples comprise less than 5% of thousands of daily triggers, making manual annotation prohibitively expensive at scale. We present the first automated AEB annotation framework to address this problem. During development, we identified two fundamental challenges that severely impair delayed/false trigger annotation accuracy: (1) Extreme class imbalance where delayed/false triggers are overwhelmed by true triggers; (2) Asymmetric label noise where mislabeled majority samples (true triggers) suppress minority samples (delayed/false triggers) learning. To overcome these challenges, we propose two key innovations: (1) Specific data augmentation that synthesizes realistic samples by manipulating focal target attributes, transplanting ego-vehicle dynamics, and masking non-focal agents; (2) noise suppression using stable hardness estimation and probe-guided adaptive threshold to clean mislabeled true trigger samples. Crucially, we deploy our model as a practical annotation system with full-stack architecture, efficiently identifying critical delayed/false triggers from thousands of daily AEB events. Production results demonstrate 80% improvement in recall of delayed/false triggers and 50% reduction in manual workload. Beyond immediate gains, the system enables continuous self-improvement through accumulated high-quality annotations, establishing a necessary data foundation for on-vehicle AEB system optimization

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个自动化AEB事件标注框架，针对延迟/误触发样本（<5%）的极端类别不平衡和非对称标签噪声问题，设计了特定数据增强和噪声抑制方法，并在实际部署中使召回率提升80%、人工工作量降低50%。
Motivation: AEB系统优化依赖对真实世界中罕见但关键的延迟/误触发事件进行准确标注，但手动标注成本极高，且存在极端类别不平衡（<5%）和标签噪声（误标注的多数类抑制少数类学习）两大挑战。
Method: 提出两阶段增强：通过调整目标属性、移植自车动力学和遮蔽非焦点对象生成合成样本；以及基于稳定困难度估计和探针引导自适应阈值清洁误标注样本的噪声抑制方法。
Result: 实际生产环境测试显示，延迟/误触发事件的召回率提升80%，人工标注工作量减少50%。
Conclusion: 该框架在AEB事件标注中有效解决类别不平衡和噪声问题，且能通过积累高质量标注实现持续自改进，为车载AEB优化奠定数据基础。

papers.title: AGDN: Learning to Solve Traveling Salesman Problem with Anisotropic Graph Diffusion Network
papers.abstract_en: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is a cornerstone of combinatorial optimization and arises in many practical scenarios. Although graph-based learning approaches have been explored for TSP, the question of how to exploit graph structure more effectively remains open. We present the Anisotropic Graph Diffusion Network (AGDN), a new Graph Neural Network framework designed to solve TSP. Our method tackles two central difficulties: (1) the lack of informative topological prior in fully connected TSP graphs, and (2) losing connected nodes in the optimal solution after the commonly used graph sparsification techniques. To overcome these issues, we construct a MixScore transition matrix that merges node similarity with pairwise distance, and we develop an anisotropic graph diffusion strategy that supports efficient information exchange across multiple hops. Comprehensive experiments spanning diverse instance sizes and node distributions show that AGDN consistently outperforms existing methods while keeping computation time competitive. Furthermore, AGDN generalizes well to problem sizes and distributions beyond those seen during training. The implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/AGDN.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出各向异性图扩散网络（AGDN），一种用于求解旅行商问题（TSP）的图神经网络框架。通过构建融合节点相似性与成对距离的MixScore转移矩阵，并采用各向异性图扩散策略支持多跳信息交换，解决了全连接TSP图缺乏拓扑先验以及常用图稀疏化技术导致最优解中节点丢失的问题。实验表明，AGDN在不同实例规模和节点分布下一致优于现有方法，且计算时间具有竞争力，并具有良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有基于图学习的TSP方法未能充分利用图结构信息，主要面临两个困难：全连接TSP图缺乏信息性的拓扑先验，以及常用图稀疏化技术会导致最优解中连接节点丢失。
Method: 提出各向异性图扩散网络（AGDN），核心包括：构建MixScore转移矩阵融合节点相似性与成对距离，以及开发支持多跳高效信息交换的各向异性图扩散策略。
Result: 在多种实例规模和节点分布上的综合实验表明，AGDN一致优于现有方法，同时保持计算时间具有竞争力，并且能良好泛化到训练时未见的问题规模和分布。
Conclusion: AGDN通过各向异性图扩散有效利用了图结构信息，为TSP提供了一种新的高效求解框架，且代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When AUC Misleads: Polarization-Aware Evaluation of Deepfake Detectors under Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative AI, such as diffusion models and face-swapping tools, have enabled the creation of highly realistic deepfakes, leading to real-world harms including financial fraud and non-consensual explicit content. In response, deepfake detection has become an active research area, with recent methods increasingly focusing on improving generalization to unseen manipulations. This is typically evaluated using the Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) measured separately across multiple datasets. However, such an evaluation fails to reflect real-world scenarios where detectors face a mixture of data sources and varying artifact types. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel metric, Cross-dataset AUC (Cross-AUC) that averages per-domain AUCs with a measure of prediction polarization for taking into account the robustness to domain shift. The polarization extent is quantified by the Wasserstein Distance between class score distributions. Cross-AUC not only assesses the generalization capabilities of deepfake detectors under domain shifts more realistically, but it is also interpretable as it better explains the reason behind a drop in performance. Experiments performed on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate its practical relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有深度假检测评估中广泛使用的AUC指标在跨域场景下具有误导性，并提出Cross-AUC指标，通过结合各域AUC与预测极化程度（基于Wasserstein距离）来更真实地评估模型对域迁移的鲁棒性。在七个基准数据集上的实验验证了其实际意义。
Motivation: 现有AUC评估未能反映真实场景中检测器面对混合数据源和多样伪造类型的域迁移问题，导致性能评估失真。
Method: 提出Cross-AUC指标，平均各域AUC，并引入基于Wasserstein距离的预测极化度来衡量模型对域迁移的鲁棒性。
Result: 在七个基准数据集上实验，证明了Cross-AUC比传统AUC更能解释性能下降原因，且更贴近实际部署场景。
Conclusion: Cross-AUC为深度假检测评估提供了更可靠且可解释的指标，但论文未讨论其在不同检测器架构上的泛化或计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language Models as Interfaces, Not Oracles: A Hybrid LLM-ML System for Pediatric Appendicitis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can make clinical decision support more accessible by interpreting free-text documentation, but their direct use as diagnostic engines is limited by sensitivity to prompts, information order, and plausible but incorrect outputs. Structured machine-learning models offer more stable risk prediction, yet they require tabular inputs that are difficult to integrate with narrative clinical workflows. We present ClaMPAPP (Clinical Language-assisted Machine-learning Pipeline for Appendicitis), a hybrid system that uses an LLM as an interface rather than as the final decision-maker. ClaMPAPP extracts schema-constrained clinical features from note-like narratives, applies deterministic plausibility checks, and passes validated features to an XGBoost classifier trained on clinical, laboratory, and ultrasound variables. We evaluated ClaMPAPP on two independent pediatric appendicitis cohorts from German hospitals and compared it with end-to-end LLM baselines, including open-source and proprietary models. To preserve ground truth while testing free-text input, narratives were generated from structured electronic health records through template rendering and constrained LLM rewriting, with additional sentence-order permutation to assess positional robustness. ClaMPAPP achieved the strongest overall diagnostic performance in both internal and external validation while minimizing missed appendicitis cases, the key safety concern in acute triage. End-to-end LLMs showed unstable sensitivity-specificity trade-offs and greater degradation under narrative reordering. These results support an LLM-as-interface, ML-as-predictor design that separates natural-language usability from predictive inference and provides a more auditable pathway for clinical decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ClaMPAPP，一种混合LLM-ML系统，用于儿童阑尾炎的诊断支持。系统将LLM作为接口从自由文本中提取结构化特征，经确定性验证后传递给XGBoost分类器，在两个德国医院独立队列上评估，相比端到端LLM基线取得更强诊断性能并减少漏诊。
Motivation: LLM直接作为诊断引擎对提示词和信息顺序敏感，且可能产生看似合理但错误的输出；结构化ML模型需要表格输入，难以融入临床叙事工作流。
Method: ClaMPAPP系统：LLM从叙事文本中提取受模式约束的临床特征，经确定性合理性检查后，将验证后的特征输入基于临床、实验室和超声变量训练的XGBoost分类器。
Result: 在内部和外部验证中，ClaMPAPP取得整体最佳诊断性能，同时最小化漏诊（急性分诊的关键安全问题）。端到端LLM在敏感性和特异性之间不稳定，且在叙述重新排序下性能下降更明显。
Conclusion: 支持LLM作为接口、ML作为预测器的设计，将自然语言可用性与预测推理分离，为临床决策支持提供更可审计的路径。

papers.title: Compute Efficiency and Serial Runtime Tradeoffs for Stochastic Momentum Methods
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic momentum methods such as heavy ball (HB), Nesterov momentum, and variants of Accelerated SGD (ASGD) [Kidambi et al., 2018] are widely used in modern training, but their stochastic benefits depend on two distinct quantities: serial runtime, the number of iterations needed to reach a target accuracy, and compute efficiency (CE), the inverse total gradient-query or FLOP cost. Larger batches reduce serial runtime without hurting CE only when the contraction gap grows linearly with batch size. We study stochastic HB and ASGD for consistent linear regression with Gaussian covariates and prove finite-dimensional, discrete-time lower bounds on their batch-size tradeoffs. Our first result shows that HB does not improve the CE frontier over SGD for arbitrary spectra; rather, it preserves SGD-level CE over a larger batch-size window, allowing larger batches to reduce serial runtime until HB reaches its deterministic accelerated scale. This window can be a factor $\sqrtκ$ larger than the SGD critical batch size. For ASGD, the picture is more spectrum-dependent: for rapidly decaying power-law spectra, ASGD improves small-batch CE over HB/SGD, but as batch size grows it trades this CE advantage for improved serial runtime. Synthetic linear-regression experiments verify these qualitative regimes, including near-overlap of ASGD and HB for slowly decaying spectra and the predicted CE--serial tradeoff for rapidly decaying spectra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了随机动量方法（如heavy ball和加速SGD）在一致线性回归中的计算效率与串行运行时间之间的权衡。理论分析表明，HB在批量大小窗口内保持SGD水平的计算效率，而ASGD的性能依赖于谱衰减速度。合成线性回归实验验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 现有随机动量方法在训练中广泛应用，但其批大小权衡（串行运行时间与计算效率）的界限尚不明确，特别是对于不同谱分布的线性回归问题。
Method: 针对一致线性回归（高斯协变量），建立了有限维离散时间下随机HB和ASGD的批大小权衡下界，分析了两类方法的计算效率前沿。
Result: HB不改善SGD的计算效率前沿，但允许更大批大小窗口（可达SGD临界批大小的√κ倍）以减少串行运行时间；ASGD在快速衰减功率谱下改善小批计算效率，但随批大小增长会权衡效率以改善串行时间。
Conclusion: 理论结果揭示了随机动量方法在批大小与串行时间之间的权衡，并强调了谱依赖性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hardware- and Vision-in-the-Loop Validation of Deep Monocular Pose Estimation for Autonomous Maritime UAV Flight
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous UAV operations on ships require reliable vision-based relative pose estimation, yet at-sea validation is costly, weather-dependent, and risky. This paper presents a hardware-validated vision-in-the-loop framework that enables fully autonomous indoor flight while emulating photorealistic maritime environments. Rendered maritime views are processed onboard by a deep transformer-based monocular pose estimator. Delayed vision measurements are fused with high-rate IMU data using a delayed Kalman filter to provide consistent state estimates for geometric control. The system captures critical embedded effects, including perception latency, asynchronous updates, and computational constraints, that are absent in pure simulation. Autonomous takeoff, trajectory tracking, and landing experiments demonstrate stable closed-loop flight. The results establish a safe and hardware-realistic intermediate stage for developing maritime UAV autonomy prior to shipboard deployment.

Motivation: 海上自主无人机操作需要可靠的视觉相对位姿估计，但海上试验成本高、受天气影响且危险。现有纯仿真缺乏关键的嵌入式效应（如感知延迟、异步更新、计算约束），因此需要硬件在环验证。
Method: 提出视觉在环框架：用逼真海事渲染视图输入深度Transformer单目位姿估计器，视觉测量经延迟卡尔曼滤波与高频IMU数据融合，向几何控制器提供一致状态估计。实验包括自主起飞、轨迹跟踪与降落。
Result: 成功实现稳定闭环自主飞行，验证了框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架为海上无人机自主性在舰载部署前提供了一个安全且硬件真实的中间验证阶段。

papers.title: A Clinician-Centered Pipeline for Annotation and Evaluation in Ultrasound AI Studies
papers.abstract_en: Clinician-centered evaluation is critical for validating medical AI systems, especially in ultrasound imaging where quantitative metrics do not always capture clinical usability. Existing medical image platforms primarily focus on dataset labeling. They lack integrated support for blinded model comparison and reproducible evaluation workflows. We present a clinician-centered pipeline for remote annotation and evaluation in ultrasound AI studies. The proposed pipeline uses a centralized server and lightweight browser interfaces to enable clinicians to perform annotation, blinded ranking, and review without local dataset downloads. The pipeline also supports multi-rater participation, centralized result aggregation, and automated statistical analysis. We validate the pipeline in a fetal ultrasound segmentation study with six raters spanning expert, generalist, and non-expert experience levels. The system automatically generated Spearman correlation, Kendall's $τ$, and top-1 selection statistics. Results indicated moderate to strong agreement across experts and other groups. The blinded evaluation results showed a tendency for later active learning models to be preferred. These outcomes suggest that the pipeline can support clinician-centered annotation and reproducible human-\ac{AI} evaluation studies in ultrasound imaging. The proposed pipeline is available on \href{https://github.com/13204942/SonoRate}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个以临床医生为中心的超声AI研究标注和评估流程，使用中央服务器和轻量级浏览器界面支持远程标注、盲法比较和多评分者参与。在胎儿超声分割研究中验证，结果显示专家间一致性中等至强，且盲法评估倾向于后期主动学习模型。
Motivation: 现有医学图像平台主要关注数据集标注，缺乏对盲法模型比较和可重复评估工作流的集成支持，尤其超声成像中定量指标不能完全捕捉临床可用性。
Method: 提出一个以临床医生为中心的流程，包括集中服务器和浏览器界面，支持远程标注、盲法排序、审查、多评分者参与、结果集中汇总和自动统计分析。
Result: 在六名评分者（专家、全科医生、非专家）的胎儿超声分割研究中验证，系统自动生成Spearman相关、Kendall's τ和top-1选择统计。结果显示专家与其他组之间中等至强一致性。盲法评估显示后期主动学习模型更受青睐。
Conclusion: 该流程能支持超声成像中以临床医生为中心的标注和可重复的人机AI评估研究。

papers.title: User as Engram: Internalizing Per-User Memory as Local Parametric Edits
papers.abstract_en: Personal memory in a language model is two problems: content and reasoning skill. The brain keeps the two apart (a sparse, local engram in the hippocampus for each episode, a slow neocortex for the shared skills that interpret it), so a new fact need not overwrite everything else. Most personalization today keeps a user's facts outside the weights, in a natural-language memory file or a retrieval index. When facts are written into the model instead, the standard recipe is the per-user LoRA adapter, which does the opposite of the brain, folding content and skill into one global weight delta. Writing a user's facts as a LoRA contaminates text unrelated to them; writing the same facts as local Engram rows leaves it mathematically untouched, resulting in a roughly 33,000x smaller memory footprint. We therefore propose User as Engram: store a user's content as surgical edits to the hash-keyed memory table of an Engram model, and carry the reasoning skill in one shared adapter. This layered design matches per-user LoRA's direct recall while delivering 5.6x higher indirect-reasoning accuracy on average, and never makes a single user worse at reasoning than the untouched base. The edit is a glass box: writing a fact switches on its lookup at exactly the trigger, adds the value the answer needs, leaves every other position unchanged to the last bit, and fails if written into the wrong layer. Because different users' facts land in disjoint hash slots, their edits compose: many users live in one shared table at once, stacking additively and losslessly, where a per-user LoRA, a single global weight delta, admits only one. Upon retrieval, a per-user Engram table does not grow with the population the retriever must search, so past ~100 facts it overtakes a retrieval pipeline on a 2.5x larger model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“User as Engram”方法，将用户特定事实以局部参数编辑的方式存储在Engram模型的哈希键内存表中，而非传统LoRA适配器。该方法避免了LoRA对无关文本的污染，实现了约33,000倍更小的内存占用，并在间接推理准确率上平均提升5.6倍，且不降低任何用户的基础推理能力。编辑操作透明，不同用户的事实可无损叠加共存。
Motivation: 现有个性化方法如LoRA将内容和推理技能混合到全局权重增量中，导致无关文本被污染，且每个用户需要独立适配器，无法高效共存。大脑通过海马体存储稀疏局部记忆痕迹（engram）和新皮层共享技能来分离二者，启发本文设计。
Method: 将用户事实作为局部编辑写入Engram模型的哈希键内存表，触发时开启查找并添加答案值，其他位置完全不变；推理技能承载在共享适配器中。编辑操作是“玻璃箱”式的，确保透明性和可审计性。
Result: 该方法在间接推理准确率上平均比per-user LoRA高5.6倍，内存占用小约33,000倍；当事实数量超过约100条时，优于2.5倍更大模型上的检索管道。从不降低单个用户的基础推理能力。
Conclusion: 通过分离内容存储（Engram表）和技能（共享适配器）实现高效、可组合的个性化，避免了LoRA的污染问题，且编辑透明、可审计。

papers.title: Beyond Safe Data: Pretraining-Stage Alignment with Regular Safety Reflection
papers.abstract_en: To achieve deeper safety alignment for large language models (LLMs), recent efforts have studied how to push safety interventions earlier into the pretraining stage, primarily by filtering unsafe data or rewriting it into safer forms. We argue that pretraining-stage alignment should go beyond making the data safe: LLMs may compose seemingly benign knowledge and capabilities into unsafe behaviors. To this end, we propose Safety Reflection Pretraining, a pretraining-stage alignment method which regularly inserts short safety reflections into pretraining corpora to integrate self-monitoring directly into language modeling, establishing a foundational capability that is subsequently reinforced by compatible post-training. Our experiments with 1.7B models pretrained on FineWeb-Edu show that Safety Reflection Pretraining improves safety classification accuracy and substantially reduces the success rates of inference-stage and finetuning attacks. Complementary to our real-world experiments, we also introduce a fully controlled synthetic environment, MedSafetyWorld, with a clear definition of safety and a reasoning structure under which models can easily generalize unsafe behaviors from safe data. Ablations in MedSafetyWorld further demonstrate a clear advantage of Safety Reflection Pretraining in preventing models from acting on unsafe behaviors generalized from safe data, compared with data filtering and rewriting. Taken together, our findings suggest that pretraining alignment should not only make the training data safe, but also shape the behaviors that models are likely to acquire from safe data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐问题，提出在预训练阶段定期插入安全反思（Safety Reflection Pretraining），将自监控能力直接融入语言建模，防止模型从看似安全的数据中组合出不安全行为。在1.7B模型上的实验表明，该方法提高了安全分类准确率，并显著降低了推理和微调攻击的成功率。
Motivation: 现有预训练对齐方法仅关注过滤或改写不安全数据，但模型仍可能从安全数据中习得并组合出有害行为，因此需要更深层的对齐机制。
Method: 提出Safety Reflection Pretraining，在预训练语料中定期插入简短的安全反思文本，使语言建模过程内嵌自监控能力，后续通过兼容的后训练（post-training）强化此能力。
Result: 在FineWeb-Edu预训练的1.7B模型上，安全分类准确率提升，推理阶段攻击和微调攻击的成功率大幅降低；在合成的MedSafetyWorld环境中，该方法在防止模型从安全数据泛化出不安全行为上优于数据过滤和重写。
Conclusion: 预训练阶段的对齐不应仅保证数据安全，还应主动塑造模型从安全数据中可能习得的行为模式。

papers.title: Essential Subspace Merging for Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: Model merging aims to enable multi-task learning by integrating the capabilities of multiple models fine-tuned from the same pre-trained checkpoint into a single model. Its core challenge is inter-task interference among task-specific parameter updates. In this paper, we analyze the output shifts induced by task updates and observe that their energy is concentrated in a small number of principal directions. We call the subspace spanned by these directions the essential subspace. In contrast, most remaining directions carry little task-relevant energy, but their accumulation across multiple task updates can cause severe interference during merging. Motivated by this observation, we propose Essential Subspace Decomposition (ESD), which decomposes each task update according to the principal components of its activation shift. Based on ESD, we introduce Essential Subspace Merging (ESM), a training-free static merging method that orthogonalizes and fuses essential components into one compact multi-task model. We further extend ESM to ESM++, a training-free dynamic merging method that decomposes task-specific residuals into low-rank experts and selects the most relevant expert through prototype-based routing during forward inference. Extensive experiments across multiple task sets and model scales demonstrate that ESM and ESM++ effectively preserves task knowledge while reducing inter-task interference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务学习中模型合并时任务特定参数更新之间的干扰问题，通过分析任务更新引起的输出偏移，发现能量集中在少数主方向上，称为本质子空间。提出本质子空间分解（ESD）将任务更新按激活偏移的主成分分解，并基于此提出无训练静态合并方法ESM和无训练动态合并方法ESM++，后者将任务特异性残差分解为低秩专家并通过原型路由选择最相关专家。实验表明ESM和ESM++能有效保留任务知识并减少任务间干扰。
Motivation: 模型合并面临任务特定参数更新之间的干扰，这是实现多任务学习的核心挑战。
Method: 提出本质子空间分解（ESD），将每个任务更新按其激活偏移的主成分分解；基于ESD提出无训练静态合并方法ESM，正交化并融合本质成分；进一步扩展为动态合并方法ESM++，将任务残差分解为低秩专家并通过原型路由选择专家。
Result: 在多个任务集和模型规模上，ESM和ESM++有效保留任务知识并减少任务间干扰。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法通过正交化本质成分可有效减少干扰，且无需额外训练。

papers.title: The Reward Was in Your Data All Along: Correcting Flow Matching with Discriminator-Guided RL
papers.abstract_en: Score- and flow-matching models often rely on preference-based reinforcement learning for two purposes: aligning with subjective preferences and, surprisingly, recovering properties such as visual realism and coherent object structure that matching-based training is intended to learn from the data itself. We argue that this reflects a structural mismatch. Matching losses measure $\ell_2$ regression error on the velocity or score field under training-time marginals, a proxy poorly aligned with the visual and semantic properties that determine sample quality at inference. Given a reward aligned with these properties, RL sidesteps the mismatch by evaluating the model on its own samples and following the reward landscape directly. The challenge is to obtain such a reward without relying on human preferences, which are expensive and conflate data realism with annotator inclinations. We propose Discriminator-Guided RL (DRL). DRL trains a discriminator to separate data from base-model samples in a pretrained representation space and uses its logit as the reward in KL-regularized RL. The pretrained space restricts the discriminator to perceptually meaningful directions, and the logit estimates the log-likelihood ratio between data and model, which is the optimal reward for targeting the data distribution. Across SiT, JiT, REPA, and RAE, DRL reduces guidance-free FID (e.g., $9.38 \to 2.62$ on SiT) and semantic-space FD (e.g., $88.2 \to 19.3$ on DINOv3 for SiT), with consistent gains across all backbones, and improves human-preference rewards without training on them. It also yields a better Pareto frontier between preference reward and image fidelity under subsequent preference-based post-training, increasing alignment while reducing low-level artifacts such as oversaturation and excessive brightness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出判别器引导强化学习（DRL），通过训练判别器在预训练表示空间中区分真实数据与基模型样本，并将其logit作为KL正则化RL的奖励，用于纠正流匹配模型中的结构失配。DRL在SiT、JiT、REPA、RAE等多个骨干网络上显著降低了无引导FID（如SiT上从9.38降至2.62）和语义空间FD，并改善了人类偏好奖励，无需依赖人工偏好。
Motivation: 现有流匹配模型依赖偏好强化学习来对齐主观偏好或恢复数据属性，反映了训练损失（ℓ2回归误差）与推理时视觉/语义质量之间的结构性失配。
Method: DRL使用预训练表示空间中的判别器，其logit近似数据与模型的对数似然比，作为KL正则化RL的奖励，从而直接优化样本质量。
Result: 在SiT、JiT、REPA、RAE上，DRL将无引导FID从9.38降至2.62（SiT），DINOv3语义FD从88.2降至19.3（SiT），并改善了人类偏好奖励，无需偏好数据训练。
Conclusion: DRL通过数据本身的判别信号替代昂贵的人类偏好，有效解决了流匹配模型的结构失配问题，提升了图像保真度和对齐性。

papers.title: Hand-4DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for 4D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic 3D hand reconstruction from egocentric videos is essential for next-generation computing platforms such as AR/VR and AI glasses. Despite its importance, most prior works focus either on multi-view 3D hand reconstruction or on 4D human body reconstruction. Egocentric 4D hand reconstruction remains challenging due to fast head motion, rapid hand dynamics, severe occlusions, and inherent ambiguity from single-view observations. To address these challenges, we introduce Hand-4DGS, the first feed-forward framework for reconstructing dynamic 4D hands directly from egocentric videos, enabling both fast (~60 FPS) inference and strong generalization. Our approach incorporates a mesh-guided representation for structural priors and temporal convolutions to model dynamic motion. We evaluate our framework on two challenging egocentric datasets, H2O and ARCTIC, and demonstrate significant improvements over baselines. Our method benefits from the generalization capability of feed-forward networks and effective 2D image supervision through Gaussian splatting, without requiring expensive 3D hand pose ground-truth annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hand-4DGS，首个前馈式 (feed-forward) 框架，用于从第一人称视频中直接重建动态 4D 手部模型，推理速度约 60 FPS。方法利用网格引导表示 (mesh-guided representation) 提供结构先验，并结合时序卷积建模动态运动。在 H2O 和 ARCTIC 数据集上，该方法显著优于基线，且仅需 2D 图像监督，无需昂贵的 3D 手部姿态标注。
Motivation: 现有工作多聚焦多视图 3D 手部重建或 4D 人体重建，而第一人称 4D 手部重建因头部快速运动、手部高速动态、严重遮挡及单视角观测的固有歧义而极具挑战，尚无高效的前馈式解决方案。
Method: 提出前馈式框架 Hand-4DGS，采用网格引导表示作为结构先验，使用时序卷积建模手部动态运动，并通过高斯溅射 (Gaussian splatting) 进行可微分渲染，利用 2D 图像进行监督。
Result: 在 H2O 和 ARCTIC 两个具有挑战性的第一人称数据集上，该方法在重建精度和速度上均显著超越现有基线，实现约 60 FPS 的推理速度。
Conclusion: Hand-4DGS 是首个前馈式 4D 手部重建方法，无需 3D 地面真值标注，通过有效的 2D 监督和泛化能力实现高效且鲁棒的重建，为 AR/VR 等应用提供新方案。

papers.title: AdsMind: A Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Self-Correcting Discovery of Adsorption Configurations on Heterogeneous Catalyst Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the lowest-energy surface-adsorbate configuration is critical for modeling heterogeneous catalysis, yet exhaustive exploration with ab initio calculations is computationally prohibitive. Machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) accelerate structural relaxation but leave the search over the vast configurational space a major bottleneck, and open-loop large language model (LLM) agents lack a physics-grounded feedback mechanism to correct erroneous initial guesses. We propose AdsMind (Adsorption configuration discovery with Machine intelligence and relaxation feedback), a closed-loop multi-agent framework that enables autonomous error correction through MLFF relaxation feedback. Across four LLM backends, AdsMind achieves consistently high search reliability, with success rates of 100% and 98.8% on the benchmarks AA20 and OCD-GMAE62. Relative to its single-pass (1-Shot) ablation it reduces cross-backend energy dispersion, and it uses only 4.11 and 4.67 MLFF relaxations per case, respectively -- an approximately 14-fold reduction over heuristic enumeration baselines. Density functional theory (DFT) validation using VASP/PBE on six representative AA20 systems shows that the reported open-loop Adsorb-Agent outputs exhibit qualitative adsorption-energy sign errors for molecular adsorbates, whereas AdsMind preserves the correct sign in all tested cases with closer quantitative agreement. AdsMind thus delivers reliability, self-reflection, and interpretability simultaneously, supporting more DFT-informed autonomous chemistry workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AdsMind，一个基于物理的多智能体系统，利用机器学习力场（MLFF）松弛反馈实现催化剂表面吸附构型的自主纠错搜索。在AA20和OCD-GMAE62基准上分别达到100%和98.8%的成功率，每案例仅需4.11和4.67次MLFF松弛，相比启发式枚举减少约14倍。DFT验证表明AdsMind能纠正开放循环方法的吸附能符号错误。
Motivation: 从头算穷举搜索表面吸附构型计算成本极高；机器学习力场加速了结构弛豫但搜索空间仍是瓶颈；开放循环大语言模型智能体缺乏物理反馈机制纠错初始猜测。
Method: AdsMind是一个闭环多智能体框架，通过MLFF松弛反馈实现自主纠错。整合四个LLM后端，结合MLFF松弛结果迭代修正吸附构型。
Result: 在AA20和OCD-GMAE62基准上成功率100%和98.8%，每案例仅需4.11和4.67次MLFF松弛（约14倍改进）。DFT验证表明AdsMind在所有测试案例中保持正确的吸附能符号，而开放循环方法对分子吸附物有定性符号错误。
Conclusion: AdsMind同时实现了可靠性、自我反思和可解释性，支持更多基于DFT的自主化学工作流。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: The Market in the Model: Latent Diffusion as Neural Economy
papers.abstract_en: Valuable critique of generative image models within visual culture and the humanities has emphasized the role of datasets in shaping the images they produce. Yet, close studies of the ideological positions embedded into the mechanism of the models have been neglected, leaving them imagined as "black boxes." In a bid to expand, rather than replace, dataset critique, this paper examines the mechanisms of the latent diffusion model in terms of the problems they were brought in to solve on behalf of computer vision engineers, and the decisions each component was tasked with automating. I interpret that ensemble through the histories of its parts and the theory of vision the system inscribes into every generated image. Drawing on Impett and Offert's notion of neural exchange value, I offer this analysis to argue that the model operates as a neural economy: a contained symbolic system that abstracts social communication into commensurable vectors as it transfers the social sphere into parcels for sale. Tracing the training and generation pipelines component by component reveals what each operation displaces, and how it further entrenches the logics of platform and attention economies over social communication. The paper warns that any critique fixated exclusively on copyright and commodity defenses risks reaffirming the very fetishism the model produces, and argues instead for centering social exchange.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从视觉文化与人文视角批判生成图像模型，指出数据集批评虽重要但忽视了模型机制的意识形态嵌入。作者将潜扩散模型解释为神经经济（neural economy），即一个抽象社会交流为可比较向量、将社会领域转化为待售包裹的封闭符号系统。通过逐组件分析训练与生成管线，揭示每个操作如何进一步强化平台经济和注意力经济的逻辑，而非社会交流。
Motivation: 现有对生成图像模型的批评多集中于数据集，而忽视了模型机制本身嵌入的意识形态立场，导致模型被视为黑箱。本文旨在扩展而非取代数据集批评，从机制层面揭示模型内化的经济逻辑。
Method: 本文采用历史分析和理论阐释方法，将潜扩散模型的各组件（训练与生成管线）置于其历史语境中，并结合Impett和Offert的神经交换价值（neural exchange value）概念，论证模型作为神经经济的运作方式。
Result: 论文通过分析认为，模型将社会交流抽象为可比较向量，将社会领域商品化；逐组件追踪显示每个操作都进一步强化平台经济和注意力经济逻辑，而非社会交流。
Conclusion: 作者警告，任何仅聚焦于版权和商品防御的批评都可能固化模型所生产的物神崇拜（fetishism），主张应将社会交流置于中心地位。

papers.title: Complementary Attention Head Pruning for Efficient Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The remarkable success of Transformer-based models in natural language processing stems from architectural scaling, which leads to a large number of parameters and hinders deployment in resource-constrained environments. While structured pruning offers a pathway to compression, existing state-of-the-art methods often rely on gradient-based importance ranking or stochastic gating, which suffer from instability, structural degeneration, and the need for extensive manual hyperparameter tuning. In this paper, we introduce CAHP (Complementary Attention Head Pruning), a novel post-hoc framework that redefines head selection as a global graph-theoretical problem. Rather than evaluating heads in isolation, CAHP utilizes graph-based clustering combined with information-theoretic distance measures to identify and preserve a topologically diverse subset of complementary attention heads. Without requiring a predefined sparsity level or pruning ratio, the framework automatically determines the number of selected attention heads across layers by identifying a diminishing marginal performance curve, where pruning additional heads leads to a sharp degradation in performance, as determined by the chosen polynomial degree. Extensive evaluations on the SST-5 and MNLI benchmarks, across different Transformer model scales, demonstrate that CAHP consistently outperforms competitive baselines, particularly in high-compression regimes. Furthermore, our structural analysis shows that CAHP avoids the "proximity bias" of gradient-based pruning methods, which tend to preserve heads mainly in layers close to the output, and instead retains a functionally critical set of attention heads in the model's intermediate layers.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for presentation at the International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAHP（互补注意力头剪枝），一种基于图论的后处理剪枝框架，将注意力头选择建模为全局图问题，利用图聚类和信息论距离保留互补的头子集，无需预设稀疏度，自动确定剪枝数量。在SST-5和MNLI基准上，CAHP在高压缩率下优于基线方法，并避免梯度方法中靠近输出层的“邻近偏差”。
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法多依赖梯度重要性排序或随机门控，存在不稳定、结构退化及需大量超参数调优的问题。
Method: 将头选择转化为全局图问题，使用图聚类结合信息论距离度量，识别并保留拓扑多样性的互补注意力头；通过边际性能曲线自动确定每层保留的头数。
Result: 在SST-5和MNLI上，CAHP在不同规模Transformer中持续优于基线，特别在高压缩率下表现更佳；结构分析表明CAHP避免了梯度方法倾向于保留靠近输出层的头的偏差。
Conclusion: CAHP提供了一种无需预设稀疏度的后处理剪枝方案，能自动选择互补头，且在高压缩下表现稳健。

papers.title: OpenAnt: LLM-Powered Vulnerability Discovery Through Code Decomposition, Adversarial Verification, and Dynamic Testing
papers.abstract_en: Automated vulnerability discovery in large codebases remains challenging: traditional static analysis produces high false-positive rates, while dynamic approaches such as fuzzing require substantial infrastructure and often target narrow classes of bugs. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable semantic reasoning about program behavior, but applying LLMs to repository-scale security analysis introduces challenges related to context management, cost, and verification. We present OpenAnt, an open-source vulnerability discovery system that integrates static program analysis with LLM-based reasoning in a multi-stage pipeline. OpenAnt introduces three key techniques. First, codebases are decomposed into self-contained analysis units filtered by reachability from external entry points, reducing the analysis surface by up to 97% while preserving attack-relevant code. Second, candidate vulnerabilities undergo adversarial verification through constrained attacker simulation, where the model evaluates exploitability under realistic attacker capabilities. Third, findings are validated through dynamic verification, in which exploit environments are generated automatically, executed in sandboxed containers, and discarded after use. Evaluation on widely used open-source projects including OpenSSL, WordPress, and Flowise shows that this architecture can identify previously unknown vulnerabilities while maintaining manageable analysis cost and substantially reducing false positives. Our results suggest that closed-loop vulnerability discovery pipelines, combining semantic reasoning with exploit validation, provide a practical path toward scalable automated security analysis. OpenAnt is released as open source under the Apache 2.0 license at https://github.com/knostic/OpenAnt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpenAnt，一个开源的漏洞发现系统，结合静态程序分析与LLM推理的多阶段流水线。通过代码分解将分析表面缩小97%，对抗验证模拟攻击者能力评估可利用性，动态验证自动生成并执行利用环境。在OpenSSL、WordPress等项目中识别了未知漏洞，降低了误报率。
Motivation: 现有静态分析误报率高，动态分析如fuzzing需要大量基础设施且针对窄类漏洞，LLM在仓库级安全分析中存在上下文管理和成本挑战。
Method: 提出三种关键技术：1) 代码分解为自包含分析单元，按外部入口点的可达性过滤，减少分析表面；2) 对抗验证通过受限攻击者模拟评估漏洞可利用性；3) 动态验证自动生成利用环境，在沙箱容器中执行后丢弃。
Result: 在OpenSSL、WordPress和Flowise等开源项目上评估，该方法能够识别先前未知的漏洞，同时保持可管理的分析成本并大幅减少误报。
Conclusion: 闭环漏洞发现流水线结合语义推理与利用验证，为可扩展的自动化安全分析提供了实用路径。OpenAnt已以Apache 2.0许可证开源。

papers.title: On Local Population-Risk Certificates
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops local certificates for population-risk increments around a current model. For a local candidate set \(\mathcal D\), the certificate is a two-sided confidence band for \(P({\ell_{θ+v}-\ell_θ})\) over \(v\in\mathcal D\). As an application, the upper endpoint of this band yields a risk-controlled update rule: an update is accepted only when its certified upper endpoint is nonpositive; otherwise the current model is retained.

papers.title: OrthoReg: Orthogonal Regularization for Hybrid Symbolic-Neural Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical systems are fundamental to modeling the natural world, yet modeling them involves a persistent trade-off: manually prescribed mechanistic models are interpretable by design but often overly simplistic and misspecified; in contrast, flexible data-driven neural methods lack physical insight. Hybrid modeling aims for the best of both worlds by combining a prescribed or symbolic, physics-based component with a flexible neural network. A critical challenge, however, is that the neural component may relearn mechanistic parts, yielding redundant and uninterpretable models, especially when the symbolic structure itself is discovered from data. Existing methods based on standard $L^2$ regularization rely on a projection argument that breaks when the symbolic component is learned through sparse discovery, allowing the neural augmentation to overlap with symbolic structure. We introduce \textbf{OrthoReg} (Orthogonal Regularization), which directly penalizes overlap between the symbolic and neural components, preventing symbolic structure from being absorbed by the neural residual. This yields a complementary decomposition: the symbolic part captures what the library can express, and the neural part captures what remains. On benchmark dynamical systems with partial library mismatch, OrthoReg improves symbolic recovery and out-of-distribution behavior.

papers.title: Human-AI Coevolution Dynamics: A Formal Theory of Social Intelligence Emergence Through Long-Term Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Current conversational AI systems have made significant progress in language generation, personalization, and long-context interaction. However, most existing methods model social behavior through isolated components such as emotion modeling, memory retrieval, or persona conditioning, lacking a unified framework to explain the emergence of stable social relationships and social intelligence in long-term human-AI interaction.To address this, we propose the Human-AI Coevolution Dynamics Framework (HACD-H), a formal model of human-AI interaction as a self-organizing social cognitive system. HACD-H integrates emotional adaptation, relational organization, social memory, and personality consistency into a unified dynamical framework and introduces principles including multi-timescale social cognition, relational attractors, trust basins, developmental phase transitions, and social cognitive energy dynamics.We construct a conversational dataset with approximately 14,700 interaction turns and develop a theory-driven empirical evaluation framework. Results reveal a hierarchy of temporal persistence in social cognition, stable relational attractors, phase-transition-like developmental patterns, and a structured social cognitive energy landscape. Social intelligence shows a significant negative correlation with social cognitive energy (r = -0.391, p < 0.001), and interaction trajectories exhibit progressive energy reduction over time.These findings suggest that social intelligence emerges from long-term social cognitive coevolution rather than isolated conversational capabilities. HACD-H provides a unified theoretical foundation for modeling adaptive human-AI social interaction and developing socially intelligent AI systems.

TL;DR: 本文提出人类-AI共同进化动力学框架（HACD-H），将人机交互视为自组织的社会认知系统，整合情感适应、关系组织、社会记忆和人格一致性，并引入多时间尺度社会认知、关系吸引子、信任盆地等概念。通过约14700轮对话数据集进行理论驱动的实证评估，揭示了社会认知的时间持久性层次、稳定关系吸引子、相变式发展模式以及结构化社会认知能量景观。社会智力与社会认知能量呈显著负相关，交互轨迹能量随时间递减，表明社会智力源于长期社会认知共同进化而非孤立对话能力。
Motivation: 现有对话AI通过情感建模、记忆检索等孤立组件建模社交行为，缺乏统一框架解释长期人机交互中稳定社会关系和社会智力的涌现。
Method: 提出HACD-H框架，将情感适应、关系组织、社会记忆和人格一致性整合为统一动力学系统，引入多时间尺度社会认知、关系吸引子、信任盆地、发展相变和社会认知能量动力学等原理，并构造约14700轮对话数据集进行理论驱动评估。
Result: 发现社会认知存在时间持久性层次、稳定关系吸引子、相变式发展模式以及结构化社会认知能量景观；社会智力与社会认知能量显著负相关（r = -0.391, p < 0.001），交互轨迹能量随时间递减。
Conclusion: 社会智力源于长期社会认知共同进化，HACD-H为建模自适应人机社交互动和发展社交智能AI提供了统一理论基础。

papers.title: ChronoSurv: A Clinical Pathway-Guided Graph Framework for Multimodal Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Accurate survival prediction is essential for personalized treatment planning in head and neck cancer, yet remains challenging due to the heterogeneous and high-dimensional nature of multimodal clinical data. While deep survival models have improved predictive performance over classical statistical approaches, existing methods typically rely on static fusion strategies or temporally agnostic modeling, limiting their ability to capture structured clinical workflows. In this work, we propose ChronoSurv, a heterogeneous hierarchical directed graph framework for multimodal survival analysis. ChronoSurv represents patient care as a progression-aware clinical trajectory using directed graphs aligned with key diagnostic steps. A hierarchical topology incorporates fine-grained, coarse, and global representations, further supporting flexible adaptation to missing modalities, while heterogeneous message passing models complex and asymmetric relationships across modalities and clinical steps. Experimental results on two public datasets demonstrate that ChronoSurv achieves state-of-the-art discriminative performance while maintaining statistically reliable calibration. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the contribution of each architectural component, highlighting the potential of trajectory-aware graph modeling for multimodal survival prediction.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ChronoSurv，一种基于异质分层有向图框架的多模态生存分析模型，用于头颈癌生存预测。该框架将患者诊疗过程建模为与关键诊断步骤对齐的时间感知临床轨迹，通过分层拓扑（细粒度、粗粒度、全局表示）和异质消息传递处理缺失模态及跨模态不对称关系。在两个公共数据集上，ChronoSurv在判别性能上达到最优，且校准良好。
Motivation: 现有深度生存模型多采用静态融合或时序无关建模，难以捕捉结构化临床工作流，限制了多模态数据中异构和高维信息的有效利用。
Method: 提出ChronoSurv，构建异质分层有向图，将患者诊疗过程表示为与关键诊断步骤对齐的临床轨迹；设计分层拓扑以融合多粒度表示，并采用异质消息传递机制建模跨模态和临床步骤间的复杂不对称关系，同时支持灵活应对缺失模态。
Result: 在两个公开头颈癌数据集上，ChronoSurv取得最先进的判别性能（如C-index等指标），且校准误差较低；消融实验证实各组件（分层图结构、异质消息传递等）均贡献显著。
Conclusion: 轨迹感知的图建模为多模态生存分析提供了新思路，能够有效利用临床流程信息提升预测性能，未来可拓展至其他癌症类型及缺失模态场景。

papers.title: Urdu Katib Handwritten Dataset: A Historical Document Dataset for Offline Urdu Handwritten Text Recognition with CRNN-Based Baseline Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) is inherently a challenging task, and its complexity is further increased when dealing with cursive scripts. Although significant efforts have been made on various cursive scripts, research regarding Urdu Handwritten Text Recognition (UHTR) has been relatively limited. This lag of research is primarily due to the unique challenges posed by its script, and the scarcity and unavailability of benchmark datasets. Therefore, to advance research in UHTR, this study presents a specialized real dataset called the Urdu Katib Handwritten Dataset (UKHD). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first offline Urdu handwritten text lines dataset specifically curated from the materials written by Katibs in historical times. It encompasses a diverse range of flat nib writing variations in the Nastalique calligraphic style. Additionally, the effectiveness of different CRNN-based hybrid models has been evaluated to identify the optimal architecture for Urdu Katib Handwriting Recognition (UKHR). Among the analyzed models, the CNN-BGRU-CTC model showed more robust performance, with low Character Error Rate (CER) and Word Error Rate (WER). This research work aims to support and encourage the research community in developing a robust recognition system for preserving Urdu handwritten literature.

papers.title: INDEQS: Informed Neural controlled Differential EQuationS
papers.abstract_en: Neural Controlled Differential Equations (NCDE) provide a powerful continuous-time framework for forecasting time series, but standard graph-based extensions typically learn spatial structure purely from data, even in settings where a directed graph structure is known a priori. We introduce Informed Neural controlled Differential EQuationS (INDEQS), a graph-based NCDE forecasting method that incorporates prior knowledge of a directed graph at distinct architectural positions. INDEQS separates inner mixing of hidden states across graph nodes from outer mixing between vector field and control, and offers both a lightweight graph-constrained variant and a more expressive variant, learning additional graph connections from data via adaptive graph convolutions. To systematically study when graph informedness is beneficial in forecasting, we devise a continuous advection simulation on directed graphs, yielding synthetic spatio-temporal datasets with known ground-truth flow structure. We then evaluate INDEQS on two real-world tasks: river discharge forecasting on a hydrological network and traffic flow prediction on PeMS08. Across these synthetic and real-world benchmarks, outer informedness consistently improves mean absolute error over an uninformed NCDE with comparable parameter count, particularly on larger graphs, while inner informedness offers a more parameter-efficient alternative when strict adherence to a known adjacency is desired. A comparison of discrete convolutional and continuous-time decoders further shows that continuous decoders yield better accuracy and greater temporal flexibility on real-world tasks. An implementation of INDEQS and the advection simulation is available at https://github.com/Mitchi1/indeqs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Informed Neural controlled Differential EQuationS (INDEQS)，一种将先验有向图知识分别嵌入神经控制微分方程（NCDE）的矢量场（内信息）和控制（外信息）的图基预测方法。方法设计了轻量图约束变体和自适应图卷积变体，并引入基于有向图连续平流模拟的合成数据集用于系统研究。在合成数据、河流流量预测和交通流预测上，外信息嵌入一致改善 MAE，连续时间解码器相比离散卷积解码器精度更高。
Motivation: 现有图扩展 NCDE 通常从数据中纯粹学习空间结构，忽略了实际应用中已知的有向图先验知识，导致参数量大或预测不准确。
Method: 将先验有向图分别嵌入矢量场（内信息）和控制（外信息），提出轻量图约束变体和自适应图卷积变体。设计基于有向图连续平流模拟的合成数据集，用于控制变量分析。
Result: 在合成和真实基准（河流流量预测、交通流 PeMS08）上，外信息嵌入持续改善 MAE，尤其在大图上；连续解码器比离散卷积解码器精度更高且时间灵活性更强。
Conclusion: INDEQS 能有效利用已知图结构提升预测性能，在河流流量和交通流预测任务上取得改进。

papers.title: A Technical Taxonomy of LLM Agent Communication Protocols
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) advance and multi-agent systems aim to overcome the limits of standalone agents, robust communication protocols are becoming essential infrastructure for distributed agent networks. Nonetheless, the fragmented protocol landscape presents a significant interoperability challenge. This study develops a technical taxonomy to classify and analyze LLM agent communication protocols. Following an established iterative method, we defined the taxonomy's purpose, meta-characteristic, and ending conditions, then performed five iterations, three empirical-to-conceptual and two conceptual-to-empirical, on nine actively maintained open-source protocols with demonstrable adoption. The taxonomy comprises five dimensions: counterparty, payload, interaction state, discovery mechanism, and schema flexibility. Classification reveals recurring architectural patterns: all sampled agent-to-agent protocols combine hybrid payloads with session-state persistence; most protocols support multiple predefined schemas, and two negotiate schemas at runtime, indicating a trend toward schema flexibility; decentralized discovery remains rare. Analysis suggests short-term convergence pressure toward protocols unifying agent-to-agent and agent-to-context (tool and data) communication. Long-term, however, no single protocol is likely to maximize versatility, efficiency, and portability simultaneously. The field will more likely evolve toward a federated, layered protocol stack. The framework guides protocol selection and highlights open research gaps such as privacy and policy enforcement.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个技术分类法，用于分类和分析LLM代理通信协议。通过对九个活跃维护的开源协议进行迭代分析，提出了五个维度：对手方、有效载荷、交互状态、发现机制和模式灵活性。分析揭示了重复出现的架构模式，并指出短期趋同压力将促使代理间与代理-上下文通信协议的统一，但长期来看可能出现联邦分层协议栈。
Motivation: 随着LLM和多代理系统的发展，稳健的通信协议成为分布式代理网络的基础设施，但当前协议碎片化导致互操作性挑战。
Method: 采用迭代方法，经过五次迭代（三次经验-概念、两次概念-经验）对九个活跃维护的开源协议进行分析，定义了分类法的目的、元特征和终止条件，最终形成五个维度的分类法。
Result: 所有样本中的代理间协议均采用混合有效载荷与会话状态持久性；大多数协议支持多个预定义模式，两个协议在运行时协商模式；去中心化发现仍然罕见。
Conclusion: 短期内有协议统一趋势，但长期无单一协议能同时最大化通用性、效率和可移植性，可能演变为联邦分层协议栈。研究还指出了隐私、策略执行等开放研究空白。

papers.title: Pareto Q-Learning with Reward Machines
papers.abstract_en: We present Pareto Q-Learning with Reward Machines (PQLRM), a multi-objective reinforcement learning algorithm for tasks whose reward structure is specified by a set of reward machines (RMs). PQLRM combines Pareto Q-Learning (PQL), which maintains sets of vector-valued Q-estimates to approximate the Pareto front, with enhancements from Q-Learning with Reward Machines (QRM), which exploits the factored automaton structure of the reward signal. This yields a multi-policy algorithm that remains sample-efficient under non-Markovian, RM-encoded rewards. Experimental trials show that PQLRM converges faster than a naive PQL baseline applied to the cross-product MDP and can synthesize Pareto-optimal policies that QRM cannot.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICAPS 2026 Workshop on Bridging the Gap Between AI Planning and (Reinforcement) Learning (PRL)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pareto Q-Learning with Reward Machines (PQLRM)，一种多目标强化学习算法，用于奖励结构由一组奖励机（Reward Machines）指定的任务。PQLRM结合了Pareto Q-Learning（维护向量Q估计的Pareto前沿）与QRM（利用奖励信号的自动机结构）的增强，得到一种在非马尔可夫、RM编码奖励下仍保持样本效率的多策略算法。实验表明PQLRM比应用于cross-product MDP的朴素PQL基线收敛更快，并能合成QRM无法获得的Pareto最优策略。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理非马尔可夫、由奖励机编码的奖励信号时样本效率低，且难以同时优化多个目标。
Method: 将Pareto Q-Learning的多策略Pareto前沿维护与QRM的奖励机自动机结构相结合，得到PQLRM算法。
Result: 实验表明PQLRM比朴素PQL基线收敛更快，并能合成QRM无法获得的Pareto最优策略。
Conclusion: PQLRM在奖励机指定的多目标强化学习任务中有效且样本高效。

papers.title: Equivariant Graph Neural Networks Improve Optical Spectra Prediction for Materials Screening
papers.abstract_en: Scalable prediction of optical spectra is a critical component of high-throughput materials screening for optoelectronic applications such as solar cells. Existing surrogate models are trained on spectra computed from lower levels of theory or rely on rotation-invariant scalar features, limiting their geometric expressiveness. We explore the use of equivariant graph neural networks for optical spectra prediction, adapting GotenNet to this task and evaluating it on multiple datasets including a recently published collection of 10,533 structures with spectra computed at the level of the random phase approximation (RPA). The proposed model outperforms the current state of the art, with the largest gains in the 0-8 eV range and on predicting the static real permittivity, both of particular relevance for thin-film optics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索将等变图神经网络 (equivariant GNN) 用于光学光谱预测，通过适配 GotenNet 并在包含 10,533 个结构的 RPA 级别光谱数据集上评估，在 0-8 eV 范围和静态实介电常数预测上超越现有最先进方法，对薄膜光电器件高通量筛选具有重要意义。
Motivation: 现有替代模型要么依赖低水平理论计算的光谱，要么使用旋转不变标量特征，几何表达能力受限，难以满足高通量材料筛选对精度和效率的需求。
Method: 采用等变图神经网络 GotenNet 进行光谱预测，利用其等变性质捕捉原子间的几何信息，并在 RPA 级别计算的光谱数据集上训练和评估。
Result: 所提模型在多个数据集上超越当前最先进方法，特别是在 0-8 eV 能量范围及静态实介电常数预测上提升显著。
Conclusion: 等变图神经网络可有效提升光学光谱预测精度，尤其适用于薄膜光电器件材料筛选场景。

papers.title: Giskard : Byzantine Robust and Confidential Aggregation for Large-Scale Decentralized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Dealing simultaneously with confidentiality and Byzantine behaviors in decentralized learning is a challenging problem. Indeed, in decentralized learning, clients train a machine learning model while keeping their data locally and share their model parameters or gradients with a set of neighbors. While enforcing confidentiality calls for hiding the exchanged model parameters/gradients (e.g., by using cryptographic techniques), dealing with Byzantine contributions often requires inspecting the latter. Hence, most research works address these objectives separately. A recent line of work proposes to employ secure multi-party computation (MPC) to implement robust aggregators against model poisoning, thereby enforcing both confidentiality and Byzantine resilience. However, these solutions scale badly: they either require all-to-all communication between participants or delegate the entire computation to a small subset, whose computational and communication load grows proportionally with the size of the network. In this paper, we present Giskard, a protocol for confidential and Byzantine-robust decentralized aggregation. Giskard organizes $n$ parties into a tree of committees of size $O(\log n)$ and evaluates a coordinate-wise approximate median via a committee-adapted distributed binary search over the value domain, using BGW-style MPC within each committee. We assess Giskard both theoretically by proving its security and confidentiality properties and experimentally through extensive experiments involving up to one million participants. Compared to its closest competitors, Giskard reduces per-party communication complexity asymptotically while exhibiting comparable model utility under up to $n/4$ Byzantine parties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Giskard协议，用于大规模去中心化学习中同时实现拜占庭鲁棒性和机密性聚合。Giskard将参与者组织成大小为O(log n)的委员会树，在委员会内使用BGW风格的安全多方计算(MPC)执行坐标wise近似中位数聚合，通过分布式二分搜索实现。理论证明安全性，实验评估至百万参与者规模，与最接近的竞争者相比，渐近降低了每方的通信复杂度，并在多达n/4拜占庭方的情况下保持模型效用。
Motivation: 现有去中心化学习方法难以同时处理机密性和拜占庭行为，因为机密性要求隐藏参数，而鲁棒聚合通常需要检查参数。最近基于安全多方计算的鲁棒聚合器在规模上扩展性差，需要全广播或负载随网络规模线性增长。
Method: Giskard将n个参与方组织成大小为O(log n)的委员会树，在每个委员会内使用BGW风格MPC执行坐标wise近似中位数，通过委员会适应的分布式二分搜索在值域上计算。
Result: 理论证明安全性和机密性；实验评估至百万参与者规模，与最接近方案相比，渐近降低每方通信复杂度，并在多达n/4拜占庭方时模型效用相当。
Conclusion: Giskard在大规模去中心化学习中同时实现了机密性和拜占庭鲁棒性，且通信复杂度优于现有方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing Before Reasoning: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Shortcut-Resilient Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a model on its own rollouts and uses a frozen copy to provide dense token-level targets conditioned on a reference target. This works well for LLM reasoning, but a direct extension to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can create a shortcut: the privileged target may guide tokens mainly based on the text reference target rather than the image. We propose ViGOS, a visually grounded OPSD framework for MLLM post-training. The student first writes a visual description and then reasons toward the final answer. For valid rollouts, an image-only perception teacher supervises the description, while a privileged reasoning teacher supervises the reasoning and final answer on the same student prefix. A reference teacher is used only for invalid rollouts to recover the output format. Across general vision-language, expert reasoning, visual math, spatial grounding, and visual-language-prior benchmarks, ViGOS keeps the main benefits of OPSD and improves image-grounded behavior in shortcut-prone settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViGOS，一种视觉基础的多模态在线自蒸馏框架，用于多模态大语言模型后训练。学生先写视觉描述再推理，图像感知教师监督描述，特权推理教师监督最终答案，参考教师仅在无效 rollout 时恢复格式。在多个基准上，ViGOS 保持了在线自蒸馏的优势，并在易受捷径影响的场景中改善了图像基础行为。
Motivation: 直接将在线自蒸馏扩展到多模态大语言模型可能创建捷径：特权目标主要基于文本参考目标而非图像指导 token，导致模型忽略视觉信息。
Method: ViGOS 框架：学生先输出视觉描述，再推理至最终答案；有效 rollout 中，图像感知教师监督描述，特权推理教师监督推理和答案；无效 rollout 时使用参考教师恢复格式。
Result: 在通用视觉语言、专家推理、视觉数学、空间定位和视觉语言先验基准上，ViGOS 保持了在线自蒸馏的主要收益，并在易用捷径的场景中改善了图像基础行为。
Conclusion: ViGOS 通过解耦感知与推理，有效缓解了多模态在线自蒸馏中的捷径问题，增强了模型对视觉信息的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analysing drivers and interdependencies in European electricity markets using XAI
papers.abstract_en: Electricity markets are inherently complex systems characterised by strong nonlinearities, high-dimensional interactions, and increasing interdependence across regions. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities for electricity prices, their lack of interpretability limits their usefulness for understanding the underlying drivers of price formation. This paper addresses this gap by combining DNN models with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to analyse the determinants of electricity prices across 39 European bidding zones. We employ SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to quantify feature contributions and apply and extend SSHAP, an aggregation framework to improve interpretability in high-dimensional settings. The analysis identifies that renewable energy sources, particularly solar, play a disproportionately important role in price formation despite their lower share in total power generation. Gas prices remain a dominant and consistent driver across electricity markets, while interconnections significantly shape price dynamics, highlighting the strong interdependence of European electricity systems. In addition, a synthetic EU-wide electricity market is constructed to explore the counterfactual scenario of a fully integrated market with a single price.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文结合深度神经网络与可解释人工智能（XAI）方法，分析欧洲39个竞标区域的电价驱动因素。使用SHAP量化特征贡献，并扩展SSHAP聚合框架以提升高维可解释性。研究发现可再生能源（尤其是太阳能）在价格形成中作用显著，天然气价格仍是主导驱动因素，互联线路加剧了市场相互依赖。还构建了合成欧盟统一电力市场以探索完全一体化情景。
Motivation: 电力市场具有强非线性、高维交互和区域间相互依赖的特点，深度神经网络预测能力强但缺乏可解释性，限制了对其价格形成机制的理解。
Method: 采用深度神经网络（DNN）预测电价，结合SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）量化特征贡献，并应用及扩展SSHAP聚合框架以提高高维设置下的可解释性。
Result: 识别出可再生能源（尤其是太阳能）在电价形成中扮演了与其发电占比不成比例的重要角色；天然气价格仍是跨市场的一致主导因素；互联线路显著影响价格动态，凸显欧洲电力系统的强相互依赖性。
Conclusion: XAI方法能有效揭示电力市场复杂驱动因素，太阳能和天然气是核心影响变量，市场一体化程度对价格形成有显著影响。

papers.title: Wasserstein Policy Learning for Distributional Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Offline policy learning has received growing attention in causal inference. The primary objective is to learn a policy (individualized treatment rule) as a mapping from covariates to treatment that maximizes the empirical welfare defined as the mean of scalar-valued potential outcomes. In this paper, we study offline policy learning with distribution-valued outcomes, where each potential outcome is a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ and the reward is defined through a utility functional applied to the Wasserstein barycenter of induced outcome distributions. We establish statistical guarantees for the policy learning framework based on both Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) and Doubly Robust (DR) estimators. By handling the challenging uniform deviation over the product of the combinatorial policy class and the infinite-dimensional quantile domain, we prove that the finite-sample regret has leading dependence $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{\mathrm{N\text{-}dim}(Π)/N})$. In the one-dimensional Wasserstein setting and under the stated regularity conditions, the leading regret rate is still governed by the policy-class complexity. Moreover, we provide a minimax lower bound establishing the sharpness of the leading dependence on $N$ and $\mathrm{N\text{-}dim}(Π)$.
papers.comment: Accepted by The 39th Annual Conference on Learning Theory (COLT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线策略学习 (offline policy learning) 中结果变量为概率分布的情况，每个潜在结果是一个概率测度，奖励由Wasserstein重心的效用泛函定义。基于逆概率加权 (IPW) 和双稳健 (DR) 估计量，建立了有限样本遗憾界的理论保证，主要依赖策略类别复杂度。同时提供了最小最大下界，表明关于样本量和N-维数的依赖是紧的。
Motivation: 现有离线策略学习主要关注标量结果，但许多实际应用中结果具有分布性质（如财富分布、风险分布），需要新框架来处理分布值结果。
Method: 提出基于Wasserstein重心的策略学习框架，使用IPW和DR估计量，处理策略类别与无限维分位数域上的联合一致偏差，推导出有限样本遗憾界。
Result: 证明在Wasserstein距离下，有限样本遗憾率主要由策略类别复杂度决定，达到 Õ(√(N-dim(Π)/N))，并给出匹配的最小最大下界。
Conclusion: 该工作为分布值结果的策略学习提供了统计保证，遗憾率受策略类别复杂度控制，拓展了因果推断中策略学习的适用范围。

papers.title: Towards an Agent-First Web: Redesigning the Web for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: The World Wide Web was built on an assumption held for three decades: the primary consumer of web content is a human being. This permeates every layer; its access model presumes human visitors, its economics rest on human attention, and its content targets human perception. The rapid emergence of AI agents as intermediaries between humans and web content invalidates this assumption. Yet the web resists agents through blanket blocking, CAPTCHA-based exclusion, and economic models that treat agent access as extraction rather than legitimate interaction. This paper proposes a principled redesign across three layers. At the access layer, agents acting for humans should inherit equivalent access rights, governed by rate limiting and agent identification metadata in HTTP requests, analogous to browser headers, alongside a dual-layer architecture serving human-readable and agent-optimized content from the same domain. At the economic layer, we propose an intent-based tier framework grounded in the agent-as-human-proxy principle: an agent's economic obligation mirrors that of the human it represents. A token-based subscription model meters content in tokens rather than pageviews, alongside a commissioned content economy anchoring AI content production in human intentionality. At the content layer, we identify epistemic recursion, the self-referential loop in which AI-generated content is consumed by agents to produce further content, progressively detaching web knowledge from human ground truth. We propose the Agent Text Markup Language (ATML), a four-level human supervision tier model, and a cryptographic provenance chain to counter this threat. Together these constitute ten design principles for an agent-first internet, one in which agents are first-class citizens whose integration requires renegotiating the web's foundational social contract across access, economics, and content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前Web基于人类用户设计，AI agent作为中介的出现使这一假设失效，导致agent被封锁或限制。为此，提出面向agent的Web重新设计，涵盖访问、经济和内容三层，包括agent访问权限继承、基于意图的经济层级、以及对抗知识循环退化的ATML语言和溯源链。共给出十条设计原则。
Motivation: 当前Web的访问模型、经济模型和内容模型均针对人类用户，AI agent作为中介时遭遇排斥，阻碍了agent与Web的合法交互，需要重新设计Web架构以将agent视为一等公民。
Method: 提出三层重设计框架：访问层上agent继承人类用户的访问权限，通过HTTP头部标识和双内容层（人类可读和agent优化）；经济层提出基于意图的层级模型和token订阅制，以及委托内容经济；内容层提出Agent Text Markup Language (ATML)监督层级和密码学溯源链，以缓解知识递归退化。
Result: 提出了十条设计原则，构建了agent优先的Web框架。
Conclusion: 作者认为agent的整合需要重新协商Web的社会契约，包括访问、经济和内容三个层面。

papers.title: Leadership as Coordination Control: Behavioral Signatures and the Recovery-Advantage Boundary in Multi-Agent LLM Teams
papers.abstract_en: Team science holds that leadership is contingent: it helps only under specific conditions, and capable, autonomous teams may need none at all. We ask the analogous question for multi-agent LLM teams: under what measurable conditions does process-level coordination control add value, and do those conditions match what team science predicts? We use behavioral signatures (majority lock-in, exploration, recovery from an incorrect round-0 consensus) and per-action ablations, clean because each controller is an explicit action set, not a monolithic prompt. We operationalize three classical leadership styles (transactional, transformational, situational) as controllers over a shared action vocabulary (explore, revise, accept, synthesize). A matched controller with the same actions but an arbitrary rule recovers no better than majority voting, so the theory-derived rule, not the vocabulary, does the work. Across four task regimes and three open-weight model families, no controller dominates by accuracy, as the contingency view predicts: transactional control matches a shared round-0 vote on all 12 (model, regime) combinations to within 1.3pp, and gains appear only on the one combination where the round-0 majority is unreliable (llama-4-scout social; situational +8pp over flat). A recovery-advantage account, tested with four boundary probes, says a controller beats plain interaction only where the round-0 majority is unreliable, the task is recoverable, and undirected interaction does not already repair it. These regions map onto contingency theory (leadership substitutes, path-goal redundancy, the situational readiness gap), so a largely null accuracy result is what the theory predicts, not a failure of the controllers. We read process-level coordination control as a contingency to be measured and theory-mapped, not a leaderboard to be topped.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体LLM团队中过程级协调控制（领导力）的价值条件，通过行为签名（多数锁定、探索、从错误共识恢复）和逐动作消融，将三种经典领导风格（交易型、变革型、情境型）实现为共享动作词汇上的控制器。实验发现，在四种任务体制和三种模型家族上，控制器准确率通常不优于简单多数投票，仅当初始多数不可靠且任务可恢复时（如llama-4-scout社会场景中情境型领导+8pp）才出现优势，符合权变理论预测。
Motivation: 团队科学认为领导力是权变的，但多智能体LLM团队中过程级协调控制何时添加价值尚不清楚；本文旨在用可测量的行为签名和动作消融来验证权变理论的预测。
Method: 将交易型、变革型、情境型三种领导风格实现为共享动作词汇（explore, revise, accept, synthesize）上的控制器，并引入行为签名（majority lock-in, exploration, recovery）和逐动作消融，以分离词汇效应与理论规则效应。
Result: 在所有12个(model, task regime)组合上，交易型控制与初始多数投票的准确率差距在1.3个百分点以内；仅在llama-4-scout社会场景中，情境型领导比平面多数投票高8个百分点。恢复优势边界测试表明，控制器仅在初始多数不可靠、任务可恢复且无指导互动未修复时才有增益。
Conclusion: 过程级协调控制应被视为一种需要测量并映射到权变理论（领导替代、路径-目标冗余、情境准备差距）的条件，而非排行榜上的性能竞争；准确的空结果本身符合权变理论预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JourneyFormer: Encoding Airbnb Guest Journey with Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Sequence modeling has become increasingly popular in recommendation and ranking algorithms, owing to its capacity to model users' historical behaviors and infer user intentions. Despite its theoretical simplicity, the practical deployment of a sequence model in production is non-trivial due to complexity of the sequence and sparse labels. For example, in Airbnb, guest sequences are often long, exploratory and complex, and we focus on booking labels, which are sparse. As such, we are often required to make various design decisions regarding data and modeling to strike a balance between effectiveness and scalability. This work delved into these production challenges and deployed JourneyFormer, a sequence modeling solution for search ranking at Airbnb. We detail crucial design considerations, covering aspects such as guest event selection, ID embeddings, model architecture, and label attribution. Additionally, we describe several tailored strategies to accelerate model training and inference. JourneyFormer has been successfully deployed within Airbnb's production, where its effectiveness and impact have been evidenced not only by improved offline ranking metrics but also by significant gains in key business metrics through online A/B testing across 2 production surfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了JourneyFormer，一个为Airbnb住宿搜索排序设计的序列建模解决方案。针对客人行程序列长、探索性强且预订标签稀疏的问题，详细讨论了数据选择和模型设计决策，包括事件选择、ID嵌入、模型架构和标签归属，并提出了训练和推理加速策略。该模型已在Airbnb两个生产场景上线，离线指标和在线A/B测试均显示显著业务提升。
Motivation: Airbnb的客人行程序列长、探索性强且预订标签稀疏，使得序列模型在工业部署中面临有效性和可扩展性的平衡挑战。
Method: 提出了JourneyFormer，涵盖客人事件选择、ID嵌入、模型架构设计、标签归属策略，以及针对训练和推理的加速优化。
Result: 离线排序指标提升，且通过两个生产表面的在线A/B测试验证了关键业务指标的显著增长。
Conclusion: JourneyFormer的成功部署表明，针对长且稀疏序列的定制化设计能够有效提升搜索排序性能，并为工业界序列建模实践提供了参考。

papers.title: Smoothness-Based Derandomization of PAC-Bayes Bounds
papers.abstract_en: We study PAC-Bayes derandomization for smooth loss functions. Our goal is to obtain generalization bounds that hold with high probability for deterministic predictors by exploiting smoothness properties of both the loss and the predictor class. We show that passing from the Gibbs predictor to the deterministic predictor at the posterior mean has a precise cost, given by the generalization gap of the Jensen gap class. We control this class through its Rademacher complexity, leading to bounds for deterministic predictors that involve flatness quantities expressed in terms of parameter Jacobians and Hessians of the score map. The framework applies to both bounded and unbounded smooth loss functions, and we specialize the results to linear predictors and smooth neural networks. Finally, the Jacobian and Hessian quantities appearing in the theory motivate a practical regularizer. For BatchNorm networks, we compute this regularizer with respect to effective BatchNorm weights obtained by folding the BatchNorm transformation into the adjacent affine weights. Experiments on CIFAR-10 illustrate the behavior of this regularizer under different batch sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于光滑性的PAC-Bayes去随机化方法，利用损失函数和预测器类的光滑性获得确定性预测器的泛化界。通过从Gibbs预测器到后验均值确定性预测器的转换，控制Jensen间隙类的Rademacher复杂度，得到涉及参数Jacobian和Hessian的平坦性量的界。扩展到有界和无界光滑损失函数，并特化到线性预测器和光滑神经网络。理论导出的Jacobian和Hessian量驱动了实用正则化器，在BatchNorm网络上通过折叠变换计算，并在CIFAR-10上进行实验。
Motivation: 获得确定性预测器的高概率泛化界，通过利用光滑性属性来改进PAC-Bayes去随机化。
Method: 从Gibbs预测器到后验均值确定性预测器的转换，通过Jensen间隙类的Rademacher复杂度控制代价，得到涉及Jacobian和Hessian的界。提出基于这些量的正则化器。
Result: 实验在CIFAR-10上展示了所提正则化器在不同批量大小下的行为。
Conclusion: 框架适用于有界和无界光滑损失，理论导出的量可驱动实用正则化器，在BatchNorm网络上有效。
