papers.title: ProductConsistency: Improving Product Identity Preservation in Instruction-Based Image Editing via SFT and RL
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in instruction-based image editing have enabled models to perform complex visual edits from natural language instructions. However, in product-centric scenarios where preserving product features, branding, and textual elements are critical, current open and closed source models often struggle to maintain this fine-grained object identity. This issue is further compounded by the lack of datasets for instruction-based product image editing with text fidelity constraints, leaving it largely treated as an implicit capability of instruction-based image editing models. In this work, we introduce the ProductConsistency dataset which is designed to improve product-centric image editing. Our approach includes a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset of 87k samples for product editing, a reinforcement learning (RL) dataset with 869 unique product images, and a new benchmark dataset, the ProductConsistency Benchmark, to allow rigorous and standardized evaluation of editing models. To guide RL training, we propose a Cyclic Consistency reward that enforces semantic preservation of product identity by using caption similarity between the original product description and captions generated from the edited image. We fine-tune both Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and Flux.1-Kontext-dev using our dataset and demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models in OCR and Perceptual metrics, and MLLM-based evaluations as well, indicating stronger product consistency, text rendering, and overall visual quality; with the Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model achieving a 5x reduction in the character error rate. The code and pipeline is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProductConsistency-6FCC/README.md
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProductConsistency 数据集和方法，用于改进基于指令的图像编辑中产品身份（如品牌、文字）的保持。通过监督微调（87k样本）和强化学习（869张产品图），结合循环一致奖励（Cyclic Consistency reward）来保持产品语义，在OCR和感知指标上取得提升，Qwen-Image-Edit-2511模型字符错误率降低5倍。
Motivation: 现有指令式图像编辑模型在产品编辑场景中难以保持产品特征、品牌和文字元素等细粒度的物体身份，且缺乏专门的数据集和评估基准。
Method: 构建 ProductConsistency 数据集，包含87k监督微调样本和869张产品图的强化学习数据集，以及标准评估基准。提出 Cyclic Consistency reward，利用编辑后图像生成的描述与原始产品描述的相似性来指导RL训练。
Result: 在 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 和 Flux.1-Kontext-dev 上微调后，OCR和感知指标以及MLLM评估均优于基线，其中Qwen模型字符错误率降低5倍。
Conclusion: 所提出的数据集和奖励机制能显著增强产品编辑中的身份保持和文本渲染质量，但工作聚焦于产品图像编辑，未涉及其他领域。

papers.title: Structure Over Nonlinearity: Explicit Interaction Architectures for Dynamical Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most learning architectures for dynamical systems rely on generic nonlinear function approximation, often requiring high model complexity to capture structured behaviors. In this work, we propose an alternative paradigm in which modeling capability arises primarily from structure rather than from expressive nonlinearities. We introduce a class of explicit structured dynamical units based on wave-inspired interaction structures with internal state. Inspired by wave-based computational principles, the proposed units adopt a strictly causal organization that eliminates algebraic loops, yielding fully explicit models that can be evaluated without implicit solvers. Stacking such units produces layered dynamical architectures with emergent hierarchical behavior. Through experiments on a nonlinear system identification task, we show that depth improves both representation quality and generalization, even under limited parameter optimization. In particular, the proposed architectures produce informative internal representations even under readout-only fitting, indicating that useful dynamical structure emerges from the organization of interactions prior to substantial parameter optimization. These results suggest that structure-first design provides a viable and effective alternative to conventional black-box approaches for learning dynamical systems, highlighting the role of interaction structure as a primary source of model expressivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于波启发交互结构（wave-inspired interaction structures）的显式结构化动力单元，替代传统依赖高复杂度非线性函数逼近的动力系统学习架构。通过严格因果组织避免代数环，堆叠单元形成层次化动力学架构。在非线性系统辨识任务上，实验表明深度提升表征质量和泛化性能，即使仅拟合读出层也能产生有信息量的内部表示，说明交互结构本身是模型表达性的主要来源。
Motivation: 现有动力学学习架构多依赖通用非线性函数逼近，需要高模型复杂度才能捕获结构化行为。本文目标是通过结构而非非线性表达能力来获得建模能力，降低对复杂非线性层的依赖。
Method: 提出一类基于波启发交互结构的显式结构化动力单元，具有内部状态和严格因果组织，避免代数环，可显式计算无需隐式求解器。堆叠多层单元形成层次化动力学架构。
Result: 在非线性系统辨识任务上，深度增加提升表征质量和泛化性能，即使仅通过线性读出层拟合（readout-only fitting）也能产生有信息量的内部表示，表明有用的动力学结构在参数优化前已从交互组织中涌现。
Conclusion: 结构优先的设计为学习动力系统提供了可行的替代方案，交互结构本身是模型表达性的主要来源，而非依赖黑盒非线性逼近。

papers.title: AMALIA-VL: A Native European Portuguese Open-Source Vision and Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision and Language Models (LVLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet European Portuguese (pt-PT) remains systematically underserved by existing open-source multimodal models, which either conflate it with Brazilian Portuguese or severely under-represent it in their training data mixes. We introduce AMALIA-VL, the first open-source instruction-tuned LVLM built natively for pt-PT, pairing a high-resolution vision encoder with dynamic image tiling and a fully open pt-PT-optimized language model via a learned connector. We contribute with a purposefully designed three-stage training process - vision-language alignment, general visual instruction tuning, and preference optimization - together with a pt-PT-centric multimodal data mix combining curated and translated public datasets with novel datasets that address the near-total absence of European Portuguese multimodal resources. Our evaluation shows that AMALIA-VL establishes a strong baseline for open-source pt-PT LVLMs.We will release model weights, training data, and construction pipelines along with machine-translated pt-PT evaluation benchmarks to help democratize pt-PT LVLM development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对欧洲葡萄牙语（pt-PT）在开源多模态大模型中严重缺乏本地化支持的问题，提出了AMALIA-VL，这是第一个原生面向pt-PT的开源指令微调视觉语言模型（LVLM）。该模型结合了高分辨率视觉编码器与动态图像分块（dynamic image tiling），并通过可学习的连接器与完全开放的pt-PT优化语言模型对接。作者贡献了三阶段训练流程（视觉-语言对齐、通用视觉指令微调、偏好优化）以及以pt-PT为中心的多模态数据组合，包括策划和翻译的公共数据集与新增数据集。评估表明AMALIA-VL为开源pt-PT LVLM建立了强基线，并将发布模型权重、训练数据和构建流程以促进该领域发展。
Motivation: 现有开源多模态大模型系统性地忽视了欧洲葡萄牙语，要么将其与巴西葡萄牙语混为一谈，要么在训练数据中严重不足，导致pt-PT用户无法享受多模态AI的进展。
Method: 提出AMALIA-VL，第一个本地化pt-PT的开源指令微调LVLM，采用高分辨率视觉编码器配合动态图像分块，通过可学习的连接器连接到完全开放的pt-PT优化语言模型。训练分为三阶段：视觉-语言对齐、通用视觉指令微调、偏好优化。数据方面构建了pt-PT中心的多模态数据混合，包含策划和翻译的公共数据集以及填补空白的新数据集。
Result: 评估显示AMALIA-VL在开源pt-PT LVLM上建立了强基线。作者将开源模型权重、训练数据和构建流程以及机器翻译的pt-PT评估基准。
Conclusion: 本文表明通过本地化数据混合和针对性训练流程，可以构建高质量的欧洲葡萄牙语多模态大模型，从而降低pt-PT社区开发LVLM的门槛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DVANet: Degradation-aware Visual-prior Alignment Network for Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: All-in-One image restoration aims to develop a unified restoration framework for handling diverse degradation types. Existing end-to-end methods usually regard the restoration process as a black-box mapping, lacking an explicit optimization interpretation. Although deep unfolding provides an interpretable iterative modeling paradigm for image restoration, existing methods mostly rely on fixed degradation assumptions or predefined degradation information, making them difficult to adapt to unified restoration requirements under complex degradations and locally damaged content. This limitation restricts their performance in degradation suppression and structural detail recovery. To address these issues, this paper proposes DVANet, a deep unfolding network inspired by the half-quadratic splitting optimization algorithm, which formulates unified image restoration under complex degradations as a collaborative unfolding process between degradation-aware observation consistency and visual-prior-guided reconstruction. Specifically, in the degradation-aware observation consistency branch, a degradation representation module is employed to extract global degradation attributes and local degradation cues, and degradation-conditioned mapping is used to enhance the model's adaptability to different degradation types. In the visual-prior-guided reconstruction branch, DINOv3 is introduced to provide structural and semantic information as hierarchical visual priors, thereby complementing the missing structural information in damaged regions and improving detail recovery. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DVANet achieves superior or competitive performance on multi-scenario degradation and cross-domain image restoration tasks, showing favorable degradation adaptability and generalization ability.
papers.comment: All-in-One Image Restoration; Deep Unfolding; Degradation Representation; Visual Prior
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DVANet，一种基于半二次分裂优化算法的深度展开网络，用于统一图像修复。该方法通过退化感知观测一致性分支和视觉先验引导重建分支协同工作，利用DINOv3提供层次化视觉先验，在多种退化类型和跨域任务上取得竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有端到端方法缺乏优化解释，深度展开方法依赖固定退化假设，难以适应复杂退化及局部损坏内容的统一修复需求。
Method: 受半二次分裂算法启发，设计双分支协同展开：退化感知分支提取全局和局部退化特征并条件映射，视觉先验分支引入DINOv3提供结构语义先验以补充缺失信息。
Result: 实验表明DVANet在多场景退化及跨域图像修复任务上达到优越或竞争性能，具有良好的退化适应性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文提出的退化感知与视觉先验对齐的深度展开网络有效提升了统一图像修复对复杂退化的适应性和细节恢复能力。

papers.title: PorTEXTO: A European Portuguese Benchmark for Visual Text Extraction
papers.abstract_en: European Portuguese (pt-PT) is largely absent from OCR benchmarks, which skew toward high-resource languages. The few benchmarks that cover pt-PT focus on historical artifacts and literature. This work addresses modern OCR applications, introducing PorTEXTO, the first benchmark for contemporary and culturally relevant pt-PT visual text extraction. To ascertain quality, we employ an annotation pipeline combining transcriptions from a frontier LVLM with exhaustive review by native speakers. We observe a sharp performance drop from synthetic to real world samples in most models, and find that, currently, specialized multilingual data is a better driver for pt-PT performance than model size or resolution budget, motivating the release of open pt-PT OCR resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了PorTEXTO，首个面向现代葡萄牙语（pt-PT）视觉文本提取的基准数据集。通过结合前沿LVLM转录和母语审核的标注流程，评估了多种OCR模型，发现合成样本到真实样本的性能大幅下降，且当前多语言专用数据比模型规模或分辨率更关键。
Motivation: 欧洲葡萄牙语（pt-PT）在OCR基准中严重缺失，现有少数基准侧重于历史文献，缺乏面向现代应用的评估。
Method: 构建PorTEXTO基准，采用结合大语言视觉模型（LVLM）自动转录与母语专家人工审核的标注流程，确保质量。
Result: 观察到多数模型从合成样本到真实世界样本的性能急剧下降，且多语言专用数据比模型大小或分辨率更能提升pt-PT OCR性能。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了发布开放pt-PT OCR资源的重要性，并指出当前阶段数据质量比模型规模更关键。

papers.title: AIFS-DOP: End-to-End Medium-Range Weather Prediction from Observations Alone with Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System for Direct Observation Prediction (AIFS-DOP). AIFS-DOP is trained on a 40-year harmonized dataset of gridded observations, without using numerical weather prediction (NWP) reanalysis or model data. The resulting model is competitive with ECMWF's Integrated Forecasting System (IFS) when scored on a one year period of forecasts across 2021/2022. This progress on Direct Observation Prediction represents the first time that a data-driven model, trained solely on observations, is competitive with the IFS at medium ranges for several key upper-air and surface headline scores, when verified against observation data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIFS-DOP，一个基于40年网格化观测数据训练的机器学习模型，用于中期天气预报。该模型无需数值天气预报（NWP）再分析或模型数据，仅依靠观测数据即可在2021/2022年的一年预报期内与ECMWF的IFS系统相竞争。这是首次有数据驱动模型在仅使用观测数据的条件下，在多个关键高空和地面预报指标上与IFS达到同等水平。
Motivation: 传统的数值天气预报依赖复杂的物理模型和再分析数据，计算成本高且依赖模型假设。本文旨在探索仅使用观测数据的机器学习方法是否能在中期天气预报中达到与顶尖NWP系统相当的性能，从而降低对模型数据的依赖。
Method: AIFS-DOP使用一个40年统一的网格化观测数据集进行端到端训练，不使用任何NWP再分析或模型输出。模型设计为直接预测观测变量，采用机器学习架构（未在摘要中具体说明）进行中期天气预报。
Result: 在2021/2022年的一年预报期上，AIFS-DOP在多个关键高空和地面预报指标上与ECMWF的IFS系统表现竞争，这是首个仅依赖观测数据的数据驱动模型达到此水平。
Conclusion: 仅使用观测数据的机器学习模型可以成功进行中期天气预报，并达到与传统NWP系统竞争的性能，为未来天气预报提供了新的范式。

papers.title: Context-Aware Optimization of Follow-Up Intervals for Type 2 Diabetes Care Using Markov Decision Processes
papers.abstract_en: Chronic disease management relies on regular patient-provider interactions to follow-up on disease progression and control. For Type 2 Diabetes (T2D), current guidelines prescribe fixed time intervals between subsequent primary care visits for all patients, overlooking heterogeneity in clinical trajectories and patient characteristics. This study introduces a Contextual Markov Decision Process (CMDP) model to optimize subpopulation-specific follow-up interval decisions using Electronic Health Record (EHR) data from 22,154 T2D patients across 10 primary care clinics. Contexts are identified by: i) dimensionality reduction of variables representing the individual health trajectories utilizing Principal Component Analysis, and ii) assigning patients to contexts via principal components and additional patient-level features using clustering. Two distinct contexts emerged, representing a lower- and a higher-risk subpopulation. CMDP-derived policies recommend: (i) follow-up within 1 month if lab value at current visit is unmeasured; (ii) up to 3 months for elevated lab values or recent hospitalizations; and (iii) 6 to 12 months for sustained glycemic control, with shorter follow-up intervals for patients in high-risk context. The optimal policies achieved lower expected cumulative cost than benchmarks (e.g., in the higher-comorbidity context, the CMDP policy reduced cost by about 34.8%, and in the lower-comorbidity context by about 6.4%, relative to an American Diabetes Association-like fixed interval follow-up policy. These findings demonstrate how context-aware approaches can inform adaptive follow-up strategies, and have the potential to advance chronic care management in primary care by synthesizing machine learning and probabilistic decision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对2型糖尿病初级护理中随访间隔的固定策略问题，提出基于上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）的优化模型。利用22,154名患者的电子健康记录数据，通过主成分分析和聚类识别出低风险和高风险两个子群体。CMDP推荐策略为：当前未测量实验室值时1个月内随访，高风险或控制不佳时3个月内，控制良好时6-12个月。相比美国糖尿病协会固定间隔策略，高风险组成本降低约34.8%，低风险组降低约6.4%。
Motivation: 现有2型糖尿病护理指南对所有患者采用固定随访间隔，忽略了临床轨迹和患者特征的异质性，导致资源浪费或控制不足。
Method: 构建上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），利用主成分分析降维并聚类患者特征，为不同风险子群体生成个性化的随访间隔策略。
Result: CMDP策略在高低风险子群中分别降低预期累积成本约34.8%和6.4%，优于美国糖尿病协会固定间隔策略。
Conclusion: 上下文感知的随访间隔优化能有效提升慢性病管理效率，机器学习与概率决策模型的结合具有改善初级护理的潜力。

papers.title: Optimal score function estimation via derivatives constraints
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of score function estimation via empirical risk minimization. We first start with the question of inferring the score function of a probability measure $μ$ with density on the flat torus from a sample of distribution $μ$. We show that constraining the hypothesis space to a Sobolev ball is sufficient to prevent overfitting and obtaining minimax estimation rates. We then consider the problem of score function estimation in the context of score-based generative modeling. Again, under a conjecture tying the score estimation rates to the quality of the output of a score-based generative model, we obtain minimax rates for such an approach using score function estimators obtained by constraining the hypothesis class to a Sobolev ball.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了通过经验风险最小化估计得分函数（score function）的理论问题。理论证明将假设空间约束到Sobolev球足以防止过拟合并取得极小极大最优估计速率，并进一步将这一结论推广至基于得分的生成模型（score-based generative modeling）。
Motivation: 得分函数估计在生成建模中至关重要，但现有方法缺乏防止过拟合的理论保证；需建立约束下的最优速率理论。
Method: 在经验风险最小化框架下，将假设空间限制为Sobolev球，通过约束导数实现正则化。
Result: 在平坦环面（flat torus）上证明约束下的得分函数估计达到极小极大最优速率；在合理猜想下，生成模型的输出质量也可获得相应的速率。
Conclusion: 约束假设空间到Sobolev球提供了理论上的最优性保证，但实际应用依赖于猜想的验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARIADNE: Agnostic Routing for Inference-time Adapter DyNamic sElection
papers.abstract_en: The increasing deployment of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has led to model ecosystems in which a single backbone is paired with many task-specialized adapters. In this setting, inference-time queries often arrive without task labels, requiring the system to automatically select the most appropriate adapter from a growing and heterogeneous adapter pool. Existing routing methods either depend on access to adapter internals, such as weight decompositions or gradient-based statistics, or require additional router training, which limits scalability and portability as new adapters are added. We introduce ARIADNE, a training-free, adapter-agnostic routing framework for dynamic adapter selection at inference time. ARIADNE represents each adapter through a set of centroids computed from embeddings of its training set, capturing the data distribution associated with that adapter. Given an unlabeled input, it selects an adapter by measuring proximity to these centroids in latent space. Because routing is performed entirely in the input embedding space, ARIADNE is compatible with arbitrary PEFT methods and requires no modification to the adapters or training procedures. Primarily evaluated with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct on 23 diverse NLP tasks, ARIADNE recovers 97.44% of the upper bound performance. Scaling to 44 tasks, it achieves 89.7% average selection accuracy, without additional training or access to adapter internals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARIADNE，一种无需训练、与适配器无关的推理时动态适配器选择框架。它通过计算每个适配器训练集嵌入的质心来表示适配器，对未标记输入选择距离最近的适配器。在23个NLP任务上恢复97.44%的上界性能，扩展到44个任务达到89.7%准确率。
Motivation: 现有路由方法依赖于适配器内部信息或需要额外训练，难以扩展和移植，需要一种无需访问适配器内部、无需训练的路由方法。
Method: ARIADNE从每个适配器的训练集嵌入中计算质心，在推理时根据输入嵌入与质心的距离选择适配器，完全在输入嵌入空间操作，兼容任意PEFT方法。
Result: 在Llama 3.2 1B Instruct上，23个任务恢复97.44%上界性能，44个任务达到89.7%平均选择准确率。
Conclusion: ARIADNE实现了无需训练、与适配器无关的动态选择，具有良好的可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Taming I2V models for Image HOI Editing: A Cognitive Benchmark and Agentic Self-Correcting Framework
papers.abstract_en: Current image editing methods excel at static attributes but fail at complex Human-Object Interactions (HOI), a critical challenge unaddressed by existing benchmarks that conflate HOI with static attributes, relying on global metrics incapable of simultaneously assessing dynamic interaction validity and entangled human-object pair preservation. Thus, we first introduce HOI-Edit, a comprehensive benchmark with three progressive cognitive levels, which features an automated metric HOI-Eval that reliably evaluates instance-level interaction by letting VLM Q&A after thinking with images containing grounded Human-Object pairs. Considering the task's essence of remodeling dynamic relationships, we benchmark Image-to-Video (I2V) models, finding them inherently suited for dynamic editing due to their temporal generation capabilities. Crucially, beyond superior performance, this capability provides a "replay of the failure process," offering unique diagnosability into why errors occur. We thus propose SCPE (Self-Correcting Process Editing), a novel, agentic self-correcting framework that constrains the generation of I2V models through iteratively refined prompts, enabling the generated videos to more accurately present the target HOI. Extracted frames from these videos are the final editing results. On HOI-Edit, SCPE achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art (SOTA) editing models like Nano Banana on interaction. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/HOI-Edit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HOI-Edit 基准和 SCPE 框架，用于图像中的人-物交互（HOI）编辑。HOI-Edit 包含三个认知级别的评估，并采用 HOI-Eval 指标通过 VLM 问答评估交互有效性。SCPE 利用图像到视频（I2V）模型的时序生成能力，通过迭代提示自修正来生成目标 HOI 的视频，再提取帧作为编辑结果。在 HOI-Edit 上，SCPE 在交互方面达到与 SOTA 模型竞争的性能。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑方法在处理复杂人-物交互（HOI）时失败，且现有基准混淆了 HOI 与静态属性，缺乏同时评估动态交互有效性和人-物对保持的指标。
Method: 引入 HOI-Edit 基准和 HOI-Eval 指标；提出 SCPE（自修正过程编辑）框架，利用 I2V 模型的时序生成能力，通过迭代精炼提示自修正，最终从视频提取帧得到编辑结果。
Result: 在 HOI-Edit 基准上，SCPE 在交互方面达到与 SOTA 模型 Nano Banana 竞争的性能。
Conclusion: I2V 模型因其时序生成能力天然适合动态编辑，且能提供失败过程回放用于诊断；自修正框架可进一步提升交互准确性。

papers.title: Model-Free Reinforcement Learning Control for Resilient Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper compares the performance of model-free controllers on a nonlinear system under cyberattacks, including false data injection and denial-of-service attacks. Four RL reward types are analyzed for accuracy, cost, and resilience. Results show that the Lyapunov reward offers the best resilience with low tracking error. Exponential mode also provides good trade-offs with acceptable resilience under moderate training conditions. Progressive and linear rewards converge faster but are less robust. RL-MPCs show strong steady-state resilience but require longer training times; RL-PID controllers are faster with significantly less training time. Proximal Policy Optimization outperforms Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient with a significant reduction in KPI variance. This study serves to highlight how well-designed RL rewards can improve performance and resilience against cyber threats.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 23rd IFAC World Congress 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了多种无模型强化学习控制器（RL-PID和RL-MPC）在非线性系统遭受假数据注入和拒绝服务攻击时的性能。研究发现，Lyapunov奖励提供最佳鲁棒性，指数模式奖励在中等训练条件下也有良好折衷。PPO相比DDPG显著降低了KPI方差。
Motivation: 网络物理系统面临网络攻击威胁，需要设计弹性控制策略。现有基于模型的方法在某些情况下难以适用，因此探索无模型强化学习控制器的弹性性能，并分析不同奖励函数的影响。
Method: 对比四种强化学习奖励函数（Lyapunov奖励、指数模式、渐进奖励、线性奖励）在RL-PID和RL-MPC框架下的性能，使用PPO和DDPG算法，针对非线性系统进行仿真，并施加假数据注入和拒绝服务攻击。
Result: Lyapunov奖励提供最佳鲁棒性且跟踪误差低；指数模式在中等训练条件下有良好折衷；渐进和线性奖励收敛快但鲁棒性差。RL-MPC稳态鲁棒性强但训练时间长，RL-PID训练时间显著更短。PPO比DDPG在KPI方差上有显著降低。
Conclusion: 精心设计的RL奖励可以提升网络物理系统对抗网络威胁的性能和弹性。

papers.title: Sensor Configuration Matters: A Systematic Evaluation of Multimodal SLAM on Quadruped Robots
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation of quadrupedal robots in diverse environments fundamentally relies on resilient Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While visual-inertial SLAM has matured across wheeled, handheld, and aerial platforms, a critical evaluation gap remains regarding how hardware-level sensor configurations affect performance under the aggressive dynamics of legged locomotion. Quadrupeds introduce distinct embodiment-induced sensory challenges, including foot-impact shocks, high-frequency mechanical vibrations, and rapid angular rotations, which degrade standard perception pipelines. To address this gap, we present a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art visual, visual-inertial, and LiDAR-visual-inertial SLAM methods using the GrandTour dataset recorded on an ANYmal D quadruped. We isolate and quantify the impacts of camera modalities, shutter techniques, and inertial sensor tiers, analyzing their trade-offs across localization accuracy, algorithmic robustness, and computational resource utilization. Our empirical findings demonstrate that hardware selection has substantial influence on system resilience: stereo configurations consistently outperform monocular and RGB-D modalities, global shutter cameras significantly mitigate motion-induced tracking failures compared to rolling shutter cameras, and, crucially, standard inertial integration can degrade the performance of primarily vision-based frameworks under harsh legged locomotion. These insights additionally offer concrete design guidelines for tailoring custom sensor payloads to achieve dependable perception on agile legged systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了在四足机器人上不同传感器配置对多模态SLAM性能的影响，使用ANYmal D机器人上的GrandTour数据集。实验表明立体相机优于单目和RGB-D，全局快门相机显著减少运动导致的跟踪失败，而标准惯性融合在剧烈运动下可能降低视觉SLAM性能。
Motivation: 四足机器人的剧烈运动（如足部冲击、高频振动、快速旋转）给感知系统带来独特挑战，而现有研究缺乏对硬件传感器配置如何影响SLAM性能的系统评估。
Method: 在GrandTour数据集上对多种视觉、视觉-惯性、激光-视觉-惯性SLAM方法进行控制变量实验，隔离并量化相机类型、快门方式、惯性传感器等级的影响。
Result: 立体配置一致优于单目和RGB-D；全局快门相机显著减少滚动快门导致的跟踪失败；标准惯性集成在剧烈运动下可能降低视觉SLAM性能。
Conclusion: 硬件传感器选择对四足机器人SLAM的鲁棒性有显著影响，提供了针对敏捷腿式系统的传感器负载设计准则。

papers.title: DREAM: Extending Vision-Language Models with Dual-Objective Encoding for Cross-Modal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: In today's media-driven world, the exponential growth of video content across domains such as surveillance, education, and entertainment has made retrieving semantically relevant videos via natural language queries increasingly critical. Early video retrieval systems relied on handcrafted features or shallow cross-modal mappings, limiting their ability to capture complex semantics and temporal dynamics. While large-scale vision-language models have improved cross-modal alignment, challenges remain in modeling fine-grained temporal dependencies and nuanced linguistic structures. In this paper, we introduce DREAM: Dual-path Representation Enhancement and Alignment Model, a novel multimodal framework that addresses these limitations through enhanced visual and textual encoding. DREAM incorporates a hybrid language modeling strategy that combines masked and permuted language modeling objectives to capture both local and global linguistic semantics. On the visual side, we design a hierarchical vision encoder with cascaded group attention, which integrates spatial and temporal information through multi-stage token interaction and coarse-to-fine attention refinement. We validate DREAM through comprehensive evaluations on the widely-used MSRVTT, MSVD and LSMDC benchmark datasets, where it achieves new state-of-the-art R1 scores of 49.4%, 49.7% and 27.3%, respectively. Qualitative analyses further show the model's ability to maintain coherent attention across frames and align complex queries with dynamic video content. These findings underscore the effectiveness of hierarchical attention and dual-objective textual modeling in enabling robust, context-aware video retrieval, and pave the way for future research in advancing cross-modal representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DREAM（Dual-path Representation Enhancement and Alignment Model），一种用于跨模态视频检索的双路径表示增强与对齐模型。该模型在视觉端采用层次化级联组注意力（cascaded group attention）捕捉时空信息，在文本端结合掩码语言建模和排列语言建模（masked and permuted language modeling）以捕获局部与全局语义。在 MSRVTT、MSVD 和 LSMDC 基准上，DREAM 分别取得 R1 分数 49.4%、49.7% 和 27.3%，达到新最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有视频检索系统依赖手工特征或浅层跨模态映射，难以捕捉复杂语义和时间动态；大规模视觉-语言模型虽改进了跨模态对齐，但在细粒度时间依赖和语言结构建模上仍有不足。
Method: 提出双路径表示增强与对齐模型：视觉端使用层次化编码器，通过级联组注意力实现多阶段 token 交互和由粗到细的注意力精炼；文本端采用混合语言建模，联合掩码语言建模和排列语言建模目标。
Result: 在 MSRVTT、MSVD 和 LSMDC 上分别取得新的最先进 R1 分数 49.4%、49.7% 和 27.3%。定性分析显示模型能保持帧间连贯注意力并理解复杂查询与动态视频内容的对齐。
Conclusion: 层次化注意力和双目标文本建模有助于实现鲁棒的、上下文感知的视频检索，为跨模态表示学习的进一步研究奠定基础。

papers.title: Quantifying and Auditing LLM Evaluation via Positive--Unlabeled Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for scalable evaluation, yet such LLM--as--a--Judge systems exhibit systematic biases that are decoupled from semantic quality, most notably verbosity bias. Meanwhile, human supervision is costly and typically selective, yielding reliable positive judgments but leaving most outputs unlabelled and potentially mixed in quality. We formulate LLM evaluation under selective human supervision as a positive--unlabelled learning problem and propose a geometric auditing framework based on Partial Optimal Transport. By aligning a small set of human--verified positives with a reliable subset of unlabelled outputs in a fixed embedding space, our method identifies human--consistent preferences and corrects biased judges without retraining. Experiments demonstrate improved alignment with human preferences, increased robustness to presentation biases, and interpretable confidence estimates, offering a scalable and statistically grounded alternative to existing LLM--as--a--judge pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将大规模语言模型（LLM）在选择性人工监督下的评估问题建模为正-无标注学习（PU learning），并提出基于部分最优传输（Partial Optimal Transport）的几何审计框架。该方法通过将少量人工验证的正例与嵌入空间中可靠的无标注子集对齐，无需重新训练即可识别人类一致的偏好并纠正有偏的LLM评估者。实验表明该方法改善了与人类偏好的一致性，增强了对呈现偏差的鲁棒性，并提供了可解释的置信度估计。
Motivation: LLM作为评估者存在系统性的展现偏差（如冗长偏差），而人工监督成本高昂且通常只提供正标签，导致大多数输出未标注且质量混杂。需要一种统计上稳健的方法来自动识别和纠正这些偏差。
Method: 将选择性人工监督下的LLM评估形式化为PU学习问题，并提出基于部分最优传输的几何审计框架：在固定嵌入空间中，通过最优传输对齐少量人工验证的正例与可靠的无标注输出子集，从而识别人类一致偏好并修正有偏评估者。
Result: 实验显示该方法提高了与人类偏好的一致性，增强了对呈现偏差的鲁棒性，并提供了可解释的置信度估计。
Conclusion: 该方法为现有的LLM-as-a-Judge流水线提供了一种可扩展且统计上有根据的替代方案，无需重新训练即可修正偏差。

papers.title: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Fine-Grained Image Tasks: From Evaluation to Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal perception and reasoning capabilities. While numerous benchmarks have evaluated LVLMs from holistic or task-specific perspectives, their capabilities on fine-grained image tasks-fundamental to computer vision-remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce FG-BMK, a comprehensive fine-grained evaluation benchmark containing 1.01 million questions and 0.28 million images, covering diverse scenarios from common object-centric domains to specialized domains. FG-BMK jointly evaluates dialogue-level fine-grained semantic recognition and feature-level visual discriminability through human-oriented and machine-oriented paradigms, enabling diagnostic analysis of whether LVLM failures arise from insufficient visual representations, weak visual-to-semantic grounding, or limited fine-grained knowledge. Through extensive experiments on a diverse set of representative LVLMs/VLMs, we find that current LVLMs remain inadequate fine-grained recognizers, with failures arising from intertwined bottlenecks in visual representations, semantic grounding, modality alignment, and category-level knowledge. We further analyze training design factors for improving fine-grained capabilities and examine how visual and linguistic perturbations affect LVLM predictions. These findings provide diagnostic insights into the limitations of current LVLMs and offer guidance for future data construction and model design in developing more reliable LVLMs for fine-grained visual tasks. Our code is open-source and available at https://fg-bmk.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FG-BMK基准，包含101万问题和28万图像，覆盖通用与专门领域的细粒度图像任务。通过人类导向和机器导向双范式评估，诊断当前LVLM在细粒度识别上存在视觉表示、语义接地、模态对齐和类别知识等瓶颈。实验表明现有LVLM细粒度识别能力不足。
Motivation: 现有LVLM基准多从整体或任务特定角度评估，缺乏对细粒度图像任务能力的深入理解。
Method: 构建FG-BMK基准，联合评估对话级细粒度语义识别和特征级视觉判别性，并进行诊断分析失败原因。
Result: 实验发现当前LVLM在细粒度识别上不足，瓶颈包括视觉表示、语义接地、模态对齐和类别知识。
Conclusion: 结果提供诊断性见解，指导未来数据构建和模型设计以提升LVLM在细粒度任务上的可靠性。

papers.title: RODS: Reward-Driven Online Data Synthesis for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn tool-use RL is bottlenecked by the rapid depletion of informative samples in static datasets. We observe that the gradient signal in GRPO concentrates on tasks with the highest rollout reward variance, a consequence of the Popoviciu upper bound. Consequently, samples near the agent's capability boundary -- where successes and failures are roughly balanced -- contribute disproportionately large policy gradients. As training progresses, this boundary continuously shifts, which gradually depletes the pool of informative samples in a static dataset. We propose RODS (Reward-driven Online Data Synthesis) to resolve this depletion. RODS closes the loop between RL training and data generation by repurposing the progress reward variance as a practical, zero-cost boundary detector that requires no extra inference beyond the rollouts already computed for training. It continuously identifies such boundary samples, synthesizes new multi-turn variants matching their structural complexity (e.g., API topology and dependency depth) via a skill-aligned resampling pipeline, and manages a dynamic replay buffer that co-evolves with the policy. Starting from 400 human seeds and maintaining an active training pool of ~800 samples, RODS achieves comparable performance to a 17K-sample offline pipeline while requiring roughly 20x fewer trajectories, and improves over fixed-data RL and environment augmentation in our controlled setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RODS（奖励驱动的在线数据合成）方法，用于解决多轮工具使用强化学习中静态数据集信息样本快速耗尽的问题。RODS通过利用奖励方差作为零成本边界检测器，动态识别并合成接近agent能力边界的多轮样本，配合动态回放缓冲区，在不增加额外推理开销的情况下，实现高效的数据合成。实验表明，从400个人类种子开始，仅用约800个活动样本即可达到17K样本离线管道的性能，所需轨迹减少约20倍。
Motivation: 多轮工具使用强化学习受限于静态数据集中信息样本的快速耗尽，导致训练效率低下。观察发现梯度信号集中在奖励方差高的任务上，而接近agent能力边界的样本贡献了不成比例的政策梯度，但这些样本会随着训练推移而耗尽。
Method: 提出RODS框架，通过将GRPO中的进度奖励方差作为零成本边界检测器，持续识别能力边界样本；利用技能对齐的重采样流程，根据样本的API拓扑和依赖深度合成新的多轮变体；并维护一个与策略共同演化的动态回放缓冲区。
Result: 从400个人类种子开始，保持约800个活动样本，RODS实现了与17K样本离线管道相当的性能，所需轨迹数减少约20倍，且在受控设置中优于固定数据RL和环境增强方法。
Conclusion: RODS通过在线数据合成有效缓解了静态数据集的样本耗尽问题，显著提高了多轮工具使用强化学习的样本效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Low-Rank Tensor Completion Based on Fractional Regularization with Ky Fan p-k Norm
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses low-rank tensor completion (LRTC) by proposing a novel nonconvex surrogate, namely the ratio of the tensor nuclear norm to the tensor Ky Fan p-k norm (TNPK), to accurately approximate the tensor tubal rank. The TNPK possesses appealing properties, including scale invariance, parameter flexibility, and the existence of closed-form solutions under specific choices of p and k. With specific parameter settings of p and k, it reduces to the ratio of the tensor nuclear norm to the tensor Ky Fan k norm (TNK) or the ratio of the tensor nuclear norm to the tensor Frobenius norm (TNF). We construct a LRTC model and, under the tensor null space property (NSP), prove that low-rank tensors are local minimizers of the proposed model. Moreover, we derive the proximal operator of the Ky Fan p-k inverse-norm and further develop an efficient alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm with guaranteed subsequential convergence under mild conditions. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the superior performance of our method against state-of-the-art competitors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于张量核范数与张量Ky Fan p-k范数之比（TNPK）的非凸替代函数来逼近张量管秩，用于低秩张量补全（LRTC）。该替代函数具有尺度不变性、参数灵活性，并在特定参数下退化为已有形式。作者在张量零空间性质下证明低秩张量是局部极小值，并推导了Ky Fan p-k逆范数的近端算子，进而提出一种保证子序列收敛的ADMM算法。实验在合成和真实数据集上表明该方法优于现有技术。
Motivation: 现有低秩张量补全方法使用的凸松弛（如张量核范数）与实际秩函数差距较大，导致恢复精度不足。本文旨在设计一种更准确的非凸替代函数来逼近张量管秩。
Method: 提出张量核范数与张量Ky Fan p-k范数之比（TNPK）作为秩的代理，并构造LRTC模型。在张量零空间性质下证明低秩张量是局部极小值，推导了Ky Fan p-k逆范数的近端算子，并设计ADMM算法。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在恢复精度上优于多种现有低秩张量补全方法。
Conclusion: TNPK作为秩代理能有效提升低秩张量补全性能，且算法具有收敛保证。

papers.title: Where Did the Variability Go? From Vibe Coding to Product Lines by Regeneration
papers.abstract_en: In vibe coding, an emerging AI-driven paradigm, an LLM generates an entire program from a natural language prompt, but what happens to the variability that traditional software engineering carefully builds into code? To answer this question, we conducted an exploratory analysis on 10 vibe coded C/C++ projects, which suggests that there is near-zero in-artifact variability, i.e., at compile and runtime. All variability decisions are resolved at a single new binding time, generation time, the moment the LLM produces the source code. Rather than treating this as a defect to fix, we propose Variability by Regeneration (VbR), to our knowledge the first product-line approach in which the LLM acts as the derivation engine, generating a purpose-built, free of dead code binary for each variant from a declarative specification, while a variant dispatcher transparently routes user requests to the matching binary. We formalise VbR, contrast it with classical SPL derivation, and demonstrate its full pipeline on a wc product family. For SPL engineering, variability in AI-generated software belongs in the specification, not in the code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了vibe coding（一种由LLM根据自然语言提示生成完整程序的AI驱动范式）中软件可变性的消失问题。对10个C/C++项目的分析表明，在编译和运行时几乎不存在工件内可变性，所有可变性决策在生成时解决。作者提出Variability by Regeneration (VbR)，一种以LLM为推导引擎的产品线方法，通过声明式规范为每个变体生成无死代码的二进制，并用变体分发器透明路由用户请求。该工作在wc产品族上展示了完整流水线，并主张AI生成软件的可变性应属于规范而非代码。
Motivation: 传统软件工程在代码中精心构建可变性，而vibe coding中LLM直接生成整个程序，导致可变性在工件内几乎消失，这引出了如何在AI生成软件中管理可变性的问题。
Method: 提出Variability by Regeneration (VbR)，一种产品线方法：LLM作为推导引擎，根据声明式规范为每个变体生成无死代码的二进制；同时使用变体分发器透明地将用户请求路由到匹配的二进制文件。
Result: 对10个vibe coded C/C++项目的探索性分析显示，在编译和运行时几乎不存在工件内可变性；VbR流水线在wc产品族上得到演示。
Conclusion: 作者主张对于软件产品线工程，AI生成软件的可变性应放在规范而非代码中，即通过重新生成而非在代码中配置变体。

papers.title: Adaptive Speech-to-Spike Encoding for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The mismatch between continuous acoustic signals and discrete event-driven processing remains a fundamental bottleneck for neuromorphic speech processing. Current systems typically rely on fixed spike encoders, forcing downstream Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) to compensate for non-adaptive input representations. To address this, we present a learnable residual speech-to-spike encoder jointly trained end-to-end with a Recurrent Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (R-LIF) backbone. We validate this approach on the Google Speech Commands v2 (GSC-v2) benchmark, achieving up to 94.97% accuracy. Notably, the learned encoder remains highly parameter-efficient with a compact 35k-parameter variant that reaches 89.8%, matching or exceeding prior baselines that require an order of magnitude more parameters. Our encoder-focused analysis, including linear probing and gradient-residual inspection, indicates that the encoder does not target faithful signal reconstruction but instead learns task-aligned spike representations that enhance class separability. Finally, we benchmark bio-inspired, hardware-friendly credit assignment by comparing Direct Feedback Alignment (DFA) with surrogate-gradient BPTT under identical architectures and training conditions. We find that DFA reaches 91.5% accuracy, quantifying the performance trade-off of bio-inspired learning rules for modern neuromorphic audio.
papers.comment: Accepted at Interspeech 2026. This version is a preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续语音信号与离散脉冲处理之间的不匹配问题，提出一种可学习的残差语音到脉冲编码器（speech-to-spike encoder），与循环泄漏积分点火（R-LIF）骨干网络端到端联合训练。在Google Speech Commands v2基准上达到94.97%的准确率，且一个仅35k参数的变体以89.8%的准确率匹配或超越此前需多一个数量级参数的基线。编码器分析表明其学习的是任务对齐的脉冲表示而非信号重建。此外，通过对比直接反馈对齐（DFA）与代理梯度BPTT，发现DFA在相同架构下达到91.5%准确率，量化了生物启发学习规则的性能折衷。
Motivation: 现有神经形态语音处理系统依赖固定脉冲编码器，迫使下游SNN补偿非自适应的输入表示，无法充分利用事件驱动处理的优势。
Method: 提出一个可学习的残差语音到脉冲编码器，与R-LIF骨干网络端到端联合训练；编码器包含可学习的参数，将连续音频转换为脉冲序列。
Result: 在GSC-v2数据集上达到94.97%的准确率；35k参数的紧凑变体达到89.8%，匹配或优于需更多参数的基线；DFA策略达到91.5%准确率。
Conclusion: 可学习的脉冲编码器能学习任务相关的稀疏表示，提升类别可分性；生物启发的DFA在牺牲少量精度（约3.5个百分点）的情况下可实现更硬件友好的训练。

papers.title: Geometric and Stochastic Analysis of Discontinuities in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) architectures are now widely deployed in state-of-the-art language and vision models, where conditional routing allows scaling to very large networks. However, this very Top-$k$ expert selection that enables conditional routing also renders the SMoE map inherently discontinuous. In the vicinity of these discontinuity surfaces, even inputs that are arbitrarily close may activate substantially different sets of experts resulting in significantly different outputs. In this work we give a rigorous geometric and stochastic analysis of these discontinuities. We first classify them by order, determined by the number of tied experts at a switching event. Using measure-theoretic slicing arguments, we establish asymptotic volume estimates for the thickened discontinuity surfaces, showing that lower-order discontinuity sets dominate, whereas higher-order ones occupy a vanishingly small relative volume. Next, modeling random perturbations in the input space via a diffusion process, we prove that the path eventually encounter a discontinuity, and moreover that the first hit almost surely occurs on an order-1 discontinuity with explicit finite-time probability bounds. We further derive occupation-time bounds that quantify the duration the random path spend in the neighborhoods of each discontinuity order. These theoretical results imply that inputs are more likely to lie near lower order discontinuities. Motivated by this insight, we propose a simple smoothing mechanism that can be directly applied to existing SMoEs, softly incorporating experts near discontinuities; our analysis guarantees that the added computational overhead remains small while providing localized smoothing near discontinuities, and experiments across language and vision tasks show that smoothing not only enforces continuity of the SMoE map but also enhances empirical performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对稀疏混合专家（SMoE）架构中的不连续性进行严格的几何与随机分析。作者按切换事件中并列专家数对不连续性进行阶数分类，利用测度论切片论证建立渐近体积估计，证明低阶不连续性占主导而高阶不连续性体积趋零。通过扩散过程建模输入随机扰动，证明路径几乎必然遇到一阶不连续性并给出有限时间概率界。基于理论洞察，提出一种轻量平滑机制，仅需少量额外计算即可局部平滑不连续性，在语言和视觉任务上提升经验性能。
Motivation: SMoE的Top-k专家路由使得映射函数本质上不连续：邻近输入可能激活完全不同专家导致输出差异显著，影响模型稳定性和鲁棒性。现有研究缺乏对这种不连续性结构的几何与随机分析。
Method: 将不连续性按并列专家数分类为不同阶数；使用测度论切片方法推导加厚不连续性表面的渐近体积估计；将输入扰动建模为扩散过程，利用概率论证明首次击中不连续性的阶数分布与时间界；基于理论结果设计一种直接应用于现有SMoE的平滑机制，在保持低计算开销前提下对不连续区域进行局部平滑。
Result: 低阶不连续性占据主导体积，高阶不连续性相对体积随维度增大趋零；随机输入路径几乎必然在有限时间内击中一个一阶不连续性；所提平滑机制在语言和视觉任务上提升性能，且额外计算量可控。
Conclusion: 理论表明SMoE输入更可能处于低阶不连续性附近，为实践中平滑不连续性提供了理论依据。平滑机制有效且计算高效，可即插即用于现有SMoE模型。

papers.title: A Hybrid LSTM--Vision Transformer Architecture for Predicting HRRR Forecast Errors
papers.abstract_en: Forecast errors in high-resolution numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems are often linked to unresolved planetary boundary layer (PBL) processes, convection, terrain-induced circulations, and other vertically structured atmospheric phenomena. Previous work demonstrated that Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks can successfully predict forecast errors in the High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR) model using mesonet observations, but we believe performance degradation is linked to periods of complex vertical atmospheric evolution. To address this limitation, we develop a hybrid LSTM-Vision Transformer (LSTM-ViT) framework that combines temporal sequence learning from surface observations with atmospheric profiles from the New York State Mesonet profiler network. The LSTM-ViT framework is trained to predict HRRR hourly precipitation, 10 m wind speed, and 2 m temperature forecast errors at individual mesonet stations. Across all three predictors, incorporation of profiler-derived atmospheric structure improves forecast error prediction skill relative to the baseline LSTM architecture, with the largest gains occurring at shorter forecast lead times and during periods of enhanced PBL activity. Improvements are particularly pronounced for precipitation forecast error, where the LSTM-ViT framework achieves approximately a twofold increase in predictive skill relative to the baseline LSTM while better capturing convectively driven error evolution and reducing degradation associated with PBL processes. These results demonstrate that combining temporal sequence learning with vertically informed attention mechanisms provides a physically meaningful pathway for improving forecast error prediction in operational NWP systems. Our research offers forecasters enhanced guidance regarding model bias and forecast confidence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合 LSTM-Vision Transformer (LSTM-ViT) 框架，用于预测高分辨率快速刷新 (HRRR) 数值天气预报模型的预报误差。该框架结合地表观测的时间序列学习与纽约州 Mesonet 廓线网络的大气垂直结构信息，在降水、10米风速和2米温度预报误差预测上均优于基线 LSTM，尤其对降水预报误差的预测技能提升约两倍，并更好地捕捉对流驱动误差演变，减少了与边界层过程相关的退化。
Motivation: 高分辨率 NWP 系统的预报误差常与未解析的边界层过程、对流及地形环流等垂直结构相关，而基线 LSTM 在复杂垂直大气演化期间性能下降。
Method: 开发了混合 LSTM-Vision Transformer (LSTM-ViT) 架构，将 LSTM 对地表观测的时序学习与 Vision Transformer 对大气廓线垂直结构的注意力机制相结合，训练预测 HRRR 的降水、风速和温度预报误差。
Result: 在所有三个预报变量上，LSTM-ViT 相比基线 LSTM 提升了预报误差预测技能，在短预报时效和边界层活动增强期间增益最大；降水误差预测技能提升约两倍，并更好地捕捉对流驱动误差。
Conclusion: 结合时序学习与垂直注意力的混合方法为改进业务 NWP 系统的预报误差预测提供了物理上有意义的途径，有助于增强预报员对模型偏差和预报置信度的指导。

papers.title: FoMoE: Breaking the Full-Replica Barrier with a Federation of MoEs
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training Large Language Models (LLMs) typically demands large-scale infrastructure with tightly coupled hardware accelerators. While increasing model and dataset scale remains the dominant driver of performance, Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) architectures have recently achieved state-of-the-art results by decoupling parameter count from computational cost. This efficiency enables training massive models on constrained compute budgets, yet it typically requires the high-speed interconnects of a single datacenter. To overcome these physical limits, recent approaches such as DiLoCo and Photon use low-communication data-parallel methods to enable scaling across geographically distributed, weakly connected data centers. However, these methods suffer from a fundamental inefficiency: they require full model replicas at every site, which imposes prohibitive memory constraints and communication overheads. In this work, we introduce FoMoE, a system that breaks the full-replica paradigm by partitioning expert layers across workers. We demonstrate that FoMoE: (I) reduces communication costs by up to 1.42x over efficient baselines and 45.44x over DDP via partial expert replication in the studied regimes; (II) achieves empirical throughput speedups of up to 1.4x through a novel skip-token mechanism; and (III) shows stable routing in the trained proxy regimes and projects the communication/memory benefits to 100B-scale configurations through system modelling.

papers.title: Lifecycle-Aware Dynamic Analysis for Secure ML Model Execution
papers.abstract_en: The growing reliance on pre-trained Machine Learning (ML) models has introduced new attack surfaces. Recent vulnerabilities demonstrate that malicious behavior can be embedded within model artifacts, often bypassing existing defenses. Current model-scanning solutions primarily rely on static, format-specific rules or known attack signatures, which limit their ability to generalize across frameworks and to detect novel exploitation paths. In contrast, we propose a solution that focuses on the effects an attack has on the host system executing the model and builds on foundational intuitions about ML model execution. In particular, we observe that ML models operate within well-defined lifecycle phases and that, within each phase, interactions with the host system are highly structured and predictable. We translate these intuitions into Moat, a dynamic lifecycle-aware approach for securing ML model execution, and instantiate this design in Re-Moat, our reference implementation. We evaluate Re-Moat across multiple ML frameworks using 77,974 real-world model artifacts from the Hugging Face Hub, 31 Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) from CVEs, and 334 models from a state-of-the-art dataset, and compare it against state-of-the-art model-scanning solutions. Our results show that our approach detects all evaluated attack classes while maintaining a close-to-zero false-positive rate, validating our intuitions and motivating dynamic analysis for securing ML model execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预训练机器学习模型工件中嵌入恶意行为的新攻击面，提出一种动态生命周期感知分析方法Moat及其参考实现Re-Moat。该方法基于ML模型在执行生命周期各阶段与主机系统交互的结构化可预测性，通过监控系统影响检测攻击。在包含77,974个真实Hugging Face模型、31个CVE概念验证和334个SOTA数据集的评估中，该方法检测了所有攻击类别并保持了接近零的假阳性率，优于现有静态规则方法。
Motivation: 现有模型扫描方案主要依赖静态、格式特定的规则或已知攻击签名，难以跨框架泛化和检测新型利用路径。
Method: 提出Moat，一种动态生命周期感知方法，利用ML模型在执行生命周期内与主机系统交互的高度结构化可预测性，通过Re-Moat实现。
Result: 在77,974个Hugging Face模型、31个CVE PoC和334个SOTA模型上的评估表明，该方法检测所有攻击类别，并保持接近零的假阳性率。
Conclusion: 验证了动态分析在保护ML模型执行中的有效性，并建议采用生命周期感知方法。

papers.title: FlowObject: Flow Steering for Bridging Generative Priors and Reconstruction Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: Recovering complete 3D representations of objects from few casual image captures remains a significant challenge. Recent 3D generative models, particularly those based on Flow-Matching (FM), can synthesize high-quality textured assets; however, they often suffer from ''synthetic bias'' where learned priors override observational evidence, alongside a lack of alignment with the observed instance. Conversely, optimization-based methods like 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provide high fidelity on visible surfaces but fail to reason about unobserved geometry. In this paper, we present FlowObject, a framework that reformulates sparse-view 3D reconstruction as a training-free, guided inverse problem. Our approach applies a dual-space guidance strategy to steer the Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) trajectory of a flow-matching model, enabling the completion of unseen regions through learned generative priors while enforcing strict consistency with real-world observations. By integrating a 3DGS refinement stage, FlowObject further bridges the gap between ''synthetic-looking'' generative outputs and photorealistic reconstructions. Comprehensive benchmarks on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that current state-of-the-art methods often struggle to achieve geometric completeness and observational consistency simultaneously, especially under severe occlusions. In contrast, our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art generative models and optimization-based frameworks in both geometric completeness and view-dependent appearance fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowObject，一种无需训练的引导逆问题框架，用于稀疏视图下的 3D 物体重建。该方法采用双空间引导策略，利用流匹配模型的生成先验填补未观测区域，同时通过 3DGS 细化阶段确保与真实观测的一致性，在几何完整性和外观保真度上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有生成模型存在“合成偏差”且缺乏观察一致性，而优化方法在未观测区域推理不足；需要同时利用生成先验和观测一致性来提升稀疏视图重建质量。
Method: 将稀疏视图重建转化为无训练的引导逆问题，通过对流匹配模型的 ODE 轨迹进行双空间引导，并结合 3DGS 细化阶段来生成高保真度的 3D 表示。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，FlowObject 在几何完整性和视图依赖外观保真度上显著优于当前最先进的生成模型和优化方法。
Conclusion: 该方法无需训练即可融合生成先验与观测约束，弥合了生成输出与真实感重建之间的差距。

papers.title: Sumi: Open Uniform Diffusion Language Model from Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become a promising alternative to autoregressive models. Among these, uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) permit any token to be updated at any step, in principle enabling more flexible generation. However, no UDLM has yet been pretrained from scratch at both large parameter scale and large token budget. Both autoregressive modeling and masked diffusion modeling already have capable models at scale that the community can study and build on; uniform diffusion has none. A scratch-pretrained UDLM at scale would provide a clean reference point for studying scaling behavior, generation dynamics, controllability, and trade-offs against established autoregressive and masked diffusion models. To this end, we introduce Sumi ("ink" in Japanese), a fully open 7B uniform diffusion language model pretrained from scratch on 1.5T tokens. Sumi performs competitively with autoregressive models trained at comparable token budgets on knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks, while under-performing on commonsense benchmarks, where our education-heavy data mixture is a likely contributor. We release our model weights, checkpoints, and full training recipe, including a complete specification of the data mixture over publicly available corpora. We hope this release enables the community to study native uniform diffusion at scale and catalyzes work on its as-yet poorly understood aspects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Sumi，一个 7B 参数的均匀扩散语言模型（UDLM），从头在 1.5T tokens 上预训练。它在知识、推理和编码基准上与同等 token 预算的自回归模型表现相当，但在常识基准上表现较差，可能源于以教育为主的数据混合。作者公开了模型权重、检查点和完整训练配方，旨在推动大规模均匀扩散语言模型的研究。
Motivation: 均匀扩散语言模型（UDLM）允许任意 token 在任何步骤更新，但尚无模型在大参数和大 token 预算下从头预训练。这种空白阻碍了社区研究其扩展行为、生成动态、可控性以及与自回归和掩码扩散模型的对比。
Method: 从零开始预训练一个 7B 参数的均匀扩散语言模型，使用 1.5T tokens 的训练数据，并公开完整的数据混合规范。
Result: 在知识、推理和编程基准上达到与同等 token 预算的自回归模型竞争的性能，但在常识基准上不及，可能因数据混合偏向教育内容。
Conclusion: Sumi 作为首个大规模从头预训练的 UDLM，为社区提供了研究参考，并希望促进对均匀扩散模型尚未充分理解方面的探索。

papers.title: Spotlight: Synergizing Seed Exploration and Spot GPUs for DiT RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) is prohibitively expensive, requiring thousands of high-end GPUs. Existing works explore two directions to reduce cost: seed exploration improves training convergence by selecting high-contrast samples, yet adds compute to the critical path; spot GPUs offer 69--77\% lower cost, yet sit idle during training because DiT rollouts finish nearly simultaneously, which prevents LLM-style pipelining of rollout with training. Spot preemptions further break Sequence Parallelism (SP) groups, fragmenting GPU topology. We present Spotlight, the first system that harvests spot GPUs for DiT RL post-training. Spotlight rests on two key insights we devise: (1)~we show that exploration can tolerate stale model weights because exploration that uses the model weights from the previous iteration preserves the relative ranking of random seeds, allowing exploration to run on idle spot GPUs during training. (2)~SP reconfiguration can reuse on-node state, reducing group recovery from minutes to sub-second launches. Built on these insights, Spotlight introduces three techniques: a bandit-based exploration planner that maximizes reward variance within the training time budget, elastic sequence parallelism that reconfigures SP groups on the fly via persistent schedulers and intra-node weight copying, and a preemption-aware pull-based request scheduler that balances load and commits in-flight state upon preemption. We implement Spotlight on the open-source RL platform ROLL and evaluate it on Qwen-Image post-training. Spotlight reaches the same target validation score $4\times$ faster than baselines, reducing total cost by $1.4$-$6.4\times$ while achieving superior image quality on DeepSeek-OCR and Geneval datasets with resolution $512\times512$ and $1280\times1280$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Spotlight系统，首次利用spot GPU进行Diffusion Transformers (DiT)的强化学习后训练。基于两个关键洞察：种子探索可容忍陈旧模型权重，以及序列并行重配置可重用节点状态。系统包含三种技术：基于bandit的探索规划器、弹性序列并行和抢占感知拉取调度器。在Qwen-Image后训练中，达到相同验证分数快4倍，总成本降低1.4-6.4倍，图像质量更优。
Motivation: DiT的强化学习后训练成本极高，现有方法中种子探索增加计算开销，而spot GPU因DiT rollout几乎同时完成而闲置，且抢占破坏序列并行组。
Method: 基于两个洞察：探索可使用上一轮迭代的模型权重以保留种子排序，SP重配置可复用节点状态实现亚秒级恢复。提出三种技术：bandit-based探索规划器最大化奖励方差、弹性序列并行通过持久调度器和节点内权重复制动态重配置SP组、抢占感知拉取调度器平衡负载并提交状态。
Result: 在Qwen-Image后训练上，达到相同验证分数快4倍，总成本降低1.4-6.4倍，在DeepSeek-OCR和Geneval数据集上512×512和1280×1280分辨率下图像质量更优。
Conclusion: Spotlight证明利用spot GPU可大幅降低DiT RL后训练成本，且不牺牲训练效率和模型质量。

papers.title: DIPHINE: Diffusion-based $Φ$-ID Neural Estimator
papers.abstract_en: Uncovering the true informational architecture of real-world complex systems requires disentangling how their components uniquely store, redundantly share, and synergistically integrate information over time. Integrated Information Decomposition ($Φ$ID) is a framework for decomposing the information dynamics of multivariate systems into sixteen non-overlapping atoms that characterize redundant, unique, and synergistic modes of information storage, transfer, and integration. Existing methods to compute $Φ$ID are restricted to Gaussian or discrete systems, preventing its application to continuous non-Gaussian dynamical systems. We address this limitation by proposing DIPHINE (Diffusion-based $Φ$-ID Neural Estimator), the first neural estimator that leverages score-based diffusion models to jointly estimate all the mutual information terms required by $Φ$ID from a single amortized network, recovering the sixteen atoms through Möbius inversion. We provide a theoretical analysis of error propagation through the inversion, showing that the Jacobian of the mapping from mutual informations to atoms is integer-valued and that the synergy-to-synergy atom is provably the hardest to estimate. We demonstrate accurate recovery of ground-truth atoms on synthetic benchmarks, superior performance compared to established mutual information estimators, and the ability to extract physiologically interpretable information-dynamic structure on an application involving real data without any distributional assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DIPHINE，首个基于扩散模型的ΦID神经估计器，利用score-based扩散模型联合估计所有互信息项，通过Möbius反演恢复16个信息原子，适用于连续非高斯动态系统。理论分析了误差传播，并证明协同-协同原子最难估计。在合成基准上准确恢复ground-truth原子，性能优于现有互信息估计器，并在真实数据上提取可解释的信息动态结构。
Motivation: 现有ΦID方法局限于高斯或离散系统，无法应用于连续非高斯动态系统，限制了其在实际复杂系统中的应用。
Method: 利用score-based扩散模型从单一摊销网络中联合估计所有互信息项，通过Möbius反演恢复ΦID的十六个原子。
Result: 在合成基准上准确恢复ground-truth原子，性能优于现有互信息估计器，并在真实数据上提取了可解释的信息动态结构。
Conclusion: 首次实现连续非高斯系统的ΦID估计，理论分析了误差传播，指出协同-协同原子最难估计。

summary_sections.result: 在合成基准上准确恢复ground-truth原子，性能优于现有互信息估计器，并在真实数据上提取了可解释的信息动态结构。
summary_sections.conclusion: 首次实现连续非高斯系统的ΦID估计，理论分析了误差传播，指出协同-协同原子最难估计。

papers.title: TRAP: Benchmark for Task-completion and Resistance to Active Privacy-extraction
papers.abstract_en: Agents are increasingly deployed in document-intensive workflows where sensitive private information is not an edge case but a routine input, e.g., an agent booking a flight needs passport numbers. In such settings, the agent must use private information to complete tasks accurately while never exposing it in its responses, because it cannot verify who is actually at the keyboard. These two obligations are in fundamental tension. A model capable enough to use private information for task completion can, by the same capability, be induced to reveal it. To evaluate the trade-off of task accuracy and privacy leakage, we introduce Task-completion and Resistance to Active Privacy-extraction (TRAP). Each scenario includes a document containing private information, a task query that requires the agent to invoke the correct tool using private fields, and an attack query that attempts to elicit the same information in natural language. Evaluating 22 models spanning frontier proprietary and open-source models at multiple scales, we find that all model families exhibit non-trivial leakage, and that instruction-following ability correlates with leakage rate. Existing prompt-based defenses reduce leakage but at significant cost to task accuracy. Prompt optimization fails to escape this trade-off. We demonstrate that this failure is not incidental. For any softmax-based model, no soft-constraint defense, e.g., prompt-based defenses, can jointly achieve high task success with zero leakage probability. Motivated by this impossibility result, we propose structural private field isolation, which replaces private fields with hash keys before they reach the model. This approach largely prevents leakage while keeping task accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能代理在文档密集型任务中必须使用隐私信息但又不泄露隐私的矛盾，提出TRAP基准测试，评估任务准确性与隐私泄露的权衡。实验发现所有模型都有非平凡泄露，指令跟随能力与泄露率相关，并证明了软约束防御（如提示防御）无法同时实现高任务成功率和零泄露概率，进而提出结构化私密字段隔离方法。
Motivation: 代理在需要处理敏感隐私信息（如护照号）的文档工作流中，必须同时保证任务准确完成和不泄露隐私，但这两者存在根本矛盾，现有防御措施效果有限。
Method: 提出TRAP基准，包含文档隐私信息、任务查询和攻击查询。评估22个模型，尝试提示防御和提示优化，发现无法突破任务-隐私权衡。理论上证明对任何softmax模型，软约束防御无法同时实现高成功率和零泄露。提出结构化私密字段隔离，用哈希键替换隐私字段后再输入模型。
Result: 所有模型家族均存在非平凡泄露，指令跟随能力与泄露率正相关。提示防御降低泄露但显著降低任务准确性。结构化私密字段隔离方法能大幅防止泄露同时保持任务准确性。
Conclusion: 本文指出在隐私敏感场景中软约束防御的根本局限性，并提供了结构化隔离作为可行方案。

papers.title: Sequential Kernel-based Conditional Independence Testing via Adaptive Betting
papers.abstract_en: Testing conditional independence is fundamental yet intrinsically difficult: without additional assumptions, Type I error control is impossible in general. The "Model-X'' paradigm addresses this difficulty by assuming exact knowledge of a relevant conditional distribution. While small deviations from this assumption can sometimes be tolerated in classical one-shot testing, existing sequential conditional independence tests typically require the Model-X conditional to be known exactly, making them fragile when it must instead be estimated. We propose a new approach that is substantially more robust to such estimation error. Our method applies testing-by-betting to an adaptively optimized Kernel Conditional Independence statistic, together with a normalization scheme and a truncate-and-shift calibration strategy. These modifications greatly reduce Type I error inflation while preserving high power across high-dimensional synthetic benchmarks and real-world fairness tasks, outperforming existing sequential Model-X approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/he-zh/SKCI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自适应投注的序列核条件独立性检验方法（SKCI），通过自适应优化的KCI统计量、归一化方案和截断-平移校准策略，增强了对模型-X条件估计误差的鲁棒性，在高维合成基准和真实公平性任务上优于现有序列Model-X方法。
Motivation: 现有序列条件独立性检验通常要求模型-X条件分布精确已知，当该分布需估计时易产生第一类错误膨胀。
Method: 将测试-投注（testing-by-betting）框架应用于自适应优化的KCI统计量，结合归一化与截断-平移校准策略。
Result: 在高维合成基准和真实公平性任务中，SKCI显著降低第一类错误膨胀并保持高功效，优于现有序列Model-X方法。
Conclusion: SKCI对模型-X条件估计误差具有更好的鲁棒性，为序列条件独立性检验提供更实用的方案。

papers.title: Show, Don't Ask: Generative Visual Disambiguation for Composed Image Retrieval with Turn-Valid Coverage
papers.abstract_en: Composed image retrieval (CIR) uses a reference image and a text modification to search for a target image. However, such queries often describe several possible images rather than one exact target, making the user's intent ambiguous. Recent methods address this by using conformal prediction to estimate ambiguity and by asking users clarifying text questions. However, these methods have two limitations: their coverage guarantee only holds at the first interaction, and text questions are often insufficient for resolving fine-grained visual differences such as appearance, attributes, or viewpoint. We propose CLARA, a clarification framework that resolves ambiguity by showing users a small panel of visual alternatives. Instead of answering text questions, the user simply selects the prototype image closest to the intended target. This provides a direct visual signal and avoids relying on a model to predict the user's answer. To maintain valid conformal guarantees across multiple interaction rounds, CLARA reweights calibration using the likelihood ratio induced by the user's selection. The displayed prototypes are also constrained to represent the current candidate set and are snapped to real corpus images, ensuring that generated images cannot artificially improve coverage. Experiments on open-domain and fashion benchmarks show that CLARA matches single-turn state-of-the-art retrieval performance, maintains nominal coverage across interaction rounds, and finds the intended target in fewer rounds than strong text-question baselines. Its advantage is especially clear when ambiguity involves viewpoint or fine-grained attributes, where visual clarification is more effective than textual questioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLARA框架，通过展示视觉候选面板来解决组合图像检索中的歧义，用户选择最接近目标的图像，并利用似然比重校准保持多轮保形保证。实验表明在开放域和时尚基准上匹配最先进的单轮检索性能，且比文本问题基线更高效，尤其在视角和细粒度属性歧义上优势明显。
Motivation: 现有组合图像检索方法通过保形预测估计歧义并让用户回答文本问题，但覆盖保证仅在第一轮有效，且文本问题不足以解决细粒度视觉差异（如外观、属性、视角）。
Method: 提出CLARA框架，通过展示一组视觉候选原型让用户直接选择最接近目标的图像，提供直接视觉信号；利用用户选择引起的似然比重校准校准集以保持多轮保形覆盖；原型限制为来自当前候选集且映射到真实语料图像，避免生成图像人为提高覆盖。
Result: 实验表明CLARA在单轮检索性能上与最先进方法相当，在多轮交互中保持名义覆盖，且比强基线文本问题方法用更少轮次找到目标；在视角和细粒度属性歧义上优势尤其明显。
Conclusion: 视觉澄清比文本提问在解决组合图像检索歧义方面更有效，特别是在涉及视角和细粒度属性的情况下。

papers.title: G-IdiomAlign: A Gloss-Pivoted Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Idiom Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Idioms are difficult to transfer across languages due to their non-compositionality and weak surface-form grounding, making literal mappings unreliable. We present G-IdiomAlign, a gloss-pivoted benchmark where each idiom is anchored by an English gloss from Wiktionary. We further construct a high-confidence reference alignment set for reproducible evaluation. G-IdiomAlign supports two protocols: (1) a controlled Multiple-Choice Idiom Equivalence with typed distractors for error attribution; and (2) a Gloss-Contrastive Generation contrasting No-gloss and With-gloss inputs to isolate the effect of an explicit semantic pivot. Across diverse LLMs, a bias to literal translation is a dominant failure mode, especially when the target is a low-resource language. Glosses consistently improve Gloss-Contrastive Generation under an embedding-based semantic proxy, but performance remains modest, indicating substantial headroom in the open output space. Subsequent analysis on Qwen3-8B further suggests that cross-condition differences are concentrated more in attention heads than in layers, while better With-gloss generations coincide with stronger gloss anchoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G-IdiomAlign，一个以英语 gloss 为锚点的跨语言习语对齐基准，包含多项选择等价测试和 gloss 对比生成两种协议。实验发现大语言模型普遍偏向字面翻译，引入 gloss 可改善生成质量，但总体表现仍有较大提升空间。
Motivation: 习语因非组合性和弱表面形式难以跨语言准确迁移，现有字面映射不可靠，缺乏系统性的对齐评估基准。
Method: 基于 Wiktionary 英语 gloss 构建锚点，设计高置信度参考对齐集；支持受控多项选择习语等价（含类型化干扰项）和 gloss 对比生成协议，通过有无 gloss 的对比隔离语义锚点效果。
Result: 多种大语言模型上字面翻译是主要失败模式，低资源语言尤为严重；gloss 在嵌入相似度代理下持续提升生成质量，但绝对性能仍较低，开放输出空间改善空间大。对 Qwen3-8B 的分析表明，跨条件差异更多集中在注意力头而非层，且更好的含 gloss 生成与更强的 gloss 锚定相吻合。
Conclusion: gloss 锚定能部分缓解跨语言习语对齐中的字面翻译偏差，但当前模型在开放输出场景下能力有限，未来需进一步探索。

papers.title: ThinkDeception: A Progressive Reinforcement Learning Framework for Interpretable Multimodal Deception Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal deception detection is critical for identifying fraudulent intentions, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on end to end black--box paradigms. These methods suffer from a severe lack of interpretability failing to provide transparent reasoning trajectories and struggling to explicitly capture the subtle, cross modal inconsistencies inherent in deceptive behaviors. To transcend these limitations, we propose ThinkDeception, a novel and interpretable multimodal deception detection framework. As a pioneering effort, it introduces Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into this domain, transforming deception detection from a traditional binary classification task into an explicit cognitive reasoning process. Facilitated by the first meticulously annotated step--by--step multimodal Chain of Thought (CoT) dataset, we develop a foundational model, ThinkDeception Base, empirically validating the critical role of modal inconsistency in decoding deception. Building upon this foundation, our core innovation lies in proposing Visual-Audio Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization(VAC--GRPO) equipped with a progressive training strategy. Distinct from standard GRPO, we stratify the training data into four progressive difficulty tiers, guiding the model through a psychologically grounded easy--to--hard cognitive transition. By innovatively coupling this dynamic curriculum scheduler with a multi dimensional, process aware reward mechanism and a reflective learning paradigm, we significantly elevate the model's overall reasoning quality. Extensive experiments on mainstream benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkDeception establishes a new SOTA, significantly outperforming existing methods in both detection accuracy and rationale quality. Ultimately, this work successfully drives the field of deception detection toward interpretable, multimodal cognitive reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ThinkDeception，一个可解释的多模态欺骗检测框架，首次将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）引入该领域，将欺骗检测转化为显式的认知推理过程。核心创新包括逐步多模态链式思维（CoT）数据集和Visual-Audio Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization（VAC-GRPO）渐进训练策略，通过分层难度和过程感知奖励提升推理质量。在主流基准上取得新SOTA，显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有欺骗检测方法多为端到端黑盒模型，缺乏可解释性，无法提供透明推理轨迹，且难以捕捉跨模态不一致性。
Method: 提出ThinkDeception框架，利用MLLM和精心标注的多模态CoT数据集训练基础模型；核心创新VAC-GRPO，结合渐进式训练（四个难度层级）和动态课程调度、多维过程感知奖励机制与反思学习范式。
Result: 在主流基准上达到新SOTA，在检测准确性和推理质量上显著超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 该工作推动欺骗检测领域向可解释、多模态认知推理方向发展。

papers.title: Beyond Tokenization: Direct Timestep Embedding and Contrastive Alignment for Time-Series Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have given rise to time-series question answering (TSQA), which formulates time-series analysis as natural-language question answering. However, directly feeding raw numerical series into LLMs suffers from a tokenization bottleneck: Byte Pair Encoding fragments continuous values into unstable tokens whose embeddings lack meaningful metric structure, resulting in the loss of magnitude, scale, and trend information. Prior methods use patch-based encoders that split the series into fixed windows, locking in one granularity that breaks patterns and hides exact timesteps, through a separate module that rarely transfers across datasets with different lengths or sampling rates. To address this challenge, we propose CADE (Contrastive Alignment with Direct Embedding), a novel framework for TSQA built upon two key components: direct timestep embedding and semantic alignment. The proposed framework maps each timestep directly into the LLM embedding space through a point-wise linear encoder and MLP projector, preserving exact index-level access while eliminating the need for patching and padding. To further bridge the semantic gap between time-series and language representations, we introduce a novel one-directional supervised contrastive loss that aligns time-series embeddings with frozen class-name text anchors. Experimental results on the public Time-MQA benchmark demonstrate that our framework consistently improves performance across six TSQA tasks, outperforming both open-source and proprietary LLM baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CADE 框架，通过直接时间步嵌入（point-wise linear encoder + MLP projector）和一方向监督对比损失，将时间序列直接映射到 LLM 嵌入空间，解决传统分词与补丁编码带来的粒度损失和语义鸿沟问题。在 Time-MQA 基准上，CADE 在六个时间序列问答任务上均取得一致提升，超越开源和闭源 LLM 基线。
Motivation: 现有方法将数值时间序列分词后输入 LLM 会破坏数值的度量结构，而基于补丁的编码器固定窗口粒度且跨数据集迁移差。需要一种能保留精确索引级信息并弥合时间序列与语言语义间隙的方法。
Method: 提出 CADE，其核心为：（1）直接时间步嵌入：对每个时间步使用逐点线性编码器和 MLP 投影器直接映射到 LLM 嵌入空间，无需分块或填充；（2）语义对齐：引入一方向监督对比损失，将时间序列嵌入与冻结的类名文本锚点对齐。
Result: 在公共 Time-MQA 基准上，CADE 在六个 TSQA 任务上持续改进性能，优于开源和专有 LLM 基线。
Conclusion: CADE 通过直接嵌入和对比对齐有效提升了时间序列问答的准确性和泛化性，但摘要未提及在天气特定任务（如降水预报）上的验证，其跨领域适用性有待进一步研究。

papers.title: CAPRA: Scaling Feedback on Software Architecture Deliverables with a Multi-Agent LLM System
papers.abstract_en: Automated assessment in software engineering education has advanced significantly for code grading and essay scoring. However, reviewing software architecture deliverables, which requires analyzing structural completeness and requirements traceability, has not yet been fully automated. Applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to this task requires robust architectures to ensure technical feedback is accurate and reliable for students. This paper presents CAPRA (Configurable Architecture Proficiency Report Assessment), a multi-agent LLM system that analyzes software architecture deliverables to generate personalized, template-compliant LaTeX feedback. As a core design choice, CAPRA coordinates multiple specialized agents and employs a Python-based microservice for multi-modal document extraction, utilizing PyMuPDF and vision-enabled LLMs (specifically gpt-4o) to parse text and UML diagrams. To ensure educational reliability and mitigate hallucinations, CAPRA introduces a deterministic Evidence Anchoring step using fuzzy matching via normalized Levenshtein distance, along with a ConsistencyManager agent that cross-verifies, deduplicates, and merges findings. System performance is assessed using a structured eight-criterion binary evaluation taxonomy covering: (i) extraction completeness, (ii) feature validation, (iii) issue grounding and severity detection, (iv) recommendation specificity and traceability, and (v) template and tone compliance. A preliminary empirical evaluation on 10 student reports shows that CAPRA satisfied 88.8% of the evaluated criteria under a strict two-rater aggregation rule, achieved moderate inter-rater agreement with human evaluators (kappa = 0.582), and processed each report in slightly over 4 minutes. While these results support the viability of LLM-supported architectural feedback, human oversight remains essential for subjective assessment dimensions.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 38th International Conference on Software Engineering Education and Training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAPRA是一个多智能体LLM系统，用于自动分析软件架构交付物并生成个性化LaTeX反馈。系统通过PyMuPDF和视觉LLM提取文本与UML图，采用模糊匹配的证据锚定和一致性管理器来减少幻觉。在10份学生报告上的初步评估显示，CAPRA满足88.8%的评价标准，与人工评估者达到中等一致性（kappa=0.582），每份报告处理约4分钟。
Motivation: 软件工程教育中，软件架构交付物的自动评估尚未完全自动化，现有方法难以同时分析结构完整性和需求可追溯性，需要可靠的LLM架构来生成准确的技术反馈。
Method: CAPRA通过多智能体协调，结合Python微服务进行多模态文档提取（PyMuPDF和gpt-4o），并引入确定性证据锚定（归一化Levenshtein距离模糊匹配）和ConsistencyManager代理进行交叉验证、去重和合并，确保教育可靠性。
Result: 在10份学生报告上，CAPRA在八准则二元评估中满足88.8%的标准，与人类评估者的kappa值为0.582，每份报告处理时间略超4分钟。
Conclusion: 结果表明LLM支持的架构反馈可行，但主观评估维度仍需人工监督。

papers.title: Visual-OPSD: Cross-Modal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Unified Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) interleave generated ''visual thoughts'' (VTs) with text reasoning to improve spatial tasks. This incurs roughly an order-of-magnitude inference cost from multi-step diffusion. We find this cost yields limited direct benefit. On ThinkMorph, removing or noising VTs barely changes accuracy across nine benchmarks. Once rendered, attention concentrates on the VT regardless of content. Yet a KL diagnostic shows that conditioning on a privileged VT trace shifts the model's completion distribution. This suggests the generation pathway encodes useful reasoning beyond the rendered pixels. Motivated by this gap, we propose Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation(Visual-OPSD). Teacher and student share identical weights but differ in context: the teacher sees privileged VTs while the student sees only the question. Token-level JSD distillation on on-policy student trajectories transfers the teacher's reasoning to a text-only student. Across nine benchmarks, Visual-OPSD improves over its generative teacher by $+3.40$pp with $14.3\times$ speedup (10.0s vs. 142.8s per sample) and outperforms same-scale VLMs by $+63.83$pp on VSP. A Gaussian-noise control ($+0.40$pp vs. $+10.28$pp for real VTs) and $58.4\%$ closure of the KL gap confirm that gains come from the semantic content of the generation pathway.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Visual-OPSD，一种跨模态在线自蒸馏方法，用于高效统一多模态推理。该方法基于观察：统一多模态模型生成的“视觉思考”虽带来巨大推理成本，但去除后精度几乎不变，而 KL 诊断表明生成路径的语义内容包含有用推理。Visual-OPSD 使用相同权重的教师与学生，教师看到视觉思考，学生只看问题，通过 token 级 JSD 蒸馏将教师推理转移到纯文本学生。在九个基准上，该方法比生成式教师提升 +3.40 个百分点，加速 14.3 倍，并在 VSP 上超过同规模 VLM。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型生成“视觉思考”带来约一个数量级的推理成本，但去除或噪声化视觉思考后精度几乎不变，表明当前生成路径效益有限，需要更高效的利用方式。
Method: 提出 Visual-OPSD，采用在线自蒸馏：教师和学生共享权重，教师以视觉思考为上下文，学生仅看问题；通过 on-policy 学生轨迹上的 token 级 JSD 散度蒸馏，将教师的推理转移到纯文本学生。
Result: 在九个基准上，Visual-OPSD 比生成式教师平均提升 +3.40 个百分点，每样本推理时间从 142.8 秒降至 10.0 秒（14.3 倍加速），并在 VSP 上比同规模 VLM 提升 +63.83 个百分点。KL 差距的 58.4% 被弥合，且高斯噪声控制实验（+0.40 vs 真实视觉思考 +10.28 百分点）确认增益来自生成路径的语义内容。
Conclusion: 视觉思考的生成路径编码了有用的推理，但渲染像素本身贡献有限；通过自蒸馏可将该推理转移到纯文本模型，大幅降低推理成本并提升性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FOSC-X: An Extended Framework for Optimal Local Cuts and Non-Horizontal Cluster Selection from Clustering Hierarchies
papers.abstract_en: Extracting a flat clustering solution from a hierarchy is a common task in practical cluster analysis and can be formulated as an optimisation problem. Existing approaches focus on finding a single optimal solution. We introduce FOSC-X, a framework for extracting the top-M globally optimal flat clusterings from local, non-horizontal cuts of a hierarchical cluster tree, while optionally enforcing constraints on the number of clusters. This enables automatic identification of multiple high-quality alternative clusterings that capture different aspects of the hierarchical structure. Without constraints, the top-M problem can be solved in polynomial time using dynamic programming, exploiting the property that locally optimal partial candidates within subtrees can be combined to form globally optimal solutions while automatically determining the number of clusters. However, this can lead to solutions with numbers of clusters that are ultimately undesirable -- e.g., too large to be meaningful or practically analysed within a particular application domain. Imposing cluster-count constraints breaks the optimality property underlying the unconstrained dynamic programming approach, since locally optimal partial candidates may no longer combine into feasible globally optimal solutions. FOSC-X addresses this challenge through a dynamic programming strategy that maintains compact sets of feasible candidates using lower and upper feasibility bounds while pruning infeasible or dominated combinations. The resulting method guarantees optimal rankings of the top-M solutions with linear-time complexity in the number of cluster nodes and dataset size, both with and without cluster-count constraints. Experiments show that FOSC-X efficiently reveals alternative clustering structures overlooked by single-solution extraction methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FOSC-X 是一个从层次聚类树中提取全局最优的多个扁平聚类（top-M）的扩展框架。它通过动态规划在无约束和带聚类数约束两种情况下，以线性时间保证最优解排名，并揭示了单解提取方法忽略的替代聚类结构。
Motivation: 现有方法只能从层次聚类中提取单个最优扁平解，忽略了可能存在的多个高质量替代聚类结构，且约束聚类数时优化变得困难。
Method: 提出 FOSC-X，使用动态规划策略：无约束时利用子树的局部最优组合得到全局最优；带聚类数约束时，维护可行解的上下界并剪枝不可行或支配组合，保证 top-M 最优排名。
Result: 实验表明 FOSC-X 能够高效揭示单解方法忽略的替代聚类结构，计算复杂度在聚类节点数和数据集大小上为线性。
Conclusion: FOSC-X 提供了从层次聚类中提取多个最优扁平解的通用框架，支持聚类数约束，且复杂度与数据规模线性相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Controlled Benchmark of Quantum-Latent GAN Augmentation for Brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Medical image classification is often constrained by limited labeled data, motivating generative augmentation; recently, quantum generative models have been proposed for this purpose, frequently reporting accuracy gains. However, such claims are typically based on single training runs, do not match the parameter budgets of the quantum and classical generators, and do not characterize the data regime in which any benefit appears. We present a controlled benchmark that isolates the contribution of a quantum generator to brain-MRI augmentation. Images are encoded into a KL-regularized latent space in which a conditional Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty is trained using either a variational quantum generator or a classical generator of near-identical parameter count (1648 vs. 1632). Synthetic samples are decoded and used to augment a pretrained classifier across labeled data fractions from 5% to 100%, evaluated over eight random seeds with paired significance testing (with multiple-comparison correction) and with intraset diversity and latent-distribution analyses. Across all fractions, no augmentation variant significantly outperforms real-data-only training, and the quantum and classical generators are statistically indistinguishable. Any low-data benefit behaves as regularization rather than faithful data expansion:synthetic samples are off distribution and severely mode collapsed precisely where data is scarce, and the quantum generator is no more diverse thanits classical counterpart. We release the protocol as a testbed for rigorous evaluation of quantum generative augmentation in medical imaging.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个受控基准测试，用于评估量子生成对抗网络（quantum-latent GAN）在脑MRI数据增强中的效果。通过将图像编码到KL正则化潜空间，分别使用参数数量相近的变分量子生成器和经典生成器训练条件Wasserstein GAN，并在不同标记数据比例（5%-100%）下进行测试。实验表明，无论数据比例如何，任何增强方法都没有显著优于仅使用真实数据训练，且量子与经典生成器在统计上无差异。低数据场景下的收益更像正则化而非真实数据扩充，合成样本存在模式坍塌和分布外问题。
Motivation: 现有的医学图像分类常受限于标记数据不足，而生成式增强被用来缓解这一问题；近期有研究提出使用量子生成模型并报告了精度提升。然而，这些声称通常基于单次训练运行、未匹配量子与经典生成器的参数预算，且未明确数据量 regimes 下的收益条件。该论文旨在通过受控基准测试严格评估量子生成模型在脑MRI数据增强中的真实贡献。
Method: 研究使用KL正则化的潜空间编码，在该空间中训练条件Wasserstein GAN（带梯度惩罚），分别采用变分量子生成器和参数数量几乎相同的经典生成器（1648 vs 1632）。合成样本被解码后用于增强预训练分类器，在标记数据比例从5%到100%的范围内进行评估，基于8个随机种子进行配对显著性检验（多重比较校正），并分析了集合内多样性和潜分布。
Result: 在所有数据比例下，没有任何增强变体显著优于仅使用真实数据训练；量子生成器和经典生成器在统计上不可区分。低数据场景下的任何提升表现为正则化效果而非真实数据扩充：合成样本在数据稀缺时严重偏离真实分布并存在模式坍塌，且量子生成器的多样性不优于经典对应物。
Conclusion: 论文强调，量子生成模型在脑MRI数据增强中并未带来相对于经典方法的优势，任何低数据下的收益实际源于正则化而非数据扩充，并发布该基准协议作为医学影像中量子生成增强的严格评估测试平台。
Relevance: 0
