summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调，量子生成模型在脑MRI数据增强中并未带来相对于经典方法的优势，任何低数据下的收益实际源于正则化而非数据扩充，并发布该基准协议作为医学影像中量子生成增强的严格评估测试平台。

papers.title: Balanced Twins: Causal Inference on Time Series with Hidden Confounding
papers.abstract_en: Accurately estimating treatment effects in time series is essential for evaluating interventions in real-world applications, especially when treatment assignment is biased by unobserved factors. In many practical settings, interventions are adopted at different times across individuals, leading to staggered treatment exposure and heterogeneous pre-treatment histories. In such cases, aggregating outcome trajectories across treated units is ill-defined, making individual treatment effect (ITE) estimation a prerequisite for reliable causal inference. We therefore study the problem of estimating the average treatment effect for the treated (ATT) by first recovering individual-level counterfactuals. We introduce a neural framework that learns simultaneously low-dimensional latent representations of individual time series and propensity scores. These estimates are then used to approximate the individual treatment effects through a flexible matching procedure that avoids classical convexity constraints commonly used in synthetic control methods. By operating at the individual level, our approach naturally accommodates staggered interventions and improves counterfactual estimation under latent bias, without relying on explicit temporal modeling assumptions. We illustrate our approach on both real-world energy consumption data and clinical time series, including high-frequency electricity demand-response programs and semi-synthetic data for individuals in intensive care unit (ICU), where hidden confounding, staggered treatment adoption, and non-stationary dynamics are prevalent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个神经网络框架，用于在时间序列中估计平均处理效应（ATT），特别针对存在隐藏混杂和交错干预的场景。该方法同时学习个体时间序列的低维潜在表示和倾向得分，通过灵活的匹配过程避免传统合成控制方法的凸性约束。在能源消耗和临床时间序列数据上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理交错干预和异质性预处理历史时，聚合处理单元的结果轨迹定义不清，需要先估计个体处理效应（ITE）才能进行可靠的因果推断。
Method: 提出一个神经网络框架，同时学习个体时间序列的低维潜在表示和倾向得分，然后通过灵活的匹配过程近似个体处理效应，避免了合成控制方法中常用的凸性约束。
Result: 在真实世界的能源消耗数据和临床时间序列（包括高频电力需求响应项目和ICU个体半合成数据）上展示了方法的效果，这些数据中存在隐藏混杂、交错干预和非平稳动态。
Conclusion: 该方法通过个体层面操作自然适应交错干预，并在潜在偏置下改进了反事实估计，而不依赖显式的时间建模假设。

papers.title: EfficientRollout: System-Aware Self-Speculative Decoding for RL Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a representative post-training paradigm for LLMs, enabling strong reasoning and agentic capabilities. However, rollout generation remains a dominant latency bottleneck because autoregressive sampling decodes responses sequentially and a small number of long-tailed generations often determine completion time. Speculative decoding (SD) offers a natural way to address this bottleneck, as it is a well-established technique for serving fixed LLMs that reduces latency by rapidly drafting tokens and accepting them through parallel verification while preserving the target-model distribution. However, its practical speedups do not directly carry over to RL rollouts: (i) the evolving target policy makes any fixed drafter increasingly mismatched with the policy's output distribution; and (ii) active batch sizes shrink throughout rollout decoding, shifting decoding from compute-bound to memory-bound regimes where parallel verification can exploit underutilized compute. Therefore, accelerating RL rollouts requires both a drafter that remains effective under long, high-temperature generations from an evolving policy and system-aware use of SD that avoids compute-bound regimes. We present EfficientRollout, a system-aware self-SD framework designed to address this gap for RL rollouts. EfficientRollout induces a quantized drafter from the target model (i.e. self-speculative decoding), keeping it coupled to the evolving policy without separate drafter pretraining or online adaptation. It further coordinates a system-aware SD toggle policy with acceptance-aware draft-length adaptation, enabling speculation only in beneficial regimes while matching the drafting budget to evolving drafter quality. EfficientRollout reduces rollout and end-to-end latency by up to 19.6% and 12.7%, respectively, over an accelerated AR rollout baseline, while preserving final model quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EfficientRollout，一种系统感知的自推测解码框架，用于加速强化学习(RL)中LLM的rollout生成。它通过从目标模型量化出草稿模型（自推测解码），避免单独训练；并协调系统感知的推测解码切换策略与接受感知的草稿长度自适应，仅在有利的预算区域进行推测。摘要报告在加速的自回归rollout基线上减少了高达19.6%的rollout延迟和12.7%的端到端延迟，且不损失最终模型质量。
Motivation: RL rollout生成是延迟瓶颈，因为自回归采样顺序解码且少量长尾生成决定完成时间。推测解码在固定LLM中有效，但直接用于RL rollout存在两个问题：演化中的目标策略使固定草稿模型不匹配；活跃batch size缩小使解码从计算密集型变为内存密集型，并行验证可充分利用未充分利用的计算。
Method: EfficientRollout提出系统感知的自推测解码框架：从目标模型量化出草稿模型（自推测解码），无需单独预训练或在线自适应；协调系统感知的推测解码切换策略与接受感知的草稿长度自适应，仅在有利的预算区域进行推测，并使草稿预算与演化的草稿质量匹配。
Result: 在加速的自回归rollout基线上，rollout延迟降低高达19.6%，端到端延迟降低高达12.7%，同时保持最终模型质量。
Conclusion: 该框架解决了RL rollout中推测解码的系统感知使用问题，通过自推测和自适应策略有效加速，且无需额外训练或复杂度。

papers.title: Online Reward-Punishment Learning from Fixed-Channel Perceptual Event Streams without Environment Rewards
papers.abstract_en: We study online reward-punishment learning when the environment provides no scalar reward or evaluative label. At each step the agent receives only a fixed-channel perceptual packet, and quantities such as pain, energy, contact, damage, or cognitive error are treated as perceptual dimensions whose valence must be inferred from transition consequences. OHIRL separates four roles: M_psi learns next-packet prediction, D_omega models residual dynamics, C_eta is a fixed internal post-transition trajectory evaluator, and B_xi learns to use the resulting value evidence for later policy updates and action scoring. C_eta uses a recovery-positive and persistence/growth-negative residual-regulation orientation; a coefficient-origin audit shows that equal-unit, raw-equal, and random monotone variants preserve more than 92% of the released top-action rankings, while sign inversion preserves 0%. The reward-free protocol exposes observation transitions while withholding environment rewards, delayed external evaluators, success labels, and action-goodness labels. A conditional error decomposition separates B_xi evidence-estimation error from residual policy-optimization error. In a 2x2-XOR packet task, medicine and chili acquire opposite value under visual XOR contexts, and the same pain or spice increase can be positive or negative depending on consequence structure; B_xi reaches 0.952 balanced reward-sign accuracy. In a full online-interleaved audit, M_psi reaches holdout R2=0.907, B_xi reaches 0.940 sign accuracy, and the policy reaches 0.979 optimal-action accuracy, while immediate packet scores, prediction-error rewards, shuffled targets, zero reward, and error-reduction controls collapse. Hidden-reward CartPole and Taxi controls, public-context no-leakage audits, and module-role ablations further test information boundaries and component necessity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无环境奖励的在线奖惩学习问题。在每个时间步，智能体仅接收固定通道的感知数据包，痛苦、能量、接触、损伤或认知误差等量被视为感知维度，其价值必须通过转移结果推断。OHIRL将学习分为四个角色：M_psi学习下一数据包预测，D_omega建模残差动态，C_eta是固定的内部后转移轨迹评估器，B_xi学习使用由此产生的价值证据进行后续策略更新和动作评分。方法在2x2-XOR数据包任务和隐藏奖励CartPole和Taxi控制任务上进行了评估，取得了较高准确率。
Motivation: 标准强化学习依赖环境提供的标量奖励或评价标签，但在许多现实场景中这类信号不可用或难以定义。本文目标是设计一个协议，使得智能体仅从固定通道感知事件流中学习，无需外部奖励或评估者。
Method: 提出OHIRL框架，包含四个模块：M_psi（预测下一个数据包）、D_omega（建模残差动态）、C_eta（固定内部评估器，基于后转移轨迹的恢复正性与持久/增长负性的残差调节方向）、B_xi（利用评估证据进行策略更新和动作评分）。使用条件误差分解分离证据估计误差和策略优化误差。
Result: 在2x2-XOR任务中，B_xi达到0.952的平衡奖励符号准确率；在完整在线交错审计中，M_psi的留出R²为0.907，B_xi符号准确率0.940，策略最优动作准确率0.979。而即时数据包分数、预测误差奖励、打乱目标、零奖励等控制条件均崩溃。隐藏奖励CartPole和Taxi实验进一步验证了信息边界和组件必要性。
Conclusion: 本文证明在无环境奖励的情况下，通过固定通道感知流和内部轨迹评估器可以实现有效的在线奖惩学习。方法在多种任务上取得了高准确率，但适用场景可能限于感知维度具有可解释的残差调节结构。

papers.title: Be Your Own Teacher: Steering Protein Language Models via Unsupervised Reward Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Protein language models (PLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for controllable biomolecular design, yet their post-training adaptation typically relies on costly wet-lab validation or curated preference datasets. To overcome this supervision bottleneck, we introduce unsupervised reward optimization of PLMs, a comprehensive framework for steerable protein generation without ground-truth labels. Our key insight is that task-agnostic rewards, which combine intrinsic model uncertainty with extrinsic semantic consistency informed by protein representation models, exhibit strong correlation with controllability measures across base models and temperature regimes. Building upon this discovery, we propose two offline algorithms: Soft Reward Optimization (SRO) and Binarized Reward Optimization (BRO), which effectively maximize the classical RLHF objective induced by these proxy rewards. Extensive experiments on compositional out-of-distribution prompts demonstrate that both methods significantly outperform competitive baselines (DPO, KTO), while approaching oracle performance across multiple sampling temperatures, model scales and protein families. Moreover, PLMs fine-tuned with unsupervised rewards can achieve consistently higher coverage compared to their base model in pass@k evaluations. By enabling self-improvement of PLMs through their own generated experience, our framework provides a scalable pathway toward controllable biomolecular design in settings where labeled preferences or experimental feedback are scarce or unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督奖励优化框架，用于蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的后训练适配，无需湿实验验证或偏好数据集。关键发现是任务无关的奖励（结合模型不确定性和蛋白质表示模型提供的语义一致性）与可控制性指标强相关。基于此，提出软奖励优化（SRO）和二值化奖励优化（BRO）两种离线算法，在成分分布外提示上显著优于DPO、KTO等基线，接近Oracle性能，并在多个采样温度、模型规模和蛋白质家族上保持优势。
Motivation: 蛋白质语言模型后训练适配通常依赖昂贵的湿实验验证或人工标注的偏好数据，存在监督瓶颈。需要一种无需标签的自动化优化方法。
Method: 提出无监督奖励优化框架：利用模型不确定性和蛋白质表示模型的语义一致性构建任务无关的奖励信号，并基于此设计两种离线算法SRO和BRO，最大化经典RLHF目标。
Result: 在成分分布外提示实验中，SRO和BRO显著优于DPO、KTO等基线，接近Oracle性能；在不同采样温度、模型尺度和蛋白质家族上表现一致；微调后的PLM在pass@k评估中覆盖率高于基模型。
Conclusion: 该框架使PLM能够通过自身生成的经验自我改进，为缺乏标注偏好或实验反馈的场景提供可扩展的可控生物分子设计路径。

papers.title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, offering a scalable alternative to costly real-world experimentation by generating action-consistent video rollouts. However, persistent world modeling remains challenging in manipulation: frequent end-effector occlusions and rapid wrist-camera motion make the current observation insufficient for predicting future views, causing models to forget or hallucinate scene details seen in earlier frames. Existing memory retrieval strategies often fail to identify informative history in dynamic manipulation scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Mem-World, a memory-augmented multi-view action-conditioned world model. At its core, we present W-VMem, a 4D wrist-view-centered surfel-indexed memory that anchors historical observations to temporally evolving surface elements. By explicitly modeling when and where scene elements are observed, W-VMem enables geometry-aware retrieval of relevant history frames conditioned on future actions. During generation, relevant history frames are selected via surfel-based rendering and scoring, providing informative and non-redundant context for prediction. Extensive experiments show that Mem-World generates persistent rollouts in complex manipulation scenarios, enables more reliable policy evaluation than Ctrl-World, improving the Pearson correlation with real-world performance by 14.5\%, and supports effective policy improvement through synthetic data generation, increasing success rates from 58\% to 72\% on long-horizon tasks.

Result: 摘要报告在复杂操作场景中生成持久推演，相比Ctrl-World，与真实世界性能的皮尔逊相关性提高14.5%，在长程任务上通过合成数据生成将成功率从58%提升至72%。

papers.title: Motion-Focused Latent Action Enables Cross-Embodiment VLA Training from Human EgoVideos
papers.abstract_en: Training generalist Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models typically requires massive, diverse robotic datasets with high-fidelity action annotations. While egocentric human manipulation videos are abundant and capture significant environmental diversity, the absence of action labels makes them difficult to use in conventional training paradigms. To address this, we propose a latent-action-based framework designed to extract general action priors from unlabeled human videos. The architecture features a Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE that decouples motion dynamics from environmental backgrounds through physical masks, enabling the construction of a cross-embodiment action codebook. By pre-training on human videos with the codebook, the VLM backbone learns deep representations of action intent. For adaptation to specific embodiments, we introduce an intent-perception decoupling strategy where the VLM predicts the action intent while a separate frozen visual encoder provides state-specific features to the action expert, thereby reducing action hallucinations. Results in simulation and real-world environments show that our method, pre-trained exclusively on unlabeled human videos, performs competitively with state-of-the-art VLA models trained on massive annotated datasets, requiring only 50 trajectories for downstream adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜在动作的框架，从无标签人类第一人称视频中提取通用动作先验，以训练通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。通过混合解耦VQ-VAE将运动动力学与环境背景分离，构建跨实体动作码本，并在人类视频上预训练VLM以学习动作意图。实验表明，仅用50条轨迹进行下游适配即可与使用大规模标注数据集的SOTA VLA模型竞争。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖大规模、多样化的机器人数据集和精确动作标注，而丰富的无标签人类视频难以直接使用。本文旨在利用人类视频中的动作信息，减少对标注数据的依赖。
Method: 提出潜在动作框架，包含混合解耦VQ-VAE，通过物理掩码分离运动与背景，构建跨实体动作码本。采用意图-感知解耦策略：VLM预测动作意图，冻结的视觉编码器提供状态特征给动作专家，减少动作幻觉。
Result: 在仿真和真实环境中，仅使用无标签人类视频预训练，通过50条轨迹下游适配，性能与使用大规模标注数据集训练的SOTA VLA模型相当。
Conclusion: 该框架有效利用人类视频中的动作先验，可减少对标注机器人数据的依赖，适用于跨实体泛化。

papers.title: RTSGameBench: An RTS Benchmark for Strategic Reasoning by Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle with strategic reasoning, i.e., anticipating and influencing other agents' actions, under uncertainty in competitive and cooperative settings. Real-time strategy (RTS) games can be a natural testbed for diagnosing this limitation, as they demand coordination with allies, adaptation to opponents' strategy, and long-horizon planning under partial observability. However, existing RTS benchmarks offer limited evaluation scope, lack systematic competency diagnosis, and remain fixed in the pre-designed scenario coverage. To address these limitations, we present RTSGameBench, which is built on Beyond All Reason, a large-scale RTS game with an expanded battlefield that demands broader strategy diversity than the existing testbeds. The proposed benchmark provides evaluations through diverse gameplay across various matchup structures, diagnostic assessment via mini-games, each targeting an individual strategic competency, and extensible coverage via a self-evolving generation framework that converts free-form queries into new mini-games, improving over successive cycles. Additionally, for VLMs to operate in large-scale RTS games, we provide RTSGameAgent that manages units by an FSM with agentic memory. We empirically validate that multiple state-of-the-art VLMs do not perform well when matchups demand tighter coordination, multiagent coordination and when task scale increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 RTSGameBench，一个基于大型即时战略游戏 Beyond All Reason 的基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在战略推理方面的能力。该基准通过多种对战结构、针对性小游戏诊断以及自进化生成框架扩展场景。同时提供 RTSGameAgent，使用有限状态机（FSM）和 agentic memory 管理单位。实验表明多个 SOTA VLM 在需要紧密协调、多智能体协作和任务规模增大时表现不佳。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在竞争与合作环境中的战略推理能力不足，而现有的 RTS 基准测试评估范围有限，缺乏系统诊断能力，且场景覆盖固定。
Method: 基于大型 RTS 游戏 Beyond All Reason 构建基准，包含多种对战结构、诊断性迷你游戏（每个针对一种战略能力）以及自进化生成框架（将自由形式查询转化为新迷你游戏）。同时提供 RTSGameAgent，使用有限状态机和 agentic memory 管理单位操作。
Result: 多个 SOTA VLM（如 GPT-4V 等）在需要紧密协调、多智能体协作以及任务规模增大时表现不佳。
Conclusion: RTSGameBench 提供了一个系统诊断 VLM 战略推理局限性的工具，并推动未来研究。

papers.title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM agents increasingly depend on real-time search, yet native search grounding bundles retrieval policy, provider choice, evidence injection, cost, latency, and generation behavior behind a single model-provider boundary. This coupling makes grounding hard to inspect, tune, reuse, or port, and can trigger Search-Induced Verbosity that breaks strict output contracts. We present Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG), a vendor-agnostic boundary that moves grounding outside the reasoning model through an MCP-compatible gateway, exposing provider routing, source-aware context rendering, configured fallback, retrieval-depth control, and exact plus semantic caching as first-class controls. Across five frontier models on SimpleQA, FreshQA, and HotpotQA, native search leads on recency-sensitive FreshQA, but DSG exposes a stronger frontier when control matters: on SimpleQA it nearly matches native accuracy (86.1% vs. 87.7%) at 91% lower search cost, preserves concise answer contracts, and reaches a 99.4% warm-cache hit rate with 68% lower latency. Deployed as a shared production grounding layer for large-scale agentic workloads with interchangeable models, DSG matches or slightly exceeds native-search accuracy on an e-commerce query-understanding (QIU) workload while cutting search cost by over 98%. Real-time grounding is best treated as an optimizable interface boundary, not a fixed model feature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG)，一种与供应商无关的搜索基础架构，将实时搜索从推理模型中解耦，通过 MCP 兼容网关暴露提供商路由、上下文渲染、回退策略和缓存控制等可调参数。实验表明，DSG 在 SimpleQA 上接近原生搜索准确率（86.1% vs 87.7%），但搜索成本降低 91%，延迟降低 68%，且在生产级电商查询理解任务中准确率持平，成本降低超 98%。
Motivation: 生产 LLM 代理依赖实时搜索，但原生搜索基础将检索策略、提供商选择、证据注入、成本和生成行为捆绑在单一模型-提供商标界后，难以检查、调优、复用或移植，且可能引发搜索诱导的冗长问题，破坏严格的输出契约。
Method: DSG 通过一个与 MCP 兼容的网关将基础移出推理模型，将提供商路由、源感知上下文渲染、可配置回退、检索深度控制、精确语义缓存作为一等控制暴露给调用方。
Result: 在 SimpleQA 上，DSG 准确率 86.1% 对比原生搜索 87.7%，但搜索成本降低 91%；热缓存命中率达 99.4%，延迟降低 68%。在电商查询理解任务中，准确率持平，搜索成本降低超 98%。
Conclusion: 实时基础最好被视为一个可优化的接口边界，而非固定的模型特性。DSG 作为共享生产基础层，支持可互换模型，在大规模代理工作负载中匹配或略超原生搜索准确率。

papers.title: Physics-IQ Verified
papers.abstract_en: Video generative models ( VGMs) have become a new frontier that can be used not just for video generation but for a multitude of downstream tasks, including world modeling. To advance these tasks, a good video model must understand the physical reality of the world. Evaluating this understanding is an emerging field and has led to the Physics-IQ benchmark, which quantifies this explicitly by comparing model-generated videos to real-world videos of physical experiments. In this work, we present a systematic audit of the Physics-IQ benchmark, expose shortcomings and propose three solutions that sharpen how we can measure physical understanding of VGMs. Specifically, we improve prompt and ground-truth quality to reduce the influence of confounding factors and further introduce a sample-level scoring system that weights each sample and metric equally. Our resulting benchmark, Physics-IQ Verified, refines 57.6\% of all samples and improves over 34.8\% of prompts. In a comparison study using six image-to-video generative models, we observe moderate but meaningful ranking changes (Kendall's $τ= 0.46$). We hope Physics-IQ Verified advances the community by providing a more reliable signal toward physically accurate VGMs. The code for the benchmark can be accessed at https://github.com/google-deepmind/physics-iq-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对Physics-IQ基准进行系统性审计，指出其提示质量和真值标注的不足，并提出改进版本Physics-IQ Verified。改进包括优化提示、修正真值以及引入样本级加权评分，共修正了57.6%的样本和34.8%的提示。在六种图像到视频生成模型上的比较实验中，排名变化中等但显著（Kendall's τ=0.46）。
Motivation: 现有Physics-IQ基准在评估视频生成模型物理理解能力时存在提示质量差、真值标注错误等混淆因素，需要更可靠的评估信号。
Method: 通过人工审计和自动化流程，改进提示文本与真实视频的匹配度，修正错误标注，并引入样本级加权评分，使每个样本和指标对最终分数贡献相等。
Result: 改进后的基准修正了57.6%的样本和34.8%的提示；六种模型上的排名变化显示中等相关性（Kendall's τ=0.46）。
Conclusion: Physics-IQ Verified为视频生成模型的物理理解评估提供了更可靠的基准，但摘要未提及其对降水或天气相关任务的适用性。

papers.title: SciRisk-Bench: A Risk-Dimension-Aware Benchmark for AI4Science Safety
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in AI for Science (AI4Science) workflows, from scientific question answering and literature analysis to laboratory planning and autonomous discovery. This progress creates an urgent need for safety benchmarks that evaluate not only scientific competence, but also whether models recognize and avoid risks in high-stakes scientific contexts. Existing AI4Science safety datasets cover several disciplines and task formats, leaving the underlying risk dimensions underspecified. We introduce \textbf{SciRisk-Bench}, a benchmark designed to evaluate AI4Science safety from two complementary perspectives: explicit risk dimensions and scientific disciplines. SciRisk-Bench covers 7 disciplines, 31 subdisciplines and 10 risk dimensions. In the experimental section, we evaluate both mainstream LLMs and science-oriented LLMs across risk dimensions, disciplines, and sub-disciplines, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of where scientific models remain unsafe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SciRisk-Bench基准，用于评估AI4Science（AI for Science）中大语言模型在科学场景下的安全性，涵盖7个学科、31个子学科和10个风险维度。实验测评了主流和科学导向的LLM，提供细粒度的安全诊断。
Motivation: 现有AI4Science安全数据集覆盖了多个学科和任务格式，但缺乏对底层风险维度的明确界定。
Method: 构建SciRisk-Bench基准，从风险维度和科学学科两个互补角度评估AI4Science安全性，涵盖7学科、31子学科和10风险维度。
Result: 评估了主流LLM和科学导向LLM在风险维度、学科和子学科上的表现，实现了模型安全薄弱的细粒度诊断。
Conclusion: 该基准有助于识别科学模型中仍不安全的领域。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建SciRisk-Bench基准，从风险维度和科学学科两个互补角度评估AI4Science安全性，涵盖7学科、31子学科和10风险维度。
summary_sections.result: 评估了主流LLM和科学导向LLM在风险维度、学科和子学科上的表现，实现了模型安全薄弱的细粒度诊断。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该基准有助于识别科学模型中仍不安全的领域。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Active Feature Acquisition via LLM-Elicitation
papers.abstract_en: Active feature acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects which features to observe to reach a classification or ranking decision. Its central limitation is reliance on large amount of labeled data to fit probabilistic models guiding acquisition. Large language models (LLMs) supply unsupervised domain knowledge, but are poor sequential planners. Asking one to both know and decide conflates capabilities best kept separate. Here, we develop a framework for zero-shot AFA through disciplined elicitation: asking the LLM only for what it can be trusted to return, the unary deviations and pairwise co-variations that are the sufficient statistics of a Markov random field (MRF). We apply our framework to two settings: binary classification and top-$k$ identification. In practice, the LLM reliably returns only discriminative statistics, what distinguishes the classes rather than each class in isolation, which precludes classical AFA. We apply a maximum-entropy closure that resolves this gauge ambiguity. We evaluate on a cohort of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) patients, an active clinical setting where diagnostic ambiguity and patient heterogeneity obstruct stable treatment strategies. Our framework outperforms the LLM both on real labels and on its own extracted beliefs. Where it matters most, on the hardest patients, our top-$k$ acquisition policy markedly outperforms all existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本主动特征获取框架，通过从大型语言模型（LLM）中引出马尔可夫随机场（MRF）的充分统计量来指导特征选择，避免了传统AFA对大量标注数据的依赖。在炎症性肠病（IBD）患者队列上，该方法在分类和top-k识别任务中优于仅使用LLM的基线，尤其在困难患者样本上表现突出。
Motivation: 主动特征获取（AFA）传统上需要大量标注数据来拟合概率模型，限制了其在数据稀缺场景下的应用。LLM具有领域知识但缺乏序列规划能力，现有方法将知识获取和决策混合导致不足。
Method: 通过纪律性引出（disciplined elicitation）方法，仅让LLM返回马尔可夫随机场所需的充分统计量（一元偏差和成对协变），并采用最大熵闭包解决LLM仅返回判别性统计量带来的规范模糊性。
Result: 在炎症性肠病（IBD）患者队列上，该方法在真实标签和LLM自身信念上均优于直接使用LLM。在最困难的患者样本上，top-k获取策略显著优于所有现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了零样本主动特征获取，通过分离知识（LLM提供统计量）和决策（AFA算法）来克服LLM的规划弱点，在临床诊断歧义和患者异质性高的场景（如IBD）中有效。

papers.title: TransitNet: A Compact Attention-Augmented Deep Learning Framework for Low-SNR Transit Blind Searches
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the observational incompleteness of intermediate-to-long-period Earth-size planets, we present TransitNet, a compact attention-augmented deep-learning framework for low-SNR transit blind searches. To enable realistic method development and objective threshold calibration under blind-search conditions, we develop a unified dataset construction, benchmarking, and threshold-selection framework. On recovery benchmarks constructed from unseen Kepler targets, TransitNet attains 95.2 percent accuracy in the challenging SNR range of 6 to 8 and outperforms both TLS and BLS, achieving ROC-AUC and PR-AP values of 0.974 and 0.982, respectively. In an injected Earth-size and sub-Earth-size transit recovery experiment, TransitNet achieves a recovery rate of 93.0 percent, substantially exceeding those of TLS (63.1 percent) and BLS (60.0 percent). In addition to detection, TransitNet provides attention-based estimates of transit windows and midpoints. On an independent evaluation set, 97.4 percent of injected transits are fully covered by the estimated transit window. Applied to real Kepler observations, the model successfully recovers all 34 selected confirmed Kepler planets, with a mean absolute transit midpoint error of 1.24 hours. The model combines a compact footprint of about 1.5 MB with high inference efficiency, yielding speed-ups of about 12 to 25 times relative to CPU-TLS and about 4 to 5 times relative to CPU-BLS. These results demonstrate that TransitNet provides an accurate, scalable, and computationally efficient framework for low-SNR transit blind searches in the tested regime and motivate its extension to longer-period Earth-size planet searches.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 23 figures, 3 tables, submitted to MNRAS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TransitNet，一种紧凑的注意力增强深度学习框架，用于低信噪比（SNR）凌星盲搜索。通过统一的数据集构建、基准测试和阈值选择框架，TransitNet 在 SNR 6-8 范围内达到 95.2% 的准确率，ROC-AUC 和 PR-AP 分别为 0.974 和 0.982。在地球大小和亚地球大小凌星恢复实验中，恢复率达 93.0%，显著高于 TLS（63.1%）和 BLS（60.0%）。模型还提供基于注意力的凌星窗口和中心时刻估计，在真实开普勒观测中成功恢复所有 34 颗已确认行星，平均凌星中心时刻误差为 1.24 小时。模型大小约 1.5 MB，推理速度比 CPU-TLS 快约 12-25 倍，比 CPU-BLS 快约 4-5 倍。
Motivation: 目前中长周期地球大小行星的观测存在不完整性，低信噪比凌星盲搜索需要高效且准确的方法。现有方法（如 TLS 和 BLS）在低 SNR 下性能有限，且缺乏统一的基准测试框架。
Method: TransitNet 采用紧凑的注意力增强深度学习架构，结合统一的 dataset 构建、基准测试和阈值选择流程。模型可输出凌星窗口和中心时刻的注意力估计。
Result: 在 SNR 6-8 的挑战性范围内达到 95.2% 准确率；ROC-AUC 和 PR-AP 分别为 0.974 和 0.982。地球大小凌星恢复率为 93.0%，远超 TLS（63.1%）和 BLS（60.0%）。在真实数据上，所有 34 颗确认行星均被恢复，中心时刻平均误差 1.24 小时。模型大小 1.5 MB，推理速度显著快于 CPU 上的经典方法。
Conclusion: TransitNet 在测试条件下为低 SNR 凌星盲搜索提供了准确、可扩展且计算高效的框架，并有望推广到更长周期地球大小行星的搜索。

papers.title: GrapNet: A Programmable Dynamic-Architecture Neural Graph Substrate
papers.abstract_en: Programmability is a missing first-class interface in fixed-tensor neural networks: editing a relation, freezing a subgraph, auditing a local function, or changing the execution backend should be an operation on the neural program rather than ad-hoc parameter surgery. GrapNet studies this graph-as-network setting. The graph is the architecture and executable program, not an input data graph. Each compute node owns its next-layer child references and a trainable allocation vector aligned with those references; deleting a relation physically removes both the child reference and the corresponding allocation coordinate. Structural rules and execution policies live outside the node core, so the same child-owned graph can be grown, frozen, structurally edited, grouped into trainable family blocks, routed by attention over active relations, or lowered to dense snapshots after topology stabilizes. GrapNet composes with conventional modules through a vector-valued parent interface: dense layers, CNN encoders, ResNet feature extractors, attention blocks, and transformer representations can all feed one sensory GrapNode per coordinate. The evaluation is organized as a programmability stress suite rather than as a new replay benchmark. In a matched ten-seed Split Fashion-MNIST study, a plastic GrapNet+ER head reaches 63.16 percent seen-class accuracy versus 51.08 percent for a parameter-larger dense MLP+ER under the same seen-class loss and replay memory, with paired delta 12.08 points and p=1.3e-5. On Split CIFAR-10 with a frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 encoder, the same substrate improves the online head over MLP-256 by 3.81 points, with p=0.0026. These results support GrapNet as an editable neural graph substrate whose core value is structural programmability with faithful execution views.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GrapNet，一种可编程的动态架构神经图基板，其中图本身既是网络架构也是可执行程序。每个计算节点拥有指向下一层子节点的引用和可训练分配向量，支持结构编辑、冻结子图、分组训练块、注意力路由等操作，并能与常规模块通过向量化父接口组合。实验在 Split Fashion-MNIST 和 Split CIFAR-10 上验证了可编程性带来的性能提升。
Motivation: 固定张量神经网络缺乏可编程性接口，编辑关系、冻结子图、审计局部函数或更改执行后端需要临时参数手术，而非对神经程序的操作。
Method: GrapNet 将图视为网络和可执行程序，每个计算节点拥有子节点引用和可训练分配向量；通过删除引用和对应坐标实现关系删除；结构规则和执行策略独立于节点核心，支持拓扑生长、冻结、结构编辑、分组训练、注意力路由等。
Result: 在 Split Fashion-MNIST 上，可塑性 GrapNet+ER 头达到 63.16% 已见类准确率，比参数更大的密集 MLP+ER 高 12.08 个百分点（p=1.3e-5）；在 Split CIFAR-10 冻结 ResNet-18 编码器下，比 MLP-256 在线头提升 3.81 个百分点（p=0.0026）。
Conclusion: GrapNet 是一种可编辑的神经图基板，其核心价值在于结构可编程性和忠实的执行视图。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: As Easy as Rocket Science: Assessing the Ability of Large Language Models to Interpret Negation in Figurative Language
papers.abstract_en: Figurative language and negation are two areas that challenge current language models, however, both are widely used throughout written and spoken language. Large language models (LLMs) are also widely used in everyday contexts where they cannot necessarily be tuned for a specific dataset. It is therefore essential to understand the ability of LLMs to correctly interpret text that includes both negation and figurative language. To investigate this, we develop a set of new annotations to an existing dataset of figurative language, and test a range of language models on the dataset. We find that the combination of negation and figurativeness can present a particular challenge, and that performance overall and across different negation types is particularly dependent on the prompt style used.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 16 figures; for associated code and data see https://github.com/jrdowers/Negation-and-Fig-Lang; To be published in Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在比喻语言（figurative language）中理解否定（negation）的能力。作者对现有比喻语言数据集添加了否定注释，并测试了多种LLMs。发现否定与比喻性的结合尤其具有挑战性，且性能高度依赖于提示风格（prompt style）。
Motivation: 否定和比喻语言是当前语言模型的两个难点，但两者在日常语言中广泛使用。理解LLMs在这两者同时出现时的表现至关重要，尤其是在无法针对特定数据集进行微调的应用场景中。
Method: 对现有比喻语言数据集进行新的否定标注，然后在一系列语言模型上进行测试，分析不同提示风格下的表现。
Result: 否定和比喻性的组合对LLMs构成特殊挑战；性能总体上以及在不同否定类型上依赖于提示风格。
Conclusion: 研究强调了在比喻语境中处理否定时的困难，并指出提示工程的重要性。

papers.title: Some Complexity Results for Robustness Verification for Binarized Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the computational complexity of verification problems for Binarized Neural Networks (BNNs), where activations (and sometimes weights) are binary. We analyze two problems: satisfiability and robustness under uniform image occlusion. We show that BNN satisfiability is NP-complete via a reduction from Boolean satisfiability problem (SAT), and that uniform occlusion induces a piecewise-constant structure in the network output, enabling a polynomial-time robustness-checking algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了二值化神经网络（BNN）的验证问题的计算复杂度。作者证明BNN的可满足性是NP完全的（通过SAT归约），并且针对均匀图像遮挡的鲁棒性验证可以在多项式时间内完成，因为网络输出呈现出分段常数结构。
Motivation: 理解BNN的验证问题的计算复杂度，为实际验证算法提供理论基础。
Method: 通过从布尔可满足性问题（SAT）归约证明BNN可满足性的NP完全性；通过分析均匀遮挡下网络输出分段常数结构，设计多项式时间鲁棒性检查算法。
Result: 证明BNN可满足性是NP完全的；均匀遮挡场景下的鲁棒性验证存在多项式时间算法。
Conclusion: 本文界定了BNN验证问题的复杂度边界，揭示了均匀遮挡结构带来的计算易处理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REVES: REvision and VErification--Augmented Training for Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling via sequential revision has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. However, standard post-training methods primarily optimize single-shot objectives, creating a fundamental misalignment with multi-step inference dynamics. While recent work treats this as multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL), conventional approaches optimize over the multi-step trajectories directly, failing to further exploit the high-quality mistakes in intermediate steps that model can learn from correcting them. We propose a two-stage iterative framework that alternates between online data/prompt augmentation and policy optimization. By converting the intermediate steps (``near-miss'' answers) in the successful recovery trajectories into decoupled revision and verification prompts, our approach concentrates training on both effective answer transformation and error identification. This approach enables efficient off-policy data generation and reduces the computational overhead of long-horizon sampling compared to standard multi-turn RL. On LiveCodeBench, using publicly available test cases as feedback, we observe gains of +6.5 points over the RL baseline and +4.0 points over standard multi-turn training. Beyond coding, our approach matches the previously reported SOTA result on circle packing while using the smallest base model (4B) and far fewer rollouts than the much larger evolutionary search systems. Math results under ground-truth verification further confirm improved correction ability. It also generalizes to out-of-distribution constraint-satisfaction puzzles such as n\_queens and mini\_sudoku, where correctness is defined entirely by problem constraints. Code is available at https://github.com/yxliu02/REVES.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段迭代框架REVES，通过将中间步骤的“接近正确答案”转化为分离的修订和验证提示，加强对大语言模型多步推理的训练。该方法在LiveCodeBench上相比强化学习基线提升+6.5个点，在圆填充任务上使用最小模型（4B）即达到先前SOTA，并推广到分布外约束满足问题。
Motivation: 标准后训练方法主要优化单步目标，与多步推理的推理动态不匹配；现有多轮强化学习方法直接优化完整轨迹，未能充分利用中间步骤中可修正的高质量错误。
Method: 提出交替进行在线数据/提示增强和策略优化的两阶段迭代框架，将成功恢复轨迹中的中间步骤（近似答案）转换为解耦的修订和验证提示，从而聚焦于有效的答案转换和错误识别。
Result: 在LiveCodeBench上，使用公开测试用例作为反馈，相比强化学习基线提升+6.5个点，比标准多轮训练提升+4.0个点；圆填充任务中使用4B模型和较少采样即达到先前SOTA；数学结果在真实验证下显示出改进的修正能力；泛化到n皇后和迷你数独等分布外约束满足问题。
Conclusion: REVES通过高效离线数据生成和减少长轨迹采样计算开销，有效提升了测试时缩放下的推理能力，并适用于编码、数学和约束满足等多种任务。

papers.title: BindEdit: Taming Attention Leakage for Precise Multi-Object Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Real image editing enables precise manipulation of visual content, yet existing methods often fail in complex multi-object scenarios, causing semantic blending, object duplication, or incomplete edits. We attribute these failures to attention leakage, where signals across spatial regions and text tokens become entangled during the denoising process. Specifically, we identify two distinct forms of leakage: Edit-Token Leakage, where ambiguous token-region alignment leads to object blending, and Source Dominance Leakage, where tokens of unchanged source objects overwhelm the attention intended for target entities. To resolve these leakages, we propose \textbf{BindEdit}, which enforces attention-level constraints within a single diffusion trajectory. To suppress Edit-Token Leakage, BindEdit jointly regularizes cross- and self-attention so that each target token group is bound to its corresponding spatial region while maintaining instance-level separation. To suppress Source Dominance Leakage, a cross-attention re-balancing mechanism amplifies target token influence and attenuates residual source semantics within editable regions. Moreover, a region fidelity term ensures that each target concept is expressed coherently across the entire editing mask. Additionally, we propose a comprehensive multi-object benchmark encompassing diverse object counts and categories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BindEdit consistently outperforms existing methods within a single diffusion trajectory, maintaining robust performance across both single- and multi-object editing scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多目标图像编辑中的注意力泄漏问题，提出BindEdit方法，通过在单次扩散轨迹中施加注意力约束来抑制编辑-令牌泄漏和源主导泄漏，并在多目标基准上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在多目标编辑场景中常出现语义混合、对象重复或不完整编辑，论文将其归因于去噪过程中空间区域与文本令牌之间的注意力泄漏。
Method: BindEdit通过联合正则化交叉注意力和自注意力来绑定目标令牌组与对应空间区域，并通过交叉注意力重平衡机制放大目标令牌影响并削弱残留源语义，添加区域保真项确保目标概念在编辑掩码内连贯表达。
Result: 在提出的多目标基准上，BindEdit在单次扩散轨迹中一致优于现有方法，在单目标和多目标编辑场景中均保持稳健性能。
Conclusion: 论文认为通过针对两种注意力泄漏的约束机制，可以在复杂多目标编辑中实现精确的语义控制和实例分离。

papers.title: Multifractal Dynamics of Tropical Atlantic SST Indices: Nonlinear Scaling Structure and Episodic Statistical Association with ENSO Variability
papers.abstract_en: The Tropical Atlantic exhibits complex sea surface temperature (SST) variability driven by internal ocean-atmosphere interactions and remote climate forcing. We perform a comparative multifractal analysis of three SST indices, South Atlantic Tropical (SAT), Tropical Southern Atlantic (TSA), and the Tropical Atlantic SST Gradient Index (TASI), using weekly data from 1981 to 2025. Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA) reveals robust scale-dependent behavior in all indices. TASI displays a substantially broader multifractal spectrum (Delta h about 0.72) than SAT (0.27) and TSA (0.34). Surrogate-data tests show that multifractality in SAT and TSA is mainly explained by linear autocorrelations, whereas TASI contains an additional nonlinear contribution associated with phase correlations. To investigate temporal variability, we introduce a moving-window MFDFA framework that tracks the evolution of multifractal width. Significant reductions are observed during the major 1997-1998 and 2015-2016 El Nino events, indicating a suppression of multiscale variability under extreme Pacific forcing. Lagged correlation analysis reveals a significant negative association with the Oceanic Nino Index at delays of 15-18 months, consistent with known Atlantic-Pacific teleconnections. However, Granger causality and Transfer Entropy tests do not detect significant causal links, suggesting an episodic rather than persistent relationship. Lagged multifractal cross-correlation analysis further reveals scale-dependent inter-basin coupling. These results demonstrate that time-dependent multifractal measures provide a useful framework for characterizing nonlinear Atlantic variability and identify TASI as a dynamically distinct index whose scaling properties contain information not captured by regional SST indices alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对三个热带大西洋SST指数（SAT, TSA, TASI）进行多重分形分析，发现TASI具有更宽的多重分形谱（Δh≈0.72），其多重分形性包含非线性相位相关贡献。滑动窗口MFDFA揭示在1997-1998和2015-2016强厄尔尼诺事件期间多重分形宽度显著减小。滞后相关分析显示与ONI负相关（15-18个月延迟），但Granger因果检验和传递熵检验不显著，表明是一种 episodic 而非持续的关系。
Motivation: 热带大西洋SST变率复杂，内部海洋-大气相互作用和远程气候强迫共同影响，现有研究对不同SST指数的非线性尺度结构差异及与ENSO的关联缺乏系统比较。
Method: 采用多重分形去趋势波动分析（MFDFA）比较三个SST指数的标度行为；引入滑动窗口MFDFA跟踪多重分形谱宽度的时间演变；使用Granger因果检验和传递熵检验因果联系。
Result: TASI的多重分形谱宽度（Δh≈0.72）远大于SAT（0.27）和TSA（0.34）；替代数据测试表明SAT和TSA的多重分形性主要由线性自相关解释，而TASI包含非线性相位相关贡献；强厄尔尼诺事件期间多重分形宽度显著降低；滞后相关显示与ONI负相关（15-18个月延迟），但因果检验不显著。
Conclusion: 时变多重分形测量为刻画非线性大西洋变率提供了有用框架，并揭示TASI是动态独特的指数，其标度性质包含区域SST指数未捕捉的信息。

papers.title: Anomaly Detection for Sparse and Irregular Multivariate Time Series with Latent SDEs
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) is critical for a wide range of application areas, such as industrial monitoring, cybersecurity, or healthcare. Real-world data is often sparse, irregularly sampled or partially observed, yet existing methods assume uniformly sampled time series. We propose a generative approach based on Latent SDEs that projects the observed time series on a continuous-time stochastic dynamical system, directly being able to handle missing observations and irregular sampling, while also naturally capturing possible cyclic behavior that many real-world use cases inherently possess. Experiments on six anomaly benchmark datasets show that our proposed method ranks first among state-of-the-art baselines. We further demonstrate that our method remains robust under severe data sparsity, while performance significantly degrades for the tested baseline methods. These results highlight latent SDEs as a natural inductive bias for anomaly detection in multivariate time series, especially in presence of real-world irregularities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜在随机微分方程（Latent SDE）的生成式方法，用于处理稀疏、不规则采样或部分观测的多变量时间序列异常检测。该方法将观测序列投影到连续时间随机动力系统，自然处理缺失值和周期行为。在六个异常检测基准上排名第一，对数据稀疏性保持鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法大多假设均匀采样，无法处理真实世界中常见的稀疏和不规则采样数据，导致性能下降。
Method: 采用潜在随机微分方程（Latent SDE）建模连续时间随机动力系统，通过变分推断学习，直接处理缺失观测和不规则采样，并捕捉循环模式。
Result: 在六个异常检测基准数据集上排名第一，且在高稀疏度下性能保持稳定，对比基线方法显著下降。
Conclusion: 潜在SDE可作为多变量时间序列异常检测的自然归纳偏置，尤其适用于存在不规则性的实际数据。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: SAERec: Constructing Fine-grained Interpretable Intents Priors via Sparse Autoencoders for Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Intent-based recommender systems have gained significant attention for improving accuracy and interpretability by modeling the underlying motivations behind user behaviors. Most existing models derive intents directly from user sequences via clustering or prototype learning. However, they are sensitive to sequence quality, require presetting the number of intents, and lack explicit semantic grounding. These issues lead to an incomplete and coarse intent set and limit the effectiveness of recommendation. In this paper, we propose the Sparse Autoencoder for intent-based recommendation (SAERec), a novel recommender that automatically constructs a fine-grained and interpretable intent space from a textual corpus to guide recommendation. Rather than treating texts as side signals, SAERec leverages them as high information density evidence for intent construction. Specifically, we first extract a comprehensive set of fine-grained interpretable intents from the latent space of large language models (LLMs) by using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) to disentangle and interpret text embeddings, which isolates intent-related semantics from textual noise. Then, for each user, we retrieve relevant intents from this set as priors to guide recommendation. It contains personal intents matching a user's current interests and public intents capturing general item patterns shared across users (e.g., quality, price). Finally, to integrate retrieved intents into sequence modeling, we propose a multi-branch attention mechanism that captures temporal dependencies and injects both personal and public intent signals, followed by an adaptive fusion layer to construct the final user representation for recommendation. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of SAERec, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines while providing human-understandable explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAERec，一种基于稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder）的推荐方法，从大语言模型（LLM）的文本嵌入中自动解耦出细粒度、可解释的意图，避免传统方法预设意图数量和依赖序列质量的缺陷。通过多分支注意力机制融合个人意图与公共意图，在多个公开数据集上超越现有基线，并提供人类可理解的解释。
Motivation: 现有基于意图的推荐大多从用户序列中聚类或原型学习意图，受序列质量影响大、需预设意图数量且缺乏语义基础，导致意图集合不完备粗糙，限制了推荐效果。
Method: 首先利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从 LLM 文本嵌入中分离出细粒度可解释意图；然后为每个用户检索相关意图作为先验（包括个人兴趣与公共模式）；最后通过多分支注意力机制捕获时序依赖并注入意图信号，经自适应融合层得到最终用户表示。
Result: 在公开数据集上，SAERec 一致优于 state-of-the-art 基线，并同时提供可理解的解释。
Conclusion: SAERec 通过从文本语料自动构建细粒度可解释意图空间，有效提升推荐准确性与可解释性，避免了预设意图数和序列质量依赖。

papers.title: Automatic ply-specific analyses of CFRP micrographs using shortest-path-based ply distinction
papers.abstract_en: We present an automated approach to distinguish between ply instances in semantic segmentation masks of high-resolution carbon-fiber reinforced polymer micrographs. Interpreting the segmentation mask as a graph with pixels as vertices, enables us to use a shortest-path algorithm yielding the ply-separating paths. Thereby, we bridge the gap between semantic segmentation and ply instance segmentation using global information. We successfully apply our approach on high-resolution micrographs featuring a broad range of characteristics like artificially added gaps in single or multiple plies, different stacking sequences and ply traversing cracks. Assigning each fiber pixel to a ply based on the calculated paths, allows for a comprehensive, quantitative ply analysis with respect to its microstructural properties like the local fiber volume fraction as well as locally resolved ply and interleaf layer thickness. These insights help to reveal manufacturing-induced inhomogeneities, draw conclusions on manufacturing parameters and link mechanical properties to underlying microstructural imperfections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自动方法，在碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）微图的语义分割掩码中区分铺层实例。通过将分割掩码视为图，利用最短路径算法生成分离路径，从而将语义分割推广到铺层实例分割。该方法适用于各种特征的高分辨率微图，并实现了对纤维像素的铺层分配，进而进行定量分析（如局部纤维体积分数、铺层厚度等），有助于揭示制造缺陷并关联力学性能。
Motivation: 现有语义分割只能识别纤维/基体等像素类别，但无法区分不同铺层（ply）实例，限制了微观结构定量分析。本文旨在填补语义分割与铺层实例分割之间的空白。
Method: 将分割掩码视为图，像素为顶点，利用最短路径算法找到铺层之间的分隔路径。基于这些路径将每个纤维像素分配给所属铺层。
Result: 成功应用于高分辨率微图，包括人工间隙、不同堆叠顺序和穿层裂纹等多样特征。实现了局部纤维体积分数、铺层厚度等微结构属性的量化分析。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了全自动的、基于全局信息的铺层级分析，有助于揭示制造不均匀性，并连接力学性能与微观缺陷。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种自动方法，在碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）微图的语义分割掩码中区分铺层实例。通过将分割掩码视为图，利用最短路径算法生成分离路径，从而将语义分割推广到铺层实例分割。该方法适用于各种特征的高分辨率微图，并实现了对纤维像素的铺层分配，进而进行定量分析（如局部纤维体积分数、铺层厚度等），有助于揭示制造缺陷并关联力学性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有语义分割只能识别纤维/基体等像素类别，但无法区分不同铺层（ply）实例，限制了微观结构定量分析。本文旨在填补语义分割与铺层实例分割之间的空白。
summary_sections.method: 将分割掩码视为图，像素为顶点，利用最短路径算法找到铺层之间的分隔路径。基于这些路径将每个纤维像素分配给所属铺层。
summary_sections.result: 成功应用于高分辨率微图，包括人工间隙、不同堆叠顺序和穿层裂纹等多样特征。实现了局部纤维体积分数、铺层厚度等微结构属性的量化分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法提供了全自动的、基于全局信息的铺层级分析，有助于揭示制造不均匀性，并连接力学性能与微观缺陷。

papers.title: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Improving GUI agents typically relies on behavior cloning on expert trajectories. However, as the current policy deviates from the expert policy, it inevitably encounters policy-induced off-trajectory states during closed-loop execution, i.e., states that fall outside the expert trajectories. Since expert trajectories provide no demonstrations for these unseen states, such states receive no effective supervision, leaving the policy unable to select the correct action. To close this supervision gap, we propose Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation (SGCD), an iterative self-improvement framework. SGCD first runs the plain policy without skill guidance for a few steps to reach realistic off-trajectory states. From these states, a skill-guided policy then completes the task and produces successful continuations, which are mixed with expert trajectories to supply supervision over policy-induced off-trajectory states. The skills are extracted from both successful and failed rollouts, consisting of Continuation Plans, Critical Targets, Failure Traps, and Success Criteria. On OSWorld-Verified, SGCD improves the success rate of three base models from the low-30\% range to over 50\%, demonstrating its effectiveness and generality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation (SGCD) 框架，用于解决 GUI 代理在闭环执行中因策略偏离专家轨迹而遇到的脱轨状态缺乏监督的问题。SGCD 首先运行无技能引导的朴素策略以到达真实的脱轨状态，然后由技能引导策略完成任务并生成成功延续，与专家轨迹混合提供监督。技能从成功和失败的 rollouts 中提取。在 OSWorld-Verified 上，SGCD 将三个基线的成功率从约 30% 提升至 50% 以上。
Motivation: 现有行为克隆方法只在专家轨迹上训练，但当当前策略偏离专家策略时，闭环执行中会遇到专家轨迹未覆盖的脱轨状态，这些状态缺乏有效监督，导致策略无法选择正确动作。
Method: 提出 SGCD 迭代自改进框架：先运行无技能引导的策略若干步进入真实的脱轨状态；然后从这些状态出发，由技能引导策略完成任务并记录成功延续；将成功延续与专家轨迹混合，为脱轨状态提供监督。技能包括 Continuation Plans、Critical Targets、Failure Traps 和 Success Criteria，从成功和失败 rollouts 中提取。
Result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 基准上，SGCD 提升了三个不同基线的成功率，从约 30% 提升至 50% 以上，展示了有效性和普适性。
Conclusion: SGCD 通过将技能引导的成功延续与专家轨迹混合，有效填补了闭环执行中脱轨状态的监督缺口，适用于多种基线和环境。

papers.title: Generative-Model Predictive Planning for Navigation in Partially Observable Environments
papers.abstract_en: Navigation in partially observable environments presents a significant challenge for autonomous agents, requiring effective decision-making with limited sensory information in unknown environments. Belief-based methods, particularly those using neural networks to approximate the belief space, often fail to capture the inherent multimodality of belief spaces, especially in high-dimensional cases with perceptual aliasing. While generative models present a compelling alternative, they typically require substantial data or expert demonstrations and lack explicit mechanisms for long-term planning. In this paper, we introduce BeliefDiffusion, a novel framework that combines the benefits of both generation and planning. BeliefDiffusion leverages diffusion models to explicitly characterize multimodal belief distributions and utilizes Model Predictive Control (MPC) to simultaneously plan ahead. It consists of two steps: (1) Imagining plausible environment configurations based on observation history and (2) Planning efficient navigation strategies across an aggregated configurations. Through extensive experiments in synthetic map environments, we demonstrate that BeliefDiffusion significantly outperforms both model-free reinforcement learning baselines and other generative approaches in navigation success rate and path efficiency. Our results validate that explicitly incorporating multimodal belief representations into planning enables more robust navigation in partially observable settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BeliefDiffusion框架，用于部分可观测环境下的导航。该框架利用扩散模型显式表征多模态信念分布，并结合模型预测控制（MPC）进行前瞻规划。在合成地图实验中，BeliefDiffusion在导航成功率和路径效率上显著优于无模型强化学习基线和现有生成方法，验证了多模态信念表示对鲁棒导航的有效性。
Motivation: 现有信念方法难以捕捉高维、感知模糊下的多模态信念空间，而纯生成模型缺乏长期规划机制。
Method: BeliefDiffusion包含两步：1）基于观测历史生成可能的环境配置；2）在聚合配置上通过MPC规划高效导航策略。
Result: 在合成地图环境中，BeliefDiffusion在导航成功率和路径效率上均显著优于模型无关强化学习和现有生成方法。
Conclusion: 明确将多模态信念表示融入规划流程，可提升部分可观测环境下的导航鲁棒性。

papers.title: DINO-Med3D: Bridging Dimension and Domain Gaps in Volumetric Segmentation via Progressive Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Although DINOv3 has demonstrated remarkable semantic discrimination in natural imagery, its direct application to volumetric medical segmentation is hindered by inherent dimension and domain disparities. To resolve these issues, we propose DINO-Med3D, a two-stage progressive framework that repurpose the pre-trained DINOv3 encoder for 3D medical tasks. In the first stage, we mitigate the dimension gap by introducing a multi-slice embedding module that incorporates pseudo-3D context, while simultaneously employing a segmentation proxy task to adapt representations learned from natural scenes to the medical domain. Subsequently, we further enhance volumetric understanding by adding lightweight 3D adapters into the frozen backbone to enforce global inter-slice continuity. Finally, to compensate for the spatial information loss inherent in the embedding process, we design a parallel detail recovery stream to explicitly preserve high-frequency boundary cues. Extensive experiments on five public datasets demonstrate that our approach successfully adapts DINOv3 to the medical domain and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. The camera-ready version and link will be made publicly available upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DINO-Med3D，一个两阶段渐进式框架，用于将预训练的DINOv3编码器适配到3D医学图像分割任务。通过多切片嵌入模块缓解维度差距，并在冻结主干中添加轻量3D适配器增强全局切片连续性，同时设计并行细节恢复流保留高频边界信息。在五个公开数据集上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 直接应用DINOv3到体素医学分割存在维度差距（2D到3D）和域差距（自然图像到医学图像），现有方法未能有效弥合这些差距。
Method: 两阶段渐进式适应：第一阶段引入多切片嵌入模块融合伪3D上下文，并通过分割代理任务进行领域适应；第二阶段在冻结的DINOv3主干中加入轻量级3D适配器以增强全局切片连续性；同时设计并行细节恢复流保留高频边界线索。
Result: 在五个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法成功将DINOv3适配到医学领域，并显著优于最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: 所提框架有效弥合了维度与领域差距，为利用大规模预训练视觉模型进行3D医学分割提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LARE: Low-Attention Region Encoding for Text-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Image retrieval in crowded scenes is particularly challenging due to the salience bias of conventional visual encoders, which tend to focus on dominant objects while neglecting low-attention regions that are often crucial for fine-grained retrieval. We propose LARE (Low-Attention Region Encoding), a framework that explicitly models these overlooked regions. LARE adopts a dual-encoding strategy that encodes low-attention regions of an image and the full image in parallel, leading to more diverse and informative image embeddings. To evaluate image retrieval performance in challenging crowded scenes, we introduce Dense-Set, a challenging subset derived from COCO and Flickr30K. In this subset, images are re-captioned to provide richer descriptions of low-attention or previously overlooked regions. This dataset highlights the limitations of existing retrieval models and enables a more rigorous evaluation under densely crowded scene conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework improves retrieval performance by preserving subtle, non-dominant visual cues within the shared latent space.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Efficient Multimodal Question Answering (EMM-QA). Code: https://github.com/AbdulmalikDS/LARE ; Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AbdulmalekDS/Dense-Set
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LARE（低注意力区域编码）框架，用于改进拥挤场景下的文本-图像检索。传统视觉编码器偏重显著目标，忽略低注意力区域（对细粒度检索重要）。LARE采用双编码策略，并行编码低注意力区域和全图，产生更丰富、多样的图像嵌入。作者还构建了Dense-Set数据集（从COCO和Flickr30K中筛选），重新标注以包含低注意力区域的丰富描述。实验表明，LARE通过保留非主导视觉线索提升了检索性能。
Motivation: 拥挤场景中的图像检索因传统视觉编码器的显著性偏差而困难，这些编码器聚焦于主导物体，忽略低注意力区域中的关键细粒度信息。
Method: 提出LARE框架，采用双编码策略：一个编码器处理全图，另一个专门编码低注意力区域（通过注意力图识别），两者并行生成嵌入后融合。同时引入Dense-Set数据集，专门用于评估拥挤场景下的检索性能。
Result: 在Dense-Set（源自COCO和Flickr30K）上的实验显示，LARE通过保留非主导视觉线索，改进了文本-图像检索性能。
Conclusion: LARE通过显式建模低注意力区域，缓解了显著性偏差问题，在拥挤场景中提升了检索效果。

papers.title: Performance Gap Analysis between Latin and Arabic Scripts HTR
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies have shown that handwritten text recognition (HTR) systems perform worse on Arabic-script datasets than on Latin-script data. However, the reasons for this gap are still not well understood due to the lack of controlled comparisons. In this work, we present a comprehensive study of Arabic and Latin scripts HTR using a unified CRNN model for line-level HTR across nine datasets (including KHATT (Arabic), Muharaf (Arabic), NUST-UHWR (Urdu), PHTD (Persian), IAM (English), READ-2016 (German), and others) and di ferent training sizes (K in {100, 500, 1000, 2000, ..., Kfull}). Our results show the performance gap remains: it is large in low-resource settings, decreases with more data, but remains even at full scale, with a consistent difference of 5-7 CER points. We show that annotation quality matters, as many datasets contain labeling errors. Cleaning reduces error rates and narrows the gap, but does not eliminate it. In addition, we find that a fixed number of training samples provides less effective coverage in Arabic due to higher visual variability, requiring more data to learn similar representations. We compare recognition across datasets in terms of the number of text lines and the number of characters, showing an equivalence trade-off. We compare character frequency distributions across scripts and show that Arabic is significantly more heavy-tailed than Latin. Our error analysis reveals that around 30 percent of substitution errors in Arabic datasets (e.g., KHATT) are caused by confusion between visually similar characters, compared to about 15 percent in Latin-script datasets such as IAM.
papers.comment: this paper accepted at TIPS workshop ICPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过统一CRNN模型在九个手写文本数据集（包括阿拉伯语、英语、德语等）上比较拉丁和阿拉伯文字识别性能，发现阿拉伯语识别始终落后5-7 CER，低资源场景差距更大，数据增多后差距缩小但未消除。标注错误是差距原因之一，清理后仍存在。阿拉伯语字符分布更重尾且视觉相似字符混淆率（~30%）高于拉丁语（~15%）。
Motivation: 现有研究显示阿拉伯语手写识别性能低于拉丁语，但缺乏受控比较来解释原因，本文旨在系统分析这一性能差距的根源。
Method: 使用统一CRNN模型进行行级HTR，在九个数据集（含阿拉伯、乌尔都、波斯、英、德文）上控制训练数据规模（100到全量），并分析标注质量、字符频率分布、错误类型。
Result: 阿拉伯语与拉丁语HTR差距在低资源时大（>10 CER），全量数据仍差5-7 CER；清理标注可缩小差距但不能消除；阿拉伯语字符分布更重尾，需更多数据达相同覆盖；约30%替换错误源于视觉相似字符（拉丁约15%）。
Conclusion: 性能差距源于标注质量、视觉变异性大、字符分布重尾等，即使有足够数据仍难完全消除，需针对性改进。

summary_sections.conclusion: 性能差距源于标注质量、视觉变异性大、字符分布重尾等，即使有足够数据仍难完全消除，需针对性改进。

papers.title: Domain-Shift Aware Neural Networks for Unbalance Characterization in Rotating Systems
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates the application of a domain-shift aware neural network for regression tasks aimed at estimating unbalance masses in rotating shafts under varying operating conditions. Experimental data were collected from a test rig in which a primary shaft, equipped with a flange carrying unbalanced masses, was driven at different rotational speeds, while a secondary shaft could be optionally activated to introduce domain discrepancy. The unbalance masses were positioned at a fixed radial distance, and the dynamic response of the system was recorded using triaxial accelerometers. The inverse problem of mass estimation is formulated within a domain adaptation framework, where the network is trained with a maximum mean discrepancy strategy to align feature representations across source and target distributions. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly addressing domain shift in improving prediction accuracy, especially when the system's physical behavior and sources of domain discrepancy are not fully known and fall outside the training conditions. These findings highlight the potential of domain-shift aware models for regression tasks in Structural Health Monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究域偏移感知神经网络在旋转轴不平衡质量估计回归任务中的应用。实验通过在不同转速和辅助轴激活条件下采集振动数据，构建域偏移场景，并采用最大均值差异（MMD）策略对齐源域与目标域的特征分布。结果表明，显式处理域偏移能显著提升预测精度，尤其当系统物理行为及域偏移源未知时。
Motivation: 旋转机械在不同工况下运行时，数据分布存在域偏移，导致传统模型泛化能力下降。本文旨在解决该问题，以实现更鲁棒的不平衡质量估计。
Method: 提出域自适应框架，使用最大均值差异（MMD）作为正则化项，在训练中最小化源域与目标域的特征分布差异，从而使神经网络学习域不变表示。
Result: 实验表明，该方法有效提升不平衡质量估计的预测精度，尤其在测试工况与训练工况存在未知域偏移时优势明显。
Conclusion: 域偏移感知模型在结构健康监测的回归任务中有潜力，能处理物理行为不明确的系统变化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation in Optical Coherence Tomography Using Trajectory-Aligned Time-Independent Flow
papers.abstract_en: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is essential in ophthalmology, but inconsistent image quality especially in low-cost devices hinders automated analysis. To address this, we introduce a flow-matching-based test-time adaptation method that generates high-quality surrogate images from noisy inputs. Typically, domain gaps between test and training data cause pixel distribution mismatches during the denoising process. We overcome this by matching the test image's histogram to synthetic reference trajectories, successfully aligning the input with expected distributions. Additionally, we remove the network's time conditioning to account for slight deviations in real-world noise distributions. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in segmenting critical biomarkers for two stages of Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD). Code is available: https://github.com/Veit21/tta-flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对OCT图像质量不一致问题，提出一种基于流匹配的测试时自适应方法，通过将测试图像直方图匹配到合成参考轨迹并移除网络的时间条件，生成高质量替代图像。在AMD病变分割任务上达到SOTA性能。
Motivation: OCT图像质量不一致（尤其低成本设备）影响自动化分析，现有去噪方法因训练与测试数据分布不匹配而失效。
Method: 提出流匹配（flow-matching）测试时自适应方法：将测试图像直方图对齐到合成参考轨迹，并移除网络的时间条件（time conditioning）以适应真实噪声分布偏差。
Result: 在AMD两个阶段的生物标志物分割任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法有效克服测试与训练数据间的域偏移，提升OCT图像质量，代码已公开。

papers.title: Externalizing Research Synthesis and Validation in AI Scientists through a Research Harness
papers.abstract_en: AI systems can increasingly automate scientific workflows, but the reasoning that links prior evidence, generated ideas, experiments and final claims often remains implicit inside model inference. Here we introduce Xcientist, a research harness that externalizes research synthesis and experimental validation into inspectable, contract-governed processes. Xcientist organizes literature evidence, idea states, implementation plans, ablation records and repair traces as persistent research artifacts, so that generated mechanisms can be grounded, executed, tested and revised without losing their evidential basis. We identify claim drift as a failure mode of automated research, where runnable artifacts no longer support the mechanism originally claimed. Across training-free memory systems, graph-structured traffic forecasting and multi-scale physics-informed neural networks, Xcientist preserves traceable trajectories from problem formulation to mechanism design, validation and bounded revision. These results suggest that AI scientists should be evaluated not only by their final artifacts, but by whether their synthesis and validation processes remain attributable, inspectable and scientifically accountable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Xcientist，一个将AI科学家的研究合成和实验验证外部化为可检查、受合同约束过程的框架。通过将文献证据、想法状态、实施计划、消融记录和修复追踪持久化为研究工件，Xcientist确保生成的机制有依据、可执行、可测试和可修订，同时保留其证据基础。论文识别了claim drift（可运行工件不再支持最初声称的机制）作为自动化研究的失败模式，并在训练无关记忆系统、图结构交通预测和多尺度物理信息神经网络上展示了可追溯轨迹。结果表明AI科学家应通过其合成和验证过程的可归因性、可检查性和科学问责性来评估。
Motivation: 现有AI系统自动化科学工作流时，将先前证据、生成想法、实验和最终声明之间的推理隐含在模型内部，导致过程不可检查。论文旨在解决这一缺陷，使研究合成和验证对外部可检视。
Method: 引入Xcientist研究框架，通过合同治理的外部化过程组织研究工件，包括文献证据、想法状态、实施计划、消融记录和修复追踪，使生成机制可基于、可执行、可测试和可修订，从而避免claim drift。
Result: 在三种不同领域（训练无关记忆系统、图结构交通预测、多尺度物理信息神经网络）中，Xcientist保持了从问题公式化到机制设计、验证和有限修订的可追溯轨迹，确保了工件的可归因性和科学问责性。
Conclusion: 论文主张AI科学家的评估不应仅基于最终工件，还应基于其合成和验证过程是否可归因、可检查和科学上可问责，强调过程透明性而非仅结果质量。

papers.title: Bridging Single Distortion Artifacts and Mmultifactorial Clinical Quality: Few-shot Biparametric MRI Quality Assessment via Distortion-trained Prototypical Networks
papers.abstract_en: Clinical prostate multi-parametric MRI relies heavily on high-quality diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), yet reading DWI is frequently compromised by geometric distortion, often caused by rectal air. Assessing quality via the PI-QUAL scoring system is an emerging clinical standard, but it is subjective, time-consuming and suffers from a class imbalance where low-quality cases are diverse and relatively scarce. Using the PRIME clinical trial as an example, there are $6\%$ images with PI-QUAL scores lower than 4, $87\%$ of DWI issues are due to distortion. Many of the other clinical quality issues are under-represented. To address this common dual-scarcity of annotated clinical data, we propose a few-shot biparametric prototypical network for automated image quality assessment (IQA). Our framework utilizes a dual-branch 3D ResNet to fuse T2-weighted and DWI features, providing anatomical context to distinguish true morphology from distortion. To handle real-world heterogeneity, we introduce feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) and a gradient reversal layer (GRL) to align feature distributions conditioned on varying b-values while suppressing acquisition-related biases. We demonstrate that a model meta-trained solely on comparatively objective, readily obtainable distortion labels can effectively adapt to predicting complex, multi-factorial clinical quality scores such as PI-QUAL using only five representative samples. Experimental results on two datasets show that our method significantly outperforms few-shot learning baselines for this challenging IQA task, offering a practically feasible and data-efficient solution for standardizing prostate MRI quality control in clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前列腺双参数MRI质量评估中的数据稀缺和类别不平衡问题，提出一种基于原型网络的小样本方法。模型利用双分支3D ResNet融合T2加权和DWI特征，引入FiLM和GRL调整特征分布以抑制偏差。通过在形变标签上元训练，模型仅用5个样本即可适应预测PI-QUAL临床质量评分。
Motivation: 临床多参数MRI中DWI质量常受几何形变影响，PI-QUAL评分作为新兴标准但主观耗时，且低质量样本稀少多样（仅6%图像评分低于4，87%的DWI问题源于形变），需自动化方法。
Method: 提出小样本双参数原型网络，使用双分支3D ResNet融合T2和DWI特征；采用特征线性调制（FiLM）和梯度反转层（GRL）对齐不同b值下的特征分布并抑制采集相关偏差；先在形变标签上元训练，再迁移至预测多因素临床质量评分PI-QUAL。
Result: 在两个数据集上，该方法显著优于小样本学习基线，仅需5个代表样本即可适应PI-QUAL评分预测。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种数据高效的自动化前列腺MRI质量控制方案，适用于临床工作流标准化。

papers.title: Learning to Distort: Weakly-Supervised Image Quality Transfer for Prostate DWI Correction
papers.abstract_en: Single-shot echo-planar prostate diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is frequently complicated by geometric distortions, which impact the ability to derive reliable diagnoses from such images. Developing automated correction methods is challenged by the absence of paired distorted and undistorted clinical scans. In this paper, we first propose a novel weakly-supervised image quality transfer (IQT) framework from undistorted to distorted images that utilizes image quality assessment (IQA) signals to supervise the transfer process. Unlike traditional methods that require expensive, voxel-wise paired data or resort to developing unpaired algorithms, our approach utilizes image-level quality labels (here, distorted vs. undistorted) to establish latent quality prototypes within a pre-trained feature space. Recognizing that simulating realistic distortions is more reliable than direct unpaired correction, we describe a weakly-supervised prototype flow matching algorithm to explicitly regularize generative trajectories towards distorted prototypes, producing realistic susceptibility artifacts that mimic clinical degradations. By synthesizing these realistic pairs, we enable a second IQT model to be trained in the forward direction for distortion correction. Experimental results demonstrate that our generated images successfully mimic the diagnostic interference of real-world artifacts, which leads to more capable distortion correction IQT models. In addition to qualitative comparisons, we also conduct exhaustive quantitative evaluations that compare our approach with existing unpaired approaches (e.g., CycleGAN, UNIT-DDPM, and OT-FM) - as either forward or reverse alternatives - by assessing clinical downstream task performance in PI-RADS and Gleason score classification, using both in-distribution and external data sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前列腺DWI成像中的几何畸变问题，提出一种弱监督图像质量传输（IQT）框架。该框架利用图像级质量标签（畸变 vs 非畸变）作为监督信号，通过原型流匹配算法生成模拟临床畸变的图像，进而训练前向校正模型。实验表明生成图像能模拟真实伪影，并在下游分类任务上优于现有的非配对方法（如CycleGAN、UNIT-DDPM、OT-FM）。
Motivation: 前列腺DWI单次激发平面回波成像常受几何畸变影响，但缺乏配对的畸变-非畸变临床扫描对，传统方法依赖昂贵的体素级配对数据或开发非配对算法，校正效果受限。
Method: 提出弱监督图像质量传输框架：利用图像质量标签在预训练特征空间中建立潜在质量原型；采用弱监督原型流匹配算法，将生成轨迹正则化引导至畸变原型，产生逼真的伪影图像；利用合成的配对数据训练前向校正模型。
Result: 定性比较显示生成图像成功模拟临床伪影的干扰；定量评估在PI-RADS和Gleason评分分类任务上，以内部和外部数据集评估，表明生成的配对数据使校正模型优于CycleGAN、UNIT-DDPM和OT-FM等非配对方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过弱监督方式从非配对数据中生成畸变图像并训练校正模型是可行且有效的，能够提升下游诊断任务性能。

papers.title: Strategic Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: When algorithmic predictors inform resource allocation in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, these predictors must account for strategic manipulation of input features. The typical solution is to redesign the predictor itself to explicitly account for strategic interactions. In practice, however, decision makers are often constrained to adjusting coarser levers within existing prediction pipelines. For example, healthcare organizations often select which features to exclude based on perceived manipulability, while using standard regularization procedures to shrink the coefficients of retained features. In this work, we initiate a formal study of strategic classification through feature selection and its interaction with ridge regularization. Our main finding is that excluding individual features based on their manipulability alone is generally suboptimal. We provide a fine-grained characterization of the performance of a feature subset under optimal regularization, yielding new insights for policy design. Motivated by this characterization, we develop a practical algorithm for jointly choosing the feature set and the level of ridge regularization. Through a real-world case study on a healthcare payments benchmark, we illustrate how our algorithm can guide the design of coarse policy levers in practice. Our results provide a principled, practical framework for mitigating the effects of strategic behavior in algorithmic decision-making systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次正式研究通过特征选择进行战略分类（strategic classification）及其与岭正则化（ridge regularization）的交互。作者发现仅根据可操纵性排除特征通常不是最优的，并提供了特征子集在最优正则化下性能的精细刻画，由此提出联合选择特征集和岭正则化水平的实用算法。在医疗支付基准上的案例研究展示了该算法如何指导粗粒度政策杠杆的设计。
Motivation: 在医疗等高风险领域，算法预测必须考虑输入特征的战略操纵。然而决策者往往只能调整现有预测流程中的粗粒度杠杆（如选择排除哪些特征），而现有研究缺乏针对特征选择与正则化交互的理论指导。
Method: 提供特征子集在最优岭正则化下性能的精细刻画，基于此提出联合选择特征集和岭正则化水平的实践算法。
Result: 在医疗支付基准案例研究中展示算法可指导粗粒度政策设计；理论表明仅根据可操纵性排除特征是次优的。
Conclusion: 提供了一个缓解算法决策系统中战略行为影响的原则性实用框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Learning-based AEB with Massive Unlabeled Data
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies how to scale learning-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) with massive unlabeled fleet data under production constraints. Our approach is based on meta-feedback semi-supervised learning (MF-SSL), where a teacher generates pseudo labels for unlabeled driving data and is updated using a small labeled anchor set as safety-critical feedback. In production, anchor ambiguity and labeled-unlabeled mismatch can amplify systematic pseudo-label errors, leading to spurious triggers. We propose a stabilized MF-SSL framework with (i) Noise-Aware Decoupling, which removes ambiguity-prone anchors from the teacher's supervised update path, and (ii) kinematics-gated pseudo-labeling with a teacher conflict penalty to suppress mismatch-induced risk hallucinations on unlabeled data while maintaining broad coverage. Extensive experiments show consistent gains as unlabeled data scale from 1M to 1B windows, improving safety while keeping comfort stable. The 1B-trained student model is deployed to hundreds of thousands of vehicles and validated over \$10^9$ km of driving, achieving a positive-to-false activation ratio exceeding 100:1 and a 35% improvement in accident-free driving mileage over a production rule-only baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何在生产约束下利用大量无标签车队数据扩展基于学习的自动紧急制动（AEB）系统。方法基于元反馈半监督学习（MF-SSL），教师模型为无标签驾驶数据生成伪标签，并通过少量有标签锚点集作为安全关键反馈进行更新。针对生产中的锚点模糊性和有标签-无标签不匹配问题，作者提出稳定化MF-SSL框架，包含噪声感知解耦（移除易混淆锚点）和运动学门控伪标签（抑制风险幻觉）。实验表明从100万到10亿窗口的无标签数据带来一致的性能提升，部署到数十万车辆上，实际驾驶验证超过10亿公里，正误触发比超过100:1，事故减少35%。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的AEB系统依赖大量有标签数据，但生产环境中无标签车队数据丰富，如何有效利用这些数据提升安全性能是关键问题。同时，半监督学习中教师模型的伪标签错误可能因锚点模糊和分布不匹配而被放大，导致误触发。
Method: 提出稳定化元反馈半监督学习（stabilized MF-SSL），包括两个组件：噪声感知解耦（Noise-Aware Decoupling），从教师监督更新路径中移除易混淆的锚点；运动学门控伪标签（kinematics-gated pseudo-labeling），结合教师冲突惩罚抑制分布不匹配导致的风险幻觉，同时保持广泛覆盖。
Result: 在无标签数据从100万扩展到10亿窗口时，模型安全性持续提升且舒适性保持稳定。部署到数十万车辆后，正误触发比超过100:1，事故减少35%（相比纯规则基线）。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了利用大规模无标签车队数据扩展学习型AEB的可行性，并提出了应对生产环境中伪标签噪声的实用框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: URDF Synthesis from RGB-D Sequences via Differentiable Joint Inference and Energy-Consistent Verification
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing simulation-ready digital twins of articulated objects from sensor observations remains constrained by two persistent gaps: (i) part-level geometric reconstruction is decoupled from kinematic-parameter estimation, and (ii) the recovered models often violate basic dynamic invariants such as energy conservation, leading to drift when the URDF is replayed in physics simulators. We present KinemaForge, a constraint-driven pipeline that jointly infers part-level shape, joint topology, and joint parameters from short RGB-D sequences and validates the result against an energy-consistent verifier built on differentiable rigid-body dynamics. The pipeline introduces three components: a kinematic constraint graph that encodes joint-part incidences as soft edges; a differentiable screw-axis solver that backpropagates from rendered observations through Featherstone's articulated-body algorithm to joint parameters; and an energy residual loss that penalises non-physical free responses of the reconstructed model. Across five PartNet-Mobility categories and an internal RGB-D benchmark, KinemaForge reduces the average joint-axis error from 4.52 degrees to 2.83 degrees (-37.4%) over the strongest geometric baseline (PARIS) and from 5.30 degrees to 2.83 degrees (-46.6%) over the interaction-based Ditto baseline, lowers long-horizon simulation drift by 64% (vs. PARIS) over 50 s rollouts, and yields URDFs whose closed-loop manipulation success rate improves by 14.6 percentage points over Ditto in our preliminary evaluation. Code and reconstruction data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KinemaForge 管道，通过可微关节推理和能量一致验证，从短 RGB-D 序列联合推断部件级形状、关节拓扑和参数，生成仿真就绪的 URDF 模型。在 PartNet-Mobility 等基准上，关节轴误差降低 37.4%~46.6%，长期仿真漂移减少 64%，闭合操作成功率提升 14.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法将部件几何重建与运动学参数估计分离，且恢复模型常违反能量守恒定律，导致在物理仿真器中回放时出现漂移。
Method: 引入三个组件：编码关节-部件关系的运动学约束图；通过 Featherstone 算法反向传播的可微螺旋轴求解器；惩罚非物理自由响应的能量残差损失。
Result: 在五个 PartNet-Mobility 类别和内部 RGB-D 基准上，关节轴误差从 4.52° 降至 2.83°（优于 PARIS 和 Ditto），50 秒 rollout 仿真漂移减少 64%，闭合操作成功率提高 14.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: KinemaForge 通过约束驱动的联合推理和能量一致验证，有效提升了关节物体 URDF 重建的几何和物理精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantification of Uncertainty with Adversarial Models in Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable pixel-level uncertainty quantification holds the potential to transform clinical workflows by enabling high-fidelity longitudinal monitoring and distinguishing true pathological changes from artifacts. Ideally, these models provide the stability required for critical treatment planning and surgical intervention. However, standard deep learning models often suffer from miscalibration, yielding overconfident predictions that mask underlying vulnerabilities at subtle pathological boundaries. To address this, we propose QUAM-SM, a post-hoc framework using targeted adversarial search to identify "adversarially fragile" pixels. By actively seeking perturbations that expose predictive instability, our method highlights regions where decisions are most vulnerable to being flipped. Importantly, the framework disentangles epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric uncertainty. Experiments on two public datasets with multiple expert annotations demonstrate that QUAM-SM outperforms both standard and recent uncertainty estimation approaches in terms of reliability and boundary sensitivity. Code is available at https://github.com/HanaJebril/quam_sm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QUAM-SM，一种后处理框架，通过对抗性搜索识别医学图像分割中“对抗脆弱”的像素，以量化不确定性。在公开数据集上，该方法在可靠性和边界敏感性上优于现有方法，并能分离认知不确定性与偶然不确定性。
Motivation: 标准深度学习模型在校准上存在问题，在病理边界处产生过度自信的预测，掩盖了潜在的不稳定性。
Method: 提出QUAM-SM后处理框架，通过有针对性的对抗搜索寻找能暴露预测不稳定性的扰动，从而识别脆弱像素，并分离认知不确定性与偶然不确定性。
Result: 在含多个专家标注的两个公开数据集上，QUAM-SM在可靠性和边界敏感性方面优于标准及最新的不确定性估计方法。
Conclusion: 该框架为医学图像分割提供了更可靠的不确定性量化，有助于临床工作流中的纵向监测和病变变化区分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Investigating Inductive Biases for Machine Learning Emulation of Sudden Stratospheric Warmings in Idealised Isca Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning emulators are increasingly used for weather prediction and have the potential to extend skill on subseasonal-to-seasonal timescales by learning dynamically important sources of predictability. A key challenge is whether the models can exploit predictability anchors, such as stratospheric variability, that influence tropospheric circulation beyond short lead times. We test how architectural inductive bias affects emulation of sudden stratospheric warming (SSW) dynamics using paired idealised Isca simulations that differ only in an imposed wave-2 heating perturbation. Across convolutional, transformer, and graph-based architectures trained for one-step prediction, model differences are modest when the stratosphere is dynamically quiet but widen substantially when SSW-like variability is active. Our results identify explicit three-dimensional vertical coupling as a key inductive bias for machine-learning emulation of stratospheric dynamics. However, Eliassen-Palm flux diagnostics show that low forecast error does not guarantee physically faithful wave-mean-flow interaction, with coherent errors remaining in stratospheric wave-driving structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器学习模型模拟平流层突然变暖（SSW）动力学的归纳偏置。使用Isca理想化模拟数据，比较卷积、Transformer和图神经网络架构的单步预测性能。结果显示，当平流层活跃时模型差异显著，三维垂直耦合是关键归纳偏置，但低预测误差不保证物理一致的波-流相互作用。
Motivation: 机器学习模拟器在次季节到季节尺度预测中有潜力，但需要利用平流层变率等可预测性锚点。当前缺乏对模型归纳偏置如何影响SSW动力学模拟的系统研究。
Method: 使用配对理想化Isca模拟（仅波-2加热扰动不同），训练卷积、Transformer和图神经网络进行单步预测，对比不同架构在平流层活跃/静默状态下的性能，并利用Eliassen-Palm通量诊断评估物理一致性。
Result: 平流层静默时模型差异小，活跃时差异显著。三维垂直耦合是关键归纳偏置。低预测误差不保证物理一致的波-平均流相互作用，平流层波驱动结构存在相干误差。
Conclusion: 强调了显式三维垂直耦合对于模拟平流层动力学的重要性，但指出仅凭预测误差不足以评估物理真实性，需结合物理诊断。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Approximate Structured Diffusion for Sequence Labelling
papers.abstract_en: Sequence labelling, a core task of Natural Language Processing (NLP), consists in assigning each token of an input sentence a label. From a Machine Learning point of view, sequence labelling is often cast as a Linear-Chain Conditional Random Field (CRF) parametrised by a neural network. While this approach gives good empirical results, CRFs assume a finite decision span (eg label bigrams) which can limit their expressivity and hurt performance when long-range dependencies are required. We show we can leverage diffusion to train a CRF conditioned on an entire label sequence, with the caveat that the condition is on a noisy version of labels. We show experimentally that this method, in conjunction with approximate CRF inference, improves label accuracy with a 16.5% error reduction for POS-tagging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出近似结构化扩散（Approximate Structured Diffusion）方法，用于序列标注任务。该方法利用扩散模型训练以整个标签序列为条件的CRF，但条件基于噪声版本的标签。实验表明，结合近似CRF推理，在词性标注（POS-tagging）上错误率降低16.5%。
Motivation: 传统线性链CRF假设有限决策跨度（如标签二元组），限制了表达能力，尤其在需要长距离依赖时性能受损。本文旨在利用扩散模型突破这一限制。
Method: 利用扩散模型训练一个以整个标签序列为条件的CRF，但条件基于噪声版本的标签，并采用近似CRF推理。
Result: 在词性标注（POS-tagging）任务上，错误率降低16.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法与近似CRF推理结合能有效提升标签准确率，但未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kernel of Partition Paths: A Unified Representation for Tree Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: A recent line of work has reframed individual decision trees as linear models on engineered features associated with their splits, opening routes for oracle inequalities and feature-importance reinterpretation, but leaving open the question of what unified geometric object a forest induces when one indexes its feature map by nodes rather than by splits. The present paper studies that object. KPP indexes the feature map by the nodes of the forest, weighted by a path metric that turns each coordinate into a component of a squared-Euclidean path-isometric embedding. KPP unifies four pillars under a single non-diagonal Gram that carries a metric: prediction, exact additive attribution, deterministic Lipschitz robust radius in the KPP metric, and uniform Rademacher risk bounds for regression and classification under fixed, honest, or cross-fit conditioning. All probabilistic guarantees are conditional on the representation and are stated under three explicit conditioning regimes; the robust-radius guarantee is deterministic in the KPP metric rather than in a norm on the raw input. Conjectured fast-rate refinements for both regression and classification are stated as open problems and are not claimed as theorems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出核化划分路径（Kernel of Partition Paths, KPP），将树集成（tree ensembles）的特征映射统一表示为非对角的Gram矩阵，该矩阵携带度量并同时支持预测、精确加性归因（additive attribution）、确定性Lipschitz鲁棒半径（robust radius）和均匀Rademacher风险界。所有概率保证均条件于表示，并在固定、诚实或交叉拟合三种显式条件化机制下陈述。
Motivation: 现有工作将单棵决策树重新解释为分裂特征上的线性模型，但未阐明森林在按节点而非按分裂索引特征映射时所诱导的统一几何对象。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出KPP，通过路径度量（path metric）加权森林的节点，将每个坐标转换为平方欧几里得路径等距嵌入（squared-Euclidean path-isometric embedding）的分量，从而构造一个非对角Gram矩阵。

Conclusion: 本文强调了KPP作为树集成统一表示的优势，并提出了回归和分类快速率改进的猜想开放问题，未作为定理声称。
