papers.title: Aligning Implied Statements for Implicit Hate Speech Generalizability with Context-Bounded Semi-hard Negative Mining
papers.abstract_en: Classifying implicit hate speech remains a challenge, as intent is often masked through insinuation and context rather than explicit slurs. Prior supervised contrastive approaches improve in-domain detection but can overfit surface cues and struggle to transfer across datasets. We propose ImpSH, a triplet-based framework that aligns posts with implied statements when available and uses context-bounded semi-hard negatives to focus learning on near confusions. We also examine AugSH, which forms positives via data augmentation. In controlled evaluations on IHC, SBIC, and DynaHate with BERT and HateBERT, ImpSH is a viable alternative to standard supervised contrastive baselines and often improves cross-domain performance under matched preprocessing and tuning budgets. Representation analysis using alignment and uniformity indicates tighter positive pairs with balanced global spread, and qualitative nearest-neighbor case studies illustrate typical false negatives under domain shift. These results demonstrate that aligning posts with their implied statements via context-bounded mining provides a more stable, bijective-like mapping to related insinuations, overcoming the volatility inherent in traditional clustering-based representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ImpSH框架，通过三元组学习将隐式仇恨言论帖子与隐含声明对齐，并利用上下文有界的半困难负例挖掘来提升跨数据集泛化能力。在IHC、SBIC和DynaHate数据集上的实验表明，ImpSH在相同预处理和调参预算下，常优于标准监督对比学习基线，并改善跨域性能。
Motivation: 现有隐式仇恨言论分类方法存在过拟合表面线索、跨数据集迁移困难的问题，需要更稳定的表示学习策略。
Method: 提出ImpSH框架，使用三元组损失对齐帖子与隐含声明，并引入上下文有界的半困难负例挖掘（context-bounded semi-hard negative mining）聚焦于易混淆样本；同时考察了数据增强构建正样本的AugSH变体。
Result: 在IHC、SBIC和DynaHate上使用BERT和HateBERT的受控实验中，ImpSH作为标准监督对比基线的可行替代方案，常提升跨域性能；表示分析显示更紧的正对与均匀的全局分布，最近邻案例研究揭示了领域迁移下的典型假阴性。
Conclusion: 通过上下文有界挖掘对齐帖子与隐含声明，能形成更稳定的、类似双射的映射到相关暗示，克服传统聚类表示学习的波动性。

papers.title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: To assist humans over extended periods in real homes, embodied agents must remember user routines, world states, and past interactions. Existing long-term memory benchmarks mainly evaluate language-centric retrieval and question answering, while embodied benchmarks often focus on short-horizon task execution without testing long-term memory use in dynamic environments. We introduce WorldLines, a project-driven benchmark for long-horizon embodied household assistance. It constructs temporally extended household traces with dialogues, actions, execution feedback, object and device state changes, and converts them into evidence-linked samples for Memory QA and Embodied Task Planning. We further propose ObsMem, an observer-grounded memory framework that maintains visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails for state-aware decisions. Experiments reveal persistent challenges in partial observability, overwritten world states, and translating long-term memory into embodied plans, while ObsMem offers a stronger reference architecture for this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldLines 是一个针对长时域具身家庭助手（long-horizon embodied household assistants）的项目驱动基准。它构建了包含对话、动作、反馈和状态变化的时序家庭轨迹，并生成用于记忆问答（Memory QA）和具身任务规划（Embodied Task Planning）的样本。作者提出 ObsMem，一个基于观察者的记忆框架，维护可见性感知记忆和动作原生状态轨迹以实现状态感知决策。实验揭示了部分可观测性、世界状态覆盖以及将长期记忆转化为具身规划等持续挑战。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆基准主要评估语言为中心的检索和问答，而具身基准多聚焦短期任务执行，缺乏在动态环境中测试长期记忆使用的能力。本文旨在填补这一空白，为长时域具身家庭助手提供统一的评估基准。
Method: 构建 WorldLines 基准，从家庭环境日志中提取时序轨迹并转化为带有证据链接的 Memory QA 和 Embodied Task Planning 样本。提出 ObsMem 框架，包含 visibility-aware 记忆和 action-native 状态轨迹，以支持部分可观测条件下的状态感知决策。
Result: 实验揭示了部分可观测性、被覆盖的世界状态以及将长期记忆转化为具身规划蓝图（embodied plans）方面的持续挑战，而 ObsMem 提供了更强的参考架构。
Conclusion: WorldLines 和 ObsMem 为长时域具身家庭助手研究提供了新的评估和建模基础，但该领域仍面临多项核心挑战。

papers.title: From Bounding Boxes to Visual Reasoning: An On-Policy Data Annotation Tool for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are rapidly advancing toward sophisticated grounded structured visual reasoning. Training models for such advanced capabilities demands a new genre of data that seamlessly unifies spatial coordinates, open-vocabulary descriptions, structured attributes, and topological relationships into a singular representation. However, existing data annotation tools fundamentally fail to meet these intricate demands, suffering from three systematic bottlenecks: limited expressiveness, severe annotation-training decoupling, and poor data reusability. To bridge this infrastructure gap, we introduce an open-source annotation tool, ScreenAnnotator. First, we define a unified annotation atom schema that binds spatial, semantic, and structural primitives into a single unit. Second, we implement an on-policy annotation loop embedded with a Bayesian Annotation Verifier (BAV). Finally, we design a template-driven multi-task data synthesis process dynamically transforms static atoms into diverse multi-dimensional reasoning tasks, eliminating redundant re-annotation. The on-policy loop drives the annotation accept rate to nearly 100% on flowcharts and 77% on GUI screenshots, while steadily reducing per-image annotation time as labeled data accumulate. In the flowchart scenario, fine-tuning a VLM yields 76.1% average accuracy, which is a 35.1% point absolute gain. Our code is available at: https://github.com/WnQinm/Annotator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍ScreenAnnotator，一个面向视觉语言模型（VLM）的在线策略数据标注工具。它定义了统一标注原子模式，将空间、语义和结构原语绑定；实现嵌入贝叶斯标注验证器（BAV）的在线策略标注循环；设计模板驱动的多任务数据合成过程。在流程图和GUI截图标注实验中，标注接受率分别达到近100%和77%，并逐步减少每张图片标注时间；在流程图场景下，微调VLM获得76.1%平均准确率，绝对提升35.1个百分点。
Motivation: 现有数据标注工具无法满足VLM对空间坐标、开放词汇描述、结构化属性和拓扑关系统一表示的需求，存在表达力有限、标注-训练解耦、数据复用性差三个系统瓶颈。
Method: 定义统一标注原子模式（annotation atom schema），将空间、语义和结构原语绑定为一个单元；实现嵌入贝叶斯标注验证器（BAV）的在线策略（on-policy）标注循环；设计模板驱动的多任务数据合成过程，动态将静态原子转换为多样化多维推理任务。
Result: 在线策略循环将流程图标注接受率提升至近100%，GUI截图标注接受率达77%，并随标注数据积累逐步降低每张图片标注时间；在流程图场景下，微调VLM获得76.1%平均准确率，绝对提升35.1个百分点。
Conclusion: ScreenAnnotator填补了VLM数据标注的基础设施空白，通过统一模式、在线策略验证和模板驱动合成解决了现有工具的瓶颈。

papers.title: Learning from Your Own Mistakes: Constructing Learnable Micro-Reflective Trajectories for Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation improves reasoning in large language models by using the model's own rollouts as training signal, typically through implicit logit-level alignment that minimizes KL divergence toward a privileged target distribution. However, because this supervision is generated via uncontrolled sampling, it provides no diagnostic insight into the model's specific errors or corrective guidance for its individual failure patterns. Consequently, the model learns to imitate a privileged distribution rather than receiving fine-grained corrections that pinpoint where and why its reasoning fails. In this paper, we propose Trajectory-Augmented Policy Optimization (TAPO), which advances self-distillation from implicit distributional alignment to explicit trajectory construction. During RL training, the model produces both correct and incorrect rollouts to the same query, and TAPO leverages this contrastive structure to construct micro-reflective corrections, new training trajectories that retain the model's erroneous reasoning up to the point of failure, then insert a natural-language diagnosis and corrected reasoning guided by a correct reference from the same sampling group. Since each trajectory is anchored in the learner's own prefix and solutions, the corrective signal preserves the model's on-policy distribution to a greater extent than the position-wise alignment imposed by KL-based methods. To integrate these trajectories, TAPO introduces difficulty-aware candidate selection at the model's capability boundary and decoupled advantage estimation to prevent gradient contamination. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025 show that TAPO achieves consistent improvements over GRPO under the same number of training steps. Further analysis demonstrates that TAPO strengthens both first-pass reasoning and error-correction effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trajectory-Augmented Policy Optimization (TAPO)，通过显式构建微反射纠正轨迹来改进自蒸馏。在强化学习训练中，TAPO 利用正确和错误的 rollout 对比结构，插入自然语言诊断和纠正推理，并引入难度感知候选选择和去耦优势估计。在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 HMMT 2025 上，TAPO 在相同训练步数下一致优于 GRPO。
Motivation: 现有自蒸馏通过隐式 logit 对齐（最小化 KL 散度）进行监督，无法提供模型具体错误的诊断信息或针对个体失败模式的纠正指导。模型只能模仿特权分布，而无法获得细粒度的错误定位和纠正。
Method: TAPO 在强化学习训练中对同一查询收集正确和错误的 rollout，利用对比结构构造微反射纠正轨迹：保留模型错误推理直到失败点，然后插入基于同组正确参考的自然语言诊断和纠正推理。同时引入难度感知候选选择（在模型能力边界）和去耦优势估计以防止梯度污染。
Result: 实验表明，在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 HMMT 2025 基准上，TAPO 在相同训练步数下相对于 GRPO 取得一致改进。分析进一步显示 TAPO 增强了首遍推理和纠错效果。
Conclusion: TAPO 将自蒸馏从隐式分布对齐推进到显式轨迹构建，通过基于模型自身错误构造的纠正信号保留了比 KL 方法更接近在线策略的分布。该方法有效提升了推理能力。

papers.title: Rethinking Air-Ground Collaboration: A Progressive Cross-Task Benchmark and Socialized Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Air-ground collaborative perception is crucial for robust visual understanding in real-world dynamic environments. However, existing studies typically formulate collaboration as single-task cross-view fusion, overlooking the functional dependencies among localization, target association, and fine-grained parsing. In addition, the heterogeneous nature of aerial and ground views introduces substantial geometric, scale, and occlusion discrepancies, making uniform feature sharing vulnerable to negative transfer. To tackle these issues, we model air-ground perception as a progressive cross-task collaboration task and construct the Air-Ground Progressive Collaboration (AGPC) benchmark, a spatio-temporally aligned benchmark comprising more than 745K raw video frames. Built upon this benchmark, we propose Socialized Co-Perception (SCP), a coarse-to-fine framework that organizes collaboration progressively from aerial global localization to ground target association and identity-aware parsing. Its core module, the Dual-Layer Router (DLR), decouples input-side multi-scale expert selection from output-side task-conditioned modulation, enabling selective cross-view and cross-task interaction while suppressing harmful interference. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of SCP. It achieves a 3.73\% coevolutionary gain and a 7.86\% improvement in average downstream performance. These results show that task-conditioned collaboration is more effective than uniform fusion for heterogeneous air-ground perception. The code is available at https://github.com/g1136639260-spec/AGSCP.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 任务条件化协作比统一融合更有效，代码已开源。

papers.title: Semantic Robustness Certification for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are now widely used in downstream tasks. However, real-world applications often expose VLMs to distribution shifts induced by semantic variation (e.g., shape, size, and style). Robustness certification determines if a model's prediction changes when transformations are applied to its input. While most certification frameworks study geometric or pixel-level transformations over inputs, this work proposes a novel framework that enables certifying VLM robustness under semantic-level transformations. Leveraging the open-vocabulary capability of VLMs, we use text prompts as semantic proxies to construct transformations parameterized by an extent that controls the degree of semantic variation. By characterizing the VLM decision boundary in closed form, our framework quantitatively certifies extent intervals for which the predicted class remains unchanged under the semantic transformation. Our framework is the first to certify VLM robustness under semantic-level variations without requiring additional data for each variation, making it practical to apply. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world data show that our framework enables certifying robustness under diverse semantic variations across scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在语义层面变换下的鲁棒性认证框架。利用VLM的开放词汇能力，以文本提示作为语义代理构建参数化变换，通过闭式表征VLM决策边界，定量认证预测类别不变的程度区间。实验证明该方法在多种语义变化下有效，且无需为每种变化收集额外数据。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒性认证主要研究几何或像素级变换，缺乏对语义级变换（如形状、大小、风格）的认证，而实际应用中VLM常面临此类分布偏移。
Method: 利用VLM的开放词汇能力，以文本提示作为语义代理，构建由程度参数控制的语义变换；通过闭式表征VLM决策边界，定量认证预测类别不变的语义程度区间。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上的实验表明，该框架能够在多种语义变化下认证VLM的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文首次实现无需额外数据即可认证VLM在语义级变化下的鲁棒性，具有实用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Skill-MAS: Evolving Meta-Skill for Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has become a crucial frontier for tackling complex tasks. However, existing methods face a dilemma between model capability and experience retention. Inference-time MAS leverages frozen frontier LLMs but repeats identical searches without learning from past experience. Conversely, Training-time MAS internalizes experience via gradient updates but is constrained by the low capability ceiling of smaller models, and is hard to scale to large frontier LLMs. To bridge this gap, we propose Skill-MAS, a novel third path that decouples experience retention from parametric updates by conceptualizing the high-level orchestration capability as an evolvable Meta-Skill. Skill-MAS refines this architectural knowledge through a closed optimization loop: (1) Multi-Trajectory Rollout samples a behavioral distribution for each task under the current Meta-Skill; and (2) Selective Reflection adaptively selects priority tasks and applies hierarchical contrastive analysis to distill systemic experience into generalizable, strategy-level principles. Extensive experiments across four complex benchmarks and four distinct LLMs demonstrate that Skill-MAS not only achieves remarkable performance gains but also maintains a favorable cost-performance trade-off. Further analysis reveals that the evolved Meta-Skills are highly robust and exhibit strong transferability across unseen tasks and different LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Skill-MAS，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动多智能体系统（MAS）生成新范式。该方法将高层编排能力概念化为可演化的元技能（Meta-Skill），通过多轨迹采样和选择性反射的闭环优化，在不进行参数更新的情况下保留和泛化经验。在四个复杂基准和四个不同 LLM 上的实验表明，Skill-MAS 取得了显著的性能提升，并保持了良好的成本-性能权衡。进一步分析显示，演化出的元技能具有高度鲁棒性和跨任务、跨 LLM 的强迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的自动 MAS 生成方法在模型能力和经验保留之间存在矛盾：推理时 MAS 使用冻结前沿模型但重复搜索无法学习，训练时 MAS 通过梯度更新内化经验但受限于较小模型的能力天花板，难以扩展到大型前沿 LLM。
Method: 提出一种新路径，通过将高层编排能力概念化为可演化的元技能，解耦经验保留与参数更新。具体包括两个步骤：(1) 多轨迹采样：在当前元技能下为每个任务采样行为分布；(2) 选择性反射：自适应选择优先级任务，应用分层对比分析将系统经验蒸馏为可泛化的策略级原则。
Result: 在四个复杂基准和四个不同 LLM 上的实验显示，Skill-MAS 取得了显著性能提升，并保持有利的成本-性能平衡。演化出的元技能具有高鲁棒性，并表现出对未见任务和不同 LLM 的强迁移能力。
Conclusion: Skill-MAS 作为第三种路径，成功弥合了推理时和训练时 MAS 之间的差距，通过元技能演化实现经验保留与参数更新的解耦，并展现出良好的泛化性。

papers.title: Improving Human-Robot Teamwork in Urban Search and Rescue Through Episodic Memory of Prior Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Effective human-robot teamwork requires robots to adapt to partners, situations, and task dynamics from the start of an interaction. In the MATRX Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) environment, people can externalize collaboration patterns (CPs) they discover during teamwork through a chat and reflection interface. We study whether a robot can use such prior team experience to become a better teammate in future interactions. To this end, we represent historical CPs as knowledge-graph episodic memories and use graph representation learning with a node-classification objective to identify a representative and effective memory for reuse. We then initialize the robot with this memory before a new collaboration episode begins. Across 20 participants and 160 round-level observations, initializing the robot with a single automatically selected prior CP increases rescue success from 25.7% to 41.3% and reduces average task time by 283 seconds. The strongest gains appear at the beginning of interaction, suggesting that reusable episodic memory can help robots enter collaboration with more effective task knowledge and support smoother early teamwork.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在城市场景搜索与救援（USAR）环境中，机器人如何利用先前协作的经历（episodic memory）来提升人机团队协作效果。作者将历史协作模式表示为知识图谱情景记忆，并通过图表示学习和节点分类任务自动选择最具代表性的记忆，在每次合作开始前用该记忆初始化机器人。实验结果表明，基于20名参与者和160轮观察，初始化后的机器人将救援成功率从25.7%提升至41.3%，平均任务时间减少283秒，且早期互动阶段改善最为显著。
Motivation: 人机团队协作中，机器人通常缺乏对合作伙伴和任务动态的快速适应能力，尤其是在开始阶段，导致初期协作效率低下。
Method: 将历史协作模式（collaboration patterns, CPs）构建为知识图谱情景记忆，使用图表示学习（graph representation learning）进行节点分类，自动筛选出代表性且有效的记忆，并在新协作回合前用该记忆初始化机器人的策略。
Result: 在USAR环境中，初始化一个自动选择的先前协作模式后，救援成功率从25.7%提升至41.3%，平均任务时间减少283秒，且早期阶段的收益最为明显。
Conclusion: 可重复利用的情景记忆能帮助机器人带着更有效的任务知识进入协作，从而支持更顺畅的早期团队合作，提升整体团队表现。

papers.title: Identifying Structural Biases from Causal Mechanism Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery methods commonly assume that all data is independently and identically distributed (i.i.d.) and that there are no unmeasured variables affecting the system. In practice, these assumptions are often violated, leading to inaccurate inference. In this paper, we study how to identify hidden confounding and selection biases from causal mechanism shifts. In particular, we show that structural biases lead to dependent mechanism shifts. That is, by considering for which variables the mechanisms change given data from different environments, we can tell which variables are unbiased, which are subject to hidden confounding, and which are undergoing selection bias. We formalize this into an empirically testable criterion based on mutual information, and show under which conditions it identifies structural biases. To tell which nodes are subject to what kind of bias, we introduce the StruBI algorithm. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data show that StruBI works well in practice, accurately recovering affected variable sets and types of biases, outperforming the state-of-the-art by a wide margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从因果机制转移中识别隐藏混淆和选择偏差。作者证明结构偏差会导致依赖的机制转移，并提出基于互信息的可测试准则，以及StruBI算法。实验表明该方法在合成和真实数据上准确恢复受影响变量集和偏差类型，性能大幅超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法通常假设数据独立同分布且无未测量变量，但这些假设在实践中常被违反，导致推断不准确。本文旨在识别隐藏混淆和选择偏差。
Method: 通过分析不同环境下机制变化的依赖性，利用互信息构建可测试准则，并提出StruBI算法来识别哪些节点受何种偏差影响。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上，StruBI准确恢复受影响变量集和偏差类型，性能大幅超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的方法能够有效识别结构偏差，但依赖多环境数据，对环境数量和质量有一定要求。

papers.title: Seed-Guided Semi-Supervised Clustering by A-Contrario Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a semi-supervised clustering framework grounded in the statistical duality between grouping principles and anomaly detection. We address the challenge of robust cluster definition in noisy environments -- a task where partitioning algorithms often over-assign outliers and density-based methods remain sensitive to heuristic global parameters. Drawing on \textit{a-contrario} statistical reasoning and Gestalt proximity principles, we define a cluster as a maximal subset of data points containing no anomalies relative to a null hypothesis of uniform randomness. Central to this approach is the Perception algorithm, which utilises a principled expectation-based threshold ($\mathbb{E} < 1$) to identify outliers without manual parameter tuning. By treating clustering as the dual of anomaly detection, we employ an iterative ``clustering-by-exclusion'' mechanism. The algorithm is seed-guided, leveraging minimal user-provided labels to initialise robust cluster medians and form initial groups, which are subsequently expanded by admitting non-anomalous points. This approach naturally isolates fringe points, isolated noise, and emerging unknown clusters. We evaluate the method on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, including image and text datasets represented through raw, linear-reduced, and neighbourhood-preserving embeddings. Results demonstrate that with as few as 10--30 seeds per cluster, the proposed method achieves competitive and often very strong performance under a practical low-tuning benchmarking protocol, while maintaining linear scalability with respect to both observations and dimensionality for a fixed number of seeded clusters and iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于a-contrario统计推理的半监督聚类框架，将聚类视为异常检测的对偶问题。通过感知算法（Perception algorithm）利用期望阈值（E<1）自动识别异常点，并以少量种子标签初始化聚类中心，迭代扩展非异常点形成簇。在合成和真实基准（包括图像和文本数据集）上，使用每类10-30个种子即可取得有竞争力的性能，且对观测数和维度线性可扩展。
Motivation: 现有聚类算法在噪声环境下易过度分配离群点或依赖全局参数，缺乏鲁棒的簇定义。
Method: 提出聚类-异常检测对偶视角，使用a-contrario统计假设检验定义簇为不含异常的最大子集；感知算法基于期望阈值自动识别异常；种子引导初始化簇中心，并通过排除异常点迭代扩展簇。
Result: 在图像和文本数据集上，每类10-30个种子即可实现与现有方法相当或更优的性能，算法对观测数和维度具有线性可扩展性。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种低参数调优的半监督聚类方案，能自然分离边缘点、孤立噪声和新出现的未知簇。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于a-contrario统计推理的半监督聚类框架，将聚类视为异常检测的对偶问题。通过感知算法（Perception algorithm）利用期望阈值（E<1）自动识别异常点，并以少量种子标签初始化聚类中心，迭代扩展非异常点形成簇。在合成和真实基准（包括图像和文本数据集）上，使用每类10-30个种子即可取得有竞争力的性能，且对观测数和维度线性可扩展。

papers.title: Target-confidence Recourse Using tSeTlin machines: TRUST
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations are widely used to provide algorithmic recourse in high-stakes decision-making systems. Most existing methods seek the smallest change to an input that flips a model's decision. However, decision-makers often rely not only on predicted labels but also on confidence thresholds and risk margins. Counterfactuals that barely cross a decision boundary can be fragile and unstable under noise or model variation. In this paper, we propose Target-confidence Recourse Using tSeTlin machines (TRUST), a framework in which users explicitly specify the desired prediction confidence for recourse. Rather than generating counterfactuals and evaluating confidence afterward, TRUST directly searches for minimal changes that satisfy a user-defined confidence target, enabling comparison of recourse options in terms of cost, confidence, and robustness. We instantiate TRUST using a Probabilistic Tsetlin Machine (PTM) combined with Bayesian optimization. The probabilistic clause-based structure of PTM links prediction confidence to the stability of decision rules. We show that counterfactuals satisfying the same rules can still differ substantially in reliability depending on how securely they satisfy those rules, revealing whether decisions are supported by robust or fragile clause activations. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that target-confidence counterfactuals produce more robust and interpretable recourse than conventional boundary-based approaches. Across multiple benchmarks, TRUST achieves perfect robustness while maintaining low recourse cost, including an L2 distance of 0.10 on the Haberman dataset at 0.92 confidence. By explicitly controlling confidence and exposing rule-level stability, TRUST provides actionable recourse for high-stakes decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRUST框架，利用概率Tsetlin机器（PTM）和贝叶斯优化，直接搜索满足用户指定置信度目标的最小特征改变，生成更稳健和可解释的反事实解释。实验表明，在多个基准上达到完美稳健性且保持低代价，例如在Haberman数据集上L2距离为0.10、置信度0.92。
Motivation: 现有反事实解释方法通常仅最小化改变以翻转预测标签，忽略决策者依赖的置信度阈值和风险边际，导致生成的解释脆弱且不稳定。
Method: 提出TRUST框架，基于概率Tsetlin机器（PTM）结合贝叶斯优化，直接优化满足用户指定置信度目标的最小特征改变，并在规则层面提供稳定性分析。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，目标置信度反事实比传统边界方法更稳健和可解释，实现完美稳健性且代价低（如Haberman数据集L2距离0.10、置信度0.92）。
Conclusion: 通过显式控制置信度并揭示规则级稳定性，TRUST可为高风险决策支持提供可操作的解释。

papers.title: Beyond Reward Engineering: A Data Recipe for Long-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning is an essential capability for large language models, particularly when they are deployed as autonomous agents that must reason over lengthy trajectories. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving this ability, yet existing work largely focuses on reward engineering while diverse training data remains scarce. We revisit this problem from a data-centric perspective and show that a simple yet effective data recipe alone, paired with a minimal outcome-based GRPO setup, suffices to substantially improve long-context reasoning. Our recipe targets three complementary task families -- retrieval, multi-evidence synthesis, and reasoning -- for which we construct and curate eight datasets totaling ~14K examples. Experiments on three models (Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B) yield average gains of +7.2/+3.2/+6.4 points across seven long-context benchmarks, surpassing prior RL training sets. We further demonstrate that these gains transfer to agentic tasks, where continuing RL training on an agent-tuned model with our data recipe improves GAIA by +4.8 and BrowseComp by +7.0 points. We will release our datasets to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从数据角度重新审视长上下文推理的强化学习，提出一个简单有效的数据配方，包含检索、多证据合成和推理三个任务族，共8个数据集约14K样本。在Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B模型上，该配方在7个长上下文基准上平均提升+7.2/+3.2/+6.4分，且提升可迁移到智能体任务（GAIA+4.8、BrowseComp+7.0）。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B上，平均提升+7.2/+3.2/+6.4分，并在智能体任务上进一步改善。
Conclusion: 简单的数据配方配合最小化RL设置足以显著提升长上下文推理，且具备跨任务迁移能力。

papers.title: GateMem: Benchmarking Memory Governance in Multi-Principal Shared-Memory Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory benchmarks for LLM agents largely assume single-user settings, leaving shared assistants for hospitals, workplaces, campuses, and households understudied. In these deployments, multiple principals write to a common memory pool and query it under different roles, scopes, and relationships, so memory quality requires governance as well as recall. We introduce GateMem, a benchmark for multi-principal shared-memory agents. GateMem jointly evaluates utility for legitimate long-horizon requests with state updates, access control across contextual authorization boundaries, and agent-facing active forgetting after explicit deletion requests. It spans medical, office, education, and household domains, with long-form multi-party episodes, incremental memory injection, hidden checkpoints, structured judging, and leak-target annotations. Across diverse baselines and backbone models, no method simultaneously achieves strong utility, robust access control, and reliable forgetting. Long-context prompting often yields the best governance score at high token cost, while retrieval-based and external-memory methods reduce cost yet still leak unauthorized or deleted information. These results show current memory agents remain far from reliable shared institutional deployment.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 8 figures. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/rzhub/GateMem and https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ray368/GateMem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GateMem基准，用于评估多主体共享内存代理在医疗、办公、教育、家庭等场景下的内存治理能力，包括长程请求的状态更新、跨授权边界的访问控制以及删除请求后的主动遗忘。实验表明现有方法无法同时实现高实用性、强访问控制和可靠遗忘。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理内存基准主要针对单用户场景，忽略了医院、办公室等环境中多用户共享内存时需治理内存质量的问题，即需要同时支持多角色授权访问和用户删除请求后的遗忘。
Method: GateMem基准包含来自医疗、办公、教育和家庭领域的多轮长对话，设计增量内存注入、隐藏检查点、结构化评判和泄露目标标注，同时评估实用性、访问控制和遗忘能力。
Result: 在多种基线和骨干模型上，没有方法能同时达到强实用性、鲁棒访问控制和可靠遗忘。长上下文提示词获得最高治理分数但token成本高，检索式和外存方法成本低但仍泄露未授权或已删除信息。
Conclusion: 当前内存代理远未达到可靠的机构部署要求，多主体共享内存环境下的治理能力亟待提升。

papers.title: Space Is Intelligence: Neural Semigroup Superposition for Riemannian Metric Generation
papers.abstract_en: Traditional approaches place intelligence in the agent, whether as a learned policy or a search procedure. We instead place intelligence in the space itself: a scene induces a Riemannian metric on the configuration manifold, and action reduces to following the geodesics of that metric rather than invoking a separate planner or collision checker. A single Encoder-Router network realizes this idea through three complementary parameter groups -- frame parameters that orient the generators, modulation parameters that govern their spatial propagation, and basic coefficients that determine their strength. These groups combine through a shared semigroup-superposition mechanism to produce a single Riemannian metric field, yielding a compact architecture whose geometry scales naturally with scene complexity. Trained on a single two-obstacle scene, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization across unseen obstacle configurations, with orders-of-magnitude separation between collision-free and obstacle-penetrating path costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将智能置于空间本身而非智能体内部：场景在配置流形上诱导黎曼度量，智能体的行动变为沿该度量的测地线运动，无需独立的规划器或碰撞检测。通过编码器-路由器网络的三组参数（框架参数、调制参数、基本系数）经半群叠加机制生成度量场，架构紧凑且随场景复杂度自然扩展。在单双障碍物场景上训练后，模型在未见过的障碍物配置上展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力，碰撞路径与无碰撞路径的成本相差数个数量级。
Motivation: 传统方法将智能放在智能体中（学习策略或搜索过程），本文试图将智能转移至空间本身，使路径规划简化为空间度量的几何属性，从而简化系统复杂度并提升泛化能力。
Method: 提出一个编码器-路由器网络，通过三组参数（框架参数定向生成器、调制参数控制空间传播、基本系数决定强度）经由共享的半群叠加机制生成黎曼度量场，无需外部规划器或碰撞检查模块。
Result: 在单个双障碍物场景上训练后，模型在未见过的障碍物配置上实现零样本泛化，碰撞路径成本与无碰撞路径成本相差多个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将智能置于空间中的思路可行，且该架构可自然扩展至复杂场景，但未提及在高维或动态环境中的表现。

papers.title: EDoF-NeRF: extended depth-of-field neural radiance fields using a coded aperture camera
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method for extending the depth-of-field (DoF) to construct high-fidelity neural radiance fields (NeRF) -- an emerging technique for rendering photorealistic novel views from a dataset of images captured at different viewpoints, based on implicit neural representations. The trade-off between DoF and light quantity is inherent not only in conventional cameras but also in NeRF, since the datasets used by NeRF are captured by these cameras. To address this issue, we introduce a coded aperture placed at the camera pupil, preserving spatial frequency components under defocused conditions. We develop a camera model incorporating coded apertures into NeRF, allowing direct input of coded images and enabling the generation of novel views with an extended DoF. We validate the proposed method, termed extended DoF-NeRF (EDoF-NeRF), through simulations and experiments, demonstrating its superior performance compared to conventional aperture cameras.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EDoF-NeRF方法，通过在相机光阑处放置编码光圈来扩展景深，从而构建高保真神经辐射场（NeRF）。该方法允许直接输入编码图像并生成具有扩展景深的新视角。仿真和实验表明，相比传统光圈相机，EDoF-NeRF具有更优性能。

Result: 仿真和实验验证了EDoF-NeRF优于传统光圈相机的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限性，但强调EDoF-NeRF通过编码光圈有效扩展了NeRF的景深范围。

papers.title: DreamReg: Belief-Driven World Model for 2D-3D Ultrasound Registration
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound (US) is widely used for surgical navigation, yet real-time registration between intraoperative 2D slices and preoperative 3D volumes remains challenging due to partial observability, speckle noise, and the action-dependent US acquisition. Existing methods are one-shot or short-horizon, making it hard for them to gather evidence over time or capture how surgeons adjust probe motion based on on-screen feedback. We propose DreamReg, a belief-driven world-model framework that formulates 2D-3D registration as belief updating over rigid transformations. DreamReg maintains a latent belief state that summarizes past observations and poses information, and continuously refines the transformation through learned dynamics as new slices arrive. During training, DreamReg is exposed to probe-motion trajectories that mimic clinical scanning behavior and learns to update its belief by conditioning pose refinement on the current US observation. During inference, DreamReg refines registration via internal imagination: it rolls out the learned world model to simulate candidate probe motions and their predicted observations, and integrates these imagined outcomes to converge to an accurate rigid transformation. Experiments on CAMUS and u-RegPro datasets demonstrate improved robustness and competitive registration accuracy for real-time guidance compared with state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DreamReg，一种基于信念驱动的世界模型框架，用于2D-3D超声图像配准。该方法将配准问题建模为对刚体变换的信念更新，通过维护潜在信念状态并利用学习到的动力学，在接收到新超声切片时连续优化变换。在CAMUS和u-RegPro数据集上，方法在实时引导任务中展现出优于现有方法的鲁棒性和精度。
Motivation: 现有2D-3D超声配准方法多为单次或短视，难以随时间积累证据或捕捉医生根据屏幕反馈调整探头运动的行为，且面临部分观测、散斑噪声和动作依赖的超声采集挑战。
Method: DreamReg维护一个潜在信念状态，该状态总结过去观测和位姿信息，并通过学习到的动力学在新切片到来时持续优化变换。训练时暴露于模仿临床扫描行为的探头运动轨迹，通过当前超声观测调整位姿优化；推理时通过内部想象：展开学习到的世界模型模拟候选探头运动及其预测观测，并整合这些想象结果以收敛到精确的刚体变换。
Result: 在CAMUS和u-RegPro数据集上，与最先进方法相比，DreamReg在实时引导中展现出更高的鲁棒性和有竞争力的配准精度。
Conclusion: DreamReg通过信念驱动和世界模型实现连续配准，为超声图像引导手术导航提供更可靠的实时配准方案。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出DreamReg，一种基于信念驱动的世界模型框架，用于2D-3D超声图像配准。该方法将配准问题建模为对刚体变换的信念更新，通过维护潜在信念状态并利用学习到的动力学，在接收到新超声切片时连续优化变换。在CAMUS和u-RegPro数据集上，方法在实时引导任务中展现出优于现有方法的鲁棒性和精度。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有2D-3D超声配准方法多为单次或短视，难以随时间积累证据或捕捉医生根据屏幕反馈调整探头运动的行为，且面临部分观测、散斑噪声和动作依赖的超声采集挑战。
summary_sections.method: DreamReg维护一个潜在信念状态，该状态总结过去观测和位姿信息，并通过学习到的动力学在新切片到来时持续优化变换。训练时暴露于模仿临床扫描行为的探头运动轨迹，通过当前超声观测调整位姿优化；推理时通过内部想象：展开学习到的世界模型模拟候选探头运动及其预测观测，并整合这些想象结果以收敛到精确的刚体变换。
summary_sections.result: 在CAMUS和u-RegPro数据集上，与最先进方法相比，DreamReg在实时引导中展现出更高的鲁棒性和有竞争力的配准精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: DreamReg通过信念驱动和世界模型实现连续配准，为超声图像引导手术导航提供更可靠的实时配准方案。

papers.title: Where Will They Go? Modelling Multimodal Pedestrian Manoeuvres from Ego-centric Videos
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian trajectory prediction from an ego-centric camera is challenging since it depends on complex interactions with vehicles and scene context, as well as the intention of the pedestrian. By modelling correlation and intent from the historical and future trajectories of the pedestrian, it will usually result in a multimodal (i.e. multiple modes) distribution. Existing stochastic predictors often sample multiple futures from a single unimodal distribution, which can yield sub-optimal 'mixed-mode' trajectories that lie between distinct motion patterns and become implausible in real scenes. In this paper, we propose MMPM, a mode-aware framework that separately models future trajectory distributions into semantically meaningful modes based on the pedestrian's crossing behavior. MMPM consists of two modules: behavior-aware Pedestrian Interaction Module (PIM) that jointly captures pedestrian-vehicle and pedestrian-environment interactions by introducing gaze, head and hand gesture, and a CVAE-based Mode-aware Trajectory Predictor (MTP) module to model the future trajectory distributions on two modes, crossing and non-crossing the road, separately. A query-based decoder further enforces mode consistency during decoding. Experiments on PIE and JAAD datasets show that our method surpasses state-of-the-art baselines. Our proposed MTP is model-agnostic, which can be integrated into existing frameworks such as BiTrap-NP and SGNet-ED to further improve future trajectory prediction performance. We additionally introduce a data-driven validation protocol that matches predictions to spatio-temporally consistent ground-truth trajectories, demonstrating improved frame-wise displacement errors over previous work.
papers.comment: Accepted at The IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMPM，一种从自车视角进行多模态行人轨迹预测的框架。通过将轨迹分布显式建模为过马路与不过马路两种语义模式，并引入注视、头部和手势等交互特征，MMPM在PIE和JAAD数据集上超越现有方法。其MTP模块是模型无关的，可集成至其他预测框架。
Motivation: 现有随机预测器从单一单峰分布采样多个未来，产生的混合模式轨迹在真实场景中不合理。需要更精确地建模行人的多模态意图（如过马路与否）以生成合理轨迹。
Method: 提出MMPM，包含行为感知行人交互模块（PIM）和基于CVAE的模式感知轨迹预测器（MTP）。PIM通过注视、头部和手势联合建模行人与车辆及环境的交互；MTP分别对过马路和非过马路两种模式建模未来轨迹分布，并使用查询解码器强制执行模式一致性。
Result: 在PIE和JAAD数据集上，MMPM在帧位移误差等指标上优于现有最先进方法。其MTP模块可无缝集成至BiTrap-NP和SGNet-ED等框架，进一步提升预测性能。
Conclusion: 所提出的模式感知框架能更准确地预测行人多模态轨迹，且MTP模块的即插即用特性便于推广至其他预测模型。

papers.title: Maturing Markov Decision Processes: Decision Making under Increasing Information and Shrinking Action Sets
papers.abstract_en: Sequential decision problems often exhibit an asymmetric evolution of information and decision flexibility: as a decision cycle unfolds, the agent receives richer information while feasible actions expire due to operational cutoffs, commitments, or resource constraints. Standard MDP formulations typically flatten this structure into stage-dependent state descriptions and action masks, thereby obscuring the nested information--action asymmetry that determines which decisions are urgent and which can be deferred. We introduce Maturing Markov Decision Processes (MMDPs), a formulation built around this information--action asymmetry. We characterize one of its key consequences through an expiring-action priority principle, which identifies the actions that must be resolved before the next stage. Motivated by this structure, we develop a structure-aware reinforcement learning framework with stage-aware policy design, expiring-action abstraction, and search-augmented learning with distillation. Experiments on a controlled multi-supplier replenishment problem, simplified cash-management environments of increasing complexity, and a production-scale simulator show that explicitly modeling this asymmetry improves learning efficiency and becomes increasingly valuable as decision problems scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对标准MDP在决策过程中信息增加与动作空间缩小的不对称性建模不足的问题，提出Maturing Markov Decision Processes (MMDPs)，显式刻画这种不对称性，并据此开发了结构感知的强化学习框架。实验表明，在多个决策问题上建模该不对称性能提升学习效率，且随问题规模增大优势更明显。
Motivation: 标准MDP将决策过程扁平化为阶段依赖的状态和动作掩码，忽略了信息增加与可行动作过期形成的不对称结构，导致无法准确判断哪些决策需要优先处理。
Method: 提出MMDPs，通过过期动作优先级原则识别必须在当前阶段决策的动作，并构建包含阶段感知策略、过期动作抽象以及搜索增强蒸馏学习的强化学习框架。
Result: 在控制的多供应商补货问题、简化现金管理环境以及生产规模模拟器上，实验显示显式建模不对称性提高了学习效率，且优势随问题规模扩大而增强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调建模信息-动作不对称性对于大规模顺序决策问题的有效性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SwitchBraidNet: Quantisation-Aware Lightweight Architecture for Hybrid Brain-Computer Interface
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) that integrate motor imagery (MI) and steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEP) provide high-dimensional neural decoding but typically exceed the computational limits of embedded hardware. To address this, we propose SwitchBraidNet, a compact EEG classification architecture designed for low-power deployment. The model employs a dual-path temporal braid to extract multiscale oscillatory features, an adaptive squeeze-and-excitation spatial switch for electrode gating, and a log-variance readout layer for direct band-power encoding. Furthermore, through systematic quantisation-aware training on the OpenBMI dataset, we compared SwitchBraidNet against four established baselines across FP32, FP16, and INT8 precisions. Experimental results demonstrate superior efficiency and performance, achieving MI accuracy of 69.49% (FP16), SSVEP accuracy of 93.48% (FP32), and a hybrid information transfer rate of 64.82 bits/min (FP16). With an INT8 footprint of only 3.03 KB, SwitchBraidNet maintains high accuracy across varying numerical precisions, demonstrating its suitability for low-power embedded BCI deployment.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, Preprint accepted at IEEE SMC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SwitchBraidNet，一种面向混合脑机接口 (BCI) 的轻量级 EEG 分类架构，集成运动想象 (MI) 和稳态视觉诱发电位 (SSVEP) 解码。模型采用双路径时间编织提取多尺度振荡特征、自适应挤压激励空间开关进行电极门控、对数方差读出层直接编码带功率，并通过量化感知训练在 OpenBMI 数据集上对比 FP32、FP16 和 INT8 精度。结果显示，MI 准确率 69.49% (FP16)、SSVEP 准确率 93.48% (FP32)、混合信息传输率 64.82 bits/min (FP16)，且 INT8 模型仅 3.03 KB，适合低功耗嵌入式部署。
Motivation: 混合 BCI 整合 MI 和 SSVEP 可提供高维神经解码，但计算需求通常超过嵌入式硬件的限制。
Method: 提出 SwitchBraidNet，包含双路径时间编织、自适应挤压激励空间开关和对数方差读出层，并系统地进行量化感知训练。
Result: 在 OpenBMI 数据集上，MI 准确率 69.49% (FP16)、SSVEP 准确率 93.48% (FP32)、混合信息传输率 64.82 bits/min (FP16)，INT8 模型占用 3.03 KB 且保持高精度。
Conclusion: SwitchBraidNet 在不同数值精度下均保持高准确率，适合低功耗嵌入式 BCI 部署。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Foundation Models Should Already Be A Thing
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for language and vision are powered by internet-scale data, while structured domains (tabular prediction, time-series forecasting, graph learning, reinforcement learning) are not. The substitute is synthetic data, which shifts the burden from collection to prior design. Such priors already exist for many structured tasks: TabPFN and its successors solve tabular classification with a transformer pretrained on a synthetic Bayesian prior. We make two points. \textbf{First}, reinforcement learning is the conspicuous gap: sampling a synthetic MDP is as feasible as sampling a synthetic tabular dataset, yet no in-context RL work treats prior design as a primary objective. \textbf{Second}, MDPs admit a fixed-size sufficient statistic, independent of the episodes observed and tabular in shape, which makes them directly amenable to the attention-based architectures used for tabular foundation models, with a policy head replacing the supervised target. Together these define the agenda for an RL foundation model. As a proof of concept, we train one model entirely on synthetic MDPs and show that, with no task-specific tuning, it solves held-out tabular benchmarks in context, both online and offline: online, in far fewer episodes than UCB-VI and tabular Q-learning, and offline, competitively with VI-LCB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出强化学习领域缺失像TabPFN那样的基础模型，并提出利用合成MDP作为先验数据训练一个Transformer模型，使其能通过上下文学习解决新MDP问题。作为概念验证，该模型完全在合成MDP上训练，无需任务特定微调即可在在线和离线表格基准任务中达到有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 结构化领域（如表格预测、时间序列、图学习）已有基于合成数据预训练的基础模型，但强化学习尚未出现类似工作，作者认为这一空白亟需填补。
Method: 提出使用合成MDP作为先验，训练一个基于注意力的Transformer模型，其架构与表格基础模型类似，但将监督目标替换为策略头，从而实现对新MDP的上下文学习。
Result: 在线任务中，训练模型在远少于UCB-VI和表格Q-learning的episodes内解决表格基准；离线任务中，性能与VI-LCB相当。
Conclusion: 本文为构建强化学习基础模型提出了明确的研究议程，并通过初步实验证明了其可行性。

papers.title: Rescaling MLM-Head for Neural Sparse Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Learned sparse retrieval (LSR) models such as SPLADE have traditionally used BERT-style masked language models as backbone encoders. A natural expectation is that replacing BERT with stronger pretrained encoders should improve retrieval effectiveness. However, we find that under standard SPLADE training recipes, backbones with large MLM-head L2 norms can suffer performance degradation and even training collapse under standard SPLADE training recipes. We identify this failure as a scale mismatch in the MLM head: SPLADE directly uses MLM-head outputs to construct sparse lexical representations, and query-document relevance is computed by an unnormalized dot product over these representations. As a result, an inflated MLM-head scale can amplify sparse activations, distort matching scores, and destabilize contrastive training under common training settings. To address this issue, we introduce a simple initialization-time correction that rescales the MLM-head projection by a constant factor before SPLADE training. This zero-cost adjustment improves training stability without modifying the model architecture or training objective. Across both in-domain and out-of-domain retrieval benchmarks, this simple correction substantially improves large-norm backbones such as ModernBERT and Ettin, turning unstable training runs into competitive sparse retrievers. In several settings, the corrected models further match or surpass the classic BERT-SPLADE baseline. These findings suggest that the bottleneck in adapting pretrained encoders to LSR is not encoder capacity alone, but the calibration of the MLM-head scale used to construct sparse lexical representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现使用更强预训练编码器（如ModernBERT、Ettin）替换BERT进行学习型稀疏检索（LSR）时，MLM头的L2范数过大会导致训练不稳定甚至崩溃。作者提出在初始化时对MLM头投影进行常数因子缩放，无需修改架构或训练目标即可稳定训练。实验表明该修正使大范数骨干网络在域内和域外检索基准上达到甚至超越经典BERT-SPLADE基线。
Motivation: 基于BERT的稀疏检索模型（如SPLADE）替换更强骨干网络后性能反而下降甚至崩溃，原因是MLM头尺度与SPLADE训练不匹配，导致稀疏表示放大、匹配分数扭曲及对比训练不稳定。
Method: 提出初始化时对MLM头投影进行常数因子缩放的零成本修正，调整MLM头输出尺度，避免训练崩溃。
Result: 在多个检索基准上，修正后的ModernBERT、Ettin等大范数骨干网络训练稳定，性能匹配或超越BERT-SPLADE基线。
Conclusion: 预训练编码器适配LSR的瓶颈不仅是编码器容量，更是MLM头尺度的校准。

papers.title: Learning from Own Solutions: Self-Conditioned Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in training LLMs for reasoning tasks, but representative methods such as GRPO assign uniform credit across all tokens, wasting gradient on routine tokens while under-crediting pivotal reasoning steps. Existing token-level credit assignment methods require resources beyond the model's own rollouts. GRPO variants rely on process reward models or ground-truth answers. Knowledge distillation assigns credit through per-token divergence but requires external teachers (On-Policy Distillation) or privileged information (On-Policy Self Distillation). However, these dependencies limit applicability in the pure RLVR setting. We observe that conditioning the model on its own verified trajectories induces a measurable per-token KL divergence between the original and conditioned distributions, and prove that distilling from a self-teacher constructed by verified trajectories leads to infeasible weighted-average solutions when multiple verified trajectories exist. We propose SC-GRPO (Self-Conditioned GRPO), which uses KL divergence mentioned before as a multiplicative weight on GRPO gradients. Across five benchmarks spanning math, code, and agentic tasks, SC-GRPO consistently outperforms 8.1% over GRPO and 5.9% over DAPO with stronger OOD performance. Moreover, SC-GRPO achieves higher performance than OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）中GRPO方法对所有token分配均匀信用的问题，提出SC-GRPO（Self-Conditioned GRPO），利用模型自身验证轨迹引起的KL散度作为梯度乘性权重，实现token级信用分配。在数学、代码和智能体任务共五个基准上，SC-GRPO平均比GRPO提升8.1%，比DAPO提升5.9%，且泛化性能更强。
Motivation: 现有GRPO对token均匀分配信用，浪费梯度在常规token上而对关键推理步骤信用不足；而其他token级方法依赖外部过程奖励模型、真实答案或教师模型，不适用于纯RLVR设置。
Method: SC-GRPO在GRPO梯度上乘以一个由自条件化（conditioning on own verified trajectories）产生的per-token KL散度权重，理论分析表明直接蒸馏自验证轨迹会导致多轨迹下不可行的加权平均解。
Result: 五个基准（数学、代码、智能体任务）上平均超越GRPO 8.1%、DAPO 5.9%，且OOD性能更强，同时超越在线策略蒸馏（OPD）。
Conclusion: SC-GRPO通过自条件化KL散度实现有效token级信用分配，无需外部资源，在纯RLVR设置中提升性能与泛化能力。

papers.title: Learning Augmented Exact Exponential Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: The field of learning-augmented algorithms has demonstrated that machine-learned predictions can bypass worst-case lower bounds across a wide range of problems. So far, however, the focus has been almost exclusively on polynomial-time algorithms, where predictions improve competitive ratios, approximation guarantees, or running times. In this paper, we raise the question of whether predictions can push the frontier of exact exponential-time algorithms for NP-hard problems. We answer this question affirmatively by proposing a general approach that augments an entire family of state-of-the-art exact algorithms for a variety of subset selection problems. We show that a noisy predictor that is only marginally better than random guessing suffices to provably reduce the search space, and that the resulting runtime speedup scales smoothly with the prediction quality. Importantly, our algorithms require only pairwise independence of predictions or, alternatively, do not require the knowledge of the predictor's accuracy - both strictly weaker and more realistic settings than typically assumed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用方法，将学习增强（learning-augmented）应用于精确指数时间算法，用于NP难问题的子集选择问题。研究表明，即使仅比随机猜测略好的噪声预测器也能显著减少搜索空间，加速比随预测质量平滑变化，且仅需预测的成对独立性或无需知道预测器精度。
Motivation: 现有学习增强算法主要聚焦于多项式时间算法，提升竞争比、近似比或运行时间。本文探讨预测能否推动精确指数时间算法解决NP难问题的前沿。
Method: 提出一种通用框架，增强多种最先进的精确指数时间算法，用于子集选择问题。利用机器学习预测（可能噪声）来剪枝搜索空间，要求预测器仅具备成对独立性或无需已知精度。
Result: 证明即使预测器仅略好于随机猜测，也能显著降低搜索空间；加速比随预测质量平滑缩放。
Conclusion: 学习增强可以有效地应用于精确指数时间算法，且假设比通常更弱、更实际。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProfiLLM: Utility-Aligned Agentic User Profiling for Industrial Ride-Hailing Dispatch
papers.abstract_en: Bringing Large Language Models (LLMs) into industrial ride-hailing dispatch as semantic feature extractors over platform-scale behavioral logs is a compelling but under-explored data systems problem. Production matching pipelines remain dominated by structured numerical features, yet decisive behavioral signals (e.g., a driver's habitual aversion to certain regions) are inherently contextual and naturally expressible as LLM-generated user profiles. However, scaling such profiling to a live, millisecond-latency dispatcher faces three intertwined constraints rarely addressed together: on a platform with millions of daily orders, logs exceed any LLM's context window by orders of magnitude; most users are long-tail, with too few interactions for per-user profiling; and surface-fluent profiles do not necessarily improve downstream prediction utility. We present ProfiLLM, an agentic LLM data pipeline that operationalizes utility-aligned user profiling for production matching systems through two modules. (1) Tool-Augmented Global Knowledge Mining equips an LLM agent with 27 analytical tools to mine platform-scale data, producing reusable global knowledge, adaptive user clustering rules, and region-level supply-demand priors. (2) Utility-Aligned Profile Exploration generates multiple candidate profiles per cluster, evaluates them via a lightweight downstream utility proxy, iteratively refines the best candidates and constructs preference pairs for DPO fine-tuning. Deployed on DiDi's production dispatcher, ProfiLLM achieves up to +6.14% relative AUC improvement in outcome prediction, up to +4.35% GMV gain in dispatching simulation, and consistent improvements in a 14-day online A/B test including +0.47% GMV, +0.33% Completion Rate, and -0.82% Cancel-Before-Accept rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProfiLLM，一个面向工业网约车调度的智能体LLM数据流水线，通过两个模块实现效用对齐的用户画像：工具增强的全局知识挖掘和效用对齐的画像探索。在滴滴生产调度系统上部署后，结果预测AUC提升最高6.14%，GMV提升最高4.35%，在线A/B测试中GMV提升0.47%，完成率提升0.33%，取消率降低0.82%。
Motivation: 现有工业网约车调度系统主要依赖结构化数值特征，缺乏对上下文行为信号（如司机回避特定区域）的利用，而LLM生成用户画像面临日志超长、长尾用户数据稀疏、表面流畅画像未必提升下游预测效用等挑战。
Method: ProfiLLM包含两个模块：(1) 工具增强的全局知识挖掘，为LLM智能体配备27种分析工具，挖掘平台规模数据，生成可复用全局知识、自适应用户聚类规则和区域级供需先验；(2) 效用对齐的画像探索，为每个簇生成多个候选画像，通过轻量下游效用代理评估，迭代优化并构建偏好对用于DPO微调。
Result: 在滴滴生产调度系统上，结果预测AUC相对提升最多+6.14%，调度模拟GMV最多+4.35%，14天在线A/B测试中GMV+0.47%，完成率+0.33%，取消率-0.82%。
Conclusion: ProfiLLM展示了LLM在工业网约车调度中作为效用对齐用户画像生成器的有效性，但摘要未提及对极端天气或降水等气象因素的考虑。

papers.title: SHIFT: Semantic Harmonization via Index-side Feature Transformation for Multilingual Information Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid expansion of massive multilingual corpora, Multilingual Information Retrieval (MLIR) has emerged as a critical technology for global information access. MLIR enables users to retrieve semantically relevant documents from multilingual text collections using a single-language query. However, recent multilingual dense retrieval models often exhibit a strong preference for documents in the same language as the query. This leads to severe language bias, where top-ranked results are dominated by documents of specific languages, even when documents in other languages contain more semantically relevant information. To address this issue, we propose SHIFT, a training-free method applicable in the indexing stage. Specifically, SHIFT utilizes parallel translation pairs to estimate a relative language vector for each target language with respect to a source language. Subsequently, SHIFT corrects the language-specific offset by subtracting this relative language vector from document embeddings during indexing. Our comprehensive evaluation across four MLIR benchmarks and diverse dense retrieval models confirms that SHIFT can effectively mitigate language bias and enhance MLIR performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言信息检索中存在的语言偏差问题，提出一种无需训练的索引阶段特征变换方法SHIFT。该方法通过平行翻译对估计目标语言相对于源语言的相对语言向量，并在索引时从文档嵌入中减去该向量以修正语言特定偏移。实验表明，SHIFT能有效缓解语言偏差，提升多语言检索性能。
Motivation: 现有密集检索模型在跨语言检索时严重偏向与查询同语言的文档，导致排名结果被特定语言主导，即使其他语言文档包含更相关语义信息。
Method: 利用平行翻译对估计相对语言向量，在索引阶段从文档嵌入中减去该向量，从而消除语言特定偏移。方法无需训练，适用于任何密集检索模型。
Result: 在四个多语言检索基准和多种密集检索模型上验证，SHIFT能有效缓解语言偏差并提升检索性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SHIFT是一种训练无关、轻量级的索引阶段特征变换方法，能有效缓解多语言信息检索中的语言偏差问题。

papers.title: Fuzzy-Geometric Branch-Point Modeling for Structure-Aware Augmentation of Handwritten Chinese Characters
papers.abstract_en: Data scarcity and structural distortion significantly limit handwriting recognition in high-security authentication. Existing augmentation methods often cause topological and morphological damage, particularly when processing complex Chinese characters where stroke intersections, ligatures, and sharp turns render traditional branch-point detection unreliable. To address this, this paper proposes a fuzzy geometry-driven structure-aware (FGSA) augmentation framework. We model branch points as fuzzy sets within the skeleton space, constructing a continuous branch-point membership field by integrating topological neighborhood evidence with direction field divergence. This membership field is adaptively optimized via an unsupervised surrogate objective, enabling robust stroke decoupling without manual annotation. Finally, kinematically-aligned samples are synthesized through parameterized cubic Bézier reconstruction and multi-strategy perturbations, ensuring a balance between structural fidelity and sample diversity. Moreover, we establish LZUSig, a large-scale, highly challenging dataset specifically dedicated to fine-grained structural degradation in Chinese handwritten signatures. Extensive experiments on CASIA-HWDB1.1, ChiSig, and LZUSig demonstrate that FGSA significantly reduces the word-level error rate ($Δ$WER), achieving optimal recognition gains over the compared baselines. More importantly, it strikes a robust trade-off among task gain, structural fidelity, and discriminative feature preservation, offering a highly controllable solution for handwriting augmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模糊几何驱动的结构感知（FGSA）数据增强框架，用于手写汉字识别。通过将笔画分支点建模为骨架空间中的模糊集，结合拓扑证据与方向场散度构建连续隶属场，并利用无监督目标优化实现鲁棒笔画解耦。基于参数化三次贝塞尔重建与多策略扰动生成运动对齐样本，同时建立大规模高挑战性数据集LZUSig。在多个数据集上，FGSA显著降低词错误率，并在任务增益、结构保真度与判别特征保持间取得良好平衡。
Motivation: 现有数据增强方法在处理复杂汉字时易造成拓扑与形态损伤，尤其在笔画交叉、连笔和急转弯处，传统分支点检测不可靠。
Method: 将分支点建模为骨架空间中的模糊集，通过集成拓扑邻域证据与方向场散度构建连续分支点隶属场，并采用无监督代理目标进行自适应优化；通过参数化三次贝塞尔重建与多策略扰动合成运动对齐样本。
Result: 在CASIA-HWDB1.1、ChiSig及新建立的LZUSig数据集上，FGSA显著降低了词错误率（ΔWER），识别性能优于其他对比基线。
Conclusion: FGSA提供了高度可控的手写数据增强方案，在任务增益、结构保真度和判别特征保持之间实现了稳健折中。

papers.title: Closing the Loop: PID Feedback Control for Interpretable Activation Steering in Symbolic Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based architectures have significantly advanced the generation of complex symbolic sequences, yet a significant gap remains in achieving fine-grained, interpretable control over discrete signal attributes. This paper investigates the mechanistic interpretability of the Multitrack Music Transformer (MMT) and proposes a framework for deterministic attribute modulation without retraining to bridge this gap via inference-time activation steering. Utilizing the Difference-in-Means (DiffMean) methodology, we isolate latent directions for signal attributes, specifically Pitch and Duration, within the residual stream. We validate the Linear Representation Hypothesis in this domain, achieving high correlation between steering magnitude and attribute shift. To address the inherent feature entanglement in multi-attribute steering, we introduce a Dual Steering framework utilizing Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization. Experimental results demonstrate that this geometric decoupling reduces conceptual interference and signal degradation compared to naive vector addition, enabling independent deterministic control even against strong autoregressive conditioning.
papers.comment: Accepted at Learning to Listen: ICML 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio (43rd International Conference on Machine Learning - ICMLMLA26), 4 pages main (11 total), 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对符号音乐生成中离散信号属性的细粒度可解释控制问题，提出基于PID反馈控制的推理时激活转向框架。利用差异均值方法提取残差流中音高与时值的潜在方向，验证线性表示假说，并通过双转向框架（格拉姆-施密特正交化）解耦多属性特征，实现独立确定性控制。
Motivation: Transformer在符号序列生成中表现优异，但缺乏对离散信号属性（如音高、时值）的可解释、细粒度控制，且多属性控制时特征纠缠导致性能下降。
Method: 采用差异均值方法识别残差流中与属性相关的线性方向；提出双转向框架，利用格拉姆-施密特正交化解耦音高与时值方向，结合PID反馈机制进行推理时激活转向，无需重新训练。
Result: 摘要报告验证了线性表示假说，转向强度与属性偏移高度相关；双转向框架相比朴素向量加法减少了概念干扰和信号退化，实现了对强自回归条件作用的独立确定性控制。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了利用几何解耦和反馈控制在符号音乐生成中实现可解释属性控制的可行性，为离散序列的细粒度干预提供了新思路。

summary_sections.motivation: Transformer在符号序列生成中表现优异，但缺乏对离散信号属性（如音高、时值）的可解释、细粒度控制，且多属性控制时特征纠缠导致性能下降。
summary_sections.method: 采用差异均值方法识别残差流中与属性相关的线性方向；提出双转向框架，利用格拉姆-施密特正交化解耦音高与时值方向，结合PID反馈机制进行推理时激活转向，无需重新训练。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告验证了线性表示假说，转向强度与属性偏移高度相关；双转向框架相比朴素向量加法减少了概念干扰和信号退化，实现了对强自回归条件作用的独立确定性控制。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作展示了利用几何解耦和反馈控制在符号音乐生成中实现可解释属性控制的可行性，为离散序列的细粒度干预提供了新思路。

papers.title: HandwritingAgent: Language-Driven Handwriting Synthesis in Scalable Vector Space
papers.abstract_en: Teaching machines to emulate natural handwriting styles remains an open challenge, as it requires synthesizing stroke sequences that dynamically vary in shape, texture, pressure and script - not only across individuals, but also within a single person's handwriting. Attempts at this challenge have largely explored deep learning methods in both online and offline settings. However, these approaches are often constrained by style-specific architectural choices, heavy reliance on large datasets, high compute costs, and a lack of flexible control over writing styles through natural language. To this end, we introduce HandwritingAgent, a language-driven agent that can synthesize natural handwriting sequences directly in Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) format with no need for style-specific training. The agent leverages a large reasoning model to geometrically analyse and autoregressively generate target handwritten glyphs as stroke sequences in a discrete grid canvas environment. Generation is conditioned on texts provided in either conversational or non-conversational mode, along with a reference handwriting-style image. Experiments on diverse handwriting tasks spanning imitation, recognition, multi-lingual handwriting synthesis, and generation of complex handwritten maths and science expressions indicate substantial improvement in performance, with HandwritingAgent matching or surpassing state-of-the-art generative handwriting models, while providing a more efficient, controllable, and generalizable synthesis method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HandwritingAgent 是一个语言驱动的智能体，能在可缩放矢量图形 (SVG) 格式中直接合成自然手写序列，无需针对特定风格进行训练。它利用大型推理模型在离散网格画布环境中以自回归方式生成手写笔划序列，并支持对话或非对话模式下的文本条件以及参考手写风格图像。实验表明，在手写模仿、识别、多语言合成及复杂数学科学表达式生成等任务上，该代理匹配或超越了现有最先进生成模型，同时提供更高效、可控和通用的合成方法。
Motivation: 现有手写合成方法受限于风格特定的架构、依赖大规模数据集、计算成本高且缺乏通过自然语言灵活控制书写风格的能力。
Method: 提出 HandwritingAgent，利用大型推理模型对手写字形进行几何分析，并在离散网格画布环境中自回归生成 SVG 格式的笔划序列，生成条件为文本（对话/非对话模式）和参考手写风格图像。
Result: 在多种手写任务上（模仿、识别、多语言合成、复杂数学科学表达式生成）性能显著提升，匹配或超越现有最先进生成模型。
Conclusion: HandwritingAgent 提供了一种更高效、可控且泛化能力强的合成方法，无需针对风格进行训练。

papers.title: Learned Radius Estimation for UDF-Based Point Cloud Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Surface reconstruction from point clouds is important for consumer-grade 3D capture, including AR/VR and indoor scanning. Local-patch Unsigned Distance Field (UDF) methods are lightweight and generalizable, but their accuracy depends on the support radius, traditionally fixed or selected by a one-dimensional curvature heuristic that cannot capture heterogeneous local geometry. We propose a learned per-query radius selector that predicts a continuous support radius and plugs into a frozen LoSF-UDF backbone. The selector is trained using off-grid target radii obtained by parabolic interpolation of cached UDF error curves. Experiments show improved fine-scale reconstruction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于学习的逐查询半径选择器，用于改进基于无符号距离场（UDF）的点云表面重建精度。该方法预测连续的支持半径，并插入冻结的LoSF-UDF骨干网络，通过抛物插值获取目标半径进行训练。实验显示在精细尺度重建上取得改进。
Motivation: 现有局部补丁UDF方法依赖固定半径或一维曲率启发式，无法适应异质局部几何，限制了重建精度。
Method: 提出一个学习的每查询半径选择器，预测连续支持半径，并集成到冻结的LoSF-UDF骨干中；使用通过抛物插值缓存UDF误差曲线获得的离网格目标半径进行训练。
Result: 摘要报告在精细尺度重建精度上取得改进，但未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 该工作表明学习半径选择器可提升UDF方法的重建质量，尤其对精细几何细节。

papers.title: R2D-RL: A RoboCup 2D Soccer Environment for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robot soccer is a challenging testbed for multi-agent reinforcement learning because it combines partial observability, cooperative and adversarial interaction, sparse rewards, and long-horizon tactical behavior. RoboCup 2D Soccer Simulation (RCSS2D) provides a mature robot-soccer platform, but its competition-oriented server-client architecture is difficult to use directly with modern Python-based MARL workflows. We introduce R2D-RL, a reinforcement learning environment that connects RCSS2D and HELIOS-based player clients to a Python MARL interface through shared-memory communication and cycle-level synchronization. R2D-RL supports full-field and scenario-based training with configurable opponents, Base discrete and Hybrid parameterized action spaces, action masks, expected possession value (EPV)-based reward shaping, and parallel execution. We provide front-goal scenarios and an 11-vs-11 full-field benchmark, together with baseline results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了R2D-RL，一个连接RoboCup 2D Soccer Simulation (RCSS2D)和HELIOS客户端到Python多智能体强化学习(MARL)接口的环境，通过共享内存通信和循环级同步实现。支持全场和基于场景的训练，可配置对手，离散和混合参数化动作空间，动作掩码，基于期望控球值(EPV)的奖励塑造，以及并行执行。提供了前场目标和11对11全场比赛基准及基线结果。
Motivation: RoboCup 2D Soccer Simulation平台虽然成熟，但其面向竞赛的服务器-客户端架构难以直接与基于Python的现代MARL工作流集成，需要构建一个连接环境。
Method: 通过共享内存通信和循环级同步将RCSS2D服务器和HELIOS客户端连接到Python MARL接口，支持全场/场景训练、可配置对手、离散/混合动作空间、动作掩码、EPV奖励塑造和并行执行。
Result: 提供了前场目标场景和11对11全场比赛基准，以及基线结果。
Conclusion: 该环境使得在RoboCup 2D平台上进行MARL研究更加便捷。

papers.title: Bayesian Anytime Pareto Set Identification for Multi-Objective Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Identifying Pareto optimal solutions is critical to support multi-objective decision-making. We introduce the first anytime Multi-Objective Multi-Armed Bandit algorithm for the Pareto Set Identification problem, taking a Bayesian approach: Top-Two Pareto Front Thompson Sampling (TTPFTS). We benchmark TTPFTS against state-of-the-art fixed-budget Pareto Set Identification algorithms on synthetic environments. Next, we demonstrate its practical utility in a challenging multi-objective molecular discovery setting by efficiently exploring an ultra-large synthesis-on-demand molecular library. Furthermore, we introduce a novel uncertainty quantification metric that estimates our algorithm's confidence in the predicted Pareto set. We demonstrate that this metric effectively proxies true performance, yielding a robust methodology for monitoring learning progress in complex settings. Finally, we complement these empirical findings with a theoretical proof of the algorithm's asymptotic correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个任意时间（anytime）的多目标多臂赌博机帕累托集合识别算法：Top-Two Pareto Front Thompson Sampling (TTPFTS)，采用贝叶斯方法。在合成环境和超大型合成分子库中验证了其实用性，并引入新的不确定性量化指标来估计算法对预测帕累托集合的置信度，证明了渐近正确性。
Motivation: 现有帕累托集合识别算法多为固定预算（fixed-budget）设计，缺乏随时可用的任意时间算法，且在多目标决策中贝叶斯方法应用不足。
Method: 提出TTPFTS算法，结合Thompson采样与Top-Two采样策略，用于多目标帕累托集合的在线识别；同时设计了一个不确定性量化指标来监控学习进度。
Result: 在合成环境中与最先进固定预算算法对比表现优异；在分子发现任务中展示了高效探索超大型分子库的能力；不确定性指标有效代理真实性能；理论证明算法渐近正确。
Conclusion: TTPFTS是首个适用于多目标帕累托集合识别的任意时间贝叶斯算法，在理论和实践中均有效，但当前评估限于分子发现领域，其他多目标决策领域的适用性有待验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SCR-Guided Difficulty-Aware Optimization for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection remains challenging due to severe background clutter, low contrast, and weak spatial responses where geometric overlap alone is insufficient to characterize detection quality. In this work, we propose REEM (Reweighted Explicit-visibility Enhanced Modulation), a lightweight SCR-guided difficulty-aware optimization framework that incorporates Signal-to-Clutter Ratio (SCR) as a physically meaningful visibility prior during training. Instead of modifying the network architecture or directly optimizing SCR, REEM computes a ground-truth local SCR from the input image and applies a differentiable modulation to the soft-IoU learning signal, emphasizing low-visibility targets while preserving stable optimization and identical inference behavior. REEM is integrated into a U-Net-based MSHNet without introducing additional parameters, architectural modifications, or inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over the baseline, achieving higher IoU and detection probability (Pd) together with substantially reduced false alarms (FA), particularly under challenging low-visibility conditions. These results suggest that SCR-guided difficulty-aware optimization provides an effective and physically grounded complement to conventional overlap-based objectives for infrared small target detection. The code is available at https://github. com/yall-in-one/Reemm.
papers.comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Workshops (PBVS). Published version: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026W/PBVS/html/Sevim_SCR-Guided_Difficulty-Aware_Optimization_for_Infrared_Small_Target_Detection_CVPRW_2026_paper.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REEM框架，利用信杂比（SCR）作为可见性先验，通过可微调制软IoU损失来强调低可见性红外小目标，无需修改网络架构或增加推理开销。实验表明，该方法在保持相同推理行为的同时，显著提升了IoU和检测概率，并降低了虚警，尤其在低对比度背景下。
Motivation: 现有基于几何重叠的损失函数难以充分表征红外小目标的检测质量，尤其是在背景杂波严重、目标低对比度和弱空间响应的情况下。
Method: 提出REEM（Reweighted Explicit-visibility Enhanced Modulation）框架，在训练时从输入图像计算真实局部SCR，并对软IoU学习信号进行可微调制，使低可见性目标获得更大权重，推理时保持原模型行为不变。
Result: 基于U-Net的MSHNet集成REEM后，在多个数据集上相比基线获得更高的IoU和检测概率，同时显著降低虚警，尤其在低可见性条件下。
Conclusion: SCR引导的难度感知优化为传统重叠目标函数提供了有效的物理基础补充，适用于红外小目标检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RedactionBench
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models are increasingly applied to sensitive domains that require redaction of personally identifiable information (PII). While redacting PII is a data cleaning prerequisite, existing benchmarks conflate extraction mechanics with privacy semantics. A public phone number is not equivalent to a phone number in a medical record. Whether information constitutes a violation depends heavily on who holds it, why, and in what context, fundamentally differentiating redaction from simple entity recognition. Grounded in contextual integrity, we introduce RedactionBench, a manually annotated benchmark comprising 200 diverse documents across 11 domains, mostly seeded from real-world sources. We also introduce R-Score, a novel character-level metric that treats semantically similar redactions equally and nullifies shallow formatting choices, such as varying masking styles for phone numbers. Evaluations across Named Entity Recognition models, entity extraction Small Language Models, and frontier models equipped with agentic tools demonstrate that contextual redaction remains an unsolved problem. A human evaluation with over 80 users on RedactionBench reveals a stark dichotomy in privacy perceptions. Annotators show consensus with target labels for mandatory redactions (89.4 percent) and safe text preservations (94.1 percent), but fail to agree on contextual redactions (47.7 percent). This variance demonstrates the subjective nature of contextual privacy and motivates R-Score, which decouples contextual ambiguity from strict precision. We compare 35 models across families and report their performance in redacting PII. Finally, we release RedactionBench to establish a baseline for future privacy-preserving systems, hoping to inspire efficient model design and standardized evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RedactionBench，一个手动标注的基准，包含 200 个跨 11 个领域的文档，用于评估大语言模型在个人可识别信息（PII）编辑上的表现。引入 R-Score，一种字符级指标，将语义相似的编辑视为等价并忽略格式差异。评估了 NER 模型、小语言模型和前沿模型，发现上下文编辑仍未解决。人类评估显示强制性编辑一致性 89.4%，安全文本保留 94.1%，但上下文编辑一致性仅 47.7%。
Motivation: 现有基准混淆了提取机制与隐私语义，缺乏上下文完整性。PII 是否构成违规取决于谁持有、为何持有及上下文，因此编辑不同于简单的实体识别。
Method: 构建 RedactionBench 数据集，包含 200 个跨 11 个领域的手动标注文档（多源自真实来源）。提出 R-Score，一种字符级指标，对语义相似的编辑给予同等对待，并消除格式差异的影响。
Result: 评估了 35 个模型，包括 NER 模型、小语言模型及带代理工具的前沿模型。人类评估中，强制性编辑一致性 89.4%，安全文本保留 94.1%，但上下文编辑一致性仅 47.7%。
Conclusion: 上下文编辑仍是一个未解决的问题。R-Score 有助于解耦上下文歧义与严格精确度。发布该基准以建立未来隐私保护系统的基线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SAMA: Semantic Anchor-aligned Augmentation for Unified Low-Resource Multimodal Information Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Information Extraction (MIE)-covering tasks such as Multimodal Named Entity Recognition (MNER), Relation Extraction (MRE), and Event Extraction (MEE)-is essential for understanding multimedia content but remains constrained by severe data scarcity. Although data augmentation is a promising remedy, existing approaches are impeded by coarse cross-modal alignment and fragmented, task-specific designs that fail to exploit shared semantic knowledge. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Semantic Anchor-aligned Multimodal Augmentation (SAMA), a unified framework for generating high-fidelity, task-aware synthetic data. SAMA constructs structured semantic anchors from ground-truth labels to guide a Collaborative Multi-Experts Multimodal Large Language Model (CME-MLLM), which integrates a Universal Adapter for shared semantics with Task-Specific Adapters to produce diverse yet constraint-compliant textual samples. For image synthesis, SAMA employs an Anchor-Preserving Diffusion mechanism that uses anchor-weighted prompts and latent conditioning to maintain critical semantic anchors while diversifying visual contexts. To eliminate the need for manual verification, SAMA further introduces a Dual-Constraint Filtering module that selects synthetic samples based on both cross-modal consistency and anchor fidelity. Extensive experiments across benchmark datasets for MNER, MRE, and MEE demonstrate that SAMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art augmentation baselines under both fully supervised and low-resource settings, underscoring its versatility, robustness, and effectiveness.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAMA（Semantic Anchor-aligned Multimodal Augmentation），一个统一的低资源多模态信息抽取数据增强框架。它通过结构化语义锚点引导多模态大模型生成高保真、任务感知的合成文本和图像，并引入双约束过滤模块筛选样本。在 MNER、MRE、MEE 等任务上，SAMA 在完全监督和低资源设定下均优于现有增强方法。
Motivation: 多模态信息抽取（MIE）受数据稀缺限制，现有增强方法跨模态对齐粗糙且任务设计碎片化，未能有效利用共享语义知识。
Method: SAMA 从标注标签构建结构化语义锚点，指导协作多专家多模态大语言模型（CME-MLLM）生成文本；采用锚点保留扩散机制合成图像；并通过双约束过滤模块（跨模态一致性和锚点保真度）自动筛选高质量样本。
Result: 在 MNER、MRE、MEE 的基准数据集上，SAMA 在完全监督和低资源设置下均一致超越最先进的增强基线。
Conclusion: SAMA 作为一个统一框架，通过语义锚点对齐有效缓解多模态信息抽取中的数据稀缺问题，展示了通用性、鲁棒性和有效性。

papers.title: Online Distributional Prediction via Latent Cluster Geometry Under Drift and Corruption
papers.abstract_en: Online learning in non-stationary streams is often formulated as tracking a point estimate, but many applications require predicting the full data-generating distribution. We study online distributional prediction under drift and adversarial corruption. Our approach represents each candidate law through a latent cluster geometry: a variable-size configuration of centers that organizes probability mass and induces a predictive distribution. A Gibbs quasi-posterior over these configurations yields an online predictor by posterior averaging, and the resulting variable-dimensional posterior can be sampled with reversible-jump MCMC. The method therefore avoids specifying a parametric streaming law while retaining a structured latent space for uncertainty, regularization, and comparison. We evaluate performance by cumulative Wasserstein-1 regret against the time-varying true law. The analysis separates two effects: corruption perturbs the loss-based posterior update, whereas drift makes long-horizon posterior memory stale. We address the latter with a restarted variant that temporally localizes the same quasi-Bayesian update. The resulting high-probability bounds decompose into a PAC-Bayesian complexity term, a corruption-sensitive posterior perturbation term, and a dynamic optimal-transport term driven by \(A_T^{\mathrm{OT}}=\sum_{t=2}^T W_2^2(p_{t-1}^*,p_t^*)\). Under bounded support, stable latent geometry, predictive-map regularity, oracle realizability, localized restart windows, sublinear transport action, and sublinear corruption budget, the restarted predictor achieves sublinear cumulative Wasserstein regret. These guarantees require no parametric model for the stream, drift mechanism, or corruption process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非平稳流中的在线分布预测问题，允许漂移和对抗性腐败。通过潜在簇几何（变长中心配置）表示分布，利用Gibbs准后验和可逆跳MCMC进行在线预测。理论分析将Wasserstein-1累积遗憾分解为PAC-Bayesian复杂度项、腐败敏感的后验扰动项和动态最优传输项，并在适当假设下证明重启变体可实现亚线性遗憾。
Motivation: 现有在线学习研究多聚焦点估计跟踪，但许多应用需要预测完整数据生成分布。非平稳流中的分布预测面临漂移和腐败挑战，缺乏无参数假设的结构化方法。
Method: 提出基于潜在簇几何的在线分布预测方法：用变长中心配置组织概率质量，通过Gibbs准后验进行后验平均，使用可逆跳MCMC采样变维后验。为应对漂移，引入重启变体局部化准贝叶斯更新。
Result: 导出高概率遗憾界，分解为PAC-Bayesian复杂度、腐败扰动和动态最优传输三项。在假设有界支撑、稳定潜在几何、预测映射正则性、预言可实现性、局部化重启窗口、亚线性传输动作和腐败预算下，重启预测器实现亚线性累积Wasserstein遗憾。
Conclusion: 方法无需指定参数化流模型、漂移机制或腐败过程，提供结构化潜在空间以处理不确定性、正则化和比较。理论保证依赖于多个假设，实际性能需进一步验证。

papers.title: RouteJudge: An Open Platform for Reproducible and Preference-Aware LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: We present RouteJudge, an online pairwise preference evaluation framework for LLM routing systems, with a public platform available at https://routejudge.cn. Different from model-level response evaluation, RouteJudge focuses on router-level decision quality. For each user query, multiple routing strategies independently recommend candidate models under the same model pool and budget constraints. The selected model responses are then presented to users through anonymous pairwise comparisons, and the resulting user preferences are attributed back to the routing strategies behind the compared responses. Each evaluation record stores the query, routing decisions, model responses, preference labels, cost, latency, and task metadata, enabling preference-aware, cost-aware, and task-conditioned analysis of LLM routers. To support the continuous expansion of routing methods in RouteJudge, we further release ORBIT (Optimal Routing and Budgeted Inference Toolbox), a modular and extensible toolbox that standardizes the end-to-end workflow of LLM routing. ORBIT provides unified interfaces for benchmark loading, query representation, router implementation, budget-aware evaluation, and method comparison, allowing researchers to develop and evaluate routing algorithms under consistent protocols. It also serves as the submission and integration layer for RouteJudge: researchers can implement routing methods within ORBIT, validate them on existing routing benchmarks, and submit compatible routers for online preference-based evaluation. The code of ORBIT is available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/LAMDA-ORBIT.
papers.comment: Accepted by Pluralistic Alignment Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RouteJudge，一个用于LLM路由系统的在线成对偏好评估平台，并发布ORBIT工具箱，标准化LLM路由的端到端工作流。平台通过匿名成对比较收集用户偏好，将偏好归因于路由策略，支持成本感知和任务条件分析。
Motivation: 当前缺乏对LLM路由器决策质量的系统评估框架，特别是考虑用户偏好和成本，现有评估多关注模型级响应而非路由器级。
Method: RouteJudge平台：对每个查询，多个路由策略独立推荐候选模型，匿名呈现给用户进行成对比较，偏好归因于路由策略。ORBIT工具箱：提供统一接口标准化基准加载、查询表示、路由器实现、预算评估和方法比较。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但平台支持偏好感知、成本感知和任务条件分析，并公开平台和代码。
Conclusion: RouteJudge和ORBIT为可重复和偏好感知的LLM路由提供了开放平台和工具箱，有助于路由器算法的开发与评估。

papers.title: Private Learning with Public Feature Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: We study differentially private (DP) regression in settings where each data sample includes public, non-sensitive features -- common in applications such as recommendation and advertising systems. While such label-DP or semi-sensitive-feature settings have been primarily explored in the context of classification, effective approaches for regression remain underexplored. We introduce Cond-DP, a conditioned variant of DPSGD that leverages the structure of public feature matrices to improve optimization under privacy constraints. Motivated by the observation that these public features often exhibit rapidly decaying spectra, Cond-DP incorporates a data-driven conditioning matrix to reshape the optimization landscape and accelerate convergence. We provide convergence guarantees for convex, strongly convex, and non-convex settings, and recover standard DPSGD as a special case when the conditioning matrix is the identity. We show how to construct an effective conditioning matrix for Cond-DP directly from public features, enabling provably faster convergence than DPSGD in private linear regression without incurring additional privacy cost. Empirically, Cond-DP with this conditioning matrix consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across a wide range of datasets and model architectures under label DP, demonstrating strong and robust performance in practice.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 26 pages, 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cond-DP，一种在标签差分隐私 (label DP) 下利用公共特征结构加速回归的 DPSGD 变体。通过从公共特征构建数据驱动的条件矩阵来重塑优化景观，Cond-DP 在凸、强凸和非凸设置下均提供收敛保证，并在多种数据集和模型上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私回归方法未充分利用数据中存在的公共非敏感特征，而这些特征在推荐和广告系统中常见，且其快速衰减谱特性可用于改进优化。
Method: 引入 Cond-DP，它利用公共特征矩阵构造一个条件矩阵，在每次梯度更新前对梯度进行变换，从而加速收敛；该矩阵直接从公共特征学习，不增加额外隐私成本。
Result: 在标签差分隐私设置下，Cond-DP 在线性回归中实现比标准 DPSGD 更快的理论收敛速度，并在多个数据集和模型架构上持续优于当前最优基线。
Conclusion: Cond-DP 展示了如何有效利用公共特征的结构属性来提升差分隐私回归的性能，且理论和实证结果一致支持其有效性。

papers.title: SpectralDiT: Timestep-Conditioned Spectral Residual Correction for Flow-Matching DiTs
papers.abstract_en: We propose SpectralDiT, a lightweight modification to flow-matching Diffusion Transformers that adds timestep-conditioned spectral correction to the MLP residual branch. The module decomposes each residual update into low- and high-frequency components on the patch-token grid, then learns a zero-initialized additive gate so the model initially matches the baseline DiT. On CIFAR-10 pixel-space generation, SpectralDiT improves FID from 20.78 to 19.71 at patch size 1 and reduces the radial Fourier spectrum gap. Furthermore, we scale our method to latent diffusion on ImageNet-100. With 0.6% additional theoretical FLOPs and 1.36% additional parameters, SpectralDiT improves latent flow-matching, achieving an 8.7% relative FID reduction under classifier-free guidance (CFG 2.0). All reported results are averaged over five seeds. Ablations and gate visualizations on CIFAR-10 reveal stable block-specific spectral correction patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpectralDiT，对 flow-matching Diffusion Transformers 的 MLP 残差分支增加时间步条件频谱校正。该方法将残差更新分解为低频和高频分量，并学习零初始化的加法门，使模型初始匹配基线 DiT。在 CIFAR-10 上，patch size 1 时 FID 从 20.78 降至 19.71，并缩小径向傅里叶频谱差距；在 ImageNet-100 潜扩散中，仅额外增加 0.6% 理论 FLOPs 和 1.36% 参数，即在无分类器引导（CFG 2.0）下实现 8.7% 的相对 FID 降低。所有结果均为五种子平均。消融实验和门控可视化展示了稳定的块特定频谱校正模式。
Motivation: 现有 DiT 在残差更新中未显式考虑频域特性，可能导致生成质量受限，特别是在高频细节和低频结构之间的平衡上。
Method: 提出一个轻量模块，在 MLP 残差分支中引入时间步条件频谱校正：先将残差更新在 patch-token 网格上分解为低频和高频分量，然后学习一个零初始化的加法门控信号，确保模型初始输出与基线 DiT 一致。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 像素空间生成中，patch size 1 下 FID 从 20.78 降至 19.71，并减小径向傅里叶频谱差距；在 ImageNet-100 潜扩散中，仅增加 0.6% 理论 FLOPs 和 1.36% 参数，在 CFG 2.0 下实现 8.7% 的相对 FID 降低。
Conclusion: SpectralDiT 以极小计算开销提升了 flow-matching DiT 的生成质量，且块特定频谱校正模式具有稳定性，表明该轻量方法有效。

summary_sections.conclusion: SpectralDiT 以极小计算开销提升了 flow-matching DiT 的生成质量，且块特定频谱校正模式具有稳定性，表明该轻量方法有效。

papers.title: A Neural Network Framework for Geodesic-Like Curve Computation on Parametric Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: The concept of geodesic-like curves was introduced by Chen in 2010 as a method for estimating shortest paths (geodesics) on parametric surfaces, with its convergence established theoretically. However, an efficient numerical computational framework has not yet been developed. In this paper, we propose an elegant and efficient approach for computing geodesic-like curves by leveraging deep learning and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Under the proposed framework, not only can single parametric surfaces be handled efficiently, but a broad class of complex parametric surfaces including multi-surface systems with $C^0$ or higher continuity and surfaces of revolution can also be robustly addressed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的优雅高效框架，用于计算参数曲面上的测地线类似曲线。该框架不仅能高效处理单一参数曲面，还能鲁棒地处理包括C0或更高连续性的多曲面系统以及旋转曲面在内的复杂参数曲面。
Motivation: 测地线类似曲线的概念早在2010年提出且收敛性理论已建立，但一直缺乏高效的数值计算框架。
Method: 利用深度学习与物理信息神经网络（PINNs）构建计算框架，将测地线类似曲线的求解转化为神经网络优化问题。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称框架高效且能处理多种复杂参数曲面。
Conclusion: 该框架可处理单参数曲面以及具有C0或更高连续性的多曲面系统和旋转曲面，拓展了测地线类似曲线的实际应用范围。
