papers.title: SMART: A Flexible, Interpretable, and Scalable Spatio-temporal Brain Atlas from High-Resolution Imaging Data
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SMART, a framework for learning a flexible, interpretable, and scalable spatio-temporal brain atlas from longitudinal high-resolution 3D medical images. Existing approaches to spatio-temporal atlas construction rely on black-box generative models that lack flexibility, limit interpretability, and struggle to scale to high-dimensional data. SMART addresses these challenges by learning a continuous disease-time atlas that decouples global group-wise disease dynamics from their patient-specific anatomical manifestation. Guided by anatomically inspired priors, SMART models interpretable global trajectories of regional progression along a shared disease timeline through region-specific differential equations. Global trajectories are further personalized to individual anatomies via dense diffeomorphic displacements parameterized by a flexible and scalable multi-scale Neural Cellular Automata. Evaluated on five longitudinal MRI datasets in Alzheimer's disease (ADNI-1/GO/2, OASIS-3, AIBL; > 1,300 subjects), SMART produces anatomically meaningful predictions of disease progression and achieves state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy and improved temporal consistency over adversarial and diffusion baselines. Our approach establishes a new paradigm for flexible, interpretable, and scalable modeling of spatio-temporal change in high-dimensional medical image time-series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMART框架，用于从纵向高分辨率3D医学图像中学习灵活、可解释且可扩展的时空脑图谱。SMART通过连续疾病时间图谱解耦全局疾病动态与患者特异性解剖表现，利用区域特异性微分方程建模可解释的全局进展轨迹，并通过多尺度神经细胞自动机实现个性化变形。在五个阿尔茨海默病纵向MRI数据集（ADNI-1/GO/2, OASIS-3, AIBL；超过1300名受试者）上，SMART生成解剖学上有意义的疾病进展预测，在预测准确性和时间一致性上超越对抗和扩散基线方法。
Motivation: 现有时空图谱构建方法依赖黑箱生成模型，缺乏灵活性、可解释性，且难以扩展到高维数据。
Method: SMART学习连续疾病时间图谱，通过区域特异性微分方程建模全局组水平疾病动态的轨迹，并用多尺度神经细胞自动机参数化密集微分同胚位移以实现个性化。
Result: 在五个阿尔茨海默病MRI数据集上，SMART实现了最先进的预测准确性和改进的时间一致性，优于对抗和扩散基线。
Conclusion: SMART为高维医学图像时间序列中时空变化的灵活、可解释和可扩展建模建立了新范式。

papers.title: Ensuring Trustworthy Online A/B Testing: Addressing Five Key Questions on CUPED
papers.abstract_en: A/B testing has become the gold standard for data-driven decision-making in large-scale online experimentation, providing critical guidance for feature launch, pricing optimization, and user experience enhancement. To maximize statistical sensitivity, many technology companies routinely employ Controlled-experiment Using Pre-Experiment Data (CUPED), a technique that achieves substantial variance reduction while preserving the unbiasedness of estimating the average treatment effect. Despite its widespread adoption, several critical methodological and practical nuances of CUPED remain underexplored. This paper systematically addresses five frequently encountered yet overlooked questions regarding the application of CUPED. First, we provide a comparative analysis of various post-CUPED estimators to identify the optimal adjustment specification. Second, we evaluate the validity of regression-based adjustments and delineate robust variance estimation methods tailored for such frameworks. Finally, we extend our investigation to complex but common scenarios, including multi-arm experiments and two-stage sampling designs. Our findings reveal that in these settings, naive reliance on standard variance estimators can lead to severely misleading inferences. By offering rigorous theoretical insights and extensive experimental validation, this work deepens the conceptual understanding of CUPED. Notably, the recommended methodologies have been successfully deployed and integrated into ByteDance's experimentation platform.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地回答了在线A/B测试中CUPED（利用实验前数据的控制实验）方法五个关键但常被忽视的问题，包括对比分析后CUPED估计量、回归调整的有效性及稳健方差估计，并扩展到多臂实验和两阶段抽样设计。研究发现标准方差估计在这些场景下会导致严重误导，推荐的方法已被字节跳动实验平台部署。
Motivation: CUPED被广泛用于提高统计灵敏度，但其在实践中的一些方法论和操作细节尚未被充分理解，可能导致错误推断。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验验证，比较不同后CUPED估计量，评估回归调整的方差估计方法，并针对多臂实验和两阶段抽样设计提出稳健的方差估计。
Result: 在复杂实验场景（多臂实验、两阶段抽样）中，标准方差估计会导致严重误导性推断；推荐的调整方法成功应用于字节跳动实验平台。
Conclusion: 本研究加深了对CUPED的理论理解，并为实践提供了可靠的方差估计建议，已在大型在线平台验证。

papers.title: Toward Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection in 3D Medical Images: A Batch-Based Approach Using 2D Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) is attractive for medical imaging because clinical systems must handle heterogeneous acquisition protocols, changing patient populations, and pathologies for which annotated training data may be unavailable. Most existing zero-shot anomaly detection methods are designed for 2D images, and their direct extension to 3D medical volumes is limited by the scarcity of large-scale volumetric foundation models or by the difficulty of utilizing volumetric context. We propose CS3F, a training-free batch-based framework for ZSAD in 3D medical images using 2D foundation models. Each volume is decomposed along multiple anatomical axes and encoded slice-wise by a 2D vision transformer. These are then converted into localized volumetric tokens by pooling neighboring slice features. Anomaly scores are obtained from cross-subject mutual similarity: tokens that lack close analogues in other subjects are assigned higher anomaly scores. To reduce the attenuation of focal lesion signals caused by depth pooling, we introduce a coarse-to-fine tokenization strategy that enables fine-resolution volumetric scoring without exhaustive matching. CS3F is evaluated on brain MRI across metastases, glioma, and stroke, as well as validated on lung CT to test generalizability beyond atlas-aligned brain MRI. The results show that frozen 2D foundation models can support anomaly localization in 3D medical images, and that the benefit of fine tokenization depends strongly on lesion contrast and imaging modality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CS3F，一种无需训练的批量处理框架，利用2D基础模型实现3D医学图像的零样本异常检测。它将3D体积沿多个解剖轴分解，逐切片编码，并通过跨被试相似性计算异常分数。在脑MRI（转移瘤、胶质瘤、卒中）和肺CT上验证，表明冻结的2D基础模型可支持3D异常定位，且精细分词效果取决于病灶对比度和成像模态。
Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测方法多针对2D图像，直接扩展到3D医学体积受限于大规模3D基础模型稀缺或难以利用体积上下文。
Method: 将每个体积沿多个解剖轴分解，用2D视觉Transformer逐切片编码，池化相邻切片特征得到局部体积标记，通过跨被试互相似性分配异常分数，并引入粗到细的分词策略减少深度池化导致的病灶信号衰减。
Result: 在脑MRI（转移瘤、胶质瘤、卒中）和肺CT数据集上评估，表明冻结的2D基础模型能有效定位3D异常，且精细分词对高对比度病变更有用。
Conclusion: CS3F验证了无训练条件下2D基础模型在3D医学异常检测中的潜力，但其性能高度依赖于病灶对比度和成像模态。

papers.title: Generating Natural and Expressive Robot Gestures through Iterative Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Expressive gestures are essential for natural and effective communication, complementing speech when verbal cues alone are insufficient (e.g., pointing). For social robots such as the humanoid Pepper, producing natural and expressive movements is critical for improving human-robot interaction (HRI) and long-term acceptance. However, generating gestures remains challenging due to reliance on expert-authored animations, resulting in rigid behaviors that are impractical for dynamic and diverse environments. Alternatively, machine learning approaches often struggle to capture perceived naturalness, becoming increasingly challenging with more degrees of freedom. Consequently, producing expressive robot gestures requires a system that can adapt to the environment while adhering to social norms and physical constraints. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable dynamic code generation, offering new opportunities for runtime gesture synthesis from natural language. In this paper, we integrate ChatGPT into the humanoid robot Pepper to generate co-speech gestures aligned with conversational output. While this baseline enables flexible gesture generation, the resulting motions are often perceived as stiff and unnatural. To address this limitation, we introduce an iterative reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) system that finetunes gesture generation based on user evaluations, leveraging an iterative user study to compare Pepper's generated gestures. Our results show that RLHF improved the LLM's co-speech generative capabilities, producing more expressive, relevant and fluid movements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对社交机器人Pepper的共语手势生成问题，提出结合大语言模型（LLM）与迭代人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）的框架。先使用ChatGPT根据自然语言生成手势代码，再通过用户反馈微调，使手势更自然、表达力更强。实验表明RLHF显著提升手势的流畅性、相关性和表现力。
Motivation: 现有机器人手势生成依赖专家预定义动画，僵硬且难以适应动态环境；机器学习方法难以捕捉自然感。需要一种能结合社交规范与物理约束的适应性手势生成方法。
Method: 将ChatGPT集成到Pepper机器人中，根据对话输出动态生成共语手势代码；然后引入迭代RLHF系统，基于用户评估微调手势生成，通过迭代用户研究比较改进效果。
Result: RLHF改进后，LLM生成的共语手势在表达力、相关性和流畅性上均优于基线。
Conclusion: LLM结合RLHF能有效提升社交机器人手势的自然度与表现力，为自适应人机交互提供了新途径。

papers.title: What Must Generalist Agents Remember?
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a formal account of what generalist agents must store in memory in order to act near-optimally across multiple environments and goals. It shows that when two domains share an observational bottleneck but require incompatible optimal actions, any uniformly near-optimal policy must induce distinct memory distributions at that bottleneck. The result yields a separation theorem: sufficiently successful agents cannot rely only on current state observations, but must preserve domain-relevant information in memory. The paper further shows that if an agent's memory contains enough information to estimate values for related goals, then that memory can be used to approximately reconstruct the agent's local transition dynamics. Together, these results characterize memory as the substrate that supports domain disambiguation, transition-model reconstruction, and planning for generalist agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从形式化角度探讨通用智能体（generalist agents）在多个环境和目标下需要记忆什么才能实现近似最优行为。证明当两个领域存在观测瓶颈但需要不相容的最优动作时，任何统一近似最优策略必须在瓶颈处引发不同的记忆分布，从而得出分离定理：足够成功的智能体不能仅依赖当前状态观测，必须在记忆中保留领域相关信息。进一步显示，若记忆包含足够信息以估计相关目标的值，则可近似重建局部转移动力学。这些结果将记忆刻画为支持领域区分、转移模型重建和规划的基石。
Motivation: 通用智能体需在多样环境中表现良好，但现有理论对记忆的必要性和作用缺乏形式化理解。
Method: 通过理论分析和数学证明，从观测瓶颈和最优动作不相容性出发，推导记忆的必要性；并利用值函数信息重建转移动力学。
Result: 给出了分离定理：均匀近似最优策略必须在观测瓶颈处产生不同记忆分布；记忆若含足够值信息，可近似重建局部转移动力学。
Conclusion: 记忆是通用智能体实现领域区分、模型重建与规划的关键；当前形式化框架阐明了记忆在跨环境任务中的核心作用。

summary_sections.motivation: 通用智能体需在多样环境中表现良好，但现有理论对记忆的必要性和作用缺乏形式化理解。
summary_sections.method: 通过理论分析和数学证明，从观测瓶颈和最优动作不相容性出发，推导记忆的必要性；并利用值函数信息重建转移动力学。
summary_sections.result: 给出了分离定理：均匀近似最优策略必须在观测瓶颈处产生不同记忆分布；记忆若含足够值信息，可近似重建局部转移动力学。
summary_sections.conclusion: 记忆是通用智能体实现领域区分、模型重建与规划的关键；当前形式化框架阐明了记忆在跨环境任务中的核心作用。

papers.title: Point-Cloud-Assistant Localized Statistical Channel Prediction by Tangent Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate, site-specific channel information is crucial for optimizing next-generation wireless networks. Among various approaches, localized statistical channel modeling (LSCM), which models the channel multipath angular power spectrum (APS) from the reference signal received power (RSRP) measurement, has emerged as a state-of-the-art method tailored for efficient network optimization. However, despite its effectiveness, LSCM cannot predict APS at the vast majority of locations where no measurements are available, which significantly restricts its applicability in large-scale, real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we present \emph{point-cloud-assisted tangent Gaussian splatting} (PC-TGS), the first framework to \emph{extrapolate} APS to unmeasured outdoor grids by integrating sparse radio measurements with dense LiDAR-based geometry. PC-TGS represents environmental scatterers as anisotropic 3D Gaussians, initialized and refined through a relaxed-mean reparameterization of the raw point cloud. A tangent-plane projection accurately maps each Gaussian into the local angular domain, while a depth-aware electromagnetic splatting process aggregates their contributions. To ensure practical deployment, we derive a closed-form Gaussian-weighted average (GWA) for APS bin integration and provide a provable error bound. { Evaluations on a LiDAR-scanned city-scale dataset (5M points, 6,310 RSRP samples) demonstrate that PC-TGS achieves better APS and RSRP prediction performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines and faster inference time for APS extrapolation task. These results highlight the potential of PC-TGS to enable geometry-aware and data-efficient channel prediction in large-scale wireless digital twins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出点云辅助切面高斯溅射（PC-TGS）框架，首次利用稀疏无线电测量与密集LiDAR几何信息外推未测量位置的局部角度功率谱（APS）。PC-TGS将环境散射体表示为各向异性3D高斯，通过切面投影和深度感知电磁溅射聚合，并给出闭式高斯加权平均（GWA）和可证明误差界。在包含5M点云和6310个RSRP样本的城市规模数据集上，PC-TGS在APS外推任务中预测性能优于现有基线，且推理速度更快。
Motivation: 现有局部统计信道模型（LSCM）虽能基于RSRP测量建模APS，但无法预测无测量位置的信道特性，严重限制其在真实大规模场景中的适用性。
Method: PC-TGS：通过松弛均值重参数化从原始点云初始化各向异性3D高斯，经切面投影映射到局部角域，再通过深度感知电磁溅射聚合高斯贡献；推导了APS bin积分的闭式高斯加权平均（GWA）和误差界。
Result: 在LiDAR扫描的城市级数据集（5M点、6310 RSRP样本）上，PC-TGS在APS和RSRP预测方面优于最先进基线，且外推推理时间更快。
Conclusion: PC-TGS展示了利用几何信息实现数据高效、大规模无线数字孪生信道预测的潜力，但摘要未讨论其在非视距或动态场景下的泛化性。

papers.title: SWE-Future: Forecast-Conditioned Data Synthesis for Future-Oriented Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Realistic coding-agent benchmarks often replay public GitHub issues and pull requests, making them vulnerable to overlap with model pretraining, fine-tuning, synthetic-data generation, or benchmark-driven model selection. Fully synthetic tasks avoid direct historical replay, but can drift away from real repository needs. We propose SWE-Future, a forecast-conditioned data synthesis method for future-oriented coding tasks. Given a forecast snapshot at time $T_0$, the method uses only pre-$T_0$ repository evidence to forecast future feature implementation/enhancement, bugfix, and refactor task families. We first validate this forecasting step retrospectively: after forecasts are fixed, later pull requests are used only to measure whether the predicted task families match future repository work. In an 80-repository study, the forecaster achieves 58.1\% future-work relevance under the main semantic matching metric. We then use validated forecast families as conditioning signals to synthesize a 200-task coding-agent dataset across 61 repositories from a task-generation snapshot, rather than replaying the later pull requests used for validation. SWE-Future shows that repository-evolution forecasts can guide realistic, future-oriented coding-task synthesis while reducing direct dependence on historical pull-request replay.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SWE-Future，一种基于预测条件的数据合成方法，用于生成面向未来的软件工程智能体任务。方法利用仓库历史证据预测未来的任务类别（新功能、bug修复、重构），并在80个仓库的回顾性验证中达到58.1%的未来工作相关性。基于预测的任务家族合成了200个任务的编码智能体数据集，减少对历史pull request的直接依赖。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体基准往往回放公开GitHub issue和PR，导致与模型预训练重叠；完全合成的任务又可能偏离真实仓库需求。需要一种既能避免历史回放又能保持真实性的数据合成方法。
Method: 提出预测条件的数据合成（SWE-Future）：在时间T0利用T0之前的仓库证据预测未来任务类别（功能实现/增强、bug修复、重构），然后以验证后的预测类别作为条件合成编码智能体任务数据集。
Result: 在80个仓库的回顾性验证中，预测器在主要语义匹配指标上达到58.1%的未来工作相关性。基于预测合成了200个任务的数据集，涉及61个仓库。
Conclusion: 仓库演化预测可以指导面向未来且真实的编码任务合成，同时减少对历史pull request回放的直接依赖。局限包括预测精度仍有提升空间。

papers.title: Low-Cost Neuromorphic Fall Detection Using Synthetic Event Data and Hybrid SNNs
papers.abstract_en: This work presents the development of hybrid models that integrate spiking neural networks (SNNs) with components of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to learn from simulated event-based camera data (Dynamic Vision Sensor, DVS) generated from conventional smartphone videos. Aimed primarily at human fall detection, the approach leverages the energy efficiency and spatio-temporal processing capabilities of SNNs by converting video frames into event-based data. The proposed models are evaluated through simulations on multiple datasets, comparing their performance to that of traditional machine learning models. Results demonstrate significant gains in efficiency without sacrificing accuracy, underscoring the potential of combining SNNs and DVS technology for complex tasks in real-world environments.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 6 figures, presented at ICONS 2025 during the Poster Session, but not published
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种低成本神经形态跌倒检测方法，利用合成事件数据（从智能手机视频转换）和混合SNN-CNN模型。在多个数据集上的仿真表明，该方法在保持精度的同时显著提升了计算效率。
Motivation: 传统跌倒检测方法能耗高，且基于帧的视觉处理在效率上存在瓶颈。SNN和事件相机（DVS）具有低功耗和时空处理优势，但事件数据获取困难。本文旨在通过合成事件数据克服这一限制。
Method: 将常规智能手机视频帧转换为模拟事件相机数据，然后训练结合SNN和CNN的混合模型进行跌倒检测。
Result: 仿真实验显示，该方法与传统机器学习模型相比，在精度不损失的情况下取得了显著的效率提升。
Conclusion: 混合SNN-CNN模型结合合成事件数据可有效实现低成本、低功耗的跌倒检测，具有实际应用潜力。

papers.title: Two-Phase Bilevel Search for the Moving-Target Traveling Salesman Problem with Moving Obstacles
papers.abstract_en: The Moving-Target Traveling Salesman Problem (MT-TSP) seeks a minimum cost trajectory for an agent that departs from a static depot, visits a set of moving targets, each within one of their assigned time windows, and returns to the depot. In this article, we study the Moving-Target Traveling Salesman Problem with Moving Obstacles (MT-TSP-MO), a generalization of the MT-TSP where the agent trajectory must avoid moving obstacles. We present a Mixed-Integer Conic Programming (MICP) formulation that can be solved using off-the-shelf solvers, as well as a fast and scalable Two-Phase Bilevel Search (TPBS) algorithm that computes high-quality feasible solutions for the problem. We evaluate our approaches against an existing baseline algorithm on a broad range of problem instances with up to 40 targets and 40 obstacles. The results demonstrate that both the proposed methods significantly outperform the baseline with respect to success rates, solution costs, and computation time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对带移动障碍物的移动目标旅行商问题（MT-TSP-MO），提出混合整数锥规划（MICP）公式和一种快速可扩展的两阶段双层搜索（TPBS）算法。实验表明，在多达40个目标和40个障碍物的实例上，两种方法在成功率、解质量和计算时间上均显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有移动目标旅行商问题（MT-TSP）研究未考虑移动障碍物，而实际应用中障碍物的存在增加了路径规划的复杂性，需要通用的求解方法。
Method: 提出混合整数锥规划（MICP）精确公式，以及一种两阶段双层搜索（TPBS）启发式算法，通过分层搜索快速生成高质量可行解。
Result: 在最多40个目标和40个障碍物的实例上，MICP和TPBS在成功率、解成本和计算时间上均显著优于现有基线算法。
Conclusion: 所提方法能有效求解带移动障碍物的MT-TSP问题，且TPBS算法在可扩展性和解质量上具有优势。

papers.title: TimeLAVA: Learning-Agnostic Data Valuation for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Data valuation quantifies the intrinsic quality of individual samples to enable principled data curation, quality control, and robust learning. For time series in critical domains such as healthcare, finance, and industrial monitoring, effective valuation methods are essential yet fundamentally lacking. Existing approaches are either model-dependent, limiting their generalizability, or designed for i.i.d. data and thus fail to capture temporal dependencies, multi-scale patterns, and non-stationary dynamics inherent to sequential data. We introduce TimeLAVA, a learning-agnostic framework that values temporal segments by their marginal contribution to minimizing distributional discrepancy between evaluated and reference data. At its core is a novel Selective Wavelet-based Wasserstein discrepancy combining multi-scale wavelet transforms for temporal localization with unbalanced optimal transport for robustness to distributional shifts. Segment values are efficiently computed via sensitivity analysis without requiring model training and aggregated into point-wise scores. We provide theoretical guarantees linking valuation to model-agnostic generalization and prove bounded sensitivity to outlier contamination. Extensive experiments across anomaly detection, data pruning, and label noise detection demonstrate that TimeLAVA produces significantly more informative value scores than existing methods on diverse real-world datasets.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TimeLAVA，一个学习无关的时间序列数据估值框架，通过衡量时间片段在最小化评估数据与参考数据分布差异中的边际贡献来评估数据质量。其核心是结合多尺度小波变换（用于时间定位）和不平衡最优传输（用于鲁棒应对分布偏移）的选择性小波Wasserstein差异。片段值通过敏感性分析高效计算，无需模型训练，并可聚合为点级分数。理论部分提供了与模型无关泛化能力的联系，并证明了估值对异常值污染的有限敏感性。在异常检测、数据修剪和标签噪声检测等任务上的实验表明，TimeLAVA在多个真实数据集上比现有方法产生更具信息量的价值分数。
Motivation: 现有数据估值方法要么依赖特定模型从而限制泛化性，要么针对独立同分布数据设计，无法捕捉时间序列固有的时间依赖性、多尺度模式和非平稳动态。医疗、金融和工业监控等关键领域缺乏有效的时序数据估值方法。
Method: 提出TimeLAVA框架，通过选择性小波Wasserstein差异结合多尺度小波变换与不平衡最优传输，计算每个时间片段对降低分布差异的边际贡献，并利用敏感性分析高效计算估值，无需模型训练。
Result: 在异常检测、数据修剪和标签噪声检测任务上，TimeLAVA在多个真实数据集上比现有方法产生更具信息量的价值分数。理论证明该估值与模型无关的泛化能力有联系，并对异常值污染具有有限敏感性。
Conclusion: TimeLAVA为时间序列提供了一种学习无关、理论有保障的数据估值方法，适用于数据筛选、质量控制等场景。

papers.title: Graph Grounded Cross Attention Transformer Neural Network for Structurally Constrained Full Event Sequence Generation in Predictive Process Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Structurally constrained event sequence generation remains challenging because generated paths must preserve transition feasibility, temporal order, termination, and attribute consistency. In predictive process monitoring (PPM), this challenge appears as full event sequence generation, whereas existing work mainly addresses component tasks such as next activity, remaining time, outcome, and attribute prediction. This paper proposes the Graph Grounded Cross Attention Transformer Neural Network (GGATN) for this unified PPM task. GGATN uses a global process graph as structured activity memory, contextualizes sequence positions through Transformer self attention, and injects process topology through graph grounded cross attention. Unlike autoregressive decoding, GGATN generates activities, timestamps, length, and event level and sequence level attributes in a single pass, followed by Viterbi style graph constrained decoding for feasible paths and explicit termination. Experiments on six benchmark event logs show more reliable generation quality than local instruction prompted LLM baselines. GGATN achieves strong performance on sequence similarity, Damerau Levenshtein similarity, bigram based control flow similarity, and duration distribution, while maintaining zero hallucinated activities and zero sequence level attribute inconsistency. Ablation analyses confirm the global graph encoder as a stable structural prior. Interpretability analyses show how graph structure, sequence context, feedback refinement, and constrained decoding shape generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预测过程监控（PPM）中结构约束的全事件序列生成问题，提出图基交叉注意力变换网络（GGATN）。GGATN利用全局过程图作为结构记忆，通过自注意力编码序列位置，并通过图基交叉注意力注入流程拓扑。与自回归解码不同，GGATN在单次前向中生成活动、时间戳、长度及事件级和序列级属性，随后采用维特比风格图约束解码确保路径可行和显式终止。在六个基准事件日志上的实验表明，GGATN在序列相似性、Damerau-Levenshtein相似性、二元语法控制流相似性和持续时间分布方面优于局部指令提示的LLM基线，且零幻觉活动和零序列级属性不一致。消融实验确认全局图编码器作为稳定结构先验，可解释性分析揭示了图结构、序列上下文、反馈细化和约束解码的作用。
Motivation: 结构约束的事件序列生成需要保持转移可行性、时间顺序、终止性和属性一致性，但现有PPM工作主要解决子任务（如下一活动、剩余时间、结果和属性预测），缺乏统一的完整序列生成方法。
Method: 提出图基交叉注意力变换网络（GGATN），包含全局过程图编码器、序列位置自注意力、图基交叉注意力注入拓扑，以及单次前向生成后接维特比风格图约束解码，同时生成活动、时间戳、长度和多种属性。
Result: 在六个基准事件日志上，GGATN在序列相似性、Damerau-Levenshtein相似性、二元语法控制流相似性和持续时间分布方面优于局部指令提示的LLM基线，且达到零幻觉活动和零序列级属性不一致。
Conclusion: 全局图编码器提供稳定的结构先验，结合图基交叉注意力和约束解码可提升生成质量和可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Clinically Aligned Geometry Constraints for Robust IVUS Vessel Boundary Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) lumen and external elastic membrane (EEM) segmentation is important for quantitative coronary plaque burden assessment. Errors in lumen or EEM delineation directly propagate to plaque area, plaque burden and geometric measurements. However, standard methods prioritising overlap scores often suffer from boundary drift and topology errors, leading to inaccurate clinical measurements. We present GeoCat, a geometry-consistent network that processes 5-frame IVUS clips using dual Cartesian-polar encoders with cross-domain attention and temporal fusion. A differentiable geometry consistency loss directly supervises clinically relevant descriptors including diameters, orientations, and cross-sectional areas. The model is trained on 12,242 annotated frames from 146 patients acquired with two commercial IVUS systems. We evaluate performance using both segmentation accuracy and plaque-relevant clinical metrics, including Dice/IoU, boundary measures(95HD (mm), ASSD), topology violation rate, and clinical geometry errors (dmax/dmin, angles, and areas). On our dataset, GeoCat achieves a Dice of 0.93, reduces 95HD to 0.14 mm, and lowers topology violations to 1.0%. Importantly, it significantly improves geometric fidelity, yielding diameter errors of 0.13-0.16 mm and angular errors of ~8 degrees, supporting reliable plaque burden quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoCat，一种几何一致性网络，用于IVUS血管边界分割。该网络处理5帧IVUS片段，采用双笛卡尔-极坐标编码器、跨域注意力和时间融合，并通过可微几何一致性损失直接监督直径、方向和面积等临床指标。在146名患者的12,242帧数据上，GeoCat取得Dice 0.93、95% Hausdorff距离0.14 mm、拓扑违规率1.0%，直径误差0.13-0.16 mm，角度误差约8度。
Motivation: IVUS管腔和外弹性膜分割中的边界漂移和拓扑错误会导致斑块负担和几何测量不准确。标准方法仅优化重叠分数，忽略了临床相关的几何一致性约束。
Method: 提出GeoCat网络，使用双笛卡尔-极坐标编码器提取特征，结合跨域注意力机制和时间融合处理5帧IVUS片段。通过可微几何一致性损失直接监督直径、方向和横截面积等临床描述符。
Result: 在包含12,242帧来自146名患者的测试集上，GeoCat实现Dice 0.93、95HD 0.14 mm、拓扑违规率1.0%，直径误差0.13-0.16 mm，角度误差约8度。
Conclusion: GeoCat通过几何一致性约束显著提升了IVUS分割的几何保真度，为可靠的斑块负担量化提供了支持。

papers.title: Rethinking the Pointer Loss in Table Structure Recognition: Geometry-Aware Pointer Loss for Spatial Locality
papers.abstract_en: Table Structure Recognition (TSR) using a pointer network achieves impressive results by predicting HTML sequences while aligning tags to detected text (or cell) regions. However, our analysis reveals that when pointer networks fail, 79.6% of errors occur between spatially adjacent cells (Manhattan distance <= 2). Despite this, standard cross-entropy loss weights all negative candidates equally. In this work, we propose Geometry-Aware Pointer (GAP) Loss, which reweights the cross-entropy objective based on spatial proximity to ground truth. By applying inverse distance weighting, GAP focuses gradient flow where the model struggles most: immediate neighbors receive stronger gradients than distant cells. Our approach requires only a straightforward modification to the loss computation, maintaining the same model architecture with zero additional inference cost. Extensive experiments on PubTabNet and SynthTabNet demonstrate that GAP consistently reduces adjacent-cell errors, achieving new state-of-the-art performance. Our findings suggest that incorporating geometric inductive biases at the loss level provides a simple yet effective approach to robust TSR. Our code is available at https://github.com/teamreboott/GAP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表格结构识别（TSR）中指针网络的错误分析，发现79.6%的错误发生在空间相邻的单元格之间。为此提出几何感知指针损失（GAP Loss），通过基于空间邻近度的逆距离加权重新调整交叉熵目标，使相邻单元格获得更强梯度。该方法仅需修改损失函数，不增加推理成本，在PubTabNet和SynthTabNet上达到新的最高性能。
Motivation: 现有TSR指针网络使用标准交叉熵损失对所有负候选样本一视同仁，但实际错误主要集中于空间相邻单元格，导致模型难以区分局部混淆。
Method: 提出几何感知指针损失（GAP Loss），在交叉熵损失中引入基于曼哈顿距离的逆距离权重，使得与真实标签空间距离越近的负候选样本获得更大的梯度信号。
Result: 在PubTabNet和SynthTabNet上持续减少相邻单元格错误，取得新的最高性能（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: 在损失层面融入几何归纳偏置是一种简单有效的TSR鲁棒性提升方法，且不改变模型架构或增加推理开销。

papers.title: Morpheus: A Morphology-Aware Neural Tokenizer and Word Embedder for Turkish
papers.abstract_en: Turkish is agglutinative: meaning is carried by morphemes, yet the subword tokenizers that drive modern language models split words by corpus statistics, fragmenting semantically loaded suffixes and -- in the case of WordPiece and rule-based analyzers -- failing to decode their output back to the original text. This paper presents \textbf{Morpheus}, a neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish that is at once a lossless, morphology-aware tokenizer and a word-embedding producer. A differentiable Poisson-binomial dynamic program turns per-character boundary probabilities into soft morpheme memberships during training and exact segments at inference, with no string normalization, so $\mathrm{decode}(\mathrm{encode}(w)) = w$ holds by construction. Because the model is neural, the same forward pass that tokenizes also emits a structured word embedding. Among reversible tokenizers -- the only ones valid for generation -- Morpheus attains the lowest bits-per-character ($1.425$), roughly doubles the gold morphological alignment of the subword family (MorphScore macro-F1 $0.61$ vs.\ ${\sim}0.32$), and uses ${\sim}19\%$ less GPU memory than 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizers. As an embedder, frozen Morpheus vectors lead on lexical retrieval (root-family MAP $0.85$) and same-root verification (ROC-AUC $1.00$), surpassing the multilingual retriever BGE-M3 and BERTurk; on context- and inflection-dependent tasks (NER, case/number probing) the heavier contextual encoders remain ahead -- a trade-off we attribute to Morpheus's root-centric geometry. Code: https://github.com/lonewolf-rd/TurkishMorpheus; model: https://huggingface.co/lonewolflab/Morpheus-TR-50K; interactive demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/lonewolflab/morpheus-tr-demo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Morpheus，一个针对土耳其语的神经形态感知分词器与词嵌入模型。它使用可微的泊松-二项动态规划将字符级边界概率转换为软形态成分，推理时产生无损分段，保证encode-decode可逆。在可逆分词器中达到了最低的bits-per-character（1.425），形态对齐的Macro-F1约为0.61，相比子词方法提升约一倍，且GPU内存使用减少约19%。作为嵌入器，在词汇检索和同根验证任务上超越多语言检索模型BGE-M3和BERTurk，但在上下文依赖任务（如NER）上不如上下文编码器。
Motivation: 土耳其语是黏着语，语义由语素承载，但现有子词分词器基于语料统计分割，会破坏带语义的后缀，且WordPiece等规则解析器无法解码回原文。论文旨在设计一种无损、形态感知的分词器和词嵌入模型。
Method: 提出Morpheus，一个神经语素边界模型。通过可微的泊松-二项动态规划，在训练时输出软语素隶属度，推理时输出确切分段，不进行字符串归一化，确保decode(encode(w)) = w成立。同一前向传播同时输出结构化词嵌入。
Result: 在可逆分词器中，Morpheus达到最低的bits-per-character（1.425）；形态对齐的Macro-F1为0.61，约为子词方法的0.32的两倍；GPU内存使用比64K词汇子词分词器少约19%。作为嵌入器，在词汇检索（root-family MAP 0.85）和同根验证（ROC-AUC 1.00）上超越BGE-M3和BERTurk，但在NER等上下文依赖任务上不如更重的上下文编码器。
Conclusion: Morpheus是一种无损、形态感知的土耳其语分词器和词嵌入器，在可逆性和形态对齐上显著优于子词方法，在词汇级任务上表现突出，但上下文依赖任务仍需借助上下文编码器。作者归因于Morpheus的以词根为中心的几何结构。

papers.title: Trainable Photonic Measurement for Physics-Informed PDE Learning
papers.abstract_en: Photonic quantum machine learning offers a route to trainable physical representations built from phase, interference and measurement. However, its role in scientific machine learning remains largely unexplored. Physics-informed neural fields provide a natural setting, because differential equations require trial spaces that preserve phase, frequency and derivative structure. Here we introduce a photonic quantum neural field in which coordinates become trainable optical phases, are mixed by multi-photon Fock-space interference and are decoded from photon-number measurements. The photonic circuit is optimized as the neural-field representation itself, not as a fixed feature map or hardware accelerator. Photonic measurement is therefore a trainable representation on which the physics-informed residual is minimized. Across seven elliptic, wave, nonlinear dispersive and inverse PDE benchmarks, we observe a phase-complexity transition: classical coordinate and Fourier-feature networks suffice in smooth regimes, whereas the photonic field is most accurate when residual derivatives amplify phase mismatch. In the hardest regimes it gives the lowest errors, with margins reaching an order of magnitude and about one quarter of the trainable parameters of classical baselines. Frozen and shuffled controls, together with noise stress tests, attribute this gain to learned interference and stable Fock-probability readout under compound perturbations. These results identify photonic quantum measurement as a representation-learning principle for scientific machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种光子量子神经场（photonic quantum neural field），将坐标编码为可训练的光学相位，通过多光子Fock空间干涉混合，并从光子数测量中解码。该光路作为神经场表示本身进行优化，而非固定的特征映射或硬件加速器，并在物理信息残差最小化中作为可训练测量表示。在七个椭圆、波动、非线性色散和反问题PDE基准上，发现相位复杂度转变：光滑区域中经典坐标和傅里叶特征网络足够，而光子场在残差导数放大相位失配时最准确，在困难区域误差最低，可达一个数量级，且仅需约经典基线四分之一的训练参数。冻结和打乱控制以及噪声压力测试表明，增益来自学习到的干涉和复合扰动下稳定的Fock概率读出。这些结果将光子量子测量确立为科学机器学习中表示学习的一种原理。
Motivation: 光子量子机器学习在科学机器学习中的作用尚未充分探索，物理信息神经场需要保持相位、频率和导数结构的试验空间，而现有经典方法在困难PDE区域可能不够精确。
Method: 引入光子量子神经场：坐标变为可训练光学相位，经多光子Fock空间干涉混合，从光子数测量解码；光路作为神经场表示优化，物理信息残差最小化直接作用于可训练测量表示。
Result: 在七个PDE基准上，光子场在困难区域误差最低，可达一个数量级优势，且仅用约经典基线四分之一的训练参数；冻结/打乱控制和噪声测试验证了干涉学习和Fock概率读出的稳定性。
Conclusion: 光子量子测量可作为科学机器学习中一种有效的表示学习原理，特别适用于导数放大相位失配的困难PDE区域。

papers.title: PEFT-MedSAM: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Medical Foundation Models for Explainable Skin Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Automated segmentation of skin lesions using deep learning models for dermoscopic images can be very helpful in finding melanomas earlier than they would normally be detected. However, most deep learning methods available do not perform well. The aim of this paper is to present a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method called PEFT-MedSAM for adapting the Medical Segment Anything Model (MedSAM) to automatically segment dermoscopic skin lesions. The PEFT-MedSAM method uses only the lightweight mask decoder for training the model while keeping the pre-trained image encoder and prompt encoder frozen. The experiments performed on the ISIC 2018 benchmark dataset shows that PEFT-MedSAM obtains a dice coefficient of .9411 and an intersection over union value of .8918 when compared to both a fully trained U-Net baseline (.8715 dice coefficient) and zero-shot MedSAM inference (.8997 dice coefficient). The external validation of the model using PH2 dataset shows .9467 dice coefficient with +/- .0310 standard deviation. Supportive evidence for these claims include a p-value less than .0001 for Wilcoxon signed rank tests comparing the two datasets and bootstrap-estimated 95% confidence intervals of [.9364,.9447] that represent the estimated range of possible values for the average dice coefficient obtained by repeating the test. To increase clinical trustworthiness, we used Grad-CAM explainability along with a pointing game based evaluation methodology to evaluate the CNN baseline model on the validation set. The results showed that we had an accuracy rate of 98.27% on the validation set of 519 images and confirmed that the model classified regions containing skin lesions.

papers.title: Contextualizing Biological Language Models across Modalities via Logit-Space Contrastive Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained biological language models expose per-token probability distributions through masked-token prediction, providing the likelihood interface central to sequence design, variant scoring, and mechanistic interpretation. Yet these distributions are learned from broad unlabeled corpora and are not naturally conditioned on task-specific biological contexts such as interaction partners, cellular environments, or therapeutic interventions. Existing contextual matching methods often distort this interface through pooled embeddings, contrastive latent spaces, or task-specific prediction heads. We introduce LOGICA (Logit-space Contrastive Alignment), a framework for context-conditioned prediction that performs contrastive learning directly in output-logit space. Using gated cross-modal adapters compatible with each model's native token head, LOGICA preserves the pretrained likelihood interface and converts contextualized token log-likelihoods into matching scores. Alignment is defined through context-sensitive token probabilities rather than proximity in a shared embedding space, enabling learning from sparse paired data across models with distinct vocabularies, without a shared tokenizer or decoder. LOGICA is particularly effective for mutation-local variant ranking, where comparisons reduce to context-conditioned likelihoods of mutant tokens at perturbed sites. Across protein--ligand binding, TCR--peptide activity, and drug-conditioned resistance prediction, LOGICA improves over prior state-of-the-art methods, including matched latent-contrastive and conditional MLM baselines, while retaining a token-level interface for interpretation and generation. On held-out-gene single-mutation drug-resistance prediction, LOGICA improves AUC from near-random latent-space baselines of $\sim$0.55 to $\sim$0.65.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOGICA（Logit-space Contrastive Alignment）框架，直接在输出 logit 空间进行对比学习，通过门控跨模态适配器保留预训练语言模型的似然接口，实现上下文条件预测。在蛋白质-配体结合、TCR-肽活性、药物耐药预测等任务上，LOGICA 优于基于潜在空间对比和条件 MLM 的现有方法，且保持 token 级接口用于解释和生成。
Motivation: 现有预训练生物语言模型的 token 概率分布未针对特定生物上下文（如相互作用伙伴、细胞环境）进行条件化，而现有上下文匹配方法（如池化嵌入、对比潜在空间或任务特定预测头）会扭曲原始似然接口，影响序列设计和变异评分的可靠性。
Method: 提出 LOGICA，在输出 logit 空间进行对比学习，使用门控跨模态适配器兼容不同模型的原生 token 头，将上下文化的 token 对数似然转换为匹配分数，无需共享 tokenizer 或解码器，能从稀疏配对数据中学习。
Result: 在蛋白质-配体结合、TCR-肽活性、药物条件耐药预测任务上，LOGICA 优于先前最先进方法；在保留基因单突变药物耐药预测中，AUC 从约 0.55 提升至约 0.65。
Conclusion: LOGICA 在跨模态、跨模型场景下有效学习上下文条件预测，同时保留 token 级似然接口，适用于序列设计和机制解释。

papers.title: UniTemp: Unlocking Video Generation in Any Temporal Order via Bidirectional Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a promising approach for long video generation, achieving strong performance in streaming settings. However, existing methods are restricted to forward temporal generation, whereas practical video creation often requires flexible generation order, e.g., conditioning on future context to extend backward, or on both past and future context for inbetween generation. We bridge this gap by training an autoregressive model that supports generation in arbitrary temporal directions. A key technical challenge arises from the Causal 3D VAE widely used in video diffusion models, which encodes latents strictly conditioned on past context. While suited for forward generation, this causal structure causes inter-block discontinuities when generation proceeds backward. To address this, we introduce blockwise anchor latents, a set of auxiliary latents that restore the missing past context at block boundaries during backward generation. Built on this design, we propose UniTemp, a bidirectional distillation framework that trains a single autoregressive student model for any-direction video generation. At inference time, UniTemp conditions on arbitrary past and/or future frames, improving controllability for both bidirectional and inbetween generation. Experiments show that UniTemp maintains competitive performance on short and long video generation compared to forward-only methods, while enabling diverse workflows such as bidirectional video extension, inbetween generation, looping video generation, scene transition, and visual story generation. Project website: https://lzhangbj.github.io/projects/unitemp/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniTemp，一个双向蒸馏框架，用于训练支持任意时间方向视频生成的自回归模型。通过引入块状锚点潜在变量解决因果3D VAE在逆向生成时的块间不连续问题，UniTemp能够基于过去和/或未来帧进行条件生成，实现双向视频扩展、中间帧生成、循环视频生成等多种工作流。实验显示其在短和长视频生成上与纯前向方法性能相当。
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型仅限于前向生成，而实际视频创作常需要灵活生成顺序，如基于未来帧逆向扩展或基于上下文插帧。
Method: 提出块状锚点潜在变量（blockwise anchor latents）恢复因果3D VAE在逆向生成时缺失的过去上下文，并基于此设计双向蒸馏框架，训练单个自回归学生模型支持任意方向视频生成。
Result: 在短和长视频生成任务上，UniTemp与前向方法性能相当；支持双向扩展、插帧、循环、场景转换和视觉故事生成等多种工作流。
Conclusion: UniTemp通过双向蒸馏实现了灵活的时间顺序视频生成，扩展了自回归模型的实用性，但摘要未提及在降水或天气领域的应用。

papers.title: TW-LegalBench: Measuring Taiwanese Legal Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across diverse tasks, yet their performance on jurisdiction-specific legal reasoning remains underexplored. We present TW-LegalBench that utilizes Taiwanese legal system's rich official corpus open to the public to fill the gap in evaluating LLMs on Taiwanese law, among common-law benchmarks that focus on English sources and civil-law benchmarks focusing on sources of Simplified Chinese. TW-LegalBench comprises three task types: (1) over 16,000 multiple-choice questions (MCQs) across five years of official examinations in 18 professional domains; (2) 117 open-ended essay questions (OEQs) from examinations for legal professionals with official scoring rubrics; and (3) more than 14,000 legal judgment prediction (LJP) instances covering hundreds of crime categories. We evaluate 13 LLMs using accuracy for MCQs, a decomposed LLM-as-Judge framework based on the scoring rubric points for OEQs, and metrics for sentencing accuracy and statute citation for LJP. Our results reveal that top-performing models exceed the passing threshold for qualified lawyers (passing rate: 11%) but fall short of that for judges and prosecutors (passing rate: 1~2%). For LJP, while models demonstrate reasonable verdict type accuracy and sentence prediction capability, they struggle to cite exact legal articles. These findings highlight that reliable legal text generation remains challenging for LLMs, even though their performance on qualification examinations approaches human level.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, To appear in ICAIL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TW-LegalBench，一个针对台湾法律体系的 LLM 评估基准，包含超过 16,000 道多项选择题、117 道开放式问答题和 14,000 多个法律判决预测实例。在 13 个 LLM 上的评估结果显示，顶尖模型在律师资格考试（通过率 11%）上超过合格线，但在法官/检察官考试（通过率 1-2%）上仍然不足；法律判决预测中模型能给出合理的判决类型和刑期，但难以引用准确法条。
Motivation: 现有法律基准主要聚焦普通法系（英文）或大陆法系（简体中文），缺乏针对台湾法律体系的评估，而台湾法律系统拥有丰富的公开语料。
Method: TW-LegalBench 包含三种任务：官方考试多项选择题（5年18领域）、开放式问答题（附评分标准）以及法律判决预测（涵盖数百种犯罪类别）。评估使用准确率、基于评分标准的 LLM-as-Judge 框架以及量刑和法条引用指标。
Result: 最佳模型在律师资格考试上超过 11% 的通过率，但法官/检察官考试通过率仅 1-2%；法律判决预测中模型判决类型和刑期预测合理，但精确法条引用能力薄弱。
Conclusion: 尽管 LLM 在资格考试上接近人类水平，但可靠的 legal text generation 仍具挑战，尤其在法条引用方面。

papers.title: Leveraging Energy Features for Surface Classification with Deep Learning: A Comparative Analysis Across Three Independent Datasets
papers.abstract_en: The energy-based method remains a comparatively underexamined approach for surface classification in mobile robotics, despite promising results in constrained environments. This study evaluated the viability of using energy-derived features as either a standalone classification modality or as supplementary input to inertial data. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted across three publicly available datasets, comparing the performance of modern deep learning architectures including recurrent neural networks, convolutional neural networks, encoder-only transformers, and Mamba state-space models, under automated hyperparameter tuning and input sequence length optimization. The models achieved higher accuracy than previously reported values on all evaluated datasets, with the convolutional neural network yielding the highest overall performance. When relying exclusively on energy-based features, the models attained classification accuracies in the range of 85-90%, approximately 5-10% lower than those achieved when combined with inertial features (96-99%). Augmenting inertial data with energy features resulted in a consistent mean accuracy improvement of 1-2%. These findings indicate that classifiers relying solely on energy features offer sufficient accuracy for standalone deployment, while also providing a consistent gain when used in combination with other sensing modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于能量特征（energy features）的表面分类方法在移动机器人中的应用，比较了循环神经网络、卷积神经网络、编码器-变压器（encoder-only transformers）和Mamba状态空间模型在三个公开数据集上的性能。结果表明，仅使用能量特征的分类准确率为85-90%，与惯性特征结合后达到96-99%，且添加能量特征可使准确率稳定提升1-2%。卷积神经网络表现最佳。
Motivation: 能量方法在表面分类中研究较少，尽管在受限环境中展现出潜力。本研究旨在评估能量特征作为独立分类模态或惯性数据的补充输入的可行性。
Method: 在三个公开数据集上，对多种现代深度学习架构（RNN、CNN、编码器-变压器、Mamba状态空间模型）进行自动化超参数调优和输入序列长度优化，比较仅使用能量特征、仅使用惯性特征以及两者结合的分类性能。
Result: 模型在所有数据集上均达到优于前人报告的准确率，CNN总体性能最高。仅用能量特征时准确率85-90%，结合惯性特征后达96-99%；为惯性数据增加能量特征可带来1-2%的稳定提升。

papers.title: Stealthy World Model Manipulation via Data Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Model-based learning agents use learned world models to predict future states, plan actions, and adapt to new environments. However, the process of updating world models from collected experience creates a training-time attack surface: adversarially poisoned fine-tuning trajectories can manipulate the learned dynamics and thereby corrupt downstream planning. In this paper, we propose SWAAP, the first two-stage data poisoning framework for learned world models. In the first stage, SWAAP identifies a harmful target world model that induces low-return behavior under planning while remaining close to clean dynamics, using first-order bilevel optimization enabled by a transition-gradient theorem. In the second stage, SWAAP realizes this target through stealth-constrained gradient matching, modifying only a limited fraction of fine-tuning transition targets so that the induced training gradients steer the victim model toward the adversarial target, while a prediction-error regularizer encourages the poisoned targets to remain close to the world model's natural approximation error. To assess attack stealthiness, we evaluate defenses and detectability across three stages of the poisoning pipeline: pre-training detection of poisoned transitions, robust training during fine-tuning, and test-time monitoring of the resulting world model. Across diverse continuous-control tasks, SWAAP causes substantial performance degradation while keeping poisoned transitions close to clean data and evading the evaluated non-adaptive residual/CUSUM/TRIM-style defenses. These results reveal a practical vulnerability in world-model adaptation pipelines and highlight the need for robustness methods that protect both world-model training data and learned dynamics.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SWAAP，首个针对学习世界模型的两阶段数据投毒攻击框架。第一阶段通过一阶双层优化识别接近清洁动力学的有害目标世界模型，第二阶段通过隐蔽梯度匹配修改有限比例微调数据，使模型被引向目标。在连续控制任务中，SWAAP导致显著性能下降，同时保持投毒数据接近清洁状态，并逃避多种非自适应防御。
Motivation: 基于模型的智能体从经验更新世界模型的过程存在训练时攻击面：对手可通过投毒微调轨迹操纵学得的动力学，破坏下游规划，但现有研究缺乏对该漏洞的系统利用。
Method: SWAAP两阶段框架：第一阶段利用过渡梯度定理实现的一阶双层优化，寻找使规划产生低回报但接近清洁动力学的目标世界模型；第二阶段通过隐蔽约束梯度匹配，仅修改有限比例微调过渡目标，并用预测误差正则化使投毒目标接近自然逼近误差，从而诱导模型参数移向目标。
Result: 在多种连续控制任务中，SWAAP造成显著性能下降，投毒过渡保持接近清洁数据，并成功规避训练前检测、鲁棒训练和测试时监控三类非自适应防御（residual、CUSUM、TRIM）。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示世界模型自适应流水线中存在实际漏洞，强调需要同时保护训练数据和学得动力学的鲁棒方法。

papers.title: Attention as Frustrated Synchronization
papers.abstract_en: A network of oscillators that synchronizes perfectly computes nothing further, so an attention architecture built from synchronization must locate its computation in structured departures from agreement. We introduce the Frustrated Synchronization Network (FSN), whose token states are phases on a torus and whose entire value pathway is one learned complex coupling kernel over harmonics and a one-step delay. Each component of the kernel is a frustration in the sense of the synchronization literature. The complex phases are static Kuramoto-Sakaguchi frustration angles, the signed harmonics are repulsive Daido components, and the delay term, which couples each token to the successors of the tokens it attends to, is algebraically identical to Kuramoto-Sakaguchi coupling whose frustration angle is the data's own transition, so next-token prediction is implemented as synchronization frustrated by the data. At matched one-million-parameter and training budgets on character-level text and code, the FSN's validation loss is below a tuned RoPE-SwiGLU transformer's at every epoch measured, and the comparison survives training the baseline to convergence: every thirty-epoch enwik8 seed finishes below the transformer's converged fifty-epoch loss of 1.611, and the FSN's completed fifty-epoch runs converge to 1.5953 +/- 0.0014. A variant with every feed-forward block replaced by mean-field coupling to learned collective modes, leaving no multilayer perceptron in the stack, tracks the transformer. On natural text the unfrustrated base layer falls behind the converged transformer at every copy depth, worst on long-range copy events; the kernel reverses the deficit at every depth of four and beyond. Headline comparisons are at the one-million-parameter scale; a scale ladder is complete through four million parameters with the advantage persisting, and remaining arms are marked as in progress.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Preliminary report at the 1-10M parameter scale
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出挫败同步网络（FSN），将token状态建模为复相位，通过学习的复杂耦合核（含谐波和一步延迟）实现注意力计算。在字符级文本和代码任务上，1M参数的FSN在验证损失上始终优于调优的RoPE-SwiGLU Transformer，且优势在4M参数尺度上仍然保持。
Motivation: 标准同步网络在完全同步后丧失计算能力，因此需要设计具有结构化不一致的同步注意力架构来执行有用计算。
Method: FSN的token状态为环面上的相位，整个价值通路是一个学习的复杂耦合核，包括静态Kuramoto-Sakaguchi挫败角、有符号谐波（排斥Daido分量）和一步延迟项。延迟项在代数上等同于其挫败角为数据自身转移的Kuramoto-Sakaguchi耦合，使得下一个token预测成为数据挫败的同步。
Result: 在1M参数和相同训练预算下，FSN在字符级文本和代码上的验证损失在每个epoch均低于调优的RoPE-SwiGLU Transformer。enwik8上30轮FSN的所有种子均低于Transformer收敛的50轮损失1.611，FSN 50轮运行收敛至1.5953±0.0014。用平均场耦合替代所有前馈块的变体仍能跟踪Transformer。在自然文本上，无挫败的基础层在所有复制深度落后，而核在深度4及以上逆转了差距。优势在4M参数尺度上持续存在。
Conclusion: FSN在1M到4M参数规模上优于Transformer，表明基于挫败同步的注意力机制是一种有竞争力的架构。更大规模实验仍在进行中。

papers.title: Robust and Interpretable Adaptation of Equivariant Materials Foundation Models via Sparsity-promoting Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained materials foundation models, or machine learning interatomic potentials, leverage general physicochemical knowledge to effectively approximate potential energy surfaces. However, they often require domain-specific calibration due to physicochemical diversity as well as mismatches between practical computational settings and those used in constructing the pre-training data. To address this, we propose a sparsity-promoting fine-tuning method that selectively updates model parameters by exploiting the structural properties of E(3)-equivariant materials foundation models. On energy and force prediction tasks across molecular and crystalline benchmarks, our method matches or surpasses full fine-tuning and equivariant low-rank adaptation while updating only $\sim$3~\% of parameters, and in some cases as little as $\sim$0.5~\%. Beyond energy and force calibration, we further demonstrate task generalizability by applying our method to magnetic moment prediction and magnetism-aware total energy modeling. Finally, analysis of sparsity patterns reveals physically interpretable signatures, such as enhanced $d$-orbital contributions in transition metal systems. Overall, our results establish sparsity-promoting fine-tuning as a flexible and interpretable method for domain specialization of equivariant materials foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对材料基础模型（如E(3)-等变机器学习原子间势）在领域特异性校准中的需求，提出一种稀疏性促进的微调方法，仅更新约0.5%~3%的参数即可匹配或超越全微调与等变低秩适配的性能。方法在能量与力预测任务上验证，并扩展到磁矩预测和磁性总能量建模。稀疏模式分析揭示了物理可解释的特征，例如过渡金属体系中d轨道贡献的增强。
Motivation: 预训练的材料基础模型因物理化学多样性和计算设置不匹配，需要领域特异性校准。现有全微调或低秩适配方法要么计算成本高，要么可解释性不足。
Method: 提出稀疏性促进微调（sparsity-promoting fine-tuning），利用E(3)-等变材料基础模型的结构特性，选择性地更新参数，仅调整少量参数实现领域自适应。
Result: 在分子和晶体基准的能量与力预测任务上，以约3%的参数（部分低至0.5%）匹配或超越全微调与等变低秩适配；成功应用于磁矩预测和磁性总能量建模；稀疏模式分析显示过渡金属体系中d轨道贡献增强等物理可解释特征。
Conclusion: 稀疏性促进微调是一种灵活且可解释的方法，适用于等变材料基础模型的领域专业化，能够有效平衡性能与计算成本。

papers.title: Dual-Channel Grounded World Modeling (DCGWM): Structural Prevention of Objective Interference Collapse via Heterogeneous External Grounding with Inward-Only Gradient Flow
papers.abstract_en: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a leading approach to world model representation learning. We identify a failure mode in JEPA-based world models grounded against two qualitatively distinct external signals: physical dynamics (sparse, high-magnitude, constraint-satisfying gradient corrections) and social-behavioral dynamics (diffuse, distribution-matching corrections). We term this Objective Interference Collapse (OIC): we argue that joint learning in a shared latent space causes the dominant channel to systematically collapse the subordinate channel's representational subspace, in a manner not resolvable by loss weighting alone. We propose Dual-Channel Grounded World Modeling (DCGWM), designed to structurally prevent OIC through a partitioned latent space (physical subspace Z_p, behavioral subspace Z_b) with inward-only gradient flow. A Physical Grounding Channel updates only Z_p via VICReg-style alignment to physical measurements; a Social-Behavioral Grounding Channel updates only Z_b via alignment to trajectories from an emergent multi-agent simulation. An Inter-Channel Interface Module couples the subspaces at the task level without cross-subspace gradients. An Asymmetric Grounding Adherence Loss penalizes rollout drift with a hard hinge for physical violations and a soft KL for behavioral divergence. A Generative Rendering Layer is architecturally isolated from the latent world model. We present three theoretical results: the partition removes the gradient-interference pathway implicated in OIC; each grounded subspace inherits anti-collapse guarantees from its alignment objective; and generative isolation is necessary under a stated assumption on the generative objective's geometry. This manuscript establishes the problem formulation and architecture; experimental validation is ongoing and will be reported in a future revision.
papers.comment: Position paper. Experimental validation in progress
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在同时对接物理动态和社会行为动态两种外部信号时的失败模式——目标干扰崩溃（OIC），并提出双通道接地世界建模（DCGWM）来结构性地防止该问题。DCGWM通过划分潜在空间（物理子空间Z_p和行为子空间Z_b）并采用内向梯度流，使得每个通道仅更新对应的子空间，从而消除梯度干扰。文章提供了三个理论结果，实验验证正在进行中。
Motivation: 现有JEPA在同时对接物理动态（稀疏、高幅度、满足约束的梯度修正）和社会行为动态（扩散、分布匹配的修正）时，共享潜在空间会导致主导通道系统性地压垮次通道的表征子空间，且无法通过损失加权解决。
Method: 提出DCGWM，包含：1) 物理接地通道通过VICReg-style对齐物理测量更新Z_p；2) 社会行为接地通道通过多智能体模拟轨迹对齐更新Z_b；3) 通道间接口模块在任务级别耦合子空间而不传递梯度；4) 非对称接地损失：物理违反使用硬边界，行为偏离使用软KL散度；5) 生成渲染层与潜在世界模型架构隔离。
Result: 论文尚未报告实验结果，仅提供了理论分析：划分消除了梯度干扰路径；每个接地子空间从其对齐目标继承防崩溃保证；在生成目标几何形状的假设下生成隔离是必要的。
Conclusion: 本文建立了问题定义和架构，实验验证正在进行中，将在后续版本报告。

papers.title: Spatially Stratified Distillation for Heterogeneous Radar Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Scalable, all-weather place recognition increasingly relies on heterogeneous radar place recognition to bridge diverse hardware platforms. A notable application is matching queries from cost-effective 4D automotive radars against high-fidelity reference maps built by dense spinning radars. This process is fundamentally limited by the extreme sparsity (and narrow field-of-view) of the 4D sensor, which captures only a fraction of the structural density present in the spinning radar database. Prior efforts address this issue by unifying different radar signals. That is, projecting both signals into a common representational space. Yet, they suffer performance degradation in multi-session environments. In this paper, we propose spatially-stratified distillation (SSD); a strategy that replaces standard uniform distillation with an asymmetric spatial alignment derived directly from physical radar returns. In regions where both radars exhibit overlapping returns, SSD enforces strong feature alignment. Crucially, in sparse regions where the 4D student lacks returns but the teacher contains valid structure within the shared field of view, SSD applies heavily discounted distillation weights. Extensive evaluations of the recent HeRCULES dataset demonstrate that SSD significantly outperforms prior place recognition methods, achieving state-of-the-art results on its challenging dynamic sequences.

TL;DR: 本文针对异质雷达位置识别中4D汽车雷达稀疏点云与密集旋转雷达地图匹配的难题，提出空间分层蒸馏（SSD）方法。SSD根据雷达回波的物理空间分布进行不对称对齐：在重叠区域强制特征对齐，在稀疏区域对蒸馏权重进行大幅折扣。在HeRCULES数据集上的实验表明，SSD在动态序列上取得了最先进的性能。
Motivation: 现有异质雷达位置识别方法通过统一雷达信号到公共表示空间，但在多会话环境中性能下降。根本原因是4D雷达的极端稀疏性和窄视场导致其仅能捕获旋转雷达数据库中的部分结构密度。
Method: 提出空间分层蒸馏（SSD），替代标准均匀蒸馏：在雷达回波重叠区域强制强特征对齐，在4D学生雷达无回波但教师雷达在共享视场内有有效结构的稀疏区域，应用大幅折扣的蒸馏权重。
Result: 在HeRCULES数据集上的评估表明，SSD显著优于先前的位置识别方法，在其挑战性动态序列上达到最先进结果。
Conclusion: 实验证明了空间分层蒸馏对于异质雷达位置识别的有效性，特别是在处理稀疏4D雷达与密集旋转雷达之间的匹配时。

papers.title: ForecastBench-Sim: A Simulated-World Forecasting Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting benchmarks for general-purpose AI systems usually inherit the constraints of the real world: outcomes resolve slowly, tail events are rare, and counterfactual questions are difficult to score. We introduce ForecastBench-Sim, a simulated-world forecasting benchmark built on game rollouts from Freeciv, a turn-based strategy game modelled on the Civilization series. Forecasters receive a fixed world report (a structured snapshot of the current game state) and answer questions about hidden future states; the benchmark then continues the simulation and scores forecasts. Because the world is simulated, the same setup can generate continuous or binary forecasting questions at arbitrary time horizons, paired intervention worlds for conditional or causal questions, and resolved examples of rare or disruptive outcomes. We describe the benchmark pipeline, question families, scoring protocol, and release artifacts, and report validation slices from model evaluations and an anonymized human pilot. ForecastBench-Sim is intended to complement real-world forecasting benchmarks by providing controlled, immediately resolvable tasks for studying probabilistic reasoning under dynamic world states.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 main figures, 6 appendix figures. Spotlight presentation at Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence / Workshop on AI Forecasting, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForecastBench-Sim，一个基于 Freeciv 策略游戏模拟的世界预测基准，用于评估通用 AI 系统的概率推理能力。基准通过游戏回放生成连续或二值预测问题，支持条件因果问题，并包含模型评估和人类试点验证。
Motivation: 现有真实世界预测基准受限于结果解决慢、尾部事件稀有和反事实评分困难，而模拟世界可提供可控、即时可解的任务。
Method: 利用 Freeciv 游戏状态快照作为世界报告，生成关于隐藏未来状态的问题，并通过继续模拟进行评分。支持任意时间跨度的预测、干预世界对以及罕见事件示例。
Result: 报告了模型评估和匿名人类试点的验证切片，表明基准能有效区分不同预测能力。
Conclusion: ForecastBench-Sim 旨在通过提供可控、即时可解的任务，补充真实世界预测基准，用于研究动态世界状态下的概率推理。

papers.title: Multi-Class Brain Tumor Classification Using Advanced Deep Learning Models: A Comparative Study
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advancements in deep learning, accurately classifying brain tumors from MRI images continues to pose challenges. In this research, we present a comprehensive evaluation of five different convolutional neural networks (CNN) architectures, including a customized baseline model and four pre-trained models - for use in classifying multi-class brain tumors using a clinically-sourced dataset of approximately 10,000 MRI images. We have utilized five different architectures; VGG16, VGG19, DenseNet121, and EfficientNetB0, which were all tested and trained within an identical experimental framework. Performance was measured by both overall accuracy and tumor-wise recall as a means to measure the clinically-relevant performance of each architecture. We found that EfficientNetB0 had the best overall classification accuracy at 95%, when compared to the other architectures tested; specifically VGG16 (94.37%), VGG19 (92.29%), DenseNet121 (90.91%) and the customized CNN (78.00%). An especially important finding of our research was the considerable improvement in detecting meningiomas; specifically, while simple CNNs could detect meningiomas with a recall rate of approximately 20%, EfficientNetB0 was able to detect meningiomas with a recall rate of 89%. Meningiomas are often difficult to detect because they can appear very subtly on MRI images. Additionally, an interesting finding was that the deeper VGG19 performed worse than the shallower VGG16. This indicates that in many cases the architectural efficiency of a CNN model may be more important than its depth when working with medical images. Overall, EfficientNetB0 appears to provide the optimal trade-off between classification accuracy, number of parameters used in the model and clinically meaningful performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对五种卷积神经网络（包括自定义baseline和VGG16、VGG19、DenseNet121、EfficientNetB0）在临床MRI图像上多类脑肿瘤分类任务进行了系统比较。使用约10,000张MRI图像的数据集，EfficientNetB0以95%的总体准确率最优，并且将脑膜瘤的召回率从约20%提升至89%。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤MRI分类中，现有深度学习模型在检测某些亚型（如脑膜瘤）时召回率较低，且模型深度与效率的关系尚未明确。
Method: 在相同实验框架下训练并测试五种CNN架构：自定义CNN、VGG16、VGG19、DenseNet121和EfficientNetB0，以总体准确率和肿瘤级召回率评估性能。
Result: EfficientNetB0达到最高总体准确率95%，VGG16为94.37%，VGG19为92.29%，DenseNet121为90.91%，自定义CNN为78.00%。EfficientNetB0对脑膜瘤的召回率从20%提高到89%，且VGG19（更深）性能反而低于VGG16。
Conclusion: EfficientNetB0在分类精度、参数效率和临床相关性能之间提供了最佳折衷，表明模型架构效率比单纯增加深度更重要。

papers.title: Moving Beyond Diversity: Visual Token Pruning as Subspace Reconstruction for Efficient VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Despite their remarkable performance, Vision Language Models (VLMs) incur substantial computational overhead due to the large number of visual tokens. While diversity maximization has become a dominant strategy for token reduction, existing methods rely on cosine-based normalized similarity that discards magnitude information, failing to faithfully approximate the original feature representation and leading to suboptimal performance, particularly on compositional multi-skill reasoning tasks. In this paper, we introduce SPARE, a subspace reconstruction method that reformulates token pruning as a column subset selection problem and explicitly minimizes reconstruction error. By iteratively selecting tokens with large projection residuals, SPARE performs reconstruction-driven pruning beyond angular diversity. Moreover, we reveal a counterintuitive anti-relevance phenomenon: tokens with lower image-text relevance score can better preserve contextual information. Based on this finding, we incorporate anti-relevance into SPARE as an additional selection criterion to promote context-aware token selection. Extensive experiments across multiple VLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that SPARE consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with strong gains on compositional tasks. When applied to LLaVA, SPARE removes up to 94% of visual tokens while retaining 95% of the baseline performance, all in a fully training-free manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）因大量视觉token带来的计算开销问题，提出SPARE方法，将token剪枝重新表述为子集选择问题，通过最小化重构误差进行剪枝，并发现并利用“反相关性”现象进一步改进选择策略。实验表明，SPARE在多个VLM和基准上达到最先进性能，在LLaVA上可移除94%的视觉token而保留95%的基线性能，且无需训练。
Motivation: 现有基于多样性最大化的token剪枝方法使用余弦归一化相似度，忽略了幅度信息，无法忠实近似原始特征表示，在组合多技能推理任务上表现欠佳。
Method: 提出SPARE方法，将token剪枝建模为列子集选择问题，通过迭代选择投影残差大的token实现重构驱动的剪枝，并引入反相关性（anti-relevance）作为额外选择标准以促进上下文感知的token选择。
Result: 在多个VLM和基准上达到最先进性能，在LLaVA上移除94%的视觉token而保留95%的基线性能，且在训练无关（training-free）方式下实现。
Conclusion: SPARE通过重构驱动的剪枝超越了仅依赖角度多样性的方法，反相关性现象的发现和利用进一步提升了上下文感知能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fair Online Resource Allocation
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of fair online resource allocation, motivated by applications such as refugee resettlement and airline scheduling, where agents arrive sequentially and must be assigned to facilities with limited capacities. We introduce a model that maximizes the overall welfare subject to resource constraints and a Lipschitz fairness requirement, which ensures that similar agents arriving in the same batch receive similar expected outcomes. We first analyze the offline problem, proving that the value of the optimal fair allocation is at least an $Ω(1/γ)$ fraction of the optimal unfair allocation, where $γ$ is the fairness coefficient, thereby bounding the price of fairness. For the online setting, we propose an algorithm based on dual mirror descent that enforces fairness constraints within batches while estimating optimal dual variables. We prove that this algorithm achieves sublinear regret relative to the optimal offline fluid benchmark. Finally, we validate our theoretical results using real-world data from the Refugee Economies Programme, demonstrating the algorithm's performance and examining the trade-offs between welfare maximization and fairness enforcement.
papers.comment: 3 pages, 4 figures. To appear in the proceedings of EC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究公平在线资源分配问题，提出模型最大化整体福利同时满足Lipschitz公平性约束。离线分析给出公平性代价的上界，在线算法基于对偶镜像下降实现亚线性遗憾，并用难民安置真实数据验证。
Motivation: 难民安置和航空调度等应用中需在线分配有限资源，同时保证相似个体获得相似结果，现有工作对在线公平性数学刻画不足。
Method: 定义Lipschitz公平性需求，离线证明公平分配与最优不公平分配的比值下界；在线提出对偶镜像下降算法，在批次内强制公平约束并估计最优对偶变量。
Result: 离线最优公平分配达到最优不公平分配的Ω(1/γ)分数；在线算法相对离线流体基准实现亚线性遗憾；真实数据实验展示算法性能与公平-福利权衡。
Conclusion: 框架能有效平衡福利最大化和公平性，并通过实证验证了理论的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bounded Context Management for Tabular Foundation Models on Stream Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tabular stream learning requires predictions on sequentially arriving examples under distribution shift. While standard methods adapt by updating model states, tabular foundation models (TFMs) make predictions conditioned on a labeled context in an in-context manner, making them a natural alternative for stream learning. This shifts the challenge from how to update the model to how to manage the context. We propose a future information view that yields three practical requirements for context management: preserve recent examples, retain uncertain examples, and remove redundant examples. We instantiate these requirements as CURE (Context management via Uncertainty-aware admission and Redundancy aware Eviction), a context-managing policy with entropy-gated admission and redundancy-aware eviction. Across seven streams, CURE shows up to 27.0% relative improvement over classical stream learners, remains robust across multiple TFM backbones, and ranks first among other policy variants. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/morcellinus/CURE-ICML-FMSD.
papers.comment: Accepted as a spotlight oral (top 5%) at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD@ICML2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表格流学习（tabular stream learning）中的分布漂移问题，提出一种上下文管理策略CURE，通过熵门控准入和冗余感知驱逐来管理带标签上下文，使得表格基础模型（TFM）能够以上下文方式适应流数据。在七个流数据集上，CURE相对于经典流学习器实现了高达27.0%的相对改进，并在多种TFM骨干中保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 表格流学习需要处理顺序到达的样本并适应分布漂移，传统方法通过更新模型参数来适应，而表格基础模型（TFM）依赖上下文进行预测，因此问题转化为如何管理上下文。现有上下文管理方法缺乏系统原则。
Method: 提出未来信息视角导出的三个实际需求：保留最近样本、保留不确定样本、移除冗余样本。具体实现为CURE策略，包含基于熵的门控准入和基于冗余的驱逐机制。
Result: 在七个流数据集上，CURE相对于经典流学习器（如在线随机森林、Hoeffding树等）有高达27.0%的相对性能提升；在多种TFM骨干（如TabPFN、TabPTM）上表现稳定；在多种上下文管理策略变体中排名第一。
Conclusion: 上下文管理是表格基础模型应用于流学习的关键，CURE提供了有效且通用的解决方案，代码和数据已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: InTrain: Intrinsic Trainability for Zero-Cost Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Training-free neural architecture search promises efficient discovery of high-performance networks without costly training. However, existing zero-cost proxies rely on fragmented heuristics that fail to capture the fundamental question: what makes an architecture trainable? This paper introduces Intrinsic Trainability (InTrain), a unified theoretical proxy that formalizes trainability as an architectural invariant emerging from two synergistic components: geometric capacity and optimization resilience. We operationalize intrinsic trainability through analysis of neural information processing. Geometric capacity is quantified via the participation ratio of activation covariance eigenspectrum, capturing the effective dimensionality of representation manifolds. Optimization resilience is measured through cumulative gradient health, assessing the robustness of backpropagation across network depth. InTrain synthesizes these dimensions through a scale-invariant multiplicative coupling, which we hypothesize is essential for capturing their synergistic, non-additive relationship. Extensive experiments on standard NAS benchmarks and search spaces demonstrate that InTrain achieves ranking correlations on par with state-of-the-art ensemble-based proxies and outperforms other single-metric methods.

papers.title: BrainFusionNet: a deep learning and XAI model to understand local, global, and sequential features of MRI images for improved brain tumour detection
papers.abstract_en: The noise of Magnetic Resonance Imaging MRI poses challenges for Deep Learning DL when tumor boundaries are obscured tumor location and appearance are complex Therefore we develop BrainFusionNet that combines Convolutional Neural Networks CNNs Vision Transformers ViT and Gated Recurrent Units GRUs to extract spatial contextual and sequential features from MRI images for improved brain tumor classification Furthermore explainable AI such as SHAP LIME and GradCAM are integrated to visualise and highlight image regions that contribute to BrainFusionNets decisionmaking process The proposed BrainFusionNet model is evaluated on two publicly available MRI datasets Kfold validation suggests 98 accuracy on both datasets The model was compared with the six stateoftheart SOTA CNNs and transfer learning Among the SOTA CNNs DenseNet121 and VGG16 achieved the highest accuracy of 96 The novelty of BrainFusionNet is that the hybrid model effectively extracts local and global features from MRI images even in smallscale tumor regions and small tumor sizes The model has a balanced sequential CNN architecture to capture lowlevel and deeperlayer features a customized ViT that captures local features stabilizes gradient flow and reduces the risk of vanishing gradients during MRI image training The CNN and ViT outputs are fed into a GRU for final classification Furthermore we analyze pixel intensities to determine whether MRI image quality affects image classification Our findings are very novel in image interpretation as we found that the distribution of pixel intensities in MRI images affects DL performance
papers.journal_ref: Brain Inf. 13, 21 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BrainFusionNet，一种结合CNN、Vision Transformer (ViT)和GRU的混合深度学习模型，用于脑肿瘤MRI分类。模型集成SHAP、LIME和GradCAM等可解释AI方法，在公开数据集上达到98%准确率，优于DenseNet121和VGG16等SOTA模型。
Motivation: MRI噪声、肿瘤边界模糊及位置形态复杂导致传统深度学习检测困难，现有模型难以同时提取局部、全局和序列特征。
Method: BrainFusionNet包含三部分：CNN提取低层和高层特征，ViT捕捉局部特征并稳定梯度，GRU对CNN和ViT输出进行最终分类；集成SHAP、LIME和GradCAM增强可解释性。
Result: 两个公开MRI数据集上的K折交叉验证准确率达98%，与SOTA CNN（DenseNet121、VGG16等）对比，最高准确率为96%。
Conclusion: 混合模型能有效提取小尺度肿瘤的局部及全局特征，并发现MRI像素强度分布会影响深度学习性能。

papers.title: scGTN: Deep Siamese Graph Transformer Network for Single-cell RNA Sequencing Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) serves a pivotal role in characterizing gene expression at the cellular level, enabling the identification of cell types and advancing the understanding of cellular heterogeneity. Despite the significant progress in scRNA-seq data clustering, we argue that current methods always ignore the sparsity and noise, as well as the complex intercellular structural information inherent in scRNA-seq data. Toward this end, in this paper, we propose a novel single-cell RNA-seq clustering framework via deep Siamese Graph Transformer Network (termed scGTN), which explicitly integrates gene expression profile and intercellular structural dependencies for cell clustering. In particular, we formulate scRNA-seq data as a graph and construct two augmented graph views that serve as dual views to capture complementary intercellular information. Then, a Siamese graph transformer network is employed to explicitly incorporate shortest-path information and node-wise distances for capturing richer structural relationships between cells. Finally, we employ an optimal transport strategy to guide the cell clustering in a self-supervised manner. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark scRNA-seq datasets demonstrate that our scGTN consistently outperforms existing methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/W-RMSL/scGTN.
papers.comment: Accepted by Proceedings of the Thirty-Fifth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出scGTN，一种基于孪生图变换网络（Siamese Graph Transformer Network）的单细胞RNA-seq聚类框架。通过将数据构建为图并生成两个增强视图，利用最短路径和节点间距离捕捉结构关系，最后用最优传输进行自监督聚类。在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法忽略scRNA-seq数据的稀疏性、噪声以及复杂的细胞间结构信息。
Method: 提出scGTN：将数据建模为图，构建两个增强图视图作为双视图；使用孪生图变换网络融合最短路径信息和节点距离；采用最优传输策略进行自监督聚类。
Result: 在多个基准scRNA-seq数据集上，scGTN一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调scGTN显式整合基因表达谱和细胞间结构依赖关系，有效提升聚类性能。

papers.title: NeuralMUSIC: A Hybrid Neural-Subspace Framework for Robot Sound Source Localization
papers.abstract_en: Reliable sound source localization is fundamental to robot audition, enabling autonomous robots to perceive spatial cues and operate effectively in dynamic environments. Classical methods such as Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC) offer strong theoretical foundations but degrade under low signal-to-noise ratios. While deep learning-based approaches achieve promising performance, they often struggle with limited generalization across conditions. To address these challenges, we propose NeuralMUSIC, a hybrid neural-subspace framework for robotic sound source localization. Specifically, a neural network first estimates the spatial covariance matrix from multichannel microphone observations. The predicted covariance is then integrated into a classical MUSIC pipeline with eigenvalue decomposition (EVD) and pseudo-spectrum computation, followed by a Frequency Attention Fusion (FAF) module to produce the final DOA estimates. To improve data efficiency, we further introduce a Self-supervised Spatial Correlation Learning (SSCL) strategy that leverages unlabeled acoustic data to capture spatial structure. Extensive experiments across different robotic tasks demonstrate that NeuralMUSIC achieves competitive localization accuracy while exhibiting improved robustness and cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuralMUSIC，一种混合神经子空间框架用于机器人声音源定位。神经网络估计空间协方差矩阵，然后结合经典MUSIC算法（特征分解和伪谱计算），再通过频率注意力融合模块输出DOA估计。引入自监督空间相关学习策略利用未标记声学数据提高数据效率。实验表明该方法在定位准确度、鲁棒性和跨域泛化方面表现良好。
Motivation: 经典MUSIC方法在低信噪比下性能下降，深度学习方法泛化有限，需要结合两者优势以提升声音源定位的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Method: 神经网络估计多通道麦克风观测的空间协方差矩阵，然后将其融入经典MUSIC流水线（特征分解和伪谱计算），最后通过频率注意力融合模块输出最终DOA估计。另外引入自监督空间相关学习策略利用未标记声学数据。
Result: 在多种机器人任务上取得有竞争力的定位精度，并展现出改进的鲁棒性和跨域泛化能力。
Conclusion: 混合神经子空间框架能有效结合数据驱动和物理模型，提升声音源定位的性能和跨条件泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LandslideAgent with Multimodal LandslideBench: A Domain-Rule-Augmented Agent for Autonomous Landslide Identification and Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent landslide hazard interpretation is critical for disaster prevention, yet current paradigms struggle to simultaneously extract visual features and high-level geoscientific semantics, while general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from perceptual limitations and domain hallucinations in complex geological scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an instruction-driven agentic framework comprising three components. First, LandslideBench, a multimodal fine-grained dataset with seven subtype labels, high-resolution imagery, pixel-level masks, and high-quality textual descriptions, is constructed via multi-VLM cross-validation and interactive annotation. Then, LandslideVLM, a landslide-oriented VLM, is fine-tuned via LoRA on LandslideBench to enhance geological semantic understanding. Finally, LandslideAgent, a domain rule-enhanced agent taking LandslideVLM as its cognitive backbone, employs a dual-rule controller incorporating structured report metadata constraints and cross-validation identification constraints to regulate automated tool invocation. Experiments demonstrate that LandslideBench provides effective baselines across five mainstream models on fine-grained classification and semantic segmentation. LandslideVLM achieves accuracy improvements of 10.96%, 32.87%, and 15.91% on landslide discrimination, fine-grained classification, and semantic description quality, respectively. LandslideAgent further enables autonomous multi-source spatial data inference, realizing full-process intelligence for landslide identification and analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个指令驱动的智能体框架，包含多模态滑坡基准数据集 LandslideBench、滑坡专用视觉语言模型 LandslideVLM 以及领域规则增强的智能体 LandslideAgent，用于实现高分辨率遥感影像中滑坡的自主识别与分析。实验表明，该框架在滑坡判别、细粒度分类和语义描述质量上分别提升 10.96%、32.87% 和 15.91%，并能进行多源空间数据推理。
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时提取视觉特征与地质语义，通用视觉语言模型在复杂地质场景下存在感知局限和领域幻觉，亟需一个结合领域知识的自主滑坡识别与分析系统。
Method: 构建了含七种细粒度子类型、高分辨率影像、像素级掩码和高质量文本描述的多模态数据集 LandslideBench；在此基础上通过 LoRA 微调得到滑坡专用 VLM LandslideVLM；设计 LandslideAgent，以 LandslideVLM 为认知核心，通过双规则控制器（结构化报告元数据约束与交叉验证识别约束）自动调用工具。
Result: LandslideBench 为五个主流模型提供了细粒度分类与语义分割的基线；LandslideVLM 在滑坡判别、细粒度分类和语义描述质量上分别提升 10.96%、32.87% 和 15.91%；LandslideAgent 实现了全流程智能化滑坡识别与分析。
Conclusion: 该框架验证了结合领域规则与专用 VLM 在滑坡灾害智能解译中的有效性，但未提及对其他灾害类型的泛化能力或实时性限制。

papers.title: On-Manifold Variational Learning with Heat-Kernel Priors
papers.abstract_en: Learning unsupervised representations of medical imaging cohorts can reveal clinically meaningful prototypes without expert labels, which are often noisy and fail to capture true pathological heterogeneity. However, existing deep latent-variable models estimate Gaussian mixture priors via Euclidean averaging, producing prototypes that drift off the curved data manifold and degenerate as the number of sub-populations grows. We propose a manifold-anchored variational framework built on a geometry-aware Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, whose M-step selects each sub-population prototype as the graph medoid with the highest diffusion centrality on a heat-kernel-weighted latent graph, ensuring that every prototype remains on-manifold. A Dirichlet energy regularizer enforces geometric smoothness of the latent space, and a per-sub-population uncertainty score enables label-free quality assessment. \rev{The manifold-anchored EM is a general-purpose geometric tool that extends standard EM and applies readily to other latent-variable models beyond this setting.} On cardiac scar and brain MRI benchmarks, our framework attains the highest accuracy among all compared methods, produces the sharpest prototypes reported to date, and remains stable at large sub-population counts where all baselines degenerate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于流形的变分学习框架，利用热核先验和几何感知的EM算法，确保潜变量模型的原型位于数据流形上。在心脏疤痕和脑MRI基准上达到最高精度，并生成最清晰的原型，在子群体数量大时保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有深度潜变量模型使用欧氏平均估计高斯混合先验，导致原型偏离弯曲的数据流形，且随着子群体数量增加而退化。
Method: 提出流形锚定的变分框架，基于几何感知的EM算法，M步骤选择具有最高扩散中心性的图medoid作为原型，使用热核加权潜图，并添加Dirichlet能量正则化保证几何平滑，每个子群体有不确定性分数实现无标签质量评估。
Result: 在心脏疤痕和脑MRI基准上，该框架达到所有比较方法中最高的准确率，生成迄今最清晰的原型，在子群体数量大时仍保持稳定，而所有基线退化。
Conclusion: 流形锚定的EM是一种通用几何工具，可扩展标准EM并应用于其他潜变量模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BLADE: Scalable Bi-level Adaptive Data Selection for LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Model (LLM) datasets scale to trillions of tokens, data selection has emerged as a critical frontier to filter out uninformative noise and construct adaptive learning trajectories. Beyond static heuristic filtering, advanced data selection methods for LLM training largely follow two paradigms, each with fundamental limitations. Influence-based methods provide principled bi-level objectives but require intractable inverse-Hessian computations, while excess-loss methods are computationally efficient but rely on a static reference model that becomes misaligned with the evolving proxy model during training. We propose BLADE (Bi-Level Adaptive Data sElection), a Hessian-free framework for data selection. BLADE reformulates the bi-level optimization problem underlying influence-based methods as a penalized single-level objective via Lagrange multipliers, avoiding inverse-Hessian computation while revealing a principled connection to excess-loss based data selection. The resulting objective recovers an excess-loss form but replaces the static reference model with a dynamic one that stays synchronized with training. Theoretically, we prove that this penalized formulation guarantees first-order convergence. For efficient online batch selection, we instantiate BLADE as a memoryless randomized block-coordinate Frank-Wolfe algorithm. Extensive experiments show that BLADE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art data selection baselines, providing a practical recipe for LLM training.

TL;DR: 本文提出BLADE，一种可扩展的双层自适应数据选择框架用于LLM训练。它避免了影响函数方法中耗时的逆Hessian计算，通过拉格朗日乘子转化为单层惩罚目标，并动态更新参考模型。理论上证明一阶收敛，实践中使用记忆无关随机块坐标Frank-Wolfe算法实现高效在线批次选择。实验表明在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法存在根本局限：基于影响的方法需要计算逆Hessian，计算不可行；而基于超额损失的方法使用静态参考模型，与训练中不断变化的代理模型不匹配。
Method: 提出BLADE，将双层优化重新表述为通过拉格朗日乘子的带惩罚单层目标，避免了逆Hessian计算并揭示了与超额损失数据选择的联系。该目标恢复超额损失形式，但用动态参考模型替代静态参考模型。为高效在线批次选择，实例化为记忆无关随机块坐标Frank-Wolfe算法。
Result: 理论上证明该惩罚公式保证一阶收敛。大量实验表明BLADE一致优于最新数据选择基线。
Conclusion: 为LLM训练提供了实用的数据选择方案。
