summary_sections.method: 提出校准方差传播（CVP），包括归一化层的新传播方法、结合现有激活函数处理技术，以及通过轻量校准步骤吸收残差误差，实现单次前向传播中的不确定性估计。
summary_sections.result: 在 NLVR2（BEiT-3）上，CVP 将 0.5% 风险下的覆盖率从 8.2% 提升至 14.6%；在 VQAv2（ViLT）上，从 2.6% 提升至 10.8%，并适用于卷积架构。
summary_sections.conclusion: CVP 能以远低于蒙特卡洛采样的成本获得可比的不确定性估计，填补了方差传播方法在现代架构中的应用空白。

papers.title: Formalizing and Mitigating Structural Distortion in LLM Attention for Graph Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs). However, applying LLMs to graphs requires linearizing their structure into sequences, introducing distortion rooted in the graph bandwidth problem. While this distortion has been shown to degrade performance, it is often attributed to prompt design or model scale, leaving the underlying mechanism unclear. In this work, we show \textit{how} rotary positional embeddings turn graph linearization into bandwidth-dependent attention decay, suppressing attention between graph-adjacent nodes that are forced far apart in the serialized sequence. This shifts the focus of LLM-based graph reasoning from prompt engineering and scaling toward correcting attention misalignment. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \textbf{G}raph-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{A}ttention (\textbf{GaLA}), a lightweight, inference-time modification for LLMs. GaLA biases attention toward graph-adjacent nodes while preserving the LLM's sequential inductive biases. Across TAG benchmarks, GaLA improves performance with negligible overhead, demonstrating that distortion is a correctable bottleneck in LLM-based graph reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化地分析了LLM在图推理中因图序列化导致的注意力结构失真问题，指出旋转位置编码将序列化转化为带宽依赖的注意力衰减，抑制了图中相邻但序列中远处节点间的注意。提出轻量级的图对齐语言注意力（GaLA），在推理时通过偏置调整注意力，提升图推理性能且开销极小。
Motivation: 现有LLM在图推理中常将图线性化为序列，但由此产生的结构失真（源于带宽问题）被归因于提示设计或模型规模，其底层机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示该失真的本质并提出可纠正的解决方案。
Method: 通过分析旋转位置嵌入对线性化图的影响，提出Graph-aligned Language Attention (GaLA)，在推理时对注意力进行偏置，使其偏向图相邻节点，同时保留LLM的序列归纳偏置。
Result: 在TAG基准测试上，GaLA以极小的额外开销提升了性能，表明结构失真是LLM图推理中可纠正的瓶颈。
Conclusion: 本文强调结构失真而非提示工程或模型规模是LLM图推理的关键瓶颈，GaLA提供了一种轻量级的纠正方案。

papers.title: Open-World Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: While video segmentation has advanced rapidly on short clips and closed-set benchmarks, open-world video segmentation remains largely unexplored. The challenge is twofold: (1) existing methods are not designed to support object discovery and identity maintenance in long videos of dynamic ego-motion, and (2) existing evaluation protocols rely on a rigid 1:1 matching that unfairly penalizes semantically valid predictions with mismatched granularity. To address both gaps, we introduce Savvy, a practical and strong system for zero-shot open-world long-horizon video segmentation. Savvy combines hierarchical mask discovery, deferred admission, and track consolidation to support persistent object discovery, safe track promotion, and stable long-range identity maintenance. We further propose OGA, a granularity-aware evaluation suite for open-world video segmentation. Built on a Granularity-Agnostic (GA) matching protocol, OGA relaxes conventional 1:1 matching to an n:1 mapping, but still enforces temporal rigor by detecting support discontinuities through sever points and scoring each reference object through its dominant coherent fragment. This prevents fragmented or flickering support from being over-rewarded while enabling GA-adapted metrics and structural diagnostics: identity persistence (IP), and identity concentration (IC). On VIPSeg, we show that standard 1:1 evaluation substantially underestimates open-world methods, whereas GA evaluation recovers much of their suppressed performance. On the more realistic long-horizon benchmarks: ScanNet and HM3D, Savvy consistently outperforms strong baselines across both classical and proposed metrics, including STQ, VPQ$_\infty$, IP and IC. Together, these results establish a practical benchmark and a strong baseline for open-world long-horizon video segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Savvy系统，结合层级掩膜发现、延迟接纳和轨迹整合，实现零样本开放世界长时视频分割；同时提出OGA评估套件，采用粒度无关匹配协议，通过身份持久性和集中度指标更公平地评估开放世界方法。在VIPSeg、ScanNet和HM3D基准上，Savvy优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有视频分割方法局限于短剪辑和封闭集，无法支持长动态视频中的目标发现和身份维护；现有评估协议依赖严格1:1匹配，不公正地惩罚粒度不匹配的语义有效预测。
Method: 提出Savvy系统，包含层级掩膜发现、延迟接纳和轨迹整合；提出OGA评估套件，基于粒度无关匹配协议，通过主导连贯片段检测支持不连续性并计算身份持久性和集中度指标。
Result: 在VIPSeg上，标准1:1评估低估开放世界方法，GA评估恢复被抑制性能；在ScanNet和HM3D上，Savvy在STQ、VPQ∞、IP和IC等指标上优于强基线。
Conclusion: 该工作为开放世界长时视频分割建立了实用基准和强基线，并证明了粒度无关评估的重要性。

papers.title: RaLMPH: Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization in Whole-Slide Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) is a standard paradigm for Whole-Slide Image (WSI) analysis and has achieved strong results in computational pathology. However, most MIL pipelines assume a single "gold" label per slide, which conflicts with clinical practice where substantial inter-pathologist variability is common. Existing multi-annotator learning and label-refinement methods typically estimate global annotator reliability or rely on single-instance assumptions, making them poorly suited to MIL and to localized diagnostic contexts where experts disagree. We propose RaLMPH (Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization), a MIL-based label reconciliation framework for WSIs annotated by multiple pathologists. RaLMPH introduces a reliability field that jointly models (i) local neighborhood structure in WSI feature space and (ii) expert uncertainty (entropy), enabling per-sample identification of trustworthy reference neighborhoods. Leveraging this field, RaLMPH performs sample-wise local annotator ranking to select reliable opinions per slide and applies an adaptive gating mechanism to fuse labels conditioned on local reliability. Experiments on a clinical WSI dataset with labels from six pathologists, as well as controlled simulated benchmarks, show that RaLMPH consistently outperforms existing approaches. Further analyses clarify how our reliability-aware mechanism improves label reconciliation and downstream MIL performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多病理学家标注全切片图像（WSI）中的标签不一致问题，本文提出RaLMPH，一种基于多实例学习（MIL）的标签协调框架。该方法引入可靠性场，联合建模WSI特征空间的局部邻域结构与专家不确定性（熵），实现样本级局部标注者排序，并通过自适应门控机制根据局部可靠性融合标签。实验表明，在六位病理学家标注的临床数据集及模拟基准上，RaLMPH持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有MIL管道通常假定每张切片有一个“金标准”标签，但临床实践中不同病理学家间的标注分歧普遍存在；现有的多标注者学习或标签精炼方法多依赖全局可靠性估计或单实例假设，不适用于MIL和局部诊断场景。
Method: 提出RaLMPH，一个基于MIL的标签协调框架，包含三个核心组件：一是可靠性场，联合建模特征空间局部邻域结构和专家不确定性；二是基于该场的样本级局部标注者排序，选择可信邻居参考；三是自适应门控机制，根据局部可靠性融合标签。
Result: 在六位病理学家标注的临床WSI数据集和模拟基准上，RaLMPH在标签协调和下游MIL分类性能上均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，该可靠性感知机制能够有效改善多标注者场景下的标签协调，并提升MIL分类性能。

papers.title: Sensory Restoration via Brain-Computer Interfaces: A Unified 2 x 2 Framework and Convergence Roadmap
papers.abstract_en: Millions of individuals worldwide suffer from sensory and communication deficits caused by neurodegenerative diseases, stroke, or trauma. Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer a promising avenue for sensory and motor restoration. However, the scientific literature remains highly fragmented between invasive neuroprosthetics and non-invasive electrophysiological decoders, with a lack of consistent terminology and comparison metrics. This chapter proposes a unified 2 x 2 framework categorizing BCIs along two axes: degree of invasiveness (invasive vs. non-invasive) and signal direction (afferent sensory-IN vs. efferent sensory-OUT). We define and distinguish the paradigms of restoration, substitution, and augmentation. Furthermore, we outline a structural roadmap for the convergence of these modalities over near-, medium-, and long-term horizons, focusing on physical limits and the integrative role of machine learning foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对因神经退行性疾病、中风或创伤导致的感觉和沟通障碍，提出一个统一的2×2框架来分类脑机接口（BCI），沿侵入性（有创vs无创）和信号方向（传入感觉IN vs 传出感觉OUT）两个轴。定义了恢复、替代和增强三种范式，并概述了近期、中期和长期这些模态融合的结构化路线图。
Motivation: 目前BCI领域在侵入式神经假体和非侵入式电生理解码器之间高度碎片化，缺乏一致的术语和比较指标，需要一个统一的分类框架。
Method: 提出了一个2×2分类框架，并基于物理极限和机器学习基础模型的整合角色，规划了近期、中期和长期的融合路线图。
Result: 摘要提出框架和路线图，没有给出具体实验数值。
Conclusion: 该框架有助于统一BCI领域术语和比较，路线图指出了未来融合方向。

papers.title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
papers.abstract_en: Current automated pipelines for audio-visual Question Answering (QA) generally adopt a ``video-caption-QA'' paradigm. However, these methods typically segment videos into short clips and generate separate descriptions for audio and visual modalities. This decoupled processing severs inherent associations between sounds and their visual sources, while independent clip processing often causes inconsistent descriptions of the same entity across segments. Furthermore, coupling long-text comprehension and QA synthesis into a single step often restricts models to localized events, yielding questions lacking long-term temporal connections and deep cross-modal reasoning. To address these issues, we propose an automated data engine featuring two mechanisms: (1) \textbf{Entity-Anchored Video Scripting} transforms videos into structured scripts, comprising summaries, main entity lists, and segment-wise audio-visual descriptions. The entity list serves as a global prior to ensure cross-segment referential consistency and reconstruct audio-visual associations. (2) \textbf{Clue-Guided QA Generation} prompts models to first mine cross-segment, multimodal clues from the script, and subsequently generate QA pairs based on these high-value clues. Leveraging this pipeline, we construct the instruction-tuning dataset \textbf{OmniVideo-100K} and a human-verified test set, \textbf{OmniVideo-Test}. Fine-tuning VITA-1.5, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and Qwen3-Omni-30B on OmniVideo-100K yields performance gains of up to 20.59% on OmniVideo-Test, demonstrating strong generalization (up to 12.64% improvements) across established benchmarks like Daily-Omni and JointAVBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniVideo-100K数据集及其自动化构建流程，通过实体锚定视频脚本（Entity-Anchored Video Scripting）和线索引导的QA生成（Clue-Guided QA Generation）两个机制，解决当前音视频问答中模态关联断裂、跨片段不一致以及缺乏深度跨模态推理的问题。在OmniVideo-Test上微调VITA-1.5等模型获得最高20.59%的性能提升，并在Daily-Omni等基准上展示良好泛化性。
Motivation: 现有音视频QA自动化流程通常采用“视频-描述-QA”范式，但解耦处理割裂了声音与视觉源的关联，独立片段处理导致实体描述不一致，且将长文本理解与QA合成耦合会限制模型于局部事件，缺乏长时程跨模态推理。
Method: 提出自动化数据引擎，包含两个机制：(1) 实体锚定视频脚本，将视频转化为结构化脚本（摘要、实体列表、逐片段音视频描述），实体列表作为全局先验保证跨片段指代一致并重建音视频关联；(2) 线索引导的QA生成，先让模型从脚本中挖掘跨片段多模态线索，再基于高价值线索生成QA对。
Result: 构建OmniVideo-100K指令微调数据集和人验证测试集OmniVideo-Test；在VITA-1.5、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和Qwen3-Omni-30B上微调后，在OmniVideo-Test上性能提升最高20.59%，在Daily-Omni和JointAVBench等基准上泛化提升最高12.64%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该自动化数据引擎能有效提升音视频问答中的跨片段和跨模态推理能力，数据集和方法具有良好泛化性。

papers.title: MeEvo: Metacognitive Evolution Combined with Natural Evolution for Automatic Heuristic Design
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) by enabling heuristic generation through reasoning and code synthesis. Existing LLM-based AHD architectures mainly follow two paradigms: Natural Evolution, which uses crossover and mutation to explore heuristic programs, and Metacognitive Evolution, which refines reasoning through reflection. However, Natural Evolution discards reasoning traces, weakening knowledge inheritance and exploitation, while Metacognitive Evolution lacks population-level recombination, limiting exploration and increasing the risk of premature convergence. These limitations reduce search efficiency, stability, and solution quality on complex problems. To address this gap, we propose MeEvo, a dual-layer AHD framework that cyclically couples Natural Evolution and Metacognitive Evolution. Natural Evolution explores heuristic code while recording reasoning traces, fitness values, and errors into a shared history; Metacognitive Evolution then reflects on this history to generate improved heuristics that re-enter the parent pool for the next cycle. This design enables population-driven exploration and reflection-driven refinement to reinforce each other. Experiments on five optimization problems with two LLM backbones show that MeEvo achieves stronger and more stable performance than existing LLM-based AHD architectures, especially on complex constrained tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MeEvo，一种双层自动启发式设计框架，循环耦合自然进化（Natural Evolution）和元认知进化（Metacognitive Evolution）。自然进化探索启发式代码并记录推理痕迹、适应值和错误到共享历史中；元认知进化基于该历史进行反思，生成改进的启发式并重新进入父代池。在五个优化问题上的实验表明，MeEvo 比现有的基于 LLM 的 AHD 架构性能更强、更稳定，尤其是在复杂约束任务上。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的自动启发式设计方法中，自然进化丢弃推理痕迹，削弱知识继承和利用；元认知进化缺乏种群级重组，限制探索并增加早熟收敛风险。两者均导致搜索效率、稳定性和解质量下降。
Method: 提出 MeEvo 框架，包含两层：自然进化层通过交叉和变异探索启发式代码，同时记录推理痕迹、适应值和错误；元认知进化层基于这些历史记录进行反思，生成改进的启发式，并将其重新注入父代池，形成循环耦合。
Result: 在五个优化问题（包括复杂约束任务）上，使用两种 LLM 骨干（LLaMA 和 GPT 系列）测试，MeEvo 在解质量和稳定性上均优于现有 LLM 基 AHD 架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调循环耦合自然进化和元认知进化能够使种群驱动的探索与反思驱动的精炼相互增强，从而提升自动启发式设计的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiPOD: Diffusion Policy Optimization without Drifting Apart
papers.abstract_en: RL post-training has become increasingly pivotal for improving diffusion policies, but existing diffusion policy-gradient methods are often unstable and cannot achieve reliable policy improvement. We identify the cause as the double-drift phenomenon: optimizing a variational surrogate can let the ELBO separate from the true log-likelihood, which then makes the resulting proxy policy gradient misaligned with the true policy gradient of expected return. We propose \textbf{DiPOD}, a diffusion policy optimization framework that maintains tight-bound behavior throughout training by interleaving self-distillation with policy-improving gradient updates. This leads to a simple and practical algorithm: augmenting each diffusion policy-gradient update with an on-policy ELBO regularizer. Across diffusion language model post-training and continuous-control diffusion policies, DiPOD substantially stabilizes training and reaches higher rewards than previous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散策略（diffusion policy）强化学习后训练中的不稳定问题，指出双漂移现象（double-drift）导致代理策略梯度与真实策略梯度不对齐，并提出 DiPOD 框架，通过在每次策略梯度更新中插入 on-policy ELBO 正则化来维持紧密边界。在扩散语言模型后训练和连续控制任务上，DiPOD 显著稳定训练并取得更高奖励。
Motivation: 现有扩散策略梯度方法训练不稳定，无法实现可靠策略改进，原因是双漂移现象使 ELBO 与真实对数似然分离，导致代理梯度与真实期望回报梯度不对齐。
Method: 提出 DiPOD 框架，将自我蒸馏（self-distillation）与策略改进梯度更新交替进行，具体实现为在每个扩散策略梯度更新中附加 on-policy ELBO 正则化项。
Result: 在扩散语言模型后训练和连续控制扩散策略任务中，DiPOD 显著稳定训练过程，并达到比先前方法更高的奖励值。
Conclusion: DiPOD 通过保持训练过程中的 tight-bound 行为有效解决了双漂移问题，为扩散策略的 RL 后训练提供了一种简单实用的算法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold
papers.abstract_en: We present MoVerse, a real-time video world model that creates an interactively navigable scene from a single narrow-field-of-view image. This setting is challenging because the input observes only a small fraction of the environment, while interactive roaming requires a complete surrounding world, persistent geometry, controllable camera motion, and temporally coherent high-fidelity observations. MoVerse addresses this problem by separating world construction from observation rendering. It first expands the input into a gravity-aligned 360$^\circ$ panorama with topology-aware diffusion, closing the missing field of view before 3D reasoning. It then lifts the panorama into a persistent 3D Gaussian scaffold using panoramic geometry-aware residual prediction, yielding a dense and directly renderable spatial memory. Finally, a Gaussian-conditioned video renderer translates scaffold renderings along user-specified camera trajectories into photorealistic video. To make this renderer practical for interaction, we train a bidirectional diffusion teacher for high-quality conditional rendering and distill it into a causal autoregressive student for bounded-latency streaming. This design combines the controllability and long-range consistency of explicit 3D representations with the perceptual quality of generative video models. MoVerse supports real-time scene roaming at 8~FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX~4090 GPU, demonstrating a practical path toward single-image world creation with interactive video output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoVerse 是一个从单张窄视角图像实时生成可交互漫游场景的视频世界模型。它通过拓扑感知扩散先补全为360°全景图，再将其提升为持久3D高斯支架，最后由高斯条件视频渲染器沿用户指定轨迹生成逼真视频，支持单张 RTX 4090 上 8 FPS 的实时漫游。
Motivation: 从单张窄视角图像创建完整可交互场景极具挑战，因为输入只观察到环境的一小部分，而交互漫游需要完整的周围世界、持久几何、可控相机运动和时间一致的高保真观测。
Method: 分三阶段：1) 用拓扑感知扩散将输入图像扩展为重力对齐的360°全景图；2) 通过全景几何感知残差预测将全景图提升为持久3D高斯支架；3) 高斯条件视频渲染器（双向扩散教师蒸馏为因果自回归学生）将支架渲染沿用户轨迹转换为逼真视频。
Result: 在单张 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU 上实现 8 FPS 的实时场景漫游，结合了显式3D表示的可控性和长程一致性以及生成式视频模型的感知质量。
Conclusion: MoVerse 展示了从单张图像到交互视频输出的实用路径，但摘要未明确讨论在极端遮挡或大场景下的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bag of Dims: Training-Free Mechanistic Interpretability via Dimension-Level Sign Patterns
papers.abstract_en: We show the standard basis of transformer hidden states already provides a training-free, architecture-general feature basis. Individual dimensions encode semantic content via their signs (+/-1) and confidence via their magnitudes, acting as independent binary registers; a feature is a subset of dimensions with a consistent sign pattern, read by counting sign agreements with no learned rotation. We validate this Bag of Dims framework across seven models spanning language (Qwen 3.5-4B, Gemma 3-4B, Mistral 7B, Qwen3-32B), vision (DINOv2, ViT-Base), and audio (AST). Signs alone carry predictive content: unit-magnitude sign patterns preserve 60-93% top-5 next-token accuracy through the LM head, and decoder-free Hamming scoring reaches 80-90% top-4096. From a single-token cache (one forward pass per token, no context, no labels), we detect 175 categories at AUC 0.97-0.99 by sign agreement; a trained probe adds only +0.018 AUC and converges to axis-aligned weights. These features are causally operative: they survive the K/V attention projections, trace to the FFN neuron coalitions that write them (random-weight controls never reproduce this), and flipping a feature's signs during the live forward pass suppresses its concept across four language models, magnitude-matched and concept-specific. Dimensions stay independent throughout (pairwise mutual information below 0.006 bits). The structure is not specific to language: the same per-dimension signs appear in self-supervised vision (DINOv2, 9/12 ImageNet superclasses), supervised vision (ViT-Base, 11/12), and audio (AST, 50/50 ESC-50 categories), so it reflects transformer training in general, not the language-modeling objective. The standard basis already suffices for feature reading at one forward pass, no optimization, no GPU-days. The open problem shifts from finding the right rotation to cataloging what each dimension encodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bag of Dims 框架，证明 Transformer 隐藏状态的标准基已经足以提供无需训练、架构通用的特征基础。每个维度通过符号（+/-1）编码语义内容，通过幅度编码置信度，特征由具有一致符号模式的维度子集构成。在语言（Qwen、Gemma、Mistral、Qwen3-32B）、视觉（DINOv2、ViT-Base）和音频（AST）共七个模型上验证，符号模式具有预测性和因果操作性，维度之间保持独立（互信息低于0.006 bits）。
Motivation: 现有的 Transformer 可解释性方法通常需要学习特征旋转或训练探针，本文旨在展示标准基已经足够用于特征读取，从而将开放问题从寻找正确的旋转转变为目录化每个维度编码的内容。
Method: 利用维度符号作为二进制寄存器，通过统计符号一致性来读取特征，无需任何训练或优化。验证方法包括：用符号模式通过 LM 头预测下一个 token、无解码器的汉明评分、单 token 缓存检测类别、因果干预（翻转特征符号抑制概念）、以及维度独立性分析。
Result: 在语言模型中，仅用符号模式（单位幅度）保留60-93% top-5下一token准确率；无解码器汉明评分达到80-90% top-4096。单 token 缓存检测175个类别，AUC达0.97-0.99，而训练探针仅额外增加0.018 AUC。因果干预表明特征确实是因果运作的。视觉模型上，DINOv2覆盖9/12 ImageNet超类，ViT-Base覆盖11/12；音频模型AST在ESC-50上覆盖全部50个类别。
Conclusion: 标准基足以在单次前向传递中读取特征，无需优化或GPU时间，因此未来工作的重点应从寻找特征旋转转向目录化每个维度编码的内容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: "Did you lie?" Evaluating Lie Detectors across Model Scale and Belief-Verified Model Organisms
papers.abstract_en: Robust lie detectors for language models could enable powerful techniques for auditing, monitoring, and post-hoc investigation of model behaviour, but evaluating them requires testbeds where models verifiably believe the opposite of what they say. We show that existing trained model organisms often fail this requirement, leaving prior positive and negative detection results difficult to interpret. We address this with 13 reasoning model organisms whose hidden beliefs are verified in chain-of-thought and shown to generalise to held-out tasks, alongside Varied Deception, a prompted-lying testbed covering a broad range of lie-inducing motivations. On these testbeds we evaluate four detectors: a chain-of-thought judge, a logprob classifier, and two activation probes, including Did-You-Lie (DYL), a new method for training follow-up probes. On prompted lying, across 31 open-weight models spanning 2B to 1T parameters, all four detectors show positive scaling with model capability. However, every activation- and logprob-based detector drops sharply on our trained model organisms, with DYL retaining the most signal; only the chain-of-thought judge remains strong, with 0.82 balanced accuracy, partly as an artefact of our verification process favouring CoT-readable beliefs. Current lie detectors therefore cannot support high-confidence claims about model beliefs, and we suggest research directions that may address some of their current limitations. We release our datasets, model organisms, and trained detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了多种谎言检测器（包括链式思维判断、logprob分类器、激活探针及新提出的Did-You-Lie方法）在语言模型上的表现。通过构建13个信念已验证的推理模型有机体（model organisms）和变体欺骗（Varied Deception）测试床，发现现有检测器在训练过的模型有机体上性能显著下降，只有链式思维判断保持较高准确率（0.82平衡准确率），表明当前谎言检测器无法支持关于模型信念的高置信度声明。
Motivation: 现有谎言检测器评估需要模型真实信念与表述相反的测试床，但已有的训练模型有机体往往不满足这一要求，导致先前结果难以解释。
Method: 构建13个推理模型有机体，其隐藏信念通过链式思维验证并泛化到未见过任务；同时创建变体欺骗测试床，覆盖多种诱导撒谎动机。评估四种检测器：链式思维判断、logprob分类器、两种激活探针（包括新方法Did-You-Lie）。
Result: 在提示撒谎下，31个开源模型（2B至1T参数）上所有检测器与模型能力正相关；但在训练过的模型有机体上，基于激活和logprob的检测器性能急剧下降，DYL保留最多信号；链式思维判断达0.82平衡准确率，但部分归因于验证过程偏好可读链式思维。
Conclusion: 当前谎言检测器不能支持高置信度的模型信念声明，并提出了可能解决当前局限的研究方向。

summary_sections.result: 在提示撒谎下，31个开源模型（2B至1T参数）上所有检测器与模型能力正相关；但在训练过的模型有机体上，基于激活和logprob的检测器性能急剧下降，DYL保留最多信号；链式思维判断达0.82平衡准确率，但部分归因于验证过程偏好可读链式思维。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前谎言检测器不能支持高置信度的模型信念声明，并提出了可能解决当前局限的研究方向。

papers.title: The Art of Interrogation: Consistency Amplifies Factuality in Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit remarkable general capabilities but significantly underperform in spatial reasoning tasks. Existing approaches treat this gap as a knowledge deficit, relying on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to ingest labeled spatial data from external vision sources or synthetic engines. In contrast, we argue that for many tasks, spatial reasoning capabilities are already present in pre-trained LRMs but require alignment through logical coherence under geometric 2D and 3D constraints. In this work, we propose a self-supervised reinforcement learning (RL) framework that targets the internal reasoning process without requiring ground-truth annotations. By formalizing the notion of consistency verifiers -- reward functions that check for geometric and semantic consistency under transformations -- we demonstrate that models can improve their spatial reasoning abilities. We use both image transformations, like flipping, and textual transformations, like swapping the order of objects in the question, and propose a new optimal transport-based RL strategy, OT-GRPO, which is a minimal-matching variant of group relative policy optimization tailored to pairwise verifiers. We show that this label-free consistency training approaches the accuracy of models trained with ground-truth supervision and achieves similar generalization across diverse tasks and data domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型在空间推理任务中表现不佳的问题，提出一种自监督强化学习框架，通过定义几何和语义一致性验证器作为奖励函数，无需标注数据即可提升模型的空间推理能力。实验显示，该无标签方法在准确性上接近有监督训练，并在多种任务和数据域上实现类似泛化。
Motivation: 现有大型推理模型在空间推理任务中表现显著落后于其他能力，以往工作将此归因于知识缺失而采用有监督微调，但论文认为模型已蕴含空间推理能力，只需通过逻辑一致性对齐即可挖掘。
Method: 提出自监督强化学习框架OT-GRPO，基于最优传输的组相对策略优化变体，利用图像变换（翻转）和文本变换（对象顺序交换）构造一致性验证器作为奖励，无需真实标注。
Result: 该方法在空间推理任务上达到接近有监督训练的准确性，并在多样任务和数据域中展现出相似的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 论文表明利用一致性验证器的无标签强化学习可以有效激活预训练模型内隐的空间推理能力，减少对外部标注数据的依赖。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: UPLOTS: A Unified Pretrained Language Model for Constrained Time-series Generation
papers.abstract_en: In time-series generation, existing approaches typically handcraft ortrain a separate model for each dataset, which hinders their scalability and fails to leverage shared temporal structures across domains. To address this fragmentation, we propose UPLOTS, a Unified, Prompt-guided Language model framework fOr constrained Time-Series Generation across diverse domains. Instead of building task-specific models, UPLOTS leverages a single pre-trained transformer backbone guided by learned constraint prompts, enabling on-demand generation with precise pattern control. One key innovation is our dynamic multi-dataset loss re-weighting and prompt-to-pattern mapping, which allows UPLOTS to internalize diverse temporal structures during training and conditionally generate them at inference. We evaluate UPLOTS on four real-world benchmarks and multiple constraint settings, including peak-period, calendar, load-level, and volatility patterns. Additional held-out constraint-combination and downstream forecasting experiments further demonstrate that UPLOTS generalizes beyond the original peak-pattern setting and improves data augmentation under scarce real-data regimes. Our code and baselines are available at anonymous github repo: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UPLOTS-6C36.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UPLOTS，一个统一的、提示引导的预训练语言模型框架，用于带约束的多领域时间序列生成。它通过单个预训练 transformer 主干和学习的约束提示，实现按需生成和精确模式控制，并采用动态多数据集损失重加权与提示到模式映射来学习跨域时序结构。在四个真实世界基准和多种约束设置（峰值期、日历、负载水平、波动模式）上评估，并展示了在约束组合和下游预测任务中的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法通常为每个数据集手工设计或单独训练模型，缺乏可扩展性，无法利用跨域共享的时序结构。
Method: 提出 UPLOTS 框架，基于预训练 transformer 主干，利用学习的约束提示（constraint prompts）指导生成，并引入动态多数据集损失重加权和提示到模式映射（prompt-to-pattern mapping），使模型在训练时内化多种时序模式并在推理时条件生成。
Result: 在四个真实世界基准和多个约束设置（峰值期、日历、负载水平、波动模式）上进行了评估，额外在保留的约束组合和下游预测实验中验证了泛化能力，表明 UPLOTS 可推广到原始峰值模式设置之外，并在真实数据稀缺时改善数据增强。
Conclusion: UPLOTS 通过统一的预训练模型和约束提示机制，有效解决了时间序列生成的碎片化问题，并展现出跨数据集和约束模式的泛化能力。

papers.title: DN-Hypo-Pipeline: An AI-Driven Workflow for Hypothesis Generation via Large Language Models and Scientific Explanations
papers.abstract_en: A scientific hypothesis is the first step in research and undergoes experimental validation, yet it also reflects a deep understanding of and reasoning about scientific phenomena. We introduce DN-Hypo-Pipeline, an AI-powered workflow based on large language models, designed to support structured scientific thinking and hypothesis generation by leveraging scientific explanations as prior knowledge. This pipeline assists researchers in deriving novel hypotheses from existing literature. Given the explanandum (i.e., the conclusion) of a research paper, it identifies underlying laws, theories, and principles, and reconstructs a new, yet-to-be-verified explanation for the observed phenomenon. We evaluated DN-Hypo-Pipeline in the field of data science modeling using three highly cited papers. Statistical inference, supported by both LLM-as-judge assessment and human expert evaluation, demonstrates that our pipeline is more effective than direct generation methods. Additionally, we validated the two highest-scoring generated hypotheses by developing corresponding novel algorithms, which outperformed the baseline models presented in the original papers. Beyond application in data science, DN-Hypo-Pipeline provides a theoretical framework that not only encompasses theory-guided data science modeling methods but also reveals a more fundamental structure of the modeling process. Moreover, this approach is essentially a generalization of theory-guided modeling, offering potential for extension to other domains and across a broader range of scientific disciplines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DN-Hypo-Pipeline，一种基于大语言模型的 AI 驱动工作流，利用科学解释作为先验知识，从已有文献中生成假设。该流程以论文结论（explanandum）为输入，识别背后的规律、理论和原理，重构对现象的新解释。在数据科学建模领域，通过三项高引论文的评估（LLM-as-judge 和人类专家），表明该方法优于直接生成。两个最高分假设对应新算法超越基准。该框架可泛化至其他科学领域。
Motivation: 科学研究假设生成依赖深度理解和推理，现有方法缺乏结构化支持。论文旨在利用大语言模型和科学解释先验知识，自动化地从文献中推导新颖假设。
Method: 提出 DN-Hypo-Pipeline，包含多个阶段：输入论文结论（explanandum），识别潜在规律、理论和原理，重构尚未验证的假设。评估采用 LLM-as-judge 和人类专家结合统计推断。
Result: 在数据科学建模领域的三篇高引论文上，DN-Hypo-Pipeline 比直接生成方法更有效。两个最高分假设对应的新算法在性能上超越原论文的基线模型。
Conclusion: 该工作流不仅涵盖理论指导的数据科学建模方法，还揭示了建模过程的基础结构。本质上是对理论指导建模的泛化，可扩展至其他科学领域。

papers.title: SegmentAnyTreeV2: Scaling Transformer-Based Tree Instance Segmentation Across Sensors, Platforms, and Forests
papers.abstract_en: We present SegmentAnyTreeV2, a sensor- and platform-agnostic framework for semantic and instance segmentation of forest point clouds. The model combines a serialization-based Point Transformer v3 backbone with a lightweight semantic head and a tree-focused cross-attention mask decoder. Semantic predictions restrict instance decoding to tree-class voxels, while instance-aware query initialization, one-to-many seed supervision, and asymmetric mask scoring improve separation in dense and structurally complex stands. We further introduce FOR-instance v3, an expanded benchmark comprising 427 scenes and 26,496 annotated trees across diverse biomes, forest structures, and LiDAR platforms. On the FOR-instanceV2 test split, SegmentAnyTreeV2 achieves 90.5% precision, 80.2% recall, 85.0% F1, 90.7% coverage, and 87.6% semantic mIoU, outperforming previous learning-based methods in both instance detection and mask completeness. Zero-shot evaluation on independent sites further demonstrates strong cross-domain generalization.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables, Corrected bibliography metadata and minor typographical issues; results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SegmentAnyTreeV2，一种与传感器和平台无关的森林点云语义与实例分割框架。模型结合基于序列化的Point Transformer v3骨干网络、轻量级语义头以及树聚焦的交叉注意力掩码解码器，通过在FOR-instance v3基准上取得90.5%精度、80.2%召回率、85.0% F1分数、90.7%覆盖率和87.6%语义mIoU，优于先前方法，并在零样本评估中展现强跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有森林点云分割方法在跨传感器、平台和森林类型时泛化能力有限，且缺乏大规模标注基准支持。
Method: 采用序列化Point Transformer v3作为骨干，结合轻量级语义头和树聚焦交叉注意力掩码解码器；语义预测限制实例解码为树类体素，并引入实例感知查询初始化、一对多种子监督和非对称掩码评分以提升密集复杂林分中的分离能力。
Result: 在FOR-instanceV2测试集上，达到90.5%精度、80.2%召回率、85.0% F1、90.7%覆盖率和87.6%语义mIoU，优于先前基于学习的方法；零样本评估在独立站点上表现强跨域泛化。
Conclusion: SegmentAnyTreeV2在多种森林结构、传感器和平台上实现有效且泛化的树实例分割，但方法可能受限于点云序列化顺序和稀疏场景。

papers.title: From Privacy to Workflow Integrity: Communication-Graph Metadata in Autonomous Agent Interoperability
papers.abstract_en: Agent-interoperability protocols such as A2A and MCP standardize what agents say to one another but assume address-based transport. Whether over HTTP(S) or a content-protecting binding such as MLS-based SLIM, these transports protect message content yet leave the communication graph exposed: which agent contacts which, when, and how often. In agent systems this graph is more consequential than a privacy framing suggests. Endpoints are capability-labeled, workflows are structured and chained, and interactions are coupled to actions, so an observer recovers more than past relationships: it can recognize a recurring pending workflow from its opening and, at machine speed, act on it before it completes. The threat is one of workflow integrity, not privacy alone. We give a threat model for the communication graph and locate what makes its metadata distinctively consequential: not stronger fingerprinting but exposure across independent trust domains, coupled to autonomous action. We define transport- and bootstrap-layer privacy properties, give them an indistinguishability-game semantics, evaluate transports, and give an A2A case study where a metadata-protecting binding surfaces its implicit identity assumptions. On a corpus of real multi-agent A2A traffic from the official reference agents, on a live A2A binding, and with a generative model as a controlled instrument, a label-blind classifier recovers a task's class from passive metadata at 6x chance, and from only its opening; a defense-aware adversary does not overturn this, and only the full set of properties drives recovery toward chance. Acting on the leak is distinct from recoverability: under a fixed budget an adversary captures 0.63 of a clairvoyant attacker's advantage on the corpus (0.41 from a workflow's opening), governed by top-ranked precision rather than overall accuracy, so integrity and privacy come apart under defense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自主代理互操作性协议（如A2A、MCP）中通信图元数据的暴露问题。作者认为通信图在代理系统中比隐私框架所暗示的更具后果性：工作流结构化且与行动耦合，观察者可恢复工作流类型并在其完成前采取行动，威胁涉及工作流完整性而非仅隐私。作者给出了威胁模型，定义了传输层和引导层的隐私属性，通过不可区分性游戏评估传输，并在A2A案例研究中展示元数据保护绑定暴露隐式身份假设。在真实多代理A2A流量上，标签不可知分类器从被动元数据中恢复任务类别达到随机水平的6倍，仅从工作流开头即达此效果；防御感知的对手无法推翻此结果，只有完整属性集才将恢复率推向随机。在固定预算下，对手捕获了全知对手优势的0.63（从工作流开头为0.41），其由顶级精度而非总体准确率主导，因此完整性与隐私在防御下分离。
Motivation: 现有代理互操作性协议保护消息内容但暴露通信图元数据（谁联系谁、何时、频率），在代理系统中这比隐私更严重：可识别工作流并在完成前干预，威胁工作流完整性。
Method: 提出威胁模型，定义传输层和引导层隐私属性，使用不可区分性游戏语义；在A2A协议案例中分析元数据保护绑定的隐式身份假设。基于真实多代理A2A流量，使用标签不可知分类器评估元数据泄露程度，并对比防御感知对手的影响。
Result: 标签不可知分类器从被动元数据中恢复任务类别达6倍随机水平，仅从工作流开头即达此效果。防御感知对手未推翻此结果，仅完整属性集可降低恢复率。在固定预算下，对手优势为全知对手的0.63（0.41来自开头），由顶级精度主导。
Conclusion: 通信图元数据泄露威胁工作流完整性，且与隐私可分离；需要针对元数据的保护措施，现有协议在元数据保护方面存在不足。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究自主代理互操作性协议（如A2A、MCP）中通信图元数据的暴露问题。作者认为通信图在代理系统中比隐私框架所暗示的更具后果性：工作流结构化且与行动耦合，观察者可恢复工作流类型并在其完成前采取行动，威胁涉及工作流完整性而非仅隐私。作者给出了威胁模型，定义了传输层和引导层的隐私属性，通过不可区分性游戏评估传输，并在A2A案例研究中展示元数据保护绑定暴露隐式身份假设。在真实多代理A2A流量上，标签不可知分类器从被动元数据中恢复任务类别达到随机水平的6倍，仅从工作流开头即达此效果；防御感知的对手无法推翻此结果，只有完整属性集才将恢复率推向随机。在固定预算下，对手捕获了全知对手优势的0.63（从工作流开头为0.41），其由顶级精度而非总体准确率主导，因此完整性与隐私在防御下分离。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有代理互操作性协议保护消息内容但暴露通信图元数据（谁联系谁、何时、频率），在代理系统中这比隐私更严重：可识别工作流并在完成前干预，威胁工作流完整性。
summary_sections.method: 提出威胁模型，定义传输层和引导层隐私属性，使用不可区分性游戏语义；在A2A协议案例中分析元数据保护绑定的隐式身份假设。基于真实多代理A2A流量，使用标签不可知分类器评估元数据泄露程度，并对比防御感知对手的影响。
summary_sections.result: 标签不可知分类器从被动元数据中恢复任务类别达6倍随机水平，仅从工作流开头即达此效果。防御感知对手未推翻此结果，仅完整属性集可降低恢复率。在固定预算下，对手优势为全知对手的0.63（0.41来自开头），由顶级精度主导。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通信图元数据泄露威胁工作流完整性，且与隐私可分离；需要针对元数据的保护措施，现有协议在元数据保护方面存在不足。

papers.title: SVHighlights: Towards Extremely Long Sport Video Highlight Detection
papers.abstract_en: While highlight detection for long-form videos is of great practical importance, most existing methods remain limited to short-form content, largely due to the absence of a suitable benchmark. To bridge this gap, we introduce SVHighlights, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark for highlight detection in extremely long sports videos, each exceeding one hour in duration, across multiple sports categories. SVHighlights is constructed from pairs of full-length sports videos and their corresponding official highlight videos using a dataset generation pipeline, enabling scalable label generation without conventional per-clip saliency annotation. The benchmark comprises 320 videos with an average duration of 2.00 hours and a total of 640.18 hours, substantially exceeding previous datasets. Existing methods also face fundamental challenges on long videos: models trained on short clips fail to generalize to hour-long content, and their clip-level scoring lacks the broader context needed to identify highlights. To address this and provide a strong baseline, we present TF-SELECTOR, a training-free segment-based approach that divides each video into context-aware segments by merging adjacent shots sharing the same semantic content, and predicts segment-level saliency scores using a large language model with multimodal inputs including visual captions, transcripts, and audio volume. Experiments demonstrate that TF-SELECTOR achieves superior performance across most metrics compared to Video Temporal Grounding (VTG)-tuned baselines, with improvements of +2.50 in HIT@1, +4.04 in HIT@K, and +2.95 in IoU. These results establish SVHighlights as a challenging testbed for long-form highlight detection and demonstrate that a simple segment-based strategy can effectively scale to hour-long videos.
papers.comment: Accepted to KDD 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track). Project Page: https://leedongkyu2019.github.io/SVHighlights/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SVHighlights，据称为首个针对超长体育视频（平均时长2小时）的精彩片段检测基准，包含320个视频共640.18小时。同时提出无训练的分段方法TF-SELECTOR，利用大语言模型基于多模态输入（视觉字幕、转录文本、音量）预测片段级显著性分数，在多数指标上优于视频时序定位（VTG）基线，HIT@1提升+2.50，HIT@K提升+4.04，IoU提升+2.95。
Motivation: 现有精彩片段检测方法局限于短视频，缺乏长视频基准，且模型在长视频上泛化能力差，片段级评分缺乏上下文。
Method: 构建SVHighlights基准：通过全场比赛视频与官方精彩片段配对的数据集生成流水线，无需逐帧标注。提出TF-SELECTOR：将视频分割为语义一致的上下文感知片段，利用大语言模型融合视觉字幕、转录文本和音频音量预测片段级显著性。
Result: TF-SELECTOR在SVHighlights上相比VTG基线在HIT@1、HIT@K和IoU上分别提升+2.50、+4.04和+2.95。
Conclusion: SVHighlights为长视频精彩片段检测提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，证明了简单的分段策略可有效扩展到小时级视频。

papers.title: HAARES Half-Split Residual Basis Routing for Deep Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Block-level residual routing makes learned residual aggregation practical by routing over block summaries, but each summary compresses an ordered sequence of attention and MLP updates into one cumulative vector. We propose \method{}, a lightweight residual basis router that keeps the cumulative block source and adds one half-split detail basis, computed as the difference between first-half and second-half residual updates. The detail basis is RMS-matched and updated online, exposing coarse intra-block trajectory information without dense sublayer-level routing. Across OpenWebText, cross-domain character-level benchmarks, and BPE-tokenized OpenWebText, the empirical pattern is depth-dependent: gains are small or mixed at shallow depth and most reliable in 48-layer models. In the 201M 48-layer setting, \method{} improves over Block AttnRes across all three seeds, while a 453M two-seed probe shows the same direction. Ablations rule out source duplication, random signed details, fixed detail-source biases, or block-count changes alone. Cost analysis shows that the method is FLOP-light but not wall-clock-free: it adds memory and routing overhead, yet its relative arithmetic cost is amortized as width grows and earlier convergence can reduce time-to-target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HAARES 半分割残差基路由方法，在块级残差路由基础上增加半分割细节基，以捕捉块内粗粒度轨迹信息。实验表明深度依赖：浅层增益小，48层模型提升最可靠。201M 48层设置下，HAARES 在三颗种子上均优于 Block AttnRes。方法 FLOP 轻但非墙钟免费，内存和路由开销随宽度增加而摊销。
Motivation: 块级残差路由通过块摘要聚合残差，但每个摘要将有序序列（attention 和 MLP 更新）压缩为单一累积向量，丢失了块内轨迹信息。论文旨在低成本地提供粗粒度块内信息。
Method: 提出 HAARES，一种轻量级残差基路由器，保留累积块源，增加一个半分割细节基，计算为前半和后半残差更新的差。细节基 RMS 匹配并在线更新，无需密集子层路由。
Result: 在 OpenWebText、跨域字符级基准和 BPE 分词 OpenWebText 上，增益深度依赖：浅层小或混合，48层模型最可靠。201M 48层设置下，HAARES 在三颗种子上均优于 Block AttnRes；453M 两种子探针显示相同方向。消融排除源复制、随机符号细节、固定细节源偏差或块计数变化。
Conclusion: 摘要指出方法 FLOP 轻但非墙钟免费，增加内存和路由开销，但相对算术成本随宽度增长而摊销，早期收敛可减少到达目标时间。

papers.title: Physics in 2-Steps: Locking Motion Priors Before Visual Refinement Erases Them
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-Video diffusion models leverage input images to generate visually stunning content, yet frequently produce motion that violates physical laws. We reveal a surprising finding: a 2-step generation often exhibits better physical consistency than a 50-step output from the same model. Through spectral analysis, we trace this to phase erosion during denoising; the phase degrades significantly (dropping by $\approx 18\%$ from step 2 to step 50), whereas the magnitude remains relatively stable. Building on this insight, we propose PhaseLock, a training-free framework that preserves the valid motion priors from few-step inference throughout the denoising trajectory. Rather than relying on full-step inference for physical consistency, PhaseLock extracts a motion prior from just 2 steps and enforces it onto high-fidelity generation via Latent Delta Guidance. Our approach effectively mitigates phase degradation, improving physical consistency by an average of 6.2 points across diverse models while largely maintaining visual fidelity, with negligible overhead ($1.06\times$ time, $1.02\times$ memory) and reduced reliance on expensive external guidance methods ($\sim5\times$ time). Project Page: https://dnwjddl.github.io/phaselock
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现图像到视频扩散模型中，2步生成比50步生成具有更好的物理一致性，原因是去噪过程中的相位退化（约下降18%）。提出PhaseLock，一种无训练框架，通过从2步推理提取运动先验并利用Latent Delta Guidance施加到完整生成轨迹中，有效缓解相位退化，提升物理一致性平均6.2分，计算开销极小（1.06倍时间、1.02倍内存），并减少对外部引导方法的依赖。
Motivation: 现有图像到视频扩散模型常产生违反物理规律的运动，长时间去噪导致相位严重退化，而幅度保持稳定，使得物理一致性随步数增加而下降。
Method: 提出PhaseLock，先仅用2步推理提取运动先验（momentum prior），然后在后续去噪步骤中通过Latent Delta Guidance将这一先验施加到高保真生成上，从而保留少步推理的物理一致性且无需重新训练。
Result: 在多种扩散模型上，PhaseLock将物理一致性平均提升6.2分，同时保持视觉保真度，仅增加约1.06倍时间和1.02倍内存开销，并将昂贵的外部引导方法使用减少约5倍。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决扩散模型去噪过程中的相位退化问题，在不显著牺牲视觉质量的前提下大幅改善运动物理一致性，且计算开销极小，可作为通用增强模块。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Dataset Condensation for Diffusion Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Dataset condensation aims to construct compact datasets from real data via synthesis or selection. However, existing approaches are ill-suited for diffusion model training: synthetic data generation often yields low-fidelity samples unsuitable for authentic modeling, while real subset selection typically fails to preserve the distributional geometry required by diffusion likelihood objectives. To address this, we propose to reformulate real subset selection as a geometry-aware distribution alignment problem. By incorporating one-sided partial optimal transport, our method selectively aligns a compact subset with the full data distribution while allowing unmatched mass in low-density regions, ensuring the preserved geometric structure necessary for effective diffusion model training. To further ensure distributional fidelity, we complement geometric alignment with lightweight feature-statistics and semantic consistency regularization. An efficient two-stage discrete optimization strategy is proposed to achieve this alignment objective. Extensive experiments across diffusion variants, subset sizes, image resolutions, and training rounds show that our method achieves superior fidelity and distributional coverage in diffusion model training. Codes are available at https://github.com/2018cx/GADC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型训练中现有数据集压缩方法的不足，提出一种几何感知的分布对齐方法。通过单向部分最优运输选择真实子集，保留必要的几何结构，并辅以特征统计与语义一致性正则化，采用两阶段离散优化策略。实验表明，该方法在多种扩散变体、子集大小和分辨率下均优于现有方法，实现了更高的保真度和分布覆盖。
Motivation: 现有数据集压缩方法（合成或选择）不适用于扩散模型训练：合成数据保真度低，而真实子集选择无法保留扩散似然目标所需的分布几何结构。
Method: 将子集选择重新定义为几何感知的分布对齐问题，引入单向部分最优运输允许低密度区域不匹配，并结合轻量级特征统计与语义一致性正则化，提出高效的两阶段离散优化策略。
Result: 在扩散变体、子集大小、图像分辨率和训练轮次等设置上，该方法在生成保真度和分布覆盖方面显著优于现有数据集压缩方法。
Conclusion: 通过几何感知对齐和正则化，本文方法能有效保留扩散模型训练所需的分布结构，为数据集压缩在生成式模型中的应用提供了新思路。

papers.title: Would you still call this Dax? Novel Visual References in VLMs and Humans
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), like human learners, are frequently exposed to new visual concepts, but how they map novel visual references to language after exposure remains largely underexplored, particularly when those references contradict prior knowledge from pre-training. To study this, we present the Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD): 19,176 images spanning 90 visual concepts across different levels of visual novelty, each with up to 20 increasingly perturbed versions of the original object to probe generalization. Unlike prior work on visual augmentations of familiar concepts, NVRD comprises entirely novel, open-ended stimuli constructed from scratch, mirroring how humans encounter genuinely new concepts. We evaluate 3 open- and 2 closed-source models alongside 2,400 human judgments for direct human-model comparison, and find that (i) models struggle to acquire novel concepts in-context when they contradict prior knowledge, and (ii) while models and humans show correlated sensitivity to visual perturbations, models significantly overgeneralize, extending learned labels to stimuli that humans reject. We contribute NVRD as a corpus and benchmark for research on visual concept learning in both humans and machines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出新颖视觉参考数据集（NVRD），包含90个视觉概念、19176张图像，用于研究VLMs和人类如何习得与预训练知识矛盾的新概念。实验发现模型在上下文中学习矛盾新概念时表现不佳，且相比人类，模型会过度泛化。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注熟悉概念的视觉增强，缺乏对与预训练知识矛盾的全新视觉概念习得机制的探索。
Method: 构建NVRD数据集，包含90个视觉概念及其多达20种扰动版本；评估3个开源和2个闭源VLM与2400个人类判断。
Result: 模型在矛盾新概念上表现困难，且模型对视觉扰动的敏感性与人类相关，但模型过度泛化标签到人类拒绝的刺激。
Conclusion: 贡献NVRD作为视觉概念学习基准，揭示VLM与人类在新颖概念泛化上的关键差异。

summary_sections.method: 构建NVRD数据集，包含90个视觉概念及其多达20种扰动版本；评估3个开源和2个闭源VLM与2400个人类判断。
summary_sections.result: 模型在矛盾新概念上表现困难，且模型对视觉扰动的敏感性与人类相关，但模型过度泛化标签到人类拒绝的刺激。
summary_sections.conclusion: 贡献NVRD作为视觉概念学习基准，揭示VLM与人类在新颖概念泛化上的关键差异。

papers.title: Biomazon: A Multimodal Dataset for 3D Forest Structure and Biomass Modeling in the Amazon Basin
papers.abstract_en: Accurate, spatially explicit characterization of tropical forest structure is essential for carbon accounting and ecosystem monitoring, yet most ML pipelines predict canopy-top height proxies (e.g., RH95/RH98) or AGBD as separate scalar targets, rather than learning the forest vertical structure as an ordered profile. The community lacks a ML-ready multimodal benchmark for predicting the entire GEDI RH profile jointly with AGBD, or for evaluating methods that enforce physically consistent ordering across RH percentiles. We address this with Biomazon, a 20 m multimodal benchmark dataset over the Amazon Basin that pairs GEDI RH and AGBD targets with multi-sensor predictors (Sentinel-1/2, ALOS-2 PALSAR-2, Copernicus DEM, Dynamic World LULC, and AlphaEarth embeddings) under standardized spatial splits and evaluation protocols. Using a shared encoder-decoder with task-specific heads as a baseline framework, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study of (i) backbone/model scale, (ii) modality contributions, and (iii) the use of auxiliary embeddings under standalone and fusion settings, and we report both single-target and joint-target results to quantify tradeoffs under a unified training protocol. Finally, we contextualize baseline performance through regionally aligned comparisons against existing gridded products, including GEDI L4D RH10-RH98 and AGBD, at matching temporal scale. Biomazon, together with the accompanying protocols and baseline results, establishes a reference benchmark for future work on structurally consistent RH-profile prediction and structure-biomass modeling in tropical forests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Biomazon是一个20米分辨率的多模态基准数据集，覆盖亚马逊盆地，用于联合预测GEDI RH剖面和地上生物量密度（AGBD）。数据集结合Sentinel-1/2、ALOS-2 PALSAR-2、Copernicus DEM等多源传感器数据，并提供标准化的空间划分和评估协议。基线模型采用共享编码器-解码器结构，实验评估了骨干网络规模、模态贡献和辅助嵌入的影响。
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法通常将森林冠层高度代理变量（如RH95/RH98）或AGBD作为独立标量预测，缺乏对森林垂直结构的有序剖面学习。社区缺少用于联合预测完整GEDI RH剖面和AGBD的多模态基准。
Method: 构建Biomazon数据集，配对准GEDI RH和AGBD目标与多传感器预测因子（Sentinel-1/2, ALOS-2 PALSAR-2, Copernicus DEM, Dynamic World LULC, AlphaEarth embeddings），采用共享编码器-解码器基线框架进行消融研究。
Result: 报告了单目标和联合目标结果，量化了骨干网络规模、模态贡献和辅助嵌入的影响，并与现有网格产品（GEDI L4D）进行区域对比。
Conclusion: Biomazon为热带森林中结构一致的RH剖面预测和结构-生物量建模提供了参考基准。

papers.title: Knockoffs-based False Discovery Rate Control and Simplification for Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The deep neural network is a widely used framework in machine learning that has been widely applied in various fields. However, deep neural networks often involve a large number of parameters and inputs, many of which may be irrelevant to the goal or true output. These parameters and input variables not only increase computational complexity, but also contribute to additional computational cost. One solution to this problem is knockoff methods, which have proven successful in controlling false discovery rates in high-dimensional regression. Building on the knockoff methods and using the regularised neural network, this paper proposes three variable screening methods under the condition of controlling false discovery rates: one layer filter, multiple layers filter, and variable weight aggregation filter. In comparison with existing algorithms, we find that our algorithms show satisfactory performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络中大量冗余参数和输入变量导致计算成本高的问题，基于knockoffs方法和正则化神经网络，提出三种控制假发现率（FDR）的变量筛选方法：单层滤波器、多层滤波器和变量权重聚合滤波器。实验表明，与现有算法相比，这些方法在控制FDR的同时表现出令人满意的性能。
Motivation: 深度神经网络中许多参数和输入变量与目标无关，增加了计算复杂性，需要有效的方法筛选相关变量并控制假发现率。
Method: 利用knockoffs方法和正则化神经网络，设计了三种变量筛选方法：单层滤波器（每次筛选一层）、多层滤波器（逐层筛选）和变量权重聚合滤波器（聚合权重进行筛选）。
Result: 与现有算法相比，所提方法在控制假发现率方面表现令人满意。
Conclusion: 基于knockoffs的变量筛选方法能够有效控制深度神经网络中的假发现率，减少冗余参数。

papers.title: Attention mechanisms and transfer learning for robust peach leaf damage classification under domain shift
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence provides a practical framework for crop damage assessment from imagery data, supporting early decision-making in agricultural management. In peach orchards, climate change increases abiotic stress and biotic pressures, including pests and diseases, which often produce visually similar foliar symptoms. This overlap makes manual diagnosis difficult, especially across multiple fields with varying environmental conditions, highlighting the need for automated models with strong generalization ability. We propose an image-based classification approach for peach leaf damage detection. A benchmark dataset was created through manual annotation of publicly available images, consisting of 1,366 peach leaves across six damage categories. Several deep learning architectures were evaluated. EfficientNet models achieved the best results, with EfficientNetB0 reaching 92.9 percent accuracy, EfficientNetB3 achieving 91.5 percent, and EfficientNetB5 showing the strongest performance on minority classes. DenseNet121 reached 92.6 percent accuracy. The integration of the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) improved performance in several backbones, particularly EfficientNetB5 and InceptionV3, while showing limited or negative impact in others. The CBAM-enhanced EfficientNetB5 achieved the best overall accuracy of 93.3 percent. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, a local dataset of 180 images across four classes was collected, and transfer learning strategies were applied to address domain shift. Three fine-tuning strategies were tested. EfficientNetB3 combined with CBAM achieved the best performance in the local domain, reaching a 93 percent macro F1-score after transfer. Overall, attention-based models showed improved robustness for minority classes and better generalization across different field conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于图像分类的桃树叶损伤检测方法，构建了包含1366片桃叶、6个损伤类别的基准数据集。评估多种深度学习架构，EfficientNet系列表现最佳，集成卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）进一步提升性能，CBAM增强的EfficientNetB5达到93.3%准确率。在本地数据集上应用迁移学习应对域迁移，EfficientNetB3+CBAM在微调后达到93%宏F1分数。
Motivation: 气候变化加剧桃园非生物胁迫和生物压力，不同损伤类型视觉上相似，人工诊断困难且跨田块泛化能力差，需要自动化且泛化性强的模型。
Method: 通过人工标注构建桃叶损伤基准数据集，评估多种CNN架构（EfficientNet、DenseNet等），集成CBAM注意力模块，并在本地小数据集上测试三种微调策略以应对域迁移。
Result: EfficientNetB0达92.9%准确率，DenseNet121达92.6%，CBAM增强的EfficientNetB5最佳达93.3%。迁移学习后EfficientNetB3+CBAM在本地域达93%宏F1分数。
Conclusion: 基于注意力机制的模型在少数类鲁棒性和跨田间泛化方面表现更好，CBAM模块对多数骨干网络有提升，但对部分网络影响有限或负面。

papers.title: Improving Visual Token Reduction via Rectifying Distortions for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in vision-language tasks, yet the quadratic computational complexity arising from the vast number of visual tokens incurs significant memory and latency bottlenecks. While visual token reduction (VTR) strategies have been explored to mitigate this burden, existing methods overlook the positional and attentional consistency between the full and reduced sequences, resulting in a distorted representation. To this end, we propose RESTORE, a novel VTR framework that rectifies the positional and attentional distortions while maintaining efficiency. Specifically, we present a simple yet effective calibration method that restores lost visual attention by augmenting attention weights based on relative distances. We also introduce a distinctive anchor selection for token merging to mitigate information loss during feature averaging. Experimental results on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently improves the accuracy of various reduction methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Project page is available at https://cvlab.yonsei.ac.kr/projects/RESTORE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RESTORE 框架，通过校正视觉 token 缩减过程中的位置和注意力失真，提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的推理效率与准确性。该方法包含基于相对距离的注意力权重校准和用于 token 合并的锚点选择策略，在多个基准上取得了最先进的性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 缩减方法忽略了完整序列与缩减序列之间的位置和注意力一致性，导致表示失真，从而影响多模态大语言模型的性能。
Method: 提出 RESTORE 框架，包含两个核心组件：一是通过基于相对距离的注意力权重增强来恢复丢失的视觉注意力；二是引入独特的锚点选择机制用于 token 合并，以减少特征平均过程中的信息损失。
Result: 实验结果显示，该方法在多个基准上一致提升了不同缩减方法的准确性，达到了最先进的性能，同时保持计算效率。
Conclusion: 通过校正位置和注意力失真，RESTORE 能够在不牺牲效率的前提下显著提升视觉 token 缩减方法的效果。

papers.title: Trust Region On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is a fundamental technique for efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), with broad applications in agent learning, multi-task enhancement, and model compression. However, OPD training becomes unstable when the teacher and student distributions differ substantially, as teacher supervision on student-generated tokens may yield unreliable policy gradients and even cause optimization failure. This work addresses reliable on-policy token-level supervision through credit assignment strategies, and proposes Trust Region On-Policy Distillation, TrOPD. It features the following characteristics: 1) Trust-Region On-Policy Learning: TrOPD performs OPD only in regions where the teacher provides reliable supervision, mitigating the optimization difficulty of the K1 reverse-KL estimator under distribution mismatch. 2) Outlier Estimation: For outlier regions, we explore gradient clipping, masking, and forward-KL estimation to reduce the adverse effects of unreliable supervision. 3) Off-Policy Guidance: The student continues generation from teacher prefixes and uses forward KL to imitate off-policy guidance, encouraging on-policy exploration toward reliable regions. Experiments show that TrOPD consistently outperforms SoTA OPD baselines, including OPD, EOPD, and REOPOLD, across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and general-domain benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Trust Region On-Policy Distillation (TrOPD)，一种针对大语言模型在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中师生分布差异导致训练不稳定的改进方法。TrOPD通过信任区域学习、异常值估计和离策略引导三种策略，仅在教师提供可靠监督的区域进行蒸馏，并缓解分布不匹配下的优化困难。实验表明，在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上，TrOPD优于OPD、EOPD和REOPOLD等现有方法。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中，当教师与学生分布差异较大时，教师对学生生成标记的监督可能产生不可靠的策略梯度，导致训练不稳定甚至优化失败。现有方法缺乏对可靠逐标记监督的信用分配策略。
Method: 提出TrOPD，包含三个组件：1) 信任区域在线学习：仅在教师提供可靠监督的区域进行OPD，缓解K1反向KL估计器在分布不匹配下的优化困难；2) 异常值估计：对异常区域采用梯度裁剪、掩码和前向KL估计来减少不可靠监督的影响；3) 离策略引导：学生从教师前缀继续生成，并使用前向KL模仿离策略引导，促进在线探索朝向可靠区域。
Result: 在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上，TrOPD一致优于SoTA OPD基线（OPD、EOPD、REOPOLD）。
Conclusion: TrOPD通过信任区域机制和离策略引导有效解决了OPD中因分布不匹配导致的训练不稳定问题，为LLM后训练提供了一种更可靠的蒸馏方法。

papers.title: SkillRevise: Improving LLM-Authored Agent Skills via Trace-Conditioned Skill Revision
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are procedural artifacts that enable LLM agents to execute workflows, verify constraints, and recover from failures. Existing self-evolving methods refine skills using accumulated trajectories. However, they struggle in cold-start settings, where only an initial, imperfect skill is available. Consequently, skill construction defaults to expert authoring or one-shot LLM generation. Expert-authored skills are costly and may not align with how LLM agents actually execute tasks, while one-shot generated skills can be syntactically well formed yet behaviorally weak. To bridge this gap, we propose SkillRevise, an execution-grounded framework designed to iteratively refine these initial skills. SkillRevise diagnoses skill defects from execution evidence, retrieves relevant repair principles from a general memory, and applies execution-anchored edits. By re-executing candidates, it retains the first verifier-passing skill within the revision budget and falls back to empirical utility only when no candidate succeeds. Evaluated across three benchmarks and five LLMs, SkillRevise substantially outperforms one-shot baselines, improving the base agent's success rate on SkillsBench from 36.05% to 61.63%. Furthermore, the revised skills transfer across both executors and task environments, suggesting that SkillRevise captures reusable procedural knowledge beyond any single executor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillRevise框架，用于迭代优化LLM agent的初始技能（skill）。通过执行证据诊断技能缺陷，从通用记忆中检索修复原则，并应用执行锚定的编辑。在三个基准和五个LLM上评估，将SkillsBench成功率从36.05%提升至61.63%，且修订后的技能可跨执行器和任务环境迁移。
Motivation: 现有自进化方法在冷启动场景（只有初始不完美技能）下表现不佳，专家编写成本高且可能与实际执行不一致，一次性生成的技能语法正确但行为弱。
Method: SkillRevise框架：从执行证据诊断技能缺陷，检索相关修复原则，应用执行锚定的编辑；通过重执行候选技能，在预算内保留首个通过验证器的技能，无候选通过时回退到经验效用。
Result: 在SkillsBench上基础agent成功率从36.05%提升至61.63%；修订技能可跨执行器和任务环境迁移。
Conclusion: SkillRevise能够捕获可重用的程序性知识，超越单次执行器，在冷启动场景下有效改进LLM agent技能。

papers.title: AI Sovereignty as National Learning Capacity: A Human-Centered Learning Mechanics Viewpoint on France, the United States, and China
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence in France is often discussed through separate dimensions such as investment, compute, regulation, employment, sovereignty, and education. This viewpoint paper proposes a unified interpretation: France can be analyzed as a national AI learning system. Building on Human-Centered Learning Mechanics (HCLM), we use HCLM not as a validated econometric model, but as a conceptual and diagnostic lens for interpreting national AI development as a balance between information injection, absorptive capacity, and institutional dissipation. Information injection includes compute, data, talent, research, capital, industrial deployment, and policy experimentation. Institutional dissipation refers to avoidable frictions such as administrative overload, coordination failures, energy constraints, regulatory uncertainty, talent mobility pressures, and weak industrial absorption. Regulation is not treated as mere friction: adaptive governance, trusted data spaces, and safety-oriented standards may increase long-term learning capacity by improving legitimacy, interoperability, and social trust. The central claim is not that a country follows neural-network equations, but that AI sovereignty depends on how effectively it converts distributed information into absorbed, coordinated, and socially legitimate capability. The paper connects HCLM with neural scaling laws, endogenous growth theory, creative destruction, absorptive capacity, and coordination mechanisms. It offers a formal heuristic, policy indicators, illustrative scenarios, and implications for France. The numerical results are diagnostic scenarios, not econometric estimates or official rankings. The proposed viewpoint reframes AI policy as the governance of an open, strategic, non-equilibrium learning system that should be tested with historical and cross-country data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将法国等国家的AI发展视为一个全国性的学习系统，基于人类中心学习力学（HCLM）作为概念诊断框架。核心观点是AI主权取决于国家将分散信息转化为吸收、协调和社会合法能力的效果，而不是是否遵循神经网络方程。论文将HCLM与神经缩放定律、内生增长理论等连接，提供形式化启发式、政策指标和情景分析，但强调数值结果是诊断情景而非经济计量估计。
Motivation: 法国在AI领域的讨论常分散于投资、算力、监管、就业等维度，缺乏统一解释框架。本文旨在提出一个整合视角，将国家AI发展视为学习系统，并检验其作为政策分析工具的可行性。
Method: 基于人类中心学习力学（HCLM），将信息注入（算力、数据、人才、资本等）与机构耗散（行政负担、协调失灵、监管不确定性等）作为关键平衡变量，并纳入自适应治理和社会信任等非摩擦因素。通过形式化启发式、政策指标和情景分析来阐述观点。
Result: 未提供实证结果，仅给出诊断性情景分析。论文自身指出数值结果是诊断场景，而非经济计量估计或官方排名。
Conclusion: AI政策应被视为对开放、战略性、非平衡学习系统的治理，而非单纯的投资或监管问题。建议未来使用历史数据和跨国数据进行检验。

papers.title: Pre-Deployment Robustness Stress Testing for CT Segmentation Systems Using Clinically Motivated Multi-Corruption Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based CT segmentation systems often achieve high accuracy on clean benchmark images, but their performance may degrade under heterogeneous clinical imaging conditions such as noise, resolution loss, contrast variation, intensity shift, and artifacts. This instability can limit reliable deployment in real-world medical imaging workflows. We propose Robustness via Augmented Multi-corruption Pipeline (RAMP), a robustness-oriented augmentation framework for CT segmentation. RAMP combines anatomically constrained spatial perturbations, CT intensity transformations, and stochastic multi-corruption composition to expose models to clinically plausible image degradation during training. Across two CT segmentation evaluation settings, RAMP achieved the strongest corrupted-image performance and the smallest clean-to-corrupted robustness gap. In the five-organ noisy evaluation benchmark, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.610 to 0.753 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.264 to 0.064 compared with the nnU-Net baseline. In Abdomen1K, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.633 to 0.789 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.290 to 0.070. Although RAMP did not achieve the highest clean-image Dice, it substantially mitigated worst-case segmentation collapse under severe image degradation. These results suggest that multi-corruption augmentation can serve as a practical pre-deployment strategy for improving the reliability of CT segmentation systems in heterogeneous clinical environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAMP框架，通过结合解剖约束的空间扰动、CT强度变换和随机多损坏组合的数据增强方法，提升CT分割系统在临床异质成像条件下的鲁棒性。实验表明，该方法在噪声评估基准上将平均损坏Dice从0.610提升至0.753，鲁棒性差距从0.264降至0.064，显著缓解了严重图像退化下的分割崩溃。
Motivation: 深度学习CT分割系统在干净图像上性能优异，但在噪声、分辨率损失、对比度变化等临床异质条件下性能下降，限制了实际部署。
Method: 提出鲁棒性增强的多损坏管道（RAMP），包括解剖约束的空间扰动、CT强度变换和随机多损坏组合，在训练时对模型暴露临床可行的图像退化。
Result: 在两个CT分割评估中，RAMP实现了最强的损坏图像性能和最小的干净-损坏鲁棒性差距。在五器官噪声基准上，平均损坏Dice从0.610提高到0.753，鲁棒性差距从0.264降至0.064；在Abdomen1K上，平均损坏Dice从0.633提高到0.789，鲁棒性差距从0.290降至0.070。
Conclusion: 多损坏增强可作为CT分割系统部署前提升可靠性的实用策略，但未达到最高干净图像Dice。

papers.title: The New Social Image: How AI Competency and AI Proactivity Influence Self- and Peer-Perceptions in the Workplace
papers.abstract_en: Human-AI collaboration is considered the most promising way to incorporate AI in the workplace. What remains unexplored are the experiential consequences of this teaming. More specifically, in a team with AI, how humans perceive themselves (self-perception) and how they are perceived by their coworkers (peer perception) in terms of work ownership and job meaningfulness. In a 2x2x2 vignette study (n=50), participants rated perceptions of ownership, affect, job meaningfulness and satisfaction, and role dynamics across two levels (low/high) of AI proactivity and AI competency as within-subject factors, with point-of-view (self perception/peer perception) as between-subjects. Our results showed that AI with low competency or low proactivity generally improved feelings related to ownership, meaningfulness, satisfaction, and role dynamics, and also increased positive affect while reducing negative affect. However, these effects were often influenced by point-of-view. For instance, low AI proactivity resulted in higher job satisfaction from self-perception rather than peer perception. Based on our findings, we argue that designing AI for the future of work solely around performance metrics may not be adequate. Highly competent and proactive AI-driven systems can have undesirable impacts on perceptions of ownership, job identity, social image and team dynamics, and consequently, job meaningfulness.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过2x2x2情境实验（n=50），探究AI的能力（competency）与主动性（proactivity）对员工工作所有权感、工作意义感、工作满意度及角色动态的自我感知与同事感知的影响。结果表明，低能力或低主动性的AI通常提升积极感知，但视角（自我vs.同事）显著调节效应。作者据此指出，仅以性能指标设计未来工作AI可能不足，高能力高主动性的AI可能损害工作身份和团队动态。
Motivation: 人机协作被视为AI融入工作场所的最佳方式，但团队中AI如何影响人类对自身工作所有权和意义的感知（自我与同事视角）尚待探索。
Method: 采用2（AI能力：高/低）×2（AI主动性：高/低）×2（视角：自我/同事）混合设计的情境实验，50名被试评估所有权、情感、意义感、满意度和角色动态。
Result: 低能力或低主动性的AI通常改善所有权、意义感、满意度和角色动态，并增加积极情感、减少消极情感；但效应受视角调节，例如低主动性从自我视角而非同事视角带来更高满意度。
Conclusion: 未来AI设计不应仅围绕性能指标，高能力高主动性的AI可能对工作所有权、身份、社会形象和团队动态产生不良影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PatchWorld: Gradient-Free Optimization of Executable World Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-agent environments are typically modeled as partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), assuming that the simulator's latent state and transition dynamics are hidden from the agent. Yet little work has examined whether executable code can be induced to serve as a world model for prediction and planning under partial observability. We introduce PatchWorld, a gradient-free framework that turns offline trajectories into executable Python world models through counterexample-guided code repair. Instead of predicting the next observation with a black-box model, PatchWorld induces symbolic belief-state programs whose action updates can be inspected, replayed, and locally patched. Across seven AgentGym environments, PatchWorld-Simple achieves the highest code-based planning score among evaluated methods, reaching 76.4\% macro success in live one-step lookahead while invoking no LLM calls inside the world-model prediction module itself. We further find that a human-specified residual-memory bias improves surface observation fidelity but weakens decision utility. This exposes a tradeoff in executable world models, since improving observation fidelity can come at the expense of action-discriminative dynamics, and vice versa. Code is available at https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/PatchWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PatchWorld，一种无需梯度的框架，通过反例引导的代码修复将离线轨迹转化为可执行的 Python 世界模型。在七个 AgentGym 环境中，PatchWorld-Simple 在不调用 LLM 的情况下达到 76.4% 的宏成功率（一步前瞻）。研究发现观测保真度与决策效用之间存在权衡，残差记忆偏差虽提高表面精度但削弱行动判别能力。
Motivation: 现有文本智能体环境通常视为 POMDP，但缺乏利用可执行代码作为可解释世界模型进行预测和规划的方法。
Method: PatchWorld 通过反例引导的代码修复，从离线轨迹诱导出符号信念状态程序，支持动作更新的检查、重放和局部修补，无需梯度或黑箱预测。
Result: 在七个 AgentGym 环境中，PatchWorld-Simple 达到 76.4% 宏成功率（一步前瞻），且世界模型预测模块不调用 LLM。同时发现，人为指定的残差记忆偏差可提高观测保真度但降低决策效用，表明可执行世界模型存在权衡。
Conclusion: 可执行世界模型中观测保真度与行动判别动态之间存在内在权衡，需根据具体任务平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are increasingly used for scientific work, but their end-to-end autonomous research capability remains difficult to verify. We present ResearchClawBench, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target scientific artifacts into weighted criteria, enabling evaluation of target-paper-level re-discovery while leaving room for new discovery. We evaluate seven autonomous research (auto-research) agents under a unified protocol and seventeen native LLMs through the lightweight ResearchHarness. Current systems remain far from reliable re-discovery: the strongest autonomous agent, Claude Code, averages 21.5, and the strongest ResearchHarness LLM, Claude-Opus-4.7, averages 20.7, with an LLM frontier mean of only 26.5. Error analysis shows that failures concentrate in experimental protocol mismatch, evidence mismatch, and missing scientific core. ResearchClawBench provides a reproducible evaluation frontier for measuring progress toward autonomous scientific research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResearchClawBench 是一个评估端到端自主科研能力的基准，包含10个科学领域的40个任务，每个任务基于真实已发表论文。通过专家策划的多模态评分标准评估目标论文级别的再发现能力。当前最强自主智能体 Claude Code 平均得分21.5，最强LLM Claude-Opus-4.7平均得分20.7，LLM前沿平均仅26.5。错误分析表明失败集中在实验方案不匹配、证据不匹配和科学核心缺失。
Motivation: 现有AI编码智能体被用于科研工作，但端到端自主科研能力难以验证，缺乏统一的评估基准。
Method: 构建包含40个任务、覆盖10个科学领域的基准，每个任务基于真实论文并提供相关文献和原始数据，隐藏目标论文；专家制定多模态评分标准，分解目标科学产物为加权准则，评估再发现能力。
Result: 最强自主智能体 Claude Code 平均得分21.5，最强LLM Claude-Opus-4.7平均得分20.7，LLM前沿平均仅26.5；失败集中在实验方案不匹配、证据不匹配和科学核心缺失。
Conclusion: 当前系统距离可靠再发现仍有很大差距，ResearchClawBench 为衡量自主科研进展提供了可复现的评估边界。

papers.title: Notation Matters: A Benchmark Study of Token-Optimized Formats in Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models in Agentic AI systems consume tool schemas and execution results and emit tool invocations as structured data. The default language for that exchange, JSON, was designed for application-to-application interchange rather than token efficiency, so its structural elements impose substantial token overhead. Recent work proposes token-optimized alternatives such as TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) and TRON (Token Reduced Object Notation) as more compact replacements, but these formats have been evaluated only on isolated comprehension or generation tasks. Whether their token reductions hold inside end-to-end agentic loops therefore remains an open question. We evaluate TOON and TRON on four agentic benchmarks (BFCL, MCPToolBenchPP, MCP-Universe, StableToolBench) and five open-weight LLMs, decoupling input compression from output compression to measure comprehension and generation independently. TRON reduces tokens by up to 27% with accuracy within 14pp of the JSON baseline. TOON achieves up to 18% reduction at a similar 9pp accuracy cost, but additionally cascades on multi-turn parsing failures and collapses parallel tool-call output for most models. The code is available at: https://github.com/lkutschka/notation-matters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Agentic AI系统中默认JSON格式的token开销问题，评估了两种token优化格式TOON和TRON。在四个基准（BFCL、MCPToolBenchPP等）和五个开源LLM上，将输入与输出压缩解耦进行测试。TRON最多减少27% token，准确率下降14个百分点；TOON减少18% token，准确率下降9个百分点，但存在多轮解析失败和并行工具调用输出崩溃问题。
Motivation: JSON在Agentic AI系统中作为工具调用和数据交换的默认格式，其结构性元素带来大量token开销。已有替代格式（TOON和TRON）仅在孤立任务上测试，其在端到端agent循环中的实际效果尚未被验证。
Method: 将输入压缩和输出压缩解耦，在BFCL、MCPToolBenchPP、MCP-Universe、StableToolBench四个基准上，使用五个开源LLM，独立测量TOON和TRON相比JSON的token压缩率和任务准确率。
Result: TRON减少token最多27%，准确率保持在JSON基线的14个百分点内；TOON减少18% token，准确率下降9个百分点，但出现多轮解析失败和并行工具调用输出崩溃等级联问题。
Conclusion: TRON在保持合理准确率的同时显著降低token消耗，而TOON存在额外故障模式，不适合端到端agent系统。代码已开源。

papers.title: LLM-Evolved Domain-Independent Heuristics for Symbolic AI Planning
papers.abstract_en: Heuristic search is the dominant paradigm in symbolic AI planning, and the strongest heuristics are the result of decades of work by planning researchers. Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can design heuristics for individual planning domains, but no LLM-generated heuristic has so far worked on arbitrary planning tasks. In this paper, we use evolutionary search to produce the first LLM-generated domain-independent heuristics that exceed the hand-engineered state of the art. We let an LLM mutate parent heuristics written in C++, store candidates in a MAP-Elites archive keyed on informedness and speed and calculate fitness scores by blending coverage with solving time. To place the evolved programs in context, we additionally benchmark a broad set of hand-engineered heuristics on their informedness-speed tradeoff, which to our knowledge has not been done before. On unseen testing domains, our best evolved heuristic solves more tasks than even the strongest baseline, with our full heuristic suite spanning the Pareto frontier of said tradeoff. We also find that seeding evolution from the trivial blind heuristic outperforms seeding from the strong FF heuristic, even when the resulting program is itself an FF variant, and that LLM reasoning effort affects how often candidates compile much more than the quality of those that do. Because the evolved programs are plain C++, they slot into existing planners as drop-in replacements and inherit the soundness and completeness guarantees of the underlying search.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用进化搜索让大语言模型（LLM）生成领域无关的启发式函数，用于符号AI规划。生成的C++启发式在未见过的测试域上超越了手工设计的强基线，并且可以即插即用。此外还评估了手工启发式的信息性和速度权衡。
Motivation: 现有LLM生成的启发式只针对特定领域，无法应用于任意规划任务。本文目标是产生首个领域无关且超越手工现状的LLM生成启发式。
Method: 让LLM变异用C++写的父启发式，将候选启发式存储在MAP-Elites存档中，键为信息性和速度，适应度分数结合覆盖率和求解时间。从盲目启发式或FF启发式开始进化。
Result: 最佳进化启发式在未见测试域上解决了比最强基线更多的任务，整个启发式套件覆盖了信息性-速度权衡的帕累托前沿。从盲目启发式开始比从FF启发式开始更好。
Conclusion: 进化后的程序是纯C++，可以替换现有规划器中的启发式，继承底层搜索的可靠性和完备性保证。作者发现LLM推理努力影响编译成功率而非质量。

papers.title: Latent-Conditioned Parameterized Quantum Circuits as Universal Approximators for Distributions over Quantum States
papers.abstract_en: Many applications in quantum simulation, quantum chemistry, and quantum machine learning require not a single quantum state but an ensemble of states characterizing the heterogeneity of a target system. Preparing such ensembles state-by-state is prohibitive in both variational and fault-tolerant settings, thereby motivating a generative modeling approach. We introduce latent-conditioned parameterized quantum circuits (LPQCs), a hybrid quantum-classical framework in which classical neural networks map a latent variable sampled from a prior distribution to the parameters of a parameterized quantum circuit. We prove that LPQCs are universal approximators for probability measures over density operators in the 1-Wasserstein distance, extending classical universal approximation theorems to the quantum-distribution setting. We additionally introduce a multimodal latent prior and a mixture-of-experts circuit architecture, and show empirically that the latent-conditioned parameterization alleviates the barren plateau problem during optimization, a behavior for which we provide rigorous partial guarantees. Numerical experiments validate the framework on a synthetic multi-cluster ensemble of mixed quantum states and on a QM9-derived ensemble of 3-D molecular structures. In these tasks, LPQC outperforms recent quantum generative baselines and matches the generation quality of a classical neural-network baseline, while requiring an output dimension that grows only linearly with the number of qubits rather than exponentially. By leveraging classical expressivity in the latent space, LPQCs offer a tractable route to quantum generative modeling.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出潜在条件参数化量子电路（LPQC），一种混合量子-经典生成框架，其中经典神经网络将潜在变量映射到参数化量子电路的参数。证明LPQC在1-Wasserstein距离下是密度算符上概率测度的万能近似器，并引入多模态潜在先验和混合专家电路架构。实验表明LPQC缓解了贫瘠高原问题，在合成多簇混合量子态和QM9分子结构数据集上优于近期量子生成基线，生成质量匹配经典基线，且输出维度随量子比特数线性增长而非指数。
Motivation: 量子模拟、量子化学和量子机器学习中的许多应用需要量子态集合而非单一量子态，但逐状态制备在变分和容错设定下均不可行，亟需一种生成式建模方法。
Method: 提出LPQC框架：经典神经网络将从一个先验分布中采样的潜在变量映射为参数化量子电路的参数，从而生成量子态的分布；同时引入多模态潜在先验和混合专家电路架构。
Result: 理论证明LPQC是1-Wasserstein距离下密度算符概率测度的万能近似器，并给出缓解贫瘠高原问题的部分严格保证。实验上，在合成多簇混合量子态和QM9分子结构任务中，LPQC优于近期量子生成基线，生成质量与经典神经网络基线相当，且输出维度仅随量子比特数线性增长。
Conclusion: LPQC通过利用经典网络在潜在空间的表达能力，为量子生成建模提供了一条可处理的路径，避免了指数级输出维度。

papers.title: Triangular-Reference Schrödinger Bridges for Time Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Schrödinger bridges for time series (SBTS) generate synthetic paths by projecting, in relative entropy, a Brownian reference onto the path laws that match the joint distribution of the data on the observation grid. The Brownian reference, however, fixes the quadratic variation of the generated paths, which is restrictive when stochastic volatility, correlated noise, or rank-deficient covariance structures must be reproduced. We introduce "Triangular-Reference Schrödinger Bridges for Time Series" (TR-SBTS), which keeps the entropy-projection backbone of SBTS but replaces the Brownian reference by a triangular, volatility-informed, intervalwise frozen reference on a state augmented with latent covariance descriptors. The construction remains a single entropy projection on the augmented state: the minimiser is the \(h\)-transform of the reference, and on each frozen interval the optimal drift has the logarithmic-gradient form \(b^\star(t,x)=A\,\nabla\log H(t,x)\), intrinsic to the active covariance directions when the frozen covariance \(A\) is degenerate. We prove stability of the frozen approximation and consistency of the associated regularised kernel estimators, describe a reference-aware Nadaraya--Watson implementation of the conditional next-increment law, and evaluate the construction on numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列生成中布朗参考桥（SBTS）限制二次变分的问题，提出三角参考薛定谔桥（TR-SBTS），用三角波动率感知的区间冻结参考替换布朗参考，并在增广状态空间上执行单一熵投影。理论证明了冻结近似的稳定性和核估计量的一致性，并给出了参考感知的Nadaraya-Watson实现。
Motivation: 现有SBTS方法使用布朗参考，固定了生成路径的二次变分，无法再现随机波动率、相关噪声或秩亏协方差结构，限制了生成时间序列的真实性。
Method: 保持SBTS的熵投影框架，将布朗参考替换为基于三角分解、波动率感知的区间冻结参考，并在增广状态（含隐式协方差描述符）上执行单一熵投影；最优漂移形式为b^*(t,x)=A∇log H(t,x)，适用于冻结协方差A退化的情况。
Result: 理论证明了冻结近似的稳定性和正则化核估计量的一致性，数值实验展示了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: TR-SBTS通过引入更灵活的参考过程，扩展了SBTS的能力，能够生成具有随机波动率和复杂协方差结构的时间序列，但文中未提及具体应用场景。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: Practical Anonymous Two-Party Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
papers.abstract_en: Structured data is well handled by gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDT), which are usually trained on vertically partitioned features across mutually distrustful parties. High speed and interpretability make GBDTs popular in finance and healthcare, where neural networks may fall short. Enabling secure computation for GBDTs poses unique challenges, requiring secure record alignment for comparison. Relying on private set intersection (PSI) is a de facto approach. Mistaking PSI for a safety measure actually exposes which record identifiers (IDs) are shared between the datasets. Although circuit-PSI could help, it is costly for generic uses. New ideas are needed to efficiently train in a "dark forest". Aiming to hide the IDs, we initiate the study of anonymous GBDT training on split data held by two parties. Dual circuit-PSI in our design lets the parties alternate as receiver to run pick-then-sum over local features. Via oblivious programmable pseudorandom functions, we propagate circuit-PSI outputs as shared state across runs. Avoiding universal alignment, we resolve the neglected dilemma that ID hiding incurs a cost that scales with domain size. Next, we halve the cost of ciphertext packing used to convert single-instruction multiple-data homomorphic encryption from (ring) learning with errors in prior secure GBDT (Usenix Security' 23) and related secure machine-learning computations. Comparative experiments show our protocol remains competitive with leaky approaches in efficiency. Enabling ID-hiding aggregation, our techniques can extend to other vertically partitioned analytics.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在垂直分割数据上训练梯度提升决策树（GBDT）时隐藏记录标识符（ID）的问题。提出匿名双人GBDT训练协议，利用双电路私有集合交集（circuit-PSI）和可编程伪随机函数（OPPRF）实现ID隐藏聚合，并优化了密文打包的开销。实验表明该协议在效率上与有泄漏的方法相当。
Motivation: 现有安全GBDT训练依赖私有集合交集（PSI）对齐记录，但PSI会暴露共享记录ID，而电路-PSI成本高。需要高效的方法在隐藏ID的情况下训练GBDT。
Method: 提出双电路PSI设计，双方交替作为接收者执行本地特征的pick-then-sum操作；通过可编程伪随机函数传播电路PSI输出作为共享状态；避免全局对齐，并将ID隐藏的开销与域大小解耦；同时将密文打包的开销减半（基于环学习误差的同态加密）。
Result: 实验表明，该协议在效率上与有泄漏的方法具有竞争力，并实现了ID隐藏聚合。
Conclusion: 该技术可扩展到其他垂直分割数据分析任务，实现了ID隐藏聚合。
