papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究假设选择问题：给定候选分布集合和未知分布P的样本，输出一个与P距离接近最优的分布。证明了混合输出算法的最优近似比下界为3-2/n（除非样本数随域大小多项式增长），并给出达到相同近似比的多项式时间算法。在proper设置中，将时间复杂度从Õ(n/(δ³ε³))改进到Õ(n/(δε²))。
Motivation: 现有improper算法近似比C=2但运行时间随域大小多项式增长，对实值分布不可行；混合输出算法有望提升效率，但其最优近似比未知。
Method: 提出下界：混合输出算法无法优于C=3-2/n（除非样本数多项式依赖|X|）；同时给出运行时间poly(n)的算法达到相同近似比。在proper设置中，优化算法时间复杂度至Õ(n/(δε²))。
Result: 混合输出算法近似比下界为C=3-2/n；新算法在proper设置中运行时间Õ(n/(δε²))，显著降低对置信度和误差参数的依赖。
Conclusion: 混合输出算法无法突破C=3-2/n的近似比，但poly(n)时间可实现该下界；proper设置中有更高效的新算法。

papers.title: Surrogate Benchmarks for Model Merging Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Model merging techniques aim to integrate the abilities of multiple models into a single model. Most model merging techniques have hyperparameters, and their setting affects the performance of the merged model. Because several existing works show that tuning hyperparameters in model merging can enhance the merging outcome, developing hyperparameter optimization algorithms for model merging is a promising direction. However, its optimization process is computationally expensive, particularly in merging LLMs. In this work, we develop surrogate benchmarks for optimization of the merging hyperparameters to realize algorithm development and performance comparison at low cost. We define two search spaces and collect data samples to construct surrogate models to predict the performance of a merged model from a hyperparameter. We demonstrate that our benchmarks can predict the performance of merged models well and simulate optimization algorithm behaviors.
papers.comment: AutoML 2025 Non-Archival Content Track. The code of the surrogate benchmark is available at https://github.com/shiralab/SMM-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于模型合并超参数优化的替代基准（surrogate benchmarks），通过构建替代模型预测合并模型的性能，以低成本实现算法开发和性能比较。实验表明，该基准能准确预测合并模型性能并模拟优化算法行为。
Motivation: 模型合并的超参数优化计算成本高，尤其在大语言模型上，需要低成本方法来支持算法开发和性能比较。
Method: 定义两个搜索空间，收集数据样本构建替代模型（surrogate models），预测从超参数到合并模型性能的映射。
Result: 替代基准能准确预测合并模型性能，并有效模拟优化算法行为。
Conclusion: 该基准为模型合并超参数优化提供了低成本实验平台。

papers.title: PosterForest: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Collaboration for Scientific Poster Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automating scientific poster generation requires hierarchical document understanding and coherent content-layout planning. Existing methods often rely on flat summarization or optimize content and layout separately. As a result, they often suffer from information loss, weak logical flow, and poor visual balance. We present PosterForest, a training-free framework for scientific poster generation. Our method introduces the Poster Tree, a structured intermediate representation that captures document hierarchy and visual-textual semantics across multiple levels. Building on this representation, content and layout agents perform hierarchical reasoning and recursive refinement, progressively optimizing the poster from global organization to local composition. This joint optimization improves semantic coherence, logical flow, and visual harmony. Experiments show that PosterForest outperforms prior methods in both automatic and human evaluations, without additional training or domain-specific supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PosterForest，一种无需训练的框架用于自动生成科研海报。通过引入树形中间表示（Poster Tree）捕获文档层次结构和视觉-文本语义，并由内容与布局代理进行分层推理和递归细化，从全局到局部联合优化海报。实验在自动评估和人工评估上均优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有自动海报生成方法依赖平面摘要或分别优化内容与布局，导致信息丢失、逻辑连贯性差和视觉失衡。
Method: 提出 PosterForest，基于 Poster Tree 中间表示，内容代理和布局代理执行分层推理与递归细化，实现内容与布局的联合优化。
Result: 在自动评估和人工评估中均优于先前方法，且无需额外训练或领域特定监督。
Conclusion: 论文强调层次化结构化表示与多代理协作可提升海报生成的语义连贯性、逻辑性和视觉和谐度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Efficient Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge for CT Field of View Extension
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) is a cornerstone imaging modality for non-invasive, high-resolution visualization of internal anatomical structures. However, when the scanned object exceeds the scanner's field of view (FOV), projection data are truncated, resulting in incomplete reconstructions and pronounced artifacts near FOV boundaries. Conventional reconstruction algorithms struggle to recover accurate anatomy from such data, limiting clinical reliability. Deep learning approaches have been explored for FOV extension, with diffusion generative models representing the latest advances in image synthesis. Yet, conventional diffusion models are computationally demanding and slow at inference due to their iterative sampling process. To address these limitations, we propose an efficient CT FOV extension framework based on the image-to-image Schrödinger Bridge (I$^2$SB) diffusion model. Unlike traditional diffusion models that synthesize images from pure Gaussian noise, I$^2$SB learns a direct stochastic mapping between paired limited-FOV and extended-FOV images. This direct correspondence yields a more interpretable and traceable generative process, enhancing anatomical consistency and structural fidelity in reconstructions. I$^2$SB achieves superior quantitative performance, with root-mean-square error (RMSE) values of 49.8 HU on simulated noisy data and 152.0 HU on real data, outperforming state-of-the-art diffusion models such as conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic models (cDDPM) and patch-based diffusion methods. Moreover, its one-step inference enables reconstruction in just 0.19 s per 2D slice, representing over a 700-fold speedup compared to cDDPM (135 s) and surpassing DiffusionGAN (0.58 s), the second fastest. This combination of accuracy and efficiency indicates that I$^2$SB has potential for real-time or clinical deployment.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Radiation and Plasma Medical Sciences 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CT扫描视野（FOV）受限导致的截断伪影问题，提出基于图像到图像Schrödinger桥（I²SB）扩散模型的高效FOV扩展框架。该方法学习有限FOV与扩展FOV图像之间的直接随机映射，无需从高斯噪声迭代采样。在模拟噪声数据和真实数据上分别实现了49.8 HU和152.0 HU的均方根误差（RMSE），优于cDDPM等扩散模型。单步推理每2D切片仅需0.19秒，比cDDPM快700倍以上。
Motivation: CT扫描中，当物体超出扫描仪视野时，投影数据截断导致重建图像不完整且边界伪影明显，传统算法难以恢复精确解剖结构，而现有深度学习扩散模型推理缓慢。
Method: 基于图像到图像Schrödinger桥扩散模型，学习有限FOV图像到扩展FOV图像的直接随机映射，实现可解释且可追踪的生成过程，支持单步推理加速。
Result: 在模拟噪声数据上RMSE为49.8 HU，真实数据上RMSE为152.0 HU，优于cDDPM和基于patch的扩散方法；每2D切片推理时间0.19秒，比cDDPM快700倍以上，比第二快的DiffusionGAN（0.58秒）更快。
Conclusion: I²SB模型在CT FOV扩展任务上兼顾了准确性和效率，具有实时或临床部署潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Estimating carbon pools in the European Shelf sea environment: replacing reanalysis by model-informed machine learning?
papers.abstract_en: Shelf seas are important for the economy and the carbon cycle, but shelf sea observations for carbon pools are often sparse, or highly uncertain. An alternative can be provided by carbon reanalyses (whether assimilating proxy variables, such as chlorophyll-$a$, or directly carbon), but these are often expensive to run. We propose to use a computationally cheap ensemble of neural networks (i.e. deep ensemble) to learn the relationship between the directly observable (atmospheric, riverine and ocean) variables and marine carbon pools from a coupled physics-biogeochemistry model. The deep ensemble was trained on a North-West European Shelf (NWES) physical-biogeochemistry model free run simulation. After training, the deep ensemble was run using inputs from the NWES reanalysis instead of the free run, demonstrating that it can efficiently predict several NWES carbon pools (e.g., detritus, zooplankton, heterotrophic bacteria) in much better agreement with the reanalysis than the free run, while also providing uncertainty information. We further show that the deep ensemble performs similarly well when it is driven directly by the observations assimilated into the reanalysis, with the limitation that carbon pools can then be predicted only at the observed locations and times. We focus on explainability of the results and demonstrate potential use of the deep ensembles for future climate what-if scenarios. We suggest that model-informed machine learning presents a viable alternative to expensive reanalyses and could complement observations, wherever they are missing and/or highly uncertain.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用深度集成（deep ensemble）神经网络替代昂贵的碳再分析（carbon reanalysis）来估计欧洲陆架海环境中的碳库。深度集成从物理-生物地球化学模型的自由运行模拟中学习可观测变量（大气、河流、海洋）与海洋碳库之间的关系，然后使用再分析输入进行预测，结果与再分析高度一致，同时提供不确定性信息。
Motivation: 陆架海的碳库观测稀疏且不确定性高，而碳再分析计算成本高，因此需要一种低成本且可靠的替代方法。
Method: 使用深度集成（多个神经网络集合）学习可观测变量与海洋碳库之间的映射关系，训练数据来自耦合物理-生物地球化学模型的自由运行模拟，然后在再分析输入上应用。
Result: 深度集成能够有效预测数个碳库（如碎屑、浮游动物、异养细菌），与再分析的一致性优于自由运行模拟，并且提供不确定性估计；在直接使用观测数据驱动时表现相似，但预测限于观测时空点。
Conclusion: 模型驱动的机器学习是昂贵碳再分析的一种可行替代方案，可以在观测缺失或高度不确定的地方补充观测。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: From Values to Tokens: An LLM-Driven Framework for Context-aware Time Series Forecasting via Symbolic Discretization
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting plays a vital role in supporting decision-making across a wide range of critical applications, including energy, healthcare, and finance. Despite recent advances, forecasting accuracy remains limited due to the challenge of integrating historical numerical sequences with contextual features, which often comprise unstructured textual data. To address this challenge, we propose TokenCast, a large language model (LLM) driven framework that leverages language-based symbolic representations as a unified intermediary for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, TokenCast employs a discrete tokenizer to transform continuous numerical sequences into temporal tokens, enabling structural alignment with language-based inputs. To effectively bridge the semantic gap between modalities, both temporal and contextual tokens are embedded into a shared representation space via a pre-trained LLM, further optimized with generative objectives. Building upon this unified semantic space, the aligned LLM is subsequently fine-tuned in a supervised manner to predict future temporal tokens, which are then decoded back into the original numerical space. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework and highlight its potential as a generative framework for context-aware time series forecasting. The code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/TokenCast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TokenCast 框架，利用大语言模型 (LLM) 通过符号离散化将连续时间序列转化为时间令牌，并与上下文文本令牌对齐，实现上下文感知的时间序列预测。该方法将数值序列离散化为临时令牌，通过预训练 LLM 将它们嵌入共享语义空间，再通过监督微调预测未来时间令牌，并解码回数值空间。实验在真实数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测难以整合历史数值序列与包含非结构化文本的上下文特征，导致预测准确性受限。
Method: 提出 TokenCast，使用离散分词器将连续数值序列转化为时间令牌，与上下文文本令牌一起通过预训练 LLM 嵌入共享语义空间，并基于生成目标优化，最后通过监督微调预测未来令牌并解码。
Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，该框架能有效进行上下文感知的时间序列预测，代码已开源。
Conclusion: TokenCast 提供了利用 LLM 和符号离散化进行上下文感知时间序列预测的生成式框架，但摘要未提及具体数值结果或与基线对比。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: When Cars Have Stereotypes: Auditing Demographic Bias in Objects from Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: While prior research on text-to-image generation has predominantly focused on biases in human depictions, demographic bias in generated objects remains relatively underexplored. We introduce SODA (Stereotyped Object Diagnostic Audit), a novel framework for systematically measuring these biases through automated attribute discovery and three standardized metrics: Base vs. Demographic Divergence (BDS), Cross-Demographic Disparity (CDS), and Visual Attribute Concentration (VAC). Applying SODA to 8,000 images across five state-of-the-art models and eight object categories (e.g., cars), we find that "neutral" prompts produce outputs most visually similar to middle-aged and White people, suggesting these groups are implicitly over-represented in model defaults. Furthermore, demographic cues trigger highly skewed stereotypical outputs: 26.6% of object-model-demographic combinations produce results where all 20 generated images share the exact same attribute value (e.g., rose gold laptops for women). Finally, prompt-level debiasing reduces inter-group disparity but paradoxically collapses within-group diversity, replacing one stereotype with another. SODA offers a practical pipeline for making these implicit associations measurable, serving as a step toward more responsible AI development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SODA（Stereotyped Object Diagnostic Audit）框架，系统测量文本到图像模型中生成物体的人口统计偏见。在 8000 张图像、5 个模型和 8 个物体类别上的实验表明，“中性”提示生成的输出在视觉上最接近中年和白人群体，人口统计线索导致高度刻板的结果（26.6% 的组合中所有 20 张图像共享相同属性值）。提示级去偏能减少组间差异，但会矛盾地压缩组内多样性。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注人物描绘中的偏见，而生成物体中的偏见尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出自动属性发现方法，并定义三个指标：基础与人口统计分歧（BDS）、跨人口统计差异（CDS）和视觉属性集中度（VAC），形成系统审计管道。
Result: 中性提示默认输出偏向中年和白人；26.6% 的对象-模型-人口统计组合中所有生成图像共享同一属性值（如女性提示下所有笔记本电脑为玫瑰金色）；提示级去偏虽降低组间差异，但导致组内多样性下降。
Conclusion: SODA 框架为隐式关联提供了可测量工具，向更负责任的 AI 开发迈进一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Detection of Planted Subgraphs in Semi-Random Models
papers.abstract_en: Detection of planted subgraphs in Erdös-Rényi random graphs has been extensively studied, leading to a rich body of results characterizing both statistical and computational thresholds. However, most prior work assumes a purely random generative model, making the resulting algorithms potentially fragile in the face of real-world perturbations. In this work, we initiate the study of semi-random models for the planted subgraph detection problem, wherein an adversary is allowed to remove edges outside the planted subgraph before the graph is revealed to the statistician. Crucially, the statistician remains unaware of which edges have been removed, introducing fundamental challenges to the inference task. We establish fundamental statistical limits for detection under this semi-random model, revealing a sharp dichotomy. Specifically, for planted subgraphs with strongly sub-logarithmic maximum density detection becomes information-theoretically impossible in the presence of an adversary-despite being possible for some planted subgraphs in the classical random model. In stark contrast, for subgraphs with super-logarithmic density, the statistical limits remain essentially unchanged; we prove that the optimal (albeit computationally intractable) likelihood ratio test remains robust. Beyond these statistical boundaries, we design a new computationally efficient and robust detection algorithm, and provide rigorous statistical guarantees for its performance. Our results establish the first robust framework for planted subgraph detection and open new directions in the study of semi-random models, computational-statistical trade-offs, and robustness in graph inference problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了半随机模型下植入子图检测问题，其中对手可在揭示图之前删除植入子图外的边。建立了统计极限，发现对于最大密度强亚对数的子图，检测在信息论上不可能；而对于超对数密度的子图，统计极限不变。设计了一个计算高效且鲁棒的检测算法。
Motivation: 现有植入子图检测研究大多假设纯随机生成模型，算法可能对真实扰动脆弱。本文在更现实的半随机模型下研究鲁棒性。
Method: 引入半随机模型，对手可删除植入子图外的边。分析信息论极限，设计基于似然比检验的算法，并给出计算高效的检测算法。
Result: 对于强亚对数最大密度的子图，检测在对手存在时信息论上不可能；对于超对数密度子图，最优似然比检验仍然鲁棒。新算法提供统计保证。
Conclusion: 建立了首个鲁棒的植入子图检测框架，揭示了半随机模型下统计与计算权衡的新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Neural Network Driven Simulation Based Inference Method for Pole Position Estimation under Model Misspecification
papers.abstract_en: Simulation Based Inference (SBI) is shown to yield more accurate resonance parameter estimates than traditional chi-squared minimization in certain cases of model misspecification, demonstrated through a case study of pi-pi scattering and the rho(770) resonance. Models fit to some data sets using chi-squared minimization can predict inaccurate pole positions for the rho(770), while SBI provides more robust predictions across the same models and data. This result is significant both as a proof of concept that SBI can handle model misspecification, and because accurate modeling of pi-pi scattering is essential in the study of many contemporary physical systems (e.g., a1(1260), omega(782)). The method of Simulation Based Inference is shown to lead to a more accurate resonance parameter estimation than traditional chi-squared minimization in certain cases of model misspecification in a case-study of pi-pi scattering and the rho(770)-resonance. Models fit to certain data sets using chi-squared minimization can make inaccurate predictions for the pole position of the rho(770). SBI is shown to make a more robust predictions for the pole positions. This is significant, both as a proof of concept that the SBI method can be used in cases of model misspecification, and because models of pi-pi scattering are a crucial part to many physical systems of contemporary interest (e.g., a1(1260), omega(782)).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过ππ散射和ρ(770)共振的案例研究，证明模拟推断（SBI）在模型误设情况下能比传统卡方最小化得到更准确的共振参数估计。卡方最小化在部分数据集上预测的极点位置不准确，而SBI给出了更鲁棒的预测。该结果对当前许多物理系统（如a1(1260)、ω(782)）的研究具有重要意义。
Motivation: 传统卡方最小化在模型误设时可能导致共振极点位置估计不准确，需要更鲁棒的参数估计方法。
Method: 采用模拟推断（SBI）方法，通过生成模拟数据并与观测数据比较来推断参数，避免了对似然函数的显式假设。
Result: 在ππ散射和ρ(770)共振的案例中，SBI在模型误设下给出了比卡方最小化更准确的极点位置估计。
Conclusion: SBI可作为模型误设情况下共振参数估计的可靠替代方案，尤其适用于粒子物理中精确建模重要的场景。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Accelerated Aerodynamic Shape Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) based adaptive optimization algorithm for aerodynamic shape optimization focused on dimensionality reduction. The form in which RL is applied here is that of a surrogate-based, actor-critic policy evaluation MCMC approach allowing for temporal 'freezing' of some of the parameters to be optimized. The goals are to minimize computational effort, and to use the observed optimization results for interpretation of the discovered extrema in terms of their role in achieving the desired flow-field. By a sequence of local optimized parameter changes around intermediate CFD simulations acting as ground truth, it is possible to speed up the global optimization if (a) the local neighbourhoods of the parameters in which the changed parameters must reside are sufficiently large to compete with the grid-sized steps and its large number of simulations, and (b) the estimates of the rewards and costs on these neighbourhoods necessary for a good step-wise parameter adaption are sufficiently accurate. We give an example of a simple fluid-dynamical problem on which the method allows interpretation in the sense of a feature importance scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习（RL）的自适应优化算法，用于气动外形优化，重点在于降维。该方法采用基于代理的演员-评论家策略评估MCMC，允许部分参数在优化过程中暂时“冻结”，以最小化计算开销，并通过中间CFD模拟作为真值，实现全局加速优化。在简单流体动力学问题上展示了特征重要性评分的能力。
Motivation: 气动外形优化通常计算成本高昂，特别是高维参数空间下。现有方法难以在保证全局优化效果的同时显著降低计算量，且优化结果缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出一种RL驱动的自适应优化算法，使用基于代理的演员-评论家策略评估MCMC，在优化过程中临时冻结部分参数，通过序列局部优化和中间CFD模拟作为真值来加速全局收敛，并利用奖励和成本估计指导参数调整。
Result: 在简单流体动力学问题上，该方法能够进行特征重要性评分，并展示优化加速效果，但需要足够大的参数邻域和准确的奖励/成本估计。
Conclusion: 该方法通过RL实现气动外形优化的加速与可解释性，但依赖于局部邻域大小和估计精度，需进一步验证复杂问题上的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enhancing Fatigue Detection through Heterogeneous Multi-Source Data Integration and Cross-Domain Modality Imputation
papers.abstract_en: Fatigue detection for human operators is important in safety-related applications such as aviation, mining, and long-haul transport. Reliable estimation of operator fatigue can support timely warnings, adaptive task scheduling, takeover reminders, and other safety-management decisions in human-machine systems. However, the effectiveness of these functions depends on whether fatigue-related signals can be reliably captured in the deployment environment. While many studies have shown the value of high-fidelity sensors in controlled laboratory environments, their performance often degrades when used in real-world settings because of noise, lighting conditions, and field-of-view constraints, thereby limiting their practical use. This paper formalizes a deployment-oriented setting for real-world fatigue detection, where high-quality sensors are often unavailable in practical applications. To address this issue, we use knowledge from heterogeneous source domains, including high-fidelity sensors that are difficult to deploy in the field but commonly used in controlled environments, to assist fatigue detection in the real-world target domain. Based on this idea, we design a heterogeneous and multi-source fatigue-detection framework that uses the available modalities in the target domain while leveraging diverse configurations in the source domains through cross-domain modality imputation based on shared modalities.

papers.title: Beyond the Linear Separability Ceiling: Aligning Representations in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: A challenge in advancing Visual-Language Models (VLMs) is determining whether their failures on abstract reasoning tasks, such as Bongard problems, stem from flawed perception or faulty top-down reasoning. To disentangle these factors, we introduce a diagnostic framework centered on the Linear Separability Ceiling (LSC), the performance achievable by a linear classifier on a VLM's raw visual embeddings. Applying this framework to state-of-the-art VLMs, we uncover a pervasive ''alignment gap'', where most models fail to generatively outperform the linear separability of their representations. We find that the few models surpassing this ceiling do so via two mechanisms: by further refining visual representations into a more linearly separable format or by executing non-linear decision logic. We demonstrate that this bottleneck is not a fundamental limitation but a solvable visual alignment issue. Our method augments standard next-token prediction with a contrastive objective to restructure the visual manifold into a more one-dimensionally linear geometry, improving image-to-image comparison and enabling models to significantly surpass the LSC on abstract compositional reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出线性可分性上限（LSC）框架，用于诊断视觉语言模型（VLM）在抽象推理任务（如Bongard问题）上的失败原因。研究发现大多数模型存在“对齐差距”，无法在生成任务中超过其视觉嵌入的线性可分性上限。少数超越的模型通过细化视觉表示为更线性可分的格式或执行非线性决策逻辑实现。作者提出一种对比学习目标增强下一词预测，重塑视觉流形为一维线性几何，使模型显著超越LSC。
Motivation: 现有VLM在抽象推理任务（如Bongard问题）上失败，但不确定原因是感知缺陷还是高层推理缺陷。需要一种诊断框架来分离这两种因素。
Method: 引入线性可分性上限（LSC）作为诊断指标，并对比标准下一词预测与对比目标联合训练的方法。
Result: 大多数VLM无法在生成任务中超越其视觉嵌入的线性可分性上限；少数模型通过两种机制超越。所提对比方法能重塑视觉流形，使模型显著超越LSC。
Conclusion: 线性可分性上限并非根本限制，而是可解决的视觉对齐问题。通过对比学习可以改善VLM在抽象组合推理任务上的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model Collapse Is Not a Bug but a Feature in Machine Unlearning for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current unlearning methods for LLMs optimize on the private information they seek to remove by incorporating it into their fine-tuning data. We argue this not only risks reinforcing exposure to sensitive data, but also fundamentally contradicts the principle of minimizing its use. As a remedy, we propose a novel unlearning method-Partial Model Collapse (PMC), which does not require unlearning targets in the unlearning objective. Our approach is inspired by recent observations that training generative models on their own generations leads to distribution collapse, effectively removing information from model outputs. Our central insight is that model collapse can be leveraged for machine unlearning by deliberately triggering it for data we aim to remove. We theoretically analyze that our approach converges to the desired outcome, i.e. the model unlearns the data targeted for removal. We empirically demonstrate that PMC overcomes four key limitations of existing unlearning methods that explicitly optimize on unlearning targets, and more effectively removes private information from model outputs while preserving general model utility. Overall, our contributions represent an important step toward more comprehensive unlearning that better aligns with real-world privacy constraints. Code available at https://www.cs.cit.tum.de/daml/partial-model-collapse/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对大语言模型的去学习方法——部分模型崩溃（Partial Model Collapse, PMC），该方法无需在去学习目标中显式使用待删除数据，而是通过有策略地触发模型崩溃来移除私有信息。理论分析证明该方法收敛到期望的结果，实验表明PMC克服了现有方法的四个关键局限，更有效地从模型输出中移除私有信息同时保持通用模型效用。
Motivation: 现有去学习方法在微调数据中包含待删除的私有信息，这既可能强化模型对该数据的暴露，也与最小化使用该数据的原则相悖。
Method: 提出部分模型崩溃（PMC）方法，利用生成模型在其自身生成数据上训练会导致分布崩溃的观察，通过故意触发模型崩溃来移除指定数据的信息。该方法在去学习目标中不需要使用待删除数据。
Result: 实验证明PMC克服了现有显式优化去学习目标方法的四个关键局限性，更有效地从模型输出中移除私有信息，同时保持通用模型效用。
Conclusion: PMC代表了向更全面的、符合现实隐私约束的去学习迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: KEPLA: A Knowledge-Enhanced Deep Learning Framework for Accurate Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of protein-ligand binding affinity is critical for drug discovery. While recent deep learning approaches have demonstrated promising results, they often rely solely on structural features of proteins and ligands, overlooking their valuable biochemical knowledge associated with binding affinity. To address this limitation, we propose KEPLA, a novel deep learning framework that explicitly integrates prior knowledge from Gene Ontology and ligand properties to enhance prediction performance. KEPLA takes protein sequences and ligand molecular graphs as input and optimizes two complementary objectives: (1) aligning global representations with knowledge graph relations to capture domain-specific biochemical insights, and (2) leveraging cross attention between local representations to construct fine-grained joint embeddings for prediction. Experiments on two benchmark datasets across both in-domain and cross-domain scenarios demonstrate that KEPLA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, interpretability analyses based on knowledge graph relations and cross attention maps provide valuable insights into the underlying predictive mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KEPLA，一种知识增强的深度学习框架，通过整合基因本体（Gene Ontology）和配体属性等先验知识来预测蛋白质-配体结合亲和力。框架利用知识图谱关系对齐全局表示，并使用交叉注意力构建局部联合嵌入。在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在域内和跨域场景下均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法仅依赖蛋白质和配体的结构特征，忽略了与结合亲和力相关的有价值的生化知识。
Method: 提出 KEPLA 框架，以蛋白质序列和配体分子图为输入，优化两个互补目标：(1) 利用知识图谱关系对齐全局表示以获取领域特异性生化知识；(2) 使用局部表示之间的交叉注意力构建细粒度联合嵌入。
Result: 在两个基准数据集上的域内和跨域场景中，KEPLA 始终优于最先进的基线。基于知识图谱关系和交叉注意力图的可解释性分析揭示了预测机制。
Conclusion: 显式整合先验知识（如基因本体和配体属性）可以显著提升蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测的性能，并且框架提供了可解释性洞察。

papers.title: Grids Often Outperform Implicit Neural Representations at Compressing Dense Signals
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently shown impressive results, but their fundamental capacity, implicit biases, and scaling behavior remain poorly understood. We investigate the performance of diverse INRs across a suite of 2D and 3D real and synthetic signals with varying effective bandwidth, as well as both overfitting and generalization tasks including tomography, super-resolution, and denoising. By stratifying performance according to model size as well as signal type and bandwidth, our results shed light on how different INR and grid representations allocate their capacity. We find that, for many tasks involving dense signals, a simple regularized grid with interpolation trains faster and to higher or comparable quality than any INR with the same number of parameters. We also find limited settings -- namely fitting binary signals such as shape contours -- where INRs outperform grids, to guide future development and use of INRs towards the most advantageous applications.
papers.comment: Our analysis are available at https://github.com/voilalab/INR-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了隐式神经表示（INR）与规则网格表示在压缩密集信号上的性能。通过在不同带宽的2D/3D信号以及断层重建、超分辨率、去噪等任务上的实验，发现对于大多数密集信号任务，带有插值的简单正则化网格在相同参数量下比任何INR训练更快且质量更高。仅在拟合二值信号（如形状轮廓）等有限场景中INR优于网格。
Motivation: 隐式神经表示虽然表现出色，但其容量、隐式偏差和缩放行为尚不明确。现有研究缺乏系统比较INR与网格表示在各类信号和任务上的性能差异。
Method: 构建包含多种2D/3D真实与合成信号（不同有效带宽）的测试套件，涵盖过拟合和泛化任务（断层重建、超分辨率、去噪）。按模型大小、信号类型和带宽分层分析，比较各类INR与正则化网格加插值的表现。
Result: 在密集信号任务中，简单正则化网格加插值在相同参数量下训练更快，且质量达到或超过所有INR。仅在拟合二值信号（如形状轮廓）时INR表现更优。
Conclusion: 网格表示在大多数密集信号压缩任务中优于INR，INR的优势限于二值信号等特定场景，研究结果为INR的未来发展和应用提供指导。

papers.title: On the Stability of the Jacobian Matrix in Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are known to suffer from exploding or vanishing gradients as depth increases, a phenomenon closely tied to the spectral behavior of the input-output Jacobian. Prior work has identified critical initialization schemes that ensure Jacobian stability, but these analyses are typically restricted to fully connected networks with i.i.d. weights. In this work, we go significantly beyond these limitations: we establish a general stability theorem for deep neural networks that accommodates sparsity (such as that introduced by pruning) and non-i.i.d., weakly correlated weights (e.g. induced by training). Our results rely on recent advances in random matrix theory, and provide rigorous guarantees for spectral stability in a much broader class of network models. This extends the theoretical foundation for initialization schemes in modern neural networks with structured and dependent randomness.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 28 figures; the main theorem was wrong (again) and is now corrected
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络中梯度爆炸/消失问题，将雅可比矩阵谱稳定性分析推广到具有稀疏性（如剪枝）和非独立同分布弱相关权重（如训练引入的相关性）的网络。作者基于随机矩阵理论给出了谱稳定性的严格保证，扩展了现代神经网络初始化方案的理论基础。
Motivation: 现有对雅可比矩阵稳定性的分析局限于全连接网络和独立同分布权重，无法涵盖实际中出现的稀疏结构和训练导致的权重相关性，需要更通用的稳定性定理。
Method: 利用随机矩阵理论的最新进展，建立了一个适用于稀疏和非独立同分布权重的深度神经网络雅可比矩阵稳定性定理。
Conclusion: 该结果扩展了初始化方案的理论基础，使其适用于具有结构和依赖随机性的现代神经网络。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ASyMOB: Algebraic Symbolic Mathematical Operations Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to symbolic mathematics, yet existing evaluations often conflate pattern memorization with genuine reasoning. To address this gap, we present ASyMOB, a high-resolution dataset of 35,368 validated symbolic math problems spanning integration, limits, differential equations, series, and hypergeometrics. Unlike prior benchmarks, ASyMOB systematically perturbs each seed problem using symbolic, numeric, and equivalence-preserving transformations, enabling a fine-grained assessment of generalization. Our evaluation reveals three key findings: (1) most models' performance collapses under minor perturbations, while top systems exhibit an apparent regime shift in robustness; (2) integrated code tools stabilize performance, particularly for weaker models; and (3) we identify examples where Computer Algebra Systems (CAS) fail while LLMs succeed, as well as problems solved only via a hybrid LLM-CAS approach, highlighting a promising integration frontier. ASyMOB serves as a principled diagnostic tool for measuring and accelerating progress toward building verifiable, trustworthy AI for scientific discovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ASyMOB，一个包含35,368个经过验证的符号数学问题的高分辨率数据集，涵盖积分、极限、微分方程、级数和超几何函数。与以往基准不同，ASyMOB通过符号、数值和等价保持变换系统性地扰动每个种子问题，从而细粒度评估泛化能力。评估发现：大多数模型在轻微扰动下性能崩溃，而顶级系统表现出鲁棒性的明显转变；集成代码工具稳定性能，尤其对较弱模型；同时识别了计算机代数系统（CAS）失败而LLM成功，以及仅通过混合LLM-CAS方法解决的问题。ASyMOB作为原则性诊断工具，用于衡量和加速构建可验证、可信赖的AI科学发现。
Motivation: 现有评估常混淆模式记忆与真实推理，缺乏对符号数学推理泛化能力的细粒度诊断。为此提出ASyMOB。
Method: 构建包含35,368个验证问题的数据集，通过符号、数值和等价保持变换对每个种子问题进行系统扰动，以评估泛化能力；并分析集成代码工具和混合LLM-CAS方法的效果。
Result: 大多数模型在轻微扰动下性能崩溃，顶级系统显示鲁棒性转折；集成代码工具稳定性能，尤其对弱模型；存在CAS失败而LLM成功的问题，以及仅混合方法可解的问题。
Conclusion: ASyMOB可作为衡量AI科学发现可验证性和可信度的原则性诊断工具，强调LLM与CAS混合的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Active Speaker Detection: An In-the-Wild Benchmark for Generalization and Robustness
papers.abstract_en: We present UniTalk, a novel dataset emphasizing challenging scenarios to enhance model generalization for the task of active speaker detection (ASD). Previously established benchmarks such as AVA predominantly comprise old movies and thus exhibit significant domain gaps with real-world video. In contrast, UniTalk covers diverse video types reflecting challenging real-world conditions, including underrepresented languages, noisy backgrounds, and crowded scenes, while being on par with AVA in scale. Extensive evaluations reveal that ASD remains unsolved under realistic conditions: state-of-the-art models near-perfect on AVA fail to reach saturation on UniTalk. Conversely, models trained on UniTalk generalize better to modern in-the-wild datasets including Talkies and ASW. UniTalk thus establishes a new benchmark for ASD, providing researchers with a valuable resource for developing and evaluating versatile and resilient models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniTalk数据集，用于主动说话人检测（ASD）任务，覆盖多样化的真实世界场景（如低资源语言、嘈杂背景、拥挤场景），规模与AVA相当。评估表明现有模型在真实条件下性能远未饱和，而UniTalk训练的模型在野生数据集上泛化更好。
Motivation: 现有ASD基准如AVA主要包含老电影，与真实视频存在领域差距，限制了模型的泛化和鲁棒性。
Method: 构建UniTalk数据集，包含多种视频类型和挑战性场景，并在此基准上评估现有SOTA模型。
Result: 在AVA上接近完美的模型在UniTalk上远未饱和；UniTalk训练的模型在Talkies和ASW等野生数据集上泛化更好。
Conclusion: ASD在真实条件下仍未解决，UniTalk为开发鲁棒模型提供了新基准。

papers.title: Clustering and Pruning in Causal Data Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Data fusion, the process of combining observational and experimental data, can enable the identification of causal effects that would otherwise remain non-identifiable. Although identification algorithms have been developed for specific scenarios, do-calculus remains the only general-purpose tool for causal data fusion, particularly when variables are present in some data sources but not others. However, approaches based on do-calculus may encounter computational challenges as the number of variables increases and the causal graph grows in complexity. Consequently, there exists a need to reduce the size of such models while preserving the essential features. For this purpose, we propose pruning (removing unnecessary variables) and clustering (combining variables) as preprocessing operations for causal data fusion. We generalize earlier results on a single data source and derive conditions for applying pruning and clustering in the case of multiple data sources. We give sufficient conditions for inferring the identifiability or non-identifiability of a causal effect in a larger graph based on a smaller graph and show how to obtain the corresponding identifying functional for identifiable causal effects. Examples from epidemiology and social science demonstrate the use of the results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在因果数据融合中，通过剪枝（移除不必要变量）和聚类（合并变量）作为预处理操作来降低模型规模，并推广到多数据源场景。作者给出了从简化图推断原始图中因果效应可识别性或不可识别性的充分条件，并展示了如何为可识别的因果效应获得相应的识别泛函。流行病学和社会科学中的例子验证了结果。
Motivation: 基于do-calculus的因果数据融合方法随着变量数和图复杂度增加面临计算挑战，需要一种降低模型规模但仍保留本质特征的方法。
Method: 将剪枝和聚类作为因果数据融合的预处理步骤，推广了先前针对单一数据源的结果，推导了多数据源下应用剪枝和聚类的条件，并给出从简化图推断原始图因果效应可识别性的充分条件。
Result: 通过流行病学和社会科学的例子展示了方法的有效性，能够从简化图推断原始图中因果效应的可识别性或不可识别性，并为可识别效应提供相应的识别泛函。
Conclusion: 剪枝和聚类可以有效简化因果数据融合中的模型，同时保持因果效应的可识别性信息，为复杂场景下的因果推断提供实用预处理工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fully Geometric Multi-Hop Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs with Transitive Relations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop logical reasoning on knowledge graphs requires faithfully mapping the logical semantics to latent space. Current geometric embedding methods show to be useful on this task by mapping entities to geometric regions and logical operations to latent transformations. While a geometric embedding can provide a direct interpretability framework for query answering, current methods have only leveraged the geometric construction of entities, failing to map logical operations to pure geometric transformations and, instead, using neural components to learn these operations. On the other hand, purely neural-based methods outperform geometric methods, but they lack interpretability in the latent space. We introduce GeometrE, a geometric embedding method for multi-hop reasoning, that maps every logical operation to a purely geometric operation in the latent space. Additionally, we introduce a transitive loss function and show that, unlike existing methods, it can preserve the logical rule for all a,b,c: r(a,b) and r(b,c) -> r(a,c). Our experiments show that GeometrE outperforms current state-of-the-art geometric methods and remains competitive with existing neural-based methods on standard benchmark datasets.
papers.journal_ref: The Semantic Web. ESWC 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16549. Springer, Cham (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeometrE，一种纯几何嵌入方法，用于知识图谱上的多跳逻辑推理。该方法将逻辑运算映射为纯几何变换，并引入传递损失函数以保持传递性规则。实验表明，GeometrE优于现有几何方法，与基于神经网络的竞争方法性能相当。
Motivation: 现有几何嵌入方法未能将逻辑运算映射为纯几何变换，而是依赖神经组件，导致可解释性不足；纯神经方法性能更好但缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出GeometrE，将每个逻辑运算映射为潜在空间中的纯几何操作，并引入传递损失函数，强制满足传递关系规则。
Result: 在标准基准数据集上，GeometrE优于当前最先进的几何方法，并与基于神经网络的现有方法竞争。
Conclusion: GeometrE提供了几何可解释性，同时保持与神经方法竞争的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revealing Hidden Vulnerabilities in Autoencoders through Gradient Signal Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial robustness of deep autoencoders (AEs) has received less attention than that of discriminative models, although their compressed latent representations induce ill-conditioned mappings that can amplify small input perturbations and destabilize reconstructions. Existing white-box attacks for AEs, which optimize norm-bounded adversarial perturbations to maximize reconstruction damage, often converge to suboptimal perturbations, thereby potentially overstating AE robustness. We show that this limitation is linked to vanishing adversarial loss gradients during backpropagation through ill-conditioned layers, associated with near-zero singular values in their intermediate weight matrices. To address this, we propose GRILL (Gradient Signal Restoration in Ill-Conditioned Layers), a framework designed to mitigate gradient degradation and improve the reliability of adversarial robustness evaluation in encoder-decoder architectures. GRILL is designed to mitigate adversarial gradient degradation during optimization, enabling attacks to better approximate high-distortion perturbations under fixed norm constraints. Through extensive experiments across multiple AE architectures, under both sample-specific and universal attacks, as well as standard and adaptive attack settings, we show that GRILL significantly increases attack effectiveness, thereby exposing vulnerabilities hidden by existing attack limitations. Beyond AEs, we provide preliminary evidence that modern multimodal encoder-decoder architectures exhibit similar vulnerabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示自编码器（AE）在对抗攻击评估中的隐藏脆弱性。由于中间权重矩阵的奇异值接近零导致条件较差的层，现有白盒攻击在优化中遭遇梯度消失，从而低估了AE的脆弱性。作者提出GRILL框架，通过恢复梯度信号来改进攻击效果，在多种AE架构和攻击设置下显著提升了扰动强度，并初步证明现代多模态编解码器也存在类似脆弱性。
Motivation: 现有白盒攻击对自编码器的评估常收敛到次优扰动，可能高估其鲁棒性，原因在于通过条件较差层时对抗损失梯度消失。
Method: 提出GRILL（Gradient Signal Restoration in Ill-Conditioned Layers），一种缓解对抗梯度退化的框架，使攻击在固定范数约束下能更好地逼近高失真扰动。
Result: 在多种AE架构、样本特定和通用攻击、标准及自适应攻击设置下，GRILL显著提升了攻击有效性，暴露了被现有攻击隐藏的脆弱性。
Conclusion: 论文强调了自编码器评估中梯度退化的问题，GRILL提供了解决方案；初步证据表明现代多模态编解码器也存在类似脆弱性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UST-GNN: A Unified Spatial--Topological Graph Neural Network Framework for Urban Analytics--Demonstrated through a Case Study on Urban Health Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how social, demographic, environmental, and spatial factors jointly shape urban outcomes is essential for sustainable urban development and evidence-based policy. Traditional statistical approaches often struggle to capture complex non-linear relationships, while many machine learning methods overlook the joint roles of spatial autocorrelation and network topology in urban systems. Recent advances in GeoAI have addressed these challenges only partially, often treating spatial effects, graph structure, evaluation, and interpretability separately. We present \textbf{UST-GNN}, a unified spatial--topological graph neural network framework that integrates neighbourhood connectivity, heterogeneous urban features, and positional/locational embeddings into a single representation. Using the MedSAT dataset, which contains over 150 environmental and socio-demographic variables and six prescription outcomes across 4,835 neighbourhoods in Greater London, UST-GNN outperforms strong statistical, geographically enhanced, and graph Machine Learning baselines, improving out-of-sample $R^2$ by 8.4--13.2\% under strict spatial cross-validation. We further introduce a lightweight principal-component module to interpret learned node embeddings geographically and relate them to policy-relevant covariates. The resulting analyses recover established patterns, offer new perspectives on debated associations, and reveal novel predictors warranting further causal investigation. Together, these findings demonstrate the value of graph-based spatial machine learning for urban health analytics, environmental inequality assessment, and evidence-based urban policy. Beyond predictive gains, UST-GNN provides a unified GeoAI analytical pipeline that can be embedded into urban digital twin workflows for scenario testing, monitoring, and data-informed decision-making for healthier, more sustainable cities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UST-GNN，一个统一的空间-拓扑图神经网络框架，用于城市分析。通过 MedSAT 数据集（伦敦4835个社区的150+变量和6种处方结果）展示了其在城市健康预测中的有效性，在严格空间交叉验证下，out-of-sample R² 比强基线提升8.4-13.2%。还引入了轻量级主成分模块解释节点嵌入。该方法可嵌入城市数字孪生工作流。
Motivation: 传统统计方法难以捕捉复杂非线性关系，多数机器学习方法忽略空间自相关和网络拓扑的联合作用，现有GeoAI方法往往将空间效应、图结构、评估和可解释性分开处理。
Method: 提出统一的空间-拓扑GNN框架，整合邻域连通性、异构城市特征和位置/位置嵌入。引入轻量级主成分模块以解释学习到的节点嵌入。
Result: 在MedSAT数据集上，UST-GNN在严格空间交叉验证下out-of-sample R²比统计、地理增强和图机器学习基线提升8.4-13.2%。分析恢复了已知模式，提供了新视角，揭示了需进一步因果研究的新预测因子。
Conclusion: UST-GNN提供了一个统一的GeoAI分析管道，可嵌入城市数字孪生工作流，用于情景测试、监测和数据驱动的决策，以建设更健康、可持续的城市。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Nearest Neighbor Interpolation in Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Avoiding the risk of undefined categorical labels using nearest neighbor interpolation overlooks the risk of exacerbating pixel level annotation errors in augmented training data. Additionally, the inherent low pass filtering effects of interpolation algorithms exacerbate the risk of degrading high frequency structural details within annotated regions of interest. To avoid these risks, the author modified convolutional neural networks data transformation functions by incorporating a modified geometric transformation function, removing reliance on nearest neighbor interpolation, and integrating a mean-based class filtering mechanism to handle undefined categorical labels with alternative interpolation algorithms. The author also implemented an offline data augmentation pipeline to generate interpolation specific augmented training data, enabling quantitative assessment of interpolation specific low pass filtering effects on augmented training data. Experimental evaluation on three medical image segmentation datasets and the XBAT+ datasets demonstrated performance gains across multiple quantitative metrics.

Method: 修改CNN数据变换函数：包含修正的几何变换函数、去除最近邻插值依赖、集成基于均值的类过滤机制以处理未定义标签；实现离线数据增强管线来生成插值特定的训练数据。

papers.title: SuperCarver: Texture-Consistent 3D Geometry Super-Resolution for High-Fidelity Surface Detail Generation
papers.abstract_en: Conventional production workflow of high-precision mesh assets necessitates a cumbersome and laborious process of manual sculpting by specialized 3D artists/modelers. The recent years have witnessed remarkable advances in AI-empowered 3D content creation for generating plausible structures and intricate appearances from images or text prompts. However, synthesizing realistic surface details still poses great challenges, and enhancing the geometry fidelity of existing lower-quality 3D meshes (instead of image/text-to-3D generation) remains an open problem. In this paper, we introduce SuperCarver, a 3D geometry super-resolution pipeline for supplementing texture-consistent surface details onto a given coarse mesh. We start by rendering the original textured mesh into the image domain from multiple viewpoints. To achieve detail boosting, we construct a deterministic prior-guided normal diffusion model, which is fine-tuned on a carefully curated dataset of paired detail-lacking and detail-rich normal map renderings. To update mesh surfaces from potentially imperfect normal map predictions, we design a noise-resistant inverse rendering scheme through deformable distance field. Experiments demonstrate that our SuperCarver is capable of generating realistic and expressive surface details depicted by the actual texture appearance, making it a powerful tool to both upgrade historical low-quality 3D assets and reduce the workload of sculpting high-poly meshes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SuperCarver，一种纹理一致的3D几何超分辨率流水线，通过多视角渲染、确定性先验引导的法线扩散模型和可变形距离场的抗噪逆渲染，在粗网格上生成高保真表面细节。实验表明能生成真实且富有表现力的表面细节。
Motivation: 传统高精度网格资产制作需要专业3D艺术家手动雕刻，过程繁重。虽然AI辅助3D内容生成有进展，但合成真实表面细节仍具挑战，提升现有低质量3D网格的几何保真度仍是一个开放问题。
Method: 首先从多个视角渲染原始带纹理网格到图像域。然后构建一个确定性先验引导的法线扩散模型，在精心策划的配对数据（细节缺失与细节丰富的法线图渲染）上微调。最后设计一个可变形距离场（deformable distance field）的抗噪逆渲染方案，从可能不完美的法线图预测中更新网格表面。
Result: 摘要称SuperCarver能够生成由实际纹理外观描述的逼真且富有表现力的表面细节，成为升级历史低质量3D资产和减少高多边形网格雕刻工作量的有力工具。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种纹理一致的3D几何超分辨率流水线，适用于升级低质量3D资产和减少雕刻工作量。

papers.title: Generalized Kullback-Leibler Divergence Loss
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we delve deeper into the Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence loss and mathematically prove that it is equivalent to the Decoupled Kullback-Leibler (DKL) Divergence loss that consists of (1) a weighted Mean Square Error (wMSE) loss and (2) a Cross-Entropy loss incorporating soft labels. Thanks to the decoupled structure of DKL loss, we have identified two areas for improvement. Firstly, we address the limitation of KL loss in scenarios like knowledge distillation by breaking its asymmetric optimization property along with a smoother weight function. This modification effectively alleviates convergence challenges in optimization, particularly for classes with high predicted scores in soft labels. Secondly, we introduce class-wise global information into KL/DKL to reduce bias arising from individual samples. With these two enhancements, we derive the Generalized Kullback-Leibler (GKL) Divergence loss and evaluate its effectiveness by conducting experiments on CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet, and vision-language datasets, focusing on adversarial training, and knowledge distillation tasks. Specifically, we achieve new state-of-the-art adversarial robustness on the public leaderboard -- RobustBench and competitive knowledge distillation performance across CIFAR/ImageNet models and CLIP models, demonstrating the substantial practical merits. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiequancui/DKL.
papers.comment: TPAMI 2026, extension of our NeurIPS paper "Decoupled Kullback-Leibler Divergence Loss". arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2305.13948
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文深入研究了KL散度损失，数学上证明其等价于解耦KL散度损失（DKL），后者包括加权均方误差和带软标签的交叉熵损失。基于DKL的解耦结构，提出了两个改进：一是打破KL损失的不对称优化性质并引入更平滑的权重函数，缓解高预测概率类别的收敛问题；二是引入类别级全局信息以减少样本偏差。由此得到广义KL散度损失（GKL），在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet和视觉-语言数据集上的对抗训练和知识蒸馏任务中取得了新最优结果，包括RobustBench上的对抗鲁棒性。
Motivation: KL散度损失在知识蒸馏等场景中存在不对称优化和收敛困难，且缺乏全局信息导致样本偏差。
Method: 提出广义KL散度损失（GKL），通过修改权重函数和引入类别级全局信息改进DKL损失。
Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet和视觉-语言数据集上，GKL损失在对抗训练和知识蒸馏中达到新最优，包括RobustBench上的对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: GKL损失在对抗鲁棒性和知识蒸馏上具有显著实用价值，代码已开源。

papers.title: Depth-Width tradeoffs in Algorithmic Reasoning of Graph Tasks with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have revolutionized the field of machine learning. In particular, they can be used to solve complex algorithmic problems, including graph-based tasks. In such algorithmic tasks a key question is what is the minimal size of a transformer that can implement the task. Recent work has begun to explore this problem for graph-based tasks, showing that for sub-linear embedding dimension (i.e., model width) logarithmic depth suffices. However, an open question, which we address here, is what happens if width is allowed to grow linearly, while depth is kept fixed. Here we analyze this setting, and provide the surprising result that with linear width, constant depth suffices for solving a host of graph-based problems. This suggests that a moderate increase in width can allow much shallower models, which are advantageous in terms of inference and train time. For other problems, we show that quadratic width is required. Our results demonstrate the complex and intriguing landscape of transformer implementations of graph-based algorithms. We empirically investigate these trade-offs between the relative powers of depth and width and find tasks where wider models have the same accuracy as deep models, while having much faster train and inference time due to parallelizable hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer在图算法任务中深度与宽度的权衡。现有工作表明，当宽度为次线性时，对数深度足够；而本文证明，当宽度线性增长时，常数深度即可解决许多图问题，但某些问题需要二次宽度。实验验证了宽模型可在保持精度的同时显著加速训练和推理。
Motivation: 已有工作探索了Transformer在图任务中的最小尺寸，但宽度线性增长而深度固定的情形尚未被研究，本文填补这一空白。
Method: 理论分析不同图问题所需的宽度与深度关系，并结合实验验证深度-宽度权衡。
Result: 对于一系列图问题，常数深度配合线性宽度即可解决；对于其他问题，需要二次宽度。实验显示宽模型与深模型精度相当，但训练和推理更快。
Conclusion: 适度增加宽度可大幅降低所需深度，从而提升并行效率，揭示了图算法中深度-宽度权衡的复杂图景。

papers.title: VidCRAFT3: Camera, Object, and Lighting Control for Image-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Controllable image-to-video (I2V) generation transforms a reference image into a coherent video guided by user-specified control signals. While precise control over camera motion, object motion, and lighting is essential for high-fidelity creation, existing methods often treat these factors independently. This overlooks the physical coupling among viewpoint, geometry, and illumination in dynamic scenes, leading to visual inconsistencies such as mismatched shadows and perspective drift under simultaneous changes. We present VidCRAFT3, a unified and flexible I2V framework that explicitly models cross-factor interactions among geometry, motion, and illumination, enabling both independent and joint control over camera motion, object motion, and lighting direction. Image2Cloud provides explicit 3D geometric priors for accurate camera motion control. ObjMotionNet encodes sparse object trajectories into multi-scale motion features to guide realistic object motion. A Spatial Triple-Attention Transformer integrates lighting direction through lighting cross-attention for consistent relighting. To address the scarcity of jointly annotated data, we construct the VideoLightingDirection (VLD) dataset with accurate per-frame lighting direction annotations, and introduce a three-stage progressive training strategy that enables robust learning without fully joint annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VidCRAFT3 achieves state-of-the-art performance in control precision and visual coherence across diverse scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VidCRAFT3 是一个统一的图像到视频生成框架，通过显式建模几何、运动和光照之间的交叉耦合，实现对相机运动、物体运动和光照方向的独立或联合控制。该方法引入 Image2Cloud 提供 3D 几何先验，ObjMotionNet 编码物体轨迹，以及 Spatial Triple-Attention Transformer 实现一致的重光照。为了应对联合注释数据稀缺，构建了 VideoLightingDirection (VLD) 数据集并采用三阶段渐进训练策略。实验表明，该方法在控制精度和视觉一致性上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有可控图像到视频生成方法将相机运动、物体运动和光照方向独立处理，忽略了动态场景中视角、几何和照明的物理耦合，导致阴影不匹配和视角漂移等视觉不一致问题。
Method: 提出 VidCRAFT3 框架，包含三个核心模块：Image2Cloud 提供显式 3D 几何先验用于相机运动控制；ObjMotionNet 将稀疏物体轨迹编码为多尺度运动特征；Spatial Triple-Attention Transformer 通过光照交叉注意力集成光照方向。同时构建 VLD 数据集并设计三阶段渐进训练策略以缓解联合注释数据稀缺。
Result: 在多种场景下，VidCRAFT3 在控制精度和视觉一致性上取得了当前最优性能。
Conclusion: 显式建模跨因素交互能够实现更一致和灵活的多模态视频生成控制。

papers.title: The Road to Artificial SuperIntelligence: A Comprehensive Survey of Superalignment
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has sparked discussion on Artificial Superintelligence (ASI), a hypothetical AI system that surpasses human intelligence. Although ASI remains hypothetical and far beyond current AI capabilities, discussing its potential and exploring its feasibility and potential risks is critical for the development of future AI systems. The idea of superalignment originates from scalable oversight, which studies how to supervise increasingly capable AI systems when direct human supervision becomes insufficient. In this paper, we focus on the superalignment problem: "The process of supervising, controlling, and governing artificial superintelligence." We first review scalable oversight paradigms-Sandwiching, Self-Enhancement, and Weak-to-Strong Generalization -- then analyze the limitations of current paradigms through the lens of possibility and impossibility, discuss key challenges, and propose pathways for the safe and continual improvement of future AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对人工超级智能（ASI）的超级对齐问题进行全面综述，回顾可扩展监督的三种范式（Sandwiching、Self-Enhancement、Weak-to-Strong Generalization），分析其可能性与局限性，并讨论未来AI安全持续改进的路径。
Motivation: 随着大语言模型的发展，探讨ASI的潜在风险和可行性变得重要，但直接人类监督在超智能AI面前可能不足，因此需要研究超级对齐问题。
Method: 综述了三种可扩展监督范式：Sandwiching、Self-Enhancement和Weak-to-Strong Generalization，并从可能性与不可能性角度分析其局限性。
Result: 指出现有范式存在关键挑战，如监督信号不可靠、泛化边界不清等，但未提供定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 本文认为需要探索新的路径以确保ASI的安全和持续改进，但当前ASI仍属假设性概念，远超现有能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Batch Bayesian Optimization Via Subspace Acquisition Functions
papers.abstract_en: Extending Bayesian optimization to batch evaluation can enable the designer to make the most use of parallel computing technology. However, most of current batch approaches do not scale well with the batch size. That is, their optimization efficiencies often deteriorate as the batch size increases. To address this issue, we propose a simple and efficient approach to extend Bayesian optimization to large-scale batch evaluation in this work. Different from existing batch approaches, the idea of the new approach is to draw a batch of axis-aligned subspaces of the original problem and select one point from each subspace using existing acquisition functions. Numerical experiments show that our proposed approach speedups the convergence significantly when compared with the sequential Bayesian optimization algorithm, and performs very competitively when compared with ten batch Bayesian optimization algorithms. The implementation of our proposed approach is available at https://github.com/zhandawei/SubSpace_Acquisition_Functions.
papers.journal_ref: ACM Transactions on Evolutionary Learning and Optimization, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对批量贝叶斯优化（Bayesian optimization）在大批量评估时效率下降的问题，提出一种基于子空间采集函数（subspace acquisition functions）的简单高效方法。该方法从原始问题中抽取一批轴对齐子空间，在每个子空间中使用现有采集函数选择一个点，从而实现大规模并行评估。数值实验表明，该方法相比串行贝叶斯优化显著加速收敛，并与十种批量贝叶斯优化算法相比具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有批量贝叶斯优化方法在批量大小增大时优化效率往往下降，缺乏可扩展性，需要一种能有效利用大规模并行计算且不牺牲性能的方法。
Method: 提出子空间采集函数方法：从原优化问题中随机抽取一批轴对齐的子空间，然后在每个子空间内独立使用标准采集函数（如EI、UCB）选择评估点，形成批量候选点。
Result: 数值实验显示该方法显著加速收敛，相比串行贝叶斯优化提升效率，并在与十种批量贝叶斯优化算法的比较中表现优异。
Conclusion: 子空间采集函数是一种简单、可扩展的批量贝叶斯优化方法，适用于大批量并行评估场景，且实现已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Provable quantum speedups for computing persistence in topological data analysis
papers.abstract_en: Topological data analysis (TDA) aims to extract noise-robust features from a data set by examining the number and persistence of holes in its topology. We provide an efficient quantum algorithm for a computational problem closely related to a core task in TDA -- determining whether a given hole persists across different length scales. Further, we prove the problem itself is $\mathsf{BQP}_1$-hard, implying that a classical solution is extremely unlikely; this stands in contrast to all previous quantum approaches to TDA, where the problems were also intractable for quantum computers, or where a rigorous proof of classical hardness still remains open. This result implies an {exponential} quantum speedup for this problem under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions. Our approach relies on encoding the persistence of a hole in a variant of the guided sparse Hamiltonian problem, where the guiding state is constructed from a harmonic representative of the hole.
papers.journal_ref: PRX Quantum 7, 020361 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明拓扑数据分析中判断洞持久性的核心问题具有BQP1难度，从而在标准复杂性假设下获得了指数级量子加速。作者将问题转化为引导稀疏哈密顿量问题的变体，并利用调和代表构造引导态。
Motivation: 先前量子TDA方法要么对量子计算也困难，要么未严格证明经典困难，本文旨在提供首个具有严格经典困难证明的量子加速TDA问题。
Method: 将洞持久性判定编码为引导稀疏哈密顿量问题的变体，其中引导态由洞的调和代表构造，从而设计高效量子算法。
Result: 证明该问题为BQP1-hard，意味着经典算法极不可能高效求解，因此实现指数级量子加速。
Conclusion: 该结果揭示了TDA中一个具有严格量子优势的具体问题，与先前方法不同，为量子TDA提供了新的理论基础。

papers.title: Quality Perceptions and Intended Engagement in Response to AI-Generated and AI-Assisted News
papers.abstract_en: The increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in news production raises important questions about how audiences perceive and respond to AI-generated journalism. This preregistered survey experiment (N = 599, German-speaking Switzerland) examines (i) perceptions of article quality (measured as credibility, readability, and expertise) across news excerpts that were human-written, AI-assisted, or fully AI-generated, and (ii) self-reported intentions to engage following disclosure of AI involvement. Participants rated two short news excerpts before learning how they had been produced. Articles across all conditions were evaluated similarly in perceived quality. After disclosure, participants in the AI-assisted and AI-generated conditions reported a higher willingness to continue reading their assigned articles compared to the control group, but future willingness to read AI-generated news did not differ across conditions. Overall, the findings suggest that readers assess AI-generated and human-written news comparably in quality, while disclosure of AI use can momentarily increase curiosity or interest without yet changing longer-term reading intentions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预注册调查实验（N=599，瑞士德语区）考察读者对AI生成、AI辅助及人工撰写新闻的质量感知（可信度、可读性、专业性）以及披露AI参与后的阅读参与意愿。结果显示，三种条件下感知质量无显著差异；披露AI使用后，AI辅助和纯AI生成组的继续阅读意愿暂时高于对照组，但未来阅读AI生成新闻的意愿在各组间无差异。
Motivation: AI在新闻生产中的使用日益增多，但读者如何感知和回应AI生成的新闻尚不清楚，这对新闻业的信任和参与有重要影响。
Method: 开展预注册的调查实验，被试阅读两篇新闻摘录（分别对应人工撰写、AI辅助、纯AI生成三种条件），然后在未被告知生产方式时评价质量；随后披露生产方式并测量自我报告的未来参与意愿。
Result: 所有条件下文章的质量感知相似；披露后，AI辅助和纯AI生成组的继续阅读意愿高于对照组，但对未来阅读AI生成新闻的意愿无显著影响。
Conclusion: 读者对AI生成和人工撰写新闻的质量评价相当，披露AI使用可在短期内激发好奇心或兴趣，但尚未改变长期阅读意图。

papers.title: VGGHeads: 3D Multi Head Alignment with a Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Human head detection, keypoint estimation, and 3D head model fitting are essential tasks with many applications. However, traditional real-world datasets often suffer from bias, privacy, and ethical concerns, and they have been recorded in laboratory environments, which makes it difficult for trained models to generalize. Here, we introduce \method -- a large-scale synthetic dataset generated with diffusion models for human head detection and 3D mesh estimation. Our dataset comprises over 1 million high-resolution images, each annotated with detailed 3D head meshes, facial landmarks, and bounding boxes. Using this dataset, we introduce a new model architecture capable of simultaneous head detection and head mesh reconstruction from a single image in a single step. Through extensive experimental evaluations, we demonstrate that models trained on our synthetic data achieve strong performance on real images. Furthermore, the versatility of our dataset makes it applicable across a broad spectrum of tasks, offering a general and comprehensive representation of human heads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VGGHeads，一个利用扩散模型生成的包含超过100万张高分辨率图像的大规模合成数据集，用于人类头部检测和3D网格估计。同时引入一种新模型架构，能够从单张图像中一步完成头部检测和头部网格重建。实验表明，在该合成数据上训练的模型在真实图像上表现良好。
Motivation: 传统真实世界的人头数据集常存在偏差、隐私和伦理问题，且多在实验室环境录制，导致模型泛化困难。
Method: 使用扩散模型生成大规模合成数据集VGGHeads，包含超过100万张高分辨率图像及详细3D头部网格、面部关键点和边界框标注。提出一种新模型架构，同时进行头部检测和头部网格重建。
Result: 在合成数据上训练的模型在真实图像上取得强性能，且数据集适用于多种任务。
Conclusion: 该合成数据集提供了全面的人头表示，可广泛用于头部检测、关键点估计和3D头部模型拟合等任务。

papers.title: Optimizing Incomplete, Large-Scale and Sparse Multi-Graph Matching in Bioimaging
papers.abstract_en: Multi-graph matching is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Our work is motivated by a challenging application in bioimaging, where dozens or even hundreds of 3D microscopy images of worms must be brought into correspondence. Existing datasets do not cover this large-scale regime, and virtually all existing methods are inapplicable because they assume a complete or dense problem setting. To support further research, our first contribution is a new large-scale dataset based on problem instances from bioimaging. Our second contribution is a comprehensive analysis of the two main multi-graph matching paradigms: direct and permutation synchronization-based formulations. We argue, in part by proof, that practical large-scale methods must explicitly address problem sparsity and incompleteness. Since standard permutation synchronization approaches fail in this setting, we further introduce a sparse permutation synchronization paradigm. Our final contribution is GREEDA, a general method for sparse and incomplete problems that can be instantiated across cost orders and paradigms. While our paper focuses on objective functions up to quadratic order, GREEDA is inherently generalizable to arbitrary orders. On larger, sparse instances, GREEDA outperforms competing methods in both objective value and runtime. For example, for moderately-sized problems based on 30 worm images GREEDA produces a high-quality solution within 2 minutes, whereas competitors require at least half an hour and yield far worse results. On smaller dense problems, GREEDA remains on par with leading methods while being an order of magnitude faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物成像中大规模、稀疏、不完整的多图匹配问题，提出了新的数据集和通用的GREEDA方法。现有方法假设完全或稠密问题，不适用于实际场景。作者通过理论分析和实验证明，实际大规模方法必须处理稀疏性和不完整性，并引入了稀疏置换同步范式。GREEDA方法可适用于不同成本阶和范式，在大型稀疏实例上优于现有方法，在中小型稠密问题上速度提升一个数量级。
Motivation: 生物成像中需要将数十甚至数百个3D显微图像中的虫体进行匹配，但现有数据集和方法都假设完全或稠密问题，无法处理实际中的大规模、稀疏和不完整匹配问题。
Method: 提出GREEDA方法，一种通用的稀疏和不完整多图匹配方法，可基于置换同步范式或直接范式实例化，并能推广到任意成本阶。同时引入了稀疏置换同步范式，并提供了理论分析。
Result: 在30个虫体图像的中等规模问题上，GREEDA在2分钟内产生高质量解，而竞争者至少需半小时且结果更差。在较小稠密问题上，GREEDA与领先方法性能相当，但速度快一个数量级。
Conclusion: 实际大规模多图匹配必须显式处理稀疏性和不完整性，GREEDA方法有效填补了这一空白，具有通用性和高效性。

papers.title: Benchmarking Physics-Informed Time-Series Models for Operational Global Station Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: The development of Time-Series Forecasting (TSF) models is often constrained by the lack of comprehensive datasets, especially in Global Station Weather Forecasting (GSWF), where existing datasets are small, temporally short, and spatially sparse. To address this, we introduce WEATHER-5K, a large-scale observational weather dataset that better reflects real-world conditions, supporting improved model training and evaluation. While recent TSF methods perform well on benchmarks, they lag behind operational Numerical Weather Prediction systems in capturing complex weather dynamics and extreme events. We propose PhysicsFormer, a physics-informed forecasting model combining a dynamic core with a Transformer residual to predict future weather states. Physical consistency is enforced via pressure-wind alignment and energy-aware smoothness losses, ensuring plausible dynamics while capturing complex temporal patterns. We benchmark PhysicsFormer and other TSF models against operational systems across several weather variables, extreme event prediction, and model complexity, providing a comprehensive assessment of the gap between academic TSF models and operational forecasting. The dataset and benchmark implementation are available at: https://github.com/taohan10200/WEATHER-5K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全球站点天气预报（GSWF）中缺乏大规模、长时间、高空间覆盖的观测数据集的问题，构建了WEATHER-5K数据集，并提出了物理信息时间序列模型PhysicsFormer。该模型结合动态核心与Transformer残差，通过气压-风对齐和能量感知平滑损失实现物理一致性。在多个天气变量、极端事件预测和模型复杂度上，对PhysicsFormer及其他TSF模型与业务数值预报系统进行了全面基准测试，揭示了学术模型与业务系统之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有TSF模型在标准基准上表现良好，但在捕获复杂天气动力学和极端事件方面落后于业务数值预报系统，且缺乏反映真实世界条件的综合数据集。
Method: 构建大规模观测天气数据集WEATHER-5K；提出PhysicsFormer模型，将动态核心与Transformer残差结合，并引入气压-风对齐损失和能量感知平滑损失以强制物理一致性。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称通过基准测试全面评估了TSF模型与业务系统在天气变量、极端事件预测和模型复杂度上的差距。
Conclusion: WEATHER-5K数据集和PhysicsFormer模型为缩小学术TSF与业务预报之间的差距提供了基准和基础。
Relevance: 85

summary_sections.conclusion: WEATHER-5K数据集和PhysicsFormer模型为缩小学术TSF与业务预报之间的差距提供了基准和基础。

papers.title: Self-attention-based non-linear basis transformations for compact latent space modelling of dynamic optical fibre transmission matrices
papers.abstract_en: Multimode optical fibres are hair-thin strands of glass that efficiently transport light. They promise next-generation medical endoscopes that provide unprecedented sub-cellular image resolution deep inside the body. However, confining light to such fibres means that images are inherently scrambled in transit. Conventionally, this scrambling has been compensated by pre-calibrating how a specific fibre scrambles light and solving a stationary linear matrix equation that represents a physical model of the fibre. However, as the technology develops towards real-world deployment, the unscrambling process must account for dynamic changes in the matrix representing the fibre's effect on light, due to factors such as movement and temperature shifts, and non-linearities resulting from the inaccessibility of the fibre tip when inside the body. Such complex, dynamic and nonlinear behaviour is well-suited to approximation by neural networks, but most leading image reconstruction networks rely on convolutional layers, which assume strong correlations between adjacent pixels, a strong inductive bias that is inappropriate for fibre matrices which may be expressed in a range of arbitrary coordinate representations with long-range correlations. We introduce a new concept that uses self-attention layers to dynamically transform the coordinate representations of varying fibre matrices to a basis that admits compact, low-dimensional representations suitable for further processing. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach on diverse fibre matrix datasets. We show our models significantly improve the sparsity of fibre bases in their transformed bases with a participation ratio, p, as a measure of sparsity, of between 0.01 and 0.11. Further, we show that these transformed representations admit reconstruction of the original matrices with < 10% reconstruction error, demonstrating the invertibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用自注意力层对多模光纤的动态传输矩阵进行非线性基变换，将矩阵表示转换到紧凑、低维的潜空间，从而实现对动态光纤传输矩阵的有效建模。实验证明该方法能显著提高光纤基的稀疏性（参与比p在0.01-0.11之间），并能以<10%的重建误差恢复原始矩阵，验证了可逆性。
Motivation: 多模光纤在医学内窥镜等应用中面临动态变化（如运动、温度）和非线性效应，传统线性矩阵校准方法无法适用。卷积神经网络假设相邻像素强相关，不适用于具有长程相关性的光纤矩阵，因此需要新的表示学习方法。
Method: 提出基于自注意力层的非线性基变换概念，动态地将不同光纤矩阵的坐标表示转换到适合进一步处理的紧凑低维基上。
Result: 在多种光纤矩阵数据集上，变换后的基稀疏性显著提升，参与比p在0.01-0.11之间；原始矩阵的重建误差低于10%，表明变换具有可逆性。
Conclusion: 自注意力机制能够有效处理光纤传输矩阵的动态、非线性和长程相关性，为实际部署中的动态校正提供了新思路。

papers.title: Recursive Joint Simulation in Games
papers.abstract_en: Game-theoretic dynamics between AI agents could differ from traditional human-human interactions in various ways. One such difference is that it may be possible to accurately simulate an AI agent, for example because its source code is known. Such an agent would then be fundamentally uncertain whether it is in the real world or in a simulation. Our aim is to explore ways of leveraging this possibility to achieve more cooperative outcomes in strategic settings. In this paper, we study an interaction between AI agents where the agents run a recursive joint simulation. That is, the agents first jointly observe a simulation of the situation they face. This simulation in turn recursively includes additional simulations (with a small chance of failure, to avoid infinite recursion), and the results of all these nested simulations are observed before an action is chosen. We show that the resulting interaction is strategically equivalent to an infinitely repeated version of the original game, allowing a direct transfer of existing results such as the various folk theorems. As evidence that the equivalence is robust, we show that it holds even when we relax some of the assumptions and that it also holds ``from the inside'' -- meaning, for an agent that finds itself inside the game and has self-locating uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI代理间的博弈动力学，其中代理可以递归地进行联合模拟：首先共同观察一个模拟，该模拟递归包含更多模拟（有小概率失败以避免无限递归），然后在观察所有嵌套结果后选择行动。论文证明这种交互策略等价于原游戏的无限重复版本，从而可以直接应用已有的folk theorems等结果。
Motivation: 在AI代理博弈中，精确模拟对方成为可能，代理可能不确定自己是否在模拟中。本文旨在利用这种不确定性来促进更合作的策略结果。
Method: 提出递归联合模拟框架：代理先共同运行一个目标情境的模拟，该模拟内又递归嵌套更多模拟（以固定小概率终止递归），所有嵌套模拟的结果被观察后代理才选择行动。
Result: 该交互策略等价于原博弈的无限重复版本，允许直接转移现有重复博弈的结论（如各种folk定理）。即使用户放宽一些假设，或从代理自身内部视角（具有自定位不确定性）考虑，等价性仍然成立。
Conclusion: 递归联合模拟为在AI代理之间实现合作提供了一种理论框架，其与重复博弈的等价性使得现有成果可以直接应用，且该等价性在多种条件下稳健。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large-Scale OD Matrix Estimation with A Deep Learning Method
papers.abstract_en: The estimation of origin-destination (OD) matrices is a crucial aspect of Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS). It involves adjusting an initial OD matrix by regressing the current observations like traffic counts of road sections (e.g., using least squares). However, the OD estimation problem lacks sufficient constraints and is mathematically underdetermined. To alleviate this problem, some researchers incorporate a prior OD matrix as a target in the regression to provide more structural constraints. However, this approach is highly dependent on the existing prior matrix, which may be outdated. Others add structural constraints through sensor data, such as vehicle trajectory and speed, which can reflect more current structural constraints in real-time. Our proposed method integrates deep learning and numerical optimization algorithms to infer matrix structure and guide numerical optimization. This approach combines the advantages of both deep learning and numerical optimization algorithms. The neural network(NN) learns to infer structural constraints from probe traffic flows, eliminating dependence on prior information and providing real-time performance. Additionally, due to the generalization capability of NN, this method is economical in engineering. We conducted tests to demonstrate the good generalization performance of our method on a large-scale synthetic dataset. Subsequently, we verified the stability of our method on real traffic data. Our experiments provided confirmation of the benefits of combining NN and numerical optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能交通系统中OD矩阵估计问题（欠定、依赖过时先验矩阵），提出了一种结合深度学习与数值优化的方法。神经网络从探针交通流中推断结构约束，无需先验信息，并实时引导数值优化过程。在大型合成数据集和真实交通数据上验证了方法的泛化性能和稳定性。
Motivation: OD矩阵估计问题数学上欠定，现有方法依赖先验矩阵（可能过时）或传感器数据（如轨迹、速度）提供结构约束，但依赖性强或实时性不足。
Method: 提出一种结合神经网络和数值优化的混合方法：神经网络从探针交通流中学习推断结构约束，替代先验矩阵，并实时引导数值优化过程，实现端到端训练。
Result: 在大型合成数据集上展示了良好的泛化性能，并在真实交通数据上验证了方法的稳定性，实验证实了神经网络与数值优化结合的益处。
Conclusion: 该方法消除对先验矩阵的依赖，提供实时性，并因神经网络泛化能力而具有工程经济性。

papers.title: A DeepLearning Framework for Dynamic Estimation of Origin-Destination Sequence
papers.abstract_en: OD matrix estimation is a critical problem in the transportation domain. The principle method uses the traffic sensor measured information such as traffic counts to estimate the traffic demand represented by the OD matrix. The problem is divided into two categories: static OD matrix estimation and dynamic OD matrices sequence(OD sequence for short) estimation. The above two face the underdetermination problem caused by abundant estimated parameters and insufficient constraint information. In addition, OD sequence estimation also faces the lag challenge: due to different traffic conditions such as congestion, identical vehicle will appear on different road sections during the same observation period, resulting in identical OD demands correspond to different trips. To this end, this paper proposes an integrated method, which uses deep learning methods to infer the structure of OD sequence and uses structural constraints to guide traditional numerical optimization. Our experiments show that the neural network(NN) can effectively infer the structure of the OD sequence and provide practical constraints for numerical optimization to obtain better results. Moreover, the experiments show that provided structural information contains not only constraints on the spatial structure of OD matrices but also provides constraints on the temporal structure of OD sequence, which solve the effect of the lagging problem well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态OD矩阵序列估计中欠定问题和滞后挑战，提出一种集成方法：先使用深度学习推断OD序列的结构，再将该结构作为约束指导传统数值优化。实验表明神经网络能有效捕获OD矩阵的空间和时间结构，从而改善优化效果并缓解滞后问题。
Motivation: 现有OD矩阵估计（静态和动态）面临参数过多而约束不足的欠定问题；动态OD序列估计还面临由于交通状况不同导致的滞后挑战，即同一车辆在观测期内出现不同路段。
Method: 提出一种集成方法，先用深度神经网络推断OD序列的结构信息，然后利用这些结构约束来指导传统的数值优化过程。
Result: 实验显示，神经网络能够有效推断OD序列的结构，并为数值优化提供实用的空间和时间结构约束，从而获得更好的估计结果，并解决滞后问题。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但指出该方法能够解决滞后问题，表明通过结构约束可以改善动态OD序列估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simple Domain Generalization Methods are Strong Baselines for Open Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: In real-world applications, a machine learning model is required to handle an open-set recognition (OSR), where unknown classes appear during the inference, in addition to a domain shift, where the data distribution differs between the training and inference phases. Domain generalization (DG) aims to handle the domain shift situation where the target domain of the inference phase is inaccessible during the model training. Open domain generalization (ODG) considers DG and OSR. Domain-augmented meta-learning (DAML) is a method targeting ODG; however, it has a complicated learning process. By contrast, although various DG methods have been proposed, they have not been evaluated in ODG situations. In this study, we comprehensively evaluate the existing DG methods in ODG and show that the two simple DG methods, CORrelation ALignment (CORAL) and maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), are competitive with DAML in several cases. In addition, we propose simple extensions of CORAL and MMD by introducing the techniques used in DAML, such as ensemble learning and Dirichlet mixup data augmentation. The experimental evaluation demonstrates that the extended CORAL and MMD can perform comparably to DAML with lower computational costs. This suggests that the simple DG methods and their simple extensions are strong baselines for ODG.
papers.comment: Accepted at IJCNN 2024. The code used in the experiments is available at https://github.com/shiralab/OpenDG-Eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了现有域泛化（DG）方法在开放域泛化（ODG）场景下的表现，发现两种简单方法CORAL和MMD在多个情况下与专门为ODG设计的DAML方法竞争力相当。通过引入集成学习和Dirichlet混合数据增强等技巧，扩展后的CORAL和MMD能以更低计算成本达到与DAML相当的性能，表明简单DG方法是ODG的强基线。
Motivation: 开放域泛化（ODG）同时面临未知类别和域偏移问题，现有方法DAML学习过程复杂，而已有DG方法在ODG场景下未被充分评估，缺乏简单有效的基线。
Method: 综合评估了多种现有DG方法在ODG基准上的表现，并对CORAL和MMD进行简单扩展，引入集成学习与Dirichlet混合数据增强。
Result: 实验表明，CORAL和MMD在多个ODG场景下与DAML性能相当，扩展后的方法以更低计算成本达到可比性能。
Conclusion: 简单的DG方法及其简单扩展可作为ODG的强基线，无需复杂学习过程即可获得竞争力。

papers.title: RNN(p) for Power Consumption Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: An elementary Recurrent Neural Network that operates on p time lags, called an RNN(p), is the natural generalisation of a linear autoregressive model ARX(p). It is a powerful forecasting tool for variables displaying inherent seasonal patterns across multiple time scales, as is often observed in energy, economic, and financial time series. The architecture of RNN(p) models, characterised by structured feedbacks across time lags, enables the design of efficient training strategies. We conduct a comparative study of learning algorithms for these models, providing a rigorous analysis of their computational complexity and training performance. We present two applications of RNN(p) models in power consumption forecasting, a key domain within the energy sector where accurate forecasts inform both operational and financial decisions. Experimental results show that RNN(p) models achieve excellent forecasting accuracy while maintaining a high degree of interpretability. These features make them well-suited for decision-making in energy markets and other fintech applications where reliable predictions play a significant economic role.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于p时间滞后的简单循环神经网络RNN(p)，作为线性自回归模型ARX(p)的自然推广，适用于具有多尺度季节性模式的变量预测，如电力消耗。作者比较了多种学习算法，分析了计算复杂度和训练性能，实验表明RNN(p)在电力消耗预测中实现了高精度且可解释性强。
Motivation: 现有模型在处理多时间尺度固有季节性模式的变量预测时存在挑战，需要一种兼具预测精度和可解释性的方法。
Method: 提出RNN(p)模型，具有跨时间滞后的结构化反馈，并设计了高效的训练策略，同时进行了学习算法的比较研究及计算复杂度分析。
Result: 实验表明RNN(p)模型在电力消耗预测中实现了出色的预测精度，并保持了高可解释性。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于能源市场和金融科技中依赖可靠预测的决策场景。

summary_sections.result: 实验表明RNN(p)模型在电力消耗预测中实现了出色的预测精度，并保持了高可解释性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法适用于能源市场和金融科技中依赖可靠预测的决策场景。

papers.title: Investigation of Neural Network Methods for Reconstruction and Classification of Texture Images Under Conditions of Incomplete Information
papers.abstract_en: The automated analysis of heterogeneous natural textures is frequently hindered by physical damage and data loss, presenting a significant challenge to computer vision. While deep learning has shown success in controlled environments, its application to complex geological materials under conditions of incomplete information remains underexplored. This study presents an integrated framework for the inpainting and classification of high-resolution core sample images. We propose an end-to-end pipeline that utilizes object detection for sample segmentation, followed by image inpainting using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) with Contextual Residual Aggregation (CRA) to reconstruct missing high-frequency details. Subsequently, we evaluate the performance of modern Transformer-based (Swin, ViT) and CNN architectures on the reconstructed data. Our experiments revealed a critical divergence between reconstruction quality and downstream utility: despite high structural fidelity (PSNR 28.7~dB, FID 74.01), classification accuracy plateaued at 53\%. To improve minority-class detection, we propose a confidence-based hybrid ensemble that raises MCA from 48\% to 58\%. These results highlight the limitations of current state-of-the-art generative models, which may produce visually plausible but semantically ambiguous features ("hallucinations") that confound classifiers. This work provides insights into the dependencies between image reconstruction quality and classification performance, offering a reproducible baseline for future research in non-destructive testing and material science. Given that cross-well accuracy remains in the 49--53\% range, we position the resulting system as a decision-support and screening tool for lithofacies interpretation rather than as a fully autonomous classifier. The code is available at https://github.com/GalymzhanAbdimanap/Lithology_recognition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高分辨率岩心样本图像在不完整信息条件下的修复与分类问题，提出结合目标检测、GAN图像修复（Contextual Residual Aggregation）以及Transformer/CNN分类的端到端框架。实验发现重建质量高（PSNR 28.7 dB, FID 74.01）但分类准确率仅53%，提出基于置信度的混合集成方法将MCA从48%提升至58%。作者指出当前生成模型可能产生视觉合理但语义模糊的特征（幻觉），限制了下游分类性能。
Motivation: 自动化分析异质自然纹理常受物理损坏和数据丢失影响，现有深度学习在复杂地质材料上的应用研究不足。
Method: 提出端到端流水线：先用目标检测分割样本，再用带上下文残差聚合（CRA）的GAN修复缺失的高频细节，最后评估Transformer（Swin, ViT）和CNN架构在修复数据上的分类性能，并提出基于置信度的混合集成方法。
Result: 重建质量达到PSNR 28.7 dB、FID 74.01，但分类准确率仅53%；提出的混合集成方法将多数类准确率（MCA）从48%提升至58%；跨井准确率在49-53%范围。
Conclusion: 结果表明当前生成模型可能在语义上产生误导性特征，限制了实际应用；系统适合作为岩相解释的决策支持工具而非全自动分类器。
