papers.title: SP-TransientBench: A Real-Captured Single Photon Perception Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Single-photon LiDAR (SPL) based on single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) sensing enables time-resolved photon measurements with extreme sensitivity, offering unique potential for active 3D perception in photon-starved scenarios.However, real-world single photon perception remains fundamentally challenging due to unique measurement noise and complex multi-return transient phenomena, which jointly complicate geometric reconstruction and semantic scene understanding. Despite growing interest in SPAD-based sensing, existing studies are largely limited to simulated data or small-scale controlled captures. As a result, systematic evaluation of real-world single photon perception across depth estimation, multi-view reconstruction, and 3D semantic understanding remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SP-TransientBench (STB), a real-captured multi-task benchmark for single photon perception. SP-TransientBenc comprises 10 diverse scenes and 10,297 views captured using a solid-state single-photon LiDAR at $256\times192$ resolution. Each view provides full time-of-flight histograms with multi-return behavior,standardized metadata, and calibrated camera poses for multi-view evaluation. We further provide 13-class 3D semantic annotations for selected scenes. By providing dedicated data splits and evaluation protocols for each task, STB enables consistent and reproducible benchmarking of real-world single photon perception across multiple 3D vision problems. The dataset and code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SP-TransientBench (STB)，一个真实采集的单光子 LiDAR (SPL) 多任务基准数据集。数据集包含 10 个场景、10297 个视图，采用 256×192 分辨率的固态单光子 LiDAR 采集，提供完整飞行时间直方图、多返回行为、标准化元数据和标定相机位姿，并为部分场景提供 13 类 3D 语义标注。STB 为深度估计、多视角重建和 3D 语义理解提供专用数据划分和评估协议，旨在推动真实单光子感知的系统评估。
Motivation: 现有单光子感知研究大多基于模拟数据或小规模受控采集，缺乏真实场景下深度估计、多视角重建和 3D 语义理解的系统评估基准。
Method: 构建真实采集的多任务基准数据集，使用固态单光子 LiDAR 以 256×192 分辨率捕获 10 个场景的 10297 个视图，每个视图包含多返回飞行时间直方图、标准元数据和标定相机位姿，并针对选定场景提供 13 类 3D 语义标注。
Result: 数据集提供 10 个场景、10297 个视图，并为每个任务（深度估计、多视角重建、3D 语义理解）设定专用数据划分和评估协议，支持一致且可重复的基准测试。
Conclusion: STB 填补了真实单光子感知基准的空白，为 3D 视觉问题提供标准化评估平台。

papers.title: Engagement Intensity as a Learner-Modeling Signal for Adaptive AI Ethics Instruction
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive AI ethics instruction in graduate research training benefits from intake measures that reflect differences in prior LLM experience. Prior coursework or workshop attendance is an obvious candidate, but it is not clear whether it is associated with pre-instruction ratings on key AI perception items. We compare three candidate intake features, self-reported usage frequency, self-rated LLM familiarity, and prior AI education, across five baseline perception outcomes in 93 bioscience graduate and postdoctoral trainees enrolled in a required research ethics course. Usage frequency shows Holm-corrected associations with all five outcomes, self-rated familiarity with three, and prior AI education with none. A threshold-like pattern at the lower end of the scale is most visible for training interest and accuracy trust rather than appearing as a uniform gradient across all five outcomes. In a short intake survey, reported LLM use is more consistently associated with these perceptions than prior coursework or workshops, with self-rated familiarity serving as a secondary indicator. These results suggest that simple pre-instruction behavioral signals can inform lightweight intake profiling for adaptive AI ethics education.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在研究生AI伦理课程中，通过简单的课前调查（LLM使用频率、自评熟悉度、先前AI教育）来预测学生对AI的感知（兴趣、准确信任等）。发现LLM使用频率与五个感知结果都有显著关联，而先前AI教育无关联。表明行为信号可用于适应性教学。
Motivation: 自适应AI伦理教学需要反映学习者之前LLM经验的差异，但先前课程/工作坊是否与实际感知关联尚不清楚。
Method: 比较三个候选特征（使用频率、自评熟悉度、先前AI教育）与五个基线感知结果（培训兴趣、准确信任等）的关联，在93名研究生和博士后中进行相关性分析。
Result: 使用频率与所有五个结果有Holm校正关联，自评熟悉度与三个关联，先前AI教育与无关联。低端阈值模式在培训兴趣和准确信任上最明显。
Conclusion: 简单的课前行为信号可以用于轻量级适应性的AI伦理教育。

papers.title: CEO-Bench: Can Agents Play the Long Game?
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents are becoming proficient executors at isolated, short-horizon tasks such as software engineering and customer service. Yet real-world challenges require a combination of sophisticated skills that remain largely untested in agents: (1) navigating long horizons amid uncertainty; (2) acquiring information in noisy environments; (3) adapting to a changing world; (4) orchestrating multiple moving parts toward a coherent goal. We introduce CEO-Bench, which evaluates these capabilities together by simulating a representative real-world task: operating a startup for 500 days. An agent manages pricing, marketing, budgeting, and many other aspects of a fictional company through a programmable Python interface, operating in the same environment and facing the same challenges as a human CEO. Success demands analyzing noisy, interconnected business databases, translating signals into sound strategy, and coordinating many decisions with programming. The strongest agents write sophisticated code that simulates customer cohorts to forecast future cash and mines negotiation history to uncover hidden customer preferences. Even so, most state-of-the-art models struggle in this environment. Only Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 finish above the $1M starting balance, and neither consistently turns a profit. CEO-Bench takes a first step toward measuring the intelligence required to drive sustained, adaptive progress over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CEO-Bench，一个模拟创业公司运营 500 天的基准，用于评估语言模型代理在长周期、不确定性和多目标环境中的综合能力。代理需管理定价、营销、预算等任务，并处理噪声数据和动态变化。最强模型虽能编写复杂代码模拟客户群，但多数模型难以盈利。
Motivation: 现有基准大多测试代理在孤立、短期任务上的表现，缺乏对长期规划、信息获取、环境适应和多任务协调等核心能力的综合评估。
Method: 构建一个可编程 Python 接口，模拟创业公司 500 天的运营环境，要求代理管理多个业务方面，从噪声商务数据库中提取信号并制定策略。
Result: 最先进的模型如 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5.5 仅能维持初始资金（100万美元）以上，但均无法稳定盈利，表明当前代理在长期自适应任务中表现不足。
Conclusion: CEO-Bench 为衡量代理在持续、自适应进步中的智能提供了初步测试，但现有模型在该环境中的表现仍有显著差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TS-Fault: Benchmarking Time Series Forecasters Against Structural Faults
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting (TSF) underpins consequential decisions in energy, transportation, finance, and healthcare, yet TSF models are almost universally ranked by a single number (e.g., average error) on clean held-out data, under the implicit assumption that it predicts deployed reliability. However, real faults are not i.i.d noise but structured events with temporal shape, broken cross-variable dependencies, regime change coupled with missingness, and causal propagation across a sensing pipeline. Treating TSF robustness as a data-quality problem, we present TS-Fault, a benchmark that evaluates forecasting models under explicit, parameterized fault scenarios with controllable semantic difficulty. TS-Fault organizes recurring failures into four modes along two orthogonal axes (observation- vs mechanism-level; univariate vs multivariate) and injects each fault into the most prediction-critical window via a unified importance score. This design enables robustness to be tested against the structures models actually rely on, rather than reduced to generic noise sensitivity. We evaluate 21 models across 6 datasets, 4 modes, and 5 difficulty levels under a paired clean/corrupt protocol. The results reveal three findings that contradict common leaderboard intuition: (i) clean-data accuracy anti-correlates with robustness; (ii) clean rankings are preserved under observation-level faults but reshuffled under mechanism-level faults; and (iii) all catastrophic failures occur under mechanism-level faults, with foundation models achieving the highest clean-data accuracy yet exhibiting the greatest fragility. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Ray-zyy/TS-Fault.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TS-Fault 基准，用于评估时间序列预测模型在结构化故障下的鲁棒性。通过四类参数化故障（观测级与机制级、单变量与多变量组合）和可控难度注入，对 21 个模型在 6 个数据集上测试，发现干净数据准确率与鲁棒性反相关，基础模型（如大模型）最脆弱。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型排名仅基于干净数据上的平均误差，忽略真实世界中非 i.i.d. 的结构化故障（如时序形状变化、跨变量依赖断裂、机制改变等），导致排名无法反映部署可靠性。
Method: 提出 TS-Fault 基准，包含四个故障模式（观测级单变量、观测级多变量、机制级单变量、机制级多变量），每个故障通过统一重要性分数注入预测最关键的窗口，并设置 5 个难度级别。
Result: 在 6 个数据集、21 个模型上实验，发现：(i) 干净数据准确率与鲁棒性负相关；(ii) 观测级故障下干净排名保持，机制级故障下排名重排；(iii) 所有灾难性失败出现在机制级故障，基础模型（如大模型）干净准确率最高但最脆弱。
Conclusion: 时间序列预测模型的鲁棒性不能由干净数据准确率推断，机制级故障是评估可靠性的关键，需要在特定故障场景下测试。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Effects of sparsity and superposition on loss in simple autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: One of the major difficulties in the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks is the occurrence of polysemanticity, which suggests that each neuron is typically responsible for multiple different tasks, impeding a clean interpretation of their function. The seminal paper of Elhage et al. (2022) argues that this occurs due to superposition, a phenomenon where the neural network represents distinct features as non-orthogonal directions in a lower-dimensional space, a strategy that allows much greater compression of the data without sacrificing fidelity due to the feature sparsity of input vectors. Elhage et al. (2022) empirically validates these hypotheses in a rather natural and simple autoencoder with sparse inputs. The contribution of the present work is to analyze the mathematical basis for the occurrence and optimality of superposition, while rigorously corroborating some of their findings. In particular, we provide upper and lower bounds for the L2 reconstruction loss, tight in the very sparse regime, for power activation functions. A short list of interesting open problems are also included at the end.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从数学上分析了神经网络机械可解释性中的叠加现象，证明了在稀疏输入下，使用幂激活函数的简单自动编码器的L2重构损失存在紧的上下界，证实了Elhage等人关于叠加现象的假设。
Motivation: 神经网络中多义性（polysemanticity）阻碍了清晰的可解释性，其根源被认为是叠加现象，但缺乏严格的数学分析。
Method: 为具有稀疏输入和幂激活函数的简单自动编码器推导了L2重构损失的上下界，并在极稀疏区域给出紧界。

Conclusion: 摘要指出本文为叠加现象提供了数学基础，并证实了Elhage等人的部分发现，同时列出了一些开放问题。

papers.title: Do as the Romans Do: Learning Universal Behaviors from Heterogeneous Agents
papers.abstract_en: Humans often acquire new skills by observing others, since observed behaviors implicitly reveal how to act in an environment. However, observations drawn from a heterogeneous population introduce conflicting behavioral signals, making it difficult to determine which behaviors are worth imitating. We address this challenge with General Reward Inference and Disentanglement (GRID), a social learning method that extracts universally useful behaviors from a heterogeneous population of demonstrators pursuing different goals. GRID decomposes per-agent reward functions into a general reward, capturing behaviors shared across all agents, and specific rewards, capturing individual preferences and objectives. Training exclusively on the general reward provides a new paradigm of generalist pretraining. It yields a generalist agent that internalizes universal environmental competencies, such as safety and basic task proficiency, without the mode-averaging bias that afflicts standard learning from demonstration techniques. This generalist serves as a superior prior for fine-tuning to downstream tasks, including preferences unseen during training. Experiments across a synthetic basis function decomposition, multi-agent Craftax, and a continuous autonomous driving simulator (Highway-Env) confirm that GRID successfully disentangles reward structure in a semantically meaningful way, outperforms standard learning from demonstration baselines, and enables more efficient and stable specialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通用奖励推理与解耦（GRID）方法，从追求不同目标的异构演示者群体中提取普遍有用的行为。GRID将每个智能体的奖励函数分解为通用奖励（捕捉所有智能体共享的行为）和特定奖励（捕捉个体偏好和目标）。仅基于通用奖励训练可得到通用智能体，它内化了环境通用能力（如安全性和基本任务熟练度），避免了标准模仿学习中的模式平均偏差。实验在合成基函数分解、多智能体Craftax和连续自动驾驶模拟器上验证了GRID的有效性。
Motivation: 人类通过观察他人学习新技能，但异质群体的观察会引入冲突的行为信号，难以确定哪些行为值得模仿。现有模仿学习方法在异质演示者面前往往产生模式平均偏差。
Method: GRID通过分解每个演示者的奖励函数为通用奖励和特定奖励，仅用通用奖励进行预训练，得到的通用智能体可微调至下游任务，包括训练中未见过的偏好。
Result: 在合成基函数分解、多智能体Craftax和连续自动驾驶模拟器上，GRID成功以语义有意义的方式解耦奖励结构，优于标准模仿学习基线，并实现更高效稳定的特化。
Conclusion: GRID提供了一种新的通用预训练范式，从异质演示中提取通用环境能力，为下游微调提供更好的先验。

papers.title: Shrinkage priors for Bayesian Substitute Confounders
papers.abstract_en: Multi-cause observational studies contain information about unmeasured confounding through the dependence structure among causes. However, literal imputation of the unobserved confounder is often more complex than learning a lower-dimensional substitute score that preserves the shared assignment variation needed for stable causal adjustment. The deconfounder (Wang and Blei, 2019) and related substitute confounder methods exploit this idea, but flexible assignment models can fit the joint distribution of the causes while producing scores that over-encode the treatment vector, collapse overlap, or capture single-cause variation. We develop a Bayesian factor assignment framework for learning sparse substitute confounders that retain coarse multi-cause dependence with shrinkage priors. The theory is stated at the level of posterior concentration, factor score contraction, and overlap-preserving assignment geometry and therefore does not rely on a particular shrinkage prior. Under these conditions, the proposed regression-adjusted estimators are consistent for mean potential outcomes when the corresponding latent variable identification assumptions hold. Shrinkage priors provide a natural tool for latent structural learning: they favour low-dimensional factors supported by multiple causes, discourage effectively single-cause factors, and induce an ordering of the latent factors through progressive shrinkage. Synthetic experiments illustrate the roles of signal strength, outcome validity, and geometry-aware regularization. In an Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) baseline analysis, sparse substitute scores recover much of the adjustment obtained by directly conditioning on invasive cerebrospinal-fluid biomarkers, while collapse diagnostics identify when fitted factors reduce to individual observed measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多原因观测研究中未测量混杂因素的替代分数学习问题，提出了贝叶斯因子分配框架，利用收缩先验学习稀疏的替代混杂因素。该框架能够保留多原因间的粗粒度依赖关系，避免过度编码处理变量或捕捉单原因变异。理论结果包括后验集中性、因子分数收缩和重叠保持的分配几何性质，并证明在潜在变量识别假设下，回归调整估计量对平均潜在结果具有一致性。合成实验验证了信号强度、结果有效性和几何正则化的作用，ADNI数据分析显示稀疏替代分数能恢复直接使用侵入性生物标志物进行因果调整的大部分效果。
Motivation: 现有的替代混杂因素方法（如deconfounder）在灵活分配模型下可能产生过度编码处理向量、破坏重叠或捕捉单原因变异的分数，导致不稳定。需要一种能学习稀疏、保留多原因依赖且保持重叠的替代分数的框架。
Method: 提出贝叶斯因子分配框架，使用收缩先验（如马蹄先验等）学习稀疏的替代混杂因素。先验倾向于支持由多个原因支撑的低维因子，抑制仅涉及单原因的因子，并通过渐进收缩对潜在因子排序。理论分析不依赖特定收缩先验，而是基于后验集中性、因子收缩和重叠保持的几何条件。
Result: 合成实验表明信号强度、结果有效性和几何正则化对学习质量有影响。在ADNI数据分析中，稀疏替代分数恢复了直接条件于侵入性脑脊液生物标志物所获得的大部分调整效果，同时塌陷诊断可识别拟合因子何时退化为单个观测变量。
Conclusion: 收缩先验为替代混杂因素学习提供了一种自然且理论保障的方法，能够产生稀疏、保留多原因依赖且重叠友好的分数，并在实际数据中有效。局限性包括依赖潜在变量识别假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI Sandboxes: A Threat Model, Taxonomy, and Measurement Framework
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are increasingly evaluated in bounded environments that combine isolation, simulation, instrumentation, supervision, and evidence capture. For physical AI, AIoT, and cyber-physical systems, this shift is not a matter of terminology: the system under test may sense, decide, actuate, communicate, and fail through physical processes, networked devices, and human operators. This article develops an assurance-oriented account of AI sandboxes as controlled environments for testing, evaluation, verification, and validation across digital AI, embodied autonomy, and cyber-physical deployments. We formalize the sandbox boundary and a weakest-link rule for composing per-dimension evidence into a bounded deployment claim; separate major sandbox archetypes; define a cyber-physical threat model that includes attacks on the assurance apparatus itself; and introduce a measurement framework spanning fidelity, controllability, observability, containment, reproducibility, and governance artifacts, instantiated on three worked case studies of real sandboxes. The resulting threat model, taxonomy, and measurement framework clarify what a sandbox can validly test, which risks it can contain, and what forms of evidence it can support for safety, security, and regulatory assurance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI系统在受限环境（沙箱）中的测试评估，提出了一种威胁模型、分类法和测量框架，涵盖数字AI、具身自主和网络物理系统。通过形式化沙箱边界和最弱链接规则，区分主要沙箱原型，并定义针对保证装置本身的威胁模型。测量框架包括保真度、可控性、可观测性、容器化、可重复性和治理工件，并通过三个实际沙箱案例研究进行实例化。
Motivation: 现有AI系统在受限环境中的评估缺乏系统化的保证方法，尤其是对于物理AI和网络物理系统，需要统一的框架来处理隔离、仿真、仪器化、监督和证据捕获。
Method: 提出面向保证的沙箱模型，形式化沙箱边界和最弱链接规则，定义沙箱原型分类，建立针对保证装置的网络物理威胁模型，并引入跨保真度、可控性等维度的测量框架。
Result: 通过三个实际沙箱案例研究验证了框架的实用性，明确了沙箱的有效测试范围、风险控制能力和证据支持类型。
Conclusion: 该威胁模型、分类法和测量框架帮助厘清沙箱在安全、安保和监管保证中的作用和局限。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: When Does Trajectory-Level Supervision Permit Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning is typically analyzed under process-level reward supervision, yet many sequential decision datasets record only trajectory-level outcomes. We develop a statistical theory for offline policy optimization from such outcome-level supervision. We first study the canonical setting where the target remains the expected cumulative reward, but each offline trajectory provides only a scalar label whose conditional mean is the cumulative return. We propose OPAC, a pessimistic actor-critic algorithm that learns a latent reward model and optimizes a policy from trajectory-level labels. We prove a high-probability guarantee of order $\widetilde O(H^2\sqrt{C_{sa}(π^\star)/n})$ and a matching lower bound, characterizing the sharp statistical cost of replacing process-level rewards with one trajectory-level label. We then extend the principle to preference-based feedback, preserving the leading horizon and concentrability dependence up to preference-model constants. Finally, we study generalized outcome-based offline RL, where both the supervision and the objective are trajectory-level quantities induced by a nonlinear aggregation of latent per-step rewards. This problem is not learnable in general: for all-success objectives, any offline learner may require $Ω(2^H)$ trajectories even with deterministic transitions and constant concentrability. We then identify a tractable regime through two structural coefficients, $κ_μ(σ)$ and $χ_μ(σ)$, capturing information loss in outcome aggregation and generalized Bellman updates, under which generalized OPAC achieves polynomial sample complexity. Together, our results delineate when outcome-level supervision enables sample-efficient offline control and when missing process-level rewards create fundamental statistical barriers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线强化学习中轨迹级监督的理论基础。提出OPAC算法处理仅知轨迹总回报的情况，并给出样本复杂度界限。扩展到偏好反馈和一般基于结果的目标。发现某些目标（如全部成功）可能指数级困难。
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习通常假设过程级奖励，但许多实际数据集只记录轨迹级结果（如总回报或偏好），缺失局部奖励信号。
Method: 提出悲观演员-评论家算法OPAC，学习隐式奖励模型并从轨迹级标签优化策略。理论分析包括上界和下界，并引入结构系数描述信息损失。
Result: 对于累计回报目标，证明样本复杂度为Õ(H²√(C_{sa}(π^*)/n))，与下界匹配。偏好反馈保持主要依赖项。对于非线性聚合的轨迹级目标，一般不可学习（需指数级样本），但在特定结构条件下多项式复杂度。
Conclusion: 论文刻画了使用轨迹级监督进行样本高效离线控制的可行边界，指出缺少过程级奖励时存在根本的统计障碍。

papers.title: Evaluating Prompting-Based Defenses Against Domain-Camouflaged Injection Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Domain-camouflaged injection attacks embed malicious instructions in retrieved content using domain-appropriate vocabulary, evading standard detectors that rely on syntactic injection markers. When detection fails, practitioners need to know which defense architectures reduce attack success. We evaluate five prompting-based defenses (spotlighting, paraphrasing, prompt sandwiching, and two combinations) against domain-camouflaged injection across three model families (Claude Haiku, Llama 3.1 8B, Gemini 2.0 Flash) and three deployment domains (financial, legal, general) using 3,510 trials. Paraphrasing retrieved content before agent processing is the most consistently effective defense in this benchmark, reducing camouflage attack success rate by 55-84\% depending on model, and achieves lower attack success rates than our Llama Guard 4 configuration on every model tested. Defense effectiveness is strongly model-dependent: spotlighting halves attack success on Claude Haiku but provides no benefit on Llama 3.1 8B. Financial domain deployments face the highest residual risk at 26-33\% baseline attack success rate, with no prompting-based defense fully eliminating the threat on weaker models. These results provide the first systematic evaluation of prompting-based defenses specifically against camouflage-class injection attacks and establish benchmark-based recommendations for practitioners. All tasks use synthetically constructed professional documents; whether these benchmark rankings generalize to real enterprise documents remains an open question.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables; under review at the AdvML-Frontiers x CoTMA workshop, COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了五种基于提示的防御方法（spotlighting、paraphrasing、prompt sandwiching及两种组合）对抗域伪装注入攻击的效果，在三个模型家族（Claude Haiku、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemini 2.0 Flash）和三个部署领域（金融、法律、通用）上进行了3510次试验。实验表明，paraphrasing是最稳定有效的防御，能将伪装攻击成功率降低55-84%，且防御效果高度依赖模型；金融领域基线攻击成功率最高（26-33%），且没有防御方法能在较弱模型上完全消除威胁。所有结果基于合成文档，泛化到真实企业文档仍需验证。
Motivation: 域伪装注入攻击通过使用领域相关词汇将恶意指令嵌入检索内容中，能规避依赖句法注入标记的标准检测器。当检测失败时，从业者需要知道哪些防御架构能降低攻击成功率，但此前缺乏针对此类攻击的基于提示防御的系统评估。
Method: 评估五种基于提示的防御：spotlighting（高亮检索内容）、paraphrasing（改写检索内容）、prompt sandwiching（将检索内容夹在提示之间），以及两种组合。在三个模型（Claude Haiku、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemini 2.0 Flash）和三个领域（金融、法律、通用）上，使用3510次试验进行基准测试。
Result: Paraphrasing是最一致有效的防御，将伪装攻击成功率降低55-84%（取决于模型）；在所有测试模型上，其攻击成功率低于Llama Guard 4配置。Spotlighting在Claude Haiku上将攻击成功率减半，但对Llama 3.1 8B无效果。金融领域基线攻击成功率最高（26-33%），且没有基于提示的防御能在较弱模型上完全消除威胁。
Conclusion: 本研究首次系统评估了针对伪装类注入攻击的基于提示防御，为从业者提供了基于基准的建议。但所有试验使用合成构建的专业文档，这些基准排名是否泛化到真实企业文档仍是一个开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Prototypical Signature Approach for Writer-Independent Offline Signature Verification
papers.abstract_en: Offline handwritten signature verification aims to distinguish genuine from forged signatures using static images. Since real forgeries are rarely available, negative samples are usually randomly drawn from genuine signatures of other users to create training data. However, this random selection often lacks diversity, increases redundancy, and escalates computational cost, leading to inefficient training. We propose a data-driven strategy to generate diverse, informative negative samples using prototypical signatures, which are compact, non-identifiable summaries of genuine signature features. Based on the experiments results, we conclude that (i) prototypical signatures yield more informative negative samples, improving the detection of skilled forgeries; (ii) the proposed approach is backbone-agnostic, showing robustness across architectures; and (iii) when combined with a primal-form linear SVM, it serves as an alternative to RBF-based models while significantly improving scalability and computational efficiency. Implementation of the method is available at https://github.com/kdmoura/proto_hsv.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于原型签名（prototypical signatures）的数据驱动策略，用于离线手写签名验证中生成多样且信息丰富的负样本，以提升对熟练伪造签名的检测能力。实验表明该方法与多种骨干网络兼容，且与线性SVM结合时可作为RBF模型的替代，显著提高可扩展性和计算效率。
Motivation: 现有方法随机抽取其他用户的真实签名作为负样本，导致多样性不足、冗余高且计算开销大，影响训练效率。
Method: 提出利用原型签名（紧凑且不可识别的真实签名特征摘要）生成多样且信息丰富的负样本，并采用主形式线性SVM进行分类。
Result: 实验表明原型签名能产生更信息化的负样本，提升熟练伪造检测；方法对骨干网络不敏感；与线性SVM结合时，相比RBF模型显著改善可扩展性和计算效率。
Conclusion: 原型签名方法是骨干无关的，可有效提升离线签名验证性能，并作为RBF模型的可扩展替代方案。

papers.title: Toward Simultaneously Optimal Regret in U-Calibration
papers.abstract_en: U-calibration studies online forecasting algorithms whose predictions can be consumed by any unknown downstream agent, guaranteeing sublinear regret simultaneously for all proper loss functions. Existing U-calibration algorithms achieve worst-case optimal $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret for every bounded proper loss, but they fail to adapt to easier losses: as we show, even for smooth losses such as squared loss, they incur $Ω(\sqrt{T})$ regret instead of the optimal $O(\log T)$ regret. In this work, we show that this limitation is not inherent. Specifically, we design a single forecast algorithm that simultaneously achieves $\tilde O(\sqrt{T})$ regret for every bounded proper loss and $O(\log T)$ regret for every bounded smooth proper loss. More generally, our algorithm also attains logarithmic regret for losses that are smooth relative to the log-barrier, which include several non-Lipschitz examples. Our approach is based on a novel variant of Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) in which perturbations are applied directly in the prediction space using self-concordant noise. The resulting analysis also departs substantially from prior FTPL analyses due to the complex nature of this noise and may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对U-校准问题，提出一种基于跟随扰动领导者（FTPL）变体的在线预测算法，同时实现所有有界适当损失函数的O~(√T)遗憾和所有有界光滑适当损失函数的O(log T)遗憾。该方法通过在预测空间中使用自洽噪声进行扰动，分析技术可能具有独立价值。
Motivation: 现有U-校准算法在最坏情况下对所有有界适当损失函数达到最优O(√T)遗憾，但无法利用损失函数的平滑性（如平方损失）获得O(log T)的最优遗憾。作者证明这一局限性并非固有。
Method: 提出一种新型跟随扰动领导者（FTPL）变体，其中扰动直接应用于预测空间，使用自洽噪声（self-concordant noise）。分析因噪声的复杂性而与传统FTPL分析有显著不同。
Result: 单算法同时实现：对所有有界适当损失函数的O~(√T)遗憾，以及对所有有界光滑适当损失函数的O(log T)遗憾。更一般地，对相对于对数障碍（log-barrier）光滑的损失也达到对数遗憾，包括若干非Lipschitz例子。
Conclusion: 证明了U-校准中同时最优遗憾的可能性，提出的算法优于现有方法，且分析技术可能具有独立价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Attention via Domain Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We propose a hierarchical attention mechanism based on two-level overlapping Schwarz domain decomposition. The method is motivated by the observation that two-level Schwarz domain decomposition methods combine local subdomain corrections with a coarse level that communicates global, long-range information. We test its usefulness in the context of finite-dimensional operator learning using a simple, one-dimensional diffusion problem with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. Although elementary, this problem provides a controlled sequence-to-sequence setting in which the exact nonlocal solution operator is known. After discretization, learning the solution operator amounts to approximating the inverse of a symmetric positive definite matrix. As a baseline, we use a global softmax-free low-rank attention operator of the form $QK^T$. The proposed construction replaces this dense global factorization by a two-level additive structure: local low-rank attention blocks on overlapping subdomains are combined with a coarse attention block. The resulting operator has the form $$M_θ^{-1} = ΦQ_0 K_0^T Φ^T + \sum_{i=1}^{N} R_i^T D_i^{1/2} Q_i K_i^T D_i^{1/2} R_i.$$ Here $R_i$ restricts to an overlapping subdomain, $D_i$ is a partition-of-unity weight, and $Φ$ is a coarse interpolation (or prolongation) matrix. Numerical experiments for synthetic Fourier right-hand sides indicate that the domain-decomposition attention operator is able to train faster and can give more accurate approximations than a global low-rank attention baseline while using significantly fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于两层重叠 Schwarz 区域分解的分层注意力机制，用于有限维算子学习。方法将全局低秩注意力分解为局部子域注意力块和粗层注意力块的加性结构，并在简单一维扩散问题上验证其有效性。实验表明该方法比全局低秩注意力基线训练更快、精度更高，且参数更少。
Motivation: 传统全局低秩注意力计算成本高且无法有效捕捉局部和全局信息；受两水平 Schwarz 区域分解方法启发，希望结合局部子域修正与粗层全局信息传递，提高算子学习的效率与精度。
Method: 提出分层注意力算子：整体结构为局部重叠子域上的低秩注意力块（带单位分解权重）与粗层注意力块的加性组合，替代全局稠密低秩分解；子域由限制算子 R_i 定义，粗层由插值矩阵 Φ 实现全局通信。
Result: 在合成傅里叶右端项的一维扩散问题数值实验中，区域分解注意力算子相比全局低秩注意力基线训练更快、近似更精确，且所需参数显著更少。
Conclusion: 基于区域分解的分层注意力在简单但可控的序列到序列问题上展现出优于全局低秩注意力的潜力，可为进一步将此类结构应用于更复杂偏微分方程问题提供基础。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: On the Residual Scaling of Looped Transformers: Stability and Transferability
papers.abstract_en: Looped (weight-tied) Transformers apply a shared residual block $N$ times ($h \leftarrow h + \varepsilon\,f(h)$, same $f$ at each step), increasing effective depth without adding parameters. Prior depth-scaling analyses prescribe $\varepsilon = 1/\!\sqrt{L}$ for depth-$L$ residual networks. We show that this is insufficient for looped architectures: weight sharing makes residual updates correlated across iterations, requiring the stronger scaling $\varepsilon = 1/N$. For multi-layer blocks ($L$ unique layers looped $N$ times), we derive a factored parameterization $\varepsilon = λ/(N\!\sqrt{L})$ that separates the two sources of growth: $1/N$ controls the within-layer loop correlation, and $1/\!\sqrt{L}$ controls the across-layer variance. A key consequence is that the optimal learning rate depends only on the number of unique layers $L$, not on the loop count $N$, enabling direct hyperparameter transfer from small to large $N$ without retuning. Experiments on looped Transformers confirm that $1/N$ scaling improves trainability and yields better loss than $1/\!\sqrt{N}$ scaling across loop counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环变压器（looped Transformers）的残差缩放问题。权重共享使得残差更新在迭代间相关，因此需要更强的缩放因子ε=1/N（而非传统残差网络的1/√L）。对于多层循环块，提出了分解参数化ε=λ/(N√L)，其中1/N控制层内循环相关性，1/√L控制层间方差。实验表明1/N缩放相比1/√N缩放能提升可训练性并取得更优损失。
Motivation: 现有残差网络的深度缩放分析（ε=1/√L）不适用于循环架构，因为权重共享导致迭代间残差更新存在相关性，需要重新推导缩放规律。
Method: 推导了循环变压器的残差缩放条件：对于单层循环块，ε=1/N；对于多层循环块（L个独特层循环N次），使用分解参数化ε=λ/(N√L)，分离循环相关性和层间方差的影响。
Result: 实验表明，1/N缩放优于1/√N缩放，且最优学习率仅依赖于独特层数L，与循环次数N无关，支持超参数从小N到大N的直接迁移。
Conclusion: 正确的残差缩放是循环变压器稳定训练的关键，所提出的分解参数化能有效改善可训练性，并允许超参数跨循环次数迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DART: A design-aware microfluidic chip paradigm for real-time live-cell image analysis
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput microfluidic live-cell imaging generates rich single-cell data. Yet semi-automated procedures for locating regions of interest (RoIs), each containing one cell population, and removing surrounding microfluidic structures from recorded images, scale with the number of RoIs. This prevents real-time image analysis and delays time-to-insight by hours to days. We introduce the Design-Aware and Real-Time capable (DART) paradigm for microfluidic cultivation chips, which aligns the CAD blueprint with the physical chip and thereby enables throughput-independent localization of all RoIs and fully automated image processing across diverse RoI geometries and chip layouts. DART establishes this alignment through embedded fiducial markers and deep-learning-based marker detection. We validate DART using the Swiss Army Knife chip, which combines eight structurally distinct RoI designs across 1164 RoI locations. DART localizes all RoIs in five minutes, removes microfluidic structures from raw microscopy images in 40 ms, and performs fully automated image analysis, including cell segmentation, in under 1.1 s per image. Together, these capabilities establish DART as an end-to-end hardware-software paradigm with real-time-capable analysis that paves the way toward closed-loop and outcome-driven smart microscopy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DART 范式，通过将 CAD 蓝图与物理微流控芯片对齐，实现高通量活细胞成像中感兴趣区域 (RoI) 的高效定位和自动化图像处理。实验在 Swiss Army Knife 芯片上验证，可 5 分钟内定位所有 RoI，40 ms 去除微流控结构，每张图像分析时间小于 1.1 秒。
Motivation: 现有半自动 RoI 定位和微流控结构去除方法耗时且随 RoI 数量线性增长，阻碍实时图像分析，导致数据获取到见解的时间延迟数小时至数天。
Method: 提出 Design-Aware and Real-Time capable (DART) 范式，通过嵌入 fiducial markers 和基于深度学习的 marker 检测，建立 CAD 蓝图与物理芯片的对齐，实现与通量无关的 RoI 定位和全自动图像处理。
Result: 在 Swiss Army Knife 芯片上，DART 5 分钟内定位全部 1164 个 RoI，40 ms 去除微流控结构，每张图像完成细胞分割等全自动分析耗时低于 1.1 秒。
Conclusion: DART 作为端到端硬件-软件范式，具备实时分析能力，为闭环、结果驱动的智能显微技术奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sparsity Curse: Understanding RLVR Model Parameter Space from Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm that surpasses Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) in eliciting reasoning intelligence and resisting catastrophic forgetting. Recent studies further reveal that RLVR induces highly sparse and off-principal parameter updates compared to SFT. This naturally raises the question: does such sparsity make RLVR models more amenable to model merging? If so, model merging would offer a scalable, training-free path to aggregate diverse reasoning capabilities from independently trained RLVR models. Surprisingly, we find the opposite, uncovering a sparsity curse: the sparse RLVR updates are spread farther apart in parameter space, forming near-orthogonal shortcuts that make aggregation inherently fragile. This is likely rooted in the stochasticity of RL optimization and the diversity of emergent reasoning patterns. Unlike SFT models that converge to shared, flat basins and merge naturally, RLVR models suffer severe degradation under standard merging methods. Through systematic empirical analysis of the update geometry, we characterize the mechanisms behind this failure and propose Sensitivity-aware Resolving Merging (SAR-Merging), a merging recipe tailored for the unique structure of RLVR parameter spaces. SAR-Merging resolves conflicts in overlapping update regions via Fisher Information-based sensitivity arbitration, followed by magnitude-aware sparsification and rescaling to preserve fragile reasoning pathways. Experiments on mathematical and coding benchmarks demonstrate that SAR-Merging substantially outperforms existing merging methods on RLVR models, enabling both single-task enhancement and multi-capability fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）模型的参数稀疏性对模型合并的影响，发现RLVR的稀疏更新在参数空间中分布更分散，形成近乎正交的捷径，导致标准合并方法失效。作者提出SAR-Merging方法，通过Fisher信息敏感性仲裁、幅度感知稀疏化和重新缩放来解决冲突，在数学和代码基准上显著优于现有合并方法。
Motivation: RLVR后训练产生的参数更新具有高稀疏性和非主成分特性，但现有研究未系统探究这种稀疏性是否有利于模型合并。本文旨在理解RLVR模型在合并中的表现，并解决其聚合脆弱性问题。
Method: 提出SAR-Merging（敏感性感知解析合并），首先通过Fisher信息感知的敏感性仲裁解决重叠更新区域的冲突，然后进行幅度感知的稀疏化和重新缩放，以保留脆弱的推理路径。
Result: 在数学和代码基准实验上，SAR-Merging在RLVR模型上显著优于现有合并方法，支持单任务增强和多能力融合。
Conclusion: RLVR模型的稀疏更新在参数空间中分散较远，导致标准合并失效；SAR-Merging针对这一结构特性设计，有效提升了合并性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compact Geometric Representations of Hierarchies
papers.abstract_en: Computing geometric representations of data is a cornerstone of modern machine learning, typically achieved by training dual encoders which map queries and documents into a shared embedding space. Recent work of You et al. [NeurIPS '25] has extended this approach to hierarchical retrieval, where relevance is determined by the ancestor-descendant relationships in a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). While previous work has shown that valid embeddings exist when the number of descendants is small, these bounds degrade significantly for deep hierarchies, requiring dimensions as large as the total number of nodes. In this paper, we investigate compact reachability embeddings for more general graph classes and provide theoretical guarantees for representing hierarchies using embeddings whose dimension depends on structural graph parameters. We prove that for any directed tree, there exists a reachability embedding in constant dimension 3, independent of the tree's size or depth. We generalize this result to graphs characterized by treewidth $t$, constructing embeddings of dimension $O(t \log n)$, where $n$ is the number of nodes. Complementing these upper bounds, we provide matching or near-matching lower bounds, showing that dimension $Ω(n)$ is necessary for general DAGs and $Ω(t/\log(n/t))$ is required for graphs of treewidth $t$. We also obtain upper and lower bounds parameterized by the number of cross-edges in the DAG. We additionally show that our embeddings can be constructed on real world datasets, and that they give much smaller dimensions in high recall regimes compared to prior embeddings with theoretical guarantees.
papers.comment: Published at the 39th Annual Conference on Learning Theory (COLT) 2026. 22 Pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层次结构（如有向无环图DAG）的几何表示，提出紧凑的可达嵌入（reachability embedding）方法。对于有向树，证明存在常数维度3的嵌入；对于树宽为t的图，给出维度O(t log n)的嵌入。同时提供匹配或近匹配的下界，并在真实数据集上验证了嵌入的紧凑性。
Motivation: 现有层次检索的嵌入方法在深层结构中需要与节点数相当的维度，导致存储和计算开销大，亟需更紧凑的表示。
Method: 通过分析图的结构参数（如树宽、交叉边数量），构造可达嵌入的显式上下界；对一般DAG和树宽有界图分别给出嵌入维度的理论保证。
Result: 有向树可嵌入常数维3；树宽t的图嵌入维度为O(t log n)；证明一般DAG需要Ω(n)维，树宽t图需要Ω(t/log(n/t))维。
Conclusion: 嵌入维度由图的树宽等结构参数决定，可实现远小于节点数的维度，并在真实数据集的高召回率场景下明显优于已有理论保证的嵌入。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: As You Wish: Mission Planning with Formal Verification using LLMs in Precision Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Though robotic systems are now being commercialized and deployed in various industries, many of these systems are highly specialized and often require an advanced skill set to operate and ensure they perform as instructed. To mitigate this problem, we recently introduced a mission planner leveraging LLMs to synthesize mission plans in precision agriculture based on mission descriptions provided in natural language. While the system demonstrates impressive performance, it also suffers from the inherent ambiguities of natural language. In this paper, we extend our system to address this issue by introducing multiple feedback loops in the planning architecture that leverage linear temporal logic (LTL) to ensure the mission planning system meets the specifications formulated by the user while still using natural language. To mitigate potential bias, this is achieved by using two different commercial LLMs in charge of the specification and verification subtasks. Through extensive experiments, we highlight the strengths and limitations of integrating mission verification into a fully autonomous pipeline, particularly regarding an LLM's ability to generate valuable LTL formulas, and show how our proposed implementation addresses and solves these challenges.
papers.journal_ref: Published in Proceedings of 2026 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了先前基于LLM的精确农业使命规划器，通过引入多个基于线性时序逻辑（LTL）的反馈循环，确保规划满足用户规范，并使用两个不同的商业LLM分别处理规范生成与验证任务，以减轻偏见。实验表明该方法能有效解决自然语言歧义问题，但LLM生成有用LTL公式的能力仍是挑战。
Motivation: 自然语言描述的歧义性导致LLM生成的使命规划可能不符合用户意图，需要引入形式化验证来保证规划的正确性。
Method: 在规划架构中引入多个基于LTL的反馈循环，使用两个商业LLM分别负责规范生成和验证子任务，以减轻潜在偏见。
Result: 通过大量实验展示了集成使命验证的全自动流水线的优势与局限，特别是LLM生成有价值LTL公式的能力，并证明所提出的实现能解决这些挑战。
Conclusion: 本文的反馈循环架构能有效利用LTL验证提升使命规划的正确性，但LLM在LTL公式生成方面仍有改进空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PSyGenTAB: A Privacy-Preserving Framework for Synthetic Clinical Tabular Data Generation via Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The development of medical AI is constrained by limited access to high-quality clinical data due to institutional silos and strict privacy regulations such as HIPAA and GDPR. Synthetic data generation offers a potential solution, but existing methods lack principled mechanisms to explicitly manage the privacy-utility trade-off, often degrading clinically meaningful patterns or risking patient re-identification. We present PSyGenTAB, a privacy-preserving generative framework that formulates synthetic healthcare data generation as a constrained optimization problem solved using the Augmented Lagrangian Method. By embedding configurable privacy constraints directly into model training, PSyGenTAB enforces minimum privacy thresholds while maximizing clinical data utility. Across multiple clinically motivated benchmarks, PSyGenTAB preserves inter-feature clinical relationships and minority-class diagnostic patterns essential for reliable health AI. Downstream evaluation using Train-on-Synthetic, Test-on-Real and Train-on-Real, Test-on-Synthetic protocols shows that models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real patient records. Privacy auditing further demonstrates reduced exact record reproduction and strong resilience to membership inference attacks. These results establish PSyGenTAB as a principled framework for balancing privacy protection and clinical utility in synthetic healthcare data, supporting secure cross-institutional AI development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSyGenTAB 是一个针对合成临床表格数据的隐私保护生成框架，它将数据生成建模为带约束优化问题，并使用增广拉格朗日方法求解。通过在训练中嵌入可配置的隐私阈值，该方法在保证最小隐私要求的同时最大化临床数据效用。实验表明，基于合成数据训练的模型在临床任务上能达到与真实数据训练相近的性能，且对成员推断攻击具有强韧性。
Motivation: 医疗AI发展受限于高质量临床数据获取困难，原因包括机构数据孤岛和HIPAA/GDPR等严格隐私法规。现有合成数据生成方法缺乏显式管理隐私-效用权衡的机制，常导致临床模式退化或患者重识别风险。
Method: 提出PSyGenTAB框架，将合成医疗数据生成形式化为带约束优化问题，采用增广拉格朗日法求解。通过将可配置的隐私约束直接嵌入模型训练，强制满足最低隐私阈值的同时最大化临床数据效用。
Result: 在多个临床基准上，PSyGenTAB保留了特征间临床关系和少数类诊断模式。使用Train-on-Synthetic/Test-on-Real等协议评估，合成数据训练模型性能与真实数据训练模型相当。隐私审计显示精确记录复制减少，对成员推断攻击具有强韧性。
Conclusion: PSyGenTAB为合成医疗数据中的隐私保护与临床效用平衡提供了原则性框架，支持安全的跨机构AI开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exponentially many initializations to avoid barren plateaus
papers.abstract_en: Barren plateaus are stated as an average-case phenomenon: pick an ansatz, initialize it naively, and concentration follows. This has led to the common view that a potential cure for barren plateaus is simply to initialize the parameters more carefully. Here we show that the situation is subtler. We introduce a first-moment framework that gives a simple operator-level diagnostic for when an initialization may escape the fully concentrated barren-plateau fixed point, and for comparing the biases induced by different initialization strategies. Our framework recovers several known initialization schemes such as identity and Gaussian initialization, but also shows that barren-plateau avoidance is highly non-unique. Indeed, many shifted, biased, and non-symmetric parameter distributions can avoid concentration, and these choices need not be equivalent. In fact, our results show that one can generate exponentially many families of inequivalent initialization strategies. Then, our numerics indicate that different first-moment-distinct initializations can lead to different attained minima, suggesting that avoiding barren plateaus via smart initializations can trade the exponential concentration problem for the challenge of selecting the right trainable pocket amongst many options.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一阶矩框架，分析量子变分算法中初始化策略对避免贫瘠高原的影响。研究表明，存在指数多类不等价的初始化方案，不同方案会导致不同的局部极小值，从而将指数浓度问题转化为选择合适可训练区域的问题。
Motivation: 传统观点认为精心初始化可避免贫瘠高原，但论文发现情况更微妙，需要系统诊断初始化是否真正摆脱指数浓度。
Method: 引入一阶矩框架，给出算子级诊断条件，分析不同初始化策略（如恒等初始化、高斯初始化及多种偏移/非对称分布）的偏置效果。
Result: 存在指数多个不等价的初始化族，不同一阶矩的初始化导致不同极小值，表明避免贫瘠高原可能将指数浓度问题转化为多区域选择问题。
Conclusion: 初始化避免贫瘠高原的方案并不唯一，且不等价策略之间存在性能差异，需谨慎选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: N(CO)$^2$: Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Chance Constraints to Solve Stochastic Orienteering
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) offers a promising alternative to traditional heuristic-based methods for solving complex graph optimization problems by proposing to learn heuristics through data. This class of problems frequently arises in automation, as it can be used to model a variety of applications. While NCO has been extensively studied for deterministic combinatorial optimization problems, there are only a few works that aim to solve stochastic combinatorial optimization problems. In this work, we present N(CO)$^2$: Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Chance cOnstraints to solve the Stochastic Orienteering Problem (SOP) without the use of hand-crafted heuristics. By integrating a reinforcement learning (RL) framework, the model optimizes path selection under uncertainty, effectively balancing exploration and exploitation. Empirical results demonstrate that our method generalizes well across diverse SOP instances, achieving competitive performance compared to the state-of-the-art mixed-integer linear program (MILP) for the task. The proposed approach reduces human effort in heuristic design while enabling adaptive and efficient decision-making in uncertain environments.

papers.title: Architectural Bias in Face Presentation Attack Detection: A Comparative Study of Vision Transformers and Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Face Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) systems constitute a critical security layer in biometric authentication; however, existing approaches exhibit systematic performance disparities across demographic groups, disproportionately affecting individuals with darker skin tones. This paper presents a comparative empirical investigation of whether Vision Transformer architectures reduce demographic bias in face PAD systems relative to convolutional baselines. Experiments are conducted on the CASIA-SURF Cross-Ethnicity Face Anti-Spoofing (CeFA) dataset. Three architectures are evaluated: a Multimodal ViT-Tiny trained from scratch, a ResNet18 CNN baseline, and a pretrained DeiT-S fine-tuned on CeFA across African, East Asian, and zero-shot Central Asian demographic groups. DeiT-S achieves the highest overall accuracy of 97.27% and the lowest EER of 0.86%, outperforming ResNet18 at 90.15% accuracy. In terms of fairness, DeiT-S reduces the inter-ethnic ACER gap between African and East Asian subjects to 0.13%, compared to 0.75% reported in an LBP-based work [6], representing an 83% reduction. Most notably, while ResNet18 records a BPCER of 10.44% on zero-shot Central Asian subjects, DeiT-S maintains 2.89% on the same unseen group, demonstrating a 3.6x generalization advantage. These results suggest that pretrained Vision Transformers achieve superior PAD accuracy, produce smaller demographic performance gaps, and generalize more equitably across unseen demographic groups, indicating that cross-demographic fairness in PAD may partly be influenced by architectural design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了视觉Transformer（ViT）和卷积神经网络（CNN）在人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）中的表现，并重点考察人口统计偏差。在CASIA-SURF跨种族人脸防欺骗数据集上的实验表明，预训练的DeiT-S在准确率（97.27%）、等错误率（0.86%）和公平性（跨种族ACER差距0.13%）上均优于ResNet18（90.15%准确率），且对未见过的中亚人群泛化能力更强（BPCER下降3.6倍）。
Motivation: 现有面部PAD系统在不同人口统计群体间存在系统性性能差异，尤其对深肤色人群影响更大。本文旨在探究视觉Transformer架构是否能减少这种人口统计偏差。
Method: 在CASIA-SURF CeFA数据集上对比三种架构：从头训练的Multimodal ViT-Tiny、ResNet18 CNN基线、以及在CeFA上微调的预训练DeiT-S。评估了非洲、东亚和零样本中亚三个群体。
Result: DeiT-S取得最高准确率97.27%和最低EER 0.86%；跨种族ACER差距从LBP方法的0.75%降至0.13%（降幅83%）；对零样本中亚群体，ResNet18的BPCER为10.44%，DeiT-S仅为2.89%（泛化优势3.6倍）。
Conclusion: 预训练视觉Transformer在PAD中不仅精度更高，还能减少人口统计偏差并更公平地泛化到未见群体，表明架构设计影响跨人口统计公平性。

papers.title: Concept Modulation Models: A Unified Framework for Identifiability and Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable generalization in conditional latent variable models requires understanding both identifiability and extrapolation: how observed variation across attributes determines latent structure, and how that structure determines distributions at unseen attributes. However, existing identifiability and extrapolation guarantees are largely model-specific, with separate analyses in nonlinear ICA, causal representation learning, perturbation modeling, and related conditional latent variable models. We introduce concept modulation models (CMMs), an attribute-indexed class of conditional generative models with structure $A\to Λ\to C\to X$, where attributes select modulators, modulators induce latent concept laws, and concepts generate observed features. CMMs lift transition-based identifiability to conditional settings by showing that feature agreement on observed attributes induces a latent concept transition constrained by the CMM class. We express these constraints through attribute potentials, log-density ratios between attribute-conditioned concept laws, separating the generic lifting step from model-specific rigidity arguments. The same potentials control extrapolation: agreement at unseen attributes holds exactly when the transported attribute-potential identities extend to those attributes. This yields algebraic extrapolation criteria, identifies the common potential-based proof objects behind several existing identifiability and extrapolation results, and, when combined with the model-specific rigidity arguments in those works, recovers their stated conclusions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出概念调制模型（CMM），一种属性索引的条件生成模型类，结构为A→Λ→C→X，其中属性选择调制器，调制器诱导潜在概念定律，概念生成观测特征。CMM将基于转移的可识别性提升到条件设置，并利用属性势（attribute potentials）统一表达可识别性和外推条件，恢复多个现有结果。
Motivation: 现有条件潜变量模型的可识别性和外推保证大多是模型特定的，缺乏统一框架。本文旨在提供一个统一的框架，以理解不同模型间的共性。
Method: 引入概念调制模型（CMM），通过属性势（log密度比）分离了通用的提升步骤和模型特定的刚性论证，并推导了代数外推准则。
Result: 摘要声称该方法恢复了多个现有可识别性和外推结果的结论，并提供了统一的势基础证明对象。
Conclusion: CMM框架统一了条件潜变量模型的可识别性和外推分析，但需要结合具体的模型特定刚性论证来恢复已有结论。

papers.title: Beyond AHI: An Interpretable Causal-Discovery-Guided Framework for Sleep Recovery in Connected Health
papers.abstract_en: Objective sleep assessment relies on polysomnography (PSG), yet clinical impact is often better reflected in patient-reported outcomes (PROs) such as sleepiness and fatigue. Existing summary indices, including the Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI), provide limited insight into the multidomain physiology underlying functional recovery. We propose an interpretable, causal-discovery--guided framework for deriving a hierarchical Sleep Recovery Score (SRS) from multimodal PSG. Using two large population cohorts (MESA: n=1540; MrOS: n=825), we apply directed acyclic graph (DAG) learning to identify candidate physiological drivers spanning respiratory burden, hypoxic burden, sleep fragmentation, sleep architecture, and autonomic regulation. Although derived from clinical PSG, these domains map naturally to sensing streams increasingly available in connected health technologies, including wearable ECG, oximetry, and sleep-stage estimation devices. To preserve mechanistic plausibility, we introduce a two-stage screening process that combines physiology-based constraints with constrained LLM-assisted auditing to identify and remove structural confounders and construct-overlapping variables. Across cohorts, these five domains emerge as recurrent physiological domains associated with recovery, and the resulting SRS shows up to 2.5$\times$ stronger alignment with perceived recovery than AHI. By linking multimodal sleep physiology to patient-centered outcomes through an interpretable, bias-aware, and domain structured framework, this work provides a practical foundation for recovery modeling across both clinical sleep studies and emerging smart and connected health settings.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Sensing and Computing for Smart and Connected Health (SCH), co-located with IEEE/ACM CHASE 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的因果发现引导框架，从多导睡眠图（PSG）中推导层次化睡眠恢复评分（SRS）。在MESA和MrOS两个大规模人群队列中，通过有向无环图（DAG）学习识别呼吸负担、缺氧负担、睡眠碎片化、睡眠结构和自主神经调节五个生理领域，并与患者报告结局（PROs）对齐。SRS与感知恢复的关联强度是传统AHI指标的2.5倍。
Motivation: 现有客观睡眠评估指标（如AHI）无法充分反映患者主观恢复感，且缺乏对多领域生理机制的洞察。
Method: 采用因果发现（DAG学习）从多模态PSG中提取关键生理领域；引入两阶段筛选（生理约束+LLM辅助审计）去除结构混杂和重叠变量，构建层次化SRS。
Result: 在MESA和MrOS队列中，SRS与感知恢复的对齐强度比AHI提升至2.5倍，五个生理领域在各队列中稳定出现。
Conclusion: 该框架为连接临床睡眠研究与智能健康设备的恢复建模提供了可解释、偏倚可控且领域结构化的基础。

papers.title: Quantum Annealing Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Accurate Remaining Useful Lifetime Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Remaining useful life (RUL) estimation is central to predictive maintenance, where an unplanned failure can cost far more than the asset itself. Statistical degradation models miss the strong nonlinearity of real systems, and data-driven models often converge to suboptimal solutions in high-dimensional, non-convex search spaces. We propose a Quantum Annealing enhanced Q-Learning (QAQL) framework that couples the sampling behaviour of quantum annealing with the sequential decision making of Q-learning. Each Q-value update is encoded as a small quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) whose ground state is the greedy action; rather than acting as a deterministic optimizer, the annealer returns a distribution over near-optimal actions across many reads, and this stochastic action selection supplies the exploration that curbs premature convergence on nonlinear degradation trajectories. The QUBO is solved on the D-Wave Advantage system using minor embedding, with the annealer woven into the reinforcement-learning loop rather than bolted on after training. We validate QAQL on two public benchmarks: the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan engine datasets and a device-fleet predictive maintenance dataset. Averaged over many independent runs and across six error metrics, QAQL outperforms the classical and quantum baselines considered in this study, with statistically significant improvements. The results indicate that quantum annealing is a usable, not merely theoretical, optimizer inside a reinforcement-learning loop for industrial predictive-maintenance applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 量子退火增强Q学习（QAQL）框架将量子退火的采样行为与Q学习的序列决策相结合，用于剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测。每个Q值更新被编码为小规模二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，其基态对应贪心动作；退火器返回近优动作的分布，提供探索以防止在非线性退化轨迹上过早收敛。在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机数据集和设备车队预测性维护数据集上，QAQL在六种误差指标上均优于经典和量子基线，统计显著改善。
Motivation: 统计退化模型难以捕捉真实系统的强非线性，数据驱动模型在高维非凸搜索空间中易收敛到次优解，亟需能有效探索并优化非线性退化轨迹的RUL预测方法。
Method: 提出QAQL框架，将量子退火嵌入强化学习循环：每个Q值更新对应一个QUBO问题，由D-Wave Advantage系统通过小规模嵌入求解；退火器多次读取返回动作概率分布，实现随机动作选择以增强探索。
Result: 在NASA C-MAPSS和设备舰队两个公开基准上，QAQL在多次独立运行的平均表现上，六种误差指标均优于经典和量子基线，且具有统计显著性。
Conclusion: 量子退火可作为工业预测性维护中强化学习循环的实用优化器，而不仅是理论工具。

papers.title: Neural Phase Correlation
papers.abstract_en: Correspondence is fundamentally relational: it seeks the unknown transformation between two observations of a common scene, not the content of either. Yet the dominant learning-based methods do not represent the transformation as a first-class object in the architecture. They encode each image independently and let a learned similarity function or a deep decoder discover the mapping implicitly. Phase correlation is the canonical exception, measuring the inter-image relationship directly in the Fourier domain, but the rigidity of its fixed basis confines it to global translation. We introduce a learned generalization of phase correlation that lifts this restriction by learning the basis on which the transformation decomposes. The same algebraic primitive extends to dense non-rigid deformations and to unitary dynamics. On the ACDC cardiac-MRI benchmark the framework matches or exceeds prior published baselines on both registration directions. On CAMUS echocardiography it matches state-of-the-art without auxiliary scoring or adaptive-smoothness mechanisms. Applied to time-evolved wavefunction pairs of the 1-D quantum harmonic oscillator, the same framework recovers the Hermite-function eigenstates and the quantized energy levels of the unknown Hamiltonian from observation pairs alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习型相位相关（Neural Phase Correlation）方法，将经典相位相关的傅里叶域互相关操作泛化到可学习基上，从而支持非刚性变形和酉动力学。在ACDC心脏MRI基准上匹配或超过先前基线，在CAMUS超声心动图上无需辅助评分或自适应平滑即达到最先进水平，并在1D量子谐振子波函数对中从观测对恢复出本征态和能级。
Motivation: 经典相位相关仅限于全局平移，而主流学习方法将变换隐式编码在特征相似性中，未将变换作为一等对象。本文旨在保留相位相关直接度量变换的代数结构，同时消除其对固定基的刚性限制。
Method: 通过神经网络学习一个基，使得变换在该基上分解为简单的相位差运算，从而将相位相关从全局平移推广到密集非刚性形变和酉动力学。
Result: 在ACDC心脏MRI上双向配准均匹配或超越先前发表基线；在CAMUS超声心动图上无需辅助机制即达到最先进水平；在量子谐振子波函数对中，仅从观测对恢复出Hermite函数本征态和未知Hamiltonian的量子化能级。
Conclusion: 该框架保留了相位相关直接度量变换的代数优雅性，同时通过可学习基扩展到更广泛的变换类型，具有跨领域的潜力。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种学习型相位相关（Neural Phase Correlation）方法，将经典相位相关的傅里叶域互相关操作泛化到可学习基上，从而支持非刚性变形和酉动力学。在ACDC心脏MRI基准上匹配或超过先前基线，在CAMUS超声心动图上无需辅助评分或自适应平滑即达到最先进水平，并在1D量子谐振子波函数对中从观测对恢复出本征态和能级。
summary_sections.motivation: 经典相位相关仅限于全局平移，而主流学习方法将变换隐式编码在特征相似性中，未将变换作为一等对象。本文旨在保留相位相关直接度量变换的代数结构，同时消除其对固定基的刚性限制。

papers.title: SFT Overtraining Predicts Rank Inversion via Entropy Collapse Under RLVR
papers.abstract_en: The standard heuristic of selecting the SFT checkpoint with the highest pass@1 for GRPO can fail when SFT compresses the rollout distribution. For binary rewards, the expected within group advantage variance is $p(1{-}p)(g{-}1)/g$; when early GRPO drives $p$ below $p^*(g)$, most groups have identical rewards and provide no group relative signal. We study SFT depth ladders for Qwen2.5-Coder-3B and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B. We test Qwen2.5-Coder-3B across five depths and three seeds, and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B across four matched depths and three seeds. On Qwen, pre RL pass@1 rises with SFT depth, but peak GRPO pass@10 falls from $0.806$ to $0.481$ (3 seed mean, $n{=}20$); pre RL entropy is positively associated with the GRPO outcome ($ρ{=}{+}0.69$). On DeepSeek, pass@1 remains far above $p^*(8){=}0.083$, and GRPO outcomes compress rather than invert. A two stage diagnostic, combining pre RL entropy triage with an early GRPO entropy monitor, flags high risk checkpoints and can stop failing runs early. Simple KL to reference regularisation and label smoothing variants do not rescue the collapsed Qwen checkpoint in our setting, suggesting the failure is not a trivial GRPO hyperparameter artefact.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Deep Learning for Code (DL4C) Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在RLVR（Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards）场景下，SFT（Supervised Fine-Tuning）过训练导致排名反转的问题。作者发现，当SFT压缩了rollout分布时，标准启发式方法失效，并提出了基于预RL熵和早期GRPO熵的两阶段诊断方法。实验使用Qwen2.5-Coder-3B和DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B模型，发现预RL熵与GRPO结果正相关（ρ=+0.69），而简单的KL正则化和标签平滑无法挽救塌缩的检查点。
Motivation: 标准启发式方法（选择SFT中pass@1最高的检查点用于GRPO）可能在SFT压缩rollout分布时失败，导致模型在RL阶段性能反转。理解这一失效机制对RL训练的选择至关重要。
Method: 通过SFT深度梯度的实验设计，结合预RL熵的早期预警和早期GRPO熵监控，提出两阶段诊断方法。实验在两个代码模型（Qwen2.5-Coder-3B和DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B）上，使用不同深度和种子进行验证。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-Coder-3B上，随着SFT深度增加，预RL的pass@1上升，但GRPO的pass@10从0.806下降到0.481（3种子均值，n=20）；预RL熵与GRPO结果正相关（ρ=+0.69）。在DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B上，pass@1远高于阈值p*(8)=0.083，GRPO结果压缩而非反转。
Conclusion: 预RL熵和早期GRPO熵可以诊断高风险检查点并提前终止失败训练。简单的KL正则化和标签平滑无法挽救塌缩的Qwen检查点，表明该失败并非简单的GRPO超参数伪影。

papers.title: MagpieTTS-LF: Inference-Time Long-Form Speech Generation Without Training on Long-Form data
papers.abstract_en: Neural Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems achieve remarkable quality on short utterances but long-form speech generation shows prosodic drift, speaker inconsistencies and sentence boundary artifacts. Existing approaches either compress sequences, increase context length or naively concatenate independently synthesized chunks. We present an inference-time approach called MagpieTTS-LF that enables MagpieTTS to produce coherent long-form speech without model retraining. Our method introduces three key innovations: (1) soft attention priors to guide monotonic alignment while preserving past and future context; (2) a stateful inference algorithm that maintains context across sentence chunks, ensuring prosodic continuity; (3) history-aware text encoding that uses past text for discourse-level prosodic planning. Experiments on long texts show significant improvements in long-range intelligibility, prosodic coherence, speaker consistency, and boundary naturalness compared to other baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MagpieTTS-LF，一种无需在长文本数据上重新训练即可实现长语音生成的方法。该方法通过软注意力先验、状态化推理算法和历史感知文本编码三项创新，解决了长语音生成中的韵律漂移、说话人不一致和句子边界伪影等问题。实验表明，与基线相比，该方法在长程可懂度、韵律连贯性、说话人一致性和边界自然度上有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有神经TTS在短句上表现优异，但生成长语音时会出现韵律漂移、说话人不一致和句子边界伪影，而现有方法要么压缩序列、增加上下文长度，要么简单拼接独立合成的片段，效果有限。
Method: 提出推理时方法MagpieTTS-LF，包含三项创新：软注意力先验以引导单调对齐同时保留上下文；状态化推理算法跨句子块维护上下文保证韵律连续性；历史感知文本编码利用历史文本进行篇章级韵律规划。
Result: 在长文本上，与基线相比，该方法在长程可懂度、韵律连贯性、说话人一致性和边界自然度上均有显著改善。
Conclusion: 本文展示了无需训练长文本数据即可通过推理时策略提升长语音生成质量的可能性，但摘要未提及在极长文本或极端场景下的局限性。

papers.title: Vines-DB: An RGB image dataset for multi-species ornamental vine segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The Vines-DB dataset contains 1,218 original high-resolution RGB images of seven ornamental vine species collected under field conditions at the Utah Agricultural Experiment Station's Greenville Research Farm in Logan, Utah, USA. The dataset was generated from 168 individual vine plants that were transplanted in 2022 and photographed repeatedly across multiple months during the 2023 and 2024 growing seasons (July-October). Images were captured with an iPhone 16 Pro equipped with a 48 MP camera between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM under daylight. Vines were grown on 1.2m x 2.4m trellises and photographed from a distance of 1m against black or white Styrofoam backdrops to improve contrast and reduce background noise. The dataset includes Akebia quinata, Campsis radicans, Hydrangea anomala petiolaris, Lonicera x heckrottii, Campsis x tagliabuana 'Madame Galen', Parthenocissus quinquefolia, and Wisteria floribunda. All original images were manually annotated in Roboflow by trained annotators to produce polygon-based instance segmentation masks for eight classes, including seven species and background. After preprocessing and data augmentation, the working dataset was expanded to 2,307 images for model development and evaluation. The augmented dataset was divided into 2,019 training images, 192 validation images, and 96 test images using stratified sampling to maintain balanced representation. Vines-DB supports the development and evaluation of deep learning models for multi-class instance segmentation in precision horticulture and urban ecology. The dataset enables applications such as automated canopy cover estimation, species identification, and scalable field phenotyping. In addition, repeated monthly imaging of the plants captures temporal variation in canopy development and plant appearance, increasing the dataset's utility for segmentation benchmarking under realistic field conditions.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure. Source data repository: OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/YJHCK)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了Vines-DB数据集，包含1,218张高分辨率RGB图像，涵盖七种观赏藤蔓植物，在田间条件下拍摄并手工标注了多边形实例分割掩码。经过数据增强后扩展至2,307张图像，并划分为训练、验证和测试集。该数据集旨在支持精准园艺和城市生态中的多类实例分割模型开发与评估。
Motivation: 现有的藤蔓分割数据集缺乏多物种、高分辨率、带时间变化的田间图像，限制了深度学习模型在自动化冠层覆盖估计、物种识别和田间表型分析中的应用。
Method: 收集了七种藤蔓植物在2023-2024年生长季（7-10月）的多月图像，使用iPhone 16 Pro拍摄，并在黑色或白色泡沫板背景下从1米距离拍摄以增强对比度。所有图像由训练人员在Roboflow中进行多边形标注，生成八个类别（七种藤蔓加背景）的实例分割掩码，并通过数据增强将数据集扩展至2,307张图像。
Result: 数据集包含2,019张训练图像、192张验证图像和96张测试图像，通过分层抽样保持类别平衡。提供了七种藤蔓植物的实例分割标注，捕捉了冠层发育的时间变化。
Conclusion: Vines-DB数据集为多物种藤蔓实例分割提供了高质量的基准数据，支持精准园艺和城市生态中的自动化冠层覆盖估计、物种识别和田间表型分析等任务。

papers.title: The Illusion of Improvement: Reject Inference Strategies in Credit Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Reject inference methods are widely used to mitigate survival bias in credit scoring, yet their effectiveness remains poorly understood. We systematically evaluate several such methods and uncover a structural failure mode: in a natural retraining cycle, models whose accuracy improves while recall collapses create an illusion of improvement that leads practitioners to believe the system is getting better when, in fact, its rejection quality -- the ability to correctly screen out defaulters -- is deteriorating. We then propose a controlled exploration strategy that breaks the feedback loop without statistical assumptions: the lender deliberately approves a fraction of rejected applicants and observes their true outcomes. We show that accuracy and rejection quality give opposite recommendations on whether to explore: accuracy favors no exploration, while rejection quality improves with it, confirming that standard evaluation metrics are misleading under selection bias. Even minimal exploration rates (2--5\%) prove sufficient in our experiments to diagnose the severity of the feedback loop at near-zero cost. Our findings are consistent across two machine learning methods and three real-world datasets, and suggest that standard evaluation protocols are inadequate for assessing models trained under survival bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了信用评分中常用的拒绝推断（reject inference）方法，发现其在自然重训练循环中存在结构性失效模式：模型准确率提升但召回率下降，造成改进假象，实际上拒绝质量恶化。作者提出一种受控探索策略，通过故意批准少量被拒申请者并观察真实结果来打破反馈循环，无需统计假设。实验表明，即使仅2-5%的探索率也能以接近零成本诊断问题严重性，且该结论在两种机器学习方法和三个真实数据集上一致。
Motivation: 拒绝推断方法广泛用于缓解信用评分中的生存偏差（survival bias），但其有效性缺乏深入理解；标准评估指标在存在选择偏差时具有误导性，可能掩盖模型实际性能退化。
Method: 系统评估多种拒绝推断方法，识别其结构性失效模式；提出受控探索策略，即贷款机构故意批准一部分被拒申请人并观察真实违约结果，从而打破准确率提升而召回率下降的反馈循环，无需统计假设。
Result: 准确率与拒绝质量对是否探索给出相反建议：准确率偏好不探索，而拒绝质量随探索率提升而改善。实验中2-5%的探索率即可有效诊断反馈循环严重性，且成本近乎为零。
Conclusion: 标准评估协议在生存偏差下训练的模型中不充分，可能产生虚假改进信号；受控探索策略能够以极低代价识别模型失效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data-Forcing Distillation: Restoring Diversity and Fidelity in Few-Step Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress has shown promise in distilling multi-step video diffusion models into efficient few-step students. Among them, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and its successor DMD2 achieved strong generation quality and fast convergence. However, due to the nature of the reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective, these methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: a substantial drop in sample diversity, and visibly over-saturated outputs that deviate from real-video appearance. In this work, we propose Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD), a simple post-training framework that restores diversity and fidelity in DMD with only a single-line of code change. At its core is the teacher score discrepancy to guide the student toward the real-data distribution, pulling it to missing modes (mitigating mode collapse) and away from problematic modes absent in real data (avoiding over-saturation). We provide an in-depth theoretical analysis of our framework and validate our approach on text-to-video, image-to-video, and autoregressive video generation. With only 100--300 steps of finetuning, DFD effectively restores diversity and fidelity on both Wan2.1-1.3B and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B model, resolving the over-saturation artifacts with significantly better video dynamics and appearance, and even outperforms the teacher model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD)，一种用于修复分布匹配蒸馏 (DMD) 在多步视频扩散模型蒸馏为少步学生模型时产生的多样性和保真度损失的简单后训练框架。DFD 通过教师分数差异 (teacher score discrepancy) 引导学生模型逼近真实数据分布，从而缓解模式坍塌和过饱和伪影。实验表明，在 Wan2.1-1.3B 和 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 模型上仅需 100-300 步微调即可恢复多样性并提升视频动态与外观，甚至超越教师模型。
Motivation: DMD 及其后续 DMD2 因逆向 KL 散度目标导致样本多样性显著下降和过饱和伪影，偏离真实视频外观。
Method: 提出 Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD)，核心是引入教师分数差异项，引导学生模型向真实数据分布移动：拉向缺失模式（缓解模式坍塌）并推离问题模式（避免过饱和）。仅需一行代码更改。
Result: 在文本到视频、图像到视频和自回归视频生成任务上，对 Wan2.1-1.3B 和 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 模型微调 100-300 步，有效恢复多样性和保真度，消除过饱和伪影，视频动态和外观甚至优于教师模型。
Conclusion: DFD 提供了一种简单有效的方法来修复 DMD 蒸馏后的多样性和保真度问题，实验验证了其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Domain Generalizable Adaptation of 3D Vision-Language Models via Regularized Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptation remains a central challenge in 3D vision, especially for multimodal foundation models that align 3D point clouds with visual and textual data. While these models demonstrate strong general capabilities, adapting them to downstream domains with limited data often leads to overfitting and catastrophic forgetting. To address this, we introduce ReFine3D, a regularized fine-tuning framework designed for domain-generalizable tuning of 3D large multimodal models (LMMs). ReFine3D combines selective layer tuning with two targeted regularization strategies: multi-view consistency across augmented point clouds and text diversity through synonym-based prompts generated by large language models. Additionally, we incorporate point-rendered vision supervision and a test-time augmentation mechanism with confidence-based aggregation to further enhance robustness. Extensive experiments across different 3D domain generalization benchmarks show that ReFine3D improves base-to-novel class generalization by 1.36%, cross-dataset transfer by 2.43%, robustness to corruption by 1.80%, and few-shot accuracy by up to 3.11%, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods with minimal added computational overhead.
papers.comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D多模态大模型（LMMs）在有限目标域数据下微调时容易过拟合和灾难性遗忘的问题，提出ReFine3D正则化微调框架。该框架结合选择性层微调、多视图一致性正则化、基于大语言模型生成同义词提示的文本多样性、点渲染视觉监督以及测试时增强与置信度聚合策略。在多个3D领域泛化基准上，ReFine3D在基类到新类泛化、跨数据集迁移、鲁棒性和少样本准确率方面分别提升1.36%、2.43%、1.80%和3.11%，且计算开销小。
Motivation: 现有3D多模态基础模型在跨域下游任务中表现良好，但直接微调少量标注数据会导致过拟合和灾难性遗忘，限制了其领域泛化能力。
Method: 提出ReFine3D框架，包含：(1) 选择性层微调；(2) 多视图一致性正则化（对增强点云施加特征一致性约束）；(3) 文本多样性策略（利用大语言模型生成同义词替换的提示）；(4) 点渲染视觉监督；(5) 测试时增强与置信度聚合。
Result: 在多个3D领域泛化基准上，基类到新类泛化提升1.36%，跨数据集迁移提升2.43%，对腐败鲁棒性提升1.80%，少样本准确率提升最多3.11%，超越先前最优方法。
Conclusion: ReFine3D通过多种正则化策略有效提升了3D视觉-语言模型在目标域有限数据下的泛化能力，且仅引入少量额外计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured Representation Learning with Locally Linear Embeddings and Adaptive Feature Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Neuroscientific research has revealed that the brain encodes complex behaviors by leveraging structured, low-dimensional manifolds and dynamically fusing multiple sources of information through adaptive gating mechanisms. Inspired by these principles, we propose a novel reinforcement learning (RL) framework that encourages the disentanglement of dynamics-specific and reward-specific features, drawing direct parallels to how neural circuits separate and integrate information for efficient decision-making. Our approach leverages locally linear embeddings (LLEs) to capture the intrinsic, locally linear structure inherent in many environments, mirroring the local smoothness observed in neural population activity, while concurrently deriving reward-specific features through the standard RL objective. An attention mechanism, analogous to cortical gating, adaptively fuses these complementary representations on a per-state basis. Experimental results on benchmark tasks demonstrate that our method, grounded in neuroscientific principles, improves learning efficiency and overall performance compared to conventional RL approaches, highlighting the benefits of explicitly modeling local state structures and adaptive feature selection as observed in biological systems.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (04/2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受神经科学启发，本文提出一种强化学习框架，通过局部线性嵌入（LLE）捕获环境中的局部线性结构，并利用标准RL目标推导奖励特征，再通过注意力机制自适应地融合这两种表示。实验表明该方法能提升学习效率和整体性能。
Motivation: 神经科学研究发现大脑通过结构化低维流形和自适应门控机制融合信息进行高效决策，而现有RL方法缺乏此类显式建模。
Method: 使用LLE学习状态空间的局部线性结构，同时通过RL目标学习奖励特定特征，并采用注意力机制（类比皮层门控）按状态动态融合这两种表示。
Result: 在基准RL任务上，该方法相比传统RL方法提升了学习效率和整体性能。
Conclusion: 显式建模局部状态结构和自适应特征选择（与神经系统原理一致）有助于提升RL性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ToolChain-CRC: Conformal Risk Control for Agentic AI Under Retrieval and Tool-Use Drift
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI agents retrieve documents, call tools, check intermediate information, and then produce a final answer or action. This creates a risk-control problem that is not visible from the final answer alone. A final response may look acceptable even when the retrieval was weak, a tool output was wrong, or an earlier step was unsupported. We propose ToolChain-CRC, a conformal risk-control method for retrieval-augmented and tool-using agents under drift. The method treats each agent run as a full trajectory of actions, observations, and final output. It builds step-level risk scores, combines them into a trajectory risk score, calibrates an accept-or-intervene rule, and adds an anytime alarm that can stop risky runs before the final answer. We prove trajectory-level risk control under exchangeable calibration runs, give a drift-aware extension with auditable constants, and prove an anytime escalation rule through a supermartingale construction. Experiments cover synthetic tool-chain drift, RAG/tool-use stress tests, public SQuAD-derived retrieval tasks, an API-free agentic QA case study, ablations, target-risk sensitivity checks, 20-seed robustness checks, a drift-margin audit, and a live RAG/tool-use agent benchmark. Across these settings, final-answer-only calibration can miss retrieval and tool failures, while trajectory-level calibration keeps accepted-trajectory risk below the target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ToolChain-CRC，一种用于检索增强和工具使用型AI智能体的共形风险控制方法，该方法通过追踪完整轨迹的步骤级风险分数，校准接受或干预规则，并能在最终答案前发出实时警报，在检索和工具使用漂移下控制风险。
Motivation: 现有方法仅关注最终答案的风险控制，忽略了检索弱、工具输出错误或中间步骤不可靠等问题，导致风险控制不完整。
Method: 将每次智能体运行视为完整轨迹，构建步骤级风险分数并组合为轨迹风险分数，校准接受或干预规则，并通过超鞅构造实现可随时停止的警报机制；同时提出漂移感知扩展和可审计常数。
Result: 实验涵盖合成工具链漂移、RAG/工具使用压力测试、SQuAD检索任务、无API的智能体QA案例等，表明仅基于最终答案的校准会遗漏检索和工具故障，而轨迹级校准可将接受轨迹的风险控制在目标以下。
Conclusion: 轨迹级共形风险控制比仅关注最终答案的方法更有效地检测和减轻检索与工具使用漂移带来的风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Does the Weight Norm Control in Grokking? Logit-Scale Mediation under Cross-Entropy
papers.abstract_en: Grokking, the delayed jump from memorization to generalization, is usually tied to the weight norm: a smaller norm generalizes sooner. We ask what the norm actually controls. Holding the weight norm fixed by clamping and varying only an output temperature, we slide the grokking delay across its entire norm-induced range under cross-entropy; matching the effective logit scale back to baseline recovers about 85% of the delay at two moduli. Across a grid of norms and temperatures the delay collapses onto the logit scale alone (R2 = 0.97), with the norm adding 1-2% beyond it. The effect is loss-dependent: under mean-squared error the logit scale is pinned and the norm acts through a different route. A memorization control, a float64 softmax-collapse audit, and a no-LayerNorm transformer point to the same channel. Forking arms from one identical state, the delay follows the held norm value and not the clamp operation, which closes a rescaling-artifact concern. The proximal variable is the logit scale and the softmax saturation it drives; the weight norm is only an upstream handle. All numbers, tables, and figures reproduce from released code and data.
papers.comment: 16 papges, 10 tables and 4 figures. Code and data to reproduce all numbers, tables, and figures: https://github.com/ClevixLab/grokking-logit-scale
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究grokking现象中权重范数（weight norm）对泛化延迟的具体控制机制。通过固定权重范数并调节输出温度，发现logit scale（logit尺度）是延迟的直接决定因素，权重范数仅通过影响logit scale间接起作用。在交叉熵损失下，logit scale可解释约97%的延迟变化，而权重范数仅贡献1-2%。该效应与损失函数相关，在均方误差下logit scale被固定，权重范数通过其他途径影响。
Motivation: Grokking现象中权重范数被认为与泛化延迟密切相关，但具体机制不明。本文旨在厘清权重范数究竟控制什么，以及是否存在更直接的近端变量。
Method: 通过固定权重范数并调节输出温度（相当于改变logit scale），在不同范数和温度网格下测量groking延迟，并对比交叉熵与均方误差损失下的表现。同时进行记忆控制、float64软max崩溃审计和无LayerNorm Transformer实验以排除伪像。
Result: 在交叉熵损失下，logit scale可解释延迟变化的97%（R2=0.97），权重范数仅额外贡献1-2%。通过调节温度使有效logit scale匹配基线，可恢复约85%的延迟差异。在均方误差下，logit scale被固定，权重范数通过不同路径影响。
Conclusion: grokking延迟的近端变量是logit scale及其导致的softmax饱和程度，权重范数仅为上游操作手柄。该结论通过多种消融和对照实验得到验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Modeling Doppler Shifts in Radial-Velocity Data with Deep Learning toward Earth-mass Exoplanet Detection
papers.abstract_en: Detecting the tiny Doppler shifts induced by Earth-mass planets in stellar radial-velocity measurements remains extremely challenging due to stellar activity. Many deep-learning methods performing well on simulated data remain difficult to apply reliably on real stellar spectra. The aim of this work is to develop a deep-learning framework that generalizes to real, unseen spectra and improves the detectability of Earth-mass planets in radial-velocity data. We train artificial neural networks on HARPS-N solar spectra with injected planetary signals, using physics-motivated spectral representations based on flux and line-formation temperature, together with their velocity gradients. Two training strategies are explored: hold-out testing and cross-validation. Model robustness is enhanced through genetic-algorithm-based hyperparameter optimization, and predictive uncertainty is quantified using Monte Carlo dropout. Our most precise neural network model reliably retrieves, under the cross-validation strategy, the amplitudes, phases, and orbital periods of planetary signals with amplitudes greater than or equal to 25 cm/s and periods between 10 and 550 days. In addition, in all cases tested here, the successfully recovered signals correspond to the most significant peaks in the periodograms of the Doppler-shift predictions. Temperature-based spectral-shell representations consistently outperform flux-based shells. We also release doppleriann, a Python package implementing the proposed framework. Our results demonstrate that combining physically motivated spectral representations with deep learning provides a promising pathway toward the detection of Earth-mass planets in radial-velocity data from real observations, supported by a modeling framework that is both physically grounded and statistically rigorous, incorporating uncertainty quantification and optimized training strategies.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 14 figures. Accepted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理驱动光谱表示（流量和谱线形成温度及其速度梯度）的深度学习框架，用于处理恒星活动干扰下的径向速度数据，以探测地球质量系外行星。在HARPS-N太阳光谱注入行星信号的实验中，最佳神经网络模型（交叉验证策略）能可靠恢复振幅≥25 cm/s、周期10-550天的行星信号，且基于温度的光谱壳表示优于流量壳。框架包含遗传算法超参数优化和蒙特卡洛dropout不确定性量化，并发布了Python包doppleriann。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在模拟数据上表现良好，但难以可靠泛化到真实恒星光谱，且地球质量行星引起的多普勒频移极小，恒星活动噪声严重，亟需一种结合物理约束和不确定性量化的稳健框架。
Method: 采用人工神经网络，输入为基于光谱流量和谱线形成温度及其速度梯度的物理驱动表示；对比了保持测试与交叉验证两种训练策略；通过遗传算法优化超参数，使用蒙特卡洛dropout估计预测不确定性。
Result: 交叉验证下，模型能可靠恢复振幅≥25 cm/s、周期10-550天的行星信号的振幅、相位和轨道周期；成功恢复的信号对应多普勒频移预测周期图中的最显著峰；温度基光谱壳表示始终优于流量基表示。
Conclusion: 结合物理驱动光谱表示与深度学习的框架，辅以不确定性量化和优化训练策略，为从真实观测径向速度数据中探测地球质量行星提供了有前景的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mixed-Precision Communication-Avoiding SGD for Generalized Linear Models on GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Distributed stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is limited by communication rather than computation, since each iteration requires an AllReduce across processes. Communication-avoiding SGD (CA-SGD) amortizes communication over $s$ iterations by replacing $s$ consecutive AllReduces with a single AllReduce of an $sb\times sb$ Gram matrix, trading more computation and bandwidth for fewer synchronization points. Modern GPUs with matrix hardware and reduced-precision formats offset this by accelerating the Gram GEMM and shrinking BF16 traffic. We study mixed-precision CA-SGD for generalized linear models on NVIDIA GPUs. Our finite-precision analysis decomposes the local rounding error of one CA-SGD outer iteration into nine independent precision choices, depending on the hardware only through its low-precision unit roundoffs, so the resulting recipes transfer in principle across GPU generations. The recipe stores the input matrix and margin vector in low precision, computes the Gram matrix from low-precision inputs with high-precision accumulation, communicates it in high precision, and performs the inner recurrence and weight updates in high precision. On NERSC Perlmutter A100 GPUs, mixed-precision CA-SGD matches FP32 SGD loss within $0.5\%$ on logistic, linear, and Poisson problems and reaches $5.1$--$6.8\times$ speedup over FP32 SGD on epsilon, SUSY, HIGGS, synth, and Poisson-synth. Our software is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20448273
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合精度通信避免SGD（CA-SGD）算法，用于广义线性模型在GPU上的分布式训练。通过每s次迭代只进行一次AllReduce，将s个连续AllReduce替换为一次sb×sb Gram矩阵的AllReduce，从而减少同步开销。结合现代GPU的低精度矩阵硬件，混合精度方案在A100上达到5.1-6.8倍加速，且损失精度在0.5%以内。
Motivation: 分布式SGD的通信开销远大于计算开销，每次迭代都需要AllReduce，限制了扩展效率。CA-SGD通过多次迭代合并一次通信来减少同步次数，但需要更多计算和带宽。现代GPU的低精度硬件提供了折中机会。
Method: 将CA-SGD的外迭代局部舍入误差分解为9个独立的精度选择，取决于硬件的低精度单位舍入误差。具体配方：输入矩阵和边向量用低精度存储，Gram矩阵从低精度输入计算但高精度累加，以高精度通信，内部迭代和权重更新保持高精度。
Result: 在NERSC Perlmutter A100 GPU上，混合精度CA-SGD在逻辑回归、线性回归和泊松回归任务中，损失函数与FP32 SGD相差不超过0.5%，并在epsilon、SUSY、HIGGS、synth和Poisson-synth数据集上实现5.1-6.8倍加速。
Conclusion: 混合精度CA-SGD在保持数值精度的同时显著提升分布式训练速度，且精度配方跨GPU世代可迁移。软件已开源。
