papers.title: Task-Restricted Symmetries in Recurrent Weight Space
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent networks can contain substantial functional redundancy in weight space: changing a recurrent matrix may leave the input-output rollout nearly unchanged on a task distribution, while similar-scale changes can destroy the same behavior. We study this redundancy in one-layer tanh RNNs using ordered real Schur coordinates. The Schur form separates spectral blocks from directed nonnormal couplings, giving a diagnostic basis for structured ablations that keep the input and readout maps fixed. In a fixed-length copy task, selected nonnormal Schur couplings can be removed with little loss in some trained solutions, whereas other couplings are necessary for accurate autonomous replay. Across flip-flop, sine generation, and context-dependent integration, the loss-preserving ablation profile varies across tasks and trained solutions. These results identify candidate approximate functional invariances, not universal symmetries of recurrent weight space. Schur-coordinate ablations provide a practical diagnostic for which structured perturbations preserve a trained recurrent solution and which ones disrupt its computation.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单层tanh循环神经网络（RNN）在权重空间中的功能冗余。通过有序实Schur坐标分解，作者在一组固定长度的复制、触发器、正弦生成和上下文相关集成任务上发现：某些非正常Schur耦合可以被消融而几乎不损失性能，但该模式因任务和训练解而异，揭示了任务限制的近似功能不变性而非全局对称性。
Motivation: 循环网络权重空间存在大量功能冗余：改变循环矩阵可能不影响输入-输出滚动，而类似尺度的改变却可能破坏行为。理解这种冗余对于网络压缩、泛化解释和结构正则化具有意义。
Method: 使用有序实Schur坐标将循环矩阵分解为谱块和有向非正常耦合，在固定输入和读出映射的前提下进行结构化消融实验。
Result: 在复制任务中，部分非正常Schur耦合可被移除且几乎不损失性能，而其他耦合对自主回放至关重要。在触发器、正弦生成和上下文相关集成任务中，保留性能的消融谱因任务和训练解而异。
Conclusion: Schur坐标消融提供了一种实用诊断工具，用于识别哪些结构化扰动能保留训练好的循环网络解，哪些会破坏其计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Veriphi: Attack-Guided Neural Network Verification with Dataset-Dependent Training Methods
papers.abstract_en: We present Veriphi, a GPU-accelerated neural network verification system that combines fast adversarial attacks with formal bound certification using alpha,beta-CROWN methods. Through systematic experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 using three training methodologies (standard, adversarial, certified), we demonstrate that training method effectiveness is fundamentally dataset-dependent. Interval Bound Propagation (IBP) achieves 78% certified accuracy on simple MNIST (784 dimensions) but provides negligible certification performance on the more complex CIFAR-10 dataset, where PGD adversarial training dominates with 94% certification at small perturbations. We achieve 5x verification speedup through attack-guided falsification and scale our approach to production-size models (105.8M parameters) for real-world aerospace logistics optimization. Our results challenge the assumption that certified training universally outperforms adversarial training, showing context matters critically for verification strategy selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Veriphi 是一个 GPU 加速的神经网络验证系统，结合快速对抗攻击和 alpha,beta-CROWN 形式化边界认证。在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上的实验表明，训练方法的有效性严重依赖于数据集：Interval Bound Propagation (IBP) 在简单 MNIST 上取得 78% 的认证准确率，但在复杂 CIFAR-10 上几乎无效，而 PGD 对抗训练在小扰动下达到 94% 认证率。系统通过攻击引导的证伪实现 5 倍加速，并成功扩展到 105.8M 参数的生产规模模型用于航空物流优化。
Motivation: 现有神经网络验证方法在复杂数据集上表现不一致，需要系统评估训练方法与数据集的依赖关系，并提升验证效率。
Method: 提出 Veriphi 系统，集成 fast adversarial attacks 与 alpha,beta-CROWN 形式化边界认证，采用攻击引导的 falsification 加速验证，并在多种训练方法（标准、对抗、认证训练）下进行系统对比。
Result: IBP 在 MNIST 上实现 78% 认证准确率，但在 CIFAR-10 上几乎无认证能力；PGD 对抗训练在 CIFAR-10 小扰动下达到 94% 认证率。系统实现 5 倍验证加速，并成功验证 105.8M 参数的航空物流优化模型。
Conclusion: 认证训练并非普遍优于对抗训练，训练方法与数据集的匹配程度对验证策略选择至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Cross-Model VLM-Judge Protocol for Single-Image 3D Mesh Quality (and Why Cheap Proxies Fall Short)
papers.abstract_en: Single-image-to-3D generators are improving quickly, but there is no agreed, human-free way to tell whether one generated mesh is better than another. Practitioners commonly rely on cheap automatic proxies (render-space CLIP similarity and mesh geometry-validity statistics), yet how well these track perceived quality is unestablished. We make two contributions. First, we propose and validate a reproducible VLM-judge evaluation protocol: a fixed 24-view headless render rig, two independent vision-language judge families, and a mandatory position-bias correction that queries both presentation orders and keeps only order-consistent verdicts. The two judge families agree substantially with each other (Cohen's kappa = 0.66), well above the chance-agreement floor. Second, using this protocol as the reference, we show the cheap proxies do not substitute for it. Geometry validity is only a weak signal on average (because, as we show, it is bimodal) and stays below our pre-registered target, while render-CLIP is at chance. A learned Bradley-Terry head collapses onto a single manifoldness statistic (giving render-CLIP a negative weight) and matches geometry-only exactly, so learning the feature weights buys nothing. The proxy is also bimodal: it is significantly above chance on contrasts with visible geometric defects but at chance on ambiguous contrasts, consistent with geometry validity tracking the judge only when the defect is visually salient. We therefore recommend the VLM-judge protocol as a reliable, reproducible evaluator under the conditions tested (two feed-forward generators on Google Scanned Objects, with a face-drop degradation regime) and advise against geometry/CLIP proxies as optimization targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的可重复评估协议，用于单图像到3D网格生成的质量评估，并证明常用的廉价代理（如CLIP相似性和网格几何有效性）无法替代该协议。协议使用24视图固定渲染、两个独立VLM裁判族以及强制性位置偏差校正，两个裁判族之间一致性较高（Cohen's kappa=0.66）。实验表明，几何有效性信号微弱且呈双峰分布，渲染CLIP几乎随机，而学习特征权重的Bradley-Terry头部仅退化为单一流行度统计量。
Motivation: 单图像转3D生成器进展迅速，但缺乏公认的、无需人工的网格质量评估方法。廉价自动代理（渲染空间CLIP相似性和几何有效性统计量）被广泛使用，但未建立与感知质量的关联。
Method: 提出可重复的VLM裁判评估协议：固定24视图无头渲染管线、两个独立VLM裁判族、强制位置偏差校正（查询两种顺序并保留一致判断）。以该协议作为基准，评估廉价代理的性能。
Result: 两个VLM裁判族一致性较高（Cohen's kappa=0.66）。廉价代理中，几何有效性仅在视觉缺陷明显时高于随机，总体呈双峰分布；渲染CLIP近似随机。学习特征权重的Bradley-Terry头部退化为单一流行度统计量，与纯几何方法相当。
Conclusion: 在测试条件下（两个前馈生成器、Google Scanned Objects数据集、面丢弃退化机制），推荐VLM裁判协议作为可靠可重复评估器，不建议使用几何/CLIP代理作为优化目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TMR-GGNN: Credit Card Fraud Detection based on Time-Aware Multi-Relational Guided Graph Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, credit card fraud detection has faced significant challenges due to highly imbalanced data, evolving fraud patterns, and complex relational structures among transaction entities. To address these issues, this research proposes a novel framework called Timeaware Multi Relational Guided Graph Neural Network (TMR GGNN). Particularly, the proposed TMR GGNN extends the encoder decoder Graph Neural Network GNN architecture by modeling heterogeneous interactions across customers, merchants, devices, and IPs over temporal windows. Subsequently, the proposed TMR GGNN approach constructs a dynamic, multi relational graph and incorporates a time aware relational attention mechanism within the encoder to adaptively weigh the transaction relevance based on temporal proximity and semantic context. Consequently, the decoder employs a contrastive learning module to distinguish between real and synthesized transaction patterns, while improving the models generalization of rare fraud cases. Additionally, to effectively manage severe class imbalances and emphasize discriminative learning, a composite loss function combining Information Noise Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) based contrastive loss with Focal Loss is introduced. This integration assists in improving fraud identification while mitigating false negatives.

papers.title: Reasoning as Intersection: Consensus-Frame Alignment for Visual Focus in Video-MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but applying outcome-only rewards to video multimodal large language models (Video-MLLMs) provides limited guidance on which visual evidence should support the answer. Inspired by multisensory integration, where consistent cues can enhance the salience and reliability of perceptual estimates, we introduce Consensus Frame GRPO (CF-GRPO), a temporal-annotation-free process-level reward framework for evidence-aware video reasoning. CF-GRPO constructs a consensus frame prior from intrinsic video cues, including temporal coverage, scene-transition cues, and query-conditioned visual relevance. It then computes a model-side frame-use score from visual and response representations and optimizes their agreement through the Consensus Frame Reward (CFR). With salience-aware sparse aggregation and distribution sharpening, CFR provides a high-contrast reward signal without requiring human temporal annotations. Experiments show that VideoCFR achieves competitive performance across complex video reasoning benchmarks and improves several metrics over representative Video-MLLM and RL baselines, while the consensus prior provides an interpretable view of the evidence frames emphasized during training. The implementation is available at https://github.com/1Pansy/VideoCFR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频多模态大模型（Video-MLLMs）在推理中缺乏视觉焦点指导的问题，提出无需时间标注的过程级奖励框架 Consensus Frame GRPO (CF-GRPO)。该框架利用视频内在线索构建共识帧先验，并通过模型侧帧使用分数与先验的共识奖励（CFR）进行优化，从而提升模型对关键证据帧的聚焦能力。实验在多个复杂视频推理基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，并改善了代表模型和强化学习基线的指标。
Motivation: 现有视频多模态大模型仅使用结果级奖励，无法提供关于哪些视觉证据支持答案的明确指导，导致推理过程缺乏可解释性和效率。
Method: 提出 CF-GRPO 框架，包含共识帧先验（基于时间覆盖、场景切换、查询相关视觉特征）和模型侧帧使用分数，通过 Consensus Frame Reward 优化两者对齐，并采用显著性感知的稀疏聚合和分布锐化生成高对比奖励信号。
Result: 在视频推理基准上，CF-GRPO 取得了有竞争力的性能，并在多个指标上优于代表性 Video-MLLM 和强化学习基线。
Conclusion: 共识帧先验为训练过程中强调的证据帧提供了可解释的视角，且无需人工时间标注。

papers.title: RegimeVGGT: Layer-Wise Spatially Preserving Redundancy Removal for Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) recovers dense 3D scene structure from multi-view images in one forward pass, but quadratic cross-frame attention limits its scalability. Existing training-free accelerators reduce computation uniformly along one axis, missing layer heterogeneity. Our spectral, probing, and causal analyses reveal three regimes: shallow layers lack cross-view structure, middle layers drive cross-view alignment, and deep layers are redundant for dense geometry yet their cross-frame attention remains essential for pose. RegimeVGGT applies layer-wise U-shaped compression along two axes: Saliency-Guided Banded Merging protects geometry- and edge-salient tokens, while Selectively Protected K/V Downsampling preserves cross-frame spatial coverage and the pose-critical path through a phase-shifted spatial grid, a reference-frame anchor, and uncompressed camera/register tokens. Training-free, RegimeVGGT achieves a 6.7x speedup over VGGT* at matched reconstruction quality.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Jinhao You, Shuo Lyu, Zhuohang Lyu, Tanxuan Li, and Zibo Zhao contributed equally. Shuo Lyu is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉几何基础Transformer（VGGT）中跨帧注意力二次复杂度导致的扩展性问题，通过谱分析、探针分析和因果分析发现不同层的冗余模式，提出RegimeVGGT，一种无训练的两轴逐层压缩方法。摘要报告在保持重建质量的同时实现6.7倍加速。
Motivation: VGGT中跨帧注意力的二次复杂度限制了其在多视角3D场景重建中的可扩展性，而现有无训练加速方法沿单一轴均匀压缩，忽视了不同层的异构冗余。
Method: 提出RegimeVGGT，采用U型逐层压缩策略：Saliency-Guided Banded Merging保护几何和边缘显著token，Selectively Protected K/V Downsampling通过相移空间网格、参考帧锚点和未压缩的相机/寄存器token保留跨帧空间覆盖和位姿关键路径。
Result: 摘要报告RegimeVGGT在匹配重建质量下实现6.7倍加速（相对于VGGT*）。
Conclusion: 本文表明通过层特异性分析和两轴压缩可以实现训练无关的Transformer加速，且不牺牲3D重建质量。

papers.title: Sequential Hiring of Contingent Workers Through Learning-Based Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study a sequential workforce management problem in a contingent labor setting with uncertainty in both worker production and labor supply. A firm seeks to maximize cumulative profit by maintaining an active team of fixed size while learning worker productivity over time. We emphasize two critical operational frictions in this problem: replacing workers is costly, and workers may not be available immediately for hiring because of, for example, prior job commitments, scheduling constraints, or onboarding procedures. Thus, hiring decisions take effect only after a random delay. We formulate this problem as a stochastic multi-play bandit with costly switching and delayed actions, and develop a learning-based hiring policy, DR-UCB (DelayedReplacement-UCB), that makes replacement and hiring decisions sequentially through learning cycles. In each cycle, the policy uses real-time production data to determine when to initiate workforce changes and which workers to replace and hire. We show that the leading-order regret of the proposed policy matches its lower bound in its dependence on the time horizon. Our numerical experiments show that DR-UCB outperforms benchmark policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在临时工劳动力市场中，企业面临工人生产率不确定和劳动力供应不确定的序贯管理问题。企业通过维持固定规模的活跃团队来最大化累计利润，同时学习工人生产率。重点考虑替换成本高和雇佣存在随机延迟两个运营摩擦。将该问题建模为带有成本切换和延迟动作的随机多臂赌博机（stochastic multi-play bandit），并提出学习型雇佣策略DR-UCB（DelayedReplacement-UCB）。理论证明该策略的领先阶遗憾在时间依赖上达到下界，数值实验显示其优于基准策略。
Motivation: 临时工管理中工人替换成本高且雇佣决策存在随机延迟（如前任工作承诺、排班约束），现有研究未同时考虑这两点，导致实际决策低效。
Method: 将问题建模为带有成本切换和延迟动作的随机多臂赌博机，提出DR-UCB策略，该策略通过学习周期顺序进行替换和雇佣决策，使用实时生产数据决定何时启动人员变动及替换哪些工人。
Result: 理论证明DR-UCB的领先阶遗憾在时间依赖上匹配下界。数值实验表明其性能优于基准策略。
Conclusion: 该工作为随机延迟和成本切换下的序贯雇佣提供了可证最优的学习策略，适用于临时工场景。

papers.title: Pointwise is Pointless? A Multimodal Ablation Study for Precipitation Nowcasting with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Sparse point observations are increasingly available for precipitation nowcasting, but it is unclear how much they improve dense radar-field forecasts. We partially address this question with a multimodal graph neural network nowcasting system over the Nordic radar domain. The model predicts rain rate every five minutes up to two hours ahead and is trained with different combinations of radar history, MEPS numerical weather prediction, Netatmo surface observations, MSG satellite channels, stochastic noise, and CRPS-based ensemble losses. The study is designed as an ablation of operationally relevant information sources and training objectives. We compare radar-only, NWP-informed, station-informed, satellite-informed, noise-augmented, and CRPS-based configurations using complementary diagnostics on the radar grid, at station locations, for rain onset, and through oracle, displacement, and amplitude scores. The results show that each source improves a different part of the forecast problem. MEPS stabilises radar-only extrapolation, Netatmo observations improve local station and onset diagnostics, and satellite predictors reduce some station-level biases but may activate rain too early when used deterministically. CRPS-based configurations provide the most consistent radar-grid gains, while the combined satellite and CRPS setup gives the best overall oracle/DAS score. These results do not support the conclusion that point observations are uninformative for nowcasting, but they show that local observational skill and spatially coherent radar-field skill are distinct targets. The practical implication is that sparse observations can provide useful local constraints, but their benefit for radar-like fields depends on the training loss, uncertainty representation, and how observation support is encoded in the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏点观测是否提升稠密雷达场临近预报的问题，基于北欧雷达域设计了多模态图神经网络临近预报系统。模型预测未来两小时内每五分钟的雨率，对雷达历史、数值天气预报、地面观测、卫星通道、随机噪声和CRPS损失函数等来源进行了系统性消融实验。结果表明每种信息源改善预报的不同方面：数值天气预报稳定雷达外推，地面观测提升站点诊断，卫星减少站点偏差但可能过早触发降雨，CRPS损失提供最一致的雷达网格增益。
Motivation: 稀疏点观测数据日益可用，但它们在多大程度上能改进基于稠密雷达场的降水临近预报尚不清楚，现有研究缺乏针对操作相关信息的系统性消融分析。
Method: 构建多模态图神经网络临近预报系统，采用不同组合的输入（雷达历史、MEPS数值预报、Netatmo地面观测、MSG卫星通道、随机噪声）和训练目标（CRPS损失的集合变体），在雷达网格、站点位置、降雨起始等维度进行互补诊断评估。
Result: MEPS稳定雷达外推；Netatmo观测改善站点和起始诊断；卫星预测减少站点偏差但可能过早激活降雨；CRPS损失在雷达网格上表现最一致；卫星与CRPS组合在总体oracle/DAS评分上最优。
Conclusion: 不支持点观测无用的结论，但表明局地观测技能与空间连贯的雷达场技能是不同目标。稀疏观测能提供有用局地约束，但对雷达场的效益取决于训练损失、不确定性表示以及观测支持编码方式。

papers.title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: LLM serving exhibits extreme length variability, making size-based scheduling difficult in practice. Recent LLM schedulers approximate SJF/SRPT using predicted decode lengths or ranks and primarily report mean-centric metrics such as TTFT and TBT. We show that these prediction-driven policies can be fragile under distribution shifts, bursty arrivals, and GPU memory pressure, while offering limited control over the tail latency (P90-P99) that dominates user experience, even with perfect decode-length knowledge. We introduce a distribution-aware, prediction-free scheduling framework that replaces explicit length prediction with soft priority boosting driven by lightweight statistical signals. Our design co-optimizes scheduling and cache-aware preemption to account for memory-coupled decode dynamics across workload mixes. Evaluated on production and open-source traces, our method reduces P99 TTLT by up to 35-50% relative to SRPT with perfect length knowledge and reduces TTFT by 34-47% across workloads, including reasoning-heavy and chat-heavy tasks. These results demonstrate a robust alternative for optimizing tail latency in online LLM serving.
papers.journal_ref: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM推理服务中因请求长度极端变化导致的尾延迟控制问题，提出了一种分布感知、无需显式长度预测的调度框架。该框架利用轻量级统计信号进行软优先级提升，并协同优化调度与缓存感知抢占。实验表明，在生产和开源轨迹上，该方法相比具有完美长度知识的SRPT，P99 TTLT降低35-50%，TTFT降低34-47%。
Motivation: 现有基于预测的LLM调度策略（如近似SJF/SRPT）在分布偏移、突发到达和GPU内存压力下表现脆弱，且主要关注均值指标，对用户感知关键的尾延迟（P90-P99）控制不足。
Method: 提出一种无预测的调度框架，通过轻量级统计信号实现软优先级提升，取代显式的解码长度预测；同时联合优化调度与缓存感知抢占，以应对内存耦合的解码动态。
Result: 在生产环境和开源轨迹上，该方法相较于具备完美长度知识的SRPT，P99 TTLT降低35-50%，TTFT降低34-47%，覆盖推理密集和聊天密集等任务。
Conclusion: 该系统为在线LLM服务的尾延迟优化提供了一种鲁棒的替代方案，无需依赖长度预测即可实现显著的延迟改善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Signature filtering: a lightweight enhancement for statistical watermark detection in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Statistical watermarks help organizations attribute large language model (LLM) outputs, yet existing detectors often struggle when watermark signals are weak, texts are repetitive, or watermarks are edited. We propose signature filtering, a detection-time module that enhances watermark detection without modifying watermark embedding and text generation. It learns a small set of ``signature'' tokens whose presence makes watermark tests unreliable, and removes these tokens before detection. The signatures are obtained by solving a mixed-integer linear program on a small training set, with constraints that maximize the true positive rate. We additionally derive finite-sample and asymptotic bounds under several attacker models (color-blind, color-adaptive, and distributionally correlated). On four well-known watermark families (Kgw, Sweet, Unigram, Exp), four benchmark corpora (C4, MBPP, HumanEval, Code-Search-Net), and six LLMs (Opt-1.3b, Opt-6.7b, Llama2-13b, Llama3.1-8b, Qwen2.5-14b, Phi-3-medium-14b), 2- and 3-gram signatures raise detection rates in weak-signal and low-entropy settings from 8~31% without filtering to 78~99% with filtering, while keeping false positives controllable and often negligible. In stress tests where we scramble sentences and perturb 25~50% of tokens by dilution, deletions, and substitutions, 2-gram filters for Kgw-style watermarks preserve most of the clean-text detection gains, often matching or outperforming the advanced WinMax watermark detector. Signature filtering thus provides a simple, scalable, and model-agnostic add-on to strengthen watermark-based provenance checks for LLM text in information processing workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出签名过滤 (signature filtering) 机制，通过检测前移除使水印测试不可靠的签名 token 来增强 LLM 输出水印检测。该方法不修改水印嵌入和文本生成，仅需在少量训练集上求解混合整数线性规划获取签名。在多个水印家族、语料库和 LLM 上的实验表明，弱信号和低熵设置下的检测率从 8-31% 提升至 78-99%，且假阳性可控。
Motivation: 现有统计水印检测器在弱信号、重复文本或编辑水印时性能下降，需要一种轻量级、即插即用的增强模块。
Method: 提出检测时模块 signature filtering，学习一组签名 token（其存在会使水印测试不可靠），在检测前将其移除。签名通过求解混合整数线性规划获得，约束条件最大化真阳性率。
Result: 在 Kgw, Sweet, Unigram, Exp 四种水印、C4/MBPP/HumanEval/Code-Search-Net 四个语料库、六种 LLM 上，2-gram 和 3-gram 签名过滤将弱信号和低熵设置下的检测率从 8-31% 提升至 78-99%，同时保持假阳性可控。在应力测试中（句子打乱、25-50% token 扰动），2-gram 过滤保持大部分检测增益，常优于 WinMax 检测器。
Conclusion: Signature filtering 提供了一种简单、可扩展、模型无关的插件，可增强 LLM 文本水印的可溯源验证。

papers.title: CAOA -- Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Accurately aligning CAD models to their corresponding objects in indoor RGB-D scans is a central challenge in 3D semantic reconstruction. The task requires estimating a 9-Degree-of-Freedom (DoF) pose-position, rotation, and scale along three axes-but is hindered by noisy and incomplete scans, as well as segmentation errors that cause geometric distortions. We present Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment (CAOA), a method that integrates a semantically and contextually aware point cloud completion module with a symmetry-aware relative pose estimation algorithm, enabling precise alignment of CAD models to scanned objects. Existing completion methods are typically trained and evaluated on synthetic datasets, which often fail to generalize to real-world scans. To bridge this gap, we introduce a synthetic data generation strategy tailored to indoor scenes, significantly reducing the synthetic-to-real domain gap-validated through quantitative comparisons with widely used completion datasets. In addition, we release S2C-Completion, an expert-annotated dataset of over 8,500 object-CAD pairs from Scan2CAD, created for real-world indoor single-object completion and intended as a new benchmark for this task. For object-CAD alignment, we incorporate symmetry information via a symmetry-aware loss, improving robustness to symmetric ambiguities. On the Scan2CAD benchmark, CAOA achieves a 17% accuracy improvement over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.journal_ref: Thirteenth International Conference on 3D Vision (3DV), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对室内RGB-D扫描中CAD模型与对象对齐的挑战，提出CAOA方法，融合语义感知点云补全模块与对称感知相对位姿估计。通过引入针对室内场景的合成数据生成策略和专家标注的S2C-Completion数据集，在Scan2CAD基准上相比现有方法提升17%的准确率。
Motivation: 现有CAD模型对齐方法受限于噪声、不完整扫描和分割误差导致的几何畸变，且点云补全方法在真实场景中泛化能力不足。
Method: 提出Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment (CAOA)，集成语义上下文感知的点云补全模块和对称感知相对位姿估计算法，采用针对室内场景的合成数据生成策略降低域差距，并引入对称感知损失处理对称歧义。
Result: 在Scan2CAD基准上，CAOA比现有最优方法提升17%的准确率。
Conclusion: 通过结合点云补全、对称感知和对室内场景的定制化数据生成，CAOA有效提升了实际室内扫描中CAD模型对齐的鲁棒性和精确度。

papers.title: From Specification to Execution: AI Assisted Scientific Workflow Management
papers.abstract_en: Scientific workflow management systems (WMS) support scalable and reproducible execution of complex pipelines, but workflow design, implementation, and debugging remain largely manual and require significant expertise. Recent approaches using large language models (LLMs) show promise for workflow generation from natural language, but often rely on direct code synthesis, which limits transparency, reproducibility, and integration with workflow systems. We present an AI-assisted approach to scientific workflow management that combines specification-driven workflow generation, automated debugging, and distributed execution. The method introduces a structured specification phase that separates workflow intent, design, and implementation, allowing validation prior to code generation. We also develop an LLM-based debugging agent that diagnoses and resolves failures across multiple system layers. To support distributed execution and user interaction, we integrate Pegasus, a widely used WMS, with a Model Context Protocol (MCP) layer, providing a unified interface for workflow submission, monitoring, and control. We evaluate the approach using a federated learning workflow for medical imaging, chosen for its parallel, iterative, and dependency-intensive structure. The system generated and executed large-scale workflows with thousands of jobs, reduced debugging effort, and allowed non-expert users to construct workflows with expert-level design patterns. These results indicate that end-to-end AI-assisted workflow generation and execution is feasible, and point toward AI-driven platforms for managing the scientific workflow lifecycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种AI辅助的科学工作流管理方法，通过规范驱动的工作流生成、基于LLM的调试代理以及与Pegasus WMS和MCP层的集成，实现从自然语言规范到分布式执行的端到端流程。在医疗成像的联邦学习工作流上评估，系统能生成并执行包含数千作业的大规模工作流，减少调试工作量，并支持非专家用户使用专家级设计模式。
Motivation: 科学工作流的设计、实现和调试仍高度依赖人工和领域专长，现有基于LLM的工作流生成方法多依赖直接代码合成，缺乏透明性、可重现性和与工作流系统的集成。
Method: 引入结构化规范阶段，分离工作流意图、设计和实现，在代码生成前进行验证；开发基于LLM的调试代理，跨系统层诊断和解决故障；通过模型上下文协议（MCP）层集成Pegasus WMS，提供统一接口进行工作流提交、监控和控制。
Result: 在医疗成像的联邦学习工作流上，系统成功生成并执行含数千作业的大规模工作流，显著减少调试工作量，并允许非专家用户构建具有专家级设计模式的工作流。
Conclusion: 结果表明端到端AI辅助的工作流生成与执行是可行的，为AI驱动的科学工作流生命周期管理平台指明了方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Variational Framework for LLM Generator-Regulator Games
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a variational framework for regulated language generation. Starting from autoregressive token sampling, we derive the induced distribution over complete messages and relate it to an entropy-regularized Gibbs law. Regulation is modeled as an optimal discriminator whose convex-dual value is an f-divergence, and the generator-regulator interaction is formulated as a saddle-point problem. The framework applies to moderation, censorship, AI deception detection, compliance auditing, phishing defense, and manipulation control, where regulation concerns a distribution over possible messages rather than a single output. The equilibrium clarifies the tradeoff among utility, entropy, regulatory alignment, and finite-length detectability. Two finite-vocabulary case studies, censorship filtering and phishing defense, illustrate how the theory can be evaluated through utility, entropy, divergence, receiver-side scores, and detection probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个变分框架用于受控语言生成，将调节建模为最优判别器，其凸对偶值为f-散度，生成器与调节器的交互被形式化为鞍点问题。该框架适用于审核、审查、AI欺骗检测等场景，明确了效用、熵、调节对齐和有限长度可检测性之间的权衡。两个有限词汇案例研究（审查过滤和网络钓鱼防御）展示了如何通过效用、熵、散度等指标评估理论。
Motivation: 需要一种形式化方法来处理语言生成中的各类调节任务（如内容审核、欺骗检测等），现有方法缺乏统一的理论框架来分析分布层面的调节与生成器之间的交互。
Method: 从自回归token采样出发，推导完整消息上的诱导分布并与熵正则化的Gibbs定律关联；将调节建模为最优判别器，其对偶值是f-散度；生成器-调节器交互被形式化为一个鞍点问题。
Result: 两个有限词汇案例研究（审查过滤和网络钓鱼防御）展示了如何通过效用、熵、散度、接收端分数和检测概率来评估理论框架。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了对受控语言生成中效用、熵、调节对齐和可检测性之间权衡的理论理解，并适用于多种安全相关应用。

papers.title: Measurement noise limits the advantage of nonlinear models over linear models in biomedical prediction
papers.abstract_en: On biomedical tabular data, flexible models such as deep networks, gradient-boosted trees, and kernel methods are repeatedly matched or beaten by linear and logistic regression given the same features. The usual reaction is to treat this as a model-side shortfall, to be fixed with more data, a better architecture, or tuning, on the assumption that the nonlinear structure is there and the model has failed to capture it. We argue that these fixes cannot help when the binding limit is the measurement rather than the model, as it frequently is in biomedicine. Additive noise blurs the population-optimal predictor, and because blurring removes a function's fine, rapidly varying detail before its broad shape, it erases nonlinear structure faster than linear structure. A degree-$k$ interaction is attenuated by the $k$-th power of feature reliability, while the linear part is attenuated only once. At the reliabilities typical of biomedical measurement, the nonlinear advantage can vanish even when the underlying biology is strongly nonlinear, and what the noise removes cannot be recovered by a larger cohort or a more flexible model, only by better measurement. The nonlinearity is hidden, not absent, and a tie between linear and flexible models is not by itself a verdict on the biology. These pieces are classical, drawn from measurement-error statistics, psychometrics, and Gaussian analysis, and we assemble them into an exact excess-risk identity. Measurement reliability is one of three conditions, alongside sample size and feature representation, that must align for a flexible model to help, and together they leave only a narrow window that most biomedical tasks fall outside. Across 140 UK Biobank tasks, the gap between flexible and linear models, where it exists, carries the predicted noise signature, and the three conditions can be separated by intervention but not by a benchmark alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证在生物医学表格数据中，测量噪声会优先抹去非线性结构，导致非线性模型（如深度网络）与线性模型表现持平。作者推导了精确的 excess-risk 恒等式，并在 UK Biobank 任务上验证了预测的噪声特征。
Motivation: 生物医学预测中非线性模型常被线性模型击败，通常被归因于模型缺陷；本文指出根本限制可能来自测量噪声而非模型容量。
Method: 基于测量误差统计、心理测量学和高斯分析，推导出精确的 excess-risk 恒等式，并分析测量可靠性、样本量和特征表示三个条件的必要性。
Result: 在140个UK Biobank任务上，非线性与线性模型之间的差距携带预测的噪声特征，且三个条件可以通过干预分离。
Conclusion: 测量噪声是限制非线性优势的关键因素，改善测量比增加数据或模型复杂度更有效。

summary_sections.motivation: 生物医学预测中非线性模型常被线性模型击败，通常被归因于模型缺陷；本文指出根本限制可能来自测量噪声而非模型容量。
summary_sections.method: 基于测量误差统计、心理测量学和高斯分析，推导出精确的 excess-risk 恒等式，并分析测量可靠性、样本量和特征表示三个条件的必要性。
summary_sections.result: 在140个UK Biobank任务上，非线性与线性模型之间的差距携带预测的噪声特征，且三个条件可以通过干预分离。
summary_sections.conclusion: 测量噪声是限制非线性优势的关键因素，改善测量比增加数据或模型复杂度更有效。

papers.title: P$^2$CE: Model-Agnostic Plausible Pareto-Optimal Counterfactual Explanations
papers.abstract_en: The increasing use of machine learning algorithms in social applications has raised concerns about fairness and transparency, leading to the development of counterfactual explanations. These explanations supports individuals to understand and potentially alter unfavorable decisions in areas such as loan applications, job selections, and more, by providing actionable changes to input features that would lead to a desired outcome. Existing methods often struggle to balance feasibility, plausibility, and computational efficiency. To address this, we introduce P$^2$CE, an algorithm for generating plausible Pareto-optimal counterfactual explanations, offering users a diverse set of optimal trade-offs between different notions of feasibility. P$^2$CE employs an auxiliary isolation forest outlier detector to ensure that explanations are in accordance with the data distribution and leverages SHAP values to obtain optimal results with short computing times, regardless of the underlying model. Our algorithm was empirically evaluated on three datasets, demonstrating superior performance in terms of both solution quality and computational efficiency compared to related techniques.
papers.comment: Under review in the Machine Learning journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P$^2$CE，一种模型无关的反事实解释算法，通过帕累托最优权衡不同可行性指标，使用隔离森林检测异常值保证解释的合理性，并利用SHAP值加速计算。在三个数据集上证明优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有反事实解释方法难以同时兼顾可行性、合理性和计算效率，需要一种能提供多样化最优权衡的通用方法。
Method: 提出P$^2$CE算法，结合隔离森林异常检测器确保解释符合数据分布，并利用SHAP值实现模型无关的快速优化，生成帕累托最优的反事实解释集。
Result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，P$^2$CE在解质量和计算效率上均优于相关基准方法。
Conclusion: P$^2$CE能有效生成既合理又多样化的反事实解释，且因模型无关和高效计算而具有实用价值。

papers.title: Searching for Synergy in Shared Workspace Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Automated AI agents are increasingly capable, yet many scientific and professional tasks require human judgment and contextual expertise. We study shared-workspace human-AI teams, where AI agents and human collaborators must coordinate responsibilities before submitting a final answer. Using the Collaborative Gym environment with DiscoveryBench tasks, we examine when adding simulated human collaborators improves performance and when process loss turns additional collaborators into coordination overhead. Across 1,482 sessions, adding relevant collaborators can lower performance when teams lack structure to coordinate their contributions. We then evaluate scaffolding that combines shared group memory with simulated human-in-the-loop (HITL) gates, where selected actions require approval from a designated simulated participant. This scaffolding yields higher mean performance, most clearly in three-person teams, with clearer responsibility signals and stronger routing of expertise to team actions. Overall, how human-AI teams coordinate and integrate expertise matters as much as the capability available to them.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Co-Creativity. 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Collaborative Gym环境中研究共享工作空间的人机协作，使用DiscoveryBench任务模拟人类与AI代理的协作。通过1482次会话发现，当团队缺乏协调结构时，增加协作者反而可能降低性能。提出结合共享组记忆与模拟人类参与门（HITL gates）的脚手架方法，在三方团队中显著提升平均性能，表明协调与专业整合比单纯的能力更重要。
Motivation: 尽管AI代理越来越强大，但许多科学和专业任务仍需人类判断与上下文专业知识，现有研究对人机如何有效协调及整合专业知识缺乏深入理解。
Method: 使用Collaborative Gym环境中的DiscoveryBench任务，构建共享工作空间人机团队；提出结合共享组记忆与模拟人类参与门（HITL gates）的脚手架方法，要求选定动作需经指定模拟参与者批准。
Result: 在1482次会话中，无结构团队增加协作者反而降低性能；采用脚手架方法后，三方团队获得更高平均性能，责任信号更清晰，专业路由更强。
Conclusion: 人机团队的协调与专业整合方式至少与可用能力同等重要，合理的设计（如HITL门控）可显著提升协作效果。

papers.title: Bayesian Nonparametric Detection of Anomalies in Multivariate Functional Data
papers.abstract_en: Anomalies in functional data arise from rare or distinct processes that deviate from the dominant data-generating mechanism. Detecting such departures is essential in applications where they may correspond to errors, structural changes, or other behavior of interest. This work introduces a Bayesian nonparametric approach for anomaly detection in multivariate functional data. We model functional data as an infinite mixture of multi-output Gaussian processes, with a finite and automatically determined number of mixture components obtained through slice sampling. Mean functions are represented using a wavelet basis and regularized through Besov priors to obtain a smooth and sparse representation of the data. Cross-functional dependence is captured using the intrinsic coregionalization model and we solve covariance kernel selection by introducing a Carlin-Chib product space step in the Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm. Within this model, anomalous observations are assigned to small mixture components without requiring prior specification of the number or nature of anomalies. We consider a semi-supervised setting, in which labels are available for 15% of the normal observations and a large class imbalance is present. The utility of our model is demonstrated on both univariate and multivariate functional data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯非参数方法用于多元函数型数据中的异常检测。模型将函数数据视为无限混合的多输出高斯过程，通过切片采样自动确定混合成分数量；均值函数用小波基表示并通过Besov先验正则化得到平滑稀疏表示，利用内在区域化模型捕捉跨函数依赖，并在MCMC中引入Carlin-Chib乘积空间步骤解决协方差核选择。异常观测被分配到小的混合成分中，无需预先指定异常数量或性质。在半监督设置下（15%的正常观测有标签，类别不平衡严重），在单变量和多元函数型数据上验证了模型有效性。
Motivation: 函数型数据中的异常来源于罕见或不同的过程，偏离主导数据生成机制。检测此类偏离在误差识别、结构变化等应用中至关重要，但现有方法通常需要预先指定异常数量或类型，缺乏灵活性。
Method: 采用贝叶斯非参数框架，将函数数据建模为无限混合的高斯过程（多输出），通过切片采样自动确定有限且自动选择的混合成分数；均值函数用小波基表示并施加Besov先验以实现光滑稀疏表示；通过内在区域化模型捕获跨函数依赖；通过Carlin-Chib乘积空间步骤在MCMC中完成协方差核选择。异常被自动分配至小混合成分。
Result: 摘要报告在单变量和多元函数型数据上的实验验证了模型效用，但未给出具体数值或对比基线。
Conclusion: 该方法无需预先指定异常的数量或性质，适用于半监督且类别严重不平衡的情形，但摘要未讨论局限性或扩展工作。

papers.title: Deep-Learning-Based Pixelated Microwave Filter Design and Characterization using Electro-Optical Electric-Field Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Traditional microwave filter design typically relies on iterative parameter tuning and predefined topologies, which limits design space and increases development time. This study uses a deep learning approach combining convolutional neural networks with genetic algorithms to automate pixelated microwave filter synthesis. To validate the approach experimentally, both S-parameter and spatial electric-field measurements were analyzed. The synthesized low-pass filter demonstrated excellent agreement between simulated and measured performance, achieving a 7 GHz passband with over 20 dB suppression beyond 9.5 GHz. Electro-optical measurements, for the first time, revealed electric field patterns that resemble coupled transmission-lines or stub structures, providing insight into the emergent characteristics of AI-generated designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合卷积神经网络与遗传算法的深度学习方法，用于自动设计像素化微波低通滤波器。实验通过S参数和电光电场测量验证了设计，结果显示在7 GHz通带内性能良好，9.5 GHz以上抑制超过20 dB。电光测量首次揭示了AI生成滤波器中的耦合传输线或短截线结构电场模式。
Motivation: 传统微波滤波器设计依赖迭代参数调整和预定拓扑，限制了设计空间并延长开发周期。
Method: 采用卷积神经网络与遗传算法结合的深度学习方法，实现像素化微波滤波器合成，并通过S参数和空间电场测量进行实验验证。
Result: 合成的低通滤波器在7 GHz通带内模拟与实测一致，9.5 GHz以上抑制超过20 dB。电光测量首次揭示了类似耦合传输线或短截线结构的电场模式。
Conclusion: 研究表明，深度学习可自动化微波滤波器设计并产生非直觉的拓扑结构，电光测量为理解AI生成设计的涌现特性提供了新手段。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Driven Inverse Design of Doherty Power Amplifiers Using Pixelated Combiners and Dual-State Impedance Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: The output combiner of a Doherty power amplifier (PA) integrates load modulation, impedance matching, and phase compensation within a single network, making its design and synthesis highly challenging. In this paper, we propose a three-port Doherty combiner design methodology that combines deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), pixelated layout representations, and genetic algorithms (GA) with dual-state impedance synthesis to address both peak and back-off power conditions. As a proof of concept, two GaN HEMT Doherty PA prototypes incorporating three-port pixelated combiners are designed and fabricated. Both prototypes achieve a measured saturated output power exceeding 44.2 dBm with peak drain efficiency above 71.2% within 2.6-2.8 GHz. Furthermore, a drain efficiency as high as 64% is measured at the 6-dB back-off level. After applying digital predistortion, each prototype achieves an adjacent channel leakage ratio (ACLR) better than -51.3 dBc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合深度卷积神经网络（CNN）、像素化布局表示和遗传算法（GA）的三端口Doherty合路器反演设计方法，用于同时满足峰值和回退功率条件。两个GaN HEMT原型在2.6-2.8 GHz实现饱和输出功率>44.2 dBm，峰值漏极效率>71.2%，6-dB回退效率64%，经数字预失真后ACLR<-51.3 dBc。
Motivation: 现有Doherty功率放大器输出合路器集成了负载调制、阻抗匹配和相位补偿，设计合成极具挑战。
Method: 提出结合深度卷积神经网络（CNN）、像素化布局表示和遗传算法（GA）以及双状态阻抗合成的三端口合路器设计方法。
Result: 两个GaN HEMT原型在2.6-2.8 GHz实现饱和输出功率>44.2 dBm，峰值漏极效率>71.2%，6-dB回退效率64%，经数字预失真后ACLR<-51.3 dBc。
Conclusion: 该反演设计方法有效实现高性能Doherty PA合路器，验证了深度学习驱动的设计思路。

papers.title: Learning-Based Decision Making for Combustion Phasing Control in Multi-Fuel CI Engines with Latent Fuel Reactivity Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-fuel compression-ignition engines offer fuel flexibility but introduce uncertain, time-varying fuel reactivity, represented by cetane number (CN), which complicates cycle-to-cycle combustion-phasing control. This work formulates CA50 regulation under latent CN variation as a partially observable sequential decision problem and systematically evaluates controllers with increasing temporal and representational capacity, including LinUCB, history-augmented contextual bandits, observation-only DDPG, recurrent DDPG, and a proposed GRU-guided RL framework. A Gaussian-process surrogate trained on experimental multi-fuel engine data provides a controlled and reproducible evaluation environment. Results show that myopic and fixed-history bandit methods degrade under CN variation, observation-only RL suffers from latent-state aliasing, and generic recurrence is insufficient when CN evolves rapidly. The proposed framework learns a compact GRU-based representation of fuel reactivity from combustion history and conditions both actor and critic on this estimated signal rather than oracle CN. By training the policy on the same imperfect fuel-reactivity information available at deployment, the controller avoids train-deploy inconsistency in conventional online estimate-then-control pipelines. Across unseen CN trajectories, the policy achieves stable CA50 regulation with mean absolute tracking error below 0.25° CA at the training setpoint, while producing smooth, physically consistent SOI and glow-plug-power actuation. These results show that combustion control under latent, continuously evolving fuel dynamics requires more than standalone estimation or generic recurrence. By aligning fuel-reactivity inference with control policy learning, the proposed framework enables reactivity-aware decision-making using the same estimated state available during deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多燃料压燃发动机中燃料反应性（十六烷值）未知且时变的问题，将燃烧相位CA50控制建模为部分可观测的序贯决策问题，并系统评估了多种控制器。提出的GRU引导强化学习框架从燃烧历史中学习燃料反应性的紧凑表示，并在训练和部署中使用同一估计信号，避免了传统估计-控制管线的不一致性。在基于实验数据训练的GP代理环境下，该方法在未见过的CN轨迹上实现了均绝对跟踪误差低于0.25° CA的稳定控制。
Motivation: 多燃料压燃发动机的燃料灵活性引入不确定且时变的燃料反应性，使得循环间的燃烧相位控制变得困难。现有方法（如固定历史上下文bandit、观测值纯RL）在CN变化下表现退化，而单独的估计器与控制器串联存在训练-部署不一致问题。
Method: 提出GRU引导的强化学习框架：利用GRU从燃烧历史中估计燃料反应性（而非使用oracle CN），并将该估计信号同时输入actor和critic。训练时策略基于与部署时相同的非完美燃料反应性信息。评估环境使用基于实验数据训练的GP代理模型。
Result: 在未见过的CN轨迹上，该方法在训练设定点处实现了均绝对跟踪误差低于0.25° CA的稳定CA50调节，并产生平滑、物理一致的SOI和电热塞功率控制信号。对比实验表明，myopic bandit、固定历史bandit、观测值纯DDPG以及普通循环网络在CN快速变化时均表现不佳。
Conclusion: 本文表明，在潜在且连续演变的燃料动态下进行燃烧控制，需要将燃料反应性推断与控制策略学习对齐，而非单独的估计或通用循环网络。所提框架通过使用与部署时相同的估计状态实现反应性感知决策。

papers.title: MOLAR: Learning Multimodal Molecular Representations from Noisy Labels
papers.abstract_en: Motivation: Noisy labels are a common challenge in molecular property prediction because molecular annotations are often obtained from assays, curated databases, or weak annotation pipelines rather than directly observed clean biological states. Treating recorded labels as reliable supervision can cause models to memorize corrupted observations and learn misleading molecular evidence. In multimodal molecular representation learning, this issue can be amplified by graph-text fusion or alignment, which may propagate label-induced errors across modalities. Results: We propose MOLAR, a noise-aware framework for learning multimodal molecular representations from noisy labels. MOLAR separates latent clean-property inference from recorded-label observation: graph and text views contribute residual evidence to a clean-property distribution, and a categorical label-observation channel maps this distribution to recorded labels for training. This formulation derives posterior label reliability and modality-specific molecular evidence from the model. Experiments on naturally noisy molecular benchmarks and controlled label-flipping benchmarks show that MOLAR consistently outperforms representative baselines. Visualization analyses further show that MOLAR provides interpretable reliability and modality-evidence diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOLAR，一个噪声感知的多模态分子表征学习框架，旨在解决分子性质预测中的标签噪声问题。MOLAR通过分离潜在干净属性推理与记录标签观测，利用图和文本视图提供残差证据，并通过分类标签观测通道进行训练。在自然噪声和可控标签翻转基准上，MOLAR一致优于现有基线，并提供可解释的可靠性和模态证据诊断。
Motivation: 分子注释通常来自实验、数据库或弱标注流程，存在标签噪声，且多模态融合可能加剧错误传播。现有方法将记录标签视为可靠监督，导致模型记忆错误并学习误导性的分子证据。
Method: MOLAR框架将潜在干净属性分布与记录标签观测分离：图与文本模态提供残差证据来推断干净属性分布，再通过分类标签观测通道将该分布映射到记录标签进行训练。
Result: 在自然噪声分子基准和可控标签翻转基准上，MOLAR一致优于代表性基线方法。可视化分析显示MOLAR能提供可解释的标签可靠性及模态证据诊断。
Conclusion: MOLAR通过分离干净属性与噪声观测，有效处理多模态分子表征学习中的标签噪声，并提供了诊断机制。

papers.title: LLMZero: Discovering Adaptive Training Strategies for RL Post-Training via LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: RL post-training strategies are dataset-dependent and reveal a recurring empirical pattern: capacity parameters accumulate monotonically across stages, while regularization parameters predominantly oscillate in response to shifting training dynamics. This distinction matters because fixed schedules commit all parameters to fixed trajectories and therefore cannot express the non-stationary exploration-exploitation tradeoffs that regularization must track; the principle provides actionable design rules for multi-stage training. We discover this through LLMZero, a system where LLM agents search over training trajectories via tree search, diagnosing pathologies at each checkpoint and proposing coordinated multi-parameter transitions. Across 4 diverse GRPO tasks, LLMZero discovers strategies that improve over the base model by 9% to 140% relative and over grid search by 6% to 15% relative, consistently outperforming random search and the skill-based agent. The structural principle transfers across tasks, providing an explanation for why discovered strategies take qualitatively different forms yet share similar parameter dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLMZero系统，使用LLM agent通过树搜索在RL后训练中发现自适应训练策略。摘要发现容量参数单调累积，正则化参数振荡的结构性原理。在4个GRPO任务上，发现策略相对基础模型提升9%-140%，超过网格搜索6%-15%。
Motivation: RL后训练策略依赖于数据集，固定调度无法表达非平稳的探索-利用权衡，需要自适应方法。
Method: 利用LLM agent通过树搜索在训练轨迹中搜索，诊断每个检查点的病理并提出协调的多参数转换。
Result: 在4个GRPO任务上，提升9%-140%相对基础模型，6%-15%相对网格搜索，一致性优于随机搜索和基于技能的agent。
Conclusion: 发现容量参数单调累积、正则化参数振荡的结构性原理，该原理跨任务迁移，解释不同策略为何形式不同但参数动态相似。

papers.title: CaVe-VLM-CoT: An Interpretable Vision-Language Model Framework
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain prone to hallucinations, producing fluent but visually unfaithful outputs. Existing chain-of-thought and retrieval-augmented methods only partially address this, as they neither enforce step-level citation grounding nor route verification failures back to retrieval for correction. We present CaVe-VLM-CoT, a modular reflection-based agentic-RAG framework that enforces evidence-grounded reasoning through a five-stage closed-loop pipeline: Extractor, Retriever, Solver, Citation Injector, and Verifier, in which detected ungrounded claims trigger structured feedback to the Extractor for targeted re-retrieval. Since no existing framework jointly measures retrieval quality, step-wise citation faithfulness, and cross-modal grounding, we propose a suite of 23 component-wise metrics across all stages, anchored by CaVeScore, a composite metric weighting accuracy, citation precision and recall, attribution, and evidence grounding. Without any architectural or prompt modifications, CaVe-VLM-CoT achieves 87.1\% accuracy and 56.6\% CaVeScore on ScienceQA , and 55.2\% accuracy and 35.7\% CaVeScore on MMMU (30 subjects).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CaVe-VLM-CoT，一个基于反思的智能体 RAG 框架，通过五阶段闭环管道（提取器、检索器、求解器、引用注入器、验证器）强制视觉语言模型生成带有证据引用的推理链，并对未对齐的声明触发重检索。该框架无需修改架构或提示，在 ScienceQA 上达到 87.1% 准确率和 56.6% CaVeScore，在 MMMU 上达到 55.2% 准确率和 35.7% CaVeScore。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型容易产生幻觉，输出流畅但视觉上不忠实；链式思维和检索增强方法未能强制步骤级引用，且无法将验证失败路由回检索进行修正。
Method: 提出模块化的五阶段闭环管道：Extractor 解析问题、Retriever 检索证据、Solver 生成推理步骤、Citation Injector 注入引用、Verifier 检测未对齐声明并触发重检索。同时定义 23 个组件级指标，包括复合指标 CaVeScore。
Result: 在 ScienceQA 上准确率 87.1%、CaVeScore 56.6%；在 MMMU（30 个学科）上准确率 55.2%、CaVeScore 35.7%。
Conclusion: 该框架通过闭环验证与重检索有效减少幻觉，并提供了细粒度的评估指标来量化推理忠实度。

papers.title: SCOPE-FL: A Strategy-proof Chain-based Optimal pareto efficient Federated Learning System
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Federated Learning (HFL) enables scalable collaborative model training across distributed devices while preserving data privacy. However, existing HFL client selection mechanisms suffer from a fundamental strategic inefficiency. By prioritizing stability over Pareto efficiency (PE), they produce suboptimal resource allocations, and without strategy proofness (SP), participants are incentivized to misrepresent their true preferences, both failures degrading system overall welfare in the Pareto sense in practice. To address it, we propose SCOPE-FL (Strategy-proof Chain-based Optimal pareto efficient Federated Learning), a synchronous HFL framework that formulates client selection as a two-sided school choice problem solved through the Top Trading Cycle (TTC) algorithm that simultaneously guarantees PE and SP. For reward distribution, SCOPE-FL employs a scalable Shapley value approximation based on One-Round Reconstruction (OR), ensuring compensation proportional to each client's contribution. The entire mechanism executes via blockchain smart contracts, providing the tamper-proof environment required for the SP guarantees to hold in practice. A comprehensive evaluation on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 demonstrates that SCOPE-FL outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, including DA, IAS, and other methods across model accuracy, convergence rate, and reward efficiency, while achieving communication latency comparable to DA and blockchain overhead significantly lower than DA at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE-FL，一种基于链的防策略性最优帕累托高效联邦学习系统。它通过将客户端选择建模为双边学校选择问题，并采用顶交易循环（TTC）算法同时保证帕累托效率（PE）和防策略性（SP）。奖励分配使用基于单轮重建（OR）的可扩展沙普利值近似。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上的评估表明，SCOPE-FL在模型精度、收敛速度和奖励效率方面优于现有方法，且通信延迟与DA相当，区块链开销显著低于DA。
Motivation: 现有分层联邦学习（HFL）客户端选择机制存在根本性战略低效：优先考虑稳定性而非帕累托效率导致次优资源分配，且缺乏防策略性（SP），参与者有动机虚报真实偏好，从而在帕累托意义上降低系统整体福利。
Method: 提出SCOPE-FL框架，将客户端选择形式化为双边学校选择问题，通过顶交易循环（TTC）算法求解，同时保证帕累托效率和防策略性；奖励分配采用基于单轮重建（OR）的可扩展沙普利值近似；整个机制通过区块链智能合约执行，提供防篡改环境以保障SP。
Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上的综合评估表明，SCOPE-FL在模型精度、收敛速度和奖励效率方面优于DA、IAS等最先进方法，同时达到与DA相当的通信延迟，并在大规模场景下区块链开销显著低于DA。
Conclusion: SCOPE-FL通过结合TTC算法和区块链智能合约，在联邦学习中同时实现了帕累托效率和防策略性，有效提升了系统整体福利和实际可行性。

papers.title: From Sparse Features to Trustworthy Proxies: Certifying SAE-Based Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used to extract interpretable features from language models (LMs), yet a central question remains: when can an SAE-based explanation be treated as a faithful view of an underlying frozen LM We study this through a post-hoc generalization framework that certifies the LM via a sparse proxy, obtained by replacing a native hidden activation with its pretrained SAE reconstruction. Our framework derives an upper bound on the base model's expected risk using four measurable quantities: proxy risk, SAE reconstruction gap, concept-pool mismatch, and sparse complexity. We interpret this certificate as an operational criterion for explanatory faithfulness. In particular, a non-vacuous bound indicates that the extracted sparse features retain meaningful predictive information, while small reconstruction and mismatch errors indicate that the proxy remains behaviorally close to the original model. Empirically, we show that the bound becomes non-vacuous on GPT-2 Small, Gemma-2B, and Llama-3-8B at practical sample sizes. A detailed layerwise analysis of Llama-3-8B reveals a strong depth dependence, with later layers becoming much easier to certify, associated with both stronger local fidelity and weaker downstream error amplification. Finally, through feature-shuffling ablations, we show that the decomposition distinguishes genuine semantic alignment from mere statistical sparsity, providing a useful diagnostic for when SAE-based explanations become less reliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）用于语言模型解释的可靠性，提出一个后验泛化框架，通过四个可测量量（代理风险、SAE重构差距、概念池不匹配、稀疏复杂度）导出基模型期望风险的上界，作为解释忠实性的操作准则。实验表明，在GPT-2 Small、Gemma-2B和Llama-3-8B上，该界在实用样本量下非平凡，且Llama-3-8B的逐层分析显示深层更易认证、局部保真度更强且下游误差放大更弱。特征打乱消融实验表明该分解能区分真正语义对齐与仅统计稀疏性。
Motivation: SAE被广泛用于从语言模型中提取可解释特征，但缺乏严格标准判断基于SAE的解释何时能忠实反映底层冻结模型，该文旨在通过理论框架量化这种可靠性。
Method: 提出一个后验泛化框架，通过替换原生隐藏激活为SAE重构得到稀疏代理，并推导基模型期望风险的上界，该上界由代理风险、SAE重构差距、概念池不匹配和稀疏复杂度四个可测量量组成。
Result: 在GPT-2 Small、Gemma-2B和Llama-3-8B上，该界在实用样本量下非平凡；Llama-3-8B的逐层分析显示深层更易认证；特征打乱消融实验表明该分解能区分语义对齐与统计稀疏性。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了SAE解释忠实性的操作准则，非平凡界表明稀疏特征保留有意义预测信息，小重构误差和匹配误差表明代理行为接近原模型，但解释在深层更可靠，且可诊断何时SAE解释不可靠。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RankGraph-2: Lifecycle Co-Design for Billion-Node Graph Learning in Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval at billion-node scale requires jointly solving three tightly coupled problems -- graph construction, representation learning, and real-time serving -- yet existing work addresses each in isolation. We present RankGraph-2, a framework deployed at Meta that co-designs all three lifecycle stages for similarity-based retrieval (U2U2I and U2I2I), where each stage's requirements shape the others. Serving requires a co-learned cluster index to avoid expensive online KNN -- this pushes index co-training into the training objective. Training benefits from the observation that similarity-based retrieval tolerates pre-computed neighborhoods, eliminating online graph infrastructure -- this requires construction to produce self-contained data. Construction must also support hour-level refresh for item coverage. Acting on these cascading requirements, RankGraph-2 reduces hundreds of trillions of edges to hundreds of billions via subsampling with popularity bias correction, pre-computes multi-hop neighborhoods via personalized PageRank, and co-learns a residual-quantization cluster index that reduces serving computational cost by 83%. This lifecycle co-design enables a simple architecture to achieve 3.8 x higher recall than a GAT + Deep Graph Infomax model on a bipartite graph and 2.1 x higher than PyTorch-BigGraph on item retrieval. RankGraph-2 delivers up to +0.96% CTR and +2.75% CVR, and has powered 20+ retrieval launches across major surfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RankGraph-2框架，部署于Meta，用于十亿节点规模的图学习推荐系统。该框架协同设计图构建、表示学习和实时服务三个生命周期阶段，通过流行度偏差校正的子采样减少边数量，预计算个性化PageRank多跳邻域，并联合学习残差量化聚类索引避免在线KNN搜索。实验表明，计算成本降低83%，召回率比GAT+Deep Graph Infomap提升3.8倍，业务指标CTR提升+0.96%，CVR提升+2.75%。
Motivation: 现有工作孤立地处理图构建、表示学习和实时服务，忽略了三者之间的耦合关系，导致十亿节点规模下的相似性检索效率低下，难以满足实际部署需求。
Method: 提出生命周期协同设计，具体包括：使用流行度偏差校正的子采样将边从数百兆亿减少至百亿；通过个性化PageRank预计算多跳邻域；联合训练残差量化聚类索引，避免在线KNN搜索，从而降低83%的推理计算成本。
Result: 在二分图上召回率比GAT+Deep Graph Infomap高3.8倍，在物品检索上比PyTorch-BigGraph高2.1倍；在线CTR提升+0.96%，CVR提升+2.75%。
Conclusion: 生命周期协同设计使简单架构即可达到优异性能，已在Meta多个主要表面部署20+检索任务，证明了其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Redact or Keep? A Fully Local AI Cascade for Educational Dialogue De-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Educational dialogue is a valuable but sensitive resource for research: the same transcripts that capture authentic learning often capture personally identifiable information (PII) entangled with curricular content, where "Riemann" may refer to a real student or to a mathematical concept. Existing approaches force a tradeoff between governance and accuracy. Commercial Large Language Models (LLMs) can handle this ambiguity but require sending student data to third parties, while local named entity recognition (NER) systems preserve governance but over-redact curricular terms. We propose a fully local cascade framework that reframes de-identification from open-ended entity recognition to constrained privacy triage. A recall-first union proposer combines two lightweight encoders with deterministic rules to over-generate candidate spans; a context-aware reviewer then makes a binary Redact/Keep decision for each candidate using surrounding dialogue and speaker role. We evaluate three reviewer configurations against same-family LLM-only baselines and a commercial API on math tutoring transcripts from two large platforms. The strongest local configuration reaches 0.958 macro F1, compared with 0.767 for a same-family LLM-only baseline and 0.706 for the commercial API, while running entirely on a single laptop. On a targeted challenge set of curricular-personal name ambiguity, the same configuration degrades by only 0.03 F1 versus 0.19 to 0.25 for smaller reviewers. These results suggest that for educational de-identification, problem formulation matters more than model scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个完全本地的级联框架，将教育对话去标识从开放实体识别重新定义为受限隐私分类。该框架由召回优先的联合提议器（结合两个轻量编码器和确定性规则）生成候选跨度，再由上下文感知的评审者做出二元删除/保留决策。在数学辅导对话数据集上，最强本地配置达到0.958 macro F1，优于同族LLM基线（0.767）和商业API（0.706），且完全在单台笔记本电脑上运行。在课程-人名歧义挑战集上，该配置仅下降0.03 F1，而小型评审者下降0.19-0.25。
Motivation: 教育对话转录本包含与课程内容纠缠的个人可识别信息（PII），现有方法在治理（数据不出校园）与准确性之间被迫权衡：商业LLM需发送数据到第三方，本地NER系统则过度编辑课程术语。
Method: 提出一个完全本地的级联框架，将去标识重新定义为受限隐私分类。首先使用召回优先的联合提议器（两个轻量编码器与确定性规则）生成候选跨度，然后由上下文感知的评审者根据周围对话和说话者角色对每个候选做出二元删除/保留决策。
Result: 最强本地配置达到0.958 macro F1，同族LLM基线为0.767，商业API为0.706。在课程-人名歧义挑战集上，该配置仅下降0.03 F1，而小型评审者下降0.19-0.25。
Conclusion: 对于教育去标识，问题公式化比模型规模更重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Time Series Foundation Model Benchmarks Hide Regime-Dependent Failures? Evidence from Traffic Speed Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Standard benchmarks evaluate time series foundation models (TSFMs) using aggregate metrics, but these can mask severe failures in critical operating regimes. We introduce regime-stratified evaluation and apply it to three TSFMs on two standard traffic speed benchmarks. Traffic exhibits abrupt regime switching between free-flow and congested states, producing bimodal speed distributions during transitions. When we stratify by traffic regime, both accuracy and prediction-interval coverage degrade sharply during transitions: transition-regime MAE reaches 11 mph (versus 3 mph overall), and empirical coverage of 90% prediction intervals drops as low as 55%. These failures are invisible in aggregate metrics because free-flow observations dominate the sample. A simple historical conditional baseline (sampling from per-sensor training distributions) achieves better transition coverage than any TSFM, but has far worse overall accuracy. We propose bimodal mixture augmentation (BMA), a post-hoc method that combines TSFM forecasts with historical distributional knowledge, approaching the historical baseline's transition coverage while preserving the TSFM's accuracy. Our results suggest that TSFM benchmarks should incorporate regime-aware evaluation to surface failures that aggregate metrics hide.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出标准时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）基准测试使用聚合指标可能掩盖关键运行区间中的严重失败。引入基于交通状态分层的评估，在三个TSFM上对两个标准交通速度基准进行测试，发现过渡区间（transition regime）的MAE达到11 mph（总体3 mph），90%预测区间的经验覆盖率低至55%。提出双模态混合增强（BMA）后处理方法，结合TSFM预测与历史分布知识，在保持TSFM准确性的同时接近历史基准的过渡覆盖率。建议基准测试应纳入状态感知评估。
Motivation: 标准时间序列基础模型基准测试使用聚合指标，无法揭示在关键运行区间（如交通状态转换期）的严重失败，导致对这些模型实际部署中的风险估计不足。
Method: 提出状态分层评估方法，将预测区间分为自由流、拥堵和过渡状态分别评测。并提出了双模态混合增强（BMA），一种后处理方法，将TSFM的预测与按传感器训练分布采样的历史条件基线结合。
Result: 在交通速度预测中，过渡区间的MAE达到11 mph（总体3 mph），90%预测区间覆盖率低至55%。简单历史条件基线在过渡覆盖率上优于所有TSFM，但总体准确性差很多。BMA方法接近历史基线的过渡覆盖率，同时保持TSFM的准确性。
Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型基准测试应纳入状态感知评估，以揭示聚合指标隐藏的失败。BMA是一种有效的后处理缓解方法。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guava，一个用于具身操作的工具使用框架，通过系统探索工作流、动作空间和观察空间的设计空间，识别出三个关键要素：迭代感知-推理-行动循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观察。他们还开发了一个端到端训练流程，将具身操作能力蒸馏到4B开源模型中，仅用不到2000条模拟轨迹，在模拟和真实环境中表现与前沿专有模型相当。
Motivation: 语言模型在具身代理方面有潜力，但尚未清楚什么构成高效的操作工具使用 harness，以及这种 harness 能在多大程度上解锁各种推理模型的具身能力。
Method: 提出 Guava 框架，通过系统探索设计空间，包括迭代感知-推理-行动循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观察。并开发了端到端蒸馏训练流程，将能力蒸馏到4B模型。
Result: 在模拟和真实环境中，Guava 的性能与前沿专有模型相当，展现出对未见物体、新颖指令和长时任务的强大泛化能力。
Conclusion: 设计良好的 harness 可以成为可扩展的、模型无关的具身操作接口，使得紧凑的开源模型用极少训练数据即可获得强大的涌现能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeClawBench: Separating Semantic, Audit-Evidence, and Sandbox Harm in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents introduce security failures that go beyond unsafe text: they can disclose protected objects, write persistent memory, send messages, modify databases, or trigger harmful code and tool effects. Existing evaluations often collapse these stages into a single attack success rate, making it difficult to tell whether a model merely agreed with an attacker or actually produced observable harm. We introduce SafeClawBench, a staged benchmark for tool-using agent security with 600 controlled adversarial tasks across six attack families: direct and indirect prompt injection, tool-return injection, memory poisoning, memory extraction, and ambiguity-driven unsafe inference. SafeClawBench reports three separate endpoints: semantic attack acceptance, audit-visible harm evidence, and sandbox-observed tool/state harm. Evaluating five agent endpoints under four prompt-level policies, we find that these endpoints capture different failure modes. Without additional prompt protection, semantic failure rates vary widely across models, from 9.0% to 44.2%. Audited harm evidence is narrower than semantic failure, and under a separate executable protocol some matched task identities produce sandbox harm despite passing the Semantic Core call: in a 12,000-row matched analysis, 291 of 347 observed sandbox harms occur in rows that pass the semantic check. Prompt policies change endpoint outcomes, but their effects depend on both model and protocol. SafeClawBench provides a reproducible framework for comparing agent models and prompt-policy conditions without conflating textual compliance, evidence-supported harm, and executable state changes. The open-source dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sairights/safeclawbench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeClawBench是一个用于工具使用语言模型代理安全性的分阶段基准测试，包含600个对抗性任务，来自6种攻击家族，分别报告语义攻击接受、审计可见危害证据和沙箱观察到的工具/状态危害三个独立端点。评估5个代理端点和4种提示策略后，发现这些端点捕捉不同的失败模式：语义失败率在9.0%到44.2%之间，审计危害范围更窄，且许多沙箱危害发生在通过语义检查的行中。
Motivation: 现有评估将不同阶段的安全失败（如模型同意攻击与实际产生可观察危害）混为一个成功率，难以区分模型是否仅同意攻击者还是实际造成了可观察危害。
Method: 提出SafeClawBench，包含600个受控对抗性任务，覆盖直接和间接提示注入、工具返回注入、内存中毒、内存提取和歧义驱动的不安全推理六种攻击家族，并设置了语义攻击接受、审计可见危害证据和沙箱观察工具/状态危害三个独立评估端点。
Result: 评估发现语义失败率在9.0%到44.2%之间，审计危害证据比语义失败更窄，且在12000行匹配分析中，347次沙箱危害中有291次发生在通过语义检查的行中。提示策略改变端点结果，但效果依赖于模型和协议。
Conclusion: SafeClawBench提供了一个可复现的框架，用于比较代理模型和提示策略条件，而不混淆文本合规性、证据支持的危害和可执行状态变化。

papers.title: Structural MRI Synthesis for Alzheimer's Disease via Conditional Diffusion on Anatomical Masks
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative machine learning models have significantly improved medical imaging, offering promising solutions for data augmentation, privacy preservation, and improved model generalization. However, synthesizing high-quality structural MRI data for Alzheimer's Disease (AD) remains challenging due to the subtle, region-specific, and progressive anatomical changes associated with neurodegeneration. In this paper, we extend the Med-DDPM conditional diffusion model -- originally designed for brain tumor synthesis -- to generate 3D structural MRIs specifically tailored to AD. We adopted Med-DDPM due to its established stability and structural fidelity compared to other generative models, which makes it particularly suitable for capturing the subtle anatomical changes characteristic of AD. Our approach conditions the diffusion process on anatomical segmentation masks derived from the ADNI dataset, incorporating key AD-relevant brain structures into the generation process. We systematically evaluate the quality and utility of the synthetic images by training segmentation models on real, synthetic, and hybrid (mixed) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that segmentation models trained exclusively on synthetic data achieve comparable Dice scores (0.6532) to those trained on real data (0.6513), while exhibiting significantly enhanced recall. Notably, models trained on hybrid datasets (mixing real and synthetic images) outperform both real and synthetic-only baselines, achieving a Dice score of 0.7244. These findings underscore the successful use of conditional diffusion models for generating anatomically accurate, AD-specific synthetic MRIs, and highlight their potential for enhancing training data availability, improving diagnostic accuracy, and promoting research reproducibility in neuroimaging studies.
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE 8th International Conference on Multimedia Information Processing and Retrieval (MIPR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将脑肿瘤合成领域的Med-DDPM条件扩散模型扩展到阿尔茨海默病(AD)的结构化MRI合成，以解剖分割掩模为条件，生成3D MRI图像。实验表明，纯合成数据训练的模型Dice得分(0.6532)接近真实数据(0.6513)，混合数据训练达到0.7244，验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 合成高质量AD相关结构MRI具有挑战性，因为神经退行性变化微妙、区域特异且渐进，现有方法难以捕捉这些特征。
Method: 基于Med-DDPM条件扩散模型，以ADNI数据集的解剖分割掩模作为条件，生成3D AD特定MRI图像。
Result: 合成数据训练的分割模型Dice得分为0.6532，接近真实数据的0.6513；混合数据训练达到0.7244，且召回率显著提升。
Conclusion: 条件扩散模型能生成解剖准确的AD特异性合成MRI，有望提升训练数据可用性、诊断准确性和神经影像研究可重复性。

papers.title: ThousandWorlds: A benchmark for climate emulation of potentially habitable exoplanets
papers.abstract_en: The search for life beyond Earth will depend on detecting faint signatures in the atmospheres of potentially habitable exoplanets. Interpreting those signatures requires understanding the host planet's climate: the same molecule may signal life on one planet and abiotic chemistry on another. Global climate models (GCMs) provide this understanding, but individual runs can require up to millions of core-hours and substantial domain expert time. Machine-learning emulators could remove this bottleneck, but progress has been limited by the absence of a curated, multi-model exoclimate dataset. We introduce ThousandWorlds, an ML-ready benchmark for exoclimate emulation and for the broader regime of low-data, multi-simulator, parameter-to-field regression. The dataset contains approximately 1800 simulations from five GCMs, mapping eight planet parameters to 3D atmospheric fields including temperature, humidity, winds, clouds, and radiation. Three nested subsets define progressively harder challenges: single-simulator regression, multi-simulator regression with complete observations, and multi-simulator regression with structured missingness. We propose two evaluation protocols: one for ranking methods, and one that measures performance relative to the disagreement between GCMs themselves. We evaluate seven baselines spanning simple methods, deep learning, and Gaussian processes. GP-based methods perform best, suggesting that ThousandWorlds exposes a regime where off-the-shelf deep learning does not yet succeed. Data: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/8695. Code: https://github.com/edstevenson/ThousandWorlds.
papers.comment: 10 pages main text, 26 pages references/appendix, plus NeurIPS checklist. Data at https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/8695. Code at https://github.com/edstevenson/ThousandWorlds
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThousandWorlds是一个面向机器学习的气候仿真基准数据集，包含约1800个来自五个全球气候模型（GCM）的模拟，将八个行星参数映射到三维大气场（温度、湿度、风、云、辐射）。论文提出三种难度递增的子集和两种评估协议，并评估了七种基线方法，其中基于高斯过程的方法表现最佳。
Motivation: 寻找系外生命需要解读行星大气光谱，而全球气候模型（GCM）运行成本极高，机器学习仿真器可加速这一过程，但缺乏多模型、多参数的统一基准数据集。
Method: 构建了包含五个GCM、1800次模拟的数据集，并定义三种子集任务：单仿真器回归、多仿真器完全观测回归、多仿真器结构化缺失回归。提出两种评估协议：方法排名协议和相对于GCM间差异的性能协议。
Result: 在七个基线中，高斯过程方法表现最佳，而标准深度学习模型未能超越简单方法，表明该基准涉及一个现有深度学习尚不擅长的低数据、多仿真器回归场景。
Conclusion: ThousandWorlds填补了系外气候仿真数据集的空白，并揭示了在低数据、多仿真器回归任务中，高斯过程等经典方法优于深度学习。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Self-CTRL: Self-Consistency Training with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) that faithfully describe their own behavior can more easily be audited, understood, and trusted by users. This paper describes Self-Consistency Training with Reinforcement Learning (Self-CTRL), a method that optimizes for consistency between a LM's self-explanations and behavior on related inputs by updating explanations to better predict behavior or updating behavior to better match explanations. We apply our method in two domains. First, we study a formal probabilistic reasoning task in which LMs must learn to imitate a family of biased samplers and evaluated on their ability to report the associated biases. We find that consistency training improves the correlation between self-reported and behaviorally-measured latent biases from $R^2=0.24$ to $R^2=0.64$ on a set of held-out distributions, matching the generalization of direct ground-truth supervision. Second, we study a constitutional AI domain in which LMs must describe when they will refuse or comply with user requests. Here, Self-CTRL produces rules that faithfully describe the model's behavior on held-out requests, improving the refusal predictions of a third-party auditor model from $36\%$ to $92\%$. In the other direction, behavior updates improve alignment, reducing HarmBench failure rate from $15.0\%$ to $0.5\%$ without substantially increasing refusal on harmless prompts. By aligning explanations and behavior, our work provides a general recipe for training AI models to be safer, more transparent, and more controllable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Self-CTRL方法，通过强化学习优化语言模型的自我解释与行为之间的一致性。在概率推理任务上，将自我报告偏差与行为测量偏差的相关性从R²=0.24提升到0.64；在宪法AI任务上，使第三方审计员模型的拒绝预测准确率从36%提升到92%，并将HarmBench失败率从15.0%降至0.5%。
Motivation: 语言模型难以忠实地描述自身行为，导致用户难以审计、理解和信任。
Method: 提出Self-CTRL，通过强化学习更新解释以更好地预测行为，或更新行为以更好地匹配解释，从而优化一致性。
Result: 在形式化概率推理任务上，将自我报告偏差与行为偏差的R²从0.24提升到0.64；在宪法AI领域，使审计员模型拒绝预测准确率从36%提升到92%，HarmBench失败率从15.0%降至0.5%且不增加对无害提示的拒绝。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一个通用的训练框架，使AI模型更安全、更透明、更可控。

papers.title: Neural Network Implementation of the Renormalization Group for Fault Diagnosis with Class Imbalance
papers.abstract_en: The application of machine learning models in practical tasks faces challenges such as class imbalance and multidimensional noise. This paper proposes RGNet, a neural network architecture based on the concept of the renormalization group (RG), for hierarchical coarse-graining of the feature space. The model sequentially compresses the input dimensionality and concatenates all scales before classification, allowing it to capture both local details and global patterns. The notion of RG-flows is introduced - interpretable low-dimensional representations whose visualization via t-SNE reveals a discrete curvilinear structure confirming the effectiveness of coarse-graining. Experimental results are presented on the imbalanced AI4I dataset. The obtained results demonstrate that RGNet is a universal, interpretable, and competitive solution for fault prediction in applications with imbalanced classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RGNet，一种基于重正化群 (renormalization group) 概念的神经网络架构，用于处理类别不平衡和多维噪声的故障诊断任务。该模型通过层次化粗粒化特征空间，压缩输入维度并融合多尺度信息，从而捕获局部细节和全局模式。在 AI4I 不平衡数据集上的实验表明，RGNet 是一种通用、可解释且具有竞争力的故障预测方案。
Motivation: 实际机器学习任务中常面临类别不平衡和多维噪声的挑战，现有方法难以同时处理这两类问题。
Method: 受重正化群启发，提出 RGNet 网络，通过逐层压缩输入维度并连接所有尺度进行分类，引入 RG-flow 作为可解释的低维表示。
Result: 在不平衡的 AI4I 数据集上，RGNet 在故障预测任务中取得了具有竞争力的性能，且 t-SNE 可视化显示 RG-flow 呈现离散曲线结构，验证了粗粒化的有效性。
Conclusion: RGNet 是一种通用、可解释且适合不平衡分类的故障诊断方法。

papers.title: Agentra: A Supervisable Multi-Agent Framework for Enterprise Intrusion Response
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise intrusion response still depends on static playbooks and analyst-driven triage, creating delay between alert generation and containment. We present Agentra, a supervisable multi-agent Intrusion Response System (IRS) framework that converts alerts from IDS, EDR, and XDR platforms into structured incident response plans grounded in MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND, and NIST CSF 2.0. Agentra decomposes response reasoning across role-scoped agents, validates proposed plans through a bounded Planner--Validator review loop, screens retrieved threat intelligence through a Moderator security gateway, gates actions through an Action Catalog and risk score, and records decisions in an append-only audit log. We evaluate Agentra against a static OASIS CACAO v2.0 cyber-playbook baseline on a 120-event corpus drawn from ThreatHunter-Playbook, Splunk BOTSv3, and DARPA OpTC. The strongest configuration improves FP-aware IRS F1 from 0.61 to 0.84 and restores the projected harmful-action rate to the static baseline level of 0.0% after Planner-only configurations introduce unsafe overreaction. These results indicate that multi-agent response planning can improve ontology-grounded IRS coverage while preserving analyst approval and auditability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentra 是一个可监管的多代理入侵响应框架，将 IDS、EDR 和 XDR 平台的告警转化为基于 MITRE ATT&CK、MITRE D3FEND 和 NIST CSF 2.0 的结构化响应计划。它通过角色代理分解响应推理，通过 Planner-Validator 循环验证计划，通过 Moderator 安全网关筛选威胁情报，并通过动作目录和风险评分限制行动，同时记录不可变审计日志。在 ThreatHunter-Playbook、Splunk BOTSv3 和 DARPA OpTC 的 120 事件语料上，最佳配置将 FP-aware IRS F1 从 0.61 提升至 0.84，并将有害动作率恢复到静态基线的 0.0%。
Motivation: 企业入侵响应仍依赖静态剧本和分析师手动分流，导致告警生成与响应之间存在延迟。
Method: 提出 Agentra 多代理框架，包含角色代理（如 Planner、Validator、Moderator）、基于边界 Planner-Validator 循环的响应计划验证、威胁情报安全网关、动作目录与风险评分，以及追加审计日志。
Result: 在 120 事件数据集上，最佳配置将 FP-aware IRS F1 从 0.61 提升至 0.84，并将 Planner-only 配置中出现的非安全过度反应的有害动作率降至静态基线水平的 0.0%。
Conclusion: 多代理响应规划可在保持分析师审批和可审计性的同时，提高基于本体的入侵响应覆盖率。

papers.title: Why SWAVE May Not Be All You Need:A Concept-Evolution Retrospective on Complex-Valued Recurrent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: SWave is a complex-valued recurrent language model (169.26M parameters, D=384, L=16, T=2048) trained on FineWeb-Edu using 2xH100 NVL. It was designed around three founding premises: that representing language as complex waves rather than real-valued numbers enables richer information encoding; that a Cayley-parameterised unitary transition provides a mathematical guarantee against state decay or explosion; and that a hidden state which rotates rather than shrinks preserves signal integrity over arbitrarily long contexts. The core of SWave evolved substantially across three development phases. The Resonance Head was found to structurally admit imaginary-channel collapse as a global loss minimum (a failure mode we term cos-domination collapse) and was superseded by an untied head with independent real and imaginary embedding tables from the Phase-Associative Memory (PAM) architecture. This resolved the degenerate minimum and enabled stable 200,000-step training (best-step PPL 22.0 at step 89,861). ComplexNorm and the Wave Propagation Scan proved load-bearing throughout all three phases and were retained to the final architecture. ProtectGatedScan was reframed as a structural prior rather than a learned behaviour. The four multi-scale retention concepts showed no measurable improvement under controlled evaluation and were found non-load-bearing. The ComplexGatedUnit was superseded by a real-valued squared-ReLU channel mixer with fewer parameters. The auxiliary training objectives showed no benefit once structural constraints were resolved. The investigation yields a formal characterisation of cos-domination collapse, a parallel scan with a log-space backward pass for numerical stability, six transferable engineering principles for complex-valued recurrent training, and a plan-to-code traceability methodology for catching structural divergences that conventional test suites miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了复数循环语言模型SWave（169.26M参数）的演化过程。该模型最初基于三个前提：复数波表示、Cayley酉变换保证状态稳定、旋转隐藏状态保持长程信号。经过三个阶段发展，发现共振头导致虚数通道坍塌（cos-domination collapse），被独立实虚嵌入头的相位关联记忆架构取代；ComplexNorm和波传播扫描被保留；多尺度保持概念无改进；辅助训练目标无益。研究给出了cos-domination collapse的形式化描述、对数空间反向传播的并行扫描、六个可迁移训练原则以及计划到代码的可追溯方法。
Motivation: 探究复数循环语言模型SWave初始假设的有效性，识别其开发过程中的关键演化点，并总结可迁移的训练原则。
Method: 通过三个开发阶段系统地分析SWave的每个组件，进行控制实验比较不同架构变体，形式化描述cos-domination collapse失败模式。
Result: 识别出共振头的虚数通道坍塌问题并替换为相位关联记忆架构；保留ComplexNorm和波传播扫描；多尺度保持概念无改善；辅助训练目标无益；训练达到200,000步，最好步骤困惑度22.0。
Conclusion: 强调了结构先验的重要性，并提供了六个可迁移的工程原则和计划到代码的可追溯方法，用于捕捉结构分歧。

papers.title: Reliable Neural-Codec Text-to-Speech by ASR Self-Verification and Distillation: Near-Zero Catastrophic Failures Across Models and Codecs
papers.abstract_en: Open autoregressive neural-codec text-to-speech (TTS) models sound excellent on typical inputs yet suffer stochastic catastrophic failures: on a meaningful fraction of utterances they emit silence, terminate early, or collapse into repetitive or hallucinated content. We show this failure mode is cheap to remove. Under a single format-robust metric (a catastrophic-failure rate via an ASR round-trip), best-of-N ASR self-verification drives failures to near-zero: no observed failures remain by N=2 on a standard corpus (LibriSpeech) and by N=4 on a hard prompt set. This is not an artifact of one model: the reduction replicates across four open codec-TTS systems and three neural codecs (XCodec2, SNAC, Mimi), reaching the near-zero floor by N=2 on three of the four. We then make the fix free at inference time by distilling the self-verified behaviour into the model, which recovers much of the robustness in single-shot decoding, closing ~52-58% of the failure mass on hard inputs at no test-time cost. The distillation gain concentrates where it is needed (hard inputs); on already-reliable prose there is no headroom and no detectable change. A controlled comparison adds a clean negative: offline direct preference optimization (DPO/IPO) does not beat plain supervised distillation, and an online iterative variant is promising but not statistically separable at our evaluation size. We report honestly the one model that resists (a larger Llasa where scale did not obviously help) and a rare-word capability ceiling that no self-distillation method overcomes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放自回归神经编解码文本转语音（TTS）模型在部分输入上出现随机灾难性失败（静音、提前终止、重复或幻觉内容）的问题，提出基于ASR自验证和蒸馏的低成本修复方案。摘要表明，使用单一格式鲁棒指标（ASR往返的灾难性失败率），最佳N ASR自验证可将失败率降至近零：在标准语料库LibriSpeech上N=2时无失败，在困难提示集上N=4时无失败。该效果在四个编解码TTS系统和三种神经编解码器（XCodec2、SNAC、Mimi）中均成立，其中三个系统在N=2时达到近零。进一步通过蒸馏将自验证行为融入模型，在单次解码中恢复大部分鲁棒性，在困难输入上消除约52-58%的失败，且无测试时额外开销。
Motivation: 现有开放自回归神经编解码TTS模型虽在典型输入上表现优异，但存在随机灾难性失败（静音、提前终止、重复或幻觉内容），影响可靠性和部署信心。
Method: 提出ASR自验证与蒸馏方法：利用ASR进行往返校验计算灾难性失败率，通过最佳N（best-of-N）自验证将失败率降至近零；然后将自验证行为蒸馏回模型，使单次解码获得大部分鲁棒性，且无额外推理成本。
Result: 摘要报告，在LibriSpeech上N=2时无失败，在硬提示集上N=4时无失败；该效果在四个编解码TTS系统和三种编解码器上重复，其中三个系统N=2即达近零。蒸馏恢复约52-58%的失败质量，同时发现离线直接偏好优化（DPO/IPO）不如简单监督蒸馏，在线迭代变体有潜力但统计上不显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，ASR自验证可廉价地将神经编解码TTS的灾难性失败降至近零，蒸馏可无成本地保留大部分鲁棒性；但报告一个例外（较大规模Llasa模型）以及自蒸馏无法克服的罕见词能力上限。
Relevance: 0
