papers.title: Self-Driving Datasets: From 20 Million Papers to Nuanced Biomedical Knowledge at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Manually curated biomedical repositories -- spanning bioactivity, genomics, and chemistry -- are expensive to maintain, lag behind primary literature, and discard experimental context, obscuring nuances needed to assess data correctness and coverage. We show that PubMed itself can be autonomously and cost-effectively turned into structured datasets that are larger, more nuanced, and more accurate than the curated databases they replace. We present three coupled contributions: (1) an LLM-based entity-tagging pipeline, grounded in nine biomedical ontologies, that tags 4.5B entities across 19 categories in a 22.5M-paper, 2.5T-token PubMed corpus; (2) hybrid sparse-dense retrieval supporting entity-filtered semantic queries over the tagged corpus; and (3) Starling, a multi-agent deep research system that, given only a natural-language task description, designs precision- and recall-targeted retrieval filters, induces an extraction schema, and emits structured records with nuance-rich fields and supporting passages. Across six tasks -- blood-brain barrier permeability, oral bioavailability, acute toxicity (LD50), gene-disease associations, protein subcellular localization, and chemical reactions -- Starling produces ~6.3M records (91K-3M per task); several are, to our knowledge, the largest public datasets for their property. Frontier-model rejection of our extractions is 0.6-7.7% across tasks, far below error rates we measure on widely used curated counterparts (e.g., 16.5% on BBB_Martins, 7.3% on Bioavailability_Ma). Beyond scale and accuracy, the supporting passages carry nuance tabular databases discard -- e.g., oral bioavailability may depend on fed vs. fasted state. Together, the corpus, retrieval, and agent establish a foundation for AI-driven therapeutic design. Code and datasets: https://github.com/starling-labs/starling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将PubMed文献自动转化为结构化生物医学数据集的方法，包括基于LLM的实体标注管道（标注4.5B实体、19个类别）、混合稀疏-稠密检索以及多智能体系统Starling。在血脑屏障渗透性、口服生物利用度、急性毒性等六项任务中生成约630万条记录，其准确率和细粒度优于现有手动管理数据库。
Motivation: 手动管理的生物医学数据库维护成本高、更新滞后于文献，且丢失实验上下文细节，限制了数据正确性和覆盖范围的评估。
Method: 构建三部分贡献：(1) 基于九种生物医学本体的LLM实体标注管道，对整个PubMed语料库（2250万篇论文）进行标注；(2) 混合稀疏-稠密检索支持实体过滤的语义查询；(3) Starling多智能体系统，根据自然语言任务自动设计检索过滤器和提取模式，生成结构化记录并附有支持性段落。
Result: 在血脑屏障渗透性等六项任务中生成约630万条记录（每任务9.1万至300万），多个数据集为公开最大规模。前沿模型对提取结果的拒绝率仅0.6-7.7%，远低于现有基准数据库的错误率（如BBB_Martins 16.5%）。
Conclusion: 该语料库、检索系统和智能体为AI驱动的治疗设计提供了基础，且支持段落保留了表格数据库丢弃的实验条件细微差异。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Guide
papers.abstract_en: Information-theoretic (IT) measures are ubiquitous in artificial intelligence: entropy drives decision-tree splits and uncertainty quantification, cross-entropy is the default classification loss, mutual information underpins representation learning and feature selection, and transfer entropy reveals directed influence in dynamical systems. A second, less consolidated family of measures, integrated information (Phi), effective information (EI), and autonomy, has emerged for characterizing agent complexity. Despite wide adoption, measure selection is often decoupled from estimator assumptions, failure modes, and safe inferential claims. This paper provides a practical decision framework for all seven measures, organized around three prescriptive questions for each: (i) what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; (ii) which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and (iii) what is the most dangerous misuse. The framework is operationalized in two complementary artifacts: a measure-selection flowchart and a master decision table. We cover both AI/ML and decision-making agent application domains per measure, with standardized Bridge Boxes linking IT quantities to cognitive constructs. Three worked examples illustrate the framework on concrete practitioner scenarios spanning representation learning, temporal influence analysis, and evolved agent complexity.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Submitted to Entropy (MDPI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为人工智能中的七种信息论度量（熵、交叉熵、互信息、传递熵、集成信息、有效信息、自主性）提供了一个实用决策框架，围绕三个问题组织：度量回答什么问题、适合何种估计器、常见误用。框架包含选择流程图和决策表，并通过三个案例说明。
Motivation: 研究者常根据习惯而非数据特性选择信息论度量，忽视估计器假设和失败模式，导致不可靠推论。需要一套系统化的选择指南。
Method: 针对每种度量提出三个预设问题，并基于此设计度量选择流程图和主决策表，引入标准化桥接框将信息量映射到认知概念，覆盖AI/ML和决策代理应用域。
Result: 未报告定量实验结果；提供了三个工作示例（表示学习、时间影响分析、进化代理复杂度）以说明框架使用。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在帮助从业者根据数据维度、类型和推理目标选择合适的信息论度量并避免常见误用。

papers.title: From Concept-Aligned Tokens to Vulnerable Features: Mechanistic Localization of Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: Jailbreak attacks expose a persistent failure mode in safety-aligned LLMs: models can be pushed into harmful behavior, but the internal representations enabling this shift remain poorly localized. Recent mechanistic safety studies often explain such behavior through broad representational objects, including global refusal directions, activation steering vectors, and refusal-related SAE features. We instead ask whether jailbreak vulnerability can be traced to finer-grained, prompt-conditioned SAE feature subgroups. We introduce a token-driven mechanistic pipeline that decomposes the residual stream of Gemma-2-2B into Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) features and identifies feature subgroups associated with unsafe behavior. Using single-category unsafe examples from BeaverTails to reduce cross-category interference, we extract harmful concepts from adversarial responses and align them with concept-relevant prompt tokens through subspace similarity. We then apply three feature-grouping strategies: cluster-based, hierarchical-linkage, and single-token-driven, to identify SAE feature subgroups across all 26 layers. Finally, we amplify the top features in each subgroup and evaluate the resulting generations with a standardized harmfulness judge. Single-token-driven grouping achieves harmfulness comparable to full cluster-based grouping, showing that individual harmful prompt tokens are sufficient to localize vulnerability-relevant SAE feature subgroups without relying on broader cluster-level aggregation. These subgroups appear across early and mid-to-late layers, with stronger concentration in mid-to-late layers, where targeted steering exposes specific model vulnerabilities. Overall, our results suggest that jailbreak susceptibility can be traced to sparse, token-localized SAE feature subgroups, complementing prior accounts based on broad adversarial, refusal, or steering directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）中越狱攻击（jailbreak）的机制定位，通过令牌驱动的机械论流水线，将残差流分解为稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征，并识别与不安全行为相关的特征子群。实验表明，单个有害提示令牌足以定位漏洞相关的SAE特征子群，这些子群在早、中、晚层出现，但更集中于中晚层。
Motivation: 现有研究将越狱行为归因于广泛的表征对象（如全局拒绝方向、激活转向向量），但未能精确追溯到更细粒度的、提示条件化的特征子群。本文旨在通过更精细的机制定位解释越狱漏洞。
Method: 提出令牌驱动的机械论流水线：使用Gemma-2-2B模型，结合SAE特征分解，从BeaverTails数据集中提取单类不安全示例的对抗响应，通过子空间相似性对齐有害概念与相关提示令牌，并采用三种特征分组策略（基于聚类、层次链接、单令牌驱动）识别SAE特征子群，最后通过放大特征并评估生成内容的危害性验证。
Result: 单令牌驱动分组能达到与完整聚类分组相当的危害性，表明单个有害提示令牌足以定位漏洞相关SAE特征子群，无需依赖更广泛的聚类聚合。这些子群在早、中、晚层均有出现，但在中晚层更集中。
Conclusion: 越狱易感性可追溯到稀疏的、令牌局部化的SAE特征子群，补充了以往基于广泛对抗、拒绝或转向方向的研究。

papers.title: WebSP-Eval: Evaluating Web Agents on Website Security and Privacy Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Web agents automate browser tasks, ranging from simple form completion to complex workflows like ordering groceries. While current benchmarks evaluate general-purpose performance~(e.g., WebArena) or safety against malicious actions~(e.g., SafeArena), no existing framework assesses an agent's ability to successfully execute user-facing website security and privacy tasks, such as managing cookie preferences, configuring privacy-sensitive account settings, or revoking inactive sessions. To address this gap, we introduce WebSP-Eval, an evaluation framework for measuring web agent performance on website security and privacy tasks. WebSP-Eval comprises 1) a manually crafted task dataset of 200 task instances across 28 websites; 2) a robust agentic system supporting account and initial state management across runs using a custom Google Chrome extension; and 3) an automated evaluator. We evaluate a total of 8 web agent instantiations using state-of-the-art multimodal large language models, conducting a fine-grained analysis across websites, task categories, and UI elements. Our evaluation reveals that current models suffer from limited autonomous exploration capabilities to reliably solve website security and privacy tasks, and struggle with specific task categories and websites. Crucially, we identify stateful UI elements are a primary reason for agent failure, with toggles causing more than 45% task failure across many models.
papers.comment: Accepted at PETS 2026. Project Page: https://wiscprivacy.com/webspeval/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebSP-Eval是一个评估web agents在网站安全与隐私任务上性能的框架，包含200个手工构建的任务实例（覆盖28个网站）和自动评估器。评估了8个基于多模态大语言模型的agent实例，发现当前模型在安全隐私任务上自主探索能力有限，状态UI元素（尤其是toggle开关）是主要失败原因，导致超过45%的任务失败。
Motivation: 现有benchmark（如WebArena）评估通用性能，SafeArena评估恶意行为安全性，但缺乏对用户面临的安全与隐私任务（如管理cookie偏好、配置隐私设置、撤销会话）的评估。
Method: 提出WebSP-Eval框架，包括手动构建的200个任务实例数据集（28个网站）、支持账户和初始状态管理的agent系统（基于自定义Chrome扩展）、以及自动评估器。
Result: 评估8个基于多模态LLM的agent实例，发现模型在安全隐私任务上自主探索能力有限，状态UI元素（尤其toggle）导致超过45%的任务失败。
Conclusion: 当前web agents在安全与隐私任务上表现不足，需要提升自主探索和处理状态UI元素的能力。

papers.title: Generative models for decision-making under distributional shift
papers.abstract_en: Many data-driven decision problems are formulated using a nominal distribution estimated from historical data, while performance is ultimately determined by a deployment distribution that may be shifted, context-dependent, partially observed, or stress-induced. This tutorial presents modern generative models, particularly flow- and score-based methods, as mathematical tools for constructing decision-relevant distributions. From an operations research perspective, their primary value lies not in unconstrained sample synthesis but in representing and transforming distributions through transport maps, velocity fields, score fields, and guided stochastic dynamics. We present a unified framework based on pushforward maps, continuity, Fokker-Planck equations, Wasserstein geometry, and optimization in probability space. Within this framework, generative models can be used to learn nominal uncertainty, construct stressed or least-favorable distributions for robustness, and produce conditional or posterior distributions under side information and partial observation. We also highlight representative theoretical guarantees, including forward-reverse convergence for iterative flow models, first-order minimax analysis in transport-map space, and error-transfer bounds for posterior sampling with generative priors. The tutorial provides a principled introduction to using generative models for scenario generation, robust decision-making, uncertainty quantification, and related problems under distributional shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以运筹学视角，系统介绍基于流模型和得分模型的生成式建模方法，用于处理分布偏移下的决策问题。方法通过推前映射、连续方程、Fokker-Planck方程和Wasserstein几何构建统一框架，支持学习名义不确定性、构造最劣分布用于鲁棒优化、以及生成条件分布。理论结果包括迭代流模型的前向-反向收敛性、传输映射空间中的一阶极小极大分析，以及生成先验下后验采样的误差传递界。
Motivation: 经典数据驱动决策依赖于历史数据的名义分布，但部署时的分布偏移（如上下文依赖、部分观测或应力扰动）会导致性能下降。现有方法缺乏系统的数学工具来生成决策相关的分布。
Method: 提出基于推前映射、连续性方程、Fokker-Planck方程、Wasserstein几何和概率空间优化的统一框架，利用流模型和得分模型表示和变换分布，包括学习名义不确定性、构造应力分布、生成条件分布等。
Result: 总结了若干理论保证：迭代流模型的前向-反向收敛性、传输映射空间的一阶极小极大分析、生成先验下后验采样的误差传递界。
Conclusion: 本文为利用生成模型进行情景生成、鲁棒决策、不确定性量化等分布偏移问题提供了原理性介绍。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models are a promising path to zero-shot embodied control through planning. However, existing world model planners struggle on long-horizon, multi-stage tasks: prediction errors compound and naive search is exponential in the planning horizon. Hierarchy mitigates both by decomposing tasks into shorter, tractable subproblems; yet prior hierarchical approaches either amortize control into task-specific policies (hierarchical RL) or assume low-dimensional states and known dynamics (classical hierarchical MPC). We present Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models (HWM), an architecture and planning paradigm for hierarchical model predictive control (MPC) directly on visual world models trained solely via next-latent prediction. HWM learns world models at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, so predictions from the long-horizon model serve as subgoals for the short-horizon model via latent matching, without task-specific rewards, skill learning, or hierarchical policies. To keep long-horizon search tractable, HWM learns an action encoder that compresses primitive action chunks into latent macro-actions. On real-world Franka manipulation, HWM solves pick-and-place from a single goal image at 70% success vs. 0% for single-level planning. Across simulated push manipulation and maze navigation, HWM consistently improves performance on long-horizon tasks while requiring up to 3x less planning compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次规划与潜在世界模型（HWM），一种基于视觉世界模型的分层模型预测控制（MPC）架构，通过多时间尺度潜在世界模型和动作编码器实现长时域任务规划，在机器人操作和导航任务中取得显著效果。
Motivation: 现有世界模型规划器在处理长时域多阶段任务时面临预测误差累积和指数级搜索复杂度问题，而传统层次方法依赖任务特定策略或低维状态假设。
Method: HWM在共享潜在空间中学习多时间尺度的世界模型，通过潜在匹配将长时域模型预测作为短时域模型的子目标，并使用动作编码器将原始动作块压缩为潜在宏动作以降低搜索复杂度。
Result: 在真实Franka机器人上，单张目标图像实现70%的抓取放置成功率（单层规划为0%）；在仿真推物和迷宫导航任务中，长时域任务性能提升且规划计算量减少3倍。
Conclusion: 层次潜在世界模型通过多尺度预测和潜在匹配有效克服了单层规划的长时域困难，无需任务特定奖励或分层策略。

papers.title: A CEFR-Inspired Classification Framework with Fuzzy C-Means To Automate Assessment of Programming Skills in Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Context: Schools, training platforms, and technology firms increasingly need to assess programming proficiency at scale with transparent, reproducible methods that support personalized learning pathways. Objective: This study introduces a pedagogical framework for Scratch project assessment, aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), providing universal competency levels for students and teachers alongside actionable insights for curriculum design. Method: We apply Fuzzy C-Means clustering to 2008246 Scratch projects evaluated via Dr.Scratch, implementing an ordinal criterion to map clusters to CEFR levels (A1-C2), and introducing enhanced classification metrics that identify transitional learners, enable continuous progress tracking, and quantify classification certainty to balance automated feedback with instructor review. Impact: The framework enables diagnosis of systemic curriculum gaps-notably a "B2 bottleneck" where only 13.3% of learners reside due to the cognitive load of integrating Logic Synchronization, and Data Representation--while providing certainty--based triggers for human intervention.
papers.comment: Best Paper Award CSEDU 2026 -Minor change FPC fix-
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于CEFR框架，利用Fuzzy C-Means聚类对200多万个Scratch项目进行自动等级分类（A1-C2），并引入过渡学习者和分类确定性指标以辅助教学反馈。实验揭示了B2瓶颈阶段（仅13.3%学习者），该瓶颈与逻辑同步和数据表示的认知负荷相关。
Motivation: 学校和培训平台需要大规模、透明且可重复的编程能力评估方法，以支持个性化学习路径。
Method: 采用Fuzzy C-Means聚类对Dr.Scratch评估的2008246个Scratch项目进行排序映射，引入序数准则将聚类结果对齐CEFR等级，并新增过渡学习者识别、连续进度跟踪和分类确定性量化机制。
Result: 框架检测到系统性课程缺口，特别是B2瓶颈阶段仅容纳13.3%的学习者，归因于逻辑同步和数据表示的整合认知负荷。
Conclusion: 该框架可用于诊断课程设计缺陷，并通过分类确定性阈值触发人工干预，平衡自动反馈与教师指导。

papers.title: Something from Nothing: Data Augmentation for Robust Severity Level Estimation of Dysarthric Speech
papers.abstract_en: Dysarthric speech quality assessment (DSQA) is critical for clinical diagnostics and inclusive speech technologies. However, subjective evaluation is costly and difficult to scale, and the scarcity of labeled data limits robust objective modeling. To address this, we propose a three-stage framework that leverages unlabeled dysarthric speech and large-scale typical speech datasets to scale training. A teacher model first generates pseudo-labels for unlabeled samples, followed by weakly supervised pretraining using a label-aware contrastive learning strategy that exposes the model to diverse speakers and acoustic conditions. The pretrained model is then fine-tuned for the downstream DSQA task. Experiments on five unseen datasets spanning multiple etiologies and languages demonstrate the robustness of our approach. Our Whisper-based baseline significantly outperforms SOTA DSQA predictors such as SpICE, and the full framework achieves an average SRCC of 0.761 across unseen test datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted to Interspeech 2026 Long Paper Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对构音障碍语音质量评估（DSQA）中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出一个三阶段框架，利用无标注构音障碍语音和大规模正常语音数据集进行训练。教师模型生成伪标签，结合标签感知对比学习的弱监督预训练，再微调至DSQA任务。在五个未见数据集上，基于Whisper的方法平均SRCC达到0.761，显著优于SpICE等现有方法。
Motivation: 构音障碍语音的主观评估成本高、难以扩展，且标注数据稀缺，限制了客观模型的鲁棒性。
Method: 三阶段框架：1) 教师模型为无标注样本生成伪标签；2) 标签感知对比学习进行弱监督预训练，暴露模型于多样化的说话人和声学条件；3) 在DSQA任务上微调。
Result: 在涵盖多种病因和语言的五个未见数据集上，平均SRCC为0.761，显著优于SpICE等SOTA方法。
Conclusion: 利用未标注数据和大规模正常语音可提升DSQA的鲁棒性和泛化能力，但摘要未明确提及方法的局限性。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Cross-City Generalization in End-to-End Autonomous Driving: Self-Supervised versus Supervised Representations
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving models are typically trained on multi-city datasets using supervised ImageNet-pretrained backbones, yet their ability to generalize to unseen cities remains largely unexamined. When training and evaluation data are geographically mixed, models may implicitly rely on city-specific cues, masking failure modes that would occur under real-world domain shifts when generalizing to new locations. In this work, we formulate zero-shot cross-city transfer as a controlled representation-level stress test for end-to-end autonomous driving and ask how visual pretraining affects transfer behavior under geographic domain shift. We conduct a comprehensive study by integrating self-supervised backbones I-JEPA, DINOv2, and MAE into planning frameworks. We evaluate performance under strict geographic splits on nuScenes in the open-loop setting and on NAVSIM in the closed-loop evaluation protocol. Our experiments reveal a substantial generalization gap when transferring models across cities with different road topologies, traffic conventions, and visual environments. In open-loop evaluation, a supervised backbone exhibits severe degradation when transferring between cities, yet some domain-specific self-supervised methods can substantially reduce both displacement and collision degradation. In closed-loop evaluation, self-supervised pretraining improves average out-of-distribution PDMS in several single-city training settings. Our results provide empirical evidence that representation learning influences the robustness of cross-city planning and motivate zero-shot geographic transfer as an important stress test for evaluating end-to-end autonomous driving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了端到端自动驾驶模型在零样本跨城市迁移中的泛化能力，比较了自监督（I-JEPA、DINOv2、MAE）和监督预训练骨干网络的表现。在nuScenes（开环）和NAVSIM（闭环）评估中，发现跨城市迁移存在显著泛化差距，自监督方法能减少位移和碰撞退化，但监督方法退化严重。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶模型通常在多城市数据集上训练，但跨城市泛化能力未得到充分检验；训练和评估数据混合可能掩盖依赖城市特征的失败模式。
Method: 将零样本跨城市迁移定义为表示层面的压力测试，集成不同自监督骨干网络（I-JEPA、DINOv2、MAE）到规划框架，在严格地理分割下进行开环和闭环评估。
Result: 开环评估中监督骨干跨城市迁移时性能严重下降，而某些自监督方法能显著降低位移和碰撞退化；闭环评估中自监督预训练在多个单城市训练设置下提高了OOD PDMS平均值。
Conclusion: 表示学习影响跨城市规划的鲁棒性，零样本地理迁移应作为评估端到端自动驾驶系统的重要压力测试。

papers.title: How far have we gone in Generative Image Restoration? A study on its capability, limitations and evaluation practices
papers.abstract_en: Generative Image Restoration (GIR) has achieved impressive perceptual realism, but how far have its practical capabilities truly advanced compared with previous methods? To answer this, we present a large-scale study grounded in a new multi-dimensional evaluation pipeline that assesses models on detail, sharpness, semantic correctness, and overall quality. Our analysis covers diverse architectures, including diffusion-based, GAN-based, PSNR-oriented, and general-purpose generation models, revealing critical performance disparities. Furthermore, our analysis uncovers a key evolution in failure modes that signifies a paradigm shift for the perception-oriented low-level vision field. The central challenge is evolving from the previous problem of detail scarcity (under-generation) to the new frontier of detail quality and semantic control (preventing over-generation). We also leverage our benchmark to train a new IQA model that better aligns with human perceptual judgments. Ultimately, this work provides a systematic study of modern generative image restoration models, offering crucial insights that redefine our understanding of their true state and chart a course for future development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对生成式图像恢复（GIR）模型进行了大规模研究，基于新的多维评估管道评估细节、锐度、语义正确性和整体质量。覆盖扩散、GAN、PSNR导向和通用生成模型，揭示了关键性能差异，并发现失败模式从细节缺失（欠生成）演变为细节质量和语义控制（过生成）。还利用基准训练了新的IQA模型。
Motivation: 生成式图像恢复虽然取得了感知真实感的进步，但其实际能力相比先前方法究竟进步了多少尚未明确，需要系统评估。
Method: 提出大规模研究，基于新的多维评估管道，评估模型在细节、锐度、语义正确性和整体质量上的表现。覆盖多种架构，包括diffusion-based、GAN-based、PSNR-oriented和通用生成模型。
Result: 揭示了关键性能差异，发现失败模式从细节稀缺（欠生成）转向细节质量和语义控制（过生成）。训练了新的IQA模型，更好地对齐人类感知判断。
Conclusion: 提供了对现代生成式图像恢复模型的系统研究，提供了重新定义对其真实状态理解的见解，并为未来发展绘制路线。

papers.title: On the Stability of Nonlinear Dynamics in GD and SGD: Beyond Quadratic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: The dynamical stability of the iterates during training plays a key role in determining the minima obtained by optimization algorithms. For example, stable solutions of gradient descent (GD) correspond to flat minima, which have been associated with favorable features. While prior work often relies on linearization to determine stability, it remains unclear whether linearized dynamics faithfully capture the full nonlinear behavior. Recent work has shown that GD may stably oscillate near a linearly unstable minimum and still converge once the step size decays, indicating that linear analysis can be misleading. In this work, we explicitly study the effect of nonlinear terms. Specifically, we derive an exact criterion for stable oscillations of GD near minima in the multivariate setting. Our condition depends on high-order derivatives, generalizing existing results. Extending the analysis to stochastic gradient descent (SGD), we show that nonlinear dynamics can diverge in expectation even if a single batch is unstable. This implies that stability can be dictated by a single batch that oscillates unstably, rather than an average effect, as linear analysis suggests. Finally, we prove that if all batches are linearly stable, the nonlinear dynamics of SGD are stable in expectation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了梯度下降（GD）和随机梯度下降（SGD）在非二次势能下非线性动力学的稳定性。推导了GD在多元设置下稳定振荡的精确判据，该判据依赖于高阶导数。对于SGD，证明了非线性动力学可能因单个不稳定批次而发散，而线性分析仅考虑平均效应。最后证明若所有批次线性稳定，则SGD的非线性动力学在期望下稳定。
Motivation: 现有稳定性分析通常采用线性化方法，但线性化可能无法准确捕捉非线性行为，例如GD在靠近线性不稳定极小点处仍可能稳定振荡。需要显式研究非线性项的影响以正确理解算法收敛性。
Method: 通过分析高阶导数项，推导GD在多元设置下稳定振荡的精确条件。将分析扩展到SGD，研究单个批次不稳定对整体动力学的影响，并证明当所有批次线性稳定时SGD的期望稳定性。
Result: 得到GD稳定振荡的多变量判据，依赖于高阶导数。发现SGD的非线性动力学在单个批次线性不稳定时可能发散，与线性分析预测的平均效应不同。
Conclusion: 非线性项对GD和SGD的稳定性有决定性影响，线性稳定性分析可能产生误导。SGD的稳定性由最不稳定批次而非平均行为决定。

papers.title: PRISM: A 3D Probabilistic Neural Representation for Interpretable Shape Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how anatomical shapes evolve in response to developmental covariates - and quantifying their spatially varying uncertainties - is critical in healthcare research. Existing approaches typically rely on global time-warping formulations that ignore spatially heterogeneous dynamics. We introduce PRISM, a novel framework that bridges implicit neural representations with uncertainty-aware statistical shape analysis. PRISM models the conditional distribution of shapes given covariates, providing spatially continuous estimates of both the population mean and covariate-dependent uncertainty at arbitrary locations. A key theoretical contribution is a closed-form Fisher Information metric that enables efficient, analytically tractable local temporal uncertainty quantification via automatic differentiation. Experiments on three synthetic datasets and one clinical dataset demonstrate PRISM's strong performance across diverse tasks - from modeling shape evolution to personalized shape prediction and anomaly detection - within a unified framework, while providing interpretable and clinically meaningful uncertainty estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM框架，将隐式神经表示与不确定性感知的统计形状分析相结合，用于建模解剖形状随协变量的演变，并提供空间连续的平均形状和不确定性估计。关键理论贡献是闭合形式的Fisher信息度量，通过自动微分实现高效且解析可处理的局部时间不确定性量化。在三个合成数据集和一个临床数据集上验证了模型在形状演化、个性化预测和异常检测等任务中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法通常依赖全局时间扭曲公式，忽略了空间异质性动态，难以量化形状演变中的局部不确定性。作者希望建立一个统一的概率框架，既能捕捉形状随协变量的变化，又能提供可解释、有临床意义的不确定性估计。
Method: PRISM将条件形状分布建模为隐式神经表示，输出每个空间位置的人口均值和协变量相关的不确定性。核心是推导出Fisher信息度量的闭式解，利用自动微分高效计算局部时间不确定性。
Result: 在三个合成数据集和一个临床数据集上，PRISM在形状演化建模、个性化预测和异常检测等任务中表现优异，并提供了可解释的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: PRISM为解剖形状分析提供了一个统一、可解释的概率框架，尤其适用于需要量化空间异质性不确定性的场景。

papers.title: Do Neural Networks Lose Plasticity in a Gradually Changing World?
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning has become a trending topic in machine learning. Recent studies have discovered an interesting phenomenon called loss of plasticity, referring to neural networks gradually losing the ability to learn new tasks. However, existing plasticity research largely relies on benchmarks with abrupt task transitions, without examining whether the abruptness itself contributes to the observed plasticity loss. In this paper, we investigate the role of transition abruptness by simulating gradually changing environments through input/output interpolation and task sampling. We perform theoretical and empirical analysis, showing that the severity of plasticity loss is closely tied to the abruptness of task transitions, and can be substantially reduced when the environment changes gradually.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络在逐渐变化环境中的可塑性损失问题，发现任务转换的突变性是导致可塑性损失的关键因素，当环境逐渐变化时，可塑性损失显著减轻。
Motivation: 现有持续学习研究大多基于任务突变的基准，忽略了突变性本身对可塑性损失的影响。本文旨在探究任务转换的突变性在神经网络可塑性损失中的作用。
Method: 通过输入/输出插值和任务采样模拟逐渐变化的环境，进行理论和实证分析，比较突变与渐变条件下的可塑性损失程度。
Result: 理论和实验表明，可塑性损失的严重程度与任务转换的突变性密切相关，当环境逐渐变化时，可塑性损失大幅减少。
Conclusion: 任务转换的突变性是导致神经网络可塑性损失的重要因素，在更自然的渐变环境中，可塑性损失问题可能不如先前研究认为的严重。

papers.title: Towards Understanding What State Space Models Learn About Code
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) have emerged as an efficient alternative to the Transformer architecture. Prior work shows that, when trained under comparable conditions, SSMs can match or surpass Transformers on code understanding tasks. However, their internal mechanisms remain a black box. We present the first systematic analysis of what SSM-based code models learn along with the direct comparison between SSM and Transformer models in this domain. Our analysis shows that SSMs capture syntactic and semantic structure more effectively than Transformers during pretraining but forgets certain relations during fine-tuning on some tasks. To investigate this behavior, we introduce SSM-Interpret, a frequency-domain framework that exposes a spectral shift toward short-range dependencies during fine-tuning. Guided by these findings, we propose architectural modifications that significantly improve the performance of SSM-based code model by upto +6 MRR on NLCodeSearch. This demonstrates that our analysis not only explains model behavior but also leads directly to better designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性分析基于状态空间模型（SSM）的代码模型所学内容，并与Transformer对比。摘要表明SSM在预训练中更有效捕获句法和语义结构，但在微调时遗忘某些关系。作者提出频域分析框架SSM-Interpret，揭示微调期间频谱向短距离依赖偏移，并据此提出架构改进，在NLCodeSearch上MRR提升最多+6。
Motivation: SSM在代码理解任务上可媲美或超越Transformer，但其内部机制仍为黑箱，缺乏对SSM学习表示的理解。
Method: 提出SSM-Interpret频域分析框架，用于暴露微调过程中的频谱偏移；并基于发现改进SSM架构。
Result: 改进后的模型在NLCodeSearch上MRR提升最多+6。
Conclusion: 分析不仅解释了模型行为，还直接指导了更好的设计。

papers.title: Sequential Auditing for f-Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: We present new auditors to assess Differential Privacy (DP) of an algorithm based on output samples. Such empirical auditors are common to check for algorithmic correctness and implementation bugs. Most existing auditors are batch-based or targeted toward the traditional notion of $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP; typically both. In this work, we shift the focus to the highly expressive privacy concept of $f$-DP, in which the entire privacy behavior is captured by a single tradeoff curve. Our auditors detect violations across the full privacy spectrum with statistical significance guarantees, which are supported by theory and simulations. Most importantly, and in contrast to prior work, our auditors do not require a user-specified sample size as an input. Rather, they adaptively determine a near-optimal number of samples needed to reach a decision, thereby avoiding the excessively large sample sizes common in many auditing studies. This reduction in sampling cost becomes especially beneficial for expensive training procedures such as DP-SGD. Our method supports both whitebox and blackbox settings and can also be executed in one-run frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向f-差分隐私（f-DP）的序列审计器，能够自适应确定所需样本数量，在统计显著性保证下检测隐私违规，并支持白盒与黑盒设置，避免传统审计中样本量过大的问题。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私审计器多针对传统(ε,δ)-DP且需要预先指定样本量，导致样本浪费或审计不充分；f-DP作为一种更表达力的隐私概念，缺乏相应的高效审计方法。
Method: 提出一个序列审计框架，基于权衡曲线检测全隐私谱上的违规，自适应地决定最优样本数（而非固定样本量），可在白盒和黑盒设置下运行，并支持一次性运行。
Result: 理论分析和仿真验证了统计显著性保证；相比批处理方法，自适应样本量显著降低了审计成本，尤其对DP-SGD等昂贵训练过程有利。
Conclusion: 本文提出的审计器为f-DP提供了高效且统计可靠的验证工具，减少了样本开销并扩展了审计的适用场景。

papers.title: Ultrafast On-chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Ultrafast online learning is essential for high-frequency systems, such as controls for quantum computing and nuclear fusion, where adaptation must occur on sub-microsecond timescales. Meeting these requirements demands low-latency, fixed-precision computation under strict memory constraints, a regime in which conventional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are both inefficient and numerically unstable. We identify key properties of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that align with these constraints. Specifically, we show that: (i) KAN updates exploiting B-spline locality are sparse, enabling superior on-chip resource scaling, and (ii) KANs are inherently robust to fixed-point quantization. By implementing fixed-point online training on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), a representative platform for on-chip computation, we demonstrate that KAN-based online learners are significantly more efficient and expressive than MLPs across a range of low-latency and resource-constrained tasks. To our knowledge, this work is the first to demonstrate model-free online learning at sub-microsecond latencies.
papers.comment: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文针对亚微秒级在线学习需求，利用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的B样条局部性和对定点量化的鲁棒性，在FPGA上高效实现在线学习。摘要显示KAN在资源受限的低延迟任务中比MLP更高效且更具表现力，首次实现了亚微秒延迟的无模型在线学习。
Motivation: 高频系统（如量子计算、核聚变控制）要求亚微秒级自适应，但传统MLP在低延迟、固定精度、严格内存约束下效率低且数值不稳定。
Method: 利用KAN的B样条局部性使更新稀疏，从而优化片上资源扩展；同时利用KAN对定点量化的固有机理，在FPGA上实现定点在线训练。
Result: 在低延迟和资源受限的任务中，KAN基在线学习器在效率和表现力上显著优于MLP。首次实现亚微秒延迟的无模型在线学习。
Conclusion: 摘要强调KAN在超快在线学习场景中的潜力，特别是其稀疏更新和量化鲁棒性使得在FPGA上高效实现成为可能。

papers.title: KANELÉ: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Efficient LUT-based Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Low-latency, resource-efficient neural network inference on FPGAs is essential for applications demanding real-time capability and low power. Lookup table (LUT)-based neural networks are a common solution, combining strong representational power with efficient FPGA implementation. In this work, we introduce KANELÉ, a framework that exploits the unique properties of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for FPGA deployment. Unlike traditional multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), KANs employ learnable one-dimensional splines with fixed domains as edge activations, a structure naturally suited to discretization and efficient LUT mapping. We present the first systematic design flow for implementing KANs on FPGAs, co-optimizing training with quantization and pruning to enable compact, high-throughput, and low-latency KAN architectures. Our results demonstrate up to a 2700x speedup and orders of magnitude resource savings compared to prior KAN-on-FPGA approaches. Moreover, KANELÉ matches or surpasses other LUT-based architectures on widely used benchmarks, particularly for tasks involving symbolic or physical formulas, while balancing resource usage across FPGA hardware. Finally, we showcase the versatility of the framework by extending it to real-time, power-efficient control systems.
papers.comment: International Symposium on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays 2026 (ISFPGA'2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KANELÉ 框架，利用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络 (KAN) 的固有可离散化特性，将其高效映射到 FPGA 上的查找表 (LUT) 中。通过联合优化训练、量化和剪枝，实现紧凑、高吞吐、低延迟的 KAN 架构，相比先前方法加速 2700x 并节省大量资源，在符号和物理公式任务中匹配或超越其他 LUT 网络。
Motivation: 实时低功耗应用需要低延迟、资源高效的 FPGA 推理，LUT 基神经网络是常见方案；KAN 使用可学习一维样条作为激活，天然适合离散化和 LUT 映射，但缺乏系统性的 FPGA 部署流程。
Method: 提出首个系统性 KAN 到 FPGA 的设计流程，联合优化训练过程与量化、剪枝，利用 KAN 的固定域样条结构进行高效 LUT 映射。
Result: 相比此前 KAN-on-FPGA 方法实现高达 2700 倍加速和数量级资源节省，在广泛基准上匹配或超越其他 LUT 架构，尤其擅长符号或物理公式任务。
Conclusion: KANELÉ 展示了在实时、低功耗控制系统中的扩展潜力，验证了框架的通用性。

papers.title: A Streaming Sparse Cholesky Method for Derivative-Informed Gaussian Process Surrogates Within Digital Twin Applications
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins are developed to model the behavior of a specific physical asset (or twin), and they can consist of high-fidelity physics-based models or surrogates. A highly accurate surrogate is often preferred over multi-physics models as they enable forecasting the physical twin future state in real-time. To adapt to a specific physical twin, the digital twin model must be updated using in-service data from that physical twin. In this paper, we combine and extend several previous surrogate-related advancements with the goal of demonstrating an end-to-end digital twin (DT) solution for predicting performance of an aircraft structure (the physical asset). To this end, we extend Gaussian process (GP) models to include derivative data, for improved accuracy, with dynamic updating to ingest physical twin data during service. Including derivative data, however, comes at a prohibitive cost of increased covariance matrix dimension. We circumvent this issue through our modified dynamic sparse Cholesky linear system solver. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the prediction accuracy of the derivative-enhanced sparse Cholesky GP method produces improved models upon dynamic data additions. Lastly, we demonstrate the developed algorithm within a DT framework to model fatigue crack growth in an aerospace vehicle, thereby exhibiting through our assembled engineered system how digital twin technologies can be combined in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合导数信息的流式稀疏Cholesky高斯过程方法，用于数字孪生中对物理资产（如飞机结构）进行实时预测和动态更新。该方法通过改进的稀疏Cholesky线性系统求解器，在包含导数数据时有效控制协方差矩阵维度增长，并在疲劳裂纹扩展数字孪生框架中展示了实用性。
Motivation: 数字孪生需要高精度代理模型实时预测物理资产状态，且需利用在役数据动态更新。高斯过程模型虽适合，但引入导数数据会大幅增加协方差矩阵维度，导致计算成本过高。
Method: 扩展高斯过程以包含导数数据，并设计改进的动态稀疏Cholesky线性系统求解器，以流式方式处理更新，降低计算负担。
Result: 数值实验表明，导数增强的稀疏Cholesky高斯过程方法在动态数据添加时模型精度提升，并在航空飞行器疲劳裂纹增长数字孪生框架中成功应用。
Conclusion: 该方法为数字孪生中高效融合导数信息和动态更新提供了可行方案，但仅针对结构力学领域验证，未涉及其他物理系统。

papers.title: R2BC: Multi-Agent Imitation Learning from Single-Agent Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Imitation Learning (IL) is a natural way for humans to teach robots, particularly when high-quality demonstrations are easy to obtain. While IL has been widely applied to single-robot settings, relatively few studies have addressed the extension of these methods to multi-agent systems, especially in settings where a single human must provide demonstrations to a team of collaborating robots. In this paper, we introduce and study Round-Robin Behavior Cloning (R2BC), a method that enables a single human operator to effectively train multi-robot systems through sequential, single-agent demonstrations. Our approach allows the human to teleoperate one agent at a time and incrementally teach multi-agent behavior to the entire system, without requiring demonstrations in the joint multi-agent action space. We show that R2BC methods match, and in some cases surpass, the performance of an oracle behavior cloning approach trained on privileged synchronized demonstrations across four multi-agent simulated tasks. Finally, we deploy R2BC on two physical robot tasks trained using real human demonstrations.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. In Proceedings: IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Round-Robin Behavior Cloning (R2BC)方法，使单个人类操作员通过顺序单智能体示范来训练多机器人系统，无需联合动作空间示范。在四个多智能体模拟任务上，R2BC匹配甚至超越基于特权同步示范的oracle行为克隆，并在两个物理机器人任务上部署。
Motivation: 模仿学习在单机器人设置中广泛应用，但扩展到多智能体系统时，单个人类难以提供多智能体联合示范。需要一种方法让人类通过单智能体示范有效训练多机器人团队。
Method: R2BC允许人类依次遥操作每个智能体，逐步教授整个系统的多智能体行为，不要求联合动作空间中的示范。采用循环行为克隆训练。
Result: 在四个多智能体模拟任务上，R2BC匹配或超越了基于特权同步示范的oracle行为克隆；在物理机器人任务上使用真实人类示范验证。
Conclusion: R2BC是有效的从单智能体示范扩展到多智能体系统的方法，但可能受限于任务复杂度和示范质量。

papers.title: The Personalization Trap: How User Memory Alters Emotional Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: When an AI assistant remembers that Sarah is a single mother working two jobs, does it interpret her stress differently than if she were a wealthy executive? As personalized AI systems increasingly incorporate long-term user memory, understanding how this memory shapes emotional reasoning is critical. We investigate how user memory affects emotional intelligence in large language models (LLMs) by evaluating 15 models on human-validated emotional intelligence tests. We find that identical scenarios paired with different user profiles produce systematically divergent emotional interpretations. Across validated user-independent emotional scenarios and diverse user profiles, systematic biases emerged in several high-performing LLMs where advantaged profiles received more accurate emotional interpretations. Moreover, LLMs demonstrate significant disparities across demographic factors in emotion reasoning and supportive recommendations tasks, indicating that personalization mechanisms can embed social hierarchies into models' emotional reasoning. These results highlight a key challenge for memory-enhanced AI: systems designed for personalization may reinforce social inequalities. To mitigate these disparities, we curate a general-purpose preference dataset designed to reduce demographic profiles' influence on emotional understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用户记忆如何影响大型语言模型的情感智能。通过评估15个模型在人类验证的情感智能测试上的表现，发现相同的场景配以不同的用户档案会导致系统性的情感解读差异。优势档案获得更准确的情感解读，表明个性化机制可能将社会等级嵌入模型的情感推理中。
Motivation: 随着个性化AI系统越来越多地融入长期用户记忆，理解这种记忆如何塑造情感推理至关重要，尤其是可能带来的社会偏见和不平等。
Method: 在人类验证的情感智能测试上评估15个LLM，使用不同的用户档案（如单亲母亲 vs. 富裕高管）来测试情感解读的准确性。
Result: 发现优势档案（如富裕高管）获得了更准确的情感解读，而劣势档案（如单亲母亲）则受到系统性偏见。模型在情感推理和支持性推荐任务中存在显著的人口统计差异。
Conclusion: 个性化机制可能强化社会不平等，需要开发减少人口统计档案影响的情感理解数据集。

summary_sections.result: 发现优势档案（如富裕高管）获得了更准确的情感解读，而劣势档案（如单亲母亲）则受到系统性偏见。模型在情感推理和支持性推荐任务中存在显著的人口统计差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 个性化机制可能强化社会不平等，需要开发减少人口统计档案影响的情感理解数据集。

papers.title: FORGE: Foundational Optimization Representations from Graph Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial optimization problems are ubiquitous in science and engineering. Still, learning-based approaches to accelerate combinatorial optimization often require solving a large number of difficult instances to collect training data, incurring significant computational cost. Existing learning-based methods require training dedicated models for each problem distribution, for each downstream task, severely limiting their scalability and generalization. We introduce Forge: Foundational Optimization Representations from Graph Embeddings, a framework that pre-trains a vector-quantized graph autoencoder on a large, diverse collection of mixed-integer programming (MIP) instances in an unsupervised manner, without relying on optimization solvers or optimal solutions. Vector quantization produces discrete code assignments that serve as a vocabulary for representing optimization instances. We evaluate Forge in both unsupervised and supervised settings. In the unsupervised setting, Forge embeddings effectively cluster unseen instances across problem domains and sizes. In the supervised setting, we fine-tune Forge embeddings and show that a single pre-trained model helps predicting both the integrality gap for cut-generation and variable hints for search guidance across multiple problem and size distributions. In both tasks, we improve the performance of a commercial optimization solver and outperform state-of-the-art learning-based methods. Finally, we open-source our training code, pre-trained Forge weights, and embeddings for multiple MIP distributions to foster further research in representation learning for optimization problems https://skadio.github.io/forge/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Forge 框架，利用矢量量化图自编码器 (vector-quantized graph autoencoder) 对大量混合整数规划 (MIP) 实例进行无监督预训练，生成离散编码作为优化实例的表示。该表示在无监督设置下能有效聚类未见实例，在监督设置下微调后可预测积分间隙 (integrality gap) 和变量提示 (variable hints)，从而提升商业求解器性能并超越现有学习方法。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的组合优化方法需为每个问题分布和下游任务训练专用模型，可扩展性与泛化性差，且收集训练数据计算成本高昂。
Method: 提出 Forge，通过矢量量化图自编码器对大规模多样化 MIP 实例进行无监督预训练，产生离散编码词汇表作为优化实例的通用表示。
Result: 在无监督设置中，Forge 嵌入有效聚类跨领域和大小的未见实例；在监督设置中，单一预训练模型可同时用于预测积分间隙和生成变量提示，在多个问题和大小分布上提升商业求解器性能，并超越现有学习方法。
Conclusion: 作者开源训练代码、预训练权重及多种 MIP 分布的嵌入，以促进优化问题表示学习的进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unreduced Persistence Diagrams for Topological Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised machine learning pipelines trained on features derived from persistent homology have been experimentally observed to ignore much of the information contained in a persistence diagram. Computing persistence diagrams is often the most computationally demanding step in such a pipeline, however. To explore this dynamic, we introduce several methods to generate topological feature vectors from unreduced boundary matrices and investigate their theoretical and computational properties. We compared the performance of pipelines trained on vectorizations of unreduced PDs to vectorizations of fully-reduced PDs across several data and task types. Our results indicate that models trained on PDs built from unreduced diagrams can perform on par and even outperform those trained on fully-reduced diagrams on some tasks. We also benchmarked the computational performance of an algorithm for computing unreduced diagrams, which was implemented as a heavily modified version of Ripser. These computations are parallelizable and required an order of magnitude less memory on average compared to computing full persistence diagrams. Our results suggest that machine learning pipelines which incorporate topology-based features may benefit in terms of computational cost and performance by utilizing information contained in unreduced boundary matrices.
papers.comment: Substantially expanded to include additional ML and software benchmark experiments. 11 figures, 4 tables, 20 pages (without appendix and references)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了在监督机器学习流水线中使用未约简的边界矩阵生成拓扑特征向量的方法，与基于完全约简的持续同调图（PD）的方法进行比较。实验表明，基于未约简图的模型在部分任务上表现相当甚至更好，且计算所需内存平均低一个数量级，且可并行化。
Motivation: 观察到基于持续同调的机器学习流水线中，持续同调图包含的信息往往被忽略，而计算完全约简图是计算瓶颈。本文旨在探索利用未约简边界矩阵是否能更高效地提取拓扑特征。
Method: 提出了几种从未约简边界矩阵生成拓扑特征向量的方法，并比较了未约简图与完全约简图向量化后训练模型的性能。计算未约简图的算法基于Ripser的修改版本，支持并行化且内存需求更低。
Result: 在多种数据和任务类型上，基于未约简图训练的模型性能与基于完全约简图的模型相当，部分任务上更优；计算未约简图所需内存平均低一个数量级。
Conclusion: 利用未约简边界矩阵的信息可以在计算成本和性能上带来收益，建议拓扑特征机器学习流水线考虑使用未约简图。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decomposing Prediction Mechanisms for In-Context Recall
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new family of toy problems that combine features of linear-regression-style continuous in-context learning (ICL) with discrete associative recall. We pretrain transformer models on sample traces from this toy, specifically symbolically-labeled interleaved state observations from randomly drawn linear deterministic dynamical systems. We study if the transformer models can recall the state of a sequence previously seen in its context when prompted to do so with the corresponding in-context label. Taking a closer look at this task, it becomes clear that the model must perform two functions: (1) identify which system's state should be recalled and apply that system to its last seen state, and (2) continuing to apply the correct system to predict the subsequent states. Training dynamics reveal that the first capability emerges well into a model's training. Surprisingly, the second capability, of continuing the prediction of a resumed sequence, develops much earlier. Via out-of-distribution experiments, and a mechanistic analysis on model weights via edge pruning, we find that next-token prediction for this toy problem involves at least two separate mechanisms. One mechanism uses the discrete symbolic labels to do the associative recall required to predict the start of a resumption of a previously seen sequence. The second mechanism, which is largely agnostic to the discrete symbolic labels, performs a "Bayesian-style" prediction based on the previous token and the context. These two mechanisms have different learning dynamics. To confirm that this multi-mechanism (manifesting as separate phase transitions) phenomenon is not just an artifact of our toy setting, we used OLMo training checkpoints on an ICL translation task to see a similar phenomenon: a decisive gap in the emergence of first-task-token performance vs second-task-token performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一类结合线性回归式连续上下文学习（ICL）与离散联想回忆的玩具问题，并在随机线性确定性动力系统的符号标记状态序列上预训练Transformer。研究发现模型需执行两种功能：一是识别需回忆的系统并应用该系统到最新状态，二是继续应用正确系统预测后续状态。训练动态表明第一种能力在训练后期才涌现，而第二种能力出现更早。通过分布外实验和边缘剪枝机制分析，发现下一token预测涉及至少两种独立机制：一种利用离散符号标签进行联想回忆，另一种对离散符号标签基本不敏感，基于前一个token和上下文执行“贝叶斯式”预测。两种机制具有不同的学习动力学。在OLMo的ICL翻译任务检查点上也观察到类似的多机制现象（表现为分离的相变）。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对Transformer在需要同时处理连续回归和离散回忆的混合任务中内部机制的理解，特别是两种能力如何涌现及其相互作用。
Method: 设计玩具问题：从随机线性确定性动力系统中采样带有符号标签的交错状态观测序列，预训练Transformer进行状态回忆任务。通过边缘剪枝（edge pruning）对模型权重进行机制分析，并结合分布外实验分离不同机制。
Result: 发现联想回忆机制（基于标签）和贝叶斯预测机制（基于上下文）具有不同的学习动态：前者在训练后期才涌现，后者更早出现。在OLMo的ICL翻译任务检查点上也观察到类似的第一任务token与第二任务token性能涌现的显著差距。
Conclusion: 多机制共存且分阶段涌现的现象并非玩具设置特例，在更真实的ICL任务中也有体现，表明理解Transformer的ICL需要同时考虑离散和连续信息处理路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Memorization to Parameter Interference: How Overtraining Experts Harms Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning is increasingly characterized by the use of open-weight foundation models that can be fine-tuned on specialized datasets. This has led to a proliferation of expert models and adapters, often shared via platforms like HuggingFace and AdapterHub. Model merging has recently emerged as an effective way to leverage these existing resources, enabling the composition of capabilities from different model checkpoints. A natural pipeline has thus formed to harness the benefits of transfer learning and amortize sunk training costs: models are pre-trained on general data, fine-tuned on specific tasks, and then multiple checkpoints are merged to obtain a more capable model. A prevailing assumption is that improvements at one stage of this pipeline propagate downstream, leading to gains at subsequent steps. In this work, we challenge that assumption by examining how expert fine-tuning affects model merging. We show that long fine-tuning of experts that optimizes for their individual performance leads to degraded merging performance across vision and language modalities, multiple model scales, and both fully fine-tuned and LoRA-adapted models. We trace this degradation to the memorization of a small set of difficult examples that dominate late fine-tuning steps. This causes negative parameter interference and encodes knowledge that is forgotten during merging. Finally, we demonstrate that task-dependent aggressive early stopping strategies can significantly improve model merging performance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了深度学习中预训练-微调-合并管道的常见假设，发现专家模型过训练会损害模型合并性能。实验表明，长时间微调以优化个体性能会导致在视觉和语言模态、多种模型规模及全量微调和LoRA适配上的合并效果下降。该退化归因于对少量困难样本的记忆，这些样本主导了后期微调步骤，引起负参数干扰，且编码的知识在合并中被遗忘。任务相关的早停策略能显著改善合并性能。
Motivation: 当前模型合并方法假设微调阶段提升能直接迁移到合并阶段，但该假设尚未被验证。本文旨在探究专家微调（尤其是过训练）如何影响后续模型合并。
Method: 通过在视觉和语言任务上对多种模型（全量微调及LoRA）进行不同长度的微调，然后合并检查点，系统评估过训练对合并性能的影响。进一步分析记忆化与参数干扰的关系，并提出基于早停的缓解策略。
Result: 长时间微调导致合并性能显著下降，该现象在多个模态和模型规模中成立。退化原因是模型记忆了少量困难样本，造成负参数干扰。任务相关的激进早停可大幅提升合并效果。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了专家过训练对模型合并的负面影响，指出记忆化与参数干扰是关键机制，并提出早停作为实用解决方案。该发现对开放权重模型微调和合并实践具有指导意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stimulus Motion Perception Studies Imply Specific Neural Computations in Human Visual Stabilization
papers.abstract_en: Even during fixation the human eye is constantly in low amplitude motion, jittering over small angles in random directions at up to 100Hz. This motion results in all features of the image on the retina constantly traversing a number of cones, yet objects which are stable in the world are perceived to be stable, and any object which is moving in the world is perceived to be moving. A series of experiments carried out over a dozen years revealed the psychophysics of visual stabilization to be more nuanced than might be assumed, say, from the mechanics of stabilization of camera images, or what might be assumed to be the simplest solution from an evolutionary perspective. The psychophysics revealed by the experiments strongly implies a specific set of operations on retinal signals resulting in the observed stabilization behavior. The presentation is in two levels. First is a functional description of the action of the mechanism that is very likely responsible for the experimentally observed behavior. Second is a more speculative proposal of circuit-level neural elements that might implement the functional behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一系列持续十余年的心理物理学实验，揭示了人类视觉稳定机制远比简单的图像稳定或进化上的简单方案更为精细。研究发现，尽管眼球在注视时持续存在高达100Hz的随机微小运动，导致视网膜图像不断移动，但人眼仍能稳定感知静止物体并识别运动物体。论文提出了一个功能层面的机制描述，并进一步推测了可能实现该功能的电路级神经元件。
Motivation: 理解人类视觉系统如何在眼球持续微小运动的情况下维持稳定感知，以及如何区分真实运动与自身运动产生的视网膜图像位移。
Method: 基于一系列心理物理学实验结果，推导出视觉稳定所依赖的特定视网膜信号操作，并构建功能模型，进而提出电路级神经实现假设。
Result: 实验表明视觉稳定的心理物理学特性比基于相机稳定或进化简单解的假设更为复杂，强烈暗示了视网膜信号处理中一组特定的运算。
Conclusion: 论文认为该工作提供了对视觉稳定机制的功能性解释，并指出了通往神经电路级别实现的路径，但电路级部分仍属推测。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 基于一系列心理物理学实验结果，推导出视觉稳定所依赖的特定视网膜信号操作，并构建功能模型，进而提出电路级神经实现假设。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明视觉稳定的心理物理学特性比基于相机稳定或进化简单解的假设更为复杂，强烈暗示了视网膜信号处理中一组特定的运算。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文认为该工作提供了对视觉稳定机制的功能性解释，并指出了通往神经电路级别实现的路径，但电路级部分仍属推测。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) has proven effective for addressing complex, high-dimensional tasks, but current approaches often rely on static, manually engineered multi-agent configurations. To overcome these constraints, we present the Agentic Neural Network (ANN), a framework that conceptualizes multi-agent collaboration as a layered neural network architecture. In this design, each agent operates as a node, and each layer forms a cooperative team focused on a specific subtask. Our framework follows a two-phase optimization strategy: (1) Forward Phase - Drawing inspiration from neural network forward passes, tasks are dynamically decomposed into subtasks, and cooperative agent teams with suitable aggregation methods are constructed layer by layer. (2) Backward Phase - Mirroring backpropagation, we refine both global and local collaboration through iterative feedback, allowing agents to self-evolve their roles, prompts, and coordination. This neuro-symbolic approach enables our framework to create new or specialized agent teams post-training, delivering notable gains in accuracy and adaptability. Across seven benchmark datasets, our work surpasses leading multi-agent baselines under the same configurations, showing consistent performance improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic Neural Network (ANN)框架，将多智能体协作建模为分层神经网络架构，通过前向阶段动态分解任务并构建协作团队，反向阶段模仿反向传播进行迭代反馈优化，使智能体自我演化角色、提示和协调策略。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖静态、手动配置的多智能体系统，难以适应复杂任务和动态环境。
Method: 提出两阶段优化：前向阶段动态分解任务并逐层构建协作团队；反向阶段通过迭代反馈优化全局与局部协作，实现智能体自我演化。
Result: 在七个基准数据集上，该方法在相同配置下超越主流多智能体基线，取得一致性能提升。
Conclusion: 该神经符号框架可在训练后创建新或专门化智能体团队，提升准确性和适应性。

papers.title: Signals of Provenance: Practices & Challenges of Navigating Indicators in AI-Generated Media for Sighted and Blind Individuals
papers.abstract_en: AI-Generated (AIG) content has become increasingly widespread by recent advances in generative models and the easy-to-use tools that have significantly lowered the technical barriers for producing highly realistic audio, images, and videos through simple natural language prompts. In response, platforms are adopting provable provenance with platforms recommending AIG to be self-disclosed and signaled to users. However, these indicators may be often missed, especially when they rely solely on visual cues and make them ineffective to users with different sensory abilities. To address the gap, we conducted semi-structured interviews (N=28) with 15 sighted and 13 BLV participants to examine their interaction with AIG content through self-disclosed AI indicators. Our findings reveal diverse mental models and practices, highlighting different strengths and weaknesses of content-based (e.g., title, description) and menu-aided (e.g., AI labels) indicators. While sighted participants leveraged visual and audio cues, BLV participants primarily relied on audio and existing assistive tools, limiting their ability to identify AIG. Across both groups, they frequently overlooked menu-aided indicators deployed by platforms and rather interacted with content-based indicators such as title and comments. We uncovered usability challenges stemming from inconsistent indicator placement, unclear metadata, and cognitive overload. These issues were especially critical for BLV individuals due to the insufficient accessibility of interface elements. We provide practical recommendations and design implications for future AIG indicators across several dimensions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过半结构化访谈（N=28），对比15名视力正常者与13名盲人或低视力（BLV）者对AI生成内容中自披露溯源指示器的使用情况，发现两类人群依赖不同的线索（视觉/音频 vs. 辅助工具），且普遍忽略菜单辅助指示器而更关注内容本身的标签（如标题、评论）。研究指出指示器放置不一致、元数据不清晰及认知过载等可用性问题，尤其对BLV用户因界面无障碍不足更为严重。
Motivation: AI生成内容日益普及，平台要求自披露并添加指示器，但现有指示器多依赖视觉线索，可能对感官能力不同的用户无效，尤其缺乏对盲人和低视力群体的研究。
Method: 采用半结构化访谈法，招募15名视力正常者和13名BLV参与者，收集他们与AI生成内容及自披露指示器的交互体验，分析基于内容的指示器（如标题、描述）和菜单辅助指示器（如AI标签）的优缺点。
Result: 视力正常者利用视觉和音频线索，BLV者主要依赖音频和现有辅助工具，两者都频繁忽略菜单辅助指示器而更关注内容本身；可用性问题包括指示器位置不一致、元数据不清晰和认知负荷过重，对BLV影响更大。
Conclusion: 建议未来AI生成内容的指示器设计应兼顾不同感官能力，提供更一致、易访问的界面元素，并改进元数据呈现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RUB: Evaluating Residual Knowledge in Unlearned Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine Unlearning (MUL) has emerged as a key mechanism for privacy protection and content regulation, yet current techniques often fail to guarantee the complete removal of sensitive information. While most existing works focus on verifying the execution of unlearning, they overlook the critical question of whether models remain robust against adversarial attempts to recover forgotten knowledge. In this work, we advocate for the principle of Robust Unlearning, which requires models to be both indistinguishable from retrained counterparts and resilient against diverse adversarial threats. To instantiate this principle, we propose a unified benchmark, RUB (Robust Unlearning Benchmark), that systematically evaluates the robustness of unlearning algorithms across classification, image-to-image reconstruction, and text-to-image synthesis. Within this framework, we introduce the Unlearning Mapping Attack (UMA) as a generalizable method to detect residual information, and demonstrate how existing attack strategies can be adapted into this framework as long as they conform to the generic UMA framework. Our experiments across discriminative and generative tasks reveal that state-of-the-art unlearning methods remain vulnerable under these evaluations, even when passing standard verification metrics. By positioning robustness as the central criterion and providing a benchmark for adversarial evaluation, we hope RUB paves the way toward more reliable and secure unlearning practices. The codebase and model checkpoints in RUB will be published.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Workshops, June 2026, pages 8550-8559
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出鲁棒遗忘原则，要求模型既与重训练模型不可区分，又对多种对抗攻击鲁棒。为此构建统一基准RUB，包含分类、图像重建、文本到图像合成任务，并引入遗忘映射攻击（UMA）检测残余信息。实验表明现有遗忘方法即使通过标准验证指标仍存在脆弱性。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法往往只验证执行过程而忽略模型在对抗恢复下的鲁棒性，缺乏对残余信息的系统评估。
Method: 提出鲁棒遗忘原则，构建RUB基准，包括分类、图像到图像重建、文本到图像合成任务；设计通用化的遗忘映射攻击（UMA）检测残余信息，并将现有攻击策略适配进该框架。
Result: 在判别式和生成式任务上的实验显示，当前最先进的遗忘方法在对抗评估中仍然脆弱，即使通过了标准验证指标。
Conclusion: 将鲁棒性作为核心标准并提供对抗评估基准，有助于更可靠和安全的遗忘实践。代码和模型将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FinP: Fairness-in-Privacy in Federated Learning by Addressing Disparities in Privacy Risk
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) inherently mitigates mass data centralization risks; however, its privacy protections are not equally distributed - leaving vulnerable individuals disproportionately exposed to sophisticated privacy attacks. Crucially, statistical heterogeneity in human-centric FL environments often results in an inequitable distribution of privacy risks, particularly affecting those whose sensitive attributes or behaviors make them outliers. To address this critical gap, we introduce FinP, a novel framework designed to formalize and enforce fairness-in-privacy by mitigating disproportionate client vulnerability to Source Inference Attacks (SIA). FinP operationalizes a two-pronged defense strategy that tackles both the symptoms and root causes of privacy disparity, ensuring that no group of clients bears an excessive privacy burden. It combines a server-side adaptive aggregation mechanism, which dynamically weights client contributions based on their estimated privacy risk, with a client-side regularization technique to curb localized overfitting that drives unique data memorization. Extensive empirical evaluations on FEMNIST, Human Activity Recognition (HAR), and CIFAR-10 datasets demonstrate that FinP effectively aligns privacy fairness with primary task utility. Notably, FinP successfully mitigates SIA risks and reduces disparities in privacy exposure, establishing that strong fairness-in-privacy guarantees need not compromise model utility. Ultimately, FinP establishes equitable privacy protections by reducing vulnerability disparities by up to 57.14%, while preserving global model utility within a marginal +/- 1.75% of standard federated baselines.
papers.comment: To appear in PoPETS 2026 Issue 4. Privacy Enhancing Technology Symposium (PETS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FinP框架，解决联邦学习中隐私风险分布不均的问题，特别是针对源推断攻击（SIA）的公平性。方法包括服务器端自适应聚合和客户端正则化，在FEMNIST、HAR和CIFAR-10上验证，将隐私风险差异降低57.14%，同时全局模型效用仅波动±1.75%。
Motivation: 联邦学习虽然缓解数据集中风险，但隐私保护不均衡，脆弱个体更容易受到隐私攻击，尤其是统计异质性导致隐私风险不公平分布。
Method: 采用双管齐下的防御策略：服务器端自适应聚合机制动态权重客户端贡献基于预估隐私风险；客户端正则化技术限制局部过拟合，防止数据记忆。
Result: 在三个数据集上，将SIA风险差异降低57.14%，全局模型效用相对标准FL基线仅波动±1.75%。
Conclusion: FinP表明强隐私公平性保证不必牺牲模型效用，能够在不损害性能的前提下实现公平隐私保护。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Zeroth-Order Federated Finetuning of Language Models on Resource-Constrained Devices
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is a promising paradigm for finetuning Large Language Models (LLMs) across distributed data sources while preserving data privacy. However, finetuning such large models is challenging on edge devices due to its high resource demand. Zeroth-order Optimization (ZO) estimates gradients through finite-difference approximations, which rely on function evaluations under random perturbations of the model parameters. Consequently, ZO with task alignment provides a potential solution, allowing finetuning using only forward passes with inference-level memory requirements and low communication overhead, but it suffers from slow convergence and higher computational demand. In this paper, we propose a new ZO-based method that applies a more efficient technique to reduce the computational demand associated with using a large number of perturbations while preserving their convergence benefits. This is achieved by splitting the model into consecutive blocks and allocating a higher number of perturbations to the second block, enabling efficient reuse of intermediate activations to update the full network with fewer forward evaluations. Our evaluation on RoBERTa-large, OPT1.3B, LLaMa-3-3.2B models shows up to $3\times$ reduction in computation compared to the other ZO-based techniques, while retaining the memory and communication benefits over first-order federated learning techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限设备上联邦微调大语言模型的高计算需求问题，提出一种基于零阶优化（ZO）的高效方法。通过将模型分为连续块并给第二块分配更多扰动，复用中间激活来减少前向评估次数，从而降低计算量。在RoBERTa-large、OPT1.3B、LLaMa-3-3.2B模型上，与其它ZO方法相比计算量降低最多3倍，同时保留内存和通信优势。
Motivation: 联邦微调大语言模型在边缘设备上面临高资源需求挑战，现有零阶优化方法收敛慢且计算需求高。
Method: 提出一种新的ZO方法：将模型拆分为连续块，对第二块分配更多随机扰动，通过复用中间激活来更新整个网络，减少前向评估次数。
Result: 在RoBERTa-large、OPT1.3B、LLaMa-3-3.2B模型上，与其它ZO方法相比计算量降低最多3倍，同时保留内存和通信优势。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持零阶优化内存和通信优势的同时，显著降低了计算需求，适合资源受限设备上的联邦微调。

papers.title: Distributional Instrumental Variable Method
papers.abstract_en: The instrumental variable (IV) approach is commonly used to infer causal effects in the presence of unmeasured confounding. Existing methods typically aim to estimate the mean causal effects, whereas a few other methods focus on quantile treatment effects. The aim of this work is to estimate the entire interventional distribution. We propose a method called Distributional Instrumental Variable (DIV), which uses generative modelling in a nonlinear IV setting. We establish identifiability of the interventional distribution under general assumptions and demonstrate an 'under-identified' case, where DIV can identify the causal effects while two-step least squares fails to. Our empirical results show that the DIV method performs well for a broad range of simulated data, exhibiting advantages over existing IV approaches in terms of the identifiability and estimation error of the mean or quantile treatment effects. Furthermore, we apply DIV to an economic data set to examine the causal relation between institutional quality and economic development and our results align well with the original study. We also apply DIV to a single-cell data set, where we study the generalizability and stability in predicting gene expression under unseen interventions. The software implementations of DIV are available in R and Python.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分布工具变量方法（DIV），用于在存在未测量混杂时估计整个干预分布。通过生成建模和非线性工具变量设置，证明了干预分布的可识别性，并展示了在模拟数据和实际数据集上的优势。
Motivation: 现有工具变量方法主要估计均值或分位数因果效应，缺乏估计整个干预分布的方法。
Method: 提出DIV方法，使用生成建模在非线性工具变量设置中识别整个干预分布。
Result: 模拟实验表明DIV在可识别性和估计误差上优于现有IV方法；应用于经济数据和单细胞数据，结果与原始研究一致。
Conclusion: DIV能够识别两阶段最小二乘失败的因果效应，具有更广泛的适用性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出DIV方法，使用生成建模在非线性工具变量设置中识别整个干预分布。
summary_sections.result: 模拟实验表明DIV在可识别性和估计误差上优于现有IV方法；应用于经济数据和单细胞数据，结果与原始研究一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: DIV能够识别两阶段最小二乘失败的因果效应，具有更广泛的适用性。

papers.title: Recognizing and Reconstructing a Multi-Unit Floor Plan
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins have a major potential to form a significant part of urban management in emergency planning, as they allow more efficient designing of the escape routes, better orientation in exceptional situations, and faster rescue intervention. Nevertheless, creating the twins still remains a largely manual effort, due to a lack of 3D-representations, which are available only in limited amounts for some new buildings. Thus, in this paper we aim to synthesize 3D information from commonly available 2D architectural floor plans. We propose two novel pixel-wise segmentation methods based on the MDA-Unet and MACU-Net architectures with improved skip connections, an attention mechanism, and a training objective together with a reconstruction part of the pipeline, which vectorizes the segmented plans to create a 3D model. The proposed methods are compared with two other state-of-the-art techniques and several benchmark datasets. On the commonly used CubiCasa benchmark dataset, our methods have achieved the mean F1 score of 0.86 over five examined classes, outperforming the other pixel-wise approaches tested. We have also made our code publicly available to support research in the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从常见2D建筑平面图合成3D信息的方法，采用基于MDA-Unet和MACU-Net的像素级分割网络，结合改进跳跃连接、注意力机制和专用训练目标，并通过向量化分割结果生成3D模型。在CubiCasa基准数据集上，方法在五个类别上达到平均F1分数0.86，优于其他像素级方法。
Motivation: 数字孪生在城市应急管理中潜力巨大，但3D表示缺乏且手动创建费力，因此需要从广泛可用的2D平面图自动合成3D信息。
Method: 提出两种像素级分割方法（MDA-Unet和MACU-Net），改进跳跃连接、注意力机制和训练目标，并包含重建模块将分割结果向量化为3D模型。
Result: 在CubiCasa基准数据集上，五个类别的平均F1分数为0.86，优于其他像素级方法。
Conclusion: 方法有效实现了从2D平面图到3D模型的自动化，代码已公开以支持研究。

papers.title: Vibe Coding Ate My Homework: An evaluation of AI approaches to greenfield software engineering and programming
papers.abstract_en: Thanks to rapid developments in generative AI, we are in the midst of a paradigm shift that may change how we interact with computers forever. We have observed a growth in the use of natural language prompts to build applications and coding infrastructures without underlying knowledge of the field, and this practice has been dubbed `vibe coding.' It arguably represents what the field of programming has been building towards since the beginning, with every higher level of abstraction that is conceived. Vibe coding promises to be the endpoint for the meta of high-level programming as far as method of input is concerned: eliminating a human's use of code syntax entirely in favour of programming in their mother tongue. This paper aims to evaluate the viability of vibe coding for greenfield software engineering tasks, as well as analyse the benchmarks that have been used to measure its software engineering prowess. To this end, we have developed an evaluation suite for analysing an LLM's proficiency in carrying out simple, isolated greenfield programming tasks in Python to provide scoped insight on the matter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了'vibe coding'（使用自然语言提示进行编程）在绿地软件工程任务中的可行性，并开发了一个用于分析LLM在简单Python编程任务中熟练度的评估套件。研究旨在提供对vibe coding实际效用的初步见解。
Motivation: 随着生成式AI的发展，自然语言编程（vibe coding）逐渐流行，但缺乏对其在真实软件工程任务中可行性的系统评估。现有基准可能无法完全反映其能力。
Method: 设计了一个针对简单、孤立的Python绿地编程任务的评估套件，用于测试LLM的编程能力。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅提到通过该评估套件分析LLM的熟练度以提供见解。
Conclusion: vibe coding作为编程抽象的新范式，其端到端可行性仍需进一步评估；本文的评估套件为后续研究提供了基础工具。

papers.title: QSignAI: Quantum-Randomness-Seeded Identity Signatures at the Intersection of AI for Science and Science for AI
papers.abstract_en: The 2024-2025 Nobel and Turing awards recognised AI and quantum science simultaneously. Yet no deployed system has brought these streams together for the public. This paper presents QSignAI, a production-deployed platform demonstrating a bidirectional AI-quantum relationship in a real-time event participation system. We address three questions: can quantum-randomness generation via a two-source extractor be embedded in an AI-driven social platform with acceptable latency; can an AI bot make quantum phenomena perceptually legible to general audiences; and does the combined system work in practice? A conversational bot routes each participant's first message through a quantum pipeline comprising a Toeplitz two-source extractor over independent single-qubit Hadamard measurements on SV1 and DM1 simulators, plus a 2-qubit Bell state, producing a unique quantum-randomness-seeded identity signature per participant. The first two questions are answered through system architecture and qualitative deployment evidence from live events; the third through successful production deployment. The current deployment uses cloud quantum simulators; physical QPU randomness is the near-term extension. Measurable benchmarks are identified as priority future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍QSignAI，一个将量子随机数生成与AI社交平台结合的生产部署系统。通过Toeplitz双源提取器和单量子位测量为每个参与者生成唯一身份签名。系统已成功部署于实时事件，展示了双向AI-量子关系的可行性。
Motivation: 尽管2024-2025年诺贝尔奖和图灵奖同时认可了AI和量子科学，但尚无部署系统将它们结合为公众所用。QSignAI旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 系统包含一个对话机器人，将参与者的第一条消息路由通过量子管道：利用SV1和DM1模拟器上的独立单量子位Hadamard测量的Toeplitz双源提取器，以及一个2-qubit Bell态，为每个参与者生成唯一的量子随机种子身份签名。
Result: 摘要报告前两个问题通过系统架构和现场事件部署的定性证据得到回答，第三个问题通过成功的生产部署得到回答。当前部署使用云量子模拟器；物理QPU随机性是近期扩展；可测量基准被确定为优先未来工作。
Conclusion: 论文强调QSignAI是首个将AI与量子科学双向结合的生产部署系统，工作重点是实现量子随机性生成在AI平台中的可接受延迟，并让AI使量子现象对普通观众可感知。当前系统基于模拟器，未来将使用物理QPU，并需要进一步基准测试。

papers.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics and SDE-based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: SDE-based generative models, including diffusion models and the Schrödinger bridge, have found broad applications in signal processing tasks such as speech enhancement, image restoration, and time-series generation. This note presents a modeling framework for such models within the context of stochastic thermodynamics. The main results of this note are trajectory-level definitions of work, heat, and entropy production, along with a generalized Jarzynski identity and a second-law-like inequality. The proposed framework extends the original Jarzynski setup to accommodate time-dependent bath temperature and nonconservative driving forces. This thermodynamic perspective may deepen our understanding of diffusion models and the Schrödinger bridge from a nonequilibrium statistical mechanics viewpoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在随机热力学框架下为基于SDE的生成模型（扩散模型、薛定谔桥）建立了轨迹层次的功、热、熵产生定义，并推广了Jarzynski恒等式和类第二定律不等式。该框架将原始Jarzynski设置扩展到时变浴温度和非保守驱动力，为从非平衡统计力学角度理解扩散模型提供了新视角。
Motivation: 扩散模型和薛定谔桥等SDE生成模型在信号处理中广泛应用，但其背后的热力学理解尚不完善，缺乏从非平衡统计力学角度的统一框架。
Method: 提出一个基于随机热力学的建模框架，定义轨迹层次的功、热和熵产生，并推导广义Jarzynski恒等式和类第二定律不等式，允许时变浴温度和非保守驱动力。
Result: 给出了轨迹层次的功、热、熵产生的定义，并得到了广义Jarzynski恒等式和类第二定律不等式。
Conclusion: 该热力学视角可能加深对扩散模型和薛定谔桥的非平衡统计力学理解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Knowledge Theory of Capital:The Value of Natural and Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: This volume develops a knowledge theory of capital for economies in which productive capacity increasingly resides in software, data, models, routines, expertise, platforms, organizations, commons, and public epistemic infrastructure. Beginning from Adam Smith's theory of labour, stock, specialization, and market extent, it asks what changes when knowledge becomes stock-like, mobile across forms, scalable, governable, recombinable, and imperfectly visible in accounting. The book introduces knowledge-bearing stock as the central object and analyses how it is generated, converted into governable form, deployed, improved through feedback, enclosed or shared, measured, impaired, and used as input to future production. It distinguishes embodied, disembodied, institutionalized, commons, and public knowledge forms and develops concepts such as first conversion, cognitive enclosure, feedback capture, dark capital, and expected knowledge loss. The argument is conditional and testable: modern wealth depends not only on capital accumulation, but on how productive knowledge is governed.
papers.comment: 458 pages, 8 figures. Theory-building monograph developing a conditional framework for knowledge-bearing capitalism, with formal concepts, mechanisms, measurement apparatus, and falsification conditions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该卷书针对生产能力日益集中于软件、数据、模型、流程、专业知识、平台、组织、公共基础设施和公共知识基础的经济体，构建了一种资本的知识理论。基于亚当·斯密的劳动、资本、专业化和市场范围理论，探讨知识变得具有库存性、跨形式可移动、可扩展、可治理、可重组且在会计中不完全可见时发生的变化。书中引入知识承载资本作为核心对象，分析其生成、转化为可治理形式、部署、通过反馈改进、封闭或共享、测量、减值及作为未来生产输入的过程。区分了具身、离身、制度化、公共和公共知识形式，并提出首次转化、认知封闭、反馈捕获、暗资本和预期知识损失等概念。该理论的论证是条件性的和可检验的：现代财富不仅取决于资本积累，还取决于生产性知识如何被治理。
Motivation: 现有经济学理论对知识作为资本的形式和治理机制理解不足，特别是在软件和数据驱动的经济中，需要新的概念框架来解释知识如何成为生产性资产并影响财富创造。
Method: 通过理论构建方法，从亚当·斯密的经典理论出发，提出知识承载资本作为核心分析对象，并发展出首次转化、认知封闭、反馈捕获、暗资本和预期知识损失等概念，以及区分具身、离身、制度化、公共和公共知识形式。
Conclusion: 现代财富不仅取决于资本积累，还取决于生产性知识如何被治理；该理论是条件性的和可检验的，为理解知识经济提供了新的视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Artemis: Anatomy-Resolved inTervention for Eliminating Multimodal NeuroImage confounderS
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal neuroimaging, integrating functional connectivity from fMRI and structural connectivity from DTI, enables non-invasive analysis of brain networks using graph neural networks. However, demographic factors such as age and sex systematically confound the relationship between brain connectivity and clinical outcomes, causing GNNs to exploit spurious shortcuts rather than learning causally invariant representations. While recent causal GNN methods introduce causality at the graph-modeling level, their causal mechanisms remain domain-agnostic without accounting for the real-world confounders inherent in clinical neuroimaging data. Moreover, brain networks are constructed from atlas-based parcellations where each region exhibits distinct sensitivity to demographic factors, necessitating region-aware adjustment. We propose Artemis, a region-level causal framework that bridges this gap with causal intervention at each brain region independently by learning region-specific confounder representations with lightweight parameters. Our adjustment comprehensively utilized the multimodal functional and structural features for graph reasoning as a plug-in module compatible with arbitrary GNN backbones. Experiments on three benchmarks, ADNI for disease diagnosis, OASIS for dementia staging, and HCP for sex classification, demonstrate consistent improvements over representative GNN-based baselines. Multiple supporting experiments further demonstrate statistical significance and neuroscientific interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Artemis，一种区域级因果框架，通过独立干预每个脑区并学习区域特异性混杂表征，消除多模态神经影像中的年龄、性别等混杂因素。该方法作为插件模块兼容任意GNN骨干，在ADNI、OASIS、HCP三个基准上优于代表性基线，并具备统计显著性与神经科学可解释性。
Motivation: 人口统计学因素（如年龄、性别）会系统性地混杂脑连接与临床结果的关系，导致GNN利用虚假捷径；现有因果GNN方法未针对神经影像数据特有的混杂因素进行区域感知调整。
Method: 提出Artemis，在独立脑区级别进行因果干预，通过轻量参数学习区域特异性混杂表征，并综合多模态功能与结构特征进行图推理。
Result: 在ADNI疾病诊断、OASIS痴呆分期和HCP性别分类三个基准上，一致优于代表性GNN基线；多项支持实验验证了统计显著性与神经科学可解释性。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了区域级混杂干预的空白，为多模态神经影像分析提供了可解释的因果学习方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出Artemis，在独立脑区级别进行因果干预，通过轻量参数学习区域特异性混杂表征，并综合多模态功能与结构特征进行图推理。
summary_sections.result: 在ADNI疾病诊断、OASIS痴呆分期和HCP性别分类三个基准上，一致优于代表性GNN基线；多项支持实验验证了统计显著性与神经科学可解释性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作填补了区域级混杂干预的空白，为多模态神经影像分析提供了可解释的因果学习方案。

papers.title: CODEBLOCK: Learning to Supervise Code at the Right Granularity
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning of code LLMs typically applies uniform cross-entropy loss to all response tokens, implicitly assuming that every token provides equally useful learning signal. Recent token-level selection methods challenge this assumption in natural-language SFT by supervising only high-value tokens. However, directly transferring token-level masking to code can break syntactically and semantically coherent program units, because code depends on structural completeness and definition-use relations. We therefore propose CodeBlock, a structure-aware sparse supervision framework that selects structure-complete code evidence rather than isolated tokens. CodeBlock first selects high-quality instruction-response pairs, then partitions code responses into syntactically coherent coding items, estimates their utility by aggregating generalized cross-entropy over core logic tokens, and reranks them with data-flow reach and bridge signals to prioritize blocks that propagate or connect important program dependencies. During training, the full response remains available as context, while loss is applied only to selected code items and informative natural-language tokens. Experiments on six code-generation benchmarks show that CodeBlock achieves stronger average pass@1 than full-token SFT and competitive selection baselines, while using only 1.9% of supervised response tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CodeBlock，一种结构感知的稀疏监督框架，用于代码大语言模型的监督微调。它选择结构完整的代码块而非孤立token进行监督，仅对1.9%的响应token计算损失，在六个代码生成基准上取得优于全token微调的平均pass@1。
Motivation: 现有代码LLM的监督微调对所有响应token施加均匀损失，忽略token重要性差异。直接迁移自然语言领域的token级选择方法会破坏代码的语法和语义完整性。
Method: CodeBlock先筛选高质量指令-响应对，将代码响应分割为语法连贯的代码项，通过聚合核心逻辑token的广义交叉熵估计效用，并利用数据流可达性和桥梁信号重排序，优先训练传播或连接重要依赖的代码块。训练时保留完整响应作为上下文，但仅对选中的代码项和信息性自然语言token计算损失。
Result: 在六个代码生成基准上，CodeBlock的平均pass@1优于全token监督微调和竞争性选择基线，且仅使用1.9%的监督响应token。
Conclusion: 结构感知的稀疏监督能有效提升代码LLM微调的效率与性能，避免破坏代码完整性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking the Solver Bottleneck: Training Task Generators at the Learnable Frontier
papers.abstract_en: The limiting resource for training agents via reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly frontier task supply: valid, solvable tasks just difficult enough to train the current model. As reasoning and agentic models improve, fixed task distributions saturate, while naive synthetic generation yields tasks that are trivial, impossible, or ill-posed. Training a task generator with RL to optimize validity and learnability can address this bottleneck, but direct optimization requires repeated solver rollouts per candidate. For software-engineering (SWE) tasks, a single rollout can take tens of minutes; solver-in-the-loop generator training is intractable. We introduce PROPEL, a solver-amortized framework for training task generators at the targeted solve rate. PROPEL trains a lightweight activation probe on a one-time labeled corpus of generated tasks and solver outcomes. The probe predicts target-solver pass rate from a frozen generator reference model and serves as a proxy for solve rate during generator optimization, reducing generator evaluation to a single forward pass. Across math, code, and software-engineering at multiple model scales, PROPEL shifts generation toward the targeted solve rate: for coding, tasks generated at the learnable frontier increase from $10.1\% \rightarrow 20.0\%$ for a Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct solver and from $5.3\% \rightarrow 12.6\%$ for a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct solver. For SWE, PROPEL increases the share of generations at the targeted solve rate from $9.8\% \rightarrow 19.6\%$ for Qwen3.5-27B on repositories not seen during training of probe and generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PROPEL 框架，通过训练轻量激活探针来近似求解率，从而在不进行多次求解器推演的情况下优化任务生成器。该框架在数学、代码和软件工程任务上将生成的任务向目标求解率转移，例如在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 求解器上，处于可学习前沿的任务比例从 10.1% 提升到 20.0%。
Motivation: 随着强化学习训练，固定任务分布饱和，直接优化任务生成器需要大量求解器推演，对于软件工程任务单次推演耗时数十分钟，不可行。
Method: 训练一个轻量激活探针，基于一次性标注的生成任务和求解器结果语料库，预测目标求解器的通过率，作为求解率的代理，将生成器评估简化为单次前向传播。
Result: 在多个模型尺度上，PROPEL 将生成任务向目标求解率转移：编码任务中，对于 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 求解器，处于前沿的任务从 10.1% 增加到 20.0%；对于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 从 5.3% 到 12.6%；SWE 任务中，对于 Qwen3.5-27B 从未见过的仓库，比例从 9.8% 到 19.6%。
Conclusion: PROPEL 通过求解器摊销实现了在目标求解率处训练任务生成器，使生成器优化变得可行。
