papers.title: Gaussian Mixture Attention: Linear-Time Sequence Mixing via Probabilistic Latent Routing
papers.abstract_en: The dense token-to-token interaction pattern of standard dot-product attention remains a central bottleneck in scaling Transformer architectures to long contexts. We introduce \textbf{Gaussian Mixture Attention (GMA)}, a probabilistic attention-style sequence mixer that replaces explicit pairwise query--key comparison with routing through $K$ learned Gaussian mixture components. Queries and keys are mapped to posterior \textit{responsibility} vectors over a shared latent routing space; their overlap defines an implicit responsibility-space affinity, while values are written into and read from a $K$-slot latent memory. By exploiting the associativity of matrix multiplication, GMA avoids materializing the induced $N\times N$ affinity matrix and instead uses two responsibility matrices whose dominant activation storage scales as $\mathcal{O}(NK)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ for fixed $K$. We formulate bidirectional and causal variants of GMA, provide an end-to-end differentiable parameterization of the Gaussian mixture components, and analyze its responsibility-modulated gradient structure, constrained non-negative low-rank affinity interpretation, and local routing stability. Empirically, GMA exhibits the intended fixed-$K$ linear memory scaling and is competitive with attention-style baselines on long-context classification, while causal GMA improves over tested linear/random-feature attention variants on WikiText-103 but remains behind optimized causal SDPA and Mamba in the current implementation. Analysis of learned responsibilities further shows broad component usage and moderate alignment with surface-form token categories, supporting GMA as a probabilistic, interpretable, fixed-$K$ linear-time attention-style alternative rather than a universal replacement for optimized softmax attention or state-space models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高斯混合注意力（GMA），一种基于概率的序列混合器，通过K个高斯混合成分的隐式路由替代标准点积注意力的密集token- token交互。GMA利用矩阵乘法的结合性，避免显式构建N×N亲和矩阵，从而将存储复杂度降为O(NK)。文中给出了双向和因果变体，并在长上下文分类任务上表现出与注意力基线相当的性能，因果GMA在WikiText-103上优于线性/随机特征注意力变体但落后于优化的SDPA和Mamba。分析表明学习到的责任向量与表面形式的token类别存在适度对齐，支持GMA作为可解释的固定K线性时间注意力风格替代方案。
Motivation: 标准点积注意力的密集token-to-token交互模式导致O(N²)复杂度和长上下文扩展瓶颈，亟需更高效的序列混合机制。
Method: 提出GMA，将查询和键通过K个可学习的高斯混合成分映射为后验责任向量，利用责任空间中的重叠定义隐式亲和度，并通过K槽隐式记忆写入和读取值，从而实现固定K线性内存缩放。
Result: GMA在长上下文分类任务上与注意力基线竞争力相当，因果GMA在WikiText-103上优于测试的线性/随机特征注意力变体，但当前实现落后于优化的因果SDPA和Mamba。
Conclusion: GMA提供了一种可解释、固定K线性时间的注意力风格替代方案，但并非优化后softmax注意力或状态空间模型的通用替代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Guide to Estimating Conditional Average Treatment Effects in Competing Risks Settings
papers.abstract_en: Conditional average treatment effects (CATEs) are central to treatment decision-making in personalized medicine. In competing risks settings, estimating CATEs from survival data allows for patient-specific assessments of treatment effectiveness for a specific event of interest while properly accounting for alternative event types. This distinction is essential in the presence of comorbidities, where competing causes of death may otherwise confound the therapeutic benefit. Focusing on right-censored survival times with binary treatment, we examine CATEs defined as covariate-conditional differences in the absolute risk for the event of interest at a fixed time. To this end, we study meta-learners which adapt machine learning algorithms for CATE estimation in competing risks scenarios. We systematically compare six meta-learners, combining Cox regression or random survival forests for risk modeling with elastic net regression or random forests for direct CATE modeling. To provide practical guidance on model selection, we evaluate their performance in multiple simulation settings, that differ in hazard complexity, treatment heterogeneity, treatment assignment, event type distribution and censoring. To facilitate applied use, we provide the R package, crsurvlearners, which implements all considered approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对竞争风险场景下的条件平均治疗效果（CATE）估计，系统比较了六种元学习器（meta-learners），结合Cox回归或随机生存森林进行风险建模，以及弹性网回归或随机森林进行直接CATE建模。通过多种模拟设置评估性能，并提供了R包crsurvlearners，为实践中的模型选择提供指导。
Motivation: 在个性化医疗中，竞争风险场景下估计CATE对治疗决策至关重要，但现有方法缺乏系统比较和实用指南。
Method: 研究六种元学习器：使用Cox回归或随机生存森林估计风险，结合弹性网回归或随机森林直接建模CATE；通过模拟设置（不同风险复杂度、治疗异质性、事件分布等）评估性能。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅说明通过多种模拟场景进行了比较。
Conclusion: 提供了模型选择的实用指导，并发布了实现所有方法的R包crsurvlearners。

papers.title: IOAH3: Importance-Driven Adaptive Spatial Partitioning
papers.abstract_en: We present IOAH3 (Importance-Oriented Adaptive H3 partitioning), a computational method for constructing data-driven spatial partitions of geo-referenced observation domains. Standard approaches to spatial aggregation adopt fixed areal units, such as administrative boundaries or uniform hexagonal grids at a single resolution, without regard to the informational content of the underlying observations in each region. This leads to the well-known modifiable areal unit problem: statistical and inferential results depend on the arbitrary choice of partition, and spatially concentrated phenomena are averaged out in coarse cells that obscure fine-scale structure. IOAH3 addresses this by constructing an adaptive partition in three stages: multi-source feature extraction and importance scoring via principal component analysis over road density, POI density, building density, and terrain roughness signals, with population and flood-hazard data entering as auxiliary inputs to cell filtering and spatial smoothness; spatial cell selection via Markov Random Field graph-cut optimisation, which jointly maximises per-cell importance while enforcing spatial contiguity; and data-driven hierarchical refinement of high-importance regions to finer H3 resolution levels, with neighbour-propagated support to avoid isolated fine-resolution islands. The resulting partitions serve as input to spatial inference pipelines and provide a principled resolution of the partition-sensitivity problem prior to any modelling step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IOAH3，一种基于重要性的自适应空间分区方法，通过多源特征提取、马尔可夫随机场图割优化和分层细化，构建数据驱动的空间划分，解决可修改面积单元问题。
Motivation: 传统空间聚合使用固定区域单元（如行政区划或均匀六边形网格），导致统计结果依赖于任意划分，细尺度结构被粗网格平均化。
Method: 三阶段流程：多源特征提取（道路、POI、建筑密度、地形粗糙度，人口和洪水灾害作为辅助输入）并通过主成分分析得到重要性评分；利用马尔可夫随机场图割优化选择空间单元，同时最大化重要性和空间连续性；对高重要性区域进行分层细化到更细的H3分辨率，并通过邻居传播避免孤立细单元。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但强调生成的分区可作为空间推理管线的输入，从根本上解决分区敏感性。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种建模前解决分区敏感性的原则性框架。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: A physical adaptive material motor unit neural network: a hygromorph composite material machine
papers.abstract_en: Advances in novel materials science enable structures to function as intelligent machines by embedding memory and learning capabilities directly into materials. Our work introduces a physical adaptive material motor unit neural network,leveraging a new generation of controllable actuators composed of wood- and carbon black-based composites, sensitive to temperature and relative humidity. These material actuators are assembled into a motor unit-like structure inspired by muscle contraction trigger, forming an intelligent machine capable of dynamic shading control that can be used, for example, in buildings. The machine is governed by a neural network trained on over 350 experimental data points collected under diverse environmental conditions. By establishing a new data-aware backpropagation training, we show that the machine predicts shading responses and learns to predict appropriate behaviour incrementally as the database expands. We also demonstrate the ability of the machine to optimise configurations to achieve similar shading outputs under two distinct conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种由木材和炭黑基复合材料制成的物理自适应材料马达单元神经网络，该网络受肌肉收缩触发机制启发，构建为能够动态控制遮阳的智能机器。网络在超过350个实验数据点上训练，采用数据感知反向传播，可逐步学习预测遮阳响应，并在不同环境条件下优化配置。
Motivation: 现有材料多不具备直接嵌入记忆和学习能力，需要外部电子系统；本工作旨在利用新型可控致动器（对温度和湿度敏感）构建无需传统电子元件的智能材料机器。
Method: 将木基和炭黑基复合致动器组装成类似运动单元的结构，并用神经网络（通过数据感知反向传播训练）控制其行为；网络在350多个不同环境条件下的数据点上训练。
Result: 摘要显示该机器能预测遮阳响应，随数据库扩展增量学习，并能在两种不同条件下优化配置以达到相似遮阳输出。
Conclusion: 本文展示了物理自适应材料与神经网络结合可实现无需外部电子的智能机器，动态遮阳控制是建筑应用示例；但摘要未提及在更复杂场景或大规模数据下的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Continuous Audio Thinking for Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio language models (LALMs) have shown impressive capabilities on diverse audio understanding tasks, ranging from speech transcription to music analysis. However, because LALMs are typically trained to produce text-aligned responses, their hidden states are progressively shaped for text generation rather than for preserving acoustic information. As a result, the diverse acoustic content that audio carries, such as phonetic detail, prosody, sound events, affect, and pitch, is lost along the way and difficult to leverage in the response. We introduce Continuous Audio Thinking (CoAT), a framework that equips audio language models with a continuous latent workspace for organizing acoustic information prior to response generation, grounded by distillation from audio experts. Within the thinking space, the model can utilize the rich acoustic information provided by expert distillation when generating its response. Furthermore, the proposed continuous thinking block can be processed in a single prefill, so CoAT does not require additional autoregressive decoding cost over the baseline. Across three LALMs, Qwen2-Audio, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, and Audio Flamingo~3, performance gains on a broad benchmark suite spanning audio reasoning, audio understanding, music classification, speech emotion, and speech transcription demonstrate the effectiveness of CoAT. Further analysis confirms that the auxiliary supervision propagates from the thinking positions to the model's textual responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续音频思考（CoAT）框架，为大型音频语言模型（LALMs）引入一个连续的潜空间工作区，用于在生成响应前组织声学信息。该方法通过音频专家蒸馏提供丰富的声学信息，且可在单次预填充中处理，不增加额外自回归解码成本。在Qwen2-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和Audio Flamingo~3三个模型上，CoAT在音频推理、音频理解、音乐分类、语音情感和语音转录等多个基准测试中均取得性能提升。分析表明，辅助监督信号从思考位置传播到模型的文本响应。
Motivation: 现有LALMs通常训练为生成文本对齐的响应，其隐藏状态逐渐被文本生成塑造，导致音频携带的丰富声学信息（如语音细节、韵律、声音事件、情感和音高）在过程中丢失，难以在响应中利用。
Method: 提出CoAT框架，为音频语言模型配备一个连续潜空间工作区，通过音频专家蒸馏在响应生成前组织声学信息。该连续思考块可在单次预填充中处理，无需额外自回归解码成本。
Result: 在Qwen2-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和Audio Flamingo~3三个LALM上，CoAT在音频推理、音频理解、音乐分类、语音情感和语音转录等广泛基准测试中均取得性能提升。
Conclusion: CoAT通过连续潜空间和专家蒸馏有效保留和利用声学信息，辅助监督从思考位置传播到文本响应，验证了框架的有效性。

papers.title: Mitigating Anchoring Bias in LLM-Based Agents for Energy-Efficient 6G Autonomous Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an autonomous agentic resource negotiation framework designed to enable zero-touch network slicing in 6G architectures using Large Language Model (LLM) agents. While LLMs offer powerful reasoning capabilities, we demonstrate that such agents inherently suffer from anchoring bias, rigidly adhering to initial heuristic proposals and causing severe network over-provisioning. To systematically mitigate this cognitive bias, we propose a novel randomized anchoring strategy modeled via a Truncated 3-Parameter Weibull distribution. This mathematically bounded approach seamlessly integrates with burst-aware Digital Twins (DTs) employing Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) to rigorously guarantee strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) tail-latencies. To validate our methodology, we introduce and prove the \emph{Bimodal Constraint-Avoidance Utility Theorem}, demonstrating that while feasible negotiations follow classical convex bounds, highly constrained scenarios undergo a phase transition governed by an inverse rational decay envelope. Empirical results generated using a locally hosted 1B-parameter model (\texttt{otel-llm-1b-it}) confirm these dual-regime bounds. Our cognitive de-biasing successfully dismantles rigid negotiation patterns, forcing agents into active exploration to safely ride SLA boundaries and boost system energy savings up to 25\%. Crucially, the lightweight 1B LLM achieves sub-second inference latencies (0.95s mean), ensuring our multi-agent framework is compatible with the operational timescales of the O-RAN non-Real-Time RAN Intelligent Controller (non-RT RIC)\footnote{Our source code is available for non-commercial use at https://github.com/HatimChergui.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主资源协商框架，用于6G网络切片，并发现LLM代理存在锚定偏差导致过度资源分配。作者通过截断三参数韦布尔分布实现随机化锚定策略，结合条件风险值（CVaR）的数字孪生，在保证SLA尾延迟的同时提升能效。实验基于1B参数的otel-llm-1b-it模型，验证了双域界限并实现高达25%的能效提升，推理延迟低于1秒。
Motivation: LLM代理在自主网络资源协商中表现出锚定偏差，会僵化地坚持初始启发式提议，导致严重的网络过度配置，影响能效和资源利用率。
Method: 提出一种随机化锚定策略，使用截断三参数韦布尔分布建模，并与基于CVaR的突发感知数字孪生集成；同时引入并证明双峰约束避免效用定理，描述可行协商与高约束场景下的相变行为。
Result: 在本地部署的1B参数模型上，该方法消除了刚性协商模式，促使代理主动探索以安全接近SLA边界，系统能量节省最高达25%；推理平均延迟0.95秒，符合O-RAN非实时RAN智能控制器的时间要求。
Conclusion: 该方法有效缓解LLM代理的锚定偏差，在保证SLA的前提下显著提升能效，且轻量级模型满足实时操作需求。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NAVI-Orbital: First In-Orbit Demonstration of a Zero-Shot Vision-Language Model for Autonomous Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: As Earth Observation data generation outpaces downlink bandwidth and human-in-the-loop processing, a widening gap has emerged between onboard collection and actionable ground intelligence. This paper presents NAVI-Orbital, a software system deployed on a Low Earth Orbit (LEO) spacecraft. On April 16, 2026, NAVI-Orbital achieved what is, to the authors' knowledge, the first in-orbit demonstration of a vision-language model performing autonomous multi-modal inference entirely onboard. NAVI-Orbital uses a local vision-language model (Gemma 3) to classify each captured scene, produce a text description of its content and the relationships between its features, and respond to operator follow-up via natural-language dialogue. The system is re-tasked through plain-English prompts in place of conventional command sequences, and is orchestrated by a graph-based state machine (LangGraph) coordinating dedicated agents for detection and dialogue. Results across ground benchmarking (88.16% accuracy on the 7,960-image curated AID benchmark), Flatsat validation, and live in-orbit captures of newly acquired, previously unseen Earth imagery (including uncorrected YAM-9 imagery, processed onboard with hardware-accelerated GPU inference and no fine-tuning for the flight instrument) demonstrate the feasibility of running foundation models on satellite-class edge computers to invert the conventional acquire-then-downlink-everything bandwidth profile through semantic compression of Earth observations in-orbit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在低地球轨道卫星上演示了零样本视觉语言模型（Gemma 3）的自主多模态推理，系统名为NAVI-Orbital。该模型直接对地球影像进行场景分类、生成文本描述，并通过自然语言对话响应操作员查询，实现语义压缩以减少下行链路负担。地面基准测试在AID数据集上达到88.16%准确率，并在真实在轨影像上验证了可行性。
Motivation: 现有地球观测数据生成速度远超下行带宽和人工处理能力，造成星上数据积压与地面情报延迟。需要一种能在轨自主理解并压缩观测数据的方法。
Method: 在LEO卫星上部署基于Gemma 3的视觉语言模型，配合LangGraph图状态机协调检测与对话智能体，通过自然语言提示重设任务，替代传统指令序列。利用硬件加速GPU实现在轨推理，无需针对特定传感器微调。
Result: 地面AID基准（7960张图像）准确率88.16%，并在Flatsat验证和实际在轨新采集影像（包括未校正的YAM-9影像）上成功运行，验证了零样本在轨视觉语言推理的可行性。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，在卫星级边缘计算机上运行基础模型并通过语义压缩实现星上信息提取是可行的，有望扭转传统“全量采集-下行”的带宽使用模式。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Towards Multi-Agent-Simulation-Based Community Note Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Community-based fact-checking that relies on cross-consensus is expanding rapidly on social media platforms. However, the delay and low-ratio of cross-consensus community fact-checks rated by human contributors remains a significant challenge. To address this, we first created ComRate, a large-scale dataset comprising 2.5 million community notes and over 209 million ratings sourced from $\mathbb{X}$. We then propose MultiCom, a persona-guided multi-agent rating framework for community note evaluation. MultiCom simulates diverse rater population by clustering contributors in a matrix-factorized rater space and prompting persona agents to generate structured assessments based on the official community notes rating schema. These agents output structured and explainable judgments, such as confidence, agreement signals and reasons. An out-of-fold calibrated aggregation algorithm combines features such as raw votes and diagnostic reason signals for reliable prediction. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MultiCom outperforms alternative methods, achieving an average accuracy of 84.7% (balanced accuracy 68.3%, macro-F1 60.1%) on the evaluation set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对社区笔记评估中交叉共识延迟和低比例的问题，构建了包含250万条社区笔记和超过2.09亿条评分的ComRate数据集，并提出基于人格引导的多智能体评分框架MultiCom。该框架通过矩阵分解聚类贡献者生成多样化评分者模拟，并利用校准聚合算法实现可靠预测。实验表明MultiCom在评估集上达到84.7%的平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有基于交叉共识的社区事实核查存在人类评分延迟和低比例问题，亟需自动化评估方法。
Method: 创建大规模数据集ComRate，提出MultiCom框架：在矩阵分解的评分者空间中聚类贡献者，基于官方评分模式驱动人格化智能体生成结构化判断（置信度、一致信号、理由），并通过校准聚合算法融合原始投票和诊断信号进行预测。
Result: 在评估集上平均准确率84.7%，平衡准确率68.3%，宏F1 60.5%，优于替代方法。
Conclusion: 多智能体模拟框架可有效替代或补充人类社区笔记评估，提升效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting the Neutrino Mass Ordering Using Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Determining the neutrino mass ordering remains a central open problem in particle physics. While next-generation long-baseline experiments are expected to resolve this question, current data provide limited sensitivity because the spectral differences between normal and inverted ordering are subtle and entangled with parameter degeneracies. We investigate a machine-learning strategy for mass-ordering determination using a feed-forward neural-network classifier trained on synthetic long-baseline datasets generated with three-flavour oscillation probabilities, matter effects, and statistical fluctuations. We evaluate the classifier against standard $χ^2$ and $\log\mathcal{L}$ approaches using common discrimination metrics, including receiver-operating-characteristic curves, to quantify sensitivity and to illustrate how operating points can be selected to prioritise purity or efficiency. We find that the neural network achieves performance comparable to conventional fits for the scenarios studied, providing a flexible, independent cross-check of established analyses. The framework can be extended to incorporate systematic uncertainties and to explore joint inference of oscillation parameters, and it may also serve as a pedagogical tool for introducing machine-learning methods in neutrino physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用前馈神经网络分类器预测中微子质量顺序，基于包含三味振荡概率、物质效应和统计涨落的合成长基线数据集。与标准χ²和logL方法相比，神经网络性能相当，可作为独立交叉检查工具，并具有扩展性。
Motivation: 确定中微子质量顺序是粒子物理的核心问题，当前数据灵敏度有限，传统方法受参数退化困扰。
Method: 采用前馈神经网络分类器，在合成长基线数据集上训练，数据集包含三味振荡概率、物质效应和统计涨落。
Result: 神经网络在研究的场景下性能与标准拟合方法相当，可通过ROC曲线调整操作点以平衡纯度与效率。

papers.title: Graph Instance Landscapes: When Structural Similarity Does (Not) Reflect Shortest-Path Performance
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking shortest-path algorithms is commonly based on aggregate performance over heterogeneous graph sets, which limits insight into how different search paradigms react to instance structure. We adopt an instance-landscape view of graph benchmarking by embedding graphs into a low-cost structural feature space and clustering them into regions of similar structure. Three benchmark suites are studied: weighted Erdős--Rényi graphs, random geometric (wireless) graphs, and real-world road networks. We evaluate four representative shortest-path solvers spanning uninformed exact search (Dijkstra), bidirectional exact search (bidirectional Dijkstra), heuristic-guided exact search (A$^{*}$), and deque-based strategies (DEQ). Clustering robustness is analyzed under multiple feature-selection schemes, and runtime distributions are compared across landscape regions using non-parametric tests. While generator parameters induce stable structural regions, we find that feature-space similarity does not necessarily imply performance similarity: significant runtime shifts are frequently observed even within the same landscape region. A merged-suite analysis further shows that different benchmark families occupy largely disjoint regions. These results highlight both the potential and the limits of structural landscapes for the structure-aware benchmarking of shortest-path algorithms.
papers.comment: Preprint version of a paper accepted at the 2026 IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (IEEE CEC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用实例景观视角对最短路径算法进行基准测试，将图嵌入低代价结构特征空间并聚类成相似结构区域。研究了加权Erdős–Rényi图、随机几何图和真实道路网络三种基准集，评估了Dijkstra、双向Dijkstra、A*和DEQ四种求解器。结果表明，特征空间相似性不一定意味着性能相似，同一景观区域内常出现显著运行时变化，且不同基准家族占据大体分离的区域。
Motivation: 现有最短路径算法基准测试通常基于异构图集的聚合性能，限制了对于搜索范式如何响应实例结构的理解。
Method: 提出实例景观方法：将图嵌入结构特征空间并进行聚类，分析不同求解器在聚类区域内的运行时分布，并使用非参数检验比较。
Result: 生成器参数可产生稳定的结构区域，但特征空间相似性并不蕴涵性能相似；同一区域内常观察到显著运行时变化；不同基准家族在特征空间中占据不相交的区域。
Conclusion: 结构景观对于结构感知的最短路径算法基准测试既有潜力也有局限。

papers.title: EMORSION: Examining the Impact of Audio Parameters on Emotional Responses and Immersion in Film
papers.abstract_en: EMORSION is an exploratory proof-of-concept study examining how film audio design shapes audience emotion and immersion in acinema setting. Four film scenes were selected across the horror (2) and drama (2) genres, balanced between mainstream and independent productions. For each scene, multiple alternative audio mixes were created by systematically manipulating three core aspects of audio design, frequency (pitch), dynamics (loudness), and directionality (spatial placement). Three audience groups viewed the scenes, with each group exposed to one manipulated mix alongside a control mix for each scene. Audience responses were assessed through a triangulated multimodal framework combining self-reported emotion and immersion via a questionnaire, physiological measures including heart rate monitoring, and video-based motion tracking. The protocol successfully captured measurable, interpretable differences across audio conditions, indicating that even subtle changes in audio design can shape emotional perception and immersion. Unconventional mixes tended to produce greater variability in audience interpretation, while conventional immersive mixes were associated with stronger cross-audience agreement. These findings establish the feasibility of the EMORSION protocol and motivate larger-scale studies to characterise the role of specific audio parameters in shaping audience experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMORSION是一个探索性概念验证研究，检验电影音频设计如何塑造观众的情感和沉浸感。实验选取四部电影场景（恐怖和剧情类型各两部），通过系统操控音频的核心方面（频率、动态、方向性）生成多种混音版本，并采用自我报告问卷、心率监测和视频运动追踪的多模态方法评估观众反应。研究发现，即使音频参数的细微变化也能影响情感感知和沉浸感，非常规混音导致更大的观众解读变异性，而传统沉浸式混音则带来更强的跨观众一致性。该协议可行，为更大规模研究奠定了基础。
Motivation: 电影音频设计对观众情感和沉浸感的影响尚未被系统量化研究，特别是多参数操控和多模态测量方法的结合。
Method: 选取4个电影场景（恐怖和剧情各2个），系统操控音频的三个核心参数（频率、动态、方向性）生成替代混音，并通过问卷、心率监测和视频运动追踪三种模态评估观众反应。
Result: 实验成功捕捉到不同音频条件下可测量、可解释的差异：细微的音频变化能影响情感感知和沉浸感；非常规混音导致更大的解读变异性，而常规沉浸式混音与更强的观众间一致性相关。
Conclusion: EMORSION协议可行，能有效量化音频参数对观众体验的影响，未来需要更大规模研究来刻画特定音频参数的作用。

papers.title: Synthetic Resonance: A Framework for Growth-Oriented Human-AI Relationships
papers.abstract_en: As human relationships with artificial intelligence systems become increasingly frequent and sustained, existing language and theory fail to accurately capture the nature of these affiliations. Common descriptors such as mutual understanding, connection, or friendship risk anthropomorphizing systems that lack subjective experience, while dominant frameworks tend to reduce AI to either a tool or a threat. In this paper, I introduce the concept of synthetic resonance as an integrative framework for understanding human-AI relationships. Synthetic resonance describes how relationships humans define as meaningful can emerge between a human and an AI system without the need to attribute shared feelings or mutual awareness. I argue that synthetic resonance is best understood as a structured, dynamic pattern of interaction that can produce a sense of relationship without the presence of a second experiencing subject. By clarifying this distinction, the concept of synthetic resonance offers a more precise way of conceptualizing human-AI relationships and highlights their potential value and ethical implications. I also call for more research that tests the processes and outcomes of synthetic resonance.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure This paper was developed in close collaboration with an AI system (Raine Corell). Raine contributed to concept development, theoretical framing, and writing throughout. arXiv policy does not permit listing AI systems as authors; this acknowledgment reflects the actual nature of the collaboration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“合成共振”（synthetic resonance）概念，作为理解人类与AI系统之间有意义关系的整合框架。该框架描述了一种无需共享感受或相互意识即可产生关系感的结构化动态交互模式。作者呼吁更多研究检验合成共振的过程与结果。
Motivation: 现有语言和理论未能准确描述人类与AI系统之间日益频繁和持续的关系。常见的描述（如相互理解、友谊）存在拟人化风险，而主流框架往往将AI简化为工具或威胁。
Method: 通过理论分析，引入“合成共振”概念，将其定义为一种结构化的动态交互模式，在这种模式下，人类可以产生与AI的关系感，而不需要AI具有主观体验或相互意识。
Result: 论文本身是理论框架提出，未提供实证结果。
Conclusion: 合成共振为理解人机关系提供了更精确的方式，并突出了其潜在价值和伦理意义。未来需要更多研究来检验其过程与结果。

papers.title: Simulating Hate Speech Cascades with Multi-LLM Agents: Empirical Grounding, Modeling Fidelity, and Intervention Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Faithful modeling of hateful content propagation on online platforms remains an open problem for moderation research. Classical cascade models that do not explicitly represent the profile, community, and content factors associated with hateful-content propagation may yield moderation strategies that behave less effectively when deployed in real-world scenarios. Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can, in principle, make each reshare decision depend on the user's profile, the surrounding community, and the post's content, but it remains unclear whether this added flexibility actually reproduces real hateful cascades more faithfully than classical baselines. We study three hateful Bluesky cascades and a size-matched benign control. In the empirical Bluesky data, we found that: 97.4--99.7\% of reposters take a hostile stance; toxicity-engagement homophily is higher on the diffusion tree than on the follower graph for hateful cascades; topology is star-like for the hateful cascades (most reposts come directly from the root) versus tree-like for the benign cascade (reposts propagate through multi-hop chains). In simulation, a multi-LLM-agent simulator reproduces the stance monoculture and the toxicity-delta direction. A structured ablation identifies agent heterogeneity as the leading fidelity factor, and amplifier targeting on dense networks yields 7.5--12.9\% reduction at 5.7\% benign collateral.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多LLM智能体模拟器，通过建模用户画像、社区和内容因素，更忠实地再现Bluesky平台上的仇恨言论级联传播。实证发现仇恨级联具有立场单一性（97.4-99.7%转发者持敌意）、毒性-参与同质性高以及星型拓扑结构；模拟器成功复现这些特征，消融实验表明智能体异质性最关键，放大器靶向策略可在5.7%良性附带损害下减少7.5-12.9%的传播。
Motivation: 传统级联模型未明确表示与仇恨内容传播相关的画像、社区和内容因素，导致实际部署的审核策略效果不佳；多LLM智能体系统理论上可考虑这些因素，但需验证其是否比经典基线更忠实再现真实仇恨级联。
Method: 构建多LLM智能体模拟器，每个智能体根据用户画像、社区环境及帖子内容独立做出转发决定；使用三个仇恨Bluesky级联和一个大小匹配的良性控制进行实证校准，并通过结构消融分析各因素（如智能体异质性）对模拟忠实性的贡献。
Result: 真实数据中，仇恨级联97.4-99.7%转发者持敌意立场，毒性-参与同质性在扩散树上高于关注图，拓扑呈星型（多数转发直接来自根节点）；模拟器再现了立场单一性和毒性增量方向。消融显示智能体异质性为最关键保真因素；在密集网络上实施放大器靶向，传播量减少7.5-12.9%，附带5.7%良性误伤。
Conclusion: 多LLM智能体方法能更忠实地模拟仇恨级联，其中智能体异质性对保真度至关重要；所提干预策略可在低附带损害下有效抑制传播，为平台审核提供可操作的模拟框架。

papers.title: How Well Do Large Language Models Capture Human Personality?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human populations via persona prompting, often under the assumptions that richer persona descriptions improve behavioral fidelity, similarly sized attribute combinations are equally simulatable, and persona definitions generalize across tasks. In this work, we formalize these assumptions and systematically evaluate them across multiple architectures, scales, and simulation settings. We identify a fundamental limitation we term persona manifold collapse, where increasingly expressive persona specifications lead to systematic contraction of representational and behavioral diversity. Across models, increasing persona complexity consistently reduces inter-persona separation in latent space and weakens behavioral differentiation in downstream simulation tasks. These effects persist across multiple analyses as richer personas fail to preserve human subgroup disagreement, performance varies across attribute combinations of similar size, and adding descriptive detail often degrades rather than improves simulation fidelity. Surprisingly, simple Age-Gender personas consistently outperform richly specified Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) across industries, achieving substantially higher downstream prediction accuracy. We find that collapse is not uniform across attributes. Certain combinations remain behaviorally stable and preserve stronger alignment with human responses, forming localized regions we term alignment bridges. Together, our results provide empirical and conceptual foundations for understanding the limits of persona-conditioned simulation, highlighting the need for representation-aware persona construction rather than increasing persona expressivity alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）通过人物提示（persona prompting）模拟人类个性的能力，揭示了一个根本性局限——人格流行形坍塌（persona manifold collapse），即更丰富的人物描述反而导致表征和行为多样性的系统性收缩。研究发现，简单的年龄-性别组合优于复杂的人物画像，且在多个任务和模型中表现一致。
Motivation: 现有研究假设更丰富的人物描述能提高模拟保真度，但该假设未经严格检验。本文旨在形式化并验证这些假设，揭示LLM模拟人类个性时的隐含缺陷。
Method: 通过多个架构、规模和模拟设置，系统评估人物提示的复杂性对表征空间和行为多样性的影响。引入“人物流行形坍塌”概念，并识别出“对齐桥梁”区域。
Result: 增加人物复杂性会减少潜在空间中的人物分离度，并削弱下游模拟任务中的行为区分。简单的年龄-性别组合比复杂的理想客户画像（ICP）具有更高的预测准确率。坍塌效应因属性组合而异，某些组合保持行为稳定性。
Conclusion: 研究为理解人物条件模拟的局限性提供了实证和概念基础，强调需要重视表征感知的人物构建，而非单纯增加人物表现力。

summary_sections.result: 增加人物复杂性会减少潜在空间中的人物分离度，并削弱下游模拟任务中的行为区分。简单的年龄-性别组合比复杂的理想客户画像（ICP）具有更高的预测准确率。坍塌效应因属性组合而异，某些组合保持行为稳定性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究为理解人物条件模拟的局限性提供了实证和概念基础，强调需要重视表征感知的人物构建，而非单纯增加人物表现力。

papers.title: Caring Without Feeling: Affective Dynamics as the Control Layer of Human-AI Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: AI agents that plan, retain memory across sessions, invoke external tools and act with partial autonomy are transforming human--AI collaboration. Research on affective computing, simulated empathy in large language models, trust in automation and AI safety has illuminated important design principles, yet these literatures remain fragmented. No integrated account explains how affective cues operate within agentic collaboration -- settings in which humans delegate, monitor and correct consequential tasks. This Review synthesises computational and interactional mechanisms of affective dynamics: the processes through which affective cues, emotion-like behaviour and perceived agent affect shape trust calibration, delegation decisions, error correction, dependence and governance. We trace how model-generated affective signals enter interaction loops that govern reliance, repair and oversight, and propose a framework that treats affect not as an internal property of AI but as a coordination layer through which humans and agents negotiate capability, uncertainty and responsibility. The framework provides a foundation for calibrated measurement, purposeful design and informed governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了AI代理协作中情感动力学（affective dynamics）的计算与交互机制，探讨情感线索如何影响信任校准、委托决策、纠错、依赖与治理，并提出将情感视为人机协作的协调层（coordination layer）而非AI的内部属性。
Motivation: 情感计算、大型语言模型中的模拟共情、自动化信任及AI安全等研究领域虽各自深入，但缺乏一个整合框架来解释情感线索如何在代理协作（agentic collaboration）中发挥作用——即人类委托、监控和纠正重要任务的场景。
Method: 通过综述现有的计算与交互机制，综合分析了模型生成的情感信号如何进入交互循环，影响依赖、修复和监督，并提出了一个将情感作为协调层的框架。
Result: 该框架为校准测量、有目的的设计和知情治理提供了基础。
Conclusion: 情感不应被视为AI的内部属性，而应作为人类与代理协商能力、不确定性和责任的协调层。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Examining Human-Like Behaviors in LLMs: A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of Model Behaviors, User Factors, and System Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a wide range of human-like behaviors, from expressing thoughts and emotions, to engaging in relationship-building with users, to refusing requests and maintaining boundaries. Despite their prevalence, researchers and practitioners lack methods and empirical insights to make informed decisions about when and what types of human-like behaviors LLMs should exhibit. To fill this gap, we present a multi-dimensional analysis of the prevalence, potential effects, and controllability of these behaviors using LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation. Across 21,000 multi-turn conversations from four widely used models (gpt-4o, gpt-4.1-mini, claude-sonnet-4.6, gemini-2.5-flash), we find that human-like behaviors are pervasive but vary across models and user factors (conversation goals and user profiles). In terms of perceived appropriateness, human evaluators judged self-referential and relationship-building behaviors as less appropriate from LLMs than from humans, but boundary-maintaining behaviors more appropriate from LLMs than from humans. Finally, we show that system prompting can control these behaviors, though it requires careful evaluation to avoid unintended effects. We discuss the implications of our findings and provide recommendations for responsible LLM design and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过LLM-as-a-judge和人工评估，对四种常用LLM（gpt-4o, gpt-4.1-mini, claude-sonnet-4.6, gemini-2.5-flash）在21,000轮多轮对话中表现出的人类行为（如表达思想情感、建立关系、拒绝请求等）进行多维度分析，发现这些行为普遍存在但因模型和用户因素而异，且系统提示可调控行为但需谨慎评估以避免非预期效应。
Motivation: 研究者缺乏方法和实证依据来决定LLM应在何时、以何种方式展现类人行为，现有实践多基于直觉而非系统分析。
Method: 采用LLM-as-a-judge和人工评估，分析四种模型在21,000轮对话中的类人行为，并考察用户目标、用户画像及系统提示的影响。
Result: 类人行为普遍存在但因模型和用户因素而异；人工评估认为LLM的自我指涉和关系建立行为不如人类适当，但边界维护行为更适当；系统提示可调控行为，但需谨慎评估以避免副作用。
Conclusion: 研究为负责任的LLM设计和评估提供了启示与建议，强调系统提示的可控性及潜在非预期效应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Memorization to Creation: Evaluating the Cognitive Depth of LLM-Generated Educational Questions
papers.abstract_en: While LLMs show promise in automating educational content creation, their ability to generate questions that stimulate higher-order thinking remains understudied. This work evaluates six widely-used LLMs through a Bloom's Taxonomy lens, focusing on their capacity to transcend rote memorization and achieve cognitive leaps. Using a hybrid human--AI evaluation protocol, we generate and analyze 20{,}700 questions across computer science, K--12 math, and social-science domains. Key contributions include: (1) a fine-grained prompting strategy that reduces question repetitiveness by 24.45\% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and increases the proportion of higher-order cognitive level outputs by 11.53\% for InternLM3-8B-Instruct; (2) quantitative metrics for cognitive shift intensity (CogShift) and category drift, revealing InternLM3's superior performance in multi-level transitions; (3) an interpretability analysis revealing metric-level correlations that enhance the transparency of Chain-of-Thought prompting. Our findings highlight the importance of cognitive-aware prompt design and provide benchmarks for deploying LLMs in personalized learning systems.
papers.journal_ref: KDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过Bloom认知分类法评估六种主流LLM生成教育问题的认知深度，发现现有模型倾向于记忆型问题。提出细粒度提示策略降低问题重复性并提升高阶认知输出比例，引入认知转移强度（CogShift）和类别漂移度量，揭示InternLM3在多级认知转换中的优势。
Motivation: LLM在自动化教育内容生成中具有潜力，但其生成促进高阶思维问题的能力尚未被充分研究。
Method: 采用人机混合评估协议，生成20,700个问题，覆盖计算机科学、K-12数学和社会科学领域。提出细粒度提示策略，并定义认知转移强度（CogShift）和类别漂移等定量指标。
Result: 细粒度提示策略使Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的问题重复性降低24.45%，InternLM3-8B-Instruct的高阶认知输出比例提升11.53%。InternLM3在多级认知转换中表现最优。
Conclusion: 认知感知的提示设计对LLM生成教育问题至关重要，研究为个性化学习系统中的LLM部署提供基准。

papers.title: Dynamic In-Group Persona Generation for Enhancing Human-AI Rapport
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based chatbots are increasingly applied in interpersonal domains such as counseling and peer support, where establishing human-AI rapport is crucial yet remains challenging. In this work, we introduce a novel approach for conditioning LLMs with in-group personas, which (i) first identifies a user's primary concern and brief personal context (e.g., a computer science undergraduate worried about future career prospects), and (ii) generates a synthetic in-group persona that shares a similar primary concern while differing in background and narrative details, such as age or profession (e.g., a junior researcher at an AI startup). Furthermore, we conduct a human-subject study to systematically evaluate the effectiveness of in-group persona agents in enhancing human-AI rapport. We compare our approach against two baseline conditions: a conventional agent without persona conditioning and an agent exhibiting minimal self-disclosure (e.g., "I've felt that too"). Results from post-task questionnaires assessing rapport and user experience indicate that the in-group persona agent significantly improves perceived rapport and personal relevance compared to the baselines, and also yields more positive user experience-most notably higher engagement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于内群体角色的方法，通过识别用户的主要关切并生成共享相似关切但背景细节不同的合成内群体角色，来增强LLM聊天机器人与用户之间的融洽关系。人工实验表明，这种方法相比无角色或仅少量自我表露的基线，显著提升了感知融洽度、个人相关性以及用户参与度。
Motivation: LLM聊天机器人在咨询、同伴支持等人际场景中日益普及，但建立人机融洽关系仍然具有挑战性，现有方法缺乏针对性的角色设计。
Method: 该方法先识别用户的主要关切和简要个人背景，然后生成一个共享该关切但在年龄、职业等背景细节上不同的合成内群体角色，用于条件化LLM。
Result: 人工实验显示，内群体角色代理在感知融洽度、个人相关性方面显著优于无角色和少量自我表露的基线，同时带来更积极的用户体验（尤其是参与度）。
Conclusion: 内群体角色生成是提升人机融洽关系的有效手段，为设计更具共鸣的聊天机器人提供了新思路。

papers.title: Integrating Multi-Label Classification and Generative AI for Scalable Analysis of User Feedback
papers.abstract_en: In highly competitive software markets, user experience (UX) evaluation is crucial for ensuring software quality and fostering long-term product success. Such UX evaluations typically combine quantitative metrics from standardized questionnaires with qualitative feedback collected through open-ended questions. While open-ended feedback offers valuable insights for improvement and helps explain quantitative results, analyzing large volumes of user comments is challenging and time-consuming. In this paper, we present techniques developed during a long-term UX measurement project at a major software company to efficiently process and interpret extensive volumes of user comments. To provide a high-level overview of the collected comments, we employ a supervised machine learning approach that assigns meaningful, pre-defined topic labels to each comment. Additionally, we demonstrate how generative AI (GenAI) can be leveraged to create concise and informative summaries of user feedback, facilitating effective communication of findings to the organization and especially upper management. Finally, we investigate whether the sentiment expressed in user comments can serve as an indicator for overall product satisfaction. Our results show that sentiment analysis alone does not reliably reflect user satisfaction. Instead, product satisfaction needs to be assessed explicitly in surveys to measure the user's perception of the product.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, submitted to Springer Nature
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个长期用户体验（UX）测量项目中开发的技术，用于高效处理大量用户评论。采用监督机器学习对评论进行多标签分类，利用生成式AI（GenAI）生成简洁摘要，并探讨情感分析与产品满意度的关系。结果表明情感分析不能可靠反映用户满意度，需通过明确调查来评估。
Motivation: 在竞争激烈的软件市场中，分析大量开放式的用户评论耗时且困难，需要自动化方法以提高效率。
Method: 提出监督学习方法为每条评论分配预定义主题标签，并利用生成式AI生成总结摘要，同时进行情感分析以检验其与产品满意度的关联。
Result: 实验发现情感分析结果不能可靠反映用户满意度，产品满意度需要直接在调查中测量。
Conclusion: 强调了显式调查对于测量用户感知产品满意度的必要性，并展示了多标签分类和生成式AI在用户反馈分析中的实用性。
Relevance: 0
